e.en: He wore a plain white {t-shirt} and faded jeans.
e.zh: 他穿着一件素白T恤和褪色的牛仔裤。

e.en: The band sells a limited edition tour {t-shirt} online.
e.zh: 乐队在网上出售限量版巡演T恤。

e.en: She designs custom {t-shirts} for small businesses.
e.zh: 她为小型企业设计定制T恤。

e.en: All graphic {t-shirts} are on sale this weekend.
e.zh: 本周末所有印花T恤都在打折。

tab.t:
n. 标签页；选项卡
n. 账单

e.en: The herald wore a colorful {tabard} bearing the royal crest.
e.zh: 传令官穿着印有王室徽章的彩色罩袍。

e.en: Knights at the festival paraded in matching red {tabard} costumes.
e.zh: 节日上的骑士们身着配套的红色罩袍列队游行。

e.en: He shook a few drops of {tabasco} onto his eggs.
e.zh: 他往鸡蛋上洒了几滴塔巴斯科辣酱。

e.en: The chili recipe calls for a generous splash of {tabasco}.
e.zh: 这道辣味菜需要加足量的塔巴斯科辣酱。

tabbouleh.t: n. 塔布勒（中东香草沙拉）

e.en: She ordered {tabbouleh} with extra parsley and lemon.
e.zh: 她点了一份多加香芹和柠檬的塔布勒沙拉。

e.en: Fresh {tabbouleh} pairs perfectly with grilled chicken skewers.
e.zh: 新鲜的塔布勒沙拉与烤鸡肉串是绝配。

tabby.t:
n. 虎斑猫
adj. 有斑纹的

e.en: A friendly {tabby} cat dozed on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只温顺的虎斑猫在窗台上打盹。

e.en: Their new kitten is a striped orange {tabby}.
e.zh: 他们的新小猫是只橙色条纹的虎斑猫。

e.en: The choir sang inside the historic stone {tabernacle}.
e.zh: 唱诗班在那座历史悠久的石砌礼拜堂里歌唱。

e.en: The priest placed the chalice within the gilded {tabernacle}.
e.zh: 神父将圣杯放入镀金的圣龛内。

tabla.t: n. 塔布拉鼓（印度手鼓）

e.en: He learned to play the {tabla} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他跟着祖父学会了演奏塔布拉鼓。

e.en: The classical concert featured sitar and {tabla} together.
e.zh: 这场古典音乐会有西塔琴与塔布拉鼓的合奏。

e.en: Beginners often learn guitar from {tablature} instead of sheet music.
e.zh: 初学者常用六线谱而不是五线谱学吉他。

e.en: He posted the song's {tablature} on his fan website.
e.zh: 他在粉丝网站上发布了这首歌的吉他六线谱。

table.t:
n. 桌子；表格
v. 搁置（议案）

e.en: Please clear the {table} before dessert is served.
e.zh: 上甜点前请把桌子清理干净。

e.en: The report includes a {table} comparing quarterly sales figures.
e.zh: 该报告包含一张比较各季度销售数据的表格。

e.en: The painting presents a peaceful rural {tableau} at dusk.
e.zh: 这幅画呈现出黄昏时分宁静的乡村景象。

e.en: Students arranged a living {tableau} based on the famous photograph.
e.zh: 学生们根据那张著名照片摆出了一个真人造型。

e.en: She spread a checkered {tablecloth} for the picnic.
e.zh: 她为野餐铺上一块格子桌布。

e.en: The wine stain ruined our favorite linen {tablecloth}.
e.zh: 那块红酒渍毁了我们最喜欢的亚麻桌布。

e.en: The hotel uses crisp white {tablecloths} for formal dinners.
e.zh: 酒店在正式晚宴上使用挺括的白色桌布。

e.en: She irons all the {tablecloths} before storing them away.
e.zh: 她把所有桌布都熨好后再收起来。

e.en: They camped on the high {tableland} above the canyon.
e.zh: 他们在峡谷上方的高原台地上扎营。

e.en: Wild horses graze freely across the open {tableland}.
e.zh: 野马在开阔的高地草原上自由吃草。

e.en: The restaurant arranged extra {tables} on the patio.
e.zh: 餐厅在露台上加摆了几张桌子。

e.en: All the data {tables} are exported as CSV files.
e.zh: 所有数据表都导出为CSV文件。

e.en: Add one {tablespoon} of olive oil to the pan.
e.zh: 在锅里加一汤匙橄榄油。

e.en: He stirred in a {tablespoon} of honey for sweetness.
e.zh: 他加了一汤匙蜂蜜来增加甜味。

e.en: Stir in a {tablespoonful} of soy sauce before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前拌入一汤匙酱油。

e.en: She added a generous {tablespoonful} of butter to the sauce.
e.zh: 她在酱汁里加了满满一汤匙黄油。

e.en: The recipe calls for two {tablespoons} of brown sugar.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要两汤匙红糖。

e.en: He measured three {tablespoons} of flour into the bowl.
e.zh: 他往碗里量了三汤匙面粉。

tablet.t:
n. 平板电脑
n. 药片

e.en: She reads the news on her {tablet} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都用平板电脑看新闻。

e.en: Take one {tablet} with water after each meal.
e.zh: 每餐后用水送服一片药。

tabletop.t:
n. 桌面
adj. 桌上型的

e.en: He wiped down the marble {tabletop} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他擦干净了大理石桌面。

e.en: They host a weekly {tabletop} role-playing game session.
e.zh: 他们每周举办一次桌面角色扮演游戏。

tablets.t: n. 平板电脑；药片（复数）

e.en: Schools issued {tablets} to every student last semester.
e.zh: 上学期学校给每位学生都配发了平板电脑。

e.en: The pharmacist counted out thirty {tablets} for the prescription.
e.zh: 药剂师按处方数出了三十片药。

e.en: They received elegant {tableware} as a wedding gift.
e.zh: 他们收到一套精美的餐具作为结婚礼物。

e.en: The shop sells handmade ceramic {tableware} from local artisans.
e.zh: 这家店出售当地匠人手工制作的陶瓷餐具。

e.en: The {tabloid} ran a sensational story about the celebrity breakup.
e.zh: 这家小报刊登了关于名人分手的耸动报道。

e.en: He refuses to comment on {tabloid} rumors about his family.
e.zh: 他拒绝回应小报关于他家庭的传闻。

e.en: British {tabloids} love to cover royal family drama.
e.zh: 英国小报最爱报道王室的八卦新闻。

e.en: Her photo appeared in the {tabloids} all week.
e.zh: 她的照片整整一周都出现在各家小报上。

taboo.t:
n. 禁忌
adj. 忌讳的

e.en: Discussing salary openly is still considered {taboo} here.
e.zh: 在这里公开谈论薪水仍被视为禁忌。

e.en: The film breaks a long-standing cultural {taboo}.
e.zh: 这部电影打破了一项长期存在的文化禁忌。

e.en: The minstrel beat his small {tabor} as the dancers moved.
e.zh: 舞者起舞时，吟游艺人敲打着他的小手鼓。

e.en: A piper and a {tabor} led the village procession.
e.zh: 一名风笛手和一面小手鼓引领着村里的游行队伍。

e.en: In some cultures, mentioning the dead is strictly {tabu}.
e.zh: 在某些文化中，提及亡者是严格的禁忌。

e.en: The novel explores subjects once thought entirely {tabu}.
e.zh: 这本小说探讨了曾被视为完全禁忌的主题。

e.en: Please present the survey results in {tabular} form.
e.zh: 请以表格形式呈现调查结果。

e.en: The report displays expenses in clear {tabular} layouts.
e.zh: 该报告以清晰的表格布局显示支出。

e.en: Volunteers will {tabulate} the votes after the polls close.
e.zh: 投票结束后，志愿者将统计选票。

e.en: We use a script to {tabulate} the survey responses automatically.
e.zh: 我们用脚本自动统计调查问卷的回复。

tabulated.t: v. 已制成表格（过去式）

e.en: The accountant {tabulated} every expense from last quarter.
e.zh: 会计将上季度的每一笔开支都列成了表格。

e.en: Researchers {tabulated} the data before drawing conclusions.
e.zh: 研究人员先把数据整理成表格再得出结论。

e.en: The {tabulation} of results took longer than expected.
e.zh: 结果的统计耗时比预期更长。

e.en: Software now handles the {tabulation} that clerks once did manually.
e.zh: 如今软件取代了职员手工进行的数据汇总工作。

tac.t: n. 嗒（拟声）；战术空军司令部缩写

tach.t: n. 转速表（tachometer 的缩写）

e.en: Keep an eye on the {tach} when you shift gears.
e.zh: 换挡时留意一下转速表。

e.en: The {tach} needle jumped when he pressed the accelerator.
e.zh: 当他踩下油门时，转速表指针猛地跳了起来。

e.en: The {tachometer} showed the engine revving past 6000 RPM.
e.zh: 转速表显示发动机转速超过了每分钟6000转。

e.en: A digital {tachometer} replaced the old analog dial.
e.zh: 数字转速表取代了旧式的指针式仪表。

e.en: The patient was admitted with sudden {tachycardia} and chest pain.
e.zh: 患者因突发心动过速和胸痛入院。

e.en: Caffeine sometimes triggers mild {tachycardia} in sensitive people.
e.zh: 咖啡因有时会让敏感人群出现轻度心动过速。

e.en: The sci-fi novel imagines ships powered by {tachyon} drives.
e.zh: 这部科幻小说设想了由超光速粒子引擎驱动的飞船。

e.en: No experiment has ever detected a real {tachyon}.
e.zh: 从未有实验真正探测到超光速粒子。

tacit.t: adj. 心照不宣的；默许的

e.en: There was a {tacit} agreement not to discuss the incident.
e.zh: 大家心照不宣地不再讨论那起事件。

e.en: His silence gave {tacit} approval to the plan.
e.zh: 他的沉默等于默许了这个计划。

tacitly.t: adv. 默许地；不言而喻地

e.en: The manager {tacitly} accepted the team's new working hours.
e.zh: 经理默许了团队新的工作时间。

e.en: By staying quiet, she {tacitly} supported his decision.
e.zh: 她保持沉默，等于默默支持了他的决定。

e.en: Her grandfather was a {taciturn} man who rarely smiled.
e.zh: 她的祖父是个沉默寡言、很少笑的人。

e.en: The {taciturn} cowboy nodded once and rode away.
e.zh: 那位沉默寡言的牛仔点了点头便骑马离去。

e.en: The novel contrasts the {taciturnities} of two old soldiers.
e.zh: 小说对比了两位老兵各自的沉默寡言。

e.en: Their respective {taciturnities} made dinner conversations awkwardly quiet.
e.zh: 两人各自的沉默使晚餐对话尴尬而冷清。

e.en: His natural {taciturnity} made interviews particularly difficult.
e.zh: 他天生的沉默寡言让采访格外艰难。

e.en: She mistook his {taciturnity} for arrogance at first.
e.zh: 她起初把他的沉默误以为是傲慢。

tacitus.t: n. 塔西佗（古罗马历史学家）

e.en: Historians still rely on {tacitus} for accounts of early Rome.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍依赖塔西佗的著作了解早期罗马。

e.en: She quoted {tacitus} to support her argument about tyranny.
e.zh: 她引用塔西佗的话来支持自己关于暴政的论点。

tack.t:
n. 图钉；方针
v. 用图钉钉住

e.en: He used a {tack} to pin the poster on the wall.
e.zh: 他用一枚图钉把海报钉在墙上。

e.en: After the failure, the team took a different {tack}.
e.zh: 失败之后，团队换了一种思路。

tacked.t: v. 用图钉钉住（过去式）

e.en: She {tacked} a reminder note onto the corkboard.
e.zh: 她把一张提醒便条钉在了软木板上。

e.en: The sailors {tacked} the boat against the strong wind.
e.zh: 水手们顶着强风让船改变航向。

e.en: Test the glue's {tackiness} before pressing the pieces together.
e.zh: 在把零件压合前先测试胶水的粘性。

e.en: The bright neon decor had a charming retro {tackiness}.
e.zh: 那些霓虹装饰有一种迷人的复古俗气感。

tacking.t: v. 用图钉钉住（进行时）

e.en: The captain kept {tacking} to make progress upwind.
e.zh: 船长不断地改变航向以便顶风前行。

e.en: She is {tacking} extra fabric onto the hem.
e.zh: 她正在往下摆上加缝额外的布料。

tackle.t:
v. 处理；应对
n. 用具；（橄榄球）擒抱

e.en: We need to {tackle} this problem before the deadline.
e.zh: 我们必须在截止日期前解决这个问题。

e.en: The defender made a clean {tackle} near the goal.
e.zh: 那名后卫在球门附近完成了一次干净的铲球。

tackled.t: v. 已处理；已阻截（过去式）

e.en: She {tackled} the messy garage all weekend long.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在收拾凌乱的车库。

e.en: The linebacker {tackled} the running back at the ten-yard line.
e.zh: 线卫在十码线处把跑卫扑倒。

e.en: He's the team's most reliable {tackler} in open play.
e.zh: 他是球队在运动战中最可靠的抢断手。

e.en: The young {tackler} brought down the striker cleanly.
e.zh: 那位年轻的铲球手干净利落地将前锋拦下。

tackles.t:
v. 处理（第三人称单数）
n. 用具（复数）

e.en: She {tackles} every problem with calm focus.
e.zh: 她以冷静专注的态度处理每一个问题。

e.en: The defender {tackles} the striker near the goal.
e.zh: 后卫在球门附近铲断了前锋。

tackling.t:
v. 正在处理
n. 阻截动作

e.en: The team is {tackling} climate change head-on.
e.zh: 该团队正直面应对气候变化。

e.en: He hurt his shoulder while {tackling} an opponent.
e.zh: 他在擒抱对手时伤了肩膀。

e.en: She {tacks} a poster onto the bulletin board.
e.zh: 她用图钉把海报固定在公告板上。

e.en: The captain {tacks} the sailboat against the wind.
e.zh: 船长驾驶帆船迎风换舷而行。

e.en: The wedding decorations looked cheap and {tacky}.
e.zh: 婚礼装饰看起来又便宜又俗气。

e.en: The paint is still {tacky}, so don't touch it.
e.zh: 油漆还有点黏,别碰它。

taco.t: n. 塔可饼（墨西哥卷饼）

e.en: I had a chicken {taco} for lunch today.
e.zh: 我今天午餐吃了一个鸡肉塔可。

e.en: This restaurant serves the best {taco} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的塔可是全城最棒的。

taconite.t: n. 铁燧岩（低品位铁矿）

e.en: The plant processes {taconite} into iron pellets.
e.zh: 这家工厂把铁燧岩加工成铁球团。

e.en: Minnesota mines large amounts of {taconite} each year.
e.zh: 明尼苏达州每年开采大量铁燧岩。

e.en: She handled the complaint with great {tact}.
e.zh: 她非常得体地处理了那起投诉。

e.en: Telling him the news will require some {tact}.
e.zh: 把这个消息告诉他需要一些技巧。

e.en: A {tactful} manager knows when to stay silent.
e.zh: 圆滑得体的经理知道何时该保持沉默。

e.en: She gave a {tactful} answer to the awkward question.
e.zh: 她对那个尴尬的问题给出了得体的回答。

e.en: He {tactfully} declined the invitation without offending anyone.
e.zh: 他婉转地谢绝了邀请,没有得罪任何人。

e.en: She {tactfully} pointed out the error in his report.
e.zh: 她委婉地指出了他报告中的错误。

e.en: Lowering prices is a common marketing {tactic}.
e.zh: 降价是一种常见的营销策略。

e.en: Ignoring the bully is the best {tactic} here.
e.zh: 无视那个恶霸是这里最好的策略。

e.en: The coach made a {tactical} substitution at halftime.
e.zh: 教练在中场做出了战术性换人。

e.en: She wore a {tactical} vest during the training drill.
e.zh: 她在训练演习中穿着战术背心。

e.en: The team played {tactically} to protect their lead.
e.zh: 球队战术性地踢球以保住领先优势。

e.en: He {tactically} avoided answering the reporter's question.
e.zh: 他策略性地回避了记者的提问。

e.en: The new coach is a brilliant {tactician}.
e.zh: 新教练是一位出色的战术家。

e.en: As a {tactician}, she anticipates every move.
e.zh: 作为战术家,她能预判每一步行动。

e.en: The company changed its {tactics} after sales dropped.
e.zh: 销量下滑后,公司改变了策略。

e.en: His scare {tactics} no longer work on the kids.
e.zh: 他的恐吓手段对孩子们已经不管用了。

e.en: Babies learn through {tactile} exploration of their toys.
e.zh: 婴儿通过触摸玩具来学习探索。

e.en: The phone has a satisfying {tactile} keyboard.
e.zh: 这部手机有一个手感很棒的键盘。

e.en: The fabric's {tactility} makes it perfect for blankets.
e.zh: 这种面料的触感非常适合做毯子。

e.en: Designers value {tactility} when crafting premium products.
e.zh: 设计师在打造高端产品时非常重视触感。

tactless.t: adj. 不得体的；欠圆通的

e.en: His {tactless} comment about her weight upset everyone.
e.zh: 他对她体重那番不得体的评论惹恼了所有人。

e.en: It was {tactless} to mention her recent divorce.
e.zh: 提起她最近离婚的事实在很不识相。

e.en: He {tactlessly} asked about her failed business venture.
e.zh: 他冒失地问起了她失败的创业经历。

e.en: She {tactlessly} interrupted the grieving family's conversation.
e.zh: 她不识相地打断了那个悲痛家庭的谈话。

e.en: His {tactlessness} cost him several important friendships.
e.zh: 他的不知分寸让他失去了几段重要的友谊。

e.en: The host apologized for her guest's {tactlessness}.
e.zh: 主人为她客人的失礼行为道了歉。

e.en: Different social {tacts} work in different cultural settings.
e.zh: 不同的社交策略适用于不同的文化场合。

e.en: The negotiator tried several {tacts} before reaching agreement.
e.zh: 谈判者尝试了几种方式才达成协议。

e.en: Blind readers rely on {tactual} feedback from braille.
e.zh: 盲人读者依靠盲文的触觉反馈来阅读。

e.en: The museum offers {tactual} exhibits for visually impaired visitors.
e.zh: 博物馆为视障参观者提供可触摸的展品。

e.en: The kids watched a {tadpole} grow legs in the jar.
e.zh: 孩子们看着罐子里的蝌蚪长出了腿。

e.en: Each {tadpole} eventually transforms into a frog.
e.zh: 每只蝌蚪最终都会变成青蛙。

tae.t: prep. 到、向（苏格兰方言 to）

e.en: My daughter earned her black belt in {taekwondo}.
e.zh: 我女儿获得了跆拳道黑带。

e.en: He practices {taekwondo} three evenings a week.
e.zh: 他每周练三个晚上的跆拳道。

taff.t: n. 塔夫河（英国威尔士河流）

e.en: Locals affectionately call him a {taff} from Cardiff.
e.zh: 当地人亲切地称他为来自卡迪夫的威尔士佬。

e.en: The old sailor was nicknamed {taff} by his crewmates.
e.zh: 那位老水手被船员们戏称为威尔士佬。

e.en: Her prom dress was made of shimmering pink {taffeta}.
e.zh: 她的舞会礼服是用闪亮的粉色塔夫绸做的。

e.en: The bride chose ivory {taffeta} for her gown.
e.zh: 新娘为她的礼服选择了象牙色塔夫绸。

e.en: The kids pulled {taffy} until it turned glossy white.
e.zh: 孩子们拉扯太妃糖,直到它变成光亮的白色。

e.en: She bought saltwater {taffy} at the seaside shop.
e.zh: 她在海边的店里买了海盐太妃糖。

tag.t:
n. 标签；标记
v. 标注、@某人

tagged.t: v. 标记（tag 的过去式）；被 @

e.en: She {tagged} her best friend in the vacation photo.
e.zh: 她在度假照片里@了她最好的朋友。

e.en: Each suitcase was {tagged} before being loaded onto the plane.
e.zh: 每个行李箱在装上飞机前都贴了标签。

tagger.t: n. 贴标签的人；涂鸦者

e.en: Police arrested the graffiti {tagger} near the bridge.
e.zh: 警方在桥附近逮捕了那名涂鸦者。

e.en: Each {tagger} in the playground game wore a red band.
e.zh: 操场游戏中的每个抓人者都戴着红色臂带。

e.en: Instagram makes {tagging} friends in posts very easy.
e.zh: Instagram 让在帖子里@朋友变得非常方便。

e.en: Researchers are {tagging} sea turtles to track migration.
e.zh: 研究人员正在给海龟做标记以追踪迁徙路线。

e.en: We ordered a lamb {tagine} at the Moroccan restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在那家摩洛哥餐厅点了一份羊肉塔吉锅。

e.en: She slow-cooked the chicken {tagine} for three hours.
e.zh: 她把鸡肉塔吉锅慢炖了三个小时。

e.en: I ordered {tagliatelle} with creamy mushroom sauce.
e.zh: 我点了配奶油蘑菇酱的宽面条。

e.en: Fresh {tagliatelle} cooks in just three minutes.
e.zh: 新鲜的塔利雅特尔面条只需煮三分钟。

e.en: Nike's {tagline} "Just Do It" is famous worldwide.
e.zh: 耐克的标语 "Just Do It" 闻名全球。

e.en: The agency spent weeks crafting the perfect {tagline}.
e.zh: 这家广告公司花了数周打造完美的广告语。

tags.t:
n. 标签（复数）
v. 标注

e.en: Add relevant {tags} to help people find your post.
e.zh: 添加相关标签可以帮助别人找到你的帖子。

e.en: The store removed the price {tags} from clearance items.
e.zh: 商店把清仓商品上的价格标签摘掉了。

e.en: Hummus is made by blending chickpeas with {tahini}.
e.zh: 鹰嘴豆泥是用鹰嘴豆和芝麻酱搅拌而成的。

e.en: Drizzle some {tahini} over the roasted vegetables.
e.zh: 在烤蔬菜上淋一些芝麻酱。

e.en: We honeymooned in {tahiti} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天在塔希提岛度蜜月。

e.en: Flights to {tahiti} are surprisingly expensive this season.
e.zh: 这个季节飞往塔希提岛的机票贵得惊人。

tahitian.t:
adj. 塔希提的
n. 塔希提人

e.en: She bought a string of {tahitian} black pearls.
e.zh: 她买了一串塔希提黑珍珠项链。

e.en: The resort offers traditional {tahitian} dance performances.
e.zh: 度假村提供传统的塔希提舞蹈表演。

e.en: We visited {taif} for its famous rose gardens.
e.zh: 我们去塔伊夫参观了著名的玫瑰园。

e.en: Summer temperatures in {taif} stay pleasantly cool.
e.zh: 塔伊夫的夏季气温保持着宜人的凉爽。

e.en: The Siberian {taiga} stretches for thousands of kilometers.
e.zh: 西伯利亚针叶林绵延数千公里。

e.en: Wolves and bears roam the dense {taiga} forests.
e.zh: 狼和熊在茂密的针叶林中漫游。

tail.t:
n. 尾巴；末端
v. 尾随

e.en: The puppy wagged its {tail} when I came home.
e.zh: 我回到家时,小狗摇着尾巴。

e.en: A detective was assigned to {tail} the suspect.
e.zh: 一名侦探被指派去跟踪那名嫌疑人。

tailback.t: n. 长队车流；(橄榄球) 进攻后卫

e.en: The accident caused a five-mile {tailback} on the motorway.
e.zh: 那起事故造成了高速公路上五英里的拥堵长龙。

e.en: The {tailback} broke through for a 60-yard run.
e.zh: 那名进攻后卫突破防线跑出了60码。

e.en: She bruised her {tailbone} after slipping on the ice.
e.zh: 她在冰上滑倒后摔伤了尾骨。

e.en: Sitting too long can make your {tailbone} ache.
e.zh: 久坐会让你的尾骨酸痛。

e.en: The conductor wore a black {tailcoat} for the concert.
e.zh: 指挥家穿着黑色燕尾服指挥音乐会。

e.en: His grandfather's {tailcoat} still hangs in the closet.
e.zh: 他祖父的燕尾服还挂在衣柜里。

tailed.t:
adj. 有尾巴的
v. 尾随（过去式）

e.en: A long-{tailed} bird landed on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只长尾鸟落在了窗台上。

e.en: The detective {tailed} the suspect for three days.
e.zh: 侦探跟踪了那名嫌疑人三天。

e.en: The shark's {tailfin} sliced through the calm water.
e.zh: 鲨鱼的尾鳍划破了平静的水面。

e.en: Classic Cadillacs are known for their dramatic {tailfin}.
e.zh: 经典凯迪拉克以其夸张的尾翼而闻名。

tailgate.t:
n. 后挡板、后备厢门
v. 紧跟前车

e.en: Don't {tailgate} the truck on this icy road.
e.zh: 在这条结冰的路上别跟在卡车后面太近。

e.en: We had a barbecue on the {tailgate} before the game.
e.zh: 赛前我们在车尾门上举办了烧烤聚会。

tailgater.t: n. 紧跟前车行驶的司机

e.en: The aggressive {tailgater} kept flashing his headlights.
e.zh: 那个紧跟车尾的司机不停地闪着大灯。

e.en: Every {tailgater} at the stadium brought folding chairs.
e.zh: 体育场的每个尾门派对参与者都带了折叠椅。

tailgating.t: n. 紧跟前车；尾随入门禁

e.en: {tailgating} on the highway causes many serious accidents.
e.zh: 在高速公路上紧跟前车会引发许多严重事故。

e.en: We're {tailgating} in the parking lot before kickoff.
e.zh: 开球前我们在停车场办尾门聚会。

tailing.t:
v. 跟踪、尾随
n. 尾矿

e.en: A black sedan was {tailing} her all the way home.
e.zh: 一辆黑色轿车一路尾随她回家。

e.en: Stock prices have been {tailing} off this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度股价一直在逐渐下跌。

e.en: Manx cats are a famous {tailless} breed.
e.zh: 曼岛猫是一种著名的无尾品种。

e.en: The {tailless} drone uses only its wings to maneuver.
e.zh: 这架无尾无人机仅靠机翼来操控飞行。

e.en: A broken {taillight} can get you pulled over.
e.zh: 尾灯坏了可能会被警察拦下。

e.en: I followed the red {taillight} through the heavy fog.
e.zh: 我在浓雾中跟着那盏红色尾灯前行。

tailor.t:
n. 裁缝
v. 量身定制

e.en: I'll {tailor} the presentation to your team's needs.
e.zh: 我会根据你们团队的需求调整演讲内容。

e.en: The {tailor} altered my suit jacket in two days.
e.zh: 裁缝两天就把我的西装外套改好了。

tailored.t: adj. 量身定制的；剪裁合身的

e.en: The app offers {tailored} workout plans for each user.
e.zh: 这款应用为每位用户提供量身定制的健身计划。

e.en: He wore a sharply {tailored} navy suit to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿着一套剪裁利落的深蓝色西装去面试。

e.en: She is {tailoring} the resume for a tech role.
e.zh: 她正在为科技岗位调整简历。

e.en: The jacket's fine {tailoring} justifies the high price.
e.zh: 这件外套精良的剪裁工艺配得上高昂的价格。

tailors.t:
n. 裁缝（复数）
v. 定制

e.en: Local {tailors} can hem your trousers within an hour.
e.zh: 本地的裁缝一小时内就能帮你改好裤脚。

e.en: The platform {tailors} recommendations based on your viewing history.
e.zh: 该平台会根据你的观看历史定制推荐内容。

tailpiece.t: n. 尾饰、末端部件；(提琴) 系弦板

e.en: The violin's ebony {tailpiece} anchors the four strings.
e.zh: 小提琴的乌木拉弦板固定着四根琴弦。

e.en: A short {tailpiece} closes the final chapter of the book.
e.zh: 书末尾以一段简短的尾饰收束最后一章。

e.en: Black smoke poured from the truck's rusty {tailpipe}.
e.zh: 黑烟从卡车锈迹斑斑的排气管中冒出。

e.en: He noticed water dripping from the car's {tailpipe} after starting.
e.zh: 启动后他注意到水从汽车排气管滴下来。

e.en: The aircraft's {tailplane} provides essential pitch stability during flight.
e.zh: 飞机的水平尾翼为飞行提供关键的俯仰稳定性。

e.en: Engineers inspected the damaged {tailplane} after the rough landing.
e.zh: 工程师在颠簸着陆后检查了受损的水平尾翼。

tails.t: n. 尾巴（复数）；硬币背面；燕尾服

e.en: The puppies wagged their {tails} when the food bowls appeared.
e.zh: 食盆一出现,小狗们就摇起了尾巴。

e.en: Let's flip a coin — heads or {tails}?
e.zh: 我们抛硬币吧——正面还是反面?

tailspin.t: n. 急剧下滑；(飞机) 尾旋

e.en: The bad news sent the company into a financial {tailspin}.
e.zh: 那则坏消息让公司陷入了财务上的急转直下。

e.en: The plane went into a {tailspin} before the pilot recovered control.
e.zh: 飞机一度进入尾旋,飞行员才重新控制住。

e.en: Trout thrive in the cold {tailwater} below the dam.
e.zh: 鳟鱼在大坝下游清冷的尾水中生长旺盛。

e.en: Engineers monitored the {tailwater} levels after heavy rainfall.
e.zh: 暴雨过后,工程师监测了下游尾水的水位。

e.en: A strong {tailwind} got us to London thirty minutes early.
e.zh: 强劲的顺风让我们提前三十分钟抵达伦敦。

e.en: Lower interest rates provided a {tailwind} for the housing market.
e.zh: 利率下调为房地产市场提供了顺风助力。

taint.t:
v. 玷污、败坏
n. 污点

e.en: The scandal could {taint} the brand's reputation for years.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻可能让品牌声誉多年蒙污。

e.en: There's a faint {taint} of corruption in the report.
e.zh: 这份报告中隐隐有一丝腐败的痕迹。

tainted.t: adj. 被污染的、有瑕疵的

e.en: Health officials recalled the {tainted} batch of baby formula.
e.zh: 卫生部门召回了那批受污染的婴儿奶粉。

e.en: His legacy was {tainted} by allegations of fraud.
e.zh: 他的声誉因欺诈指控而蒙上污点。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring night markets in {Taipei}.
e.zh: 我们周末在台北逛了几个夜市。

e.en: The flight from Tokyo to {Taipei} takes about four hours.
e.zh: 从东京飞往台北大约需要四小时。

e.en: Most advanced semiconductor chips are manufactured in {Taiwan}.
e.zh: 大多数先进的半导体芯片都在台湾制造。

e.en: She's planning a hiking trip across {Taiwan} this summer.
e.zh: 她计划今年夏天去台湾徒步旅行。

taiwanese.t:
adj. 台湾的
n. 台湾人

e.en: This bubble tea shop serves authentic {Taiwanese} street snacks.
e.zh: 这家奶茶店供应正宗的台湾街头小吃。

e.en: My roommate is {Taiwanese} and speaks fluent Mandarin and Hokkien.
e.zh: 我的室友是台湾人,普通话和闽南语都很流利。

taj.t: n. 泰姬（常指泰姬陵 Taj Mahal）

tajik.t:
adj. 塔吉克的
n. 塔吉克人

e.en: The {Tajik} community in Dushanbe celebrates Navruz every March.
e.zh: 杜尚别的塔吉克社区每年三月都会庆祝纳乌鲁兹节。

e.en: He learned a few {Tajik} phrases before the trip.
e.zh: 出发前他学了几句塔吉克语。

e.en: {Tajikistan} shares a long mountainous border with Afghanistan.
e.zh: 塔吉克斯坦与阿富汗有着漫长的山地边界。

e.en: The Pamir Highway through {Tajikistan} is legendary among cyclists.
e.zh: 穿越塔吉克斯坦的帕米尔公路在骑行者中享有盛誉。

take.t:
v. 拿、取；接受
n. 看法；一次拍摄

e.en: Please {take} an umbrella — it's going to rain.
e.zh: 请带把伞吧——快下雨了。

e.en: What's your {take} on the new privacy policy?
e.zh: 你对新的隐私政策有什么看法?

e.en: Please fasten your seatbelt before {take-off}.
e.zh: 请在飞机起飞前系好安全带。

e.en: His comedy {take-off} of the president went viral overnight.
e.zh: 他对总统的喜剧模仿一夜之间爆红。

e.en: Bad weather delayed several {take-ofves} at the airport this morning.
e.zh: 恶劣天气导致今早机场几次起飞延误。

e.en: The pilot logged dozens of {take-ofves} during her training.
e.zh: 这位飞行员在训练期间记录了数十次起飞。

takeaway.t:
n. 要点、结论
n. 外卖（英式）

e.en: The main {takeaway} from the meeting is to ship faster.
e.zh: 这次会议最重要的收获是要加快交付速度。

e.en: Let's order Thai {takeaway} instead of cooking tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们叫泰餐外卖吧,不做饭了。

e.en: Share your top three {takeaways} from the workshop in chat.
e.zh: 在聊天里分享一下你从工作坊学到的三大要点。

e.en: Late-night {takeaways} are a guilty pleasure for many students.
e.zh: 深夜外卖是许多学生戒不掉的小享受。

takedown.t:
n. 抨击；下架
v. 扳倒；拆除

e.en: The platform issued a {takedown} notice for the pirated video.
e.zh: 该平台对那段盗版视频发出了下架通知。

e.en: Her essay was a brutal {takedown} of the bestselling memoir.
e.zh: 她的文章对那本畅销回忆录进行了毫不留情的批判。

taken.t:
v. take 的过去分词
adj. 被占用的

e.en: All the seats by the window have already been {taken}.
e.zh: 靠窗的座位已经全部被占了。

e.en: She was quite {taken} with the candidate's calm answers.
e.zh: 那位候选人冷静的回答让她颇为欣赏。

e.en: Please fasten your seatbelts before {takeoff}.
e.zh: 请在飞机起飞前系好安全带。

e.en: His comedy routine is a hilarious {takeoff} on politicians.
e.zh: 他的喜剧段子是对政客滑稽的模仿。

e.en: The pilot logged dozens of {takeofves} during training week.
e.zh: 飞行员在训练周内记录了数十次起飞。

e.en: Heavy fog delayed all morning {takeofves} at the airport.
e.zh: 大雾延误了机场上午所有航班的起飞。

e.en: The hostile {takeover} bid shocked the company's board.
e.zh: 这次恶意收购要约让公司董事会大为震惊。

e.en: After the {takeover}, half the staff were laid off.
e.zh: 收购完成后，一半员工被裁掉了。

e.en: I offered free tickets, but there were no {taker} in the office.
e.zh: 我提供免费票，但办公室里没人愿意要。

e.en: He's a {taker}, never a giver in any relationship.
e.zh: 他在任何关系中都只索取，从不付出。

takes.t:
v. take 的第三人称单数
n. 拍摄镜头

e.en: It {takes} about twenty minutes to walk to the station.
e.zh: 走到车站大概要二十分钟。

e.en: The director shot fifteen {takes} before he was satisfied.
e.zh: 导演拍了十五条才满意。

taking.t:
v. take 的现在分词
n. 收入、进账

e.en: She is {taking} a year off to travel around Asia.
e.zh: 她正在休一年假去亚洲旅行。

e.en: He kept {taking} photos of the sunset from the balcony.
e.zh: 他一直在阳台上拍夕阳的照片。

talbot.t: n. 塔尔博特（姓氏/人名）

e.en: The painting depicts a {talbot}, an extinct white hunting hound.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘的是一只塔尔伯特犬，一种已灭绝的白色猎犬。

e.en: William Henry Fox {Talbot} was a pioneer of early photography.
e.zh: 威廉·亨利·福克斯·塔尔博特是早期摄影的先驱。

e.en: Baby powder is mostly made from {talc}.
e.zh: 婴儿爽身粉的主要成分是滑石粉。

e.en: Several lawsuits claim {talc} products may cause health issues.
e.zh: 多起诉讼称滑石粉产品可能引发健康问题。

e.en: Grandma sprinkled {talcum} powder on the baby after the bath.
e.zh: 奶奶在宝宝洗完澡后撒上爽身粉。

e.en: The bathroom smelled faintly of lavender {talcum} powder.
e.zh: 浴室里隐约飘着薰衣草爽身粉的香味。

e.en: Grandpa told us a {tale} about his childhood adventures.
e.zh: 爷爷给我们讲了一个他童年冒险的故事。

e.en: That sounds like a tall {tale} you made up.
e.zh: 听起来像是你编出来的天方夜谭。

e.en: She has a remarkable {talent} for learning languages quickly.
e.zh: 她在快速学习语言方面有非凡的天赋。

e.en: The company struggles to attract top engineering {talent}.
e.zh: 公司难以吸引顶尖的工程人才。

talented.t: adj. 有才能的、有天赋的

e.en: He is the most {talented} pianist I have ever heard.
e.zh: 他是我听过最有才华的钢琴家。

e.en: Our team hired several {talented} young designers this year.
e.zh: 我们团队今年雇了几位很有才华的年轻设计师。

e.en: Critics dismissed the new singer as completely {talentless}.
e.zh: 评论家把这位新歌手贬得毫无才华可言。

e.en: He felt {talentless} compared to his gifted classmates.
e.zh: 和那些有天赋的同学相比，他觉得自己毫无才能。

e.en: The show celebrates the diverse {talents} of young performers.
e.zh: 这场表演展示了年轻艺人们多样的才能。

e.en: Her {talents} extend from painting to creative writing.
e.zh: 她的才能涵盖绘画和文学创作。

e.en: The book collects folk {tales} from around the world.
e.zh: 这本书收集了世界各地的民间故事。

e.en: Sailors used to tell wild {tales} about sea monsters.
e.zh: 水手们过去常讲海怪的奇异故事。

e.en: The {Taliban} regained control of Afghanistan in 2021.
e.zh: 塔利班于2021年重新控制了阿富汗。

e.en: International negotiations with the {Taliban} have stalled repeatedly.
e.zh: 与塔利班的国际谈判多次陷入僵局。

e.en: Frank Lloyd Wright designed his famous home {Taliesin} in Wisconsin.
e.zh: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特在威斯康星州设计了他著名的塔里埃森住宅。

e.en: {Taliesin} was a legendary Welsh bard from the sixth century.
e.zh: 塔利埃辛是六世纪一位传奇的威尔士吟游诗人。

e.en: She wore a small jade {talisman} for good luck.
e.zh: 她戴着一块小玉护身符以求好运。

e.en: The captain became the team's {talisman} during the championship.
e.zh: 队长在锦标赛期间成了球队的精神象征。

talismanic.t: adj. 护身符的、有魔力的

e.en: The old ring had a {talismanic} power for the family.
e.zh: 那枚旧戒指对这个家族有着护身符般的力量。

e.en: His jersey number took on a {talismanic} significance for fans.
e.zh: 他的球衣号码对球迷而言有了护身符般的意义。

talk.t:
v. 说话、交谈
n. 谈话；讲座

e.en: Can we {talk} about the project after lunch?
e.zh: 午饭后我们能谈谈那个项目吗？

e.en: Her TED {talk} on creativity has millions of views.
e.zh: 她那场关于创造力的TED演讲有数百万次观看。

e.en: My nephew is unusually {talkative} for a five-year-old.
e.zh: 我侄子作为一个五岁小孩，特别爱说话。

e.en: After two coffees, she becomes much more {talkative}.
e.zh: 喝完两杯咖啡后，她话就多了很多。

e.en: His {talkativeness} made long road trips fly by.
e.zh: 他能说会道，长途公路旅行因此变得不那么漫长。

e.en: Her {talkativeness} sometimes annoys quieter coworkers.
e.zh: 她话太多有时会让那些安静的同事感到厌烦。

talkback.t: n. 对讲系统；回话节目

e.en: The director used the {talkback} to give notes to the actors.
e.zh: 导演用对讲系统给演员们提意见。

e.en: After the play, the cast hosted a {talkback} with the audience.
e.zh: 演出结束后，演员们与观众进行了一场互动交流。

talked.t: v. talk 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: We {talked} for hours about our travel plans.
e.zh: 我们聊了几个小时的旅行计划。

e.en: She {talked} her brother into lending her the car.
e.zh: 她说服了哥哥把车借给她。

e.en: He's a smooth {talker} who could sell anything.
e.zh: 他是个能说会道的人，什么都能卖出去。

e.en: My grandmother was always a great {talker} at family dinners.
e.zh: 我奶奶在家庭聚餐上总是滔滔不绝。

e.en: Hikers used a walkie-{talkie} to stay in contact on the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者们用对讲机在山路上保持联系。

e.en: The first {talkie} films revolutionized the movie industry.
e.zh: 最早的有声电影彻底改变了电影行业。

e.en: Quit {talkin} and start working on the report.
e.zh: 别再唠叨了，赶快去写报告吧。

e.en: What are you {talkin} about, my friend?
e.zh: 老兄，你在说啥呢？

talking.t:
v. talk 的现在分词
adj. 会说话的

e.en: Stop {talking} during the movie, please.
e.zh: 看电影时请别说话。

e.en: They were {talking} about moving to a bigger apartment.
e.zh: 他们在讨论搬到更大的公寓去。

talks.t:
n. 会谈、谈判
v. 说（三单）

e.en: Peace {talks} between the two countries resumed yesterday.
e.zh: 两国之间的和平谈判昨天重新开始了。

e.en: She {talks} to her mother on the phone every Sunday.
e.zh: 她每周日都会和妈妈通电话。

talky.t: adj. 话多的；对白过多的

e.en: The film is a bit too {talky} for an action movie.
e.zh: 这部片作为动作电影来说话太多了。

e.en: Critics found the play overly {talky} and slow-paced.
e.zh: 评论家觉得这部戏对白太多、节奏太慢。

e.en: My brother grew really {tall} during high school.
e.zh: 我哥哥在高中期间长得很高。

e.en: The skyscraper stands {tall} above the city skyline.
e.zh: 这座摩天大楼高耸于城市天际线之上。

e.en: She stored her sweaters in the antique {tallboy} dresser.
e.zh: 她把毛衣收在那座古董高脚衣柜里。

e.en: He grabbed a {tallboy} of beer from the fridge.
e.zh: 他从冰箱里拿了一罐大听啤酒。

e.en: The {tallgrass} prairie once covered much of the Midwest.
e.zh: 高草草原曾覆盖中西部大片土地。

e.en: Bison graze peacefully in the {tallgrass} preserve.
e.zh: 野牛在高草保护区里悠闲地吃草。

tallinn.t: n. 塔林（爱沙尼亚首都）

e.en: {Tallinn} is the medieval capital of Estonia.
e.zh: 塔林是爱沙尼亚的中世纪首都。

e.en: We took a ferry from Helsinki to {Tallinn}.
e.zh: 我们从赫尔辛基坐渡轮去了塔林。

e.en: The choir sang a beautiful motet by {Tallis}.
e.zh: 唱诗班演唱了塔利斯的一首优美经文歌。

e.en: He wore a {tallis} during the morning prayers.
e.zh: 他在晨祷时披着祈祷披巾。

e.en: She is a {tallish} woman with short brown hair.
e.zh: 她是个稍高的女人,留着棕色短发。

e.en: The new player is {tallish} but surprisingly quick.
e.zh: 新球员个子偏高,但出奇地灵活。

e.en: His {tallness} made him stand out in any crowd.
e.zh: 他的高个子让他在人群中格外显眼。

e.en: The building's {tallness} dominates the city skyline.
e.zh: 这座建筑的高度主宰着城市天际线。

e.en: Old candles were often made from animal {tallow}.
e.zh: 旧时蜡烛常常用动物油脂制成。

e.en: She uses {tallow} as a base for handmade soap.
e.zh: 她用动物脂作为手工皂的基料。

tally.t:
n. 计数；得分
v. 记录；吻合

e.en: Let me {tally} up the votes from each district.
e.zh: 让我统计一下各区的票数。

e.en: His final {tally} for the season was twenty goals.
e.zh: 他本赛季的最终进球总数是二十球。

talmud.t: n. 塔木德（犹太教经典）

e.en: He spends his evenings studying the {Talmud}.
e.zh: 他每晚都在研读《塔木德》。

e.en: The {Talmud} contains centuries of rabbinic discussion.
e.zh: 《塔木德》收录了几个世纪的拉比讨论。

talmudic.t: adj. 塔木德的；犹太经典的

e.en: Their debate had a {Talmudic} attention to detail.
e.zh: 他们的辩论像研读塔木德般注重细节。

e.en: He gave a {Talmudic} interpretation of the contract.
e.zh: 他对合同做了塔木德式的细致解读。

e.en: The eagle gripped the fish with one sharp {talon}.
e.zh: 老鹰用一只锋利的爪子抓住了鱼。

e.en: Hawks use their {talons} to catch small prey.
e.zh: 鹰用爪子捕捉小型猎物。

e.en: A {taloned} owl swooped down from the branch.
e.zh: 一只长着利爪的猫头鹰从树枝俯冲下来。

e.en: The dragon's {taloned} feet left deep marks in the earth.
e.zh: 龙的利爪在地上留下了深深的痕迹。

talus.t:
n. 距骨
n. 碎石坡

e.en: He fractured his {talus} while landing from the jump.
e.zh: 他从跳跃中落地时摔断了距骨。

e.en: Loose {talus} made the mountain trail dangerous.
e.zh: 松动的碎石让山路十分危险。

tamale.t: n. 墨西哥玉米粉蒸肉

e.en: She ordered a chicken {tamale} with green sauce.
e.zh: 她点了一份配青酱的鸡肉粽。

e.en: My grandmother taught me how to wrap a {tamale}.
e.zh: 我奶奶教我怎样包墨西哥粽。

e.en: The river {Tamar} forms the border with Cornwall.
e.zh: 塔玛河构成了与康沃尔郡的边界。

e.en: {Tamar} is also a name found in the Hebrew Bible.
e.zh: 塔玛也是希伯来圣经中出现的名字。

e.en: The {tamarack} turns golden yellow every autumn.
e.zh: 落叶松每到秋天就变成金黄色。

e.en: We hiked through a forest of {tamarack} and pine.
e.zh: 我们穿过一片落叶松和松树的森林。

e.en: The golden lion {tamarin} is critically endangered.
e.zh: 金狮狨猴已极度濒危。

e.en: A tiny {tamarin} leapt between the rainforest branches.
e.zh: 一只小狨猴在雨林枝叶间跳跃。

e.en: This sauce gets its tangy flavor from fresh {tamarind}.
e.zh: 这道酱汁的酸爽风味来自新鲜的罗望子。

e.en: She added a spoon of {tamarind} paste to the curry.
e.zh: 她在咖喱里加了一勺罗望子酱。

e.en: A {tamarisk} tree provided welcome shade in the desert.
e.zh: 一棵柽柳树在沙漠中提供了难得的阴凉。

e.en: Pink blossoms covered the {tamarisk} along the riverbank.
e.zh: 粉红色的花朵覆盖着河岸边的柽柳。

tambour.t:
n. 刺绣绷架
n. 小鼓

e.en: The desk had a sliding {tambour} cover hiding the keyboard.
e.zh: 那张桌子有一个卷帘式的盖板遮住键盘。

e.en: She embroidered the silk on a small wooden {tambour}.
e.zh: 她在一个小木绣绷上刺绣丝绸。

e.en: He shook the {tambourine} to the rhythm of the song.
e.zh: 他随着歌曲的节奏摇着铃鼓。

e.en: A {tambourine} adds bright accents to folk music.
e.zh: 铃鼓为民谣音乐增添了明快的点缀。

tame.t:
v. 驯服；驯养
adj. 温顺的；乏味的

e.en: The fox became surprisingly {tame} after weeks of feeding.
e.zh: 经过几周的喂养,那只狐狸变得出奇地温顺。

e.en: The movie's plot was disappointingly {tame} for a thriller.
e.zh: 作为一部惊悚片,这部电影的情节显得平淡无奇。

tamed.t:
adj. 被驯服的
v. 驯服（过去式）

e.en: Engineers finally {tamed} the unstable software release.
e.zh: 工程师们最终驯服了那个不稳定的软件版本。

e.en: She {tamed} the wild horse with patience and kindness.
e.zh: 她用耐心和善意驯服了那匹野马。

e.en: The dog followed her {tamely} through the crowded park.
e.zh: 那只狗温顺地跟着她穿过拥挤的公园。

e.en: He accepted the criticism too {tamely} for my taste.
e.zh: 在我看来,他对批评接受得过于顺从了。

e.en: The bird's surprising {tameness} delighted the visitors.
e.zh: 那只鸟出奇的温顺让游客们十分高兴。

e.en: Critics complained about the {tameness} of the new album.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨这张新专辑过于平淡。

tamer.t:
n. 驯兽师
adj. 更温顺的

e.en: The lion {tamer} stepped confidently into the cage.
e.zh: 驯狮员自信地走进了兽笼。

e.en: This sequel is much {tamer} than the original film.
e.zh: 这部续集比原作温和得多。

tamil.t:
n. 泰米尔人；泰米尔语
adj. 泰米尔的

e.en: She speaks fluent {Tamil} with her grandparents at home.
e.zh: 她在家里和祖父母讲一口流利的泰米尔语。

e.en: The film won awards across the {Tamil}-speaking world.
e.zh: 这部电影在整个泰米尔语世界都获得了奖项。

taming.t:
n. 驯服
v. 驯养（现在分词）

e.en: {Taming} inflation has become the central bank's top priority.
e.zh: 抑制通货膨胀已成为央行的首要任务。

e.en: The trainer specialized in {taming} rescued horses.
e.zh: 那位训练员专门驯服被救助的马匹。

tammuz.t: n. 犹太历四月；古神名

e.en: In the Hebrew calendar, {Tammuz} falls during summer.
e.zh: 在希伯来历中,搭模斯月是在夏季。

e.en: Ancient Mesopotamians worshipped a god named {Tammuz}.
e.zh: 古代美索不达米亚人崇拜一位名叫塔姆兹的神。

tamoxifen.t: n. 他莫昔芬（抗乳腺癌药）

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {tamoxifen} for five years after surgery.
e.zh: 医生为她在手术后开了五年的他莫昔芬。

e.en: {Tamoxifen} is widely used to treat hormone-sensitive breast cancer.
e.zh: 他莫昔芬被广泛用于治疗激素敏感性乳腺癌。

e.en: Use the puck to {tamp} the espresso grounds firmly.
e.zh: 用压粉器把意式咖啡粉压实。

e.en: Workers {tamp} the soil before laying the foundation.
e.zh: 工人们在打地基前先夯实土壤。

tampa.t: n. 坦帕（美国佛州城市）

e.en: Our flight to {Tampa} was delayed by thunderstorms.
e.zh: 我们飞往坦帕的航班因雷暴而延误。

e.en: {Tampa} sits along the warm Gulf Coast of Florida.
e.zh: 坦帕坐落在佛罗里达州温暖的墨西哥湾沿岸。

tampax.t: n. 丹碧丝（卫生棉条品牌）

e.en: She grabbed a box of {Tampax} from the pharmacy shelf.
e.zh: 她从药店货架上拿了一盒丹碧丝卫生棉条。

e.en: {Tampax} has been a familiar brand since the 1930s.
e.zh: 丹碧丝自上世纪三十年代以来就是知名品牌。

e.en: Do not {tamper} with the smoke detector in your room.
e.zh: 请勿擅自改动房间里的烟雾报警器。

e.en: Hackers tried to {tamper} with the election results.
e.zh: 黑客试图篡改选举结果。

tampering.t:
n. 篡改；干预
v. 干预（现在分词）

e.en: The seal showed clear signs of {tampering}.
e.zh: 封条上显示出明显的被人动过的痕迹。

e.en: Investigators accused him of {tampering} with witnesses.
e.zh: 调查人员指控他干扰证人。

e.en: She kept a spare {tampon} in her backpack pocket.
e.zh: 她在背包侧袋里备了一支卫生棉条。

e.en: Many countries now offer free {tampon} access in schools.
e.zh: 许多国家现在在学校免费提供卫生棉条。

e.en: Cardiac {tamponade} requires immediate emergency treatment.
e.zh: 心脏压塞需要立即进行紧急治疗。

e.en: The surgeon used balloon {tamponade} to stop the bleeding.
e.zh: 外科医生用球囊压迫止血。

tamworth.t: n. 塔姆沃思（英国地名/猪种）

e.en: The {Tamworth} pig is prized for its lean bacon.
e.zh: 塔姆沃思猪因其瘦肉培根而备受推崇。

e.en: We drove through {Tamworth} on our way to Birmingham.
e.zh: 我们在前往伯明翰的路上经过了塔姆沃思。

tan.t:
v. 晒黑；鞣制
adj./n. 棕褐色

e.en: A bright red {tanager} flashed through the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 一只鲜红的唐纳雀掠过雨林树冠。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {tanager} near the lake.
e.zh: 观鸟者在湖边发现了一只罕见的唐纳雀。

e.en: Mr. {Tanaka} introduced himself politely at the meeting.
e.zh: 田中先生在会上礼貌地介绍了自己。

e.en: {Tanaka} is one of the most common surnames in Japan.
e.zh: 田中是日本最常见的姓氏之一。

tandem.t:
n. 双人自行车
adv. 前后排列；协同

e.en: The two engineers worked in {tandem} to ship the feature.
e.zh: 两位工程师协同合作,顺利上线了这个功能。

e.en: They rented a {tandem} bicycle and rode along the coast.
e.zh: 他们租了一辆双人自行车,沿着海岸骑行。

e.en: I ordered {tandoori} chicken with garlic naan for dinner.
e.zh: 我点了印度烤鸡配蒜香烤饼当晚餐。

e.en: A traditional clay oven gives {tandoori} dishes their flavor.
e.zh: 传统的泥炉赋予了印度烤炉菜独特的风味。

e.en: My uncle still owns an old {Tandy} computer from the eighties.
e.zh: 我叔叔仍保留着一台八十年代的老坦迪电脑。

e.en: Jessica {Tandy} won an Oscar for Driving Miss Daisy.
e.zh: 杰西卡·坦迪凭借《为黛西小姐开车》获得了奥斯卡奖。

tang.t:
n. 强烈气味；刺鼻味
n. 刀柄根

e.en: The salad dressing has a sharp lemon {tang}.
e.zh: 这款沙拉酱带有浓烈的柠檬酸味。

e.en: Sea air carried a salty {tang} through the open window.
e.zh: 海风从敞开的窗户带来一股咸味。

tanganyika.t: n. 坦噶尼喀（东非地区）

e.en: Lake {Tanganyika} is one of the deepest lakes on Earth.
e.zh: 坦噶尼喀湖是地球上最深的湖泊之一。

e.en: {Tanganyika} merged with Zanzibar to form modern Tanzania.
e.zh: 坦噶尼喀与桑给巴尔合并,组成了今天的坦桑尼亚。

tangent.t:
n. 切线；正切
n. 离题

e.en: The professor went off on a {tangent} about her travels.
e.zh: 教授突然跑题,聊起了自己的旅行经历。

e.en: Draw a {tangent} line touching the circle at one point.
e.zh: 画一条与圆只相切于一点的切线。

e.en: His comment was {tangential} to the main discussion.
e.zh: 他的评论与主要讨论关系不大。

e.en: The report includes only {tangential} references to climate change.
e.zh: 这份报告只对气候变化进行了次要的提及。

e.en: The article only {tangentially} addresses the privacy concerns.
e.zh: 这篇文章只是顺带提到了隐私方面的问题。

e.en: She is {tangentially} involved in the merger negotiations.
e.zh: 她仅以次要身份参与了合并谈判。

e.en: She peeled a {tangerine} and shared it with her sister.
e.zh: 她剥了一个橘子，分给妹妹吃。

e.en: The sunset turned the sky a brilliant {tangerine} color.
e.zh: 夕阳把天空染成了鲜艳的橘色。

e.en: The new policy produced {tangible} benefits within months.
e.zh: 新政策几个月内就带来了实实在在的好处。

e.en: Investors want {tangible} proof that the product works.
e.zh: 投资者想要看到产品有效的实质证据。

e.en: The team's morale has {tangibly} improved since the new manager arrived.
e.zh: 自从新经理上任，团队士气有了明显提升。

e.en: Her hard work paid off {tangibly} in the quarterly results.
e.zh: 她的努力在季度业绩中得到了切实的回报。

tangier.t: n. 丹吉尔（摩洛哥港市）

e.en: We took a ferry from Spain to {Tangier} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从西班牙坐渡轮去了丹吉尔。

e.en: This sauce tastes {tangier} than the one we tried yesterday.
e.zh: 这款酱料比我们昨天尝的更酸爽。

tapa.t: n. 塔帕布（太平洋岛屿传统树皮布料）

e.en: Pacific islanders make {tapa} cloth from tree bark.
e.zh: 太平洋岛民用树皮制作塔帕布。

e.en: The museum displayed a beautifully painted {tapa} from Tonga.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块来自汤加的精美塔帕布。

tape.t:
n. 胶带；磁带
v. 用胶带粘贴；录制

e.en: Can you pass me the {tape} to wrap this gift?
e.zh: 能把胶带递给我包一下这个礼物吗?

e.en: Police used yellow {tape} to mark off the area.
e.zh: 警察用黄色警戒带把这片区域围了起来。

taped.t: v. 用胶带粘住；录制（tape 的过去式）

e.en: She {taped} the poster onto the classroom wall.
e.zh: 她把海报用胶带贴在教室墙上。

e.en: The interview was {taped} for broadcast next week.
e.zh: 这次采访录了像,下周播出。

e.en: He spread olive {tapenade} thickly on the toasted bread.
e.zh: 他在烤面包上厚厚地抹了一层橄榄酱。

e.en: The chef served {tapenade} as an appetizer with crackers.
e.zh: 主厨用饼干配橄榄酱作为开胃菜。

taper.t:
v. 逐渐变细；逐渐减少
n. 细蜡烛

e.en: The pants {taper} slightly toward the ankle.
e.zh: 这条裤子在脚踝处稍微收窄。

e.en: Doctors advised him to {taper} off the medication slowly.
e.zh: 医生建议他慢慢减少用药剂量。

tapered.t:
adj. 逐渐变细的
v. 使渐细（过去式）

e.en: She wore {tapered} jeans that hugged her ankles.
e.zh: 她穿着一条贴脚踝的锥形牛仔裤。

e.en: The candle {tapered} to a fine point at the top.
e.zh: 蜡烛顶端逐渐变细成尖头。

tapering.t:
adj. 渐细的
n. 逐渐减少

e.en: The runner is {tapering} her training before the marathon.
e.zh: 这位跑者在马拉松前逐渐减少训练量。

e.en: The tower has a {tapering} spire that catches sunlight.
e.zh: 那座塔有一个逐渐收窄的尖顶,在阳光下闪光。

tapes.t:
n. 磁带；胶带（复数）
v. 录制（第三人称单数）

e.en: He still keeps old cassette {tapes} from the nineties.
e.zh: 他还留着九十年代的旧磁带。

e.en: The coach reviews game {tapes} every Monday morning.
e.zh: 教练每周一早上都会回看比赛录像。

e.en: A medieval {tapestry} hangs on the castle wall.
e.zh: 城堡墙上挂着一幅中世纪挂毯。

e.en: The novel weaves a rich {tapestry} of family secrets.
e.zh: 这部小说编织出一幅丰富的家族秘密图景。

e.en: The vet found a {tapeworm} in the puppy's intestines.
e.zh: 兽医在小狗的肠子里发现了绦虫。

e.en: Undercooked pork can transmit a {tapeworm} to humans.
e.zh: 未煮熟的猪肉可能把绦虫传给人。

taping.t: v. 录音；用胶带粘（tape 的现在分词）

e.en: The studio is {taping} the new sitcom this weekend.
e.zh: 摄影棚这个周末正在录制新情景喜剧。

e.en: He spent the morning {taping} boxes for the move.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在用胶带封箱准备搬家。

tapioca.t: n. 木薯粉；珍珠（奶茶里的那种）

e.en: I ordered milk tea with {tapioca} pearls at the bottom.
e.zh: 我点了一杯底下加木薯珍珠的奶茶。

e.en: Grandma made a creamy {tapioca} pudding for dessert.
e.zh: 奶奶做了一份香滑的木薯布丁当甜点。

e.en: A {tapir} waded slowly through the jungle stream.
e.zh: 一只貘在丛林溪水中缓缓涉水。

e.en: The zoo just welcomed a baby {tapir} last week.
e.zh: 动物园上周刚迎来一只貘宝宝。

tapped.t: v. 轻敲；点按（tap 的过去式）

e.en: She {tapped} her phone screen to unlock it.
e.zh: 她轻点手机屏幕将其解锁。

e.en: The startup {tapped} a former Google engineer as CEO.
e.zh: 这家初创公司任命一位前谷歌工程师为CEO。

e.en: The rubber {tapper} starts work before sunrise each day.
e.zh: 那位割胶工每天日出前就开始干活。

e.en: My sister is a fast {tapper} on the keyboard.
e.zh: 我妹妹敲键盘的速度很快。

tapping.t:
v. 轻敲；点按（tap 的现在分词）
n. 敲击声

e.en: Stop {tapping} your pen during the meeting, please.
e.zh: 开会时请别再用笔敲桌子了。

e.en: The company is {tapping} into the Asian market this year.
e.zh: 公司今年正在进军亚洲市场。

taproom.t: n. 酒馆；（旅馆内的）酒吧

e.en: The brewery's {taproom} fills up every Friday night.
e.zh: 这家啤酒厂的酒吧间每周五晚都坐满人。

e.en: We met some locals at the village {taproom}.
e.zh: 我们在村里的小酒馆认识了几位当地人。

e.en: Carrots have a long {taproot} that stores nutrients.
e.zh: 胡萝卜有一条长长的主根用来储存养分。

e.en: Family loyalty is the {taproot} of his values.
e.zh: 家庭忠诚是他价值观的根基。

taps.t:
n. 水龙头（复数）
v. 轻敲（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {taps} the screen twice to like a post.
e.zh: 她双击屏幕来给帖子点赞。

e.en: Both bathroom {taps} need replacing this weekend.
e.zh: 这周末两个浴室水龙头都得换掉。

taqueria.t: n. 墨西哥卷饼小吃店

e.en: There's an amazing {taqueria} on the corner of my street.
e.zh: 我家街角有一家超棒的墨西哥卷饼店。

e.en: We grabbed late-night burritos at a {taqueria} downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心一家塔可店买了夜宵卷饼。

tar.t:
n. 焦油；沥青
v. 涂焦油

e.en: My friend {tara} just moved to Toronto for work.
e.zh: 我朋友塔拉刚因工作搬到多伦多。

e.en: The hill of {tara} is a famous Irish landmark.
e.zh: 塔拉山是爱尔兰著名的历史地标。

e.en: We dipped warm pita into creamy {taramasalata}.
e.zh: 我们用温热的皮塔饼蘸着香浓的鱼子酱沙拉吃。

e.en: The Greek deli sells excellent homemade {taramasalata}.
e.zh: 那家希腊熟食店卖很棒的自制鱼子泥。

e.en: A hairy {tarantula} crawled across the desert sand.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的狼蛛爬过沙漠的沙地。

e.en: He keeps a pet {tarantula} in a glass tank.
e.zh: 他在玻璃缸里养了一只宠物狼蛛。

e.en: He arrived {tardily} and missed the opening speech.
e.zh: 他姗姗来迟,错过了开幕致辞。

e.en: The package was delivered {tardily} due to bad weather.
e.zh: 由于天气恶劣,包裹延误送达。

e.en: Her constant {tardiness} finally cost her the job.
e.zh: 她长期迟到最终让她丢了工作。

e.en: The teacher noted his {tardiness} on the report card.
e.zh: 老师在成绩单上记下了他的迟到情况。

tardis.t: n. 塔迪斯（《神秘博士》中的时光机）

e.en: The Doctor's {tardis} looks like a blue police box.
e.zh: 博士的塔迪斯外形像一个蓝色警亭。

e.en: My tiny apartment is a {tardis} — bigger than it looks.
e.zh: 我的小公寓像塔迪斯一样,里面比看上去大得多。

e.en: Students who are {tardy} must sign in at the office.
e.zh: 迟到的学生必须到办公室签到。

e.en: His {tardy} apology did little to repair the damage.
e.zh: 他姗姗来迟的道歉无法弥补损害。

tare.t: n. 皮重（容器自重）；野豌豆

e.en: The scale subtracts the {tare} weight automatically.
e.zh: 这台秤会自动扣除皮重。

e.en: Press the {tare} button before adding the flour.
e.zh: 加面粉前请先按一下去皮按钮。

target.t:
n. 目标；靶子
v. 瞄准；针对

e.en: Our {target} is to launch the app by December.
e.zh: 我们的目标是十二月前推出这款应用。

e.en: The arrow hit the {target} dead center.
e.zh: 箭正中靶心。

targeted.t:
adj. 定向的；针对性的
v. 瞄准（过去式）

e.en: Facebook shows {targeted} ads based on your browsing history.
e.zh: 脸书会根据你的浏览记录显示定向广告。

e.en: The campaign {targeted} young first-time voters.
e.zh: 这次活动主要面向年轻的首次投票者。

targeting.t:
n. 定向投放；目标锁定
v. 瞄准（现在分词）

e.en: The startup is {targeting} small business owners directly.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正直接瞄准小企业主。

e.en: Hackers have been {targeting} hospital networks lately.
e.zh: 近来黑客一直在攻击医院网络。

targets.t:
n. 目标（复数）
v. 瞄准（第三人称单数）

e.en: The sales team hit all their quarterly {targets}.
e.zh: 销售团队完成了所有季度目标。

e.en: Phishing emails often {targets} elderly users first.
e.zh: 钓鱼邮件常常首先针对年长用户。

e.en: The new {tariff} on imported steel angered allies.
e.zh: 对进口钢铁征收的新关税激怒了盟友。

e.en: Check the hotel's {tariff} before booking a long stay.
e.zh: 长期入住前先看看酒店的价目表。

e.en: The plane sat on the {tarmac} for two hours.
e.zh: 飞机在停机坪上停了两个小时。

e.en: Hot {tarmac} stuck to the soles of my shoes.
e.zh: 滚烫的柏油路面粘在我的鞋底上。

tarmacadam.t: n. 柏油碎石路面材料

e.en: Workers laid fresh {tarmacadam} along the village road.
e.zh: 工人们沿着村路铺了一层新的柏油碎石路面。

e.en: The driveway was resurfaced with smooth {tarmacadam}.
e.zh: 车道用平整的柏油碎石重新铺过了。

e.en: We hiked up to a quiet mountain {tarn}.
e.zh: 我们徒步走到山间一个静谧的小湖。

e.en: The {tarn} reflected the clouds like a polished mirror.
e.zh: 那汪山中小湖像打磨过的镜子般映出云朵。

tarnish.t:
v. 使失去光泽；玷污
n. 晦暗；污点

e.en: Silver jewelry will {tarnish} if left in humid air.
e.zh: 银饰放在潮湿空气中会失去光泽。

e.en: The scandal could {tarnish} the company's reputation.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻可能会玷污公司的声誉。

tarnished.t: adj. 失去光泽的；名誉受损的

e.en: She polished the {tarnished} silverware before the dinner.
e.zh: 她在晚宴前把发黑的银器擦亮。

e.en: His reputation was {tarnished} by the leaked emails.
e.zh: 泄露的邮件让他的名声受损。

e.en: I love the purple color of {taro} bubble tea.
e.zh: 我超爱香芋珍珠奶茶的紫色。

e.en: In Hawaii, {taro} is mashed into a paste called poi.
e.zh: 在夏威夷,芋头被捣成一种叫poi的泥。

e.en: She offered to read my {tarot} cards at the party.
e.zh: 她在派对上提议帮我读塔罗牌。

e.en: The {tarot} deck has seventy-eight beautifully illustrated cards.
e.zh: 这副塔罗牌有七十八张精美插画的卡片。

tarp.t: n. 防水布（tarpaulin 的缩写）

e.en: Cover the firewood with a {tarp} before the rain.
e.zh: 下雨前用防水布把柴火盖好。

e.en: Workers stretched a blue {tarp} over the leaking roof.
e.zh: 工人们在漏雨的屋顶上铺了一块蓝色防水布。

tarpaper.t: n. 沥青防水纸；油毛毡

e.en: They lined the roof with {tarpaper} before adding shingles.
e.zh: 他们先在屋顶铺上油毡纸,再钉上瓦片。

e.en: The shed walls are still bare {tarpaper}.
e.zh: 棚屋的墙仍然只贴着油毡纸。

e.en: They pulled a heavy {tarpaulin} over the truck bed.
e.zh: 他们在卡车货厢上拉上一块厚重的防水油布。

e.en: Campers slept under a green {tarpaulin} during the storm.
e.zh: 露营者们在暴风雨中睡在一块绿色防水布下。

tarpon.t: n. 大海鲢（一种大型鱼）

e.en: He hooked a massive silver {tarpon} off the Florida coast.
e.zh: 他在佛罗里达海岸钓到一条巨大的银色大海鲢。

e.en: Anglers travel far for the chance to catch {tarpon}.
e.zh: 垂钓者远道而来,只为有机会钓到大海鲢。

e.en: Add fresh {tarragon} to the chicken before roasting.
e.zh: 烤鸡前先加些新鲜龙蒿。

e.en: The sauce gets its sharp flavor from {tarragon} leaves.
e.zh: 这酱汁辛香的味道来自龙蒿叶。

tarred.t: v. 涂焦油于（tar 的过去式）

e.en: The crew {tarred} the roof to seal every crack.
e.zh: 工人们在屋顶涂上沥青,把每条裂缝都封住。

e.en: He was unfairly {tarred} as a troublemaker by colleagues.
e.zh: 他被同事们不公平地贴上了麻烦制造者的标签。

tarry.t:
v. 逗留；耽搁
adj. 涂了焦油的

e.en: Don't {tarry} too long at the coffee shop.
e.zh: 别在咖啡店逗留太久。

e.en: Black {tarry} smoke poured from the burning tires.
e.zh: 燃烧的轮胎冒出黑色的沥青般浓烟。

e.en: The runner fractured a small {tarsal} bone in her foot.
e.zh: 这位跑者脚部一块跗骨发生了骨折。

e.en: Doctors examined the swollen {tarsal} joint carefully.
e.zh: 医生们仔细检查了肿胀的跗关节。

e.en: The {tarsus} is the cluster of bones in your ankle.
e.zh: 跗骨是脚踝处的一组骨头。

e.en: She injured her {tarsus} during basketball practice.
e.zh: 她在篮球训练中弄伤了跗骨。

tart.t:
n. 果馅挞
adj. 酸的；尖刻的

e.en: I baked a strawberry {tart} for Sunday brunch.
e.zh: 我为周日早午餐烤了一个草莓挞。

e.en: Her {tart} reply ended the conversation immediately.
e.zh: 她尖刻的回应立刻终止了对话。

e.en: He wore a traditional {tartan} kilt to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着传统的格子呢苏格兰短裙参加婚礼。

e.en: Each Scottish clan has its own unique {tartan} pattern.
e.zh: 每个苏格兰家族都有自己独特的格子图案。

e.en: Brushing twice daily helps prevent {tartar} buildup on teeth.
e.zh: 每天刷两次牙有助于防止牙石堆积。

e.en: He dipped the fish stick in {tartar} sauce.
e.zh: 他把鱼条蘸了塔塔酱。

e.en: The bakery sells lemon {tartlet} pastries every morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天早上都卖柠檬小挞。

e.en: She served a tiny {tartlet} topped with fresh berries.
e.zh: 她端上一个小挞,顶上点缀着新鲜浆果。

e.en: "That's none of your business," she replied {tartly}.
e.zh: “那不关你的事,”她尖刻地回应道。

e.en: He spoke {tartly} about the manager's poor decisions.
e.zh: 他对经理糟糕的决定尖刻地评论了几句。

e.en: The lemon adds a refreshing {tartness} to the dressing.
e.zh: 柠檬给沙拉酱增添了一丝清爽的酸味。

e.en: There was a hint of {tartness} in her tone.
e.zh: 她的语气中带着一丝刻薄。

e.en: She thought the dress looked a bit {tarty} for the office.
e.zh: 她觉得这条裙子穿去办公室有点过于妖艳。

e.en: He criticized the singer's {tarty} stage outfit.
e.zh: 他批评那位歌手舞台造型过于花哨俗艳。

e.en: The kids pretended to be {Tarzan} swinging through the jungle.
e.zh: 孩子们假装成泰山在丛林里荡来荡去。

e.en: He let out a loud {Tarzan} yell from the treehouse.
e.zh: 他从树屋上发出一声响亮的泰山式吼叫。

tashkent.t: n. 塔什干（乌兹别克首都）

e.en: Our flight to {Tashkent} lands early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们飞往塔什干的航班明天一早抵达。

e.en: {Tashkent} is the capital and largest city of Uzbekistan.
e.zh: 塔什干是乌兹别克斯坦的首都和最大城市。

task.t:
n. 任务；工作
v. 派给任务

e.en: Finishing the report by Friday is my top {task}.
e.zh: 周五前完成报告是我最重要的任务。

e.en: The app lets you {task} teammates with quick reminders.
e.zh: 这款应用可以给队友派发快速提醒任务。

e.en: Pin your favorite apps to the {taskbar} for quick access.
e.zh: 把常用应用固定到任务栏方便快速打开。

e.en: The clock disappeared from my Windows {taskbar} after the update.
e.zh: 更新后我的Windows任务栏上时钟不见了。

e.en: The mayor set up a {taskforce} to tackle homelessness.
e.zh: 市长成立了一个专责小组来解决无家可归问题。

e.en: A cybersecurity {taskforce} investigated the data breach.
e.zh: 一个网络安全专案组调查了这次数据泄露。

e.en: Our coach is a strict {taskmaster} during training camp.
e.zh: 我们的教练在集训时是个严厉的监工。

e.en: She's a tough {taskmaster}, but her team always delivers.
e.zh: 她要求很严,但她的团队总能交付成果。

tasks.t:
n. 任务（复数）
v. 派任务

e.en: I added three new {tasks} to my to-do list.
e.zh: 我在待办清单里又加了三项任务。

e.en: The robot can perform simple household {tasks} automatically.
e.zh: 这台机器人能自动完成一些简单家务。

e.en: Sailors crossed the {Tasman} Sea between Australia and New Zealand.
e.zh: 水手们横渡了澳大利亚和新西兰之间的塔斯曼海。

e.en: Storms in the {Tasman} delayed several flights yesterday.
e.zh: 塔斯曼海的风暴昨天延误了多个航班。

tasmania.t: n. 塔斯马尼亚（澳洲州）

e.en: We hiked through ancient rainforests in {Tasmania} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在塔斯马尼亚的原始雨林徒步。

e.en: {Tasmania} is famous for its clean air and wildlife.
e.zh: 塔斯马尼亚以空气清新和野生动物丰富著称。

tasmanian.t:
adj. 塔斯马尼亚的
n. 塔州人

e.en: The {Tasmanian} devil is an endangered marsupial.
e.zh: 袋獾是一种濒危的塔斯马尼亚有袋动物。

e.en: She bought a bottle of {Tasmanian} pinot noir.
e.zh: 她买了一瓶塔斯马尼亚黑皮诺红酒。

tass.t: n. 塔斯社（苏联通讯社）

e.en: The news agency {Tass} reported the official statement.
e.zh: 塔斯社报道了这份官方声明。

e.en: He poured whisky into a small silver {tass}.
e.zh: 他把威士忌倒进一只小银杯里。

e.en: A red silk {tassel} hung from her graduation cap.
e.zh: 她的毕业帽上挂着一条红色丝穗。

e.en: The curtain was tied back with a golden {tassel}.
e.zh: 窗帘被一根金色流苏系在一旁。

e.en: He wore {tasseled} loafers to the office party.
e.zh: 他穿着带流苏的乐福鞋去公司派对。

e.en: A {tasseled} bookmark stuck out of the novel.
e.zh: 一枚带穗的书签从小说里露了出来。

tasselled.t: adj. 带流苏的（英式拼写）

e.en: She bought a {tasselled} cushion for the sofa.
e.zh: 她为沙发买了个带流苏的抱枕。

e.en: The horse wore a brightly {tasselled} bridle.
e.zh: 那匹马戴着色彩鲜艳的流苏马辔。

taste.t:
n. 味道；品味
v. 品尝

e.en: This soup has a wonderful spicy {taste}.
e.zh: 这碗汤有着美妙的辛辣味道。

e.en: Would you like to {taste} the wine before I pour?
e.zh: 您要不要先尝尝酒再倒?

e.en: She is a respected {taste-maker} in the fashion industry.
e.zh: 她是时尚界备受尊敬的潮流引领者。

e.en: Online influencers have replaced traditional {taste-maker} critics.
e.zh: 网络红人已取代了传统的潮流评论家。

e.en: Magazine editors used to be the main {taste-makers}.
e.zh: 杂志编辑曾是主要的潮流引领者。

e.en: Today's {taste-makers} build their followings on TikTok.
e.zh: 如今的潮流引领者在 TikTok 上积累粉丝。

e.en: Each {tastebud} can detect several different flavors.
e.zh: 每个味蕾都能感知好几种不同的味道。

e.en: A burnt tongue can damage every {tastebud} temporarily.
e.zh: 烫伤舌头会暂时损伤每一个味蕾。

e.en: Spicy food really wakes up my {tastebuds}.
e.zh: 辣的食物真能唤醒我的味蕾。

e.en: The dessert was a treat for the {tastebuds}.
e.zh: 这道甜点对味蕾来说是种享受。

e.en: The fresh bread {tasted} amazing with butter.
e.zh: 刚出炉的面包配黄油味道好极了。

e.en: She {tasted} the sauce and added more salt.
e.zh: 她尝了尝酱汁,又加了些盐。

e.en: The apartment had {tasteful} modern furniture throughout.
e.zh: 整套公寓都摆着雅致的现代家具。

e.en: She made a {tasteful} speech at the wedding.
e.zh: 她在婚礼上发表了一段得体的致辞。

e.en: The room was {tastefully} decorated in soft neutrals.
e.zh: 房间用柔和的中性色调装饰得很雅致。

e.en: He dresses {tastefully} without ever looking flashy.
e.zh: 他穿着雅致,却从不显得花哨。

e.en: The hospital food was bland and {tasteless}.
e.zh: 医院的伙食既清淡又没什么味道。

e.en: His joke about the accident was deeply {tasteless}.
e.zh: 他拿那场事故开的玩笑非常没品。

e.en: Critics condemned the ad for its sheer {tastelessness}.
e.zh: 评论家批评这则广告毫无品味。

e.en: The {tastelessness} of the soup ruined the meal.
e.zh: 汤毫无味道,毁了这顿饭。

e.en: He became a leading {tastemaker} in indie music.
e.zh: 他成了独立音乐圈里引领风向的人物。

e.en: Every era has its own celebrity {tastemaker}.
e.zh: 每个时代都有自己的名人潮流引领者。

e.en: She works as a professional tea {taster} in Sri Lanka.
e.zh: 她在斯里兰卡做专业品茶师。

e.en: The chef offered us a {taster} of the new dish.
e.zh: 主厨给我们送上了新菜的试吃小份。

tastes.t:
n. 味道（复数）
v. 尝起来

e.en: Her musical {tastes} range from jazz to hip-hop.
e.zh: 她的音乐口味从爵士到嘻哈无所不包。

e.en: This cheese {tastes} stronger than I expected.
e.zh: 这种奶酪的味道比我想象中要重。

tasting.t:
n. 品鉴会
v. 品尝（现在分词）

e.en: We signed up for a wine {tasting} on Saturday.
e.zh: 我们报名参加了周六的品酒会。

e.en: She is {tasting} the broth to check the seasoning.
e.zh: 她正在尝汤,看看调味怎么样。

e.en: That was the most {tasty} burger I've had in years.
e.zh: 那是我多年来吃过最美味的汉堡。

e.en: She packed a {tasty} lunch for the picnic.
e.zh: 她为野餐准备了一份美味的午餐。

tat.t:
n. 劣质货
v. 编织花边

e.en: We slept on futons spread over a {tatami} floor.
e.zh: 我们睡在铺着榻榻米的地板上,垫的是日式被褥。

e.en: Please remove your shoes before stepping on the {tatami}.
e.zh: 踏上榻榻米前请先脱鞋。

tatar.t:
n. 鞑靼人
adj. 鞑靼的

e.en: She is learning to speak {Tatar} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她正跟着奶奶学说鞑靼语。

e.en: The {Tatar} community in Kazan celebrated the festival.
e.zh: 喀山的鞑靼社区庆祝了这个节日。

e.en: We spent the afternoon at the {Tate} Modern in London.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在伦敦的泰特现代美术馆。

e.en: The {Tate} owns one of the world's best Turner collections.
e.zh: 泰特美术馆拥有世界上最棒的透纳画作收藏之一。

e.en: He ordered a burger with extra {tater} tots.
e.zh: 他点了个汉堡,还加了份薯球。

e.en: Mom is mashing a big pot of {tater} for dinner.
e.zh: 妈妈正捣着一大锅土豆当晚餐。

tatler.t: n. 闲谈者；《闲谈者》杂志

e.en: Her wedding photos appeared in {Tatler} magazine.
e.zh: 她的婚礼照片登上了《Tatler》杂志。

e.en: {Tatler} covers high society and luxury lifestyle.
e.zh: 《Tatler》报道上流社会和奢华生活方式。

e.en: We went hiking in the High {Tatra} mountains last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们去了高塔特拉山徒步。

e.en: The {Tatra} range straddles Poland and Slovakia.
e.zh: 塔特拉山脉横跨波兰和斯洛伐克。

e.en: A torn {tatter} of cloth fluttered from the fence.
e.zh: 一片破布在围栏上随风飘动。

e.en: Years of war left every {tatter} of the flag visible.
e.zh: 多年的战争让旗帜的每一处破损都清晰可见。

tattered.t: adj. 破烂的；衣衫褴褛的

e.en: He carried a {tattered} copy of his favorite novel.
e.zh: 他随身带着一本破旧的最爱小说。

e.en: The refugees arrived in {tattered} clothes and worn shoes.
e.zh: 难民们穿着破烂的衣服和磨损的鞋子到来。

tangle.t:
v. 使缠结；纠缠
n. 乱麻；混乱

e.en: My headphone cables always {tangle} inside my bag.
e.zh: 我的耳机线总是在包里缠成一团。

e.en: She brushed out the {tangle} in her hair carefully.
e.zh: 她小心地梳开了头发上的结。

tangled.t: adj. 缠结的；错综复杂的

e.en: The kitten got {tangled} in the ball of yarn.
e.zh: 小猫被毛线团缠住了。

e.en: Their finances became hopelessly {tangled} after the divorce.
e.zh: 离婚后他们的财务变得一团糟。

tangles.t:
v. 缠结（tangle 的第三人称单数）
n. 乱麻（复数）

e.en: The hairdresser gently worked through the {tangles} in her curls.
e.zh: 理发师轻轻地梳开她卷发里的发结。

e.en: This conditioner promises to remove {tangles} instantly.
e.zh: 这款护发素号称能立刻解开打结。

tangling.t: v. 正在缠结（tangle 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {tangling} the charging cables on the desk.
e.zh: 别把桌上的充电线弄缠在一起了。

e.en: The company is {tangling} with regulators over the new app.
e.zh: 该公司正与监管机构就新应用产生纠纷。

tango.t:
n. 探戈舞
v. 跳探戈

e.en: They took {tango} lessons together every Friday night.
e.zh: 他们每周五晚上一起去上探戈课。

e.en: It takes two to {tango}, so don't blame just him.
e.zh: 一个巴掌拍不响，别光怪他一个人。

tangy.t: adj. 味道浓烈的；扑鼻的

e.en: This lemon dressing has a wonderfully {tangy} flavor.
e.zh: 这款柠檬酱料带有非常爽口的酸味。

e.en: I love the {tangy} taste of fresh yogurt in the morning.
e.zh: 我喜欢早上吃新鲜酸奶那种酸爽的味道。

tank.t:
n. 坦克；水箱
v. 惨败；暴跌

e.en: The fuel {tank} is almost empty, so we should stop soon.
e.zh: 油箱快空了，我们得尽快加油。

e.en: Sales for the new product began to {tank} after the bad reviews.
e.zh: 差评出现后，新产品的销量开始暴跌。

tanka.t: n. 日本短歌（和歌的一种）

e.en: She wrote a beautiful {tanka} about cherry blossoms in spring.
e.zh: 她写了一首优美的短歌，描写春天的樱花。

e.en: Japanese {tanka} poetry follows a strict five-line structure.
e.zh: 日本短歌遵循严格的五行结构。

e.en: He raised his pewter {tankard} and toasted the bride.
e.zh: 他举起锡制大酒杯，向新娘敬酒。

e.en: The pub displayed antique {tankard} mugs on the wall.
e.zh: 酒吧的墙上陈列着古董大酒杯。

e.en: An oil {tanker} ran aground off the coast last night.
e.zh: 一艘油轮昨晚在沿海搁浅了。

e.en: The fuel {tanker} delivers gasoline to stations every morning.
e.zh: 油罐车每天早上向加油站送汽油。

e.en: A {tankful} of gas costs nearly a hundred dollars now.
e.zh: 加满一箱油现在要将近一百美元。

e.en: One {tankful} should be enough to reach the next city.
e.zh: 一箱油应该够开到下一个城市。

tankini.t: n. 坦基尼（背心式两件套泳装）

e.en: She bought a new {tankini} for the beach vacation.
e.zh: 她为这次海滩度假买了一套新的两件式泳衣。

e.en: A {tankini} offers more coverage than a regular bikini.
e.zh: 两件式背心泳衣比普通比基尼遮盖面积更大。

tankless.t: adj. 无水箱的（如即热式热水器）

e.en: We installed a {tankless} water heater to save energy.
e.zh: 我们装了一台即热式热水器以节省能源。

e.en: A {tankless} system provides hot water on demand instantly.
e.zh: 即热式系统能即时提供热水。

tanks.t:
n. 坦克（复数）
v. 暴跌（第三人称单数）

e.en: The military deployed dozens of {tanks} along the border.
e.zh: 军方在边境部署了数十辆坦克。

e.en: Our aquarium has three large {tanks} of tropical fish.
e.zh: 我们的水族馆有三个大鱼缸养着热带鱼。

tanned.t:
adj. 晒黑的
v. 鞣制（皮革）

e.en: She came back from Bali looking deeply {tanned}.
e.zh: 她从巴厘岛回来后晒得黝黑。

e.en: His {tanned} arms showed he worked outdoors.
e.zh: 他晒黑的胳膊说明他常在户外工作。

e.en: The choir sang "O {Tannenbaum}" at the Christmas concert.
e.zh: 合唱团在圣诞音乐会上唱了《圣诞树》。

e.en: A tall {Tannenbaum} stood in the village square.
e.zh: 村中广场上立着一棵高大的圣诞树。

e.en: The {tanner} treated the leather with natural oils.
e.zh: 制革匠用天然油脂处理皮革。

e.en: After two weeks at the beach, she was much {tanner}.
e.zh: 在海滩待了两周后,她晒得黑了许多。

e.en: The old {tannery} has been turned into a design studio.
e.zh: 那家旧制革厂已经改造成设计工作室。

e.en: Workers at the {tannery} processed hides into leather.
e.zh: 制革厂的工人把生皮加工成皮革。

e.en: This red wine has a strong {tannic} aftertaste.
e.zh: 这款红酒有很重的单宁回味。

e.en: Black tea brewed too long becomes unpleasantly {tannic}.
e.zh: 红茶泡得太久会有难喝的涩味。

e.en: The {tannin} in the wine pairs well with steak.
e.zh: 这款酒的单宁和牛排搭配得很好。

e.en: Oak barrels add extra {tannin} to aged whiskey.
e.zh: 橡木桶会给陈年威士忌增添额外的单宁。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {tanning} by the pool.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在泳池边晒太阳。

e.en: Doctors warn that {tanning} beds can cause skin cancer.
e.zh: 医生警告说日晒床可能引发皮肤癌。

tannoy.t: n. 公共广播扩音系统

e.en: An announcement came over the {Tannoy} at the station.
e.zh: 车站的广播里传来一则通知。

e.en: His name was called on the {Tannoy} twice.
e.zh: 广播里两次叫了他的名字。

tans.t:
v. 晒黑（第三人称单数）
n. 棕褐色（复数）

e.en: She {tans} easily in the summer sun.
e.zh: 她在夏日阳光下很容易晒黑。

e.en: The brand offers spray {tans} that last a week.
e.zh: 这个品牌提供能维持一周的喷雾古铜色。

e.en: Bright yellow {tansy} grew along the country road.
e.zh: 鲜黄的艾菊沿着乡间小路盛开。

e.en: My grandmother used {tansy} to repel flies in the kitchen.
e.zh: 我奶奶用艾菊在厨房里驱赶苍蝇。

tantalise.t: v. 逗弄；使干着急（英式拼写）

e.en: The smell of fresh bread can really {tantalise} you.
e.zh: 新鲜面包的香味真能勾起人的食欲。

e.en: Movie trailers often {tantalise} fans without revealing too much.
e.zh: 电影预告片常常吊足影迷胃口又不剧透。

tantalised.t: v. 被逗弄（tantalise 过去式）

e.en: She was {tantalised} by the rumor of a promotion.
e.zh: 升职的传闻让她心痒难耐。

e.en: The chef {tantalised} guests with the smell of garlic butter.
e.zh: 厨师用蒜香黄油的气味勾住了客人的胃。

tantalises.t: v. 逗弄（第三人称单数，英式）

e.en: The brand {tantalises} customers with limited-edition drops.
e.zh: 这个品牌靠限量发售吊足顾客胃口。

e.en: Her unfinished story always {tantalises} the audience.
e.zh: 她未讲完的故事总能勾起听众的好奇心。

tantalising.t: adj. 诱人的；撩人的（英式）

e.en: The bakery window held a {tantalising} display of pastries.
e.zh: 面包店橱窗里摆着诱人的糕点。

e.en: He dropped a {tantalising} hint about the new project.
e.zh: 他抛出了一个关于新项目的诱人暗示。

tantalisingly.t: adv. 诱人地；撩拨地（英式）

e.en: The finish line was {tantalisingly} close at the end.
e.zh: 终点线在最后近得让人心痒。

e.en: She paused {tantalisingly} before revealing the answer.
e.zh: 她故意停顿了一下,吊足胃口才揭晓答案。

e.en: Streaming services {tantalize} viewers with weekly episode releases.
e.zh: 流媒体平台靠每周更新一集来吊住观众胃口。

e.en: Don't {tantalize} the dog with food he can't eat.
e.zh: 别拿狗不能吃的食物逗它馋嘴。

e.en: He was {tantalized} by the job offer in Tokyo.
e.zh: 东京那份工作的邀请让他心动不已。

e.en: The aroma {tantalized} everyone walking past the restaurant.
e.zh: 那股香味让每个路过餐厅的人都垂涎欲滴。

tantalizes.t: v. 逗弄（第三人称单数）

e.en: The teaser {tantalizes} fans with one quick shot.
e.zh: 这段预告用一个短镜头就把粉丝胃口吊起来了。

e.en: Her cryptic post {tantalizes} followers every Friday.
e.zh: 她每周五的神秘帖子都让粉丝心痒难耐。

e.en: The menu offered a {tantalizing} list of desserts.
e.zh: 菜单上列着一长串诱人的甜点。

e.en: He gave her a {tantalizing} glimpse of the surprise.
e.zh: 他让她瞥了一眼那个诱人的惊喜。

e.en: The keys lay {tantalizingly} just out of reach.
e.zh: 钥匙就放在差一点够不到的位置,让人心急。

e.en: She smiled {tantalizingly} and walked away.
e.zh: 她诱人地笑了笑,转身走开。

tantalum.t: n. 钽（化学元素，符号 Ta）

e.en: Most smartphones contain a small amount of {tantalum}.
e.zh: 大多数智能手机都含有少量钽。

e.en: {Tantalum} is prized for its resistance to corrosion.
e.zh: 钽因耐腐蚀性强而备受重视。

tantalus.t: n. 坦塔罗斯（希腊神话人物）

e.en: In Greek myth, {Tantalus} was punished with eternal hunger.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,坦塔罗斯被罚永远忍受饥饿。

e.en: The locked {tantalus} held three crystal decanters.
e.zh: 那只上锁的酒柜里装着三只水晶酒瓶。

e.en: His silence was {tantamount} to an admission of guilt.
e.zh: 他的沉默无异于承认有罪。

e.en: Refusing to vote is {tantamount} to giving up your voice.
e.zh: 拒绝投票就等于放弃发声的权利。

e.en: My {tante} from Berlin is visiting next month.
e.zh: 我柏林的姑妈下个月要来拜访。

e.en: Every summer we stayed with {Tante} Marie in the country.
e.zh: 每年夏天我们都住在乡下的玛丽姑妈家。

e.en: The retreat offered classes on {tantric} meditation.
e.zh: 这个静修营开设了密宗冥想课程。

e.en: She wrote a book about {tantric} traditions in Tibet.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于西藏密宗传统的书。

e.en: The toddler threw a {tantrum} in the supermarket aisle.
e.zh: 那个小孩在超市过道里大哭大闹。

e.en: He had a complete {tantrum} when his flight got canceled.
e.zh: 航班被取消时他大发了一通脾气。

e.en: Two-year-olds are famous for their dramatic {tantrums}.
e.zh: 两岁小孩出了名地爱大哭大闹。

e.en: Her boss is known for throwing {tantrums} during meetings.
e.zh: 她老板以在会议上大发脾气出名。

tanzania.t: n. 坦桑尼亚（东非国家）

e.en: We went on safari in {Tanzania} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们去坦桑尼亚参加了野生动物之旅。

e.en: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest peak in {Tanzania}.
e.zh: 乞力马扎罗山是坦桑尼亚的最高峰。

tanzanian.t:
adj. 坦桑尼亚的
n. 坦桑尼亚人

e.en: She married a {Tanzanian} doctor she met in London.
e.zh: 她嫁给了在伦敦认识的一位坦桑尼亚医生。

e.en: The cafe serves rich {Tanzanian} coffee from Kilimanjaro.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应来自乞力马扎罗的浓郁坦桑尼亚咖啡。

tao.t: n. 道（道教哲学核心概念）

e.en: The Irish {Taoiseach} addressed parliament this morning.
e.zh: 爱尔兰总理今天上午在议会发表讲话。

e.en: He served as {Taoiseach} for nearly four years.
e.zh: 他担任爱尔兰总理近四年。

taoist.t:
n. 道教徒
adj. 道教的

e.en: She studies {Taoist} philosophy at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究道家哲学。

e.en: The mountain has an ancient {Taoist} temple at the top.
e.zh: 山顶上有一座古老的道观。

tap.t:
v. 轻点（屏幕）；轻敲
n. 水龙头

e.en: His reputation lay in {tatters} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻过后,他的名声已支离破碎。

e.en: The old flag hung in {tatters} above the gate.
e.zh: 那面旧旗破破烂烂地挂在大门上。

tattersalls.t: n. 塔特索尔（英国马匹拍卖行）

e.en: He bought a young thoroughbred at {Tattersalls} last week.
e.zh: 他上周在塔特索尔拍卖行买了一匹年轻的纯种马。

e.en: {Tattersalls} is the world's oldest bloodstock auctioneer.
e.zh: 塔特索尔是世界上最古老的纯种马拍卖行。

tattle.t:
v. 告密；搬弄是非
n. 闲话

e.en: Younger siblings often {tattle} on each other to parents.
e.zh: 小孩子常常向父母告对方的状。

e.en: Don't {tattle} to the teacher about every little thing.
e.zh: 别什么小事都跑去告诉老师。

e.en: Nobody trusts a {tattletale} on the playground.
e.zh: 操场上没人会信任爱告状的人。

e.en: His little sister is a notorious {tattletale} at home.
e.zh: 他的小妹妹在家里是出了名的爱打小报告。

tattoo.t:
n. 纹身
v. 刺青

e.en: She got a small butterfly {tattoo} on her ankle.
e.zh: 她在脚踝上纹了一只小蝴蝶。

e.en: The military {tattoo} attracted thousands of spectators.
e.zh: 军乐表演吸引了成千上万的观众。

tattooed.t:
adj. 有纹身的
v. tattoo 的过去式

e.en: He has a dragon {tattooed} across his entire back.
e.zh: 他整个后背都纹着一条龙。

e.en: The sailor was heavily {tattooed} from neck to wrist.
e.zh: 那名水手从脖子到手腕都纹满了图案。

tattooing.t:
n. 纹身（动作）
v. tattoo 的现在分词

e.en: {Tattooing} has become mainstream over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里,纹身已经走入主流。

e.en: She is {tattooing} a small rose on his shoulder.
e.zh: 她正在他肩膀上纹一朵小玫瑰。

e.en: The {tattooist} sketched the design before starting the work.
e.zh: 纹身师在动笔前先画好了图案。

e.en: She booked an appointment with a famous {tattooist} downtown.
e.zh: 她预约了市中心一位有名的纹身师。

tattoos.t:
n. tattoo 的复数
v. 刺青（第三人称）

e.en: He has several {tattoos} along his right arm.
e.zh: 他右臂上有好几个纹身。

e.en: Many athletes show off their {tattoos} during games.
e.zh: 许多运动员在比赛中展示他们的纹身。

e.en: She threw out her {tatty} old sweater last week.
e.zh: 她上周扔掉了那件破旧的旧毛衣。

e.en: The hotel looked {tatty} compared to the photos online.
e.zh: 这家酒店比网上照片看起来要破旧得多。

tau.t: n. 希腊字母第19个 τ

taught.t: v. teach 的过去式和过去分词

e.en: My grandmother {taught} me how to bake bread.
e.zh: 我奶奶教我如何烤面包。

e.en: He {taught} math at the local high school for years.
e.zh: 他在本地高中教了多年数学。

taunt.t:
v. 嘲讽；奚落
n. 讥讽的话

e.en: Don't let his {taunt} get under your skin.
e.zh: 别让他的嘲讽影响到你。

e.en: The kids would {taunt} him about his accent.
e.zh: 孩子们总是嘲笑他的口音。

taunting.t:
adj. 嘲讽的
v. taunt 的现在分词

e.en: He gave her a {taunting} smile across the room.
e.zh: 他在房间另一头朝她露出嘲弄的微笑。

e.en: Stop {taunting} your little brother and apologize now.
e.zh: 别再嘲弄你弟弟了,现在就道歉。

e.en: She waved the last cookie {tauntingly} in front of him.
e.zh: 她挑衅地在他面前挥着最后一块饼干。

e.en: He smiled {tauntingly} as he revealed the winning card.
e.zh: 他亮出获胜的牌时挑衅地笑了笑。

e.en: We stopped in {Taunton} on our way to Cornwall.
e.zh: 我们去康沃尔的路上在汤顿停了一下。

e.en: The train to {Taunton} leaves from platform three.
e.zh: 开往汤顿的火车从三号站台发车。

taunts.t: n./v. taunt 的复数或第三人称

e.en: The player ignored the {taunts} from the opposing fans.
e.zh: 那名球员没理会对方球迷的嘲讽。

e.en: She {taunts} her brother whenever he loses a game.
e.zh: 每次弟弟输了游戏,她都会取笑他。

e.en: She painted the bedroom walls a soft {taupe}.
e.zh: 她把卧室的墙刷成了柔和的灰褐色。

e.en: His new sofa is a stylish {taupe} color.
e.zh: 他的新沙发是时髦的灰褐色。

taurine.t:
n. 牛磺酸
adj. 似牛的

e.en: Most energy drinks contain caffeine and {taurine}.
e.zh: 大多数能量饮料都含有咖啡因和牛磺酸。

e.en: Cats need {taurine} in their diet to stay healthy.
e.zh: 猫需要从食物中摄取牛磺酸才能保持健康。

e.en: My sister is a {Taurus} and loves good food.
e.zh: 我姐姐是金牛座,特别爱吃美食。

e.en: The constellation {Taurus} is easy to spot in winter.
e.zh: 金牛座在冬天的夜空中很容易找到。

e.en: Pull the rope {taut} before tying the knot.
e.zh: 打结之前先把绳子拉紧。

e.en: His face went {taut} when he heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息,他的脸顿时绷紧了。

e.en: This cream claims to {tauten} the skin overnight.
e.zh: 这款面霜号称能在一夜之间紧致肌肤。

e.en: The sailors worked to {tauten} the ropes before the storm.
e.zh: 水手们在暴风雨来临前忙着把绳索拉紧。

e.en: The rope was stretched {tautly} between the two trees.
e.zh: 绳子在两棵树之间被绷得紧紧的。

e.en: The thriller is {tautly} written and impossible to put down.
e.zh: 这部惊悚小说写得紧凑利落,让人欲罢不能。

e.en: Check the {tautness} of the tent ropes before bed.
e.zh: 睡前检查一下帐篷绳是否绷紧。

e.en: The film's {tautness} keeps viewers gripped from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影节奏紧凑,从头到尾都扣人心弦。

tautological.t: adj. 同义反复的；累赘的

e.en: Saying "free gift" is essentially {tautological}.
e.zh: 说“免费礼物”本质上是同义反复。

e.en: The professor flagged several {tautological} statements in the draft.
e.zh: 教授在草稿中标出了好几处同义反复的表述。

e.en: His definition was {tautologous} and added no real meaning.
e.zh: 他的定义是同义反复的,没有提供任何实质含义。

e.en: Editors should cut {tautologous} phrases like "end result".
e.zh: 编辑应该删去诸如“最终结果”这类同义重复的短语。

e.en: "A round circle" is a classic example of {tautology}.
e.zh: “圆形的圆”是一个典型的同义反复的例子。

e.en: The lawyer's argument relied on {tautology} rather than evidence.
e.zh: 那位律师的论证靠的是同义反复,而不是证据。

e.en: We met for dinner at a cozy {tavern} downtown.
e.zh: 我们约在市中心一家温馨的小酒馆吃晚餐。

e.en: The old {tavern} has been serving locals since 1820.
e.zh: 这家老酒馆自1820年起就一直服务当地居民。

e.en: We ate grilled octopus at a seaside {taverna} in Crete.
e.zh: 我们在克里特岛海边的小酒馆吃了烤章鱼。

e.en: Every village in Greece seems to have a beloved {taverna}.
e.zh: 希腊每个村庄似乎都有一家深受喜爱的小酒馆。

e.en: The friendly {taverner} poured us another round of ale.
e.zh: 热情的酒馆老板又给我们倒了一轮麦酒。

e.en: In medieval towns, the {taverner} often knew everyone's business.
e.zh: 在中世纪城镇里,酒馆老板往往对人人之事了如指掌。

tavistock.t: n. 地名/人名，塔维斯托克

e.en: She trained as a therapist at the {Tavistock} Clinic in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦塔维斯托克诊所接受了治疗师培训。

e.en: Many psychoanalytic ideas trace back to the {Tavistock} Institute.
e.zh: 许多精神分析思想都可以追溯到塔维斯托克研究所。

tawdry.t: adj. 俗艳的；廉价花哨的

e.en: The shop was full of {tawdry} souvenirs aimed at tourists.
e.zh: 店里堆满了专门卖给游客的花哨廉价纪念品。

e.en: The tabloid published every {tawdry} detail of the affair.
e.zh: 那家小报刊登了这桩绯闻的每一个低俗细节。

e.en: A {tawny} owl hooted softly from the old oak tree.
e.zh: 一只褐色的猫头鹰在老橡树上轻轻地叫。

e.en: She poured a glass of rich {tawny} port after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她倒了一杯醇厚的茶色波特酒。

tax.t:
n. 税；税款
v. 征税；使负担重

taxa.t: n. 分类单元（taxon 的复数）

e.en: Biologists discovered three new {taxa} in the rainforest last year.
e.zh: 去年生物学家在雨林中发现了三个新的分类单元。

e.en: The database now covers thousands of plant {taxa} worldwide.
e.zh: 该数据库现已收录全球数千个植物分类单元。

taxable.t: adj. 应纳税的；可征税的

e.en: Freelance income is fully {taxable} and must be reported.
e.zh: 自由职业收入完全属于应税收入,必须申报。

e.en: Gifts above a certain value may be {taxable} in some countries.
e.zh: 在某些国家,超过一定价值的礼物可能需要纳税。

e.en: The government plans to reform corporate {taxation} next year.
e.zh: 政府计划明年改革企业税制。

e.en: Heavy {taxation} on cigarettes has reduced smoking rates significantly.
e.zh: 对香烟征收重税显著降低了吸烟率。

taxed.t:
adj. 被征税的
v. tax 的过去式

e.en: Cryptocurrency gains are now {taxed} like ordinary capital gains.
e.zh: 加密货币收益现在按普通资本利得征税。

e.en: The long hike severely {taxed} her injured knee.
e.zh: 长时间徒步让她受伤的膝盖不堪重负。

e.en: Critics call him a relentless {taxer} of the middle class.
e.zh: 批评者称他是对中产阶级征税不留情面的人。

e.en: No politician wants to be remembered as a heavy {taxer}.
e.zh: 没有哪个政客愿意被人记成横征暴敛的征税者。

taxes.t:
n. 税款（复数）
v. 征税（第三人称）

e.en: Don't forget to file your {taxes} before April 15.
e.zh: 别忘了在4月15日前申报税务。

e.en: The city raised property {taxes} to fund new schools.
e.zh: 市政府提高了房产税以资助新建学校。

taxi.t:
n. 出租车
v. (飞机) 滑行

e.en: Let's grab a {taxi} — the subway is too crowded now.
e.zh: 我们打个出租车吧——现在地铁太挤了。

e.en: The plane began to {taxi} slowly toward the runway.
e.zh: 飞机开始缓缓滑行驶向跑道。

e.en: A yellow {taxicab} pulled up just as it started raining.
e.zh: 刚开始下雨,一辆黄色出租车就停了下来。

e.en: He left his phone in the back of a {taxicab}.
e.zh: 他把手机落在了出租车后座上。

e.en: The {taxidermist} carefully mounted the trophy fish on a board.
e.zh: 标本制作师小心地把那条战利品鱼制成标本钉在板上。

e.en: She apprenticed with a {taxidermist} after studying biology.
e.zh: 她学完生物学后跟随一位动物标本师当学徒。

e.en: The museum's {taxidermy} collection includes a massive Siberian tiger.
e.zh: 博物馆的动物标本收藏中有一只巨大的西伯利亚虎。

e.en: He took up {taxidermy} as a strange but fascinating hobby.
e.zh: 他把动物标本制作当作一项奇特却迷人的爱好。

e.en: Caring for a newborn is physically and emotionally {taxing}.
e.zh: 照顾新生儿在体力和情感上都很耗人。

e.en: The exam was more {taxing} than any of us expected.
e.zh: 那场考试比我们任何人预想的都要费力。

e.en: Yellow {taxis} line up outside the train station every evening.
e.zh: 每天傍晚火车站外都排着一长串黄色出租车。

e.en: It's hard to find {taxis} in the rain at rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰期下雨时很难打到出租车。

e.en: The plane waited on the {taxiway} for clearance to take off.
e.zh: 飞机在滑行道上等候起飞许可。

e.en: Crews repainted the {taxiway} markings overnight.
e.zh: 工作人员连夜重新涂刷了滑行道上的标线。

e.en: Keep all your receipts in case the {taxman} comes calling.
e.zh: 把所有收据都留好,以防税务人员上门。

e.en: Even rock stars can't escape the {taxman} forever.
e.zh: 就连摇滚明星也无法永远躲开税务局。

e.en: Biologists classify each species into a specific {taxon}.
e.zh: 生物学家将每个物种归入特定的分类单元。

e.en: This {taxon} includes several closely related insects.
e.zh: 这个分类单元包含几种亲缘关系密切的昆虫。

e.en: The museum updated its {taxonomic} labels for all specimens.
e.zh: 博物馆更新了所有标本的分类学标签。

e.en: Scientists debated the {taxonomic} status of the new fossil.
e.zh: 科学家们就这块新化石的分类地位展开了讨论。

e.en: These two birds are {taxonomically} distinct despite looking similar.
e.zh: 这两种鸟外形相似,但在分类学上截然不同。

e.en: The samples were sorted {taxonomically} before further analysis.
e.zh: 样本在进一步分析前已按分类学顺序整理。

e.en: The {taxonomist} discovered a new species of beetle.
e.zh: 那位分类学家发现了一种新的甲虫。

e.en: Every {taxonomist} relies on careful field observation.
e.zh: 每位分类学家都依赖细致的野外观察。

e.en: The startup built a clear {taxonomy} for its product categories.
e.zh: 这家初创公司为其产品类别建立了清晰的分类体系。

e.en: Modern {taxonomy} relies heavily on DNA sequencing.
e.zh: 现代分类学在很大程度上依赖于 DNA 测序。

e.en: Every {taxpayer} deserves transparency about government spending.
e.zh: 每位纳税人都应了解政府开支的透明信息。

e.en: The bailout cost the average {taxpayer} hundreds of dollars.
e.zh: 这次纾困让每位普通纳税人损失了数百美元。

e.en: {Taxpayers} funded the new public transit line.
e.zh: 纳税人为新的公共交通线路提供了资金。

e.en: Many {taxpayers} file their returns online each spring.
e.zh: 许多纳税人每年春天在网上申报税款。

taxy.t: v. (飞机) 滑行（taxi 的变体）

e.en: The pilot called the tower for permission to {taxy} out.
e.zh: 飞行员呼叫塔台请求滑行出位。

e.en: Heavy snow forced the jet to {taxy} slowly to the gate.
e.zh: 大雪迫使喷气机缓慢滑行至登机口。

e.en: {Taylor} Swift announced another world tour this morning.
e.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特今早宣布了又一次世界巡演。

e.en: Our neighbor {Taylor} just adopted a rescue dog.
e.zh: 我们的邻居泰勒刚领养了一只救助犬。

tayside.t: n. 泰赛德（苏格兰地区）

e.en: We hiked through the rolling hills of {Tayside} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了泰赛德起伏的丘陵。

e.en: {Tayside} is known for its salmon fishing rivers.
e.zh: 泰赛德以盛产三文鱼的河流而闻名。

tbilisi.t: n. 第比利斯（格鲁吉亚首都）

e.en: We spent three days exploring the old town of {Tbilisi}.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览第比利斯老城。

e.en: {Tbilisi} is the capital and largest city of Georgia.
e.zh: 第比利斯是格鲁吉亚的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Add one {tbsp} of olive oil to the pan.
e.zh: 在锅里加入一汤匙橄榄油。

e.en: The recipe calls for two {tbsp} of brown sugar.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要两汤匙红糖。

tchaikovsky.t: n. 柴可夫斯基（俄罗斯作曲家）

e.en: The orchestra performed {Tchaikovsky}'s famous violin concerto.
e.zh: 乐团演奏了柴可夫斯基著名的小提琴协奏曲。

e.en: Many ballet fans love {Tchaikovsky}'s Swan Lake score.
e.zh: 许多芭蕾爱好者钟爱柴可夫斯基的《天鹅湖》配乐。

tea.t:
n. 茶；茶水
n. 下午茶

e.en: Drop a {teabag} into the mug and pour boiling water.
e.zh: 把茶包放进杯子,然后倒入沸水。

e.en: She squeezed the {teabag} against the spoon to extract more flavor.
e.zh: 她把茶包按在勺子上,挤出更多茶味。

e.en: He toasted a buttery {teacake} for breakfast.
e.zh: 他为早餐烤了一个涂满黄油的茶点饼。

e.en: The cafe serves warm {teacake} with strawberry jam.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆供应配草莓酱的热茶点饼。

teach.t:
v. 教；教授
v. 使懂得

e.en: Can you {teach} me how to ride a bike?
e.zh: 你能教我怎么骑自行车吗?

e.en: Online courses {teach} programming to millions of beginners.
e.zh: 在线课程向数百万初学者传授编程知识。

e.en: Failure can become a {teachable} moment for any team.
e.zh: 失败对任何团队来说都可能成为可借鉴的契机。

e.en: She is curious and highly {teachable} as a new hire.
e.zh: 作为新员工,她好奇心强,非常善于学习。

e.en: My {teacher} explained the math problem in three different ways.
e.zh: 我的老师用三种不同的方式讲解了那道数学题。

e.en: She became a {teacher} after working in industry for years.
e.zh: 她在业界工作多年后转而成为一名教师。

teacherly.t: adj. 像老师的；教师气的

e.en: He answered the question in a calm, {teacherly} tone.
e.zh: 他用平静而带有教师风范的语气回答了问题。

e.en: Her {teacherly} patience made even shy students speak up.
e.zh: 她那种教师般的耐心让最害羞的学生也敢开口。

e.en: Many {teachers} use AI tools to grade essays now.
e.zh: 现在很多老师用AI工具批改作文。

e.en: The school is hiring three new math {teachers}.
e.zh: 学校正在招聘三位新的数学老师。

e.en: My sister {teaches} third grade at a local school.
e.zh: 我姐姐在一所当地学校教三年级。

e.en: This documentary {teaches} viewers about climate change.
e.zh: 这部纪录片向观众讲述气候变化问题。

teaching.t:
n. 教学；教书
n. 教诲

e.en: She's been {teaching} English in Tokyo for five years.
e.zh: 她已经在东京教了五年英语。

e.en: Online {teaching} became common during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间在线教学变得很普遍。

e.en: Buddhist {teachings} emphasize compassion and mindfulness.
e.zh: 佛教教义强调慈悲和正念。

e.en: His grandmother's {teachings} still guide him today.
e.zh: 他奶奶的教诲至今仍指引着他。

e.en: She poured the green tea into a delicate porcelain {teacup}.
e.zh: 她把绿茶倒进精致的瓷茶杯里。

e.en: The kitten was small enough to fit in a {teacup}.
e.zh: 那只小猫小到可以放进茶杯里。

e.en: We spent the afternoon at a traditional Japanese {teahouse}.
e.zh: 我们在一家传统的日式茶屋待了一下午。

e.en: The old {teahouse} on the corner has been there for decades.
e.zh: 街角那家老茶馆已经开了几十年。

e.en: The garden bench is made of weather-resistant {teak}.
e.zh: 这张花园长椅是用耐风雨的柚木做的。

e.en: She polished the {teak} dining table until it shone.
e.zh: 她把柚木餐桌擦得锃亮。

e.en: The {teakettle} on the stove started to whistle loudly.
e.zh: 炉子上的水壶开始大声鸣叫。

e.en: He filled the {teakettle} and turned on the burner.
e.zh: 他装满水壶,打开了炉灶。

e.en: The yacht's deck is built from polished {teakwood}.
e.zh: 这艘游艇的甲板由抛光柚木制成。

e.en: She admired the carved {teakwood} elephant on the shelf.
e.zh: 她欣赏架子上那只雕花柚木大象。

teal.t:
n. 蓝绿色；水鸭色
n. 水鸭

e.en: She painted the bedroom walls a soft {teal}.
e.zh: 她把卧室墙壁刷成了柔和的青蓝色。

e.en: His new sneakers are bright {teal} with white laces.
e.zh: 他的新运动鞋是亮青蓝色配白色鞋带。

team.t:
n. 团队；队伍
v. 合作；组队

e.en: Our {team} won the championship for the third year.
e.zh: 我们队连续第三年夺得冠军。

e.en: The engineering {team} ships new features every two weeks.
e.zh: 工程团队每两周发布一次新功能。

teaming.t: v. 组队；合作（team 的现在分词）

e.en: Spotify is {teaming} up with Netflix on a new podcast.
e.zh: Spotify正在和Netflix合作推出一档新播客。

e.en: The river was {teaming} with salmon during the run.
e.zh: 洄游季节里这条河里挤满了三文鱼。

e.en: My {teammate} passed me the ball at the last second.
e.zh: 我的队友在最后一秒把球传给了我。

e.en: She thanked her {teammate} for covering the night shift.
e.zh: 她感谢同事帮她顶了夜班。

e.en: His {teammates} threw him a surprise birthday party.
e.zh: 他的队友们给他办了一个惊喜生日派对。

e.en: Good {teammates} support each other through tough projects.
e.zh: 好的队友会在艰难项目中互相支持。

e.en: Both {teams} played hard until the final whistle.
e.zh: 两支队伍一直拼到终场哨响。

e.en: We use Microsoft {Teams} for our daily standup meetings.
e.zh: 我们用微软Teams开每日站会。

e.en: The {teamster} drove the truck across three states overnight.
e.zh: 这位卡车司机连夜驾车穿越了三个州。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {teamster} in the 1950s.
e.zh: 他爷爷在五十年代做过卡车司机。

e.en: Winning the project required serious {teamwork} and late nights.
e.zh: 拿下这个项目靠的是真正的团队合作和加班。

e.en: Good {teamwork} matters more than individual talent here.
e.zh: 在这里团队合作比个人天赋更重要。

teamworks.t: n. 团队协作（复数/企业名）

e.en: The studio {Teamworks} produces popular animated films.
e.zh: Teamworks工作室制作了多部热门动画电影。

e.en: Their software {Teamworks} helps coaches manage athletes.
e.zh: 他们的Teamworks软件帮助教练管理运动员。

e.en: She poured boiling water into the floral {teapot}.
e.zh: 她把开水倒进了那只花纹茶壶里。

e.en: The antique {teapot} sold for thousands at auction.
e.zh: 那只古董茶壶在拍卖会上拍出了数千美元。

tear.t:
v. 撕裂；扯破
n. 眼泪

e.en: A single {tear} rolled down her cheek during the movie.
e.zh: 看电影时一滴眼泪顺着她的脸颊滑落。

e.en: Be careful not to {tear} the wrapping paper.
e.zh: 小心别把包装纸撕破了。

tectonic.t: adj. 地质构造的；板块的

e.en: Earthquakes happen along the boundaries of {tectonic} plates.
e.zh: 地震发生在板块构造的边界上。

e.en: AI is causing a {tectonic} shift in the job market.
e.zh: 人工智能正在引发就业市场的巨大变革。

tectonics.t: n. 地质构造学；建筑构造

e.en: Plate {tectonics} explains why mountains and volcanoes form.
e.zh: 板块构造学解释了山脉和火山是如何形成的。

e.en: The geology class started with the basics of {tectonics}.
e.zh: 地质课从板块构造学的基础知识开始讲起。

ted.t:
n. 人名泰德
v. 翻晒（干草）

e.en: My aunt lives in {Teddington}, just southwest of London.
e.zh: 我姑姑住在泰丁顿,就在伦敦西南面。

e.en: The boat passed through {Teddington} Lock on the Thames.
e.zh: 船穿过了泰晤士河上的泰丁顿水闸。

e.en: The little girl hugged her {teddy} bear tightly at night.
e.zh: 小女孩晚上紧紧抱着她的泰迪熊。

e.en: He still keeps the worn-out {teddy} from his childhood.
e.zh: 他还留着小时候那只破旧的泰迪熊。

e.en: The endless {tedia} of paperwork drained her energy.
e.zh: 没完没了的文书工作让她精疲力竭。

e.en: He complained about the daily {tedia} of office life.
e.zh: 他抱怨办公室日复一日的乏味生活。

tedious.t: adj. 冗长乏味的；枯燥的

e.en: Filling out tax forms is incredibly {tedious} every year.
e.zh: 每年填税表都极其枯燥乏味。

e.en: The meeting dragged on with {tedious} status updates.
e.zh: 会议在冗长无聊的进度汇报中拖了好久。

e.en: He {tediously} explained every step of the process.
e.zh: 他不厌其烦地讲解了流程的每一步。

e.en: The lecture went on {tediously} for nearly three hours.
e.zh: 讲座枯燥乏味地持续了将近三个小时。

e.en: Music helps me escape the {tedium} of long commutes.
e.zh: 音乐能帮我摆脱漫长通勤的乏味。

e.en: She broke the {tedium} of work with short walks.
e.zh: 她靠短暂的散步打破了工作的枯燥。

tee.t:
n. 高尔夫球座
v. 把球放上球座
