e.en: He wore a faded blue {tee-shirt} to the concert.
e.zh: 他穿着一件褪色的蓝色T恤去看演唱会。

e.en: The shop prints custom designs on any {tee-shirt}.
e.zh: 这家店可以在任意T恤上印定制图案。

e.en: The band sells {tee-shirts} at every show on tour.
e.zh: 乐队在巡演的每场演出上都卖T恤。

e.en: She packed five {tee-shirts} for the weekend trip.
e.zh: 她为周末的旅行装了五件T恤。

e.en: The coral reef seems to {teem} with colorful fish.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁里似乎挤满了五彩斑斓的鱼。

e.en: City streets {teem} with tourists during the summer.
e.zh: 夏天城里的街道挤满了游客。

e.en: The pond {teemed} with tadpoles after the spring rain.
e.zh: 春雨过后池塘里满是蝌蚪。

e.en: The market {teemed} with shoppers on Saturday morning.
e.zh: 周六早上市场里挤满了购物的人。

e.en: The river was {teeming} with salmon during the run.
e.zh: 洄游季节里河里满是鲑鱼。

e.en: Tokyo's streets are {teeming} with people late at night.
e.zh: 东京的街道深夜里仍然人潮涌动。

teems.t: v. 充满（第三人称单数）

e.en: The forest {teems} with wildlife at dawn and dusk.
e.zh: 清晨和黄昏时森林里到处是野生动物。

e.en: This neighborhood {teems} with cafes and small bookshops.
e.zh: 这个街区遍布咖啡馆和小书店。

teen.t:
n. 青少年
adj. 十几岁的

e.en: The app is mostly used by {teen} girls these days.
e.zh: 这款应用如今主要被少女们使用。

e.en: He started coding when he was just a {teen}.
e.zh: 他十几岁的时候就开始写代码了。

teenage.t: adj. 十几岁的；青少年的

e.en: My {teenage} son spends hours playing video games.
e.zh: 我十几岁的儿子花很多时间打游戏。

e.en: The novel captures the awkwardness of {teenage} romance perfectly.
e.zh: 这本小说完美捕捉了少年恋爱的尴尬。

e.en: Her {teenaged} daughter just got her driver's license.
e.zh: 她十几岁的女儿刚拿到驾照。

e.en: The film follows a group of {teenaged} skateboarders.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一群十几岁滑板少年的故事。

e.en: As a {teenager}, she dreamed of becoming a journalist.
e.zh: 她十几岁时梦想成为一名记者。

e.en: The {teenager} saved his pocket money to buy headphones.
e.zh: 那个少年攒下零花钱买了一副耳机。

e.en: Most {teenagers} use TikTok more than traditional social media.
e.zh: 大多数青少年用抖音多过传统社交媒体。

e.en: The mall is packed with {teenagers} on weekends.
e.zh: 周末购物中心挤满了青少年。

teens.t: n. 十几岁的年纪；青少年们

e.en: He started his first business in his late {teens}.
e.zh: 他十八九岁时就创办了自己的第一家公司。

e.en: The cafe is popular with {teens} after school hours.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆在放学后很受青少年欢迎。

e.en: She wore a {teensy} silver ring on her pinky.
e.zh: 她小指上戴着一枚小巧的银戒指。

e.en: There's a {teensy} problem with the booking system.
e.zh: 预订系统有个小小的问题。

e.en: The puppy is {teeny} but full of energy.
e.zh: 这只小狗虽然小小的,却精力旺盛。

e.en: I felt a {teeny} bit nervous before the speech.
e.zh: 演讲前我有一点点紧张。

e.en: The mall was packed with {teenybopper} fans waiting for the band.
e.zh: 商场里挤满了等候乐队的少女粉丝。

e.en: That song became a {teenybopper} anthem in the nineties.
e.zh: 那首歌成了九十年代少女们的代表作。

e.en: The kids built a {teepee} out of blankets and chairs.
e.zh: 孩子们用毯子和椅子搭了一个圆锥帐篷。

e.en: A traditional {teepee} stood at the edge of the camp.
e.zh: 营地边上立着一座传统的印第安帐篷。

e.en: The shop sells graphic {tees} for under twenty dollars.
e.zh: 那家店出售二十美元以下的印花T恤。

e.en: He lined up his golf {tees} carefully on the bag.
e.zh: 他把高尔夫球座整齐地排在球袋上。

e.en: She grew up in {Teesside} before moving to London.
e.zh: 她在蒂赛德长大,后来搬到了伦敦。

e.en: The factory in {Teesside} employs hundreds of workers.
e.zh: 蒂赛德的那家工厂雇用了数百名工人。

e.en: The stack of books began to {teeter} on the edge.
e.zh: 那摞书在桌边开始摇摇欲坠。

e.en: The economy continues to {teeter} between growth and recession.
e.zh: 经济仍在增长与衰退之间摇摆。

e.en: She was {teetering} on high heels across the cobblestones.
e.zh: 她踩着高跟鞋在鹅卵石路上摇摇晃晃地走。

e.en: The startup is {teetering} on the brink of bankruptcy.
e.zh: 那家初创公司正濒临破产边缘。

e.en: Remember to brush your {teeth} before bed.
e.zh: 睡前别忘了刷牙。

e.en: The new law has real {teeth} for enforcing privacy.
e.zh: 这部新法律在隐私执法方面真有威力。

teething.t: n. 婴儿长牙；初期困难

e.en: The baby is {teething} and cries through the night.
e.zh: 宝宝正在长牙,整夜哭闹。

e.en: The app launch had a few {teething} problems.
e.zh: 该应用上线时出现了一些初期小问题。

e.en: He has been strictly {teetotal} since college.
e.zh: 他从大学起就严格滴酒不沾。

e.en: My grandmother lived a quiet, {teetotal} life.
e.zh: 我奶奶过着安静、不沾酒的生活。

e.en: As a lifelong {teetotaler}, she ordered sparkling water.
e.zh: 作为一位终生不饮酒者,她点了气泡水。

e.en: Most guests drank wine, but the host was a {teetotaler}.
e.zh: 大多数客人喝酒,但主人是个绝对不饮酒的人。

e.en: He became a {teetotaller} after his health scare.
e.zh: 经历过健康危机后他成了一个完全戒酒的人。

e.en: The pub welcomes both drinkers and the occasional {teetotaller}.
e.zh: 这家酒馆既欢迎酒客也欢迎偶尔来的滴酒不沾者。

teff.t: n. 苔麸（埃塞俄比亚谷物）

e.en: Ethiopian injera is made from fermented {teff} flour.
e.zh: 埃塞俄比亚的英杰拉饼是用发酵的苔麸粉做的。

e.en: {Teff} is gaining popularity as a gluten-free grain.
e.zh: 苔麸作为一种无麸质谷物正越来越受欢迎。

tefillin.t: n. 犹太教经文护符匣

e.en: He puts on {tefillin} every weekday morning for prayer.
e.zh: 他每个工作日早晨都会戴上经匣祈祷。

e.en: The leather straps of the {tefillin} were worn smooth.
e.zh: 经匣的皮带已经磨得光滑。

e.en: The pan has a {Teflon} coating that prevents sticking.
e.zh: 这只锅有特氟龙涂层,可以防止粘锅。

e.en: The politician seems to have a {Teflon} reputation.
e.zh: 那位政客的名声仿佛涂了特氟龙一般刀枪不入。

e.en: The cricket's {tegmen} produces sound when rubbed together.
e.zh: 蟋蟀的前翅相互摩擦时会发出声音。

e.en: Biologists examined the colorful {tegmen} of the beetle.
e.zh: 生物学家观察了那只甲虫色彩斑斓的前翅。

e.en: Our flight stopped briefly in {Teheran} before continuing east.
e.zh: 我们的航班在德黑兰短暂停留后继续向东飞。

e.en: She studied Persian literature at a university in {Teheran}.
e.zh: 她在德黑兰的一所大学学习波斯文学。

e.en: {Tehran} is the bustling capital of Iran.
e.zh: 德黑兰是伊朗繁华的首都。

e.en: The conference will be held in {Tehran} next spring.
e.zh: 会议将于明年春天在德黑兰举行。

e.en: We spent the weekend by the seaside in {Teignmouth}.
e.zh: 我们在廷茅斯海边度过了周末。

e.en: The poet Keats once stayed in {Teignmouth} to recover.
e.zh: 诗人济慈曾在廷茅斯养病。

e.en: The {telco} announced a major upgrade to its 5G network.
e.zh: 这家电信公司宣布对其5G网络进行重大升级。

e.en: She works as an analyst covering the {telco} sector.
e.zh: 她是一名研究电信行业的分析师。

e.en: Grandma still calls the television the {tele}.
e.zh: 奶奶还是把电视叫做电视机。

e.en: He picked up a vintage {Tele} guitar at the auction.
e.zh: 他在拍卖会上买下了一把复古Tele电吉他。

telecast.t:
n. 电视播送
v. 电视广播

e.en: Millions watched the live {telecast} of the ceremony.
e.zh: 数百万人观看了典礼的电视直播。

e.en: The network will {telecast} the match on Sunday evening.
e.zh: 电视台将于周日晚上转播这场比赛。

telecaster.t: n. 电视播音员；Telecaster 吉他

e.en: He played a vintage Fender {Telecaster} at the gig.
e.zh: 他在演出中弹奏了一把复古的Fender Telecaster电吉他。

e.en: The bright twang of a {Telecaster} defined country music.
e.zh: Telecaster清亮的音色塑造了乡村音乐的风格。

e.en: The {telecom} giant reported record quarterly profits.
e.zh: 这家电信巨头公布了创纪录的季度利润。

e.en: She works in {telecom} infrastructure across Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 她从事东南亚地区的电信基础设施工作。

e.en: Modern {telecommunication} relies on fiber optic cables and satellites.
e.zh: 现代电信依赖光纤电缆和卫星。

e.en: He earned a degree in {telecommunication} engineering.
e.zh: 他取得了电信工程学位。

e.en: The government plans to deregulate the {telecommunications} industry.
e.zh: 政府计划放松对电信行业的管制。

e.en: Reliable {telecommunications} are essential for remote work.
e.zh: 可靠的通信对远程办公至关重要。

e.en: The network will {televise} the final game live nationwide.
e.zh: 电视网将向全国直播这场决赛。

e.en: Organizers decided not to {televise} the closed-door hearing.
e.zh: 组织方决定不对这场闭门听证会进行电视直播。

televised.t:
adj. 经电视转播的
v. televise 的过去式

e.en: Millions watched the {televised} debate between the two candidates.
e.zh: 数百万人观看了两位候选人的电视辩论。

e.en: The wedding was {televised} to a global audience.
e.zh: 这场婚礼向全球观众进行了电视直播。

e.en: He fell asleep watching {television} on the couch.
e.zh: 他在沙发上看着电视睡着了。

e.en: Streaming services are reshaping how we watch {television}.
e.zh: 流媒体正在重塑我们看电视的方式。

e.en: The sports bar has {televisions} on every wall.
e.zh: 那家体育酒吧每面墙上都装了电视。

e.en: Modern {televisions} are thinner than a stack of magazines.
e.zh: 现代电视机比一摞杂志还要薄。

televisual.t: adj. 电视的；适合电视播出的

e.en: The director has a strong {televisual} sense of pacing.
e.zh: 这位导演对电视节奏有很强的感觉。

e.en: Her face is perfect for {televisual} drama.
e.zh: 她的脸非常适合电视剧。

telex.t:
n. 电传
v. 用电传发送

e.en: The bank confirmed the transfer by {telex} that afternoon.
e.zh: 银行当天下午通过电传确认了这笔转账。

e.en: Old offices kept a {telex} machine humming all day.
e.zh: 老式办公室里电传机整日嗡嗡作响。

telford.t: n. 特尔福德（人名/地名）

e.en: Thomas {Telford} designed many of Britain's iconic bridges.
e.zh: 托马斯·特尔福德设计了英国许多标志性桥梁。

e.en: We stopped in {Telford} on our drive through Shropshire.
e.zh: 我们驱车穿过什罗普郡时在特尔福德稍作停留。

e.en: Please {tell} me when the package arrives.
e.zh: 包裹到了请告诉我一声。

e.en: It's hard to {tell} the twins apart.
e.zh: 很难分清这对双胞胎。

teller.t: n. 银行出纳员；讲述者

e.en: The bank {teller} counted the bills twice for accuracy.
e.zh: 银行柜员把钞票数了两遍以确保无误。

e.en: Grandma was a wonderful {teller} of bedtime stories.
e.zh: 奶奶是个会讲睡前故事的高手。

e.en: Most {tellers} have been replaced by automated machines.
e.zh: 大多数柜员都被自动机器取代了。

e.en: The election {tellers} carefully tallied every vote.
e.zh: 选举计票员仔细统计了每一张选票。

e.en: The {tellin} is a small clam often found on sandy beaches.
e.zh: 樱蛤是一种常见于沙滩上的小型蛤类。

e.en: Children collected pink {tellin} shells along the shore.
e.zh: 孩子们沿着海岸捡拾粉色的樱蛤壳。

telling.t:
adj. 有力的；意味深长的
v. tell 的现在分词

e.en: Her silence at the meeting was particularly {telling}.
e.zh: 她在会上的沉默尤其意味深长。

e.en: He kept {telling} the same joke at every party.
e.zh: 他在每次聚会上都讲同一个笑话。

tellingly.t: adv. 有力地；意味深长地

e.en: {Tellingly}, no executive showed up to defend the decision.
e.zh: 耐人寻味的是,没有一位高管出面为这一决定辩护。

e.en: She paused {tellingly} before answering the reporter.
e.zh: 她意味深长地停顿了一下才回答记者。

tells.t: v. tell 的第三人称单数

e.en: My watch {tells} me it's almost midnight.
e.zh: 我的手表显示快到午夜了。

e.en: Good poker players read subtle {tells} from opponents.
e.zh: 高明的扑克玩家能读出对手细微的破绽。

telltale.t:
adj. 能说明问题的
n. 搬弄是非者

e.en: Crumbs on the counter were a {telltale} sign of the thief.
e.zh: 台面上的面包屑是泄露窃贼身份的明显线索。

e.en: The room had the {telltale} smell of fresh paint.
e.zh: 房间里弥漫着新刷油漆那种一闻便知的气味。

e.en: Geophysicists study {telluric} currents flowing through the earth's crust.
e.zh: 地球物理学家研究流经地壳的大地电流。

e.en: The wine has earthy, almost {telluric} undertones.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒带有泥土般、近乎大地气息的底韵。

e.en: We stayed in and watched {telly} all weekend.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都待在家里看电视。

e.en: Turn the {telly} down, the baby is sleeping.
e.zh: 把电视调小声点,宝宝在睡觉。

e.en: Cancer cells often produce extra {telomerase} to keep dividing.
e.zh: 癌细胞常常产生过量端粒酶以持续分裂。

e.en: Researchers study {telomerase} to understand cellular aging.
e.zh: 研究人员研究端粒酶以了解细胞衰老机制。

telomere.t: n. 端粒（染色体末端结构）

e.en: Each {telomere} shortens slightly with every cell division.
e.zh: 每次细胞分裂,端粒都会略微变短。

e.en: Short {telomere} length is linked to faster aging.
e.zh: 端粒较短与衰老加速有关。

e.en: A small {temblor} rattled dishes across the kitchen.
e.zh: 一次轻微的地震震得厨房里的盘子叮当作响。

e.en: Residents felt the {temblor} just before dawn.
e.zh: 居民们在天亮前感觉到了这次地震。

e.en: He had the {temerity} to interrupt the CEO mid-sentence.
e.zh: 他竟敢打断首席执行官的话。

e.en: Few reporters had the {temerity} to challenge the dictator.
e.zh: 很少有记者敢于质疑那位独裁者。

temp.t:
n. 临时雇员
v. 做临时工

e.en: The agency hired a {temp} to cover during her maternity leave.
e.zh: 公司在她休产假期间雇了一名临时工顶替。

e.en: Check the oven {temp} before you put in the cake.
e.zh: 放入蛋糕前先检查一下烤箱温度。

temper.t:
n. 脾气；情绪
v. 使缓和；回火

e.en: He lost his {temper} when the printer jammed again.
e.zh: 打印机又卡纸了,他终于发了脾气。

e.en: A short walk can help {temper} your frustration.
e.zh: 散个短步有助于缓和你的烦躁情绪。

e.en: The artist mixed egg yolk to make {tempera} paint.
e.zh: 艺术家把蛋黄调入颜料中制成蛋彩画颜料。

e.en: Renaissance icons were often painted in {tempera} on wood.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的圣像常用蛋彩绘于木板上。

e.en: She has a calm {temperament} that suits the job.
e.zh: 她性情平和,很适合这份工作。

e.en: The puppy's playful {temperament} won everyone over.
e.zh: 小狗活泼的性格赢得了所有人的喜爱。

temperamental.t: adj. 喜怒无常的；性情上的

e.en: The old printer is {temperamental} on humid days.
e.zh: 这台旧打印机在潮湿天容易闹脾气。

e.en: He's a brilliant but {temperamental} chef.
e.zh: 他是位才华横溢却脾气古怪的厨师。

temperamentally.t: adv. 从性情上说；喜怒无常地

e.en: She is {temperamentally} unsuited to office routine.
e.zh: 她的性格天生不适合办公室的日常工作。

e.en: The two brothers are {temperamentally} very different.
e.zh: 这两兄弟在性情上截然不同。

e.en: Their contrasting {temperaments} made the partnership interesting.
e.zh: 两人迥异的性格让这段合作变得有趣。

e.en: Different dog breeds have very different {temperaments}.
e.zh: 不同犬种的性格差异很大。

e.en: The movement preached {temperance} and self-control.
e.zh: 这场运动宣扬节制与自律。

e.en: He practices {temperance} when it comes to alcohol.
e.zh: 在喝酒方面他很有节制。

e.en: Vancouver enjoys a mild, {temperate} climate.
e.zh: 温哥华气候温和宜人。

e.en: She gave a {temperate} response to the harsh criticism.
e.zh: 面对尖锐批评,她回应得很克制。

e.en: The {temperature} dropped sharply overnight.
e.zh: 气温在一夜之间骤降。

e.en: My daughter is running a slight {temperature} today.
e.zh: 我女儿今天有点低烧。

e.en: Summer {temperatures} here often exceed forty degrees.
e.zh: 这里夏天的气温常常超过四十度。

e.en: Bake the cookies at high {temperatures} for ten minutes.
e.zh: 用高温把饼干烤十分钟。

tempered.t:
adj. 调和的；回火的
v. temper 的过去式

e.en: His enthusiasm was {tempered} by hard experience.
e.zh: 惨痛的经历让他的热情有所收敛。

e.en: The blade is made of {tempered} steel.
e.zh: 这把刀刃是用回火钢制成的。

tempering.t:
n. 回火；缓和
v. temper 的现在分词

e.en: She's {tempering} her ambition with a dose of realism.
e.zh: 她正用现实感来调和自己的野心。

e.en: The {tempering} process makes the steel much harder.
e.zh: 回火工艺让钢材变得坚硬许多。

tempers.t:
n. 脾气（复数）
v. temper 的第三人称单数

e.en: {Tempers} flared during the heated debate.
e.zh: 激烈的辩论中众人怒火中烧。

e.en: A long delay always {tempers} my patience.
e.zh: 长时间的延误总会消磨我的耐心。

e.en: A sudden {tempest} swept across the harbor.
e.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨席卷了港口。

e.en: His resignation caused a political {tempest}.
e.zh: 他的辞职引发了一场政治风暴。

e.en: They had a brief but {tempestuous} marriage.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻短暂却动荡不安。

e.en: The ship sailed through {tempestuous} seas.
e.zh: 船只穿越了波涛汹涌的海面。

e.en: The novel features a secretive {templar} order.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了一个神秘的圣殿骑士团。

e.en: Medieval {templar} knights guarded pilgrim routes.
e.zh: 中世纪的圣殿骑士守卫着朝圣之路。

e.en: Use this {template} to format your resume.
e.zh: 用这个模板来排版你的简历。

e.en: The startup became a {template} for others to follow.
e.zh: 这家初创公司成了同行效仿的范本。

e.en: We visited an ancient {temple} on the mountain.
e.zh: 我们参观了山上一座古老的寺庙。

e.en: He massaged his {temple} to ease the headache.
e.zh: 他揉着太阳穴以缓解头痛。

e.en: Kyoto is famous for its beautiful {temples}.
e.zh: 京都以其美丽的寺庙而闻名。

e.en: His {temples} were turning gray.
e.zh: 他的两鬓正渐渐变白。

templeton.t: n. 坦普尔顿（姓氏/地名）

e.en: Dr. {Templeton} chairs the research committee.
e.zh: 坦普尔顿博士担任研究委员会主席。

e.en: The {Templeton} Prize honors work in spirituality.
e.zh: 邓普顿奖表彰精神领域的研究成就。

e.en: The conductor sped up the {tempo} of the piece.
e.zh: 指挥加快了这首曲子的节奏。

e.en: Life in this small town moves at a slow {tempo}.
e.zh: 这个小镇的生活节奏很慢。

temporal.t: adj. 时间的；世俗的；颞部的

e.en: The film plays with {temporal} order and memory.
e.zh: 这部电影玩转了时间顺序与记忆。

e.en: The church separated spiritual from {temporal} authority.
e.zh: 教会将精神权威与世俗权力区分开来。

e.en: The {temporalis} muscle helps you chew firmly.
e.zh: 颞肌帮助你用力咀嚼。

e.en: Tension headaches often involve the {temporalis} muscle.
e.zh: 紧张性头痛常涉及颞肌。

e.en: The poem reflects on the {temporality} of beauty.
e.zh: 这首诗思考美的短暂易逝。

e.en: Philosophers debate the nature of human {temporality}.
e.zh: 哲学家们探讨人类时间性的本质。

e.en: The two events are {temporally} unrelated.
e.zh: 这两个事件在时间上并无关联。

e.en: The data is organized {temporally} by quarter.
e.zh: 数据按季度的时间顺序进行整理。

e.en: The website is {temporarily} unavailable for maintenance.
e.zh: 网站因维护暂时无法访问。

e.en: She's {temporarily} staying with her parents.
e.zh: 她暂时住在父母家里。

telecommute.t: v. 远程办公；在家办公

e.en: Many employees prefer to {telecommute} two days a week.
e.zh: 许多员工更喜欢每周远程办公两天。

e.en: The company allows new parents to {telecommute} full time.
e.zh: 公司允许新晋父母全职远程办公。

e.en: As a {telecommuter}, she sets her own daily schedule.
e.zh: 作为一名远程办公者,她自己安排日程。

e.en: The number of {telecommuter} workers has doubled since 2020.
e.zh: 自2020年以来远程办公者的人数翻了一番。

e.en: {Telecommuting} has reduced traffic congestion in many cities.
e.zh: 远程办公缓解了许多城市的交通拥堵。

e.en: She loves {telecommuting} from her cabin in the mountains.
e.zh: 她喜欢在山间小屋里远程办公。

e.en: European {telecoms} are racing to deploy new fiber networks.
e.zh: 欧洲各电信公司正竞相部署新光纤网络。

e.en: He invested heavily in {telecoms} stocks last year.
e.zh: 他去年大举投资了电信类股票。

teleconference.t:
n. 电话/视频会议
v. 举行远程会议

e.en: The team held a {teleconference} with clients in Tokyo.
e.zh: 团队与东京的客户举行了电话会议。

e.en: Please join the {teleconference} at three this afternoon.
e.zh: 请在今天下午三点加入电话会议。

e.en: {Teleconferencing} has replaced many in-person meetings since the pandemic.
e.zh: 自疫情以来电话会议取代了许多面对面会议。

e.en: The hotel offers full {teleconferencing} facilities for business guests.
e.zh: 酒店为商务客人提供完善的电话会议设施。

telegenic.t: adj. 上镜的；适合上电视的

e.en: The young senator proved unusually {telegenic} on national TV.
e.zh: 这位年轻参议员在全国电视上显得格外上镜。

e.en: They picked a {telegenic} host for the morning show.
e.zh: 他们为晨间节目挑选了一位上镜的主持人。

telegram.t: n. 电报；Telegram 即时通讯软件

e.en: My great-grandfather sent a {telegram} announcing the baby's birth.
e.zh: 我曾祖父发了一封电报宣布孩子的出生。

e.en: I joined a {Telegram} group for language exchange.
e.zh: 我加入了一个Telegram语言交流群。

e.en: Wartime {telegrams} were often heartbreakingly brief.
e.zh: 战时的电报往往简短得令人心碎。

e.en: The museum displays old {telegrams} sent during the gold rush.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了淘金热时期发出的旧电报。

telegraph.t:
n. 电报机
v. 发电报；流露（意图）

e.en: The {telegraph} revolutionized long-distance communication in the 1800s.
e.zh: 电报在十九世纪彻底改变了长途通信。

e.en: Her facial expressions {telegraph} her feelings instantly.
e.zh: 她的面部表情会立刻流露出她的情绪。

e.en: The {telegrapher} tapped out the message in Morse code.
e.zh: 那位电报员用摩尔斯电码敲出了那条信息。

e.en: She trained as a {telegrapher} during the First World War.
e.zh: 她在一战期间接受了电报员的训练。

telegraphic.t: adj. 电报的；电报式简短的

e.en: His emails are blunt and {telegraphic}, just a few words each.
e.zh: 他的邮件简短直接,每封只有寥寥数语。

e.en: The report uses a {telegraphic} style to save space.
e.zh: 该报告采用电报式简洁风格以节省篇幅。

e.en: Wireless {telegraphy} paved the way for modern radio.
e.zh: 无线电报为现代无线电铺平了道路。

e.en: The museum's exhibit traces the history of {telegraphy}.
e.zh: 博物馆的展览追溯了电报学的历史。

telekinesis.t: n. 意念移物；心灵致动

e.en: In the film, the girl uses {telekinesis} to lift objects.
e.zh: 在电影中,小女孩用念力移动物体。

e.en: Scientists have found no evidence that {telekinesis} is real.
e.zh: 科学家没有发现念力存在的任何证据。

telekinetic.t: adj. 具有意念移物能力的

e.en: The hero discovers his {telekinetic} powers as a teenager.
e.zh: 主角在少年时期发现了自己的念动力。

e.en: She wrote a novel about a {telekinetic} schoolgirl.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于一个具有念动力的女学生的小说。

telemark.t: n. 屈膝旋转（滑雪动作）

e.en: He skied down the slope using a graceful {telemark} turn.
e.zh: 他用优雅的泰勒马克转弯滑下了山坡。

e.en: {Telemark} skiing requires strong knees and good balance.
e.zh: 泰勒马克式滑雪需要强健的膝盖和良好的平衡感。

e.en: A pushy {telemarketer} called during dinner again.
e.zh: 又有一个咄咄逼人的电话推销员在晚饭时打来。

e.en: She worked briefly as a {telemarketer} after college.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后曾短暂做过电话推销员。

e.en: New rules limit {telemarketing} calls to specific hours.
e.zh: 新规定将电话营销的时段限定在特定时间。

e.en: The company shifted from {telemarketing} to email campaigns.
e.zh: 公司从电话营销转向了邮件营销。

telematics.t: n. 远程信息处理；车联网技术

e.en: Many insurers now use {telematics} to set driver premiums.
e.zh: 许多保险公司如今使用车载远程信息技术来确定保费。

e.en: Fleet managers rely on {telematics} to track vehicle locations.
e.zh: 车队管理者依靠远程信息处理系统来追踪车辆位置。

e.en: {Telemedicine} lets rural patients consult specialists from home.
e.zh: 远程医疗让乡村患者足不出户就能咨询专家。

e.en: She booked a {telemedicine} appointment instead of driving downtown.
e.zh: 她预约了一次远程医疗,免去了开车进城。

telemetry.t: n. 遥测技术；遥测数据

e.en: Mission control monitors the rocket's {telemetry} in real time.
e.zh: 任务控制中心实时监测火箭的遥测数据。

e.en: Disabling {telemetry} can improve user privacy on the device.
e.zh: 关闭遥测功能可以提升设备上的用户隐私保护。

e.en: My aunt watches a Mexican {telenovela} every weeknight.
e.zh: 我阿姨每个工作日晚上都看一部墨西哥肥皂剧。

e.en: The {telenovela} ended with a dramatic family reunion.
e.zh: 那部肥皂剧以一场戏剧性的家庭团聚收尾。

e.en: Aristotle offered a {teleological} explanation for natural phenomena.
e.zh: 亚里士多德对自然现象提出了一种目的论的解释。

e.en: Critics rejected the {teleological} view of human history.
e.zh: 批评者否定了那种目的论的人类历史观。

e.en: Aristotle's {teleology} explains nature through purpose and final causes.
e.zh: 亚里士多德的目的论用目的与终因来解释自然。

e.en: Critics reject {teleology} in modern evolutionary biology.
e.zh: 批评者反对在现代进化生物学中引入目的论。

telepath.t: n. 有心灵感应能力的人

e.en: The novel's hero is a {telepath} who reads minds.
e.zh: 小说主角是一位能读心的心灵感应者。

e.en: A trained {telepath} could communicate without speaking.
e.zh: 受过训练的心灵感应者无需言语即可交流。

e.en: The twins seem to share a {telepathic} bond.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎似乎有种心灵感应般的默契。

e.en: She gave her dog a {telepathic} command, half-joking.
e.zh: 她半开玩笑地向狗发出了一个心灵感应的指令。

e.en: The aliens communicate {telepathically} across vast distances.
e.zh: 那些外星人通过心灵感应跨越遥远距离交流。

e.en: Old friends sometimes seem to finish sentences {telepathically}.
e.zh: 老朋友有时仿佛能心灵感应地接完对方的话。

e.en: Scientists have found no real evidence for {telepathy}.
e.zh: 科学家尚未发现心灵感应存在的真实证据。

e.en: The movie explores {telepathy} between a mother and child.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了母子之间的心灵感应。

telephone.t:
n. 电话
v. 打电话

e.en: Please answer the {telephone} if it rings.
e.zh: 如果电话响了请接一下。

e.en: I'll {telephone} the clinic to confirm the appointment.
e.zh: 我会打电话给诊所确认预约。

e.en: She {telephoned} her parents the moment she landed.
e.zh: 她一落地就给父母打了电话。

e.en: The reporter {telephoned} every witness on the list.
e.zh: 记者给名单上的每位目击者都打了电话。

telephones.t:
n. 电话（复数）
v. 打电话（三单）

e.en: Modern {telephones} have replaced almost every old gadget.
e.zh: 现代电话几乎取代了所有旧式小工具。

e.en: The museum displays antique {telephones} from the 1920s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了二十年代的古董电话。

e.en: The court accepted {telephonic} testimony from the witness.
e.zh: 法庭接受了证人通过电话提供的证词。

e.en: They held a {telephonic} conference instead of meeting.
e.zh: 他们用电话会议代替了面对面会面。

e.en: He spent the morning {telephoning} potential clients.
e.zh: 他花了一上午给潜在客户打电话。

e.en: Stop {telephoning} me at midnight, please.
e.zh: 请别再半夜给我打电话了。

e.en: The hotel {telephonist} routed my call to housekeeping.
e.zh: 酒店接线员把我的电话转给了客房部。

e.en: She worked as a {telephonist} before computers replaced switchboards.
e.zh: 在电脑取代交换台之前,她当过接线员。

e.en: Internet {telephony} has made international calls nearly free.
e.zh: 网络电话让国际通话几乎免费。

e.en: The startup builds tools for cloud-based {telephony}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司开发基于云的电话通信工具。

e.en: The photographer used a {telephoto} lens to capture the lion.
e.zh: 摄影师用长焦镜头拍下了那只狮子。

e.en: A good {telephoto} is essential for wildlife photography.
e.zh: 一支好的长焦镜头对野生动物摄影至关重要。

e.en: The robot offers {telepresence} for doctors visiting remote patients.
e.zh: 这台机器人让医生能够远程探视偏远地区的病人。

e.en: VR headsets create a strong sense of {telepresence}.
e.zh: VR 头显能营造出强烈的远程临场感。

e.en: The newsroom's old {teleprinter} clattered through the night.
e.zh: 新闻编辑室那台老电传打字机彻夜咔嗒作响。

e.en: A {teleprinter} once delivered urgent dispatches across continents.
e.zh: 电传打字机曾跨洲传递紧急电讯。

e.en: The anchor read the news smoothly from the {teleprompter}.
e.zh: 主播流畅地照着提词器念新闻。

e.en: He fumbled when the {teleprompter} suddenly froze.
e.zh: 提词器突然卡住,他顿时语塞。

e.en: She closed her first {telesale} within an hour of training.
e.zh: 培训不到一个小时,她就完成了第一单电话销售。

e.en: A successful {telesale} depends on a confident opening line.
e.zh: 一次成功的电话销售取决于自信的开场白。

telescope.t:
n. 望远镜
v. 压缩；套叠

e.en: Galileo built his own {telescope} to study the moons of Jupiter.
e.zh: 伽利略自制望远镜来研究木星的卫星。

e.en: You can {telescope} the antenna into the case for travel.
e.zh: 你可以把天线伸缩收回盒子里方便携带。

e.en: Modern {telescopes} can detect planets orbiting distant stars.
e.zh: 现代望远镜能探测到围绕遥远恒星运转的行星。

e.en: The observatory houses three large {telescopes}.
e.zh: 这座天文台内有三台大型望远镜。

telescopic.t: adj. 可伸缩的；望远镜的

e.en: The hiking pole has a {telescopic} design for easy packing.
e.zh: 这根登山杖采用伸缩设计,便于打包。

e.en: She inspected the bird with a {telescopic} sight.
e.zh: 她用望远瞄具观察那只鸟。

telescopically.t: adv. 用望远镜地；伸缩地

e.en: The ladder extends {telescopically} to four meters.
e.zh: 这把梯子可伸缩延展至四米。

e.en: The camera tripod adjusts {telescopically} for any angle.
e.zh: 这款相机三脚架可伸缩调节,适应任何角度。

e.en: He carried a {telescoping} fishing rod in his backpack.
e.zh: 他背包里装着一根可伸缩的钓鱼竿。

e.en: The project plan keeps {telescoping} as deadlines compress.
e.zh: 随着截止日期压缩,项目计划不断被压缩重叠。

e.en: In Orwell's novel, the {telescreen} watches every citizen.
e.zh: 在奥威尔的小说中,电幕监视着每一个公民。

e.en: Critics compare smart TVs to a modern {telescreen}.
e.zh: 批评者把智能电视比作现代版的电幕。

teletext.t: n. 图文电视（信息广播）

e.en: Many viewers once checked sports scores on {teletext}.
e.zh: 许多观众曾经通过图文电视查看体育比分。

e.en: The broadcaster shut down {teletext} after thirty years.
e.zh: 广播公司在运营三十年后关闭了图文电视服务。

telethon.t: n. 电视马拉松募捐节目

e.en: The annual {telethon} raised millions for children's hospitals.
e.zh: 年度马拉松式电视募捐为儿童医院筹集了数百万善款。

e.en: Celebrities took turns hosting the charity {telethon}.
e.zh: 明星们轮流主持这场慈善电视募捐节目。

teletype.t:
n. 电传打字机
v. 用电传发送

e.en: Reporters once filed stories using a noisy {teletype} machine.
e.zh: 记者们曾用嘈杂的电传打字机发稿。

e.en: The vintage {teletype} still works at the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆里那台老式电传打字机仍能正常工作。

e.en: The {televangelist} urged viewers to donate to his ministry.
e.zh: 这位电视布道者呼吁观众向他的教会捐款。

e.en: A famous {televangelist} was caught up in a financial scandal.
e.zh: 一位著名的电视布道家陷入了财务丑闻。

tearaway.t:
n. 鲁莽少年；顽童
adj. 易撕开的

e.en: He was a {tearaway} as a teenager but settled down later.
e.zh: 他少年时是个野孩子,后来才安稳下来。

e.en: The notebook has {tearaway} pages for quick notes.
e.zh: 这本笔记本有可撕下的页面方便随手记事。

teardown.t:
n. 拆解（产品）；拆卸分析
v. 拆除

e.en: iFixit posted a full {teardown} of the new iPhone.
e.zh: iFixit发布了新款iPhone的完整拆解报告。

e.en: The {teardown} of the old factory took six months.
e.zh: 那座老工厂的拆除花了六个月。

e.en: Her earrings were shaped like tiny silver {teardrop} beads.
e.zh: 她的耳环是小巧的银色泪滴形珠子。

e.en: They towed a vintage {teardrop} trailer behind their car.
e.zh: 他们拖着一辆复古泪滴形拖车出行。

tearful.t: adj. 含泪的；哭哭啼啼的

e.en: She gave a {tearful} speech at her grandfather's funeral.
e.zh: 她在祖父的葬礼上含泪致辞。

e.en: The reunion between the soldier and his dog was {tearful}.
e.zh: 那位士兵和爱犬的重逢令人动容。

e.en: The actress {tearfully} thanked her family during the speech.
e.zh: 那位女演员在发言中含泪感谢了家人。

e.en: He {tearfully} apologized for missing his daughter's recital.
e.zh: 他含泪为错过女儿的演奏会道歉。

teargas.t:
n. 催泪瓦斯
v. 对…施放催泪瓦斯

e.en: Police fired {teargas} to disperse the crowd.
e.zh: 警察发射催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

e.en: Protesters covered their faces against the {teargas}.
e.zh: 抗议者捂住脸躲避催泪瓦斯。

tearing.t:
v. 撕裂（tear 的现在分词）
adj. 猛烈的

e.en: The puppy was {tearing} apart my favorite slipper.
e.zh: 小狗正在把我最爱的拖鞋撕得粉碎。

e.en: She came {tearing} down the stairs when the doorbell rang.
e.zh: 门铃一响她就飞奔下楼。

tearless.t: adj. 没有眼泪的；不哭的

e.en: He stood {tearless} at the graveside, lost in thought.
e.zh: 他无泪地站在墓前,陷入沉思。

e.en: The brand sells a {tearless} baby shampoo formula.
e.zh: 该品牌销售一款无泪配方的婴儿洗发水。

e.en: We met for scones in a cozy little {tearoom}.
e.zh: 我们在一家温馨的小茶室见面吃司康饼。

e.en: The hotel's {tearoom} serves afternoon tea daily at three.
e.zh: 酒店茶室每天下午三点供应下午茶。

tears.t:
n. 眼泪
v. 撕裂（tear 的第三人称单数）

e.en: She wiped away her {tears} before answering the door.
e.zh: 她擦干眼泪才去开门。

e.en: He {tears} open every package the moment it arrives.
e.zh: 包裹一到他就立刻撕开。

e.en: She got {teary} watching old home videos with her mom.
e.zh: 和妈妈一起看老家庭录像时她眼眶湿润了。

e.en: His {teary} goodbye at the airport touched everyone.
e.zh: 他在机场含泪的告别让每个人都动容。

tease.t:
v. 取笑；逗弄
n. 爱戏弄人者；预告片段

e.en: My brothers love to {tease} me about my cooking.
e.zh: 我的兄弟们老爱拿我的厨艺开玩笑。

e.en: The trailer was just a {tease} for the real movie.
e.zh: 那段预告只是为正片吊足了胃口。

teased.t: v. 取笑；逗弄（tease 的过去式）

e.en: Apple {teased} the new headset at last week's event.
e.zh: 苹果在上周的发布会上预告了新款头显。

e.en: The kids {teased} him for wearing mismatched socks.
e.zh: 孩子们因为他穿了不配对的袜子而取笑他。

teaser.t:
n. 预告片；悬念广告
n. 爱逗弄人者

e.en: Marvel dropped a 30-second {teaser} for the next film.
e.zh: 漫威发布了下一部电影30秒的先导预告。

e.en: The article's headline was a clever {teaser}.
e.zh: 这篇文章的标题是个巧妙的悬念引子。

teases.t: v. 取笑；逗弄（tease 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {teases} his sister about her messy room.
e.zh: 他总是拿妹妹乱糟糟的房间打趣。

e.en: The studio {teases} fans with cryptic posts before launches.
e.zh: 工作室在发布前用神秘帖子吊粉丝胃口。

e.en: There's a charming {teashop} just around the corner.
e.zh: 街角就有一家迷人的小茶馆。

e.en: The {teashop} sells over fifty varieties of loose-leaf tea.
e.zh: 这家茶店出售五十多种散装茶叶。

teasing.t:
v. 逗弄；取笑
adj. 戏弄的

e.en: His {teasing} smile made her blush a little.
e.zh: 他那揶揄的笑容让她有点脸红。

e.en: Stop {teasing} the cat with that laser pointer.
e.zh: 别再用激光笔逗那只猫了。

e.en: She {teasingly} called him her favorite nerd.
e.zh: 她打趣地叫他自己最喜欢的书呆子。

e.en: He raised an eyebrow {teasingly} at her answer.
e.zh: 听到她的回答,他调皮地挑了挑眉。

e.en: Add a {teaspoon} of vanilla extract to the batter.
e.zh: 在面糊里加一茶匙香草精。

e.en: He stirred his coffee with a small silver {teaspoon}.
e.zh: 他用一把小银茶匙搅了搅咖啡。

e.en: Add a {teaspoonful} of sugar to the warm tea.
e.zh: 往热茶里加一茶匙糖。

e.en: She swallowed a {teaspoonful} of cough syrup before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前喝了一茶匙止咳糖浆。

e.en: The recipe calls for two {teaspoons} of vanilla extract.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要两茶匙香草精。

e.en: Please put the clean {teaspoons} back in the drawer.
e.zh: 请把洗干净的茶匙放回抽屉里。

teat.t: n. 乳头；（奶瓶的）橡皮奶嘴

e.en: The lamb suckled at its mother's {teat} eagerly.
e.zh: 小羊急切地吮吸母羊的乳头。

e.en: Replace the bottle's {teat} when it gets worn out.
e.zh: 奶嘴用旧了就要换新的。

teatime.t: n. 下午茶时间；茶点时间

e.en: We always have biscuits at {teatime} on Sundays.
e.zh: 每逢周日下午茶时间我们都会吃饼干。

e.en: The kids rushed home just before {teatime}.
e.zh: 孩子们在下午茶时间前赶回了家。

tec.t: n. 侦探（detective 的口语缩写）

tech.t:
n. 科技；技术
adj. 技术的

e.en: Big {tech} companies are racing to release new AI models.
e.zh: 各大科技公司都在抢着发布新的人工智能模型。

e.en: He works as a support {tech} at a small startup.
e.zh: 他在一家小型创业公司当技术支持。

techie.t: n. 技术迷；科技爱好者

e.en: My brother is a total {techie} who loves new gadgets.
e.zh: 我哥是个十足的技术控,特别爱玩新设备。

e.en: The cafe is full of {techie} types coding on laptops.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里坐满了用笔记本写代码的技术宅。

technetium.t: n. 锝（化学元素，符号 Tc）

e.en: Doctors use {technetium} as a tracer in medical scans.
e.zh: 医生在医学扫描中用锝作为示踪剂。

e.en: {Technetium} was the first artificially produced chemical element.
e.zh: 锝是第一个人工合成的化学元素。

e.en: The manual is too {technical} for beginners to understand.
e.zh: 这份手册对初学者来说太专业了,不好懂。

e.en: She won the case on a {technical} point of law.
e.zh: 她在一个法律技术细节上赢了官司。

technicality.t: n. 技术细节；专业术语

e.en: The contract was voided on a minor {technicality}.
e.zh: 合同因为一个小的技术细节而作废了。

e.en: He escaped conviction on a legal {technicality}.
e.zh: 他靠一个法律上的技术问题逃脱了定罪。

e.en: {Technically}, tomatoes are fruits, not vegetables.
e.zh: 严格来说,西红柿是水果,不是蔬菜。

e.en: Her piano performance was {technically} flawless.
e.zh: 她的钢琴演奏在技术上无可挑剔。

e.en: A {technician} came to fix the broken printer today.
e.zh: 今天有位技术员来修了坏掉的打印机。

e.en: The lab {technician} carefully labeled each blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室技术员仔细给每份血样贴上标签。

technicolor.t:
n. 特艺彩色；绚丽色彩
adj. 色彩鲜艳的

e.en: The parade was a {technicolor} explosion of costumes.
e.zh: 游行队伍的服装五彩缤纷,绚丽夺目。

e.en: The old film was restored in vivid {technicolor}.
e.zh: 那部老电影被修复成了鲜艳的彩色版本。

technicolour.t:
n. 特艺彩色（英式拼写）
adj. 色彩鲜艳的

e.en: The garden burst into {technicolour} bloom every spring.
e.zh: 每到春天花园里就开出五彩缤纷的花。

e.en: She wore a {technicolour} coat that turned every head.
e.zh: 她穿着一件五彩外套,引得众人回头。

e.en: The author explores ancient {technics} of bronze casting.
e.zh: 作者探讨了古代青铜铸造的工艺技术。

e.en: Modern {technics} have transformed how we farm.
e.zh: 现代技术彻底改变了我们的耕作方式。

e.en: This breathing {technique} helps reduce anxiety quickly.
e.zh: 这种呼吸法能快速缓解焦虑。

e.en: Her painting {technique} improved after years of practice.
e.zh: 经过多年练习,她的绘画技巧大有提高。

e.en: Modern farming {techniques} have boosted crop yields significantly.
e.zh: 现代农业技术大幅提升了作物产量。

e.en: The chef demonstrated several knife {techniques} to the class.
e.zh: 厨师向班里演示了几种刀工技巧。

techno.t: n. 电子舞曲（一种音乐风格）

e.en: Berlin clubs are famous for their underground {techno} scene.
e.zh: 柏林的俱乐部以地下电子乐场景闻名。

e.en: He danced all night to pounding {techno} beats.
e.zh: 他随着震耳的电子节拍跳了一整晚。

e.en: Critics warn that Silicon Valley resembles a modern {technocracy}.
e.zh: 批评者警告说硅谷越来越像一个技术官僚社会。

e.en: Some believe a {technocracy} would govern more efficiently than democracy.
e.zh: 有人认为技术专家治国会比民主制度更高效。

technocrat.t: n. 技术官僚；专家政治人物

e.en: The new minister is a {technocrat} with no political background.
e.zh: 新部长是个技术官僚,没有任何政治背景。

e.en: Critics accused the {technocrat} of ignoring public opinion.
e.zh: 批评者指责这位技术官僚无视民意。

e.en: The government took a {technocratic} approach to the crisis.
e.zh: 政府以技术官僚的方式应对这场危机。

e.en: Her {technocratic} style frustrated lawmakers seeking compromise.
e.zh: 她技术官僚式的作风让寻求妥协的议员们很挫败。

e.en: Rapid {technologic} change is reshaping every industry today.
e.zh: 快速的技术变革正在重塑当今每一个行业。

e.en: The museum highlights {technologic} milestones of the last century.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了上世纪的重大技术里程碑。

e.en: AI represents the biggest {technological} leap in decades.
e.zh: 人工智能是几十年来最大的技术飞跃。

e.en: Rural areas often lag behind in {technological} development.
e.zh: 农村地区在技术发展方面常常落后。

technologically.t: adv. 技术上；在科技方面

e.en: Japan is one of the most {technologically} advanced countries.
e.zh: 日本是技术最先进的国家之一。

e.en: The factory is {technologically} ahead of its competitors.
e.zh: 这家工厂在技术上领先于竞争对手。

e.en: Renewable energy {technologies} are becoming much cheaper each year.
e.zh: 可再生能源技术每年都在变得更便宜。

e.en: Schools are slow to adopt new {technologies} in classrooms.
e.zh: 学校在课堂上采用新技术的速度比较慢。

technologist.t: n. 工艺技术专家；技术人员

e.en: She works as a medical {technologist} at the hospital lab.
e.zh: 她在医院实验室当医学技术师。

e.en: The {technologist} explained how the new sensors work.
e.zh: 那位技术专家解释了新传感器的工作原理。

e.en: New {technology} is changing how we work and communicate.
e.zh: 新技术正在改变我们工作和交流的方式。

e.en: The school invested heavily in classroom {technology} this year.
e.zh: 学校今年在课堂科技方面投入了大量资金。

e.en: As a {technophile}, he buys every new phone release.
e.zh: 作为科技迷,他每款新手机都要买。

e.en: My uncle is a {technophile} who owns three smart speakers.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个科技发烧友,家里有三台智能音箱。

e.en: My grandmother is a {technophobe} who refuses to use smartphones.
e.zh: 我奶奶讨厌科技,不肯用智能手机。

e.en: Even a {technophobe} can learn to send a quick email.
e.zh: 就算是科技恐惧者也能学会发简短邮件。

techy.t:
n. 技术迷（同 techie）
adj. 易怒的

e.en: My cousin is super {techy} and built her own computer.
e.zh: 我表妹特别懂技术,自己组装了一台电脑。

e.en: The startup hired a {techy} new CEO last month.
e.zh: 这家初创公司上个月聘请了一位懂技术的新CEO。

e.en: Old detective novels often featured hard-boiled {tecs} solving murders.
e.zh: 老式侦探小说里常有硬汉侦探破解谋杀案。

e.en: The film follows two {tecs} chasing a notorious thief.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述两个侦探追捕一个臭名昭著的小偷。

e.en: He took a {temporary} job over the summer.
e.zh: 他暑假期间找了一份临时工作。

e.en: This is only a {temporary} fix to the bug.
e.zh: 这只是这个漏洞的临时解决方案。

e.en: Politicians often {temporise} when asked tough questions.
e.zh: 政客被问到棘手问题时常常拖延搪塞。

e.en: Don't {temporise} — give us a clear answer.
e.zh: 别拖延敷衍,给我们一个明确答复。

temporize.t: v. 拖延，观望以求有利时机

e.en: The CEO chose to {temporize} rather than commit.
e.zh: 首席执行官选择拖延而非表态。

e.en: She tried to {temporize} until reinforcements arrived.
e.zh: 她试图拖延时间直到援军到达。

e.en: He suffers from {temporomandibular} joint pain.
e.zh: 他患有颞下颌关节疼痛。

e.en: The dentist examined her {temporomandibular} joint carefully.
e.zh: 牙医仔细检查了她的颞下颌关节。

e.en: The dessert menu always tries to {tempt} me.
e.zh: 甜点菜单总能勾起我的食欲。

e.en: Don't {tempt} fate by driving without a seatbelt.
e.zh: 别不系安全带开车,以免招来厄运。

temptation.t: n. 诱惑，令人心动的事物

e.en: She resisted the {temptation} to check her phone.
e.zh: 她忍住了去看手机的冲动。

e.en: Cheap flights are a real {temptation} for travelers.
e.zh: 廉价机票对旅行者来说真是一种诱惑。

e.en: The city is full of culinary {temptations}.
e.zh: 这座城市到处都是美食的诱惑。

e.en: Online shopping presents endless {temptations} to spend.
e.zh: 网购提供了数不尽的消费诱惑。

tempted.t:
adj. 心动的，想要去做的
v. tempt 的过去式

e.en: I was {tempted} to skip the meeting entirely.
e.zh: 我差点忍不住想完全翘掉这场会议。

e.en: She felt {tempted} by the job offer in Tokyo.
e.zh: 东京的那份工作邀约让她有些心动。

e.en: In the tale, the {tempter} offers forbidden knowledge.
e.zh: 故事中,诱惑者提供了禁忌的知识。

e.en: The salesman played the role of {tempter} skillfully.
e.zh: 那位推销员把诱惑者的角色演得淋漓尽致。

e.en: That offer sounds very {tempting}, but I'll pass.
e.zh: 这个提议很诱人,但我还是不要了。

e.en: The smell of fresh bread is incredibly {tempting}.
e.zh: 新出炉面包的香味让人难以抗拒。

e.en: Cookies sat {temptingly} on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 饼干诱人地摆在厨房台面上。

e.en: The pool glittered {temptingly} in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 泳池在午后阳光下闪闪发光,十分诱人。

e.en: In the film, she plays a mysterious {temptress}.
e.zh: 在电影中,她饰演一位神秘的诱惑女郎。

e.en: The novel's {temptress} leads the hero astray.
e.zh: 小说中的诱惑女子让主人公误入歧途。

tempts.t: v. tempt 的第三人称单数

e.en: The aroma of coffee {tempts} me every morning.
e.zh: 咖啡的香气每天早上都引诱着我。

e.en: Free shipping always {tempts} online shoppers.
e.zh: 免运费总能吸引网购者下单。

tempura.t: n. 天妇罗（日式油炸食物）

e.en: We ordered shrimp {tempura} at the Japanese restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在那家日料店点了炸虾天妇罗。

e.en: Light, crispy {tempura} batter is hard to perfect.
e.zh: 轻盈酥脆的天妇罗面糊很难做到完美。

tenable.t: adj. 站得住脚的，可维持的

e.en: That argument is no longer {tenable} given the evidence.
e.zh: 鉴于这些证据,那种论点已站不住脚。

e.en: The fellowship is {tenable} for three years.
e.zh: 该奖学金为期三年。

tenacious.t: adj. 顽强的，坚韧不拔的

e.en: She's a {tenacious} negotiator who never backs down.
e.zh: 她是个绝不退让的顽强谈判者。

e.en: The infection proved surprisingly {tenacious}.
e.zh: 这种感染顽固得出人意料。

e.en: He clung {tenaciously} to his original idea.
e.zh: 他顽强地坚持自己最初的想法。

e.en: The climber held {tenaciously} to the rock face.
e.zh: 那位攀岩者死死地抓住岩壁。

tenacities.t: n. 韧性，坚韧（tenacity 的复数）

e.en: Their differing {tenacities} shaped how they handled defeat.
e.zh: 两人不同的韧性决定了他们面对失败的方式。

e.en: Athletes are studied for the {tenacities} they display.
e.zh: 研究者关注运动员所展现的各种坚韧品质。

e.en: Her {tenacity} eventually paid off with a promotion.
e.zh: 她的坚韧不拔最终换来了一次升职。

e.en: Solving the puzzle required real {tenacity}.
e.zh: 解开这道谜题需要真正的毅力。

e.en: Our {tenancy} agreement runs for twelve months.
e.zh: 我们的租约期限为十二个月。

e.en: She enjoyed a peaceful {tenancy} in the apartment.
e.zh: 她在那套公寓里度过了一段安静的租住时光。

e.en: The new {tenant} moves in next Monday.
e.zh: 新租客下周一搬进来。

e.en: Every {tenant} must sign the building's safety rules.
e.zh: 每位租户都必须签署大楼的安全条例。

tenanted.t: adj. 已出租的，有人居住的

e.en: All five units in the building are currently {tenanted}.
e.zh: 这栋楼里五个单元目前都有人租住。

e.en: The cottage has been {tenanted} for over a decade.
e.zh: 这间小屋已被人租住了十多年。

e.en: The landlord met with all the {tenants} yesterday.
e.zh: 房东昨天和所有租户见了面。

e.en: Long-term {tenants} usually get a small discount.
e.zh: 长期租户通常能拿到一点折扣。

tenascin.t: n. 腱生蛋白（一种细胞外基质蛋白）

e.en: Researchers study how {tenascin} affects wound healing.
e.zh: 研究者正在研究腱生蛋白对伤口愈合的影响。

e.en: {Tenascin} is found in the extracellular matrix.
e.zh: 腱生蛋白存在于细胞外基质中。

e.en: He caught a large {tench} in the quiet pond.
e.zh: 他在那片静谧的池塘里钓到一条大丁鲷。

e.en: The {tench} is known for thriving in muddy water.
e.zh: 丁鲷以能在浑浊水域中良好生长而著称。

tend.t:
v. 倾向于，往往会
v. 照料，护理

e.en: Plants {tend} to grow toward the light.
e.zh: 植物倾向于朝着光生长。

e.en: She volunteers to {tend} the community garden.
e.zh: 她自愿照料社区花园。

e.en: He {tended} the wounded soldiers all night.
e.zh: 他整夜照料受伤的士兵。

e.en: Sales {tended} to dip in February.
e.zh: 销售额在二月份往往会下滑。

e.en: The app analyzes your spending {tendencies}.
e.zh: 这款应用会分析你的消费倾向。

e.en: He has perfectionist {tendencies} at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中有完美主义倾向。

e.en: There's a {tendency} to overestimate short-term progress.
e.zh: 人们往往会高估短期进展。

e.en: She has a {tendency} to interrupt during meetings.
e.zh: 她开会时有打断别人的倾向。

tendentious.t: adj. 有偏见的，带立场的

e.en: The article was a {tendentious} attack on the mayor.
e.zh: 这篇文章是对市长有偏见的攻击。

e.en: Critics called the documentary {tendentious} and one-sided.
e.zh: 评论家说这部纪录片立场偏颇、片面。

tender.t:
adj. 温柔的；嫩的
v./n. 投标

e.en: The steak was juicy and {tender}.
e.zh: 这块牛排多汁又嫩。

e.en: She gave him a {tender} hug at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场给了他一个温柔的拥抱。

tenderer.t:
n. 投标人
adj. 更温柔的

e.en: Slow cooking makes the brisket much {tenderer} than grilling.
e.zh: 慢炖让牛胸肉比烧烤更加软嫩。

e.en: Each {tenderer} must submit sealed bids by Friday.
e.zh: 每位投标人必须在周五前提交密封标书。

e.en: The {tenderfoot} struggled with his boots on the first hike.
e.zh: 这位新手第一次徒步时连靴子都穿不利索。

e.en: Veterans love teasing any {tenderfoot} who joins the crew.
e.zh: 老兵们最爱捉弄队里新来的菜鸟。

tendering.t:
n. 投标
v. 提出，提交

e.en: The city is {tendering} contracts for the new bridge.
e.zh: 市政府正在为新桥项目进行招标。

e.en: He is {tendering} his resignation tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 他明天上午就要正式提交辞呈。

e.en: Marinate the steak overnight to {tenderize} the meat.
e.zh: 将牛排腌一夜可以让肉变得更嫩。

e.en: Use a mallet to {tenderize} the chicken breast evenly.
e.zh: 用肉锤把鸡胸肉均匀地拍松。

e.en: A pineapple-based {tenderizer} works wonders on tough cuts.
e.zh: 菠萝制的嫩肉粉对老韧的肉块特别有效。

e.en: He whacked the pork chop with a metal {tenderizer}.
e.zh: 他用金属嫩肉锤敲打猪排。

e.en: She ordered the beef {tenderloin} medium rare.
e.zh: 她点了一份三分熟的牛里脊。

e.en: Pork {tenderloin} cooks quickly and stays juicy.
e.zh: 猪里脊熟得快,肉质又多汁。

e.en: He {tenderly} wrapped the bandage around her wrist.
e.zh: 他温柔地为她的手腕缠上绷带。

e.en: She {tenderly} kissed the baby's forehead before sleep.
e.zh: 她在睡前轻柔地吻了吻宝宝的额头。

e.en: The doctor checked for {tenderness} around the swollen ankle.
e.zh: 医生检查了肿胀脚踝周围的压痛。

e.en: Her eyes filled with {tenderness} as she held the puppy.
e.zh: 她抱着小狗时眼里满是怜爱。

e.en: The patient described several {tendernesses} along his spine.
e.zh: 病人诉说脊柱沿线有多处压痛点。

e.en: Small {tendernesses} between them grew into deep love.
e.zh: 他们之间点点滴滴的温情渐渐发展成了深爱。

tending.t: v. 照料；倾向于（tend 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent the afternoon {tending} her vegetable garden.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在打理自家的菜园。

e.en: Stock prices are {tending} downward this week.
e.zh: 本周股价呈现下行趋势。

e.en: Years of typing gave him chronic wrist {tendinitis}.
e.zh: 多年打字让他患上了慢性手腕肌腱炎。

e.en: Rest and ice are key for treating {tendinitis}.
e.zh: 休息加冰敷是治疗肌腱炎的关键。

e.en: The cut of beef was tough and {tendinous}.
e.zh: 这块牛肉又老又多筋。

e.en: Surgeons must avoid the dense {tendinous} tissue here.
e.zh: 外科医生必须避开这里致密的腱性组织。

e.en: He tore his Achilles {tendon} during the basketball game.
e.zh: 他在篮球比赛中扯伤了跟腱。

e.en: Stretching keeps every {tendon} flexible and injury-free.
e.zh: 拉伸能让每条肌腱保持柔韧,不易受伤。

e.en: Runners often develop knee {tendonitis} from overtraining.
e.zh: 跑者常因过度训练而患上膝部肌腱炎。

e.en: Physical therapy eased the {tendonitis} in her shoulder.
e.zh: 物理治疗缓解了她肩部的肌腱炎。

e.en: A green {tendril} curled around the trellis.
e.zh: 一根绿色的卷须缠绕在花架上。

e.en: A loose {tendril} of hair fell across her cheek.
e.zh: 一缕松散的发丝垂落到她的脸颊上。

tends.t: v. tend 的第三人称单数

e.en: He {tends} to arrive ten minutes early to meetings.
e.zh: 他开会往往会提前十分钟到场。

e.en: She carefully {tends} the bees in her backyard.
e.zh: 她精心照料后院里的蜜蜂。

tenement.t: n. 廉租公寓，贫民住宅

e.en: They grew up in a crowded {tenement} on the Lower East Side.
e.zh: 他们在下东区一栋拥挤的廉租公寓里长大。

e.en: The old {tenement} was finally demolished last spring.
e.zh: 那栋老旧的廉价公寓终于在去年春天被拆除。

tenerife.t: n. 特内里费岛（西班牙加那利群岛）

e.en: We booked a beach holiday in {Tenerife} next month.
e.zh: 我们订了下个月去特内里费岛的海滩度假。

e.en: Mount Teide on {Tenerife} is Spain's highest peak.
e.zh: 特内里费岛的泰德峰是西班牙最高的山。

e.en: Cats can be very {territorial} about their feeding spot.
e.zh: 猫对自己的进食地点会有很强的领地意识。

e.en: The dispute involves {territorial} waters near the islands.
e.zh: 这场争端涉及岛屿附近的领海。

e.en: Wolves display strong {territoriality} when defending their den.
e.zh: 狼在保卫巢穴时表现出很强的领地性。

e.en: Office {territoriality} can hurt team collaboration.
e.zh: 办公室里的地盘意识会损害团队协作。

territorially.t: adv. 在领土上；地域性地

e.en: Robins behave {territorially} during the breeding season.
e.zh: 知更鸟在繁殖季节会表现出强烈的领地性。

e.en: The two countries are {territorially} adjacent and trade often.
e.zh: 这两个国家领土相邻,贸易频繁。

territories.t: n. 领土；地区（territory 的复数）

e.en: The company expanded into new sales {territories} last year.
e.zh: 公司去年拓展了新的销售区域。

e.en: Several overseas {territories} still hold local elections.
e.zh: 几个海外领地仍举行地方选举。

e.en: Working from home is unfamiliar {territory} for many managers.
e.zh: 远程办公对许多管理者来说是陌生领域。

e.en: The lion patrols its {territory} every evening.
e.zh: 那头狮子每晚都在自己的领地巡视。

terror.t: n. 恐惧；恐怖；恐怖活动

e.en: She froze in {terror} when she saw the snake.
e.zh: 看到那条蛇时她吓得僵住了。

e.en: The film is a classic of psychological {terror}.
e.zh: 这部电影是心理恐怖片的经典之作。

terrorise.t: v. 恐吓；使恐惧（英式拼写）

e.en: Bullies often {terrorise} younger students at school.
e.zh: 恶霸常在学校里欺凌恐吓低年级学生。

e.en: Wild dogs began to {terrorise} the small village.
e.zh: 野狗开始在那个小村庄四处肆虐。

terrorism.t: n. 恐怖主义；恐怖活动

e.en: The government passed new laws to combat {terrorism}.
e.zh: 政府通过了打击恐怖主义的新法律。

e.en: International cooperation is essential to prevent {terrorism}.
e.zh: 国际合作对预防恐怖主义至关重要。

terrorisms.t: n. 恐怖活动（terrorism 的复数）

e.en: Scholars compare different {terrorisms} across history.
e.zh: 学者们比较历史上各种形式的恐怖主义。

e.en: The book examines state and non-state {terrorisms}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了国家与非国家形式的恐怖活动。

terrorist.t:
n. 恐怖分子
adj. 恐怖主义的

e.en: Police arrested a suspected {terrorist} at the airport.
e.zh: 警方在机场逮捕了一名恐怖分子嫌疑人。

e.en: The {terrorist} attack shocked the entire nation.
e.zh: 这场恐怖袭击震惊了整个国家。

terroristic.t: adj. 恐怖主义的；恐怖的

e.en: He was charged with making {terroristic} threats online.
e.zh: 他被指控在网上发出恐吓性威胁。

e.en: The group's {terroristic} tactics were widely condemned.
e.zh: 该组织的恐怖手段受到广泛谴责。

e.en: The {terrorists} were captured before carrying out the plan.
e.zh: 那些恐怖分子在实施计划前就被抓获了。

e.en: International forces are tracking down the remaining {terrorists}.
e.zh: 国际部队正在追捕剩余的恐怖分子。

e.en: The gang used to {terrorize} the neighborhood at night.
e.zh: 那个团伙曾在夜间恐吓骚扰这片街区。

e.en: Trolls online sometimes {terrorize} new users for fun.
e.zh: 网上的喷子有时为取乐而骚扰新用户。

terrorized.t: v. 恐吓（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The robbers {terrorized} the bank staff for over an hour.
e.zh: 劫匪恐吓银行职员长达一个多小时。

e.en: As a child, she was {terrorized} by her older cousins.
e.zh: 小时候她被表哥们欺负得很惨。

e.en: The novel describes the {terrors} of life during the war.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了战时生活的种种恐怖。

e.en: He still suffers from night {terrors} as an adult.
e.zh: 他成年后仍会经历夜惊。

e.en: She wrapped herself in a soft {terry} bathrobe.
e.zh: 她裹上了一件柔软的毛巾布浴袍。

e.en: The hotel provides {terry} towels in every room.
e.zh: 酒店每个房间都提供毛巾布毛巾。

e.en: The baby's bib is made of absorbent {terrycloth}.
e.zh: 宝宝的围嘴是用吸水的毛巾布做的。

e.en: He prefers {terrycloth} robes after a hot shower.
e.zh: 洗完热水澡后他喜欢穿毛巾布浴袍。

terse.t: adj. 简洁的；简短生硬的

e.en: His {terse} reply made me think he was upset.
e.zh: 他简短生硬的回复让我觉得他在生气。

e.en: The manager sent a {terse} email about the missed deadline.
e.zh: 经理就错过截止日期发了一封简短严厉的邮件。

e.en: She {tersely} told him to leave the room.
e.zh: 她简短而严厉地叫他离开房间。

e.en: He answered the reporter's question {tersely} and walked away.
e.zh: 他简短地回答了记者的问题就走开了。

e.en: Many graduates pursue {tertiary} education abroad these days.
e.zh: 如今许多毕业生选择出国接受高等教育。

e.en: This issue is only of {tertiary} importance to the project.
e.zh: 这个问题对项目来说只是第三位的考虑。

e.en: The shirt is made from a {terylene} blend that resists wrinkles.
e.zh: 这件衬衫由抗皱的涤纶混纺面料制成。

e.en: My grandmother kept her old {terylene} curtains for decades.
e.zh: 我奶奶那些旧的涤纶窗帘用了好几十年。

tesco.t: n. 特易购（英国连锁超市）

e.en: I picked up some milk from {tesco} on the way home.
e.zh: 我回家路上在乐购买了些牛奶。

e.en: There's a {tesco} just around the corner from my flat.
e.zh: 我公寓拐角处就有一家乐购超市。

tesserae.t: n. 镶嵌用小方块（tessera 的复数）

e.en: The Roman mosaic was made of thousands of tiny {tesserae}.
e.zh: 这幅罗马马赛克由成千上万块小镶嵌片组成。

e.en: Artisans carefully arranged the colored {tesserae} into a pattern.
e.zh: 工匠们将彩色的镶嵌石小心地拼成图案。

e.en: The aria's high {tessitura} challenges most sopranos.
e.zh: 这首咏叹调的高音域对大多数女高音都是挑战。

e.en: She avoided the role because of its uncomfortable {tessitura}.
e.zh: 她因角色音域不适合自己而拒绝出演。

test.t:
n. 测试；考试
v. 测试；检验

e.en: I have a math {test} tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我明天上午有一场数学考试。

e.en: Engineers will {test} the new app for bugs this week.
e.zh: 工程师本周将测试新应用是否有缺陷。

e.en: The seed's hard {testa} protects the embryo inside.
e.zh: 种子坚硬的种皮保护着内部的胚胎。

e.en: Soaking softens the {testa} before planting.
e.zh: 播种前浸泡可以软化种皮。

testable.t: adj. 可测试的；可检验的

e.en: A good hypothesis must be clearly {testable} through experiments.
e.zh: 一个好的假设必须能够通过实验明确检验。

e.en: Write {testable} code by keeping functions small and pure.
e.zh: 通过保持函数简洁纯粹来编写可测试的代码。

testament.t: n. 证明；遗嘱；（大写）圣约书

e.en: Her success is a {testament} to years of hard work.
e.zh: 她的成功证明了多年的辛勤付出。

e.en: He updated his last will and {testament} after retiring.
e.zh: 他退休后更新了自己的遗嘱。

e.en: The lawyer explained the {testamentary} rights of each heir.
e.zh: 律师解释了每位继承人在遗嘱中的权利。

e.en: A {testamentary} trust takes effect after the person dies.
e.zh: 遗嘱信托在立遗嘱人去世后生效。

e.en: These photographs are {testaments} to a vanished way of life.
e.zh: 这些照片见证了一种已消失的生活方式。

e.en: The library holds several historic {testaments} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏着几份十九世纪的历史遗嘱。

e.en: The {testator} signed the will in front of two witnesses.
e.zh: 立遗嘱人在两位见证人面前签署了遗嘱。

e.en: Only the {testator} can change the terms of the will.
e.zh: 只有立遗嘱人本人才能更改遗嘱条款。

e.en: The startup uses Singapore as a {testbed} for new features.
e.zh: 这家初创公司把新加坡作为新功能的试验场。

e.en: Engineers built a {testbed} to evaluate the prototype engine.
e.zh: 工程师们搭建了一个测试平台来评估原型发动机。

teste.t: n. 睾丸（testis 的单数形式）

e.en: The biology lecture briefly covered the structure of the {teste}.
e.zh: 生物课简要讲解了睾丸的结构。

e.en: Damage to a {teste} can affect hormone production.
e.zh: 睾丸受损会影响激素分泌。

tested.t:
adj. 经过测试的
v. 测试（过去式）

e.en: The team {tested} the website on multiple browsers.
e.zh: 团队在多个浏览器上测试了这个网站。

e.en: She got {tested} for allergies last month.
e.zh: 她上个月做了过敏检测。

e.en: The {tester} found three bugs in the new login flow.
e.zh: 测试员在新登录流程中发现了三个漏洞。

e.en: She works as a beta {tester} for indie games.
e.zh: 她为独立游戏担任测试员。

e.en: The doctor checked for any lump on the {testicle}.
e.zh: 医生检查睾丸上是否有肿块。

e.en: A swollen {testicle} can signal a serious infection.
e.zh: 睾丸肿胀可能是严重感染的信号。

e.en: Young men should learn how to perform {testicular} self-exams.
e.zh: 年轻男性应学会如何进行睾丸自检。

e.en: He survived {testicular} cancer after early diagnosis.
e.zh: 他因早期确诊战胜了睾丸癌。

e.en: The witness {testified} against the company in court.
e.zh: 那名证人在法庭上作证指控公司。

e.en: Her smile {testified} to how happy she was.
e.zh: 她的微笑印证了她有多开心。

testifies.t: v. 作证；证明（第三人称单数）

e.en: The data {testifies} to the success of the program.
e.zh: 这些数据证明了该项目的成功。

e.en: He {testifies} before Congress next Tuesday.
e.zh: 他下周二将在国会作证。

e.en: She agreed to {testify} about what she saw.
e.zh: 她同意就她所见之事作证。

e.en: The reviews {testify} to the restaurant's quality.
e.zh: 评价证明了这家餐厅的品质。

testifying.t: v. 作证；证明（现在分词）

e.en: He spent the morning {testifying} in front of the jury.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在陪审团面前作证。

e.en: The scientist is {testifying} about climate research today.
e.zh: 那位科学家今天就气候研究作证。

e.en: "Stop interrupting me," she replied {testily}.
e.zh: 她不耐烦地回道:"别打断我。"

e.en: He answered {testily} after the third repeat question.
e.zh: 被第三次重复提问后,他没好气地回答。

testimonial.t:
n. 推荐信；用户好评
adj. 证明的

e.en: The website features a glowing {testimonial} from a happy customer.
e.zh: 该网站登载了一位满意客户的好评推荐。

e.en: His coach gave a touching {testimonial} at the retirement dinner.
e.zh: 他的教练在退休晚宴上致辞,令人感动。

testimonials.t: n. 推荐信；用户好评（复数）

e.en: The landing page is filled with customer {testimonials}.
e.zh: 着陆页上满是客户的好评推荐。

e.en: Video {testimonials} convert better than written reviews.
e.zh: 视频推荐比文字评价转化率更高。

e.en: Several {testimonies} contradicted the defendant's story.
e.zh: 多份证词与被告的说法相互矛盾。

e.en: The survivors shared powerful {testimonies} at the hearing.
e.zh: 幸存者在听证会上发表了震撼人心的证词。

e.en: Her {testimony} helped convict the suspect.
e.zh: 她的证词帮助定罪了嫌疑人。

e.en: This bridge stands as {testimony} to old engineering skill.
e.zh: 这座桥见证了昔日的工程技艺。

e.en: His {testiness} after lunch annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 他午饭后的暴躁让整个团队都很恼火。

e.en: There was a hint of {testiness} in her email reply.
e.zh: 她的邮件回复里带着一丝不耐烦。

teriyaki.t: n. 照烧（日式酱汁烹法）

e.en: I ordered chicken {teriyaki} with steamed rice.
e.zh: 我点了一份照烧鸡配蒸饭。

e.en: She brushed {teriyaki} sauce over the salmon fillets.
e.zh: 她在三文鱼片上刷了照烧酱。

term.t:
n. 术语；学期
v. 称为

e.en: The {term} "cloud computing" can be confusing for beginners.
e.zh: "云计算"这个术语对新手来说可能令人困惑。

e.en: Final exams happen at the end of the {term}.
e.zh: 期末考试在学期末进行。

termed.t: v. 称为（term 的过去式）

e.en: This phenomenon is {termed} "survivorship bias".
e.zh: 这种现象被称为"幸存者偏差"。

e.en: What scientists once {termed} impossible is now routine.
e.zh: 科学家曾经称为不可能的事如今已成常态。

terminal.t:
n. 终端；航站楼
adj. 末期的

e.en: I opened a {terminal} to run the install command.
e.zh: 我打开终端运行了安装命令。

e.en: Her flight leaves from {terminal} 3.
e.zh: 她的航班从三号航站楼起飞。

e.en: His grandfather is {terminally} ill with cancer.
e.zh: 他爷爷得了癌症晚期。

e.en: That meme is {terminally} online humor.
e.zh: 那个梗是典型的过度网络化幽默。

e.en: The airport has four passenger {terminals}.
e.zh: 这座机场有四个客运航站楼。

e.en: Developers often keep multiple {terminals} open.
e.zh: 开发者常常会同时开着好几个终端窗口。

e.en: You can {terminate} the subscription anytime in settings.
e.zh: 你随时可以在设置里取消订阅。

e.en: Press Ctrl+C to {terminate} the running process.
e.zh: 按 Ctrl+C 可以终止正在运行的进程。

terminated.t: v. 已终止（terminate 过去式）

e.en: The contract was {terminated} after three months.
e.zh: 合同在三个月后被终止了。

e.en: His employment was {terminated} for repeated violations.
e.zh: 由于多次违规,他被解雇了。

terminates.t: v. 终止（第三人称单数）

e.en: The bus route {terminates} at the central station.
e.zh: 这条公交线路在中央车站终止。

e.en: This loop never {terminates} without a break statement.
e.zh: 这个循环没有 break 语句就永远不会结束。

e.en: The system is {terminating} all idle connections.
e.zh: 系统正在终止所有空闲连接。

e.en: They are {terminating} the lease at month's end.
e.zh: 他们将在月底终止租约。

e.en: The contract includes a 30-day {termination} clause.
e.zh: 合同包含一条三十天终止条款。

e.en: Wrongful {termination} lawsuits are taken seriously.
e.zh: 非法解雇诉讼会被认真对待。

e.en: Each statement needs a semicolon as a {terminator}.
e.zh: 每条语句都需要一个分号作为结束符。

e.en: He watched The {Terminator} again last night.
e.zh: 他昨晚又看了一遍《终结者》。

terming.t: v. 称为（term 的现在分词）

e.en: Critics are {terming} the policy a quiet disaster.
e.zh: 评论家将这项政策称为一场无声的灾难。

e.en: Reviewers are {terming} the phone a worthy upgrade.
e.zh: 评测者把这款手机称为值得入手的升级版。

e.en: The paper has several {terminological} inconsistencies.
e.zh: 这篇论文有几处术语不一致的地方。

e.en: Their debate was largely a {terminological} dispute.
e.zh: 他们的争论很大程度上只是术语之争。

e.en: Medical {terminology} can be hard to learn.
e.zh: 医学术语学起来可能很难。

e.en: The docs explain the project's core {terminology}.
e.zh: 文档解释了项目的核心术语。

e.en: The train reached its northern {terminus} just before dawn.
e.zh: 火车在天亮前抵达了北端终点站。

e.en: This station is the {terminus} of the green line.
e.zh: 这一站是绿线的终点站。

e.en: They found a {termite} infestation in the basement.
e.zh: 他们在地下室发现了白蚁侵扰。

e.en: A single {termite} colony can damage entire houses.
e.zh: 一个白蚁群可以毁坏整栋房子。

e.en: Parents receive a {termly} progress report from school.
e.zh: 家长每学期都会收到学校的进步报告。

e.en: The committee meets {termly} to review budgets.
e.zh: 委员会每学期开会一次审查预算。

e.en: Please read the {terms} before signing up.
e.zh: 注册前请先阅读条款。

e.en: In simple {terms}, the engine converts heat to motion.
e.zh: 简单来说,发动机把热能转化为运动。

e.en: A white {tern} dove into the waves for fish.
e.zh: 一只白色的燕鸥扎进浪里捕鱼。

e.en: The Arctic {tern} migrates farther than any other bird.
e.zh: 北极燕鸥的迁徙距离比任何其他鸟类都远。

e.en: Use a {ternary} expression to keep the code concise.
e.zh: 用三元表达式可以让代码更简洁。

e.en: The chip uses a {ternary} logic system instead of binary.
e.zh: 这款芯片使用三元逻辑系统而非二进制。

terpene.t: n. 萜烯（一类有机化合物）

e.en: Each cannabis strain has a distinctive {terpene} profile.
e.zh: 每种大麻品种都有独特的萜烯成分。

e.en: Pine trees release {terpene} compounds into the air.
e.zh: 松树会向空气中释放萜烯化合物。

e.en: The pots were made of warm {terra} cotta clay.
e.zh: 这些花盆是用暖色的赤陶土做的。

e.en: Sailors finally stepped onto {terra} firma after weeks at sea.
e.zh: 水手们在海上漂泊数周后终于踏上了陆地。

e.en: We had dinner on the rooftop {terrace}.
e.zh: 我们在屋顶露台上吃了晚饭。

e.en: Farmers built each {terrace} into the steep hillside.
e.zh: 农民们在陡峭的山坡上修了一层层梯田。

terraced.t: adj. 阶梯式的；有露台的

e.en: They live in a small {terraced} house in London.
e.zh: 他们住在伦敦一栋小排屋里。

e.en: The vineyard is planted on {terraced} slopes.
e.zh: 这片葡萄园种在梯田式的山坡上。

e.en: Rice {terraces} stretch across the entire valley.
e.zh: 梯田延伸覆盖了整个山谷。

e.en: Cafés with sunny {terraces} line the riverbank.
e.zh: 河岸边排满了带阳光露台的咖啡馆。

e.en: Ancient {terracing} prevents erosion on these slopes.
e.zh: 古老的梯田工程防止了这些山坡的水土流失。

e.en: The farmers are {terracing} the hillside this season.
e.zh: 农民们这一季正在把山坡修成梯田。

e.en: She filled the balcony with {terracotta} flower pots.
e.zh: 她在阳台上摆满了赤陶花盆。

e.en: The famous {terracotta} army stands in Xi'an.
e.zh: 著名的兵马俑坐落在西安。

e.en: The hike covers rough mountain {terrain}.
e.zh: 这次徒步要穿越崎岖的山地地形。

e.en: The game's open-world {terrain} feels surprisingly realistic.
e.zh: 这款游戏的开放世界地形真实得令人意外。

e.en: The SUV handles all kinds of {terrains} well.
e.zh: 这款 SUV 能轻松应对各种地形。

e.en: The map includes deserts, forests, and snowy {terrains}.
e.zh: 地图涵盖了沙漠、森林和雪地等各种地形。

e.en: A small {terrapin} basked on the rock by the pond.
e.zh: 一只小水龟在池塘边的石头上晒太阳。

e.en: The zoo just added two diamondback {terrapin} hatchlings.
e.zh: 动物园新添了两只菱斑水龟幼崽。

terrarium.t: n. 生态缸；陆栖动物饲养箱

e.en: She built a tiny moss {terrarium} for her desk.
e.zh: 她为办公桌做了一个迷你苔藓微景观瓶。

e.en: The {terrarium} houses a gecko and several live plants.
e.zh: 这个生态缸里养着一只壁虎和几株活植物。

e.en: The lobby has a polished {terrazzo} floor with brass strips.
e.zh: 大堂铺着抛光水磨石地面,镶有铜条。

e.en: Pink {terrazzo} countertops are trending in modern kitchens.
e.zh: 粉色水磨石台面在现代厨房里很流行。

e.en: The label says "Pied de {terre}," a Paris bistro classic.
e.zh: 标签上写着「Pied de terre」,巴黎小酒馆经典名。

e.en: He visited Pointe-à-Pitre on the {terre} basse coast.
e.zh: 他游览了下地海岸的皮特尔角城。

e.en: Frogs lead both aquatic and {terrestrial} lives.
e.zh: 青蛙过着水陆两栖的生活。

e.en: The telescope picked up no extra-{terrestrial} signals last night.
e.zh: 望远镜昨晚没有捕捉到任何外星信号。

e.en: The traffic this morning was absolutely {terrible}.
e.zh: 今早的交通状况糟糕透顶。

e.en: I had a {terrible} headache after the long meeting.
e.zh: 开完长会后我头痛得厉害。

e.en: I'm {terribly} sorry for the delay in replying.
e.zh: 非常抱歉回复晚了。

e.en: She missed her family {terribly} during the trip.
e.zh: 旅途中她非常想念家人。

e.en: Her little {terrier} barks at every passing cyclist.
e.zh: 她的小梗犬对每个路过的骑车人狂吠。

e.en: The {terrier} dug a hole in the backyard.
e.zh: 那只梗犬在后院刨了个洞。

e.en: You did a {terrific} job on the presentation.
e.zh: 你的演讲做得太棒了。

e.en: We had a {terrific} time at the beach yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在海滩玩得非常开心。

e.en: The new café is {terrifically} popular with students.
e.zh: 这家新咖啡馆在学生中极受欢迎。

e.en: She sings {terrifically} well for someone untrained.
e.zh: 作为一个没受过训练的人,她唱得非常好。

terrified.t:
adj. 惊恐的
v. 使恐惧（过去式）

e.en: The child was {terrified} of the thunderstorm.
e.zh: 那个孩子被雷暴吓坏了。

e.en: I'm {terrified} of public speaking in front of crowds.
e.zh: 我非常害怕在众人面前演讲。

terrifies.t: v. 使恐惧（第三人称单数）

e.en: The thought of failing the exam {terrifies} her.
e.zh: 考试不及格的想法让她害怕极了。

e.en: Spiders in the bathroom {terrifies} my younger sister.
e.zh: 浴室里的蜘蛛把我妹妹吓得够呛。

e.en: Horror movies always {terrify} my little brother.
e.zh: 恐怖电影总是把我弟弟吓得不行。

e.en: Job interviews can {terrify} even confident candidates.
e.zh: 面试甚至能吓倒自信的应聘者。

terrifying.t: adj. 可怕的；令人恐惧的

e.en: That was the most {terrifying} roller coaster I've tried.
e.zh: 那是我玩过最吓人的过山车。

e.en: She had a {terrifying} dream about falling off a cliff.
e.zh: 她做了个从悬崖坠落的可怕梦境。

terrifyingly.t: adv. 可怕地；令人恐惧地

e.en: The deadline is {terrifyingly} close now.
e.zh: 截止日期已经近得让人心慌。

e.en: AI is becoming {terrifyingly} good at writing essays.
e.zh: 人工智能写文章的能力强得让人害怕。

e.en: The chef served a vegetable {terrine} as a starter.
e.zh: 主厨上了一道蔬菜冻派作为前菜。

e.en: She prepared a duck {terrine} for the dinner party.
e.zh: 她为晚宴准备了一道鸭肉冻派。

e.en: Honesty is a core {tenet} of our company culture.
e.zh: 诚信是我们公司文化的核心信条。

e.en: Equality is a fundamental {tenet} of democracy.
e.zh: 平等是民主的一项基本原则。

tenfold.t:
adj. 十倍的
adv. 十倍地

e.en: App downloads increased {tenfold} after the viral ad.
e.zh: 那则爆款广告之后,应用下载量增长了十倍。

e.en: Investing early can multiply your savings {tenfold}.
e.zh: 尽早投资可以让你的积蓄翻十倍。

e.en: The vet found a {tenia} parasite in the dog's stool.
e.zh: 兽医在狗的粪便中发现了绦虫寄生虫。

e.en: Anatomy class covered the {tenia} bands of the colon.
e.zh: 解剖课讲到了结肠上的结肠带结构。

e.en: He ordered a pint of {Tennents} at the Glasgow pub.
e.zh: 他在格拉斯哥的酒吧点了一品脱泰能特啤酒。

e.en: {Tennents} lager is a classic Scottish brand.
e.zh: 泰能特拉格啤酒是苏格兰的经典品牌。

tenner.t: n. 十英镑/十美元钞票

e.en: Can you lend me a {tenner} until payday?
e.zh: 能借我十块钱撑到发工资那天吗?

e.en: The taxi from the station cost about a {tenner}.
e.zh: 从车站打车过来大约要十英镑。

e.en: Nashville is the music capital of {Tennessee}.
e.zh: 纳什维尔是田纳西州的音乐之都。

e.en: We drove through the Smoky Mountains in eastern {Tennessee}.
e.zh: 我们驱车穿越了田纳西州东部的大烟山。

e.en: She plays {tennis} every Saturday at the local club.
e.zh: 她每周六都在当地俱乐部打网球。

e.en: The Wimbledon {tennis} final attracted millions of viewers.
e.zh: 温网决赛吸引了数百万观众观看。

tenon.t:
n. 榫头
v. 用榫连接

e.en: The carpenter cut a clean {tenon} on the chair leg.
e.zh: 木匠在椅腿上利落地开出了榫头。

e.en: A snug mortise-and-{tenon} joint needs no glue.
e.zh: 严丝合缝的榫卯接合根本不需要胶水。

e.en: The opera's lead {tenor} hit every high note flawlessly.
e.zh: 这部歌剧的男高音主角每个高音都唱得完美无瑕。

e.en: The general {tenor} of the meeting was optimistic.
e.zh: 会议的整体基调是乐观的。

e.en: The candy bar costs only {tenpence} at the corner shop.
e.zh: 街角小店里这块糖果只卖十便士。

e.en: He fished a {tenpence} coin out of his pocket.
e.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一枚十便士硬币。

e.en: We went {tenpin} bowling for my brother's birthday.
e.zh: 我们去打十瓶保龄球为我哥哥庆生。

e.en: The {tenpin} alley was packed on Friday night.
e.zh: 周五晚上的十瓶保龄球馆挤满了人。

e.en: The {tenrec} is a small mammal native to Madagascar.
e.zh: 马岛猬是产于马达加斯加的一种小型哺乳动物。

e.en: A spiny {tenrec} curled into a ball when startled.
e.zh: 那只多刺的马岛猬受惊时蜷成了一个球。

tense.t:
adj. 紧张的
n. 时态

e.en: The room felt {tense} as everyone awaited the verdict.
e.zh: 大家等待判决时,房间里气氛紧张。

e.en: Use the past {tense} when describing finished events.
e.zh: 描述已经结束的事件要用过去时。

e.en: She waited {tensely} for the test results to load.
e.zh: 她紧张地等待着测试结果加载出来。

e.en: He gripped the steering wheel {tensely} in heavy traffic.
e.zh: 在拥堵的车流中,他紧紧握着方向盘。

e.en: You could feel the {tenseness} in the courtroom air.
e.zh: 你能感受到法庭里空气中的紧张气氛。

e.en: A hot bath helped relieve the {tenseness} in her shoulders.
e.zh: 一次热水澡帮她缓解了肩膀的紧绷感。

tenses.t:
n. 时态（复数）
v. 使紧张

e.en: English {tenses} can be tricky for new learners.
e.zh: 英语时态对初学者来说挺有难度的。

e.en: He {tenses} up whenever the boss enters the room.
e.zh: 老板一进屋他就立刻紧绷起来。

e.en: Steel cables have remarkable {tensile} strength.
e.zh: 钢缆具有极高的抗拉强度。

e.en: Engineers tested the rope's {tensile} limit before use.
e.zh: 工程师在使用前测试了绳索的拉伸极限。

e.en: There was visible {tension} between the two coworkers.
e.zh: 那两位同事之间的紧张气氛显而易见。

e.en: Adjust the belt {tension} so it doesn't slip.
e.zh: 调节皮带的张力,以免打滑。

tensions.t: n. 紧张关系；张力（复数）

e.en: Trade {tensions} between the two countries are rising again.
e.zh: 两国之间的贸易紧张关系再次升温。

e.en: A long walk eased the {tensions} of a brutal workweek.
e.zh: 散一会儿步,缓解了一周高压工作的紧张。

e.en: PyTorch operates on multidimensional {tensor} arrays.
e.zh: PyTorch 操作的是多维张量数组。

e.en: The MRI showed inflammation in the {tensor} muscle.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示张肌出现了炎症。

e.en: We pitched our {tent} beside a quiet mountain stream.
e.zh: 我们在一条幽静的山间小溪旁搭起了帐篷。

e.en: The festival's main {tent} held over five thousand people.
e.zh: 音乐节的主帐篷可容纳五千多人。

e.en: An octopus uses each {tentacle} to taste its surroundings.
e.zh: 章鱼用每条触手感知周围的环境。

e.en: The company's {tentacle} reaches into every major industry.
e.zh: 这家公司的触角伸进了每一个主要行业。

e.en: A {tentacled} jellyfish drifted past the diver silently.
e.zh: 一只长着触手的水母悄无声息地从潜水员身旁飘过。

e.en: Sci-fi films love showing {tentacled} alien creatures.
e.zh: 科幻片里特别爱出现长触手的外星生物。

e.en: We have a {tentative} plan to meet on Saturday.
e.zh: 我们暂定周六见面。

e.en: She gave a {tentative} smile before answering the question.
e.zh: 她迟疑地笑了一下才回答问题。

e.en: The launch is {tentatively} scheduled for next Monday.
e.zh: 产品发布暂定在下周一。

e.en: He {tentatively} reached out to pet the nervous dog.
e.zh: 他试探性地伸手去摸那只紧张的狗。

e.en: There was a slight {tentativeness} in her voice on stage.
e.zh: 她在台上的声音里带着一丝犹豫。

e.en: His {tentativeness} cost the team a clear scoring chance.
e.zh: 他的迟疑让球队错失了一次明显的得分机会。

e.en: The refugees lived in a {tented} camp for months.
e.zh: 难民们在帐篷营地里住了好几个月。

e.en: He {tented} his fingers thoughtfully during the interview.
e.zh: 采访时他若有所思地把双手指尖搭成尖塔状。

tenterhooks.t: n. 焦虑 (on ~ 坐立不安)

e.en: I was on {tenterhooks} waiting for the exam results.
e.zh: 等考试成绩时我紧张得坐立不安。

e.en: Fans sat on {tenterhooks} during the final penalty shootout.
e.zh: 球迷们在最后的点球大战中提心吊胆。

tenth.t:
adj. 第十的
n. 十分之一

e.en: She finished in {tenth} place at the marathon.
e.zh: 她在马拉松比赛中名列第十。

e.en: Today is our {tenth} wedding anniversary.
e.zh: 今天是我们结婚十周年纪念日。

e.en: Round the answer to two {tenths} of a second.
e.zh: 将答案精确到十分之二秒。

e.en: He won the race by three {tenths} of a second.
e.zh: 他以零点三秒的优势赢得比赛。

e.en: They pitched their {tents} beside the lake.
e.zh: 他们在湖边搭起了帐篷。

e.en: The festival sells colorful {tents} for camping trips.
e.zh: 这个节日出售色彩鲜艳的露营帐篷。

e.en: The evidence linking him to the crime is {tenuous}.
e.zh: 将他与罪行联系起来的证据非常薄弱。

e.en: She has only a {tenuous} grasp of basic math.
e.zh: 她对基础数学只是一知半解。

e.en: The two events are only {tenuously} connected.
e.zh: 这两件事只有微弱的联系。

e.en: He clung {tenuously} to his dwindling savings.
e.zh: 他勉强守着所剩无几的积蓄。

e.en: The {tenuousness} of the evidence worried the jury.
e.zh: 证据的薄弱让陪审团感到担忧。

e.en: Investors sensed the {tenuousness} of the startup's claims.
e.zh: 投资者察觉到这家初创公司说法的站不住脚。

e.en: During her {tenure} as CEO, profits doubled.
e.zh: 在她担任 CEO 期间,利润翻了一番。

e.en: The professor finally received {tenure} last spring.
e.zh: 那位教授去年春天终于拿到了终身教职。

e.en: Only {tenured} faculty can vote on this issue.
e.zh: 只有终身教职的教员才能就此事投票。

e.en: She became a {tenured} professor at thirty-five.
e.zh: 她在三十五岁时成为终身教授。

e.en: Both presidents had short and turbulent {tenures}.
e.zh: 两位总统的任期都短暂而动荡。

e.en: Their {tenures} overlapped for about a year.
e.zh: 他们的任期重叠了大约一年。

tenurial.t: adj. 任期的；土地保有的

e.en: Land reform changed the {tenurial} system completely.
e.zh: 土地改革彻底改变了土地占有制度。

e.en: The dispute involved complex {tenurial} rights.
e.zh: 这场纠纷涉及复杂的土地保有权。

e.en: Modern corn was domesticated from wild {teosinte}.
e.zh: 现代玉米是由野生大刍草驯化而来。

e.en: Researchers study {teosinte} to understand maize evolution.
e.zh: 研究人员研究大刍草以了解玉米的演化。

e.en: The kids built a {tepee} in the backyard.
e.zh: 孩子们在后院搭了一个圆锥帐篷。

e.en: A painted {tepee} stood beside the river.
e.zh: 一座彩绘的圆锥帐篷立在河边。

e.en: The coffee had gone {tepid} by then.
e.zh: 那时咖啡已经变温了。

e.en: Her new album received a {tepid} response online.
e.zh: 她的新专辑在网上反响平平。

e.en: The audience clapped {tepidly} after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲结束后观众不冷不热地鼓了掌。

e.en: Critics responded {tepidly} to the sequel.
e.zh: 评论家对这部续集反应冷淡。

e.en: He ordered a shot of {tequila} at the bar.
e.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯龙舌兰酒。

e.en: This margarita uses premium aged {tequila}.
e.zh: 这杯玛格丽特用的是优质陈年龙舌兰。

e.en: The new SSD holds a full {terabyte} of data.
e.zh: 这块新固态硬盘能装下整整一 TB 数据。

e.en: My phone backup is almost a {terabyte} now.
e.zh: 我手机的备份现在快有一 TB 了。

e.en: Doctors warn pregnant women to avoid {teratogenic} drugs.
e.zh: 医生提醒孕妇要避免使用致畸药物。

e.en: The chemical was banned for its {teratogenic} effects.
e.zh: 这种化学品因致畸作用被禁用。

e.en: Dante wrote the entire poem in interlocking {tercet} stanzas.
e.zh: 但丁用环环相扣的三行诗节写完了整首诗。

e.en: Each {tercet} ends with a soft rhyme.
e.zh: 每节三行诗都以柔和的押韵结束。

testing.t:
n. 测试
v. 测试（test 的现在分词）

e.en: The team is {testing} the new app this week.
e.zh: 团队这周正在测试新应用。

e.en: Raising twins is a {testing} experience for any parent.
e.zh: 养育双胞胎对任何父母来说都是一种考验。

e.en: Multiple rounds of {testings} confirmed the drug's safety.
e.zh: 多轮测试确认了该药物的安全性。

e.en: The lab logged all {testings} in a shared spreadsheet.
e.zh: 实验室把所有检测都记录在共享表格里。

e.en: The biology textbook diagrammed each {testis} in detail.
e.zh: 那本生物教科书详细图解了每一个睾丸。

e.en: The vet examined the dog's left {testis} for swelling.
e.zh: 兽医检查了那只狗左侧睾丸是否肿胀。

e.en: His doctor said his {testosterone} levels were low.
e.zh: 医生说他的睾酮水平偏低。

e.en: The locker room reeked of sweat and {testosterone}.
e.zh: 更衣室里弥漫着汗味和荷尔蒙的气息。

tests.t:
n. 测试（复数）
v. 测试（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {tests} every release before pushing to production.
e.zh: 她在每次发布上线前都会进行测试。

e.en: The school holds final {tests} in early June.
e.zh: 学校在六月初举行期末考试。

e.en: Dad gets {testy} when he hasn't had coffee.
e.zh: 爸爸没喝咖啡时脾气会变得暴躁。

e.en: The reporter asked a {testy} follow-up question.
e.zh: 那名记者追问了一个尖刻的问题。

e.en: You should get a {tetanus} shot after stepping on a nail.
e.zh: 踩到钉子后你应该去打一针破伤风疫苗。

e.en: Doctors recommend a {tetanus} booster every ten years.
e.zh: 医生建议每十年加打一次破伤风疫苗。

e.en: He was {tetchy} all morning after sleeping badly.
e.zh: 他没睡好,一上午都很烦躁。

e.en: The crowd grew {tetchy} as the wait dragged on.
e.zh: 等待越拖越久,人群变得烦躁起来。

tether.t:
n. 拴绳；系绳
v. 拴住

e.en: The dog strained against its {tether} in the yard.
e.zh: 那只狗在院子里拼命扯着拴绳。

e.en: You can {tether} your laptop to the phone's hotspot.
e.zh: 你可以把笔记本接到手机热点上联网。

tethered.t:
adj. 被拴住的
v. 拴住（过去式）

e.en: The boat was {tethered} loosely to the dock.
e.zh: 那艘小船松松地系在码头上。

e.en: She felt {tethered} to her phone all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末她都觉得被手机拴住了。

e.en: Mum always brews a strong cup of {tetley} in the morning.
e.zh: 妈妈早上总会泡一杯浓浓的Tetley红茶。

e.en: He picked up a box of {tetley} teabags at the supermarket.
e.zh: 他在超市买了一盒Tetley茶包。

e.en: A neon {tetra} darted between the aquarium plants.
e.zh: 一条霓虹灯鱼在水草间穿梭游动。

e.en: She added six tiny {tetra} fish to the tank.
e.zh: 她往鱼缸里加了六条小灯鱼。

e.en: Carbon {tetrachloride} was once used as a cleaning solvent.
e.zh: 四氯化碳曾被用作清洁溶剂。

e.en: The lab banned {tetrachloride} due to its toxicity.
e.zh: 实验室因毒性而禁用了四氯化碳。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {tetracycline} for the stubborn infection.
e.zh: 医生为顽固感染开了四环素。

e.en: {Tetracycline} can stain children's developing teeth.
e.zh: 四环素会让儿童正在发育的牙齿染色。

e.en: Methane has a {tetrahedral} molecular shape.
e.zh: 甲烷分子呈四面体结构。

e.en: The artist built a {tetrahedral} sculpture out of glass.
e.zh: 那位艺术家用玻璃做了一个四面体雕塑。

e.en: A regular {tetrahedron} has four triangular faces.
e.zh: 正四面体有四个三角形的面。

e.en: He folded the paper into a tiny {tetrahedron}.
e.zh: 他把纸折成一个小小的四面体。

e.en: Frogs are an early example of a living {tetrapod}.
e.zh: 青蛙是现存四足动物的早期代表。

e.en: The fossil shows the first {tetrapod} to walk on land.
e.zh: 那块化石展示了最早登陆的四足动物。

e.en: I played {tetris} for hours on the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行中我玩了好几个小时俄罗斯方块。

e.en: Packing the trunk felt like a game of {tetris}.
e.zh: 装后备箱感觉就像在玩俄罗斯方块。

e.en: The novel describes a fierce {teuton} warrior of old.
e.zh: 小说描写了一位古代凶悍的条顿武士。

e.en: The ancient {teuton} migrated south through Europe.
e.zh: 古代条顿人向南迁徙穿越欧洲。

teutonic.t: adj. 条顿人的；日耳曼的

e.en: The car's design has a distinctly {teutonic} feel.
e.zh: 这辆车的设计带有明显的德式风格。

e.en: He admired her {teutonic} efficiency at work.
e.zh: 他欣赏她那种德式的工作效率。

tewkesbury.t: n. 图克斯伯里（英国地名）

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the abbey at {tewkesbury}.
e.zh: 我们周末去蒂克斯伯里游览了那座修道院。

e.en: The battle of {tewkesbury} ended a long civil war.
e.zh: 蒂克斯伯里战役结束了一场漫长的内战。

tex.t: n. 特克斯（纱线细度单位）

texaco.t: n. 德士古（美国石油公司）

e.en: We refueled at a {texaco} station off the highway.
e.zh: 我们在高速公路边的德士古加油站加了油。

e.en: He worked twenty years as a {texaco} engineer.
e.zh: 他在德士古公司当了二十年工程师。

texan.t:
n. 德克萨斯人
adj. 德克萨斯的

e.en: The new mayor is a proud {texan} from Austin.
e.zh: 新市长是来自奥斯汀的得州人,引以为豪。

e.en: His thick {texan} accent made everyone smile.
e.zh: 他浓重的得州口音让大家都笑了。

e.en: They moved to {texas} for the warmer winters.
e.zh: 他们搬到得克萨斯州是为了过暖和的冬天。

e.en: Houston is the largest city in {texas}.
e.zh: 休斯敦是得克萨斯州最大的城市。

text.t:
n. 文本；短信
v. 发短信

e.en: Send me a {text} when you arrive at the airport.
e.zh: 你到机场后给我发个短信。

e.en: The {text} of the article needs careful editing.
e.zh: 这篇文章的正文需要仔细编辑。

textbook.t:
n. 教科书
adj. 典型的

e.en: She left her math {textbook} on the bus.
e.zh: 她把数学课本落在公交车上了。

e.en: It was a {textbook} example of good leadership.
e.zh: 那是良好领导力的典型范例。

e.en: University {textbooks} have become absurdly expensive.
e.zh: 大学课本的价格已经贵得离谱。

e.en: Many students now download {textbooks} as PDFs.
e.zh: 现在很多学生直接下载PDF版课本。

e.en: I {texted} her the address an hour ago.
e.zh: 我一小时前就把地址短信发给她了。

e.en: He {texted} his mom every night from college.
e.zh: 他在大学时每晚都给妈妈发短信。

textile.t:
n. 纺织品
adj. 纺织的

e.en: The {textile} industry employs millions across Asia.
e.zh: 纺织业在亚洲雇佣了数百万人。

e.en: She bought a beautiful handwoven {textile} in Peru.
e.zh: 她在秘鲁买了一块漂亮的手工织物。

texting.t:
n. 发短信
v. 发短信（现在分词）

e.en: Stop {texting} while you're driving — it's dangerous.
e.zh: 开车时别再发短信了,太危险了。

e.en: They've been {texting} each other every day.
e.zh: 他们每天都在互发短信。

e.en: She received fifteen {texts} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会期间她收到了十五条短信。

e.en: Ancient {texts} reveal how people once lived.
e.zh: 古代典籍揭示了昔日人们的生活方式。

e.en: The scholar performed a careful {textual} analysis of the poem.
e.zh: 那位学者对这首诗做了细致的文本分析。

e.en: The two manuscripts show interesting {textual} differences.
e.zh: 这两份手稿在文本上有有趣的差异。

textualism.t: n. 文本主义（严格按字面解读）

e.en: The judge is famous for her strict {textualism}.
e.zh: 那位法官以严格的文本主义著称。

e.en: {Textualism} focuses on the plain meaning of the law.
e.zh: 文本主义关注法律字面的本意。

e.en: Her thesis explores the {textuality} of online conversations.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨网络对话的文本性。

e.en: Critics debate the {textuality} of digital media.
e.zh: 评论家们就数字媒体的文本性展开争论。

e.en: The oral story was eventually {textualized} in print.
e.zh: 那则口头故事最终被付印成文本。

e.en: Folk songs are often {textualized} by later collectors.
e.zh: 民歌常常被后来的采集者整理成文字。

e.en: The two versions are {textually} almost identical.
e.zh: 这两个版本在文本上几乎完全相同。

e.en: She analyzed the contract {textually}, word by word.
e.zh: 她逐字逐句地从文本上分析这份合同。

e.en: The painting has rich {textural} detail you can almost feel.
e.zh: 这幅画质感丰富,几乎触手可及。

e.en: The chef added nuts for {textural} contrast.
e.zh: 主厨加了坚果来制造口感上的对比。

e.en: The fabric has a soft, silky {texture} against the skin.
e.zh: 这种面料贴肤感柔软丝滑。

e.en: Designers often add visual {texture} to make websites feel less flat.
e.zh: 设计师常加入视觉纹理让网页看起来不那么单调。

textured.t: adj. 有纹理的；有质感的

e.en: She painted the wall with a {textured} finish.
e.zh: 她把墙面刷成了带纹理的效果。

e.en: The app uses {textured} backgrounds to mimic real paper.
e.zh: 这款应用用带纹理的背景来模仿真实纸张。

e.en: The fabric store offers dozens of soft {textures} to choose from.
e.zh: 这家布料店提供几十种柔软质地可供挑选。

e.en: Her paintings combine bold colors and rough {textures}.
e.zh: 她的画作融合了大胆的色彩和粗糙的质感。

tgwu.t: n. 英国运输与普通工人工会

e.en: The {TGWU} once represented millions of British transport workers.
e.zh: 运输与一般工人工会曾代表数百万英国运输工人。

e.en: My grandfather joined the {TGWU} when he started driving lorries.
e.zh: 我祖父开始开卡车时就加入了运输与一般工人工会。

thackeray.t: n. 萨克雷（英国作家姓氏）

e.en: {Thackeray} satirized Victorian society in his novel Vanity Fair.
e.zh: 萨克雷在小说《名利场》中讽刺了维多利亚时代社会。

e.en: We read a chapter of {Thackeray} in literature class today.
e.zh: 我们今天文学课上读了一章萨克雷的作品。

thai.t:
adj. 泰国的
n. 泰国人；泰语

e.en: I ordered a spicy {Thai} curry for lunch today.
e.zh: 我今天午餐点了一份辣的泰国咖喱。

e.en: She is learning to speak {Thai} before her trip to Bangkok.
e.zh: 她在去曼谷之前正在学说泰语。

e.en: We spent two weeks exploring the islands of {Thailand}.
e.zh: 我们花了两周时间游览泰国的各个岛屿。

e.en: {Thailand} is famous for its street food and temples.
e.zh: 泰国以街头美食和寺庙而闻名。

e.en: Many {Thais} celebrate the Songkran festival every April.
e.zh: 许多泰国人每年四月都会庆祝泼水节。

e.en: Younger {Thais} are increasingly fluent in English.
e.zh: 年轻一代的泰国人英语越来越流利。

e.en: The {thalamus} relays sensory signals to the cerebral cortex.
e.zh: 丘脑将感觉信号传递到大脑皮层。

e.en: Damage to the {thalamus} can disrupt sleep and attention.
e.zh: 丘脑受损可能会扰乱睡眠和注意力。

e.en: Children with {thalassemia} often need regular blood transfusions.
e.zh: 地中海贫血患儿通常需要定期输血。

e.en: A simple blood test can screen for {thalassemia} carriers.
e.zh: 一项简单的血液检测就能筛查地中海贫血携带者。

e.en: We shared a vegetarian {thali} at the Indian restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在那家印度餐厅一起吃了素食套餐。

e.en: Her favorite {thali} comes with rice, dal, and three curries.
e.zh: 她最爱的套餐里有米饭、扁豆汤和三种咖喱。

e.en: {Thalidomide} caused severe birth defects in the 1960s.
e.zh: 沙利度胺在二十世纪六十年代曾导致严重的出生缺陷。

e.en: Doctors now use {thalidomide} cautiously to treat certain cancers.
e.zh: 医生如今会谨慎地使用沙利度胺来治疗某些癌症。

e.en: {Thallium} is a highly toxic metal once used in rat poison.
e.zh: 铊是一种剧毒金属,曾被用作灭鼠药。

e.en: Cardiologists sometimes use {thallium} scans to assess blood flow.
e.zh: 心脏科医生有时会用铊扫描来评估血流情况。

e.en: We stopped for lunch in the small town of {Thame}.
e.zh: 我们在泰姆这个小镇停下来吃午饭。

e.en: The market in {Thame} runs every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 泰姆的集市每周二早上开市。

e.en: Tourists love taking boat trips along the {Thames} in London.
e.zh: 游客们很喜欢在伦敦泰晤士河上乘船游览。

e.en: The {Thames} flows through the heart of London.
e.zh: 泰晤士河流经伦敦市中心。

than.t:
conj. 比（用于比较）
prep. 比

e.en: This phone is much faster {than} my old one.
e.zh: 这部手机比我以前那部快得多。

e.en: She would rather walk {than} take a crowded bus.
e.zh: 她宁愿走路也不愿挤公交车。

thane.t: n. 领主（中世纪苏格兰贵族）

e.en: Macbeth was named {thane} of Cawdor by the king.
e.zh: 麦克白被国王封为考特爵爷。

e.en: The medieval {thane} held land in exchange for military service.
e.zh: 中世纪的爵爷以服兵役换取土地。

e.en: The Isle of {Thanet} sits at the eastern tip of Kent.
e.zh: 萨尼特岛位于肯特郡的最东端。

e.en: Margate is the largest town in {Thanet}.
e.zh: 马盖特是萨尼特地区最大的城镇。

thank.t:
v. 感谢
n. 谢意

e.en: I want to {thank} everyone for coming to the party.
e.zh: 我想感谢每一位来参加派对的朋友。

e.en: Please {thank} your mother for the lovely gift.
e.zh: 请代我谢谢你妈妈送的精美礼物。

e.en: She {thanked} the driver before stepping off the bus.
e.zh: 她下车前向司机道了谢。

e.en: He {thanked} his teammates for their support after the win.
e.zh: 赢球后他感谢了队友们的支持。

e.en: I'm {thankful} for my family's love and support.
e.zh: 我很感激家人的关爱和支持。

e.en: She felt {thankful} that the storm had passed safely.
e.zh: 她庆幸暴风雨平安地过去了。

e.en: {Thankfully}, no one was hurt in the minor accident.
e.zh: 谢天谢地,这场小事故里没有人受伤。

e.en: The flight was delayed, but {thankfully} we still made it.
e.zh: 航班延误了,不过幸好我们还是赶上了。

e.en: She wrote a letter expressing her deep {thankfulness}.
e.zh: 她写了一封信表达她深深的感激之情。

e.en: A sense of {thankfulness} filled the room after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲结束后,房间里弥漫着一种感恩的气氛。

e.en: He stood at the door, {thanking} guests as they left.
e.zh: 他站在门口,向离开的客人一一道谢。

e.en: She posted a video {thanking} her fans for their support.
e.zh: 她发了一段视频感谢粉丝们的支持。

e.en: Cleaning up after teenagers can feel like a {thankless} job.
e.zh: 给青少年收拾烂摊子感觉是件吃力不讨好的事。

e.en: Being a referee is often a {thankless} task.
e.zh: 当裁判常常是一份不讨好的差事。

thanks.t:
int. 谢谢
n. 感谢

e.en: {Thanks} for helping me move into my new apartment.
e.zh: 谢谢你帮我搬进新公寓。

e.en: We finished early {thanks} to everyone's hard work.
e.zh: 多亏大家的努力,我们提前完成了任务。

e.en: Our family gathers every {Thanksgiving} for a big turkey dinner.
e.zh: 我们一家人每年感恩节都会聚在一起吃丰盛的火鸡大餐。

e.en: Many stores offer huge discounts the day after {Thanksgiving}.
e.zh: 许多商店会在感恩节后一天推出大幅折扣。

e.en: She sent a handwritten {thankyou} note after the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试后寄出了一张手写的感谢卡。

e.en: He gave a quick {thankyou} hug before running off.
e.zh: 他匆匆给了个感谢的拥抱就跑开了。

that.t:
pron. 那个
conj. 引导从句

e.en: I can't believe {that} she finished the marathon.
e.zh: 我真不敢相信她跑完了那场马拉松。

e.en: Could you pass me {that} blue notebook on the shelf?
e.zh: 能把书架上那本蓝色的笔记本递给我吗?

thatch.t:
n. 茅草屋顶
v. 用茅草覆盖

e.en: The cottage roof is covered with golden {thatch}.
e.zh: 小屋的屋顶覆盖着金黄色的茅草。

e.en: Birds often build nests in the old {thatch}.
e.zh: 鸟儿常常在旧茅草顶里筑巢。

e.en: They stayed in a charming {thatched} cottage in Devon.
e.zh: 他们住在德文郡一座迷人的茅草屋顶小屋里。

e.en: The {thatched} roof needs repair every twenty years or so.
e.zh: 茅草屋顶大约每二十年就需要修缮一次。

thatcher.t: n. 撒切尔（人名）；盖茅草工人

e.en: Margaret {Thatcher} served as British prime minister for eleven years.
e.zh: 玛格丽特·撒切尔担任英国首相长达十一年。

e.en: The village {thatcher} repaired our cottage roof last summer.
e.zh: 村里的茅匠去年夏天修了我们小屋的屋顶。

e.en: {Thatcherism} reshaped Britain's economy through privatization and deregulation.
e.zh: 撒切尔主义通过私有化和放松管制重塑了英国经济。

e.en: Historians still debate the long-term effects of {Thatcherism}.
e.zh: 史学家们至今仍在讨论撒切尔主义的长期影响。

thatcherite.t:
n. 撒切尔主义者
adj. 撒切尔主义的

e.en: He remained a committed {Thatcherite} throughout his political career.
e.zh: 他在整个政治生涯中始终是坚定的撒切尔主义者。

e.en: The minister proposed a strongly {Thatcherite} approach to welfare reform.
e.zh: 这位部长提出了一种鲜明的撒切尔式福利改革思路。

thaw.t:
v. 解冻；融化
n. 解冻

e.en: Spring sunshine began to {thaw} the frozen lake.
e.zh: 春日的阳光开始融化结冰的湖面。

e.en: Relations between the two countries finally started to {thaw}.
e.zh: 两国关系终于开始解冻。

e.en: I {thawed} the chicken overnight in the refrigerator.
e.zh: 我把鸡肉放在冰箱里解冻了一整夜。

e.en: Their friendship {thawed} after a long, awkward silence.
