e.zh: 在长时间尴尬的沉默之后,他们的友谊渐渐回暖。

e.en: The snow is slowly {thawing} as temperatures rise.
e.zh: 随着气温上升,积雪正在慢慢融化。

e.en: Diplomats noted a {thawing} of tensions between the rivals.
e.zh: 外交官们注意到两个对手之间的紧张关系有所缓和。

e.en: We saw a brilliant musical at the local {theater} last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚在当地剧院看了一场精彩的音乐剧。

e.en: She studied {theater} at university and now directs plays.
e.zh: 她大学学的是戏剧,如今从事舞台剧导演工作。

e.en: As a regular {theatergoer}, she has seen hundreds of plays.
e.zh: 作为常去看戏的观众,她已经看过几百部戏剧。

e.en: Every {theatergoer} received a free program at the entrance.
e.zh: 每位入场观众都在门口领到一份免费节目单。

e.en: Many Broadway {theaters} reopened after a long closure.
e.zh: 许多百老汇剧院在长时间关闭后重新开放。

e.en: The new movie premieres in {theaters} this Friday.
e.zh: 这部新电影本周五在各大影院首映。

e.en: London's West End is famous for its world-class {theatre}.
e.zh: 伦敦西区以世界级的戏剧演出而闻名。

e.en: We booked tickets for a play at the National {Theatre}.
e.zh: 我们预订了在国家剧院上演的一出戏的票。

e.en: Every avid {theatregoer} should visit Stratford-upon-Avon at least once.
e.zh: 每位热情的戏迷都应该至少去一次埃文河畔斯特拉特福。

e.en: The average {theatregoer} pays about fifty pounds per ticket.
e.zh: 普通戏剧观众每张票大约要付五十英镑。

e.en: Several historic {theatres} line the streets of central London.
e.zh: 伦敦市中心的街道上分布着几座历史悠久的剧院。

e.en: Independent {theatres} often struggle to compete with multiplexes.
e.zh: 独立剧院往往难以与连锁影院竞争。

theatrical.t: adj. 戏剧的；夸张做作的

e.en: Her speech was full of {theatrical} gestures and dramatic pauses.
e.zh: 她的演讲充满了戏剧化的手势和富有张力的停顿。

e.en: The film will get a wide {theatrical} release next month.
e.zh: 这部电影下个月将在影院大规模上映。

e.en: The opera was praised for its bold {theatricality} and design.
e.zh: 这部歌剧因其大胆的戏剧表现力和舞美设计而受到称赞。

e.en: His speeches rely on emotion and pure {theatricality}.
e.zh: 他的演讲靠的是情感和纯粹的戏剧效果。

e.en: She {theatrically} threw her hands up in mock despair.
e.zh: 她戏剧性地举起双手,假装一脸绝望。

e.en: The film will be released {theatrically} before streaming.
e.zh: 这部电影将先在影院上映,然后再上线流媒体。

theatrics.t: n. 戏剧表演；做作的举动

e.en: The senator's {theatrics} during the debate annoyed many viewers.
e.zh: 那位参议员在辩论中的浮夸表演让许多观众感到反感。

e.en: Skip the {theatrics} and just tell us what happened.
e.zh: 别再装腔作势了,直接告诉我们发生了什么。

theban.t:
adj. 底比斯的
n. 底比斯人

e.en: The {Theban} army won a famous victory at Leuctra.
e.zh: 底比斯军队在留克特拉战役中取得了著名的胜利。

e.en: Sophocles set several plays in the ancient {Theban} kingdom.
e.zh: 索福克勒斯把好几部剧的故事都设定在古代底比斯王国。

thebes.t: n. 底比斯（古希腊/古埃及城市）

e.en: Ancient {Thebes} was once one of Egypt's grandest cities.
e.zh: 古代底比斯曾是埃及最宏伟的城市之一。

e.en: Tourists visit the temples of {Thebes} along the Nile.
e.zh: 游客们沿着尼罗河参观底比斯的神庙。

thee.t: pron. 你（古英语 thou 的宾格）

e.en: The old hymn says, "I will praise {thee}, O Lord."
e.zh: 那首古老的赞美诗写道:“主啊,我要赞美你。”

e.en: Shakespeare often has lovers say, "I love {thee} dearly."
e.zh: 莎士比亚笔下的恋人常说:“我深深地爱着你。”

e.en: Police arrested two men for the {theft} of a luxury car.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了两名盗窃豪车的男子。

e.en: Identity {theft} has become a major online concern.
e.zh: 身份盗用已成为网络上的一大隐患。

e.en: A series of bike {thefts} hit the campus last month.
e.zh: 上个月校园里发生了一连串自行车失窃案。

e.en: The store reported several {thefts} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 该店在假日季节报告了多起盗窃事件。

their.t: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的

e.en: The students forgot {their} textbooks at home.
e.zh: 学生们把课本忘在家里了。

e.en: My neighbors painted {their} house bright yellow.
e.zh: 我的邻居把他们的房子刷成了亮黄色。

e.en: This umbrella isn't mine — I think it's {theirs}.
e.zh: 这把伞不是我的,我想是他们的。

e.en: Our garden is small, but {theirs} is huge.
e.zh: 我们的花园很小,但他们的非常大。

e.en: The professor compared {theism} with various forms of atheism.
e.zh: 那位教授将有神论与各种形式的无神论作了比较。

e.en: Classical {theism} holds that God is both all-powerful and all-knowing.
e.zh: 古典有神论认为上帝既全能又全知。

e.en: As a {theist}, she believes a personal God created the universe.
e.zh: 作为一名有神论者,她相信宇宙是由一位人格神创造的。

e.en: The debate featured a {theist} arguing against a noted atheist.
e.zh: 这场辩论由一位有神论者与一位知名无神论者展开。

e.en: Most major religions hold {theistic} views about a creator.
e.zh: 大多数主要宗教都持有关于造物主的有神论观点。

e.en: His philosophy class explored {theistic} arguments for God's existence.
e.zh: 他的哲学课探讨了关于上帝存在的有神论论证。

them.t: pron. 他们；她们；它们（宾格）

e.en: I baked cookies and gave {them} to my coworkers.
e.zh: 我烤了饼干,把它们送给了同事。

e.en: If you see the kids, please tell {them} to come home.
e.zh: 如果你看到孩子们,请让他们回家。

thematic.t: adj. 主题的；按主题分类的

e.en: The exhibition is organized around three {thematic} sections.
e.zh: 展览围绕三个主题板块进行布置。

e.en: The novel uses water as a {thematic} symbol.
e.zh: 这部小说用水作为一个主题象征。

e.en: The two films are very different but {thematically} linked.
e.zh: 这两部电影差别很大,但在主题上是相连的。

e.en: The playlist is arranged {thematically} rather than by artist.
e.zh: 这个播放列表是按主题而非按歌手排列的。

e.en: Her essay focused on the {thematics} of loss in modern poetry.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于现代诗歌中关于失落的主题学。

e.en: The course explores the {thematics} of identity in postcolonial novels.
e.zh: 该课程探讨后殖民小说中身份认同的主题学。

theme.t:
n. 主题；题材
n. 主题样式（界面皮肤）

e.en: The {theme} of this year's conference is sustainability.
e.zh: 今年大会的主题是可持续发展。

e.en: You can switch to dark {theme} in the app settings.
e.zh: 你可以在应用设置里切换到深色主题。

e.en: They threw a 1980s-{themed} birthday party.
e.zh: 他们办了一场以八十年代为主题的生日派对。

e.en: The café offers a Halloween-{themed} menu every October.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆每年十月都推出万圣节主题菜单。

themes.t: n. 主题（复数）；主题样式

e.en: The novel explores {themes} of love and betrayal.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了爱与背叛的主题。

e.en: The app comes with several color {themes} to choose from.
e.zh: 这款应用提供多种颜色主题供选择。

themself.t: pron. 他们自己（单数中性反身）

e.en: Each user can update {themself} in the new settings panel.
e.zh: 每位用户都可以在新的设置面板中更新自己。

e.en: Anyone who hurts {themself} should see a doctor immediately.
e.zh: 任何弄伤自己的人都应立即就医。

themselves.t: pron. 他们自己；她们自己

e.en: The kids made breakfast all by {themselves}.
e.zh: 孩子们完全自己做了早餐。

e.en: Engineers blame {themselves} when systems go down in production.
e.zh: 系统在生产环境出问题时,工程师们会自责。

then.t:
adv. 那时；然后
adv. 那么；既然如此

e.en: Add the flour, {then} mix until smooth.
e.zh: 加入面粉,然后搅拌至顺滑。

e.en: Back {then}, smartphones didn't even exist.
e.zh: 那时候智能手机还不存在呢。

e.en: We flew to Tokyo and {thence} traveled by train to Kyoto.
e.zh: 我们飞到东京,然后从那里乘火车前往京都。

e.en: The river flows south and {thence} into the sea.
e.zh: 河水向南流,再由那里汇入大海。

e.en: She signed the contract, and {thenceforth} the company was hers.
e.zh: 她签了合同,从那时起公司就属于她了。

e.en: He moved to Paris in 1920 and {thenceforth} wrote in French.
e.zh: 他于1920年移居巴黎,从此用法语写作。

e.en: The treaty was signed and {thenceforward} the borders remained peaceful.
e.zh: 条约签订后,从那时起边境一直保持和平。

e.en: She graduated in May and {thenceforward} pursued a career in law.
e.zh: 她五月毕业,自此投身于法律事业。

e.en: Medieval art was largely {theocentric}, focusing on God and saints.
e.zh: 中世纪艺术大体上以神为中心,重点描绘上帝与圣徒。

e.en: His worldview is deeply {theocentric}, placing God at the center of everything.
e.zh: 他的世界观高度以神为中心,把上帝置于万物核心。

theocracy.t: n. 神权政治；神权国家

e.en: Iran is often described as a modern {theocracy}.
e.zh: 伊朗常被描述为一个现代神权国家。

e.en: The country gradually transformed from a {theocracy} into a secular state.
e.zh: 这个国家逐渐从神权政体转变为世俗国家。

e.en: The hardline {theocrat} opposed any reforms to religious law.
e.zh: 那位强硬的神权统治者反对对宗教法做任何改革。

e.en: Critics accused the leader of behaving like a {theocrat}.
e.zh: 批评者指责这位领导人行事像个神权统治者。

e.en: The new constitution gave the country a {theocratic} character.
e.zh: 新宪法赋予了这个国家神权政治的色彩。

e.en: Reformers struggle against {theocratic} rule in the region.
e.zh: 该地区的改革者正与神权统治作斗争。

theodicy.t: n. 神义论（解释神与恶的哲学）

e.en: His book offers a modern {theodicy} for the problem of evil.
e.zh: 他的书针对恶的问题提出了一种现代神义论。

e.en: Philosophers have long debated questions of {theodicy}.
e.zh: 哲学家们长期争论神义论的相关问题。

e.en: The surveyor set up the {theodolite} on a sturdy tripod.
e.zh: 测量员把经纬仪架在了一个稳固的三脚架上。

e.en: A modern {theodolite} measures angles with extreme precision.
e.zh: 现代经纬仪能极其精确地测量角度。

e.en: The {theologian} gave a lecture on suffering and faith.
e.zh: 那位神学家做了一场关于苦难与信仰的讲座。

e.en: She became a respected {theologian} after years of study.
e.zh: 经过多年研究,她成为一位受人尊敬的神学家。

e.en: The two churches have deep {theological} differences.
e.zh: 这两个教会在神学上存在深层分歧。

e.en: He's writing a {theological} essay on the nature of grace.
e.zh: 他正在写一篇关于恩典本质的神学论文。

e.en: The sermon was {theologically} rich but easy to follow.
e.zh: 这篇讲道在神学上很丰富,却又容易理解。

e.en: The two denominations differ {theologically} on several key points.
e.zh: 两个教派在几个关键点上有神学分歧。

e.en: The seminary studies a wide range of Christian {theologies}.
e.zh: 这所神学院研究各种各样的基督教神学。

e.en: Different liberation {theologies} arose across Latin America.
e.zh: 拉丁美洲各地兴起了不同流派的解放神学。

e.en: She studied {theology} at a small Catholic university.
e.zh: 她在一所小型天主教大学研习神学。

e.en: His {theology} emphasizes mercy over judgment.
e.zh: 他的神学思想强调仁慈胜过审判。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {theophylline} to ease her asthma symptoms.
e.zh: 医生开了茶碱来缓解她的哮喘症状。

e.en: {Theophylline} is found naturally in small amounts in tea.
e.zh: 茶碱在茶叶中天然存在,含量很少。

e.en: Pythagoras's {theorem} relates the sides of a right triangle.
e.zh: 毕达哥拉斯定理描述了直角三角形各边之间的关系。

e.en: It took years to prove the new mathematical {theorem}.
e.zh: 证明这条新的数学定理花了好几年时间。

e.en: The paper offers a {theoretic} framework for studying online behavior.
e.zh: 这篇论文提供了一个研究网络行为的理论框架。

e.en: His interest is more {theoretic} than practical.
e.zh: 他的兴趣更偏理论,而非实践。

theoretical.t: adj. 理论的；纯理论上的

e.en: In {theoretical} physics, ideas often run far ahead of experiments.
e.zh: 在理论物理中,想法往往远远领先于实验。

e.en: The risk is largely {theoretical} and rarely happens in practice.
e.zh: 这种风险基本上是理论上的,实际中很少发生。

e.en: {Theoretically}, the bridge can hold a hundred trucks at once.
e.zh: 理论上,这座桥可以同时承载一百辆卡车。

e.en: The plan works {theoretically}, but the budget is unrealistic.
e.zh: 这个方案在理论上可行,但预算不切实际。

e.en: She's a brilliant {theoretician} who rarely runs experiments herself.
e.zh: 她是一位出色的理论家,自己很少做实验。

e.en: The lab needed both engineers and a sharp {theoretician}.
e.zh: 实验室既需要工程师,也需要一位敏锐的理论家。

e.en: Scientists proposed several {theories} to explain the strange signal.
e.zh: 科学家们提出了几种理论来解释这个奇怪的信号。

e.en: Online forums are full of wild conspiracy {theories}.
e.zh: 网络论坛上充斥着各种离奇的阴谋论。

theorise.t: v. 建立理论；推论（英式拼写）

e.en: Researchers {theorise} that climate shifts caused the migrations.
e.zh: 研究人员推测气候变化导致了这些迁徙。

e.en: It's easy to {theorise}, but harder to test the idea.
e.zh: 提出理论很容易,但要验证它就难得多了。

theorising.t: v. 建立理论（进行时，英式）

e.en: Stop {theorising} and start collecting actual data.
e.zh: 别再空谈理论了,开始收集实际数据吧。

e.en: Her {theorising} about consumer behavior reshaped the field.
e.zh: 她对消费者行为的理论建构重塑了这一领域。

e.en: The political {theorist} wrote a controversial book on democracy.
e.zh: 那位政治理论家写了一本关于民主的争议性著作。

e.en: As a film {theorist}, he analyzes how camera angles shape meaning.
e.zh: 作为电影理论家,他分析镜头角度如何塑造意义。

e.en: Game {theorists} study how rational players make decisions.
e.zh: 博弈论学者研究理性参与者如何做出决策。

e.en: Many {theorists} disagree about the origins of consciousness.
e.zh: 许多理论家在意识起源问题上意见不一。

e.en: Her {theorization} of digital labor influenced a generation of scholars.
e.zh: 她对数字劳动的理论化影响了一代学者。

e.en: The book offers a fresh {theorization} of social media's impact.
e.zh: 这本书对社交媒体的影响提出了全新的理论建构。

e.en: Astronomers {theorize} that a giant planet may lurk beyond Neptune.
e.zh: 天文学家推测海王星之外可能潜藏着一颗巨型行星。

e.en: It's tempting to {theorize} without enough evidence.
e.zh: 在证据不足时就急于提出理论是很诱人的。

e.en: Einstein {theorized} that gravity bends light.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦提出了引力会使光线弯曲的理论。

e.en: Detectives {theorized} that the suspect had inside help.
e.zh: 侦探们推测嫌疑人有内部接应。

e.en: Her {theorizing} about urban poverty drew international attention.
e.zh: 她关于城市贫困的理论建构引起了国际关注。

e.en: Less {theorizing}, more testing — that's our motto this quarter.
e.zh: 少谈理论,多做测试——这是我们这个季度的口号。

e.en: I use a {thesaurus} when I need a stronger verb.
e.zh: 我需要更有力的动词时会查同义词词典。

e.en: Most writing apps include a built-in {thesaurus} feature.
e.zh: 大多数写作软件都内置了同义词词典功能。

these.t:
pron. 这些
adj. 这些的

e.en: {These} headphones sound much better than the older model.
e.zh: 这副耳机的音质比旧款好得多。

e.en: Remote work has become normal for many people {these} days.
e.zh: 如今对许多人来说远程办公已成常态。

e.en: The library archives all master's {theses} from the past decade.
e.zh: 图书馆存档了过去十年的所有硕士论文。

e.en: He defended one of the more controversial {theses} at the conference.
e.zh: 他在会议上为一个较具争议的论点进行了辩护。

theseus.t: n. 忒修斯（希腊神话英雄）

e.en: The myth of {Theseus} and the Minotaur fascinates children worldwide.
e.zh: 忒修斯与牛头怪的神话让全世界的孩子着迷。

e.en: {Theseus} navigated the labyrinth using a ball of thread.
e.zh: 忒修斯靠一团线走出了迷宫。

e.en: She defended her doctoral {thesis} in front of the committee.
e.zh: 她在委员会面前为博士论文进行答辩。

e.en: His central {thesis} is that climate policy must be local.
e.zh: 他的核心论点是气候政策必须本地化。

thespian.t:
adj. 戏剧的
n. 演员

e.en: She's a gifted {thespian} who shines on every stage.
e.zh: 她是一位天赋极高的演员,在每个舞台上都光彩夺目。

e.en: The school's {thespian} club is staging a Shakespeare play.
e.zh: 学校的戏剧社正在排演一出莎士比亚戏剧。

e.en: We toured ancient ruins across {Thessaly} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们游览了色萨利各地的古迹。

e.en: {Thessaly} is famous for its vast central plain.
e.zh: 色萨利以其广阔的中央平原而闻名。

e.en: The Greek letter {theta} often represents an angle.
e.zh: 希腊字母θ通常用来表示角度。

e.en: He joined the Phi {Theta} Kappa honor society.
e.zh: 他加入了Phi Theta Kappa荣誉学会。

e.en: We stopped in {Thetford} on the way to Norwich.
e.zh: 我们在去诺里奇的路上经过塞特福德。

e.en: {Thetford} Forest is a popular spot for cycling.
e.zh: 塞特福德森林是骑行爱好者的热门去处。

e.en: {They} are launching the new app next week.
e.zh: 他们下周将推出这款新应用。

e.en: Ask whoever called and see what {they} want.
e.zh: 问问打电话的人,看看他们想要什么。

thiamin.t: n. 硫胺素（维生素 B1）

e.en: Whole grains are a good source of {thiamin}.
e.zh: 全谷物是硫胺素的良好来源。

e.en: A {thiamin} deficiency can cause serious nerve problems.
e.zh: 硫胺素缺乏可能导致严重的神经问题。

thiamine.t: n. 硫胺素（维生素 B1）

e.en: Doctors prescribed {thiamine} supplements for the malnourished patient.
e.zh: 医生给那位营养不良的病人开了硫胺素补充剂。

e.en: Pork and legumes contain plenty of {thiamine}.
e.zh: 猪肉和豆类含有大量硫胺素。

e.en: She wore a {thick} sweater to the cabin.
e.zh: 她穿了一件厚毛衣去小木屋。

e.en: The fog grew so {thick} we couldn't see ahead.
e.zh: 雾变得很浓,我们看不清前方。

e.en: Stir constantly to {thicken} the sauce evenly.
e.zh: 不停搅拌让酱汁均匀变稠。

e.en: The plot starts to {thicken} in chapter three.
e.zh: 剧情从第三章开始变得复杂起来。

e.en: The soup {thickened} after simmering for an hour.
e.zh: 汤炖了一个小时后变稠了。

e.en: Years of training had {thickened} his shoulders considerably.
e.zh: 多年的训练让他的肩膀变得宽厚了许多。

e.en: Cornstarch is a common {thickener} in Chinese cooking.
e.zh: 玉米淀粉是中餐里常用的增稠剂。

e.en: Add a little {thickener} to make the gravy richer.
e.zh: 加点增稠剂让肉汁更浓郁。

thickening.t:
n. 增稠；加厚层
v. 变厚

e.en: The fog was {thickening} as night fell.
e.zh: 夜幕降临时,雾越来越浓。

e.en: He noticed a worrying {thickening} of the artery wall.
e.zh: 他注意到动脉壁出现了令人担忧的增厚。

e.en: The rabbit darted into a dense {thicket}.
e.zh: 兔子窜进了密密的灌木丛。

e.en: They hid in a {thicket} until the storm passed.
e.zh: 他们躲在灌木丛里直到风暴过去。

e.en: Wild berries grew in the {thickets} along the trail.
e.zh: 小路两旁的灌木丛里长着野莓。

e.en: Hunters worked their way through the {thickets} carefully.
e.zh: 猎人小心地穿过那片灌木丛。

e.en: Snow fell {thickly} on the rooftops overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间雪厚厚地落在屋顶上。

e.en: He spread butter {thickly} on the toast.
e.zh: 他把黄油厚厚地涂在吐司上。

e.en: Measure the {thickness} of the board before cutting.
e.zh: 切割之前先量一下木板的厚度。

e.en: This jacket has just the right {thickness} for autumn.
e.zh: 这件外套的厚度正适合秋天穿。

e.en: The store sells paper in several different {thicknesses}.
e.zh: 这家店出售几种不同厚度的纸张。

e.en: Try various {thicknesses} of yarn for the sweater.
e.zh: 试试用几种不同粗细的毛线织这件毛衣。

e.en: A {thickset} man stood guarding the entrance.
e.zh: 一个身材壮实的男人守在入口处。

e.en: The wrestler had a {thickset} build and steady stance.
e.zh: 那位摔跤手身材敦实,站得很稳。

e.en: Police caught the {thief} on store security cameras.
e.zh: 警方通过店内监控抓到了那个小偷。

e.en: Time is a {thief} that steals our youth.
e.zh: 时间是一个偷走我们青春的窃贼。

e.en: Hungry crows often {thieve} food from picnic tables.
e.zh: 饥饿的乌鸦常从野餐桌上偷走食物。

e.en: The street kids learned to {thieve} just to survive.
e.zh: 那些流浪儿为了活命学会了偷东西。

e.en: Online {thievery} of personal data is rising sharply.
e.zh: 在网上盗取个人数据的行为正急剧增加。

e.en: The village suffered constant {thievery} during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间,这个村子不断遭受偷盗。

e.en: {Thieves} broke into three apartments last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有小偷闯入了三户公寓。

e.en: Smart locks make life harder for would-be {thieves}.
e.zh: 智能门锁让企图行窃的小偷更难得手。

thieving.t:
n. 偷窃
adj. 惯偷的

e.en: He scolded the {thieving} raccoon raiding his trash.
e.zh: 他骂了那只翻他垃圾桶的偷东西的浣熊。

e.en: She was fired for {thieving} from the cash register.
e.zh: 她因偷收银机里的钱而被解雇。

e.en: He pulled a muscle in his right {thigh}.
e.zh: 他右大腿拉伤了一块肌肉。

e.en: Chicken {thigh} stays juicier than breast when grilled.
e.zh: 烤的时候,鸡腿肉比鸡胸肉更多汁。

e.en: The femur is the longest {thighbone} in the body.
e.zh: 股骨是人体最长的大腿骨。

e.en: She fractured her {thighbone} in the skiing accident.
e.zh: 她在滑雪事故中摔断了大腿骨。

e.en: Cycling daily really tones your {thighs}.
e.zh: 每天骑车能很好地锻炼大腿肌肉。

e.en: Marinate the chicken {thighs} for at least an hour.
e.zh: 鸡腿肉至少腌一个小时。

e.en: Grandma always wore a silver {thimble} while sewing.
e.zh: 奶奶缝衣服时总戴着一枚银顶针。

e.en: He poured a {thimble} of whiskey into the glass.
e.zh: 他往杯子里倒了一丁点儿威士忌。

e.en: She added just a {thimbleful} of vanilla extract.
e.zh: 她只加了一丁点儿香草精。

e.en: He had only a {thimbleful} of patience left.
e.zh: 他剩下的耐心已寥寥无几。

e.en: Most modern vaccines no longer contain {thimerosal}.
e.zh: 现在大多数疫苗已不再含硫柳汞。

e.en: Researchers studied whether {thimerosal} caused any health risks.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了硫柳汞是否会造成健康风险。

e.en: The ice on the pond is dangerously {thin}.
e.zh: 池塘上的冰薄得很危险。

e.en: He has grown noticeably {thin} since the diet.
e.zh: 节食以来他明显瘦了。

e.en: "To {thine} own self be true," Polonius advised.
e.zh: 波洛涅斯劝告道:“要忠于你自己。”

e.en: The old hymn ends with "for {thine} is the kingdom."
e.zh: 这首老圣诗以“因为国度是你的”作结。

e.en: The best {thing} about Friday is leaving early.
e.zh: 周五最棒的事情就是能早点下班。

e.en: There's one {thing} I forgot to mention earlier.
e.zh: 我之前忘了提一件事。

thingamajig.t: n. 那玩意儿（忘名时的称呼）

e.en: Hand me that little {thingamajig} on the shelf.
e.zh: 把架子上那个小玩意儿递给我。

e.en: What's this {thingamajig} for, anyway?
e.zh: 这玩意儿到底是干什么用的?

e.en: Pack only the {things} you really need.
e.zh: 只带你真正需要的东西。

e.en: {Things} have changed a lot since we last met.
e.zh: 自从我们上次见面后,情况变化很大。

e.en: Press the little {thingy} on the side of the remote.
e.zh: 按一下遥控器侧面那个小玩意儿。

e.en: What's that flashing {thingy} on your dashboard?
e.zh: 你仪表盘上闪的那个小玩意儿是什么?

e.en: I {think} we should leave before the traffic builds up.
e.zh: 我觉得我们该在堵车前出发。

e.en: Take a moment to {think} before answering.
e.zh: 回答之前先花点时间想一想。

e.en: It's barely {thinkable} that prices could fall further.
e.zh: 价格还能再跌简直令人难以想象。

e.en: Every {thinkable} option has already been considered.
e.zh: 凡是能想到的方案都已经考虑过了。

e.en: She's a deep {thinker} who questions every assumption.
e.zh: 她是个善于深思、敢于质疑一切假设的思想者。

e.en: Confucius remains one of history's most influential {thinker}s.
e.zh: 孔子至今仍是历史上最具影响力的思想家之一。

e.en: The conference brought together leading {thinkers} in AI ethics.
e.zh: 这场大会汇集了人工智能伦理领域的顶尖思想家。

e.en: Great {thinkers} often challenge what others take for granted.
e.zh: 伟大的思想家常常质疑别人视为理所当然的事。

thinking.t:
n. 思考；想法
adj. 有思想的

e.en: Her {thinking} on climate policy has shifted recently.
e.zh: 她最近对气候政策的看法有了变化。

e.en: I was {thinking} about ordering pizza tonight.
e.zh: 我在想今晚要不要叫披萨。

e.en: His various {thinkings} on ethics fill several volumes.
e.zh: 他关于伦理的各种思考写满了好几卷书。

e.en: Her early {thinkings} laid the groundwork for the theory.
e.zh: 她早期的思考为该理论奠定了基础。

e.en: Darwin's {theory} of evolution transformed modern biology.
e.zh: 达尔文的进化论彻底改变了现代生物学。

e.en: In {theory}, the new app should sync across all devices.
e.zh: 理论上,这款新应用应该能在所有设备间同步。

e.en: The medieval poem opens with the line "and {ther} was a knight."
e.zh: 那首中世纪诗歌以"那里有一位骑士"这一句开篇。

e.en: Old manuscripts often spell "there" as {ther}.
e.zh: 古老的手稿常把"there"拼作"ther"。

e.en: Gardening can be surprisingly {therapeutic} after a stressful week.
e.zh: 忙了一周之后,园艺竟然出奇地有疗愈效果。

e.en: Doctors are exploring the {therapeutic} uses of psychedelics.
e.zh: 医生们正在探索迷幻药物的治疗用途。

e.en: Music can be used {therapeutically} to reduce anxiety.
e.zh: 音乐可作为治疗手段用于缓解焦虑。

e.en: Gardening affects many people {therapeutically} after a long week.
e.zh: 对许多人来说,园艺在忙碌一周后有疗愈作用。

e.en: The company specializes in cancer {therapeutics} and gene editing.
e.zh: 该公司专注于癌症治疗药物和基因编辑。

e.en: New {therapeutics} for Alzheimer's are entering clinical trials.
e.zh: 治疗阿尔茨海默病的新疗法正进入临床试验。

e.en: Doctors are testing several {therapies} for long COVID symptoms.
e.zh: 医生正在测试多种针对长新冠症状的疗法。

e.en: Modern cancer {therapies} are far less invasive than before.
e.zh: 现代癌症疗法比以前的创伤性小得多。

e.en: My {therapist} suggested I keep a daily mood journal.
e.zh: 我的心理治疗师建议我每天写情绪日记。

e.en: The physical {therapist} helped him recover after knee surgery.
e.zh: 理疗师帮他在膝盖手术后康复。

e.en: Many {therapists} now offer online sessions over video.
e.zh: 许多治疗师如今通过视频提供线上咨询。

e.en: Speech {therapists} work closely with children who stutter.
e.zh: 语言治疗师会和口吃儿童密切合作。

e.en: She started weekly {therapy} to deal with work stress.
e.zh: 她开始每周做心理咨询来缓解工作压力。

e.en: Gene {therapy} offers hope for several rare diseases.
e.zh: 基因疗法为多种罕见病带来了希望。

e.en: Put your bag over {there} by the door.
e.zh: 把你的包放在那边门口。

e.en: {There} are many reasons people switch to remote work.
e.zh: 人们转向远程工作的原因有很多。

e.en: The meeting starts at three or {thereabouts}.
e.zh: 会议大概三点左右开始。

e.en: He earns sixty thousand a year, or {thereabouts}.
e.zh: 他一年大约赚六万,差不多。

e.en: She graduated in 2010 and worked abroad {thereafter}.
e.zh: 她2010年毕业,此后便在国外工作。

e.en: The free trial lasts a month; {thereafter}, you pay monthly.
e.zh: 免费试用一个月,之后按月付费。

e.en: The update fixes the leak, {thereby} improving battery life.
e.zh: 该更新修复了漏洞,从而延长了电池续航。

e.en: He missed the deadline, {thereby} losing his chance to apply.
e.zh: 他错过了截止日期,因此失去了申请机会。

e.en: The contract lists the goods and the price {therefor}.
e.zh: 合同中列出了商品及其相应的价格。

e.en: She filed a claim and received compensation {therefor}.
e.zh: 她提出索赔并因此获得了赔偿。

e.en: The roads are icy; drive carefully, {therefore}.
e.zh: 路面结冰,因此请小心驾驶。

e.en: He missed the train and was {therefore} late for work.
e.zh: 他错过了火车,因此上班迟到了。

e.en: The committee read the report and drew conclusions {therefrom}.
e.zh: 委员会阅读了报告并从中得出了结论。

e.en: She inherited the house and the income {therefrom}.
e.zh: 她继承了那栋房子以及由此产生的收入。

e.en: Read the contract and the clauses {therein} carefully.
e.zh: 请仔细阅读合同及其中的条款。

e.en: The book is short, but the wisdom {therein} runs deep.
e.zh: 这本书很短,但其中蕴含的智慧很深。

e.en: You may keep the device or any part {thereof}.
e.zh: 你可以保留该设备或其任何部分。

e.en: He spoke of freedom and the meaning {thereof}.
e.zh: 他谈到了自由及其含义。

e.en: Sign the form and write the date {thereon}.
e.zh: 在表格上签字并在其上写明日期。

e.en: The land and any buildings {thereon} are included in the sale.
e.zh: 该土地及其上的任何建筑物都包含在出售范围内。

e.en: Please review the agreement and any amendments {thereto}.
e.zh: 请审阅本协议及其任何修订。

e.en: She attached the receipts {thereto} before submitting the report.
e.zh: 她在提交报告前将收据附于其上。

e.en: The discovery overturned a theory {theretofore} considered correct.
e.zh: 这一发现推翻了此前一直被视为正确的理论。

e.en: She had {theretofore} never spoken in public.
e.zh: 在那之前,她从未公开演讲过。

e.en: Read the policy and your rights {thereunder} carefully.
e.zh: 请仔细阅读该政策及你据此享有的权利。

e.en: The treaty and the obligations {thereunder} remain in force.
e.zh: 该条约及据此产生的义务仍然有效。

e.en: He finished his speech and {thereupon} left the stage.
e.zh: 他讲完话,随即离开了舞台。

e.en: The alarm rang, and {thereupon} everyone evacuated the building.
e.zh: 警报响起,人们随即全部撤离了大楼。

e.en: She signed the letter and enclosed a check {therewith}.
e.zh: 她在信上签字,并随信附上了一张支票。

e.en: The kit comes with tools and instructions {therewith}.
e.zh: 这套工具包附带工具及随附的说明书。

thermal.t:
adj. 热的；保暖的
n. 上升暖气流

e.en: He wore a {thermal} jacket for the ski trip.
e.zh: 他穿了一件保暖夹克去滑雪。

e.en: The chip uses a copper plate for {thermal} dissipation.
e.zh: 该芯片使用铜板进行散热。

e.en: The case is {thermally} efficient and stays cool under load.
e.zh: 这款机箱散热效率高,负载下仍保持凉爽。

e.en: Wool insulates {thermally} better than cotton in cold weather.
e.zh: 在寒冷天气下,羊毛的保暖性比棉更好。

thermals.t: n. 保暖内衣；上升气流

e.en: Pack your {thermals} for the camping trip in December.
e.zh: 十二月去露营记得带保暖内衣。

e.en: Eagles glide effortlessly on rising {thermals} above the canyon.
e.zh: 老鹰在峡谷上方的上升热气流中轻松翱翔。

e.en: A {thermistor} on the board monitors the CPU temperature.
e.zh: 主板上的热敏电阻用于监测CPU温度。

e.en: Engineers added a {thermistor} to detect overheating early.
e.zh: 工程师加装了热敏电阻,以便尽早检测过热。

e.en: Divers felt the cold below the {thermocline} layer.
e.zh: 潜水员在温跃层之下感受到了寒冷。

e.en: Fish often gather just above the {thermocline} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天鱼群常聚集在温跃层上方。

e.en: A {thermocouple} measures the oven temperature very accurately.
e.zh: 热电偶可以非常精确地测量烤箱温度。

e.en: The technician replaced the faulty {thermocouple} in the furnace.
e.zh: 技术员更换了炉子里损坏的热电偶。

e.en: Engineers study the {thermodynamic} efficiency of new engines.
e.zh: 工程师研究新型发动机的热力学效率。

e.en: The system reached {thermodynamic} equilibrium after several hours.
e.zh: 几小时后,该系统达到了热力学平衡。

e.en: The second law of {thermodynamics} states that entropy always increases.
e.zh: 热力学第二定律指出熵始终在增加。

e.en: She failed her {thermodynamics} exam and had to retake it.
e.zh: 她热力学考试没通过,不得不重考。

e.en: The cooler uses a {thermoelectric} chip instead of a compressor.
e.zh: 这款冷却器用半导体制冷片代替了压缩机。

e.en: Researchers improved the efficiency of {thermoelectric} generators.
e.zh: 研究人员提升了热电发电机的效率。

e.en: A {thermographic} camera revealed heat leaks around the windows.
e.zh: 热成像相机显示出窗户周围的热泄漏。

e.en: Doctors used {thermographic} imaging to detect inflammation early.
e.zh: 医生用热成像技术早期发现炎症。

e.en: Building inspectors rely on {thermography} to find hidden moisture.
e.zh: 建筑检查员依靠热成像技术查找隐藏的水分。

e.en: Infrared {thermography} can spot overheating components in circuits.
e.zh: 红外热成像可发现电路中过热的元件。

e.en: Archaeologists date pottery using {thermoluminescence} techniques.
e.zh: 考古学家用热释光技术为陶器测年。

e.en: {Thermoluminescence} reveals when minerals were last heated by sunlight.
e.zh: 热释光可揭示矿物上次被阳光加热的时间。

e.en: Engineers ran {thermomechanical} tests on the alloy under load.
e.zh: 工程师对该合金在负载下进行了热机械测试。

e.en: The chip's {thermomechanical} stress can crack the solder joints.
e.zh: 芯片的热机械应力可能使焊点开裂。

e.en: The {thermometer} read thirty-eight degrees, so she stayed home.
e.zh: 体温计显示三十八度,所以她留在家里。

e.en: Check the oven {thermometer} before putting in the cake.
e.zh: 放蛋糕进烤箱前先看一下烤箱温度计。

e.en: Digital {thermometers} are faster and safer than mercury ones.
e.zh: 电子温度计比水银温度计更快也更安全。

e.en: The clinic ran out of {thermometers} during the flu season.
e.zh: 流感季期间,诊所的体温计用光了。

e.en: Scientists are researching controlled {thermonuclear} fusion for clean energy.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究可控热核聚变以获得清洁能源。

e.en: The treaty bans testing of {thermonuclear} weapons in the atmosphere.
e.zh: 该条约禁止在大气层中试验热核武器。

e.en: {Thermophilic} bacteria thrive in hot springs near volcanoes.
e.zh: 嗜热细菌在火山附近的温泉中繁衍生息。

e.en: The compost relies on {thermophilic} microbes to break down waste.
e.zh: 这种堆肥依靠嗜热微生物分解废料。

thermoplastic.t:
n. 热塑塑料
adj. 热塑性的

e.en: Most water bottles are made from a recyclable {thermoplastic}.
e.zh: 大多数水瓶都用可回收的热塑性塑料制成。

e.en: 3D printers melt {thermoplastic} filament to build each layer.
e.zh: 3D打印机熔化热塑性丝材来逐层打印。

e.en: Sweating is the body's main method of {thermoregulation}.
e.zh: 出汗是人体调节体温的主要方式。

e.en: Reptiles rely on the sun for {thermoregulation} in the morning.
e.zh: 爬行动物早晨靠晒太阳来调节体温。

e.en: She filled her {thermos} with hot tea before the hike.
e.zh: 她在徒步前往保温瓶里装满了热茶。

e.en: This {thermos} keeps coffee warm for over twelve hours.
e.zh: 这个保温杯能让咖啡保温十二小时以上。

e.en: Set the {thermostat} to twenty-two before you leave home.
e.zh: 出门前把温控器设到二十二度。

e.en: Smart {thermostat} apps can save a lot on heating bills.
e.zh: 智能温控器的应用程序能节省不少取暖费。

e.en: The shower has a {thermostatic} valve to prevent scalding.
e.zh: 这个淋浴有恒温阀,可以防止烫伤。

e.en: Modern ovens use {thermostatic} controls for even baking.
e.zh: 现代烤箱采用恒温控制以实现均匀烘焙。

e.en: The room is heated {thermostatically} to stay around 21 degrees.
e.zh: 房间通过恒温控制保持在21度左右。

e.en: The fan turns on {thermostatically} when the chip gets hot.
e.zh: 芯片变热时,风扇会按温控自动开启。

e.en: Tyrannosaurus rex was the most famous {theropod} dinosaur.
e.zh: 霸王龙是最著名的兽脚类恐龙。

e.en: Paleontologists found a small {theropod} skeleton near the river.
e.zh: 古生物学家在河边发现了一具小型兽脚类骨架。

thinks.t: v. 思考；认为（think 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He {thinks} the project will finish ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 他认为这个项目会提前完成。

e.en: Nobody {thinks} her plan will actually work.
e.zh: 没人觉得她的计划真的能成。

e.en: Slice the garlic {thinly} for the stir-fry.
e.zh: 把蒜切成薄片用来炒菜。

e.en: The novel is a {thinly} disguised memoir.
e.zh: 这部小说其实是一部稍加伪装的回忆录。

thinned.t: v. 变薄；稀释（thin 的过去式）

e.en: The crowd {thinned} after the fireworks ended.
e.zh: 烟花结束后人群渐渐散去。

e.en: She {thinned} the paint with a little water.
e.zh: 她用一点水把颜料稀释了。

thinner.t:
adj. 更薄的；更瘦的
n. 稀释剂

e.en: The air gets {thinner} as you climb higher.
e.zh: 爬得越高,空气就越稀薄。

e.en: Use paint {thinner} to clean the brushes thoroughly.
e.zh: 用油漆稀释剂把刷子彻底清洗干净。

e.en: The doctor was concerned about her sudden {thinness}.
e.zh: 医生对她突然消瘦感到担忧。

e.en: The {thinness} of the paper made it almost transparent.
e.zh: 这张纸的薄度让它几乎透明。

thinning.t:
v. 变薄；稀疏
n. 间苗

e.en: He's started using shampoo for {thinning} hair.
e.zh: 他开始用针对脱发稀疏的洗发水了。

e.en: Gardeners recommend {thinning} the seedlings in spring.
e.zh: 园丁建议在春天给幼苗间苗。

e.en: He's a {thinnish} guy with round glasses.
e.zh: 他是个偏瘦、戴着圆框眼镜的男生。

e.en: The pancakes turned out a bit {thinnish} this time.
e.zh: 这次煎的薄饼有点偏薄。

e.en: In old verse, "{thir}" meant "these" in northern English.
e.zh: 在古诗中,“thir”在北部英语里意为“这些”。

e.en: Scholars debate the meaning of "{thir}" in medieval texts.
e.zh: 学者们对中世纪文献中“thir”一词的含义有争论。

third.t:
adj. 第三的
n. 三分之一

e.en: This is my {third} cup of coffee today already.
e.zh: 这已经是我今天的第三杯咖啡了。

e.en: She finished {third} in the marathon last weekend.
e.zh: 她上周末在马拉松比赛中获得了第三名。

thirdhand.t: adj. 三手的；间接听来的

e.en: I only heard about the layoffs {thirdhand}, so check the facts.
e.zh: 我对裁员的事只是辗转听说的，请核实一下。

e.en: Children can be harmed by {thirdhand} smoke on clothes and furniture.
e.zh: 残留在衣物和家具上的三手烟可能危害儿童健康。

e.en: {Thirdly}, we need to discuss the project budget.
e.zh: 第三，我们需要讨论一下项目预算。

e.en: And {thirdly}, always back up your files before updating.
e.zh: 第三点，更新之前一定要先备份文件。

e.en: Cut the cake into {thirds} so everyone gets a piece.
e.zh: 把蛋糕切成三等份，每个人都能分到一块。

e.en: Two {thirds} of the team voted to delay the launch.
e.zh: 团队中三分之二的人投票决定推迟发布。

thirst.t:
n. 口渴；渴望
v. 渴望

e.en: After the long hike, my {thirst} was unbearable.
e.zh: 长途徒步后，我口渴得难以忍受。

e.en: She has a real {thirst} for adventure and travel.
e.zh: 她对冒险和旅行有着强烈的渴望。

thirsted.t: v. 口渴；渴望（thirst 的过去式）

e.en: The young scholar {thirsted} for knowledge his whole life.
e.zh: 这位年轻学者一生都渴望知识。

e.en: Soldiers {thirsted} desperately during the desert march.
e.zh: 士兵们在沙漠行军中极度口渴。

e.en: The dog drank {thirstily} from the garden hose.
e.zh: 那只狗对着花园水管贪婪地喝水。

e.en: He gulped the cold water {thirstily} after the run.
e.zh: 跑完步后他大口大口地灌下冷水。

thirsting.t: v. 渴望；口渴（thirst 的现在分词）

e.en: Fans are {thirsting} for news about the next album.
e.zh: 粉丝们都迫切想知道下一张专辑的消息。

e.en: The parched land was {thirsting} for rain.
e.zh: 干裂的土地正渴望着一场雨。

thirsts.t:
v. 渴望（thirst 的第三人称单数）
n. 口渴

e.en: He {thirsts} for recognition more than money.
e.zh: 他渴望认可胜过金钱。

e.en: The startup {thirsts} for fresh engineering talent.
e.zh: 这家初创公司急需新鲜的工程人才。

e.en: I'm really {thirsty}—can I grab a soda?
e.zh: 我真的很渴，能拿瓶汽水吗？

e.en: That post is so {thirsty} for likes and comments.
e.zh: 那条帖子明显是在求赞求评论。

e.en: My daughter just turned {thirteen} last weekend.
e.zh: 我女儿上周末刚满十三岁。

e.en: The album has {thirteen} tracks in total.
e.zh: 这张专辑总共有十三首曲目。

thirteenth.t:
adj. 第十三的
n. 十三分之一

e.en: Her birthday falls on the {thirteenth} of June.
e.zh: 她的生日是六月十三号。

e.en: He finished {thirteenth} in the marathon last year.
e.zh: 他在去年的马拉松中获得第十三名。

thirtieth.t:
adj. 第三十的
n. 三十分之一

e.en: They celebrated their {thirtieth} wedding anniversary in Paris.
e.zh: 他们在巴黎庆祝了结婚三十周年纪念日。

e.en: The deadline is the {thirtieth} of this month.
e.zh: 截止日期是本月三十号。

e.en: The meeting will start in about {thirty} minutes.
e.zh: 会议大约三十分钟后开始。

e.en: She turned {thirty} and threw a huge party.
e.zh: 她满三十岁时办了一场盛大的派对。

e.en: The new manager looks {thirtyish} and very confident.
e.zh: 新来的经理看起来三十出头，非常自信。

e.en: He's a {thirtyish} guy with a tech startup background.
e.zh: 他是个三十来岁、有科技创业背景的人。

e.en: The app targets {thirtysomething} professionals in big cities.
e.zh: 这款应用面向大城市里三十多岁的职场人士。

e.en: Most attendees were {thirtysomething} parents with young kids.
e.zh: 大多数与会者是三十几岁、带着小孩的父母。

this.t:
pron. 这；这个
adj. 这个的

e.en: {This} is the best coffee I've had all week.
e.zh: 这是我这一周喝过最好的咖啡。

e.en: Can you fix {this} bug before the demo?
e.zh: 你能在演示前修好这个 bug 吗？

thistle.t: n. 蓟（植物，苏格兰国花）

e.en: A spiky purple {thistle} grew beside the path.
e.zh: 小路边长着一株带刺的紫色蓟草。

e.en: The {thistle} is a national symbol of Scotland.
e.zh: 蓟是苏格兰的国家象征。

e.en: Soft {thistledown} drifted across the summer meadow.
e.zh: 柔软的蓟绒飘过夏日的草地。

e.en: Her hair was as light as {thistledown}.
e.zh: 她的头发轻得像蓟花的绒毛。

e.en: Travelers wandered hither and {thither} across the old map.
e.zh: 旅人们在这张旧地图上四处游荡。

e.en: The villagers hurried {thither} to see the spectacle.
e.zh: 村民们匆匆赶往那处去看热闹。

tho.t: conj. 虽然（though 的非正式拼写）

e.en: {Thomas} just got promoted to senior engineer last month.
e.zh: 托马斯上个月刚晋升为高级工程师。

e.en: My son loves watching {Thomas} the Tank Engine.
e.zh: 我儿子很喜欢看《托马斯小火车》。

thomist.t: n. 托马斯·阿奎那学派信徒

e.en: The professor offered a {Thomist} reading of the text.
e.zh: 教授对该文本作了托马斯主义式的解读。

e.en: She defended a strictly {Thomist} view of natural law.
e.zh: 她坚持托马斯主义对自然法的严格观点。

thong.t: n. 丁字裤；皮带；人字拖

e.en: He slipped on a {thong} and headed to the beach.
e.zh: 他套上人字拖就往海滩走去。

e.en: The leather {thong} held the small pouch shut.
e.zh: 那条皮带绳把小袋子系紧了。

thor.t: n. 索尔（北欧神话雷神）

e.en: {Thor} is one of Marvel's most popular superheroes.
e.zh: 雷神托尔是漫威最受欢迎的超级英雄之一。

e.en: In Norse mythology, {Thor} wields a powerful hammer.
e.zh: 在北欧神话中，托尔挥舞着一把威力强大的锤子。

e.en: The patient suffered a {thoracic} spine injury in the crash.
e.zh: 病人在车祸中胸椎受伤。

e.en: She specializes in {thoracic} surgery at the city hospital.
e.zh: 她在市医院专攻胸外科。

e.en: The trauma team performed an emergency {thoracotomy} in the ER.
e.zh: 创伤团队在急诊室进行了紧急开胸手术。

e.en: Recovery from a {thoracotomy} can take several weeks.
e.zh: 开胸手术后的恢复可能需要几周时间。

e.en: The insect's {thorax} is where its legs and wings attach.
e.zh: 昆虫的胸部连接着腿和翅膀。

e.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in the {thorax}.
e.zh: X 光显示胸腔有一处小骨折。

e.en: {Thoreau} wrote Walden while living by a quiet pond.
e.zh: 梭罗在一个静谧的池塘旁写下了《瓦尔登湖》。

e.en: Many environmentalists still quote {Thoreau} today.
e.zh: 许多环保主义者至今仍引用梭罗的话。

e.en: Researchers see {thorium} as a cleaner nuclear fuel option.
e.zh: 研究人员把钍视为一种更清洁的核燃料选择。

e.en: China is testing a reactor powered by {thorium}.
e.zh: 中国正在测试一种以钍为燃料的反应堆。

e.en: A sharp {thorn} pricked her finger as she pruned roses.
e.zh: 她修剪玫瑰时，一根尖刺扎到了手指。

e.en: That issue has been a {thorn} in management's side.
e.zh: 那个问题一直是管理层的眼中钉。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the village of {Thornbury}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末游览索恩伯里村。

e.en: {Thornbury} Castle is a popular wedding venue in England.
e.zh: 索恩伯里城堡是英格兰一处热门的婚礼场地。

e.en: A rabbit darted under the dense {thornbush} for cover.
e.zh: 一只兔子窜到茂密的荆棘丛下躲藏。

e.en: His sleeve got caught on a low {thornbush}.
e.zh: 他的袖子被一丛低矮的荆棘刮住了。

thorney.t: adj. 多刺的（thorny 的异体）

e.en: The old chapel sits on {Thorney} Island in London.
e.zh: 那座古老的教堂坐落在伦敦的索尼岛上。

e.en: We took a photo near the {Thorney} village sign.
e.zh: 我们在索尼村的标牌旁拍了照。

thornhill.t: n. 索恩希尔（姓氏/地名）

e.en: My cousin lives in {Thornhill}, just north of Toronto.
e.zh: 我表亲住在多伦多以北的索恩希尔。

e.en: The {Thornhill} community center hosts weekly farmers' markets.
e.zh: 索恩希尔社区中心每周都会举办农夫集市。

e.en: The dog growled {threateningly} at the stranger.
e.zh: 那条狗对陌生人威胁地低吼。

e.en: He waved the bat {threateningly} above his head.
e.zh: 他威吓地把球棒举过头顶挥舞。

threatens.t: v. 威胁；恐吓（threaten 第三人称单数）

e.en: The new law {threatens} small business owners.
e.zh: 新法律对小企业主构成威胁。

e.en: A leaked memo {threatens} the company's reputation.
e.zh: 一份泄露的备忘录威胁到公司的声誉。

e.en: Cybersecurity {threats} have grown sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年网络安全威胁急剧增加。

e.en: The platform now blocks accounts that send {threats}.
e.zh: 该平台现在会封禁发出威胁的账号。

e.en: I'll have {three} coffees to go, please.
e.zh: 请给我打包三杯咖啡。

e.en: The meeting starts at {three} this afternoon.
e.zh: 会议在今天下午三点开始。

e.en: The app generates {three-dimensional} models from photos.
e.zh: 这款应用能从照片生成三维模型。

e.en: The novel features deeply {three-dimensional} characters.
e.zh: 这部小说塑造了非常立体的人物形象。

threefold.t:
adj. 三倍的；三重的
adv. 三倍地

e.en: Online sales grew {threefold} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间线上销售增长了三倍。

e.en: Our strategy has a {threefold} purpose.
e.zh: 我们的策略有三重目的。

threepence.t: n. 三便士（旧英国货币）

e.en: A loaf of bread once cost just {threepence}.
e.zh: 一条面包曾经只要三便士。

e.en: He found an old {threepence} coin in the attic.
e.zh: 他在阁楼里找到了一枚旧的三便士硬币。

e.en: They watched a production of 'The {Threepenny} Opera'.
e.zh: 他们观看了《三便士歌剧》的演出。

e.en: She bought a {threepenny} stamp for her letter.
e.zh: 她为信件买了一张三便士的邮票。

e.en: The dress has {threequarter} sleeves and a slim cut.
e.zh: 这条裙子是七分袖，剪裁修身。

e.en: He plays at {threequarter} on the rugby team.
e.zh: 他在橄榄球队中担任三四分卫位置。

threesome.t: n. 三人组；三人一起的活动

e.en: The {threesome} hiked the trail together every weekend.
e.zh: 这三人组每个周末都一起去徒步。

e.en: They formed a popular comedy {threesome} on YouTube.
e.zh: 他们在YouTube上组成了一个人气很高的喜剧三人组。

e.en: The composer wrote a {threnody} for the war victims.
e.zh: 作曲家为战争受害者创作了一首挽歌。

e.en: Her poem reads like a quiet {threnody}.
e.zh: 她的诗读起来像一首静默的悼亡曲。

e.en: Farmers used to {thresh} wheat by hand.
e.zh: 农民过去会用手工脱粒小麦。

e.en: Modern machines {thresh} grain in minutes.
e.zh: 现代机器几分钟内就能给谷物脱粒。

e.en: The {thresher} broke down in the middle of harvest.
e.zh: 脱粒机在收割中途坏了。

e.en: A {thresher} shark was spotted off the coast.
e.zh: 在海边发现了一条长尾鲨。

threshhold.t: n. 门槛；临界值（threshold 的拼写变体）

e.en: Pain {threshhold} varies greatly from person to person.
e.zh: 每个人的疼痛阈值差别很大。

e.en: She paused at the {threshhold} before stepping inside.
e.zh: 她在门槛前停了一下，然后才走进去。

threshing.t:
n. 脱粒；打谷
v. thresh 的现在分词

e.en: The old barn was used for {threshing} grain.
e.zh: 那座老谷仓曾被用来给谷物脱粒。

e.en: {Threshing} season kept the whole village busy.
e.zh: 脱粒季节让整个村庄都忙得不可开交。

e.en: The notification triggers when CPU usage hits the {threshold}.
e.zh: 当CPU使用率达到阈值时就会触发通知。

e.en: She paused at the {threshold} of the new office.
e.zh: 她在新办公室的门口停了一下。

e.en: You can set custom alert {thresholds} in the dashboard.
e.zh: 你可以在仪表盘中设置自定义警报阈值。

e.en: Different income {thresholds} apply to each tax bracket.
e.zh: 不同的收入门槛适用于不同的税级。

threw.t: v. 扔；投掷（throw 的过去式）

e.en: He {threw} the ball across the yard to his dog.
e.zh: 他把球扔过院子给他的狗。

e.en: Her sudden question {threw} me completely off balance.
e.zh: 她突然的问题让我完全乱了阵脚。

e.en: I've watched that movie {thrice} this month.
e.zh: 这部电影我这个月已经看了三遍。

e.en: Measure {thrice}, cut once, my grandfather said.
e.zh: 我祖父常说，量三次，再剪一次。

e.en: She bought the jacket at a {thrift} store downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心的二手店买了这件外套。

e.en: Years of {thrift} helped them buy their first home.
e.zh: 多年的节俭帮他们买下了第一套房。

e.en: Her {thriftiness} helped the family save for a new home.
e.zh: 她的节俭帮助全家攒钱买了新房。

e.en: The startup's {thriftiness} kept it alive through tough years.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的节俭让它熬过了艰难岁月。

e.en: His {thriftless} habits left him broke by month's end.
e.zh: 他大手大脚的习惯让他月底就破产了。

e.en: The {thriftless} heir blew through his inheritance in two years.
e.zh: 那个挥霍无度的继承人两年内就败光了遗产。

e.en: My grandmother is {thrifty} and never wastes leftover food.
e.zh: 我奶奶很节俭,从不浪费剩饭。

e.en: Students often look for {thrifty} ways to furnish their dorms.
e.zh: 学生们常常找便宜的方式布置宿舍。

e.en: The misspelled sign read {thril} instead of thrill.
e.zh: 那块拼错的牌子写成了 thril 而不是 thrill。

e.en: Autocorrect changed thrill to {thril} in his text.
e.zh: 自动更正把他短信里的 thrill 改成了 thril。

thrill.t:
n. 兴奋；激动
v. 使激动；令人兴奋

e.en: Riding the roller coaster gave her a real {thrill}.
e.zh: 坐过山车让她体验到真正的刺激。

e.en: It would {thrill} me to meet my favorite author someday.
e.zh: 如果有一天能见到我最喜欢的作家,我会激动不已。

thrilled.t: adj. 非常激动的；兴奋的

e.en: She was {thrilled} to receive the job offer.
e.zh: 她收到工作录用通知时激动极了。

e.en: The kids looked {thrilled} when the puppy arrived.
e.zh: 小狗到家时孩子们看起来兴奋极了。

e.en: I stayed up late finishing a psychological {thriller}.
e.zh: 我熬夜把一部心理惊悚片看完了。

e.en: The match was a real {thriller}, decided in the final seconds.
e.zh: 这场比赛真是扣人心弦,最后几秒才分出胜负。

thrillers.t: n. 惊悚片；惊险小说（复数）

e.en: He writes bestselling {thrillers} set in Cold War Berlin.
e.zh: 他写以冷战柏林为背景的畅销惊悚小说。

e.en: Netflix added several Korean {thrillers} to its lineup this month.
e.zh: 网飞这个月新上了几部韩国惊悚片。

thrilling.t: adj. 激动人心的；扣人心弦的

e.en: The final lap was absolutely {thrilling} to watch.
e.zh: 最后一圈看起来真是惊心动魄。

e.en: She told a {thrilling} story about her trek in Nepal.
e.zh: 她讲了一个关于在尼泊尔徒步的惊险故事。

thrillingly.t: adv. 令人激动地；扣人心弦地

e.en: The novel ends {thrillingly} with an unexpected betrayal.
e.zh: 小说以一场意想不到的背叛惊险收尾。

e.en: Her violin solo soared {thrillingly} above the orchestra.
e.zh: 她的小提琴独奏激动人心地凌驾于整个乐团之上。

thrills.t:
n. 刺激；兴奋（复数）
v. 使激动

e.en: Skydiving offers {thrills} that few other sports can match.
e.zh: 跳伞带来的刺激是其他运动很难比拟的。

e.en: Nothing {thrills} him more than a close basketball game.
e.zh: 没什么比一场势均力敌的篮球赛更让他激动了。

e.en: A single {thrip} can damage tender flower petals.
e.zh: 一只蓟马就能损害娇嫩的花瓣。

e.en: The gardener sprayed neem oil to control the {thrip} infestation.
e.zh: 园丁喷了印楝油来控制蓟马虫害。

e.en: Some plants {thrive} in shade and cool weather.
e.zh: 有些植物在阴凉和凉爽的天气里长得很好。

e.en: Small businesses {thrive} when local customers stay loyal.
e.zh: 当本地顾客保持忠诚时,小企业就能蓬勃发展。

thrived.t: v. thrive 的过去式；茁壮成长

e.en: The startup {thrived} after switching to a subscription model.
e.zh: 这家初创公司转向订阅模式后蓬勃发展。

e.en: She {thrived} in the fast-paced newsroom environment.
e.zh: 她在节奏紧张的新闻编辑室里如鱼得水。

thrives.t: v. 繁荣；茁壮成长（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {thrives} under pressure and tight deadlines.
e.zh: 他在压力和紧迫的截止日期下反而表现出色。

e.en: Coral {thrives} in clean, warm tropical waters.
e.zh: 珊瑚在干净温暖的热带水域中茁壮生长。

e.en: The neighborhood has a {thriving} arts scene.
e.zh: 这个街区有着繁荣的艺术氛围。

e.en: Her bakery is {thriving} thanks to viral TikTok videos.
e.zh: 靠着爆红的 TikTok 视频,她的烘焙店生意兴隆。

e.en: In old poems, {thro} is a shortened form of through.
e.zh: 在古诗中,thro 是 through 的缩写形式。

e.en: The hymn lyric reads "{thro} the night."
e.zh: 那首赞美诗的歌词写着 "thro the night"。

e.en: My {throat} feels sore after talking all day.
e.zh: 说了一整天话,我的嗓子很疼。

e.en: Drink warm tea to soothe an irritated {throat}.
e.zh: 喝点温茶可以缓解嗓子的不适。

e.en: She laughed {throatily} at his terrible joke.
e.zh: 她对他蹩脚的笑话发出沙哑的笑声。

e.en: The singer crooned {throatily} into the vintage microphone.
e.zh: 歌手对着复古麦克风低沉地浅唱。

e.en: Cold air can irritate the {throats} of asthma sufferers.
e.zh: 冷空气会刺激哮喘患者的喉咙。

e.en: The choir cleared their {throats} before the performance.
e.zh: 合唱团在表演前清了清嗓子。

e.en: The sports car has a deep, {throaty} engine sound.
e.zh: 这辆跑车有着低沉浑厚的引擎声。

e.en: She has a {throaty} voice perfect for jazz singing.
e.zh: 她有一副适合唱爵士乐的低沉嗓音。

throb.t:
v. 跳动；悸动
n. 悸动；阵痛

e.en: My head started to {throb} after staring at the screen.
e.zh: 盯着屏幕看后,我的头开始一阵阵地疼。

e.en: You could feel the bass {throb} through the dance floor.
e.zh: 你能感觉到低音在舞池中阵阵震动。

throbbing.t: adj. 悸动的；阵阵抽痛的

e.en: She woke up with a {throbbing} headache.
e.zh: 她醒来时头一阵阵地剧痛。

e.en: The {throbbing} bass shook the entire club.
e.zh: 震动的低音让整个夜店都在晃动。

e.en: Each {throe} of labor brought her closer to meeting her baby.
e.zh: 每一阵阵痛都让她更接近见到自己的宝宝。

e.en: A sudden {throe} of grief overcame him at the funeral.
e.zh: 在葬礼上,一阵剧烈的悲痛袭来,让他无法承受。

throes.t: n. 剧痛；挣扎（常用复数）

e.en: The company is in the {throes} of a major restructuring.
e.zh: 该公司正处于大规模重组的阵痛之中。

e.en: She's in the {throes} of writing her dissertation.
e.zh: 她正在艰难地撰写博士论文。

e.en: {Throgmorton} Street is historically tied to London's financial district.
e.zh: Throgmorton 街历来与伦敦金融区紧密相关。

e.en: Old maps mark {Throgmorton} as a key City of London address.
e.zh: 旧地图把 Throgmorton 标为伦敦金融城的重要地址。

e.en: {Thrombin} converts fibrinogen into fibrin during clotting.
e.zh: 凝血酶在凝血过程中将纤维蛋白原转化为纤维蛋白。

e.en: Surgeons sometimes apply topical {thrombin} to stop bleeding.
e.zh: 外科医生有时会用外用凝血酶来止血。

e.en: Patients with {thrombocytopenia} bruise more easily than usual.
e.zh: 血小板减少症患者比常人更容易瘀青。

e.en: The chemotherapy caused mild {thrombocytopenia} in several patients.
e.zh: 化疗使几名患者出现了轻度血小板减少。

e.en: Long flights can raise the risk of {thromboembolism}.
e.zh: 长途飞行会增加血栓栓塞的风险。

e.en: Doctors prescribed blood thinners to prevent {thromboembolism}.
e.zh: 医生开了抗凝血药以预防血栓栓塞。

e.en: Rapid {thrombolysis} can save brain tissue after a stroke.
e.zh: 中风后快速溶栓可以挽救脑组织。

e.en: The hospital follows strict protocols for emergency {thrombolysis}.
e.zh: 该医院对急诊溶栓有严格的操作规程。

thrombolytic.t:
adj. 溶栓的
n. 溶栓药

e.en: The patient received a {thrombolytic} drug within the critical hour.
e.zh: 患者在关键的一小时内接受了溶栓药物治疗。

e.en: {Thrombolytic} therapy is most effective when started early.
e.zh: 溶栓治疗越早开始效果越好。

e.en: {Thrombophlebitis} causes painful swelling along the affected vein.
e.zh: 血栓性静脉炎会沿受影响的静脉引起疼痛肿胀。

e.en: Bed rest for long periods can lead to {thrombophlebitis}.
e.zh: 长时间卧床可能导致血栓性静脉炎。

e.en: Deep vein {thrombosis} is a serious risk for sedentary travelers.
e.zh: 久坐不动的旅客面临深静脉血栓的严重风险。

e.en: Aspirin is sometimes used to reduce the chance of {thrombosis}.
e.zh: 阿司匹林有时被用来降低血栓形成的几率。

e.en: He suffered a {thrombotic} stroke at age fifty.
e.zh: 他在五十岁时中风,属于血栓性中风。

e.en: Doctors monitor patients closely for {thrombotic} complications.
e.zh: 医生会密切监测患者是否出现血栓性并发症。

e.en: Aspirin works partly by blocking {thromboxane} production.
e.zh: 阿司匹林的部分作用机制是抑制血栓素的生成。

e.en: {Thromboxane} causes blood vessels to constrict and platelets to clump.
e.zh: 血栓素会使血管收缩并促使血小板聚集。

e.en: A small {thrombus} blocked blood flow to her leg.
e.zh: 一个小血栓阻断了她腿部的血流。

e.en: Imaging revealed a {thrombus} in the patient's coronary artery.
e.zh: 影像检查显示患者冠状动脉里有血栓。

e.en: The young prince ascended the {throne} after his father's death.
e.zh: 年轻的王子在父亲去世后登上了王位。

e.en: She sat on a velvet {throne} in the play's final scene.
e.zh: 在剧目的最后一幕中,她坐在天鹅绒宝座上。

throng.t:
n. 人群
v. 蜂拥

e.en: A {throng} of fans waited outside the stadium.
e.zh: 一大群粉丝在体育场外等候。

e.en: Tourists {throng} the old town every summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天游客都涌入老城区。

throttle.t:
v. 限速；扼杀
n. 节流阀；油门

e.en: He pushed the {throttle} forward and the boat surged ahead.
e.zh: 他向前推油门,船猛地向前冲去。

e.en: The API will {throttle} requests once you exceed the limit.
e.zh: 一旦超出限制,该 API 就会限制请求速率。

through.t:
prep. 穿过；通过
adv. 从头到尾

e.en: We walked {through} the park on the way home.
e.zh: 我们回家路上穿过了那座公园。

e.en: She read {through} the entire report before the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议前把整份报告从头到尾读了一遍。

throughout.t:
prep. 遍及；整个期间
adv. 自始至终

e.en: Snow fell steadily {throughout} the night.
e.zh: 整夜都在不停地下雪。

e.en: The brand has stores {throughout} Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 该品牌在东南亚各地都有门店。

e.en: Upgrading the servers doubled our data {throughput}.
e.zh: 升级服务器后,我们的数据吞吐量翻了一番。

e.en: The factory measures {throughput} in units per hour.
e.zh: 工厂以每小时的产量来衡量吞吐量。

e.en: Traffic on the {throughway} crawled during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段高速公路上的车流缓慢爬行。

e.en: They built a new {throughway} to bypass the city center.
e.zh: 他们修了一条新的高速公路绕开市中心。

throw.t:
v. 扔；抛
n. 投掷

e.en: Please {throw} the ball back over the fence.
e.zh: 请把球扔回栅栏这边来。

e.en: Don't {throw} away receipts you might need later.
e.zh: 别把以后可能用得上的收据扔掉。

e.en: He made a {throwaway} comment that surprisingly went viral.
e.zh: 他随口的一句话竟然意外地火了起来。

e.en: Reducing {throwaway} packaging is a major sustainability goal.
e.zh: 减少一次性包装是一项重要的可持续发展目标。

e.en: This diner is a {throwback} to 1950s America.
e.zh: 这家小餐馆让人仿佛回到了 1950 年代的美国。

e.en: She posted a {throwback} photo from her college days.
e.zh: 她发了一张大学时代的怀旧照片。

e.en: The javelin {thrower} broke the national record.
e.zh: 那位标枪运动员打破了全国纪录。

e.en: As a flame {thrower} performer, she trains daily for safety.
e.zh: 作为一名喷火表演者,她每天训练以确保安全。

throwing.t:
n. 投掷
v. throw 的现在分词

e.en: The kids were {throwing} snowballs at each other in the yard.
e.zh: 孩子们在院子里互相扔雪球。

e.en: She is {throwing} a surprise party for her sister tonight.
e.zh: 她今晚要为姐姐办一场惊喜派对。

e.en: All the broken toys have been {thrown} in the recycling bin.
e.zh: 所有坏掉的玩具都被扔进了回收箱。

e.en: He was {thrown} from the horse but luckily wasn't hurt.
e.zh: 他被马甩了下来,幸好没受伤。

throws.t: v. throw 第三人称单数；（代码中）抛出异常

e.en: The pitcher {throws} a wicked curveball.
e.zh: 这位投手能投出刁钻的曲线球。

e.en: Sunlight {throws} long shadows across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 阳光在厨房地板上投下长长的影子。

thru.t: prep. through 的非正式写法

e.en: Drive {thru} the tunnel and turn left at the lights.
e.zh: 穿过隧道，在红绿灯处左转。

e.en: I grabbed coffee at the drive-{thru} on my way to work.
e.zh: 我上班路上在得来速买了杯咖啡。

thrum.t:
v. 嗡嗡作响
n. 持续的低响

e.en: I could feel the {thrum} of the engine through my seat.
e.zh: 我能透过座椅感受到发动机的低鸣震动。

e.en: The bass began to {thrum} softly in the background.
e.zh: 低音开始在背景中低沉地颤动。

e.en: The city was {thrumming} with energy on Friday night.
e.zh: 周五晚上整座城市充满了活力。

e.en: Her heart was {thrumming} as she opened the letter.
e.zh: 她拆信时心跳得砰砰作响。

thrush.t:
n. 画眉鸟
n. 鹅口疮

e.en: A {thrush} sang sweetly from the top of the apple tree.
e.zh: 一只画眉鸟在苹果树顶上婉转啼鸣。

e.en: The baby was diagnosed with oral {thrush} last week.
e.zh: 宝宝上周被诊断出患了鹅口疮。

thrust.t:
n. 推力；要点
v. 猛推

e.en: The rocket needs more {thrust} to escape Earth's gravity.
e.zh: 火箭需要更大的推力才能脱离地球引力。

e.en: She {thrust} the keys into my hand and ran off.
e.zh: 她把钥匙塞进我手里就跑开了。

e.en: The spacecraft fired its {thruster} to adjust orbit.
e.zh: 飞船启动推进器来调整轨道。

e.en: One {thruster} on the side of the drone failed mid-flight.
e.zh: 无人机侧面的一个推进器在飞行中失效了。

e.en: He kept {thrusting} his phone toward me to show the photo.
e.zh: 他不停地把手机递到我面前给我看照片。

e.en: The mountain peaks are {thrusting} sharply into the sky.
e.zh: 山峰陡峭地刺向天空。

e.en: Traffic on the New York {thruway} was at a standstill.
e.zh: 纽约高速公路上的交通完全瘫痪了。

e.en: We took the {thruway} north to avoid the city center.
e.zh: 我们走高速公路北上以避开市中心。

thucydides.t: n. 修昔底德（古希腊历史学家）

e.en: {Thucydides} wrote about the war between Athens and Sparta.
e.zh: 修昔底德记录了雅典和斯巴达之间的战争。

e.en: Many analysts cite the {Thucydides} Trap when discussing US-China relations.
e.zh: 许多分析人士在谈论中美关系时会提到修昔底德陷阱。

thud.t:
n. 砰的一声
v. 发出闷响

e.en: The book hit the floor with a loud {thud}.
e.zh: 那本书砰的一声重重地砸在地板上。

e.en: I heard a {thud} from upstairs and ran to check.
e.zh: 我听到楼上传来一声闷响，赶紧跑去查看。

e.en: Her footsteps were {thudding} down the hallway.
e.zh: 她的脚步声沉重地响过走廊。

e.en: My head was {thudding} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后我的头一阵阵地胀痛。

e.en: A {thug} grabbed her bag and disappeared into the crowd.
e.zh: 一个暴徒抢了她的包，消失在人群中。

e.en: The mayor called the rioters nothing but common {thug}s.
e.zh: 市长称那些暴乱者不过是普通的恶棍。

e.en: Police vowed to crack down on street {thuggery} in the area.
e.zh: 警方誓言要打击该地区的街头暴力行径。

e.en: Online {thuggery} has become a serious problem on social media.
e.zh: 网络暴力已成为社交媒体上的严重问题。

e.en: His {thuggish} behavior got him kicked out of the bar.
e.zh: 他粗暴的行为让他被酒吧赶了出去。

e.en: The bouncer gave us a {thuggish} stare as we entered.
e.zh: 我们进门时保安用凶狠的眼神瞪着我们。

thumb.t:
n. 拇指
v. 翻阅

e.en: I cut my {thumb} while chopping onions for dinner.
e.zh: 我切洋葱做晚饭时把拇指割伤了。

e.en: Most people {thumb} through their phones first thing in the morning.
e.zh: 大多数人早上起床第一件事就是刷手机。

e.en: The video {thumbnail} really determines whether people click.
e.zh: 视频缩略图很大程度上决定了人们是否会点进去。

e.en: She gave me a {thumbnail} sketch of the project plan.
e.zh: 她给我简要描述了一下项目计划。

e.en: Unlock your phone with your {thumbprint} for faster access.
e.zh: 用拇指指纹解锁手机可以更快进入。

e.en: Each handmade bowl carries the artist's unique {thumbprint}.
e.zh: 每个手工碗上都留有工匠独特的拇指印记。

thumbs.t: n. 拇指（复数）；thumbs up 表示赞同

e.en: He gave the new design two {thumbs} up.
e.zh: 他对新设计竖起了两个大拇指表示赞赏。

e.en: My {thumbs} hurt after texting all afternoon.
e.zh: 发了一下午短信后我的两个拇指都酸了。

thumbscrew.t: n. 翼形螺钉；拇指夹（刑具）

e.en: Tighten the {thumbscrew} to hold the camera in place.
e.zh: 拧紧蝶形螺丝以固定相机。

e.en: Regulators are putting the {thumbscrew}s on tech giants.
e.zh: 监管机构正在对科技巨头施加压力。

e.en: She pinned the photo to the corkboard with a red {thumbtack}.
e.zh: 她用一枚红色图钉把照片别在软木板上。

e.en: I stepped on a {thumbtack} and yelped in pain.
e.zh: 我踩到一颗图钉，疼得叫了一声。

thump.t:
v. 重击
n. 砰的一声

e.en: There was a loud {thump} from the apartment upstairs.
e.zh: 楼上公寓传来一声响亮的撞击声。

e.en: My heart began to {thump} as I walked onstage.
e.zh: 我走上舞台时心开始砰砰直跳。

e.en: He {thumped} the table to get everyone's attention.
e.zh: 他重重地拍了一下桌子以吸引大家的注意。

e.en: Her heart {thumped} loudly when she saw his message.
e.zh: 她看到他的消息时心脏砰砰地狂跳。

e.en: That bass speaker is a real {thumper} at parties.
e.zh: 那个低音音箱在派对上震撼力十足。

e.en: The kids named the rabbit {Thumper} after the cartoon.
e.zh: 孩子们照动画片把兔子取名为桑普。

thumping.t:
adj. 巨大的
v. 重击（进行时）

e.en: The candidate won by a {thumping} majority on Tuesday.
e.zh: 那位候选人周二以压倒性多数获胜。

e.en: I could hear the {thumping} bass from three blocks away.
e.zh: 我在三个街区外都能听到震耳的低音。

thumps.t: v. thump 的第三人称单数

e.en: She heard three loud {thumps} on the front door.
e.zh: 她听到前门传来三声重重的敲击声。

e.en: My chest {thumps} every time I think about the interview.
e.zh: 我每次想到面试，胸口都会怦怦直跳。

thunder.t:
n. 雷声
v. 打雷；轰鸣

e.en: The {thunder} rolled across the sky all night long.
e.zh: 雷声整夜在天空中滚滚作响。

e.en: Don't let competitors steal your {thunder} at the launch.
e.zh: 别让竞争对手在发布会上抢了你的风头。

thunderbird.t: n. 雷鸟（神话/邮件客户端名）

e.en: The Native American legend describes a giant {thunderbird}.
e.zh: 美洲原住民传说中描述了一只巨大的雷鸟。

e.en: He restored a classic Ford {Thunderbird} from the 1960s.
e.zh: 他修复了一辆六十年代的经典福特雷鸟车。

e.en: The news of her resignation came like a {thunderbolt}.
e.zh: 她辞职的消息犹如晴天霹雳。

e.en: A {thunderbolt} struck the old oak tree in the yard.
e.zh: 一道闪电劈中了院子里的老橡树。

e.en: A sudden {thunderclap} made the children scream.
e.zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣把孩子们吓得尖叫起来。

e.en: His announcement hit the office like a {thunderclap}.
e.zh: 他的宣布如同一声惊雷在办公室炸开。

e.en: A massive {thundercloud} loomed over the harbor.
e.zh: 一团巨大的雷雨云笼罩在港口上空。

e.en: His mood was like a {thundercloud} all morning.
e.zh: 他整个上午的心情都阴沉得像团雷雨云。

e.en: A towering {thunderhead} formed quickly over the prairie.
e.zh: 一团高耸的积雨云迅速在草原上空形成。

e.en: Pilots try to fly around any {thunderhead} they spot.
e.zh: 飞行员会尽量绕开他们发现的任何雷暴云。

e.en: The {thundering} herd of buffalo shook the ground.
e.zh: 奔腾的水牛群震得大地颤动。

e.en: She gave a {thundering} speech that brought the crowd to tears.
e.zh: 她发表了一场气势磅礴的演讲，让观众感动落泪。

e.en: The audience gave the pianist {thunderous} applause.
e.zh: 观众给了那位钢琴家雷鸣般的掌声。

e.en: His {thunderous} voice filled the entire auditorium.
e.zh: 他洪亮如雷的嗓音响彻整个礼堂。

e.en: The crowd cheered {thunderously} as the team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时观众雷鸣般地欢呼。

e.en: He slammed the door {thunderously} and stormed out.
e.zh: 他轰然摔上门，怒气冲冲地走了出去。

e.en: A brief {thundershower} cooled the city this afternoon.
e.zh: 一阵短暂的雷阵雨让城市今天下午凉快了不少。

e.en: The forecast warns of a {thundershower} this evening.
e.zh: 天气预报提醒今晚会有雷阵雨。

e.en: A heavy {thunderstorm} knocked out power across the neighborhood.
e.zh: 一场强雷暴让整个街区都停电了。

e.en: My dog hides under the bed during every {thunderstorm}.
e.zh: 每次打雷下雨我家狗都躲在床底下。

e.en: Severe {thunderstorms} are expected across the region tonight.
e.zh: 今晚该地区预计将有强雷暴天气。

e.en: Summer {thunderstorms} often cause flight delays at the airport.
e.zh: 夏季雷暴常常导致机场航班延误。

thunderstruck.t: adj. 大吃一惊；目瞪口呆

e.en: She stood {thunderstruck} when she heard the verdict.
e.zh: 听到判决结果时她惊呆了，愣在原地。

e.en: He was {thunderstruck} by the sudden price drop.
e.zh: 价格突然暴跌让他大吃一惊。

e.en: Expect {thundery} showers across the south coast tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天南部沿海预计会有雷阵雨。

e.en: The afternoon turned hot, humid, and {thundery}.
e.zh: 下午天气变得又热又闷，还伴有雷雨。

thunk.t:
n. 咚的一声
n. (编程) thunk 函数

e.en: I heard a soft {thunk} when the package landed on the porch.
e.zh: 包裹落到门廊上时我听到轻轻的一声闷响。

e.en: In JavaScript, a {thunk} delays computation until it's needed.
e.zh: 在 JavaScript 中，thunk 会把计算推迟到需要时才执行。

e.en: {Thuringia} is a forested state in central Germany.
e.zh: 图林根是位于德国中部的一个森林密布的州。

e.en: We toured several castles during our trip to {Thuringia}.
e.zh: 我们在图林根之行中参观了好几座城堡。

thurs.t: n. 星期四（Thursday 的缩写）

e.en: The meeting is scheduled for {Thurs} at 3 PM.
e.zh: 会议定于周四下午三点举行。

e.en: Office hours run Mon through {Thurs} this week.
e.zh: 本周办公时间是周一到周四。

e.en: Let's grab dinner together this {Thursday} after work.
e.zh: 我们这周四下班后一起吃晚饭吧。

e.en: The package should arrive by {Thursday} at the latest.
e.zh: 包裹最迟应该在周四送达。

thursdays.t:
n. 星期四（复数）
adv. 每逢星期四

e.en: I have yoga class on {Thursdays} after work.
e.zh: 我每周四下班后都有瑜伽课。

e.en: The cafe stays open late on {Thursdays} for live music.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆每周四会延长营业供现场音乐演出。

e.en: {Thurso} is the northernmost town on the British mainland.
e.zh: 瑟索是英国本土最北端的城镇。

e.en: We caught the ferry to Orkney from {Thurso} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从瑟索搭渡轮去了奥克尼。

e.en: Sales dropped sharply, and {thus} the store had to close.
e.zh: 销售额大幅下滑，因此那家店不得不关门。

e.en: You hold the chopsticks {thus}, between your fingers.
e.zh: 筷子要这样夹在手指之间拿。

e.en: He explained the algorithm {thusly}, with a quick whiteboard sketch.
e.zh: 他就这样在白板上简单画图解释了这个算法。

e.en: The professor summarized her argument {thusly} in one sentence.
e.zh: 教授就这样用一句话总结了她的论点。

thwack.t:
v. 重击；猛打
n. 重击声

e.en: The bat hit the ball with a satisfying {thwack}.
e.zh: 球棒击中球，发出一声令人满足的啪嗒声。

e.en: She gave the dusty rug a hard {thwack}.
e.zh: 她对着满是灰尘的地毯狠狠拍了一下。

e.en: Security updates aim to {thwart} hackers and malware.
e.zh: 安全更新旨在阻止黑客和恶意软件。

e.en: Bad weather may {thwart} our weekend hiking plans.
e.zh: 恶劣天气可能会打乱我们周末的徒步计划。

thwarted.t:
adj. 受挫的
v. 阻挠（过去式）

e.en: Police {thwarted} the robbery before anyone got hurt.
e.zh: 警方在有人受伤前阻止了那起抢劫。

e.en: Heavy rain {thwarted} our plans for a picnic.
e.zh: 大雨让我们的野餐计划泡汤了。

e.en: Sprinkle fresh {thyme} over the roasted potatoes.
e.zh: 在烤土豆上撒一些新鲜的百里香。

e.en: The garden smelled of lemon balm and {thyme}.
e.zh: 花园里飘着柠檬香蜂草和百里香的气味。

thymine.t: n. 胸腺嘧啶（T 碱基）

e.en: In DNA, {thymine} pairs with adenine through hydrogen bonds.
e.zh: 在DNA中，胸腺嘧啶通过氢键与腺嘌呤配对。

e.en: The textbook explained how {thymine} differs from uracil in RNA.
e.zh: 教科书解释了胸腺嘧啶与RNA中的尿嘧啶有何不同。

e.en: Each {thymocyte} matures in the thymus before becoming a T cell.
e.zh: 每个胸腺细胞在胸腺中成熟，然后变成T细胞。

e.en: Researchers tracked how a single {thymocyte} responds to selection signals.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了单个胸腺细胞如何对选择信号作出反应。

e.en: The {thymus} plays a key role in training the immune system.
e.zh: 胸腺在训练免疫系统方面起着关键作用。

e.en: After childhood, the {thymus} gradually shrinks and produces fewer T cells.
e.zh: 童年之后，胸腺会逐渐萎缩，产生的T细胞也减少。

thyroid.t:
n. 甲状腺
adj. 甲状腺的

e.en: Her doctor ordered a blood test to check her {thyroid} function.
e.zh: 医生开了血液检查来评估她的甲状腺功能。

e.en: An underactive {thyroid} can cause fatigue and weight gain.
e.zh: 甲状腺功能减退可能导致疲劳和体重增加。

e.en: The surgeon scheduled a {thyroidectomy} after the cancer diagnosis.
e.zh: 在确诊癌症后，外科医生安排了甲状腺切除手术。

e.en: Patients usually take hormone pills for life after a total {thyroidectomy}.
e.zh: 全甲状腺切除术后，患者通常需要终生服用激素药。

e.en: Hashimoto's {thyroiditis} is an autoimmune condition affecting many women.
e.zh: 桥本氏甲状腺炎是一种影响许多女性的自身免疫疾病。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed mild {thyroiditis} based on her elevated antibodies.
e.zh: 医生根据她升高的抗体诊断出轻度甲状腺炎。

e.en: The old proverb says, "Know {thyself} before judging others."
e.zh: 古谚说道：“在评判他人之前，先认识你自己。”

e.en: Shakespeare wrote, "To {thyself} be true," as timeless advice.
e.zh: 莎士比亚写下“忠于自己”作为永恒的箴言。

tia.t: n. 短暂性脑缺血发作

e.en: In Chinese philosophy, {tian} often refers to heaven or the cosmic order.
e.zh: 在中国哲学中，“天”常指上天或宇宙秩序。

e.en: The emperor claimed his authority came directly from {tian}.
e.zh: 皇帝声称他的权威直接来自天。

e.en: Tourists gathered at {tiananmen} Square to watch the flag-raising ceremony.
e.zh: 游客们聚集在天安门广场观看升旗仪式。

e.en: The gate of {tiananmen} stands at the heart of Beijing.
e.zh: 天安门城楼坐落在北京的中心。

e.en: The bride wore a sparkling {tiara} on her wedding day.
e.zh: 新娘在婚礼当天戴着一顶闪亮的头冠。

e.en: The princess waved while adjusting her diamond {tiara}.
e.zh: 公主一边挥手一边整理她的钻石头饰。

e.en: The ancient city of Rome grew along the banks of the {tiber}.
e.zh: 古罗马城在台伯河两岸发展起来。

e.en: Tourists tossed coins from a bridge over the {tiber}.
e.zh: 游客从横跨台伯河的桥上扔下硬币。

e.en: Emperor {tiberius} ruled Rome after the death of Augustus.
e.zh: 提比略皇帝在奥古斯都去世后统治了罗马。

e.en: Historians often portray {tiberius} as a reclusive and gloomy ruler.
e.zh: 历史学家常将提比略描绘成一位孤僻而阴郁的统治者。

e.en: Many travelers dream of visiting {tibet} for its dramatic mountain landscapes.
e.zh: 许多旅行者梦想去西藏欣赏壮丽的山地风光。

e.en: The high altitude in {tibet} can cause severe headaches for visitors.
e.zh: 西藏的高海拔会让游客出现剧烈的头痛。

tibetan.t:
adj. 西藏的
n. 藏族人；藏语

e.en: She studied {tibetan} Buddhism for three years in Nepal.
e.zh: 她在尼泊尔研究了三年的藏传佛教。

e.en: The monk chanted softly in {tibetan} during the morning ceremony.
e.zh: 在清晨的仪式中，僧人轻声用藏语诵经。

e.en: He fractured his {tibia} during a soccer match last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末他在踢足球时摔断了胫骨。

e.en: The {tibia} is the larger of the two bones in the lower leg.
e.zh: 胫骨是小腿两根骨头中较粗的一根。

e.en: The runner suffered a stress fracture in his {tibial} bone.
e.zh: 这名跑者的胫骨出现了应力性骨折。

e.en: The doctor checked her {tibial} pulse to assess blood flow.
e.zh: 医生检查了她的胫后动脉脉搏以评估血流情况。

e.en: Strengthening the {tibialis} anterior helps prevent shin splints in runners.
e.zh: 加强胫骨前肌有助于跑者预防胫骨疼痛。

e.en: The therapist massaged her tight {tibialis} muscle after the long run.
e.zh: 长跑之后，治疗师按摩了她紧绷的胫骨前肌。

tick.t:
v. 打勾；滴答作响
n. 勾号；蜱虫

e.en: Please {tick} the box if you agree to the terms.
e.zh: 如果您同意条款，请在方框内打勾。

e.en: A {tick} bit my dog during our walk in the woods.
e.zh: 我们在林间散步时，一只蜱虫咬了我的狗。

ticked.t:
v. 打勾（过去式）
adj. 恼火的

e.en: She {ticked} every item off her shopping list.
e.zh: 她把购物清单上的每一项都打了勾。

e.en: He was really {ticked} off after missing the last train.
e.zh: 错过末班车后他真的非常恼火。

ticker.t:
n. 股票行情显示条
n. 心脏（俚）

e.en: The stock {ticker} scrolled across the bottom of the screen.
e.zh: 股票行情条在屏幕底部滚动播出。

e.en: After the surgery, his {ticker} was working better than ever.
e.zh: 手术之后，他的“小心脏”比以往任何时候都跳得更好。

e.en: The astronauts received a {tickertape} parade through downtown New York.
e.zh: 宇航员们在纽约市中心接受了纸带飘飞的盛大游行。

e.en: Confetti fell like {tickertape} as the team celebrated their win.
e.zh: 球队庆祝胜利时，彩纸像彩带一样纷纷飘落。

e.en: This {thornless} rose variety is great for small gardens.
e.zh: 这种无刺玫瑰品种很适合小花园。

e.en: Gardeners prize the {thornless} blackberry for easy picking.
e.zh: 园丁们喜爱无刺黑莓，方便采摘。

thorns.t: n. 刺；荆棘（thorn 的复数）

e.en: The rose stem was covered in sharp {thorns}.
e.zh: 玫瑰的茎上长满了尖刺。

e.en: Every relationship has its roses and its {thorns}.
e.zh: 每段感情都有甜蜜也有烦恼。

e.en: Coach {Thornton} led the team to three straight wins.
e.zh: 索恩顿教练带领球队取得三连胜。

e.en: {Thornton} wrote a brilliant essay on urban planning.
e.zh: 索恩顿写了一篇关于城市规划的精彩论文。

thorny.t:
adj. 棘手的，麻烦的
adj. 多刺的

e.en: Privacy is a {thorny} issue for AI companies.
e.zh: 隐私对于 AI 公司来说是个棘手问题。

e.en: Be careful—those bushes are really {thorny}.
e.zh: 小心，那些灌木丛刺很多。

e.en: The doctor gave him a {thorough} physical exam.
e.zh: 医生给他做了一次彻底的体检。

e.en: Please do a {thorough} review of the contract.
e.zh: 请对合同做一次仔细的审阅。

thoroughbred.t:
adj. 纯种的
n. 纯种马

e.en: The auction featured a champion {thoroughbred} from Kentucky.
e.zh: 拍卖会上有一匹来自肯塔基的冠军纯种马。

e.en: That sports car is a {thoroughbred} on the track.
e.zh: 那辆跑车在赛道上堪称纯种猛兽。

e.en: Fifth Avenue is a busy {thoroughfare} in Manhattan.
e.zh: 第五大道是曼哈顿一条繁忙的主干道。

e.en: The market sits along the town's main {thoroughfare}.
e.zh: 市场就坐落在镇上的主干道旁。

e.en: The new CEO promised a {thoroughgoing} reform of the company.
e.zh: 新任 CEO 承诺对公司进行彻底的改革。

e.en: She is a {thoroughgoing} skeptic about cryptocurrency.
e.zh: 她对加密货币持彻底怀疑态度。

e.en: Please wash your hands {thoroughly} before cooking.
e.zh: 做饭前请把手彻底洗干净。

e.en: I {thoroughly} enjoyed the new Pixar movie.
e.zh: 我非常喜欢这部新的皮克斯电影。

e.en: Her {thoroughness} in research impressed the entire team.
e.zh: 她在研究中的细致程度让整个团队印象深刻。

e.en: The audit was praised for its {thoroughness} and clarity.
e.zh: 这次审计因细致和清晰而受到称赞。

e.en: The old {thorp} appears on maps from medieval England.
e.zh: 这个古老的小村庄出现在中世纪英格兰的地图上。

e.en: Many English place names end with {thorp} or 'thorpe'.
e.zh: 许多英语地名以 thorp 或 thorpe 结尾。

those.t:
pron. 那些
adj. 那些的

e.en: {Those} headphones on the desk are mine.
e.zh: 桌上那些耳机是我的。

e.en: I love {those} new jeans you wore yesterday.
e.zh: 我很喜欢你昨天穿的那条新牛仔裤。

e.en: Shakespeare often wrote, "{Thou} art my dearest friend."
e.zh: 莎士比亚常写道："你是我最亲爱的朋友。"

e.en: In old prayers, people address God as "{thou}".
e.zh: 在古老的祷文中，人们用"汝"来称呼上帝。

though.t:
conj. 虽然，尽管
adv. 不过

e.en: The movie was long, {though} surprisingly entertaining.
e.zh: 这部电影很长，不过出乎意料地有趣。

e.en: I'd love to come, {though} I might be late.
e.zh: 我很想去，不过可能会迟到。

thought.t:
n. 想法，思考
v. think 的过去式

e.en: That's an interesting {thought}—let me consider it.
e.zh: 这是个有趣的想法，让我考虑一下。

e.en: I {thought} the meeting started at three.
e.zh: 我以为会议是三点开始的。

e.en: The documentary was genuinely {thought-provoking} and beautifully shot.
e.zh: 这部纪录片确实发人深省,拍得也很美。

e.en: She asked a {thought-provoking} question after the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座结束后她提了一个发人深省的问题。

thoughtful.t:
adj. 体贴的
adj. 深思的

e.en: That was a really {thoughtful} gift from your sister.
e.zh: 你姐姐送的礼物真的很贴心。

e.en: He gave a {thoughtful} answer instead of reacting quickly.
e.zh: 他没有急着回应,而是给出了一个深思熟虑的答案。

thoughtfully.t: adv. 体贴地；若有所思地

e.en: She {thoughtfully} replied to every comment on her post.
e.zh: 她用心地回复了帖子下的每一条评论。

e.en: He {thoughtfully} stirred his coffee before answering the question.
e.zh: 他若有所思地搅着咖啡，然后才回答问题。

e.en: Her {thoughtfulness} in remembering my birthday really touched me.
e.zh: 她记得我的生日，这份体贴让我很感动。

e.en: The gift showed real {thoughtfulness} and care.
e.zh: 这份礼物体现了真正的用心和关怀。

e.en: That was a {thoughtless} comment about her appearance.
e.zh: 那是对她外貌的轻率评论。

e.en: His {thoughtless} parking blocked the entire driveway.
e.zh: 他随意停车堵住了整条车道。

e.en: He {thoughtlessly} forwarded the email to the wrong group.
e.zh: 他不假思索地把邮件转给了错误的群组。

e.en: She {thoughtlessly} left the door open all night.
e.zh: 她漫不经心地让门开了一整晚。

e.en: His {thoughtlessness} hurt his sister deeply.
e.zh: 他的轻率深深伤害了他的妹妹。

e.en: The mess was caused by sheer {thoughtlessness}.
e.zh: 这场混乱完全是因为缺乏考虑造成的。

thoughts.t: n. 想法，思绪（thought 的复数）

e.en: Share your {thoughts} in the comments below.
e.zh: 欢迎在下方评论区分享你的想法。

e.en: My {thoughts} kept drifting back to that conversation.
e.zh: 我的思绪不断飘回那次对话。

thousand.t:
num. 一千
n. 数以千计

e.en: The video got over a {thousand} views in an hour.
e.zh: 那段视频一小时内获得了一千多次观看。

e.en: A {thousand} thanks for helping me move yesterday.
e.zh: 非常感谢你昨天帮我搬家。

e.en: Productivity increased a {thousand-fold} after automation.
e.zh: 自动化之后生产效率提高了千倍。

e.en: The investment paid off {thousand-fold} over the years.
e.zh: 多年来这笔投资带来了千倍的回报。

e.en: Cloud storage made data access cheaper {thousandfold}.
e.zh: 云存储让数据访问的成本降低了千倍。

e.en: Their reach grew {thousandfold} after going viral.
e.zh: 走红之后他们的影响力增长了千倍。

thousandth.t:
num. 第一千
n. 千分之一

e.en: She was the {thousandth} customer and won a prize.
e.zh: 她是第一千位顾客，赢得了一份奖品。

e.en: This is the {thousandth} time I've explained the rule.
e.zh: 这是我第一千次解释这条规则了。

thousandths.t: n. 千分之几（thousandth 的复数）

e.en: The scale measures weight to the {thousandths} of a gram.
e.zh: 这台秤可以精确到千分之一克。

e.en: Race times differed by mere {thousandths} of a second.
e.zh: 比赛成绩仅相差千分之几秒。

thr.t: (罕用) 多为缩写前缀，如 thread/through

e.en: Ancient {Thrace} occupied parts of modern Bulgaria and Greece.
e.zh: 古色雷斯涵盖了今天保加利亚和希腊的部分地区。

e.en: The museum displays artifacts from {Thrace}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自色雷斯的文物。

thracian.t:
adj. 色雷斯的
n. 色雷斯人

e.en: Spartacus was a famous {Thracian} gladiator.
e.zh: 斯巴达克斯是著名的色雷斯角斗士。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {Thracian} tomb last summer.
e.zh: 考古学家去年夏天发掘了一座色雷斯古墓。

e.en: The audience sat in {thrall} as the magician performed.
e.zh: 观众被魔术师的表演完全迷住了。

e.en: He held the crowd in {thrall} with his speech.
e.zh: 他用演讲让人群如痴如醉。

e.en: The peasants lived in {thralldom} for generations.
e.zh: 农民们世世代代生活在奴役之中。

e.en: She broke free from the {thralldom} of social media.
e.zh: 她挣脱了社交媒体的束缚。

thrash.t:
v. 痛打；彻底击败
v. 剧烈挣动

e.en: The fish began to {thrash} wildly on the deck.
e.zh: 那条鱼在甲板上剧烈地扑腾。

e.en: Our team will {thrash} them in the finals.
e.zh: 我们队会在决赛中把他们打得落花流水。

e.en: The boat took a {thrashing} from the storm.
e.zh: 那艘船被风暴猛烈摇晃。

e.en: His server kept {thrashing} due to memory shortage.
e.zh: 由于内存不足，他的服务器不断出现抖动。

e.en: The abbreviation {thre} sometimes appears in old manuscripts for 'three'.
e.zh: 在古抄本中，{thre}有时作为"three"的缩写出现。

e.en: Editors marked {thre} as an archaic spelling variant.
e.zh: 编者将{thre}标注为古旧的拼写变体。

thread.t:
n. 线程；帖子串
n. 线，丝

e.en: I started a {thread} on Twitter about the new feature.
e.zh: 我在推特上发了一串帖讨论这个新功能。

e.en: She pulled the loose {thread} from her sleeve.
e.zh: 她把袖子上松开的线头扯了下来。

e.en: His {threadbare} jacket showed years of hard wear.
e.zh: 他那件磨得发亮的外套显出多年的辛劳。

e.en: The politician offered the same {threadbare} excuses again.
e.zh: 那位政客又拿出了老掉牙的借口。

threaded.t:
adj. 带螺纹的；多线程的
adj. 串联的（评论）

e.en: She {threaded} the needle on her first try.
e.zh: 她一次就把线穿过了针眼。

e.en: Reddit uses a {threaded} comment system.
e.zh: Reddit采用嵌套式的评论系统。

e.en: Multi-{threading} lets the app handle several tasks at once.
e.zh: 多线程让应用能同时处理多项任务。

e.en: She is {threading} beads onto a leather string.
e.zh: 她正把珠子串到皮绳上。

threadless.t: adj. 无螺纹的；无线程的

e.en: The bolt was {threadless} and slipped right out.
e.zh: 那颗螺栓没有螺纹，一下就滑了出来。

e.en: Designers sell custom shirts on {Threadless}.
e.zh: 设计师们在Threadless上出售定制T恤。

e.en: The microscope revealed {threadlike} fibers in the sample.
e.zh: 显微镜下样本中显出丝状的纤维。

e.en: A {threadlike} crack ran across the screen.
e.zh: 屏幕上有一道细如发丝的裂痕。

threads.t: n. 线程；帖子（thread 的复数）

e.en: Meta launched {Threads} as a Twitter alternative.
e.zh: Meta推出了Threads作为推特的替代品。

e.en: The sweater was unraveling into loose {threads}.
e.zh: 毛衣正散开成一根根松线。

thready.t: adj. 细弱的（脉搏）；丝状的

e.en: The patient had a weak, {thready} pulse.
e.zh: 病人的脉搏微弱而细丝般。

e.en: Her voice sounded {thready} after the long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后她的声音显得细弱无力。

e.en: Climate change poses a serious {threat} to coastal cities.
e.zh: 气候变化对沿海城市构成严重威胁。

e.en: He received a {threat} via anonymous email.
e.zh: 他收到了一封匿名邮件的威胁。

e.en: Rising sea levels {threaten} the entire island.
e.zh: 上升的海平面正威胁着整个岛屿。

e.en: Don't {threaten} me with legal action.
e.zh: 别拿法律诉讼来吓唬我。

threatened.t:
adj. 受到威胁的
v. threaten 的过去式

e.en: Pandas are no longer classified as {threatened}.
e.zh: 大熊猫不再被列为受威胁物种。

e.en: He {threatened} to quit if conditions didn't improve.
e.zh: 他威胁说如果情况不改善就辞职。

threatening.t: adj. 威胁性的；（天气）险恶的

e.en: She received {threatening} messages on Instagram.
e.zh: 她在Instagram上收到了威胁性的消息。

e.en: Dark clouds were {threatening} a heavy storm.
e.zh: 乌云密布，预示着一场暴风雨即将来临。

ticket.t:
n. 票；入场券
n. 罚单

e.en: I bought a one-way {ticket} to Tokyo last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚买了一张去东京的单程机票。

e.en: The officer gave him a parking {ticket} for blocking the driveway.
e.zh: 警官因他堵住车道而开了一张停车罚单。

ticketed.t:
adj. 已出票的
v. 开罚单（过去式）

e.en: He was {ticketed} for speeding on the highway last Friday.
e.zh: 上周五他在高速公路上超速被开了罚单。

e.en: All {ticketed} passengers should proceed to the boarding gate now.
e.zh: 所有已购票乘客现在请前往登机口。

e.en: Our {ticketing} system crashed minutes before the concert went on sale.
e.zh: 我们的票务系统在演唱会开售前几分钟崩溃了。

e.en: The airline introduced a new mobile {ticketing} app last month.
e.zh: 该航空公司上个月推出了一款新的移动购票应用。

e.en: Most airlines now offer {ticketless} travel through mobile boarding passes.
e.zh: 如今大多数航空公司都通过手机登机牌提供无纸化出行。

e.en: A {ticketless} passenger was removed from the train at the next stop.
e.zh: 一名无票乘客在下一站被请下了火车。

e.en: Concert {tickets} sold out within fifteen minutes of going online.
e.zh: 演唱会门票上线后十五分钟内就售罄了。

e.en: She booked two {tickets} for the museum exhibition this weekend.
e.zh: 她为本周末的博物馆展览订了两张票。

ticking.t:
n. 滴答声
n. 床垫布

e.en: The loud {ticking} of the clock kept her awake all night.
e.zh: 时钟响亮的滴答声让她整夜难眠。

e.en: With the deadline {ticking} closer, the team worked through the night.
e.zh: 截止时间一分一秒逼近，团队通宵赶工。

tickle.t:
v. 挠痒；使发痒
v. 逗乐

e.en: Don't {tickle} the baby right after she eats.
e.zh: 宝宝刚吃完饭别去挠她痒痒。

e.en: The wool sweater began to {tickle} the back of his neck.
e.zh: 羊毛衫开始让他的后颈发痒。

tickled.t:
v. 被挠痒（过去式）
adj. 感到开心的

e.en: She was absolutely {tickled} when her painting won first prize.
e.zh: 她的画作获得头奖时，她乐得不得了。

e.en: He {tickled} his little sister until she begged him to stop.
e.zh: 他挠妹妹的痒痒，直到她求他停下来。

tickler.t:
n. 备忘提醒
n. 难题

e.en: I keep a {tickler} file to remind me of upcoming deadlines.
e.zh: 我用一个备忘文件来提醒自己即将到来的截止日期。

e.en: Her assistant set up a digital {tickler} for follow-up emails.
e.zh: 她的助理设置了一个数字提醒来跟进邮件。

e.en: The grass {tickles} my feet whenever I walk barefoot in summer.
e.zh: 夏天我赤脚走路时，草总是把我的脚弄得痒痒的。

e.en: Her dry humor always {tickles} the audience in unexpected ways.
e.zh: 她那种冷幽默总能以意想不到的方式逗乐观众。

e.en: Stop {tickling} me — I can't breathe from laughing!
e.zh: 别再挠我痒痒了——我都笑得喘不过气来了！

e.en: A feather kept {tickling} her nose during the meditation session.
e.zh: 冥想时一根羽毛一直在挠她的鼻子。

ticklish.t:
adj. 怕痒的
adj. 棘手的

e.en: My younger brother is extremely {ticklish} around his ribs.
e.zh: 我弟弟肋骨那一带极其怕痒。

e.en: Negotiating salary can be a {ticklish} subject for new employees.
e.zh: 对新员工来说，谈薪水可能是个棘手的话题。

ticks.t:
n. 对勾；滴答声
n. 蜱虫

e.en: Always check for {ticks} after hiking through tall grass.
e.zh: 在高草丛中徒步后一定要检查身上有没有蜱虫。

e.en: He simply {ticks} every box on the application form.
e.zh: 他只是把申请表上每一个方框都打上勾。

e.en: A massive {tidal} wave struck the coastline after the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震过后，一道巨大的海啸袭击了海岸线。

e.en: The harbor's {tidal} patterns affect when ships can safely dock.
e.zh: 港口的潮汐规律决定了船只何时能安全靠岸。

tidbit.t:
n. 趣闻花絮
n. 小点心

e.en: She shared an interesting {tidbit} about the author's early life.
e.zh: 她分享了一则关于这位作者早年生活的有趣花絮。

e.en: The chef offered each guest a tasty {tidbit} before the main course.
e.zh: 主厨在主菜上桌前给每位客人送上一小份美味开胃菜。

e.en: The boy proudly held up the tiny {tiddler} he had caught.
e.zh: 小男孩骄傲地举起他刚抓到的那条小鱼。

e.en: Compared to the giants, our startup is still just a {tiddler}.
e.zh: 和那些巨头相比，我们的创业公司还只是个小不点。

tiddly.t:
adj. 微醉的
adj. 极小的

e.en: After two glasses of wine she felt a bit {tiddly}.
e.zh: 喝了两杯葡萄酒后，她觉得自己有点微醺。

e.en: He earns only a {tiddly} amount from his weekend gigs.
e.zh: 他周末兼职只能挣到一点点钱。

tide.t:
n. 潮汐；潮流
n. 趋势

e.en: We waited for the {tide} to come in before launching the boat.
e.zh: 我们等到涨潮之后才把船推下水。

e.en: A small loan should {tide} her over until next payday.
e.zh: 一笔小额贷款应该够她撑到下个发薪日。

e.en: Shells and seaweed marked the {tideline} along the empty beach.
e.zh: 贝壳和海藻标出了空旷海滩上的潮水线。

e.en: The children searched for treasures just above the {tideline}.
e.zh: 孩子们在潮水线上方搜寻着各种宝贝。

e.en: You could see a faint {tidemark} on the bathtub after draining it.
e.zh: 放掉水后，浴缸上能看到一圈淡淡的水渍线。

e.en: The flood left a muddy {tidemark} halfway up the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 洪水在厨房墙上留下了一道及半墙高的泥水痕。

tidepool.t: n. 潮池（退潮后留下的水洼）

e.en: We found tiny crabs hiding in a rocky {tidepool} at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时我们在岩石潮水潭里发现了几只小螃蟹。

e.en: Each {tidepool} was bursting with colorful sea anemones and snails.
e.zh: 每个潮水潭里都满是色彩斑斓的海葵和海螺。

e.en: The {tides} along this coast are unusually strong this season.
e.zh: 这一海岸本季节的潮汐异常强劲。

e.en: Political {tides} have shifted dramatically over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年间，政治潮流发生了戏剧性的变化。

e.en: The old town sits right at the {tidewater} of the wide river.
e.zh: 这座古镇正坐落在宽阔河流的潮汐水域旁。

e.en: Crabs are abundant in the shallow {tidewater} marshes nearby.
e.zh: 附近浅浅的潮汐沼泽里螃蟹很多。

e.en: Boats had to navigate carefully through the narrow {tideway}.
e.zh: 船只必须小心穿过狭窄的潮道。

e.en: The fisherman knew every current in the busy {tideway}.
e.zh: 渔夫熟悉这条繁忙潮道里的每一股水流。

e.en: She {tidied} her desk before leaving the office for vacation.
e.zh: 她在休假离开办公室前把桌子整理好了。

e.en: He {tidied} the living room while the guests were still arriving.
e.zh: 客人陆续到来时他还在整理客厅。

e.en: My roommate always {tidies} the kitchen right after dinner.
e.zh: 我的室友总是在晚饭后立刻把厨房收拾干净。

e.en: She {tidies} her room every Sunday without being asked.
e.zh: 她每个周日都不用别人提醒就主动整理房间。

e.en: The books were arranged {tidily} by color on the shelf.
e.zh: 书架上的书按颜色整整齐齐地排列着。

e.en: He folded the laundry {tidily} and stacked it on the bed.
e.zh: 他把洗好的衣服整齐地叠好，堆在床上。

e.en: Her obsession with {tidiness} drives her roommates a little crazy.
e.zh: 她对整洁的执念让室友们有点抓狂。

e.en: The hotel is famous for the {tidiness} of every guest room.
e.zh: 这家酒店以每间客房都整洁干净而闻名。

e.en: The messenger brought welcome {tiding} of victory from the front.
e.zh: 信使从前线带来了令人欣喜的胜利消息。

e.en: Carolers sang of good {tiding} on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 圣诞夜，颂歌者唱着传递佳音的歌曲。

tidy.t:
adj. 整洁的
v. 整理；收拾

e.en: Please {tidy} your room before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到之前请把你的房间整理一下。

e.en: She earned a {tidy} sum from the side project.
e.zh: 她从这个副业项目里赚了一笔可观的钱。

e.en: He spent the morning {tidying} up the kitchen.
e.zh: 他花了一早上整理厨房。

e.en: I'm {tidying} my desk before the meeting starts.
e.zh: 我在会议开始前整理一下桌子。

tie.t:
n. 领带；平局
v. 系；绑

e.en: She used a satin {tieback} to hold the curtain open.
e.zh: 她用一条缎带绑带把窗帘束开。

e.en: Each curtain came with a matching fabric {tieback}.
e.zh: 每幅窗帘都配有一条同色的束带。

e.en: The match went into a dramatic {tiebreaker} at six all.
e.zh: 比赛六比六平,进入了紧张的抢七。

e.en: Customer reviews served as the {tiebreaker} between two laptops.
e.zh: 用户评价成为两款笔记本之间的决定因素。

tied.t:
v. 系；绑（过去式）
adj. 打平的

e.en: She {tied} her hair back before starting the workout.
e.zh: 她把头发扎起来,然后开始锻炼。

e.en: The two teams {tied} two-two after extra time.
e.zh: 加时赛后两队以二比二战平。

e.en: The character {Tien} appears in many old kung fu films.
e.zh: 老功夫片里经常出现一个叫田的人物。

e.en: My friend {Tien} grew up in Hanoi before moving abroad.
e.zh: 我朋友天在搬到国外前在河内长大。

e.en: The treaty of {Tientsin} opened several Chinese ports to trade.
e.zh: 《天津条约》使多个中国港口对外通商。

e.en: Old maps still label the city as {Tientsin} rather than Tianjin.
e.zh: 旧地图上这座城市仍标作 Tientsin 而非天津。

e.en: The premium {tier} unlocks unlimited cloud storage.
e.zh: 高级套餐可以解锁无限云存储。

e.en: Our seats were on the upper {tier} of the stadium.
e.zh: 我们的座位在体育场的上层看台。

e.en: The bakery delivered a beautiful three-{tiered} wedding cake.
e.zh: 那家面包店送来了一个漂亮的三层婚礼蛋糕。

e.en: They use a {tiered} pricing model based on team size.
e.zh: 他们采用按团队规模划分的分级定价模式。

tierra.t: n. 土地（西班牙语借词）

e.en: The Spanish word {tierra} simply means earth or land.
e.zh: 西班牙语单词 tierra 意思就是大地或土地。

e.en: We sailed past {Tierra} del Fuego on a research trip.
e.zh: 我们在科考途中航经火地岛。

ties.t:
n. 领带；关系（复数）
v. 系（三单）

e.en: He owns a dozen silk {ties} in different colors.
e.zh: 他有十几条不同颜色的真丝领带。

e.en: She still has strong family {ties} to her hometown.
e.zh: 她和家乡仍有很深的家庭联系。

tiff.t:
n. 小争吵
n. TIFF 图像格式

e.en: The couple had a small {tiff} over weekend plans.
e.zh: 这对情侣因为周末安排闹了点小别扭。

e.en: Save the photo as a {TIFF} to preserve quality.
e.zh: 把照片存成 TIFF 格式以保留画质。

e.en: He proposed with a ring from {Tiffany} and Co.
e.zh: 他用蒂芙尼的戒指向她求婚。

e.en: The lamp featured a stained-glass {Tiffany} shade.
e.zh: 那盏灯配着一个蒂芙尼风格的彩色玻璃灯罩。

e.en: A wild {tiger} was spotted near the village last week.
e.zh: 上周有人在村子附近发现了一只野生老虎。

e.en: She's a real {tiger} when negotiating contracts.
e.zh: 她在谈判合同时简直像头猛虎。

e.en: He attacked the problem with {tigerish} determination.
e.zh: 他以猛虎般的决心扑向这个问题。

e.en: Her {tigerish} energy on stage stunned the audience.
e.zh: 她在台上虎虎生风的能量震撼了观众。

e.en: Wild {tigers} are critically endangered across most of Asia.
e.zh: 野生老虎在亚洲大部分地区处于极度濒危状态。

e.en: The Detroit {Tigers} won the home game last night.
e.zh: 底特律老虎队昨晚赢下了主场比赛。

tight.t:
adj. 紧的；牢固的
adj. 紧张的

e.en: These jeans feel a bit too {tight} around the waist.
e.zh: 这条牛仔裤腰部感觉有点紧。

e.en: We're on a {tight} deadline to ship by Friday.
e.zh: 我们要在周五前发布,时间非常紧。

e.en: Please {tighten} the screws before mounting the shelf.
e.zh: 装架子之前请把螺丝拧紧。

e.en: The company plans to {tighten} its security policies.
e.zh: 公司计划收紧其安全政策。

e.en: He {tightened} his grip on the steering wheel nervously.
e.zh: 他紧张地握紧了方向盘。

e.en: The government {tightened} restrictions on imported electronics.
e.zh: 政府加强了对进口电子产品的限制。

tightening.t:
v. 收紧；变紧
n. 紧缩

e.en: The central bank is {tightening} monetary policy this quarter.
e.zh: 央行本季度正在收紧货币政策。

e.en: I felt my chest {tightening} as the plane took off.
e.zh: 飞机起飞时我感到胸口发紧。

tightens.t: v. 使变紧；收紧（tighten 第三人称单数）

e.en: This serum visibly {tightens} the skin within minutes.
e.zh: 这款精华几分钟内就能让肌肤明显紧致。
