e.en: As the deadline nears, pressure {tightens} on the team.
e.zh: 随着截止日期临近,团队的压力越来越大。

tighter.t: adj. 更紧的；更严格的（tight 的比较级）

e.en: Could you make the belt one notch {tighter}?
e.zh: 能把腰带再紧一格吗?

e.en: The new law sets {tighter} rules on data privacy.
e.zh: 新法律对数据隐私制定了更严格的规则。

e.en: His {tightfisted} boss refused to pay for overtime meals.
e.zh: 他那吝啬的老板不肯报销加班餐。

e.en: Don't be so {tightfisted} on your daughter's birthday.
e.zh: 在女儿生日上别这么抠门。

e.en: She held the baby {tightly} during the bumpy ride.
e.zh: 颠簸的路上她紧紧地抱着宝宝。

e.en: The lid must be screwed on {tightly} to avoid leaks.
e.zh: 盖子必须拧紧以防漏液。

tightness.t:
n. 紧绷；紧密
n. 拮据

e.en: He felt a sudden {tightness} in his chest.
e.zh: 他突然感到胸口一阵发紧。

e.en: Stretching helps relieve {tightness} in your shoulders.
e.zh: 拉伸有助于缓解肩膀的紧绷感。

tightrope.t: n. 绷紧的钢丝；走钢丝

e.en: The acrobat walked across the {tightrope} without a net.
e.zh: 杂技演员在没有保护网的情况下走过钢丝。

e.en: Managers walk a {tightrope} between speed and quality.
e.zh: 管理者在速度和质量之间走着钢丝。

e.en: Performers practiced on low {tightropes} before going higher.
e.zh: 演员们先在低钢丝上练习再升高高度。

e.en: Diplomats often walk political {tightropes} during peace talks.
e.zh: 外交官在和谈中常常走在政治钢丝上。

e.en: She wore black {tights} under her winter dress.
e.zh: 她在冬装裙子里面穿了黑色连裤袜。

e.en: The dancer pulled on her practice {tights} backstage.
e.zh: 那位舞者在后台穿上了练习用的紧身裤。

e.en: Don't be a {tightwad}; tip the waiter properly.
e.zh: 别这么抠门,该好好给服务员小费。

e.en: My uncle's a lovable {tightwad} who clips every coupon.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个讨人喜欢的吝啬鬼,每张优惠券都剪。

e.en: In Spanish class we learned that {tigre} means tiger.
e.zh: 西班牙语课上我们学到 tigre 就是老虎。

e.en: We took a boat tour through the {Tigre} delta near Buenos Aires.
e.zh: 我们在布宜诺斯艾利斯附近坐船游览了 Tigre 三角洲。

e.en: The {tigress} fiercely defended her cubs from intruders.
e.zh: 母老虎凶猛地保护幼崽不被入侵者伤害。

e.en: She fought like a {tigress} to protect her startup.
e.zh: 她像母老虎一样拼命守护自己的创业公司。

e.en: Ancient civilizations flourished along the {Tigris} river valley.
e.zh: 古代文明在底格里斯河流域繁荣发展。

e.en: The {Tigris} flows through Iraq before joining the Euphrates.
e.zh: 底格里斯河流经伊拉克,最终汇入幼发拉底河。

e.en: The little {tike} ran giggling across the playground.
e.zh: 那个小不点咯咯笑着跑过操场。

e.en: Every {tike} in the neighborhood loves the ice-cream van.
e.zh: 街区里每个小孩都喜欢那辆冰淇淋车。

tiki.t: n. 提基神像；波利尼西亚风格装饰

e.en: They opened a {tiki} bar with rum cocktails downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心开了一家提供朗姆鸡尾酒的提基酒吧。

e.en: A wooden {tiki} statue stood at the entrance of the resort.
e.zh: 度假村门口立着一尊木制提基神像。

tikka.t: n. 提卡（印度烤肉菜肴）

e.en: I ordered chicken {tikka} masala with garlic naan.
e.zh: 我点了印度香料烤鸡配蒜香烤饼。

e.en: The {tikka} was marinated in yogurt and spices overnight.
e.zh: 这道印式烤肉用酸奶和香料腌了一整晚。

til.t: prep./conj. 直到（= till/until 的缩写）

e.en: Grilled {tilapia} with lemon makes a quick weeknight dinner.
e.zh: 柠檬烤罗非鱼是一道便捷的工作日晚餐。

e.en: This farm raises {tilapia} in large freshwater tanks.
e.zh: 这家养殖场在大型淡水池里养殖罗非鱼。

e.en: A polished {tilbury} carriage waited outside the manor.
e.zh: 一辆擦得锃亮的双轮马车停在庄园外。

e.en: The ship docked at the port of {Tilbury} near London.
e.zh: 船在伦敦附近的提尔伯里港靠岸。

e.en: The Spanish letter ñ has a {tilde} above it.
e.zh: 西班牙字母 ñ 上面有一个波浪号。

e.en: Use a {tilde} to refer to your home directory in Linux.
e.zh: 在 Linux 中用波浪号表示你的家目录。

tile.t:
n. 瓷砖；瓦片
v. 铺瓷砖

e.en: He laid a new ceramic {tile} on the bathroom floor.
e.zh: 他在浴室地板上铺了一块新的瓷砖。

e.en: Drag the {tile} to rearrange your dashboard widgets.
e.zh: 拖动磁贴可以重新排列你的仪表盘组件。

tiled.t:
adj. 铺了瓷砖的
v. 铺砖（过去式）

e.en: The kitchen has a beautifully {tiled} backsplash in blue.
e.zh: 厨房贴着一面漂亮的蓝色瓷砖防溅墙。

e.en: My editor displays files in a {tiled} window layout.
e.zh: 我的编辑器以平铺窗口布局显示文件。

e.en: We hired a skilled {tiler} to redo the bathroom floor.
e.zh: 我们请了一位手艺好的瓷砖工重铺浴室地板。

e.en: The {tiler} finished the kitchen wall in just two days.
e.zh: 那位贴砖师傅两天就完成了厨房墙面。

tiles.t:
n. 瓷砖（复数）
v. 铺砖

e.en: The roof {tiles} were damaged after the heavy storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后屋顶的瓦片受到了损坏。

e.en: You can drag app {tiles} to customize the home screen.
e.zh: 你可以拖动应用磁贴来自定义主屏幕。

tiling.t:
n. 铺砖；瓷砖面
v. 铺设瓷砖

e.en: He spent the weekend {tiling} the bathroom walls.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在给浴室墙贴瓷砖。

e.en: This window manager uses a {tiling} layout by default.
e.zh: 这个窗口管理器默认使用平铺布局。

till.t:
prep./conj. 直到
n. 收银机抽屉

e.en: I won't leave the office {till} the report is done.
e.zh: 报告完成之前我不会离开办公室。

e.en: The cashier opened the {till} to give him change.
e.zh: 收银员打开收银机给他找零。

e.en: Modern {tillage} practices help conserve soil moisture.
e.zh: 现代耕作方式有助于保持土壤水分。

e.en: Reducing {tillage} can lower carbon emissions on farms.
e.zh: 减少翻耕可以降低农场的碳排放。

e.en: Farmers {tilled} the field before planting corn.
e.zh: 农民们在种玉米之前翻耕了田地。

e.en: The freshly {tilled} soil smelled rich and earthy.
e.zh: 刚翻耕过的土壤散发着浓郁的泥土气息。

tiller.t:
n. 舵柄
n. 耕作者

e.en: He gripped the {tiller} firmly as the boat turned.
e.zh: 船转弯时他紧紧握住舵柄。

e.en: Use a small {tiller} to break up the garden soil.
e.zh: 用一台小型耕地机翻松花园的土壤。

tilling.t:
v. 耕作（土地）
n. 耕种

e.en: They were {tilling} the fields well before sunrise.
e.zh: 他们在日出前就开始耕地了。

e.en: No-{tilling} farming protects the soil from erosion.
e.zh: 免耕农业可以保护土壤免受侵蚀。

tills.t:
n. 收银抽屉（复数）
v. 耕种

e.en: All the supermarket {tills} were busy on Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 周日下午超市所有收银台都很忙。

e.en: He {tills} a small plot behind his cottage every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天他都会翻耕小屋后的一小块地。

tilt.t:
v. 倾斜；使倾侧
n. 倾角

e.en: The old bookshelf began to {tilt} dangerously to one side.
e.zh: 那个旧书架开始危险地向一边倾斜。

e.en: Recent polls show a {tilt} toward younger candidates.
e.zh: 最近的民调显示选民倾向更年轻的候选人。

tilted.t:
adj. 倾斜的
v. 使倾斜（过去式）

e.en: She {tilted} her head to listen more carefully.
e.zh: 她歪着头更仔细地听。

e.en: The painting on the wall was slightly {tilted}.
e.zh: 墙上的画微微倾斜着。

e.en: The garden soil has excellent {tilth} after years of composting.
e.zh: 经过多年堆肥，菜园的土壤质地极佳。

e.en: Farmers work the field to improve its {tilth}.
e.zh: 农民耕作田地以改善土壤的耕性。

tilting.t:
v. 倾斜；翘起
adj. 可倾斜的

e.en: The boat was {tilting} dangerously to one side.
e.zh: 船危险地向一侧倾斜。

e.en: He kept {tilting} his phone to see the screen better.
e.zh: 他不停地倾斜手机以便看清屏幕。

timbale.t: n. 蒂姆巴菜（碗状馅料菜肴）

e.en: The chef served a delicate seafood {timbale} as a starter.
e.zh: 主厨上了一道精致的海鲜模子菜作为前菜。

e.en: She baked a vegetable {timbale} for the dinner party.
e.zh: 她为晚宴烤了一道蔬菜模子菜。

e.en: The cabin was built from local {timber}.
e.zh: 这间小木屋是用当地木材建造的。

e.en: They harvest {timber} sustainably from the forest.
e.zh: 他们以可持续方式从森林采伐木材。

timbered.t: adj. 木造的；林木茂密的

e.en: The old village has many {timbered} houses.
e.zh: 那座古老的村庄有许多木结构房屋。

e.en: We stayed in a charming {timbered} cottage.
e.zh: 我们住在一间迷人的木结构小屋里。

e.en: The company owns thousands of acres of {timberland}.
e.zh: 该公司拥有数千英亩的林地。

e.en: Hikers crossed the dense {timberland} at dawn.
e.zh: 徒步者在黎明时穿越茂密的林地。

timberline.t: n. 树林线；林木生长极限线

e.en: We climbed above the {timberline} to reach the summit.
e.zh: 我们爬过树木线才到达山顶。

e.en: No trees grow beyond the {timberline} on this mountain.
e.zh: 这座山的树木线以上没有树木生长。

e.en: Her voice has a warm, rich {timbre}.
e.zh: 她的嗓音音色温暖而醇厚。

e.en: Each instrument produces a unique {timbre}.
e.zh: 每种乐器都能发出独特的音色。

timbuktu.t: n. 廷巴克图（马里城市，喻指遥远之地）

e.en: He joked that his keys had vanished to {Timbuktu}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说钥匙已经消失到天涯海角了。

e.en: The ancient city of {Timbuktu} sits on the Niger River.
e.zh: 古城廷巴克图坐落在尼日尔河畔。

time.t:
n. 时间；次数
v. 计时

e.en: Do you have {time} for a quick coffee?
e.zh: 你有时间喝杯咖啡吗？

e.en: The app reminds me to {time} my workouts.
e.zh: 这款应用提醒我为锻炼计时。

e.en: Editing videos can be very {time-consuming}.
e.zh: 剪辑视频可能非常耗时。

e.en: Manual data entry is a {time-consuming} task.
e.zh: 手动录入数据是一项耗时的工作。

e.en: Ignoring the warning signs is a financial {timebomb}.
e.zh: 忽视警示信号无异于一颗财务定时炸弹。

e.en: The aging bridge has become a safety {timebomb}.
e.zh: 这座老旧的桥梁已成为一颗安全定时炸弹。

e.en: Don't forget to punch your {timecard} before leaving.
e.zh: 下班前别忘了打考勤卡。

e.en: She submitted her weekly {timecard} online.
e.zh: 她在网上提交了每周的考勤卡。

timed.t:
adj. 计时的，定时的
v. time 的过去式

e.en: The runner {timed} her sprint with a stopwatch.
e.zh: 跑者用秒表为自己的冲刺计时。

e.en: His joke was perfectly {timed} for the moment.
e.zh: 他的笑话时机把握得恰到好处。

e.en: What's the {timeframe} for finishing this project?
e.zh: 完成这个项目的时间框架是多久？

e.en: We need a realistic {timeframe} for the launch.
e.zh: 我们需要一个切合实际的发布时间框架。

e.en: The {timekeeper} signaled the end of the match.
e.zh: 计时员示意比赛结束。

e.en: My smartwatch is a reliable daily {timekeeper}.
e.zh: 我的智能手表是日常可靠的计时器。

e.en: Accurate {timekeeping} is essential in athletics.
e.zh: 在体育比赛中准确计时至关重要。

e.en: The app simplifies employee {timekeeping}.
e.zh: 该应用简化了员工的考勤记录。

timeless.t: adj. 永恒的，不受时间影响的

e.en: Black dresses are a {timeless} fashion choice.
e.zh: 黑色连衣裙是经典永恒的时尚选择。

e.en: His music has a {timeless} appeal across generations.
e.zh: 他的音乐对几代人都有永恒的魅力。

e.en: The classic novel reads {timelessly} well today.
e.zh: 这部经典小说至今读来依然不朽。

e.en: The actress dresses {timelessly} for every event.
e.zh: 这位女演员每次活动都穿得永不过时。

e.en: The painting captures a sense of {timelessness}.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了一种永恒之感。

e.en: There is a {timelessness} to her grandmother's recipes.
e.zh: 她外婆的食谱有一种历久弥新的味道。

e.en: Please share the project {timeline} by Friday.
e.zh: 请在周五前分享项目时间线。

e.en: I scrolled through my Twitter {timeline} this morning.
e.zh: 今早我刷了一下推特时间线。

e.en: The {timeliness} of the report impressed the board.
e.zh: 报告的及时性给董事会留下了深刻印象。

e.en: News apps are valued for their {timeliness}.
e.zh: 新闻应用因其时效性而受到重视。

e.en: The editor compared the {timelinesses} of various news outlets.
e.zh: 编辑比较了各家新闻机构的时效性。

e.en: Researchers measured the {timelinesses} of multiple data sources.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了多个数据源的时效性。

e.en: Thanks for the {timely} reminder about the deadline.
e.zh: 谢谢你及时提醒我截止日期。

e.en: A {timely} update saved the system from crashing.
e.zh: 一次及时的更新避免了系统崩溃。

e.en: He inherited a beautiful antique {timepiece}.
e.zh: 他继承了一只精美的古董钟表。

e.en: The watchmaker repaired the vintage {timepiece}.
e.zh: 钟表匠修好了那只复古钟表。

e.en: Set a {timer} for fifteen minutes for the pasta.
e.zh: 为意面定一个十五分钟的计时器。

e.en: The kitchen {timer} beeped loudly when the cake was done.
e.zh: 蛋糕烤好时厨房计时器响亮地响了。

times.t:
n. 时代；次数
prep. 乘以

e.en: I've watched that movie three {times} already.
e.zh: 我已经看过那部电影三次了。

e.en: Modern {times} demand new ways of working.
e.zh: 现代社会需要新的工作方式。

timescale.t: n. 时间尺度，时间跨度

e.en: Climate change operates on a long {timescale}.
e.zh: 气候变化在较长的时间尺度上发生。

e.en: What {timescale} are we looking at for delivery?
e.zh: 我们的交付时间尺度是多久？

timeshare.t: n. 分时度假（房产）；分时共享

e.en: They bought a beachfront {timeshare} in Florida.
e.zh: 他们在佛罗里达买了一套海滨分时度假房。

e.en: The {timeshare} sales pitch lasted two hours.
e.zh: 分时度假的销售推介持续了两个小时。

timespan.t: n. 时间跨度，持续时间

e.en: The study covers a {timespan} of fifty years.
e.zh: 这项研究涵盖了五十年的时间跨度。

e.en: That's a short {timespan} for such a big change.
e.zh: 对于如此大的变化来说，那是个很短的时间跨度。

timetable.t:
n. 时间表，课程表
v. 安排时间

e.en: Check the bus {timetable} before leaving home.
e.zh: 出门前先查一下公交时刻表。

e.en: The school posted a new exam {timetable} online.
e.zh: 学校在网上发布了新的考试时间表。

timetabled.t: v. timetable 的过去式，已列入日程

e.en: The meeting is {timetabled} for next Tuesday.
e.zh: 会议安排在下周二。

e.en: All classes are {timetabled} to avoid overlap.
e.zh: 所有课程都已排好以避免冲突。

e.en: Train {timetables} have changed for the holidays.
e.zh: 火车时刻表因假期已作调整。

e.en: Schools publish their {timetables} online each term.
e.zh: 学校每学期都在网上公布课程表。

e.en: {Timetabling} hundreds of classes is a complex task.
e.zh: 为数百门课程排课是一项复杂的工作。

e.en: The software handles staff {timetabling} automatically.
e.zh: 该软件自动处理员工排班。

e.en: The {timeworn} steps led up to the old chapel.
e.zh: 那饱经岁月的台阶通向古老的教堂。

e.en: He told a {timeworn} joke that no one laughed at.
e.zh: 他讲了一个老掉牙的笑话，没人发笑。

e.en: My dad still wears the {Timex} he bought decades ago.
e.zh: 我爸爸还戴着几十年前买的天美时手表。

e.en: The classic {Timex} watch is famous for its durability.
e.zh: 经典的天美时手表以耐用著称。

e.en: The {timid} kitten hid under the sofa.
e.zh: 那只胆小的小猫藏在沙发底下。

e.en: She gave a {timid} smile when introduced to the group.
e.zh: 被介绍给大家时她羞涩地笑了笑。

e.en: The therapist helped clients overcome various {timidities}.
e.zh: 治疗师帮助来访者克服各种胆怯。

e.en: Childhood {timidities} often fade as people grow older.
e.zh: 童年的种种胆怯常随着年龄增长而消退。

e.en: His {timidity} kept him from speaking up in meetings.
e.zh: 他的胆怯使他在会议上不敢发言。

e.en: She slowly overcame her {timidity} through public speaking.
e.zh: 她通过公开演讲渐渐克服了胆怯。

e.en: The new student raised her hand {timidly} during class.
e.zh: 那位新生在课堂上怯生生地举起了手。

e.en: He {timidly} asked his boss for a day off.
e.zh: 他怯怯地向老板请了一天假。

e.en: Comedy depends heavily on good {timing} and delivery.
e.zh: 喜剧很大程度上依赖于精准的节奏感和表达。

e.en: The {timing} of the announcement caught everyone off guard.
e.zh: 宣布消息的时机让所有人都措手不及。

timings.t: n. 时间安排，时刻（复数）

e.en: Please double-check the train {timings} before heading to the station.
e.zh: 去车站之前请再确认一下列车的时刻。

e.en: The athlete's lap {timings} improved steadily over the season.
e.zh: 这位运动员单圈成绩这一赛季稳步提升。

timisoara.t: n. 蒂米什瓦拉（罗马尼亚城市）

e.en: {Timisoara} was named European Capital of Culture in 2023.
e.zh: 蒂米什瓦拉在2023年被评为欧洲文化之都。

e.en: We took a weekend trip from Budapest to {Timisoara}.
e.zh: 我们从布达佩斯出发去蒂米什瓦拉做了一次周末旅行。

timor.t: n. 帝汶岛（东南亚岛屿）

e.en: East {Timor} gained full independence in 2002.
e.zh: 东帝汶在2002年取得了完全独立。

e.en: The island of {Timor} is divided between two countries.
e.zh: 帝汶岛由两个国家分别管辖。

timorese.t:
n. 帝汶人
adj. 帝汶的

e.en: Many {Timorese} families speak both Tetum and Portuguese.
e.zh: 许多帝汶家庭同时说德顿语和葡萄牙语。

e.en: The {Timorese} delegation attended the climate summit in Geneva.
e.zh: 帝汶代表团出席了在日内瓦举行的气候峰会。

e.en: He gave a {timorous} smile when introduced to the crowd.
e.zh: 被介绍给人群时,他露出了一个胆怯的微笑。

e.en: The {timorous} kitten hid behind the sofa all afternoon.
e.zh: 那只胆小的小猫整个下午都躲在沙发后面。

timothy.t: n. 提摩太（人名）；梯牧草

e.en: Farmers feed their horses dried {timothy} hay in winter.
e.zh: 农民冬天会用晒干的猫尾草喂马。

e.en: My cousin {Timothy} just started his first job in Boston.
e.zh: 我表弟蒂莫西刚在波士顿开始了第一份工作。

e.en: The {timpani} thundered dramatically at the symphony's climax.
e.zh: 在交响乐高潮处,定音鼓发出了戏剧性的轰鸣。

e.en: She has played {timpani} in the orchestra for ten years.
e.zh: 她在乐团里担任定音鼓手已经十年了。

e.en: The orchestra's {timpanist} struck the drum with perfect precision.
e.zh: 乐团的定音鼓手击鼓的时机精准无比。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {timpanist}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为一名专业的定音鼓手。

e.en: He added a few drops of herbal {tincture} to his tea.
e.zh: 他在茶里滴了几滴草药酊剂。

e.en: The pharmacist mixed a {tincture} of iodine for the wound.
e.zh: 药剂师配了一些碘酊用来处理伤口。

e.en: Dry leaves make excellent {tinder} for starting a campfire.
e.zh: 干树叶是生火的绝佳引火物。

e.en: She matched with someone interesting on {Tinder} last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚在Tinder上匹配到一个有趣的人。

tinderbox.t: n. 火药桶；一触即发之地

e.en: The crowded square became a political {tinderbox} after the protest.
e.zh: 抗议后,拥挤的广场成了一触即发的政治火药桶。

e.en: He kept an old {tinderbox} on the fireplace mantel.
e.zh: 他在壁炉架上放着一个旧火绒盒。

e.en: One {tine} of the fork bent when it hit the plate.
e.zh: 叉子的一个齿撞到盘子时弯了。

e.en: The deer's antler had a broken {tine} near the base.
e.zh: 那只鹿角靠近根部有一个断掉的尖叉。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed his itchy rash as {tinea} pedis.
e.zh: 医生诊断他瘙痒的皮疹为足癣。

e.en: Athletes often get {tinea} from sharing locker room showers.
e.zh: 运动员常因共用更衣室淋浴而感染癣菌病。

e.en: She used a four-{tined} fork for the salad.
e.zh: 她用一把四齿叉来吃沙拉。

e.en: The gardener bought a sturdy three-{tined} pitchfork.
e.zh: 园丁买了一把结实的三齿干草叉。

e.en: The {tines} of the rake gathered fallen leaves easily.
e.zh: 耙子的齿轻松地把落叶聚拢起来。

e.en: Food got stuck between the {tines} of his fork.
e.zh: 食物卡在他叉子的齿缝之间。

e.en: Wrap the leftover chicken in {tinfoil} before refrigerating.
e.zh: 把吃剩的鸡肉用锡箔纸包好再冷藏。

e.en: He jokingly wore a {tinfoil} hat during the conspiracy debate.
e.zh: 他在阴谋论辩论中开玩笑地戴上了锡箔帽。

ting.t: n. 叮的一声（清脆声响）

e.en: The spoon made a small {ting} against the teacup.
e.zh: 勺子轻轻碰到茶杯发出叮的一声。

e.en: A faint {ting} sounded as the elevator reached her floor.
e.zh: 电梯到达她那层时传来一声轻微的叮响。

tinge.t:
n. 淡色；些许
v. 微染

e.en: Her cheeks had a pink {tinge} after the cold walk.
e.zh: 散步受寒后她的脸颊泛着一丝粉红。

e.en: His voice carried a {tinge} of regret at the end.
e.zh: 他的声音在最后带着一丝悔意。

tingle.t:
v. 感到刺痛
n. 刺痛感

e.en: I felt a {tingle} of excitement before the concert started.
e.zh: 演唱会开始前我感到一阵兴奋的悸动。

e.en: My fingers {tingle} when the cold wind hits them.
e.zh: 冷风一吹我的手指就发麻。

tingling.t:
adj. 刺痛的
n. 麻刺感

e.en: A {tingling} sensation ran down her spine during the speech.
e.zh: 演讲时她的脊背一阵酥麻。

e.en: My foot was {tingling} after sitting cross-legged too long.
e.zh: 盘腿坐太久后我的脚在发麻。

e.en: The ice cubes made a soft {tink} in the glass.
e.zh: 冰块在杯子里发出轻柔的叮响。

e.en: I heard a tiny {tink} as the coin hit the floor.
e.zh: 硬币掉到地上时我听到一声细小的叮响。

tinker.t:
v. 胡乱修补；瞎捣鼓
n. 补锅匠

e.en: He likes to {tinker} with old radios on weekends.
e.zh: 他喜欢周末摆弄老式收音机。

e.en: The engineers continue to {tinker} with the search algorithm.
e.zh: 工程师们仍在不断微调搜索算法。

tinkerbell.t: n. 小叮当（彼得潘里的小仙女）

e.en: The little girl dressed as {Tinkerbell} for Halloween.
e.zh: 小女孩万圣节扮成了小叮当。

e.en: {Tinkerbell} sprinkles pixie dust to help the children fly.
e.zh: 小叮当撒下精灵粉,帮助孩子们飞起来。

tinkered.t: v. tinker 的过去式；摆弄过

e.en: He {tinkered} with the engine all afternoon but failed.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在摆弄发动机,却没修好。

e.en: The team {tinkered} with the website's layout for weeks.
e.zh: 团队花了几周时间反复调整网站布局。

e.en: My grandfather was a lifelong {tinkerer} and inventor.
e.zh: 我爷爷一辈子都是个爱捣鼓东西的发明家。

e.en: She's a creative {tinkerer} who builds robots from spare parts.
e.zh: 她是个有创造力的修补匠,用零件造机器人。

tinkering.t:
v. tinker 的现在分词
n. 小修小补

e.en: Stop {tinkering} with the settings and just use defaults.
e.zh: 别再瞎调设置了,直接用默认值吧。

e.en: Hours of {tinkering} finally got the printer working again.
e.zh: 折腾了好几个小时,打印机终于又能用了。

tinkers.t:
n. 补锅匠（复数）
v. 瞎鼓捣

e.en: He always {tinkers} with his code right before deployment.
e.zh: 他总是在部署前才折腾自己的代码。

e.en: Traveling {tinkers} once mended pots from village to village.
e.zh: 流动的补锅匠曾走村串户修补锅具。

tinkle.t:
v. 发出叮当声
n. 叮当声

e.en: I heard the {tinkle} of wind chimes on the porch.
e.zh: 我听见门廊上风铃的叮当声。

e.en: Coins {tinkle} in the donation jar at the counter.
e.zh: 硬币在柜台的捐款罐里叮当作响。

e.en: The {tinkling} of bells filled the quiet temple courtyard.
e.zh: 铃声叮当回响在寂静的寺院庭院里。

e.en: Ice cubes were {tinkling} softly in her cocktail glass.
e.zh: 冰块在她的鸡尾酒杯里轻轻叮当作响。

e.en: The cafe played soft, {tinkly} piano music in the background.
e.zh: 咖啡馆背景里放着轻柔叮当的钢琴乐。

e.en: She loved the {tinkly} sound of her charm bracelet.
e.zh: 她喜欢她那串小饰物手链发出的叮当声。

e.en: We packed {tinned} tomatoes and pasta for the camping trip.
e.zh: 我们带了罐装番茄和意面去露营。

e.en: {Tinned} tuna is a cheap and convenient protein source.
e.zh: 罐装金枪鱼是便宜又方便的蛋白质来源。

e.en: Loud concerts can lead to permanent {tinnitus} over time.
e.zh: 长期听大音量演唱会可能导致永久性耳鸣。

e.en: He's had ringing {tinnitus} in his left ear for years.
e.zh: 他左耳的耳鸣已经持续好几年了。

tinny.t: adj. 像铁皮的；声音单薄的

e.en: The cheap speakers produced a thin, {tinny} sound.
e.zh: 那些便宜音箱发出单薄刺耳的金属声。

e.en: Her voice sounded {tinny} over the old phone line.
e.zh: 她的声音通过老电话线听起来很尖细失真。

e.en: Old toys were often made from stamped {tinplate}.
e.zh: 旧玩具常用冲压的镀锡铁皮制成。

e.en: The factory exports {tinplate} for canning food worldwide.
e.zh: 该工厂出口马口铁供全球食品罐装使用。

e.en: Several {tins} of cookies sat on the kitchen shelf.
e.zh: 厨房架子上摆着好几罐饼干。

e.en: She collected vintage biscuit {tins} from antique shops.
e.zh: 她在古董店收集复古饼干铁盒。

tinsel.t: n. 装饰金属丝；华而不实之物

e.en: We hung silver {tinsel} on the Christmas tree branches.
e.zh: 我们把银色金属丝挂在圣诞树的枝头。

e.en: The party decorations included balloons and shiny {tinsel}.
e.zh: 派对装饰里有气球和闪亮的金属丝带。

e.en: She moved to {Tinseltown} hoping to become a movie star.
e.zh: 她搬到好莱坞,希望能成为电影明星。

e.en: {Tinseltown} gossip dominates the entertainment news every week.
e.zh: 好莱坞八卦每周都占据娱乐新闻的头条。

e.en: The village {tinsmith} repaired pots and made lanterns.
e.zh: 村里的白铁匠修锅也做灯笼。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {tinsmith} during the depression.
e.zh: 他祖父在大萧条时期做白铁匠为生。

tint.t:
n. 色调；淡色
v. 染色

e.en: The sunset gave the clouds a pink {tint}.
e.zh: 日落给云朵染上了一抹粉色。

e.en: She wants to {tint} her hair a darker brown.
e.zh: 她想把头发染成深一点的棕色。

e.en: His car has heavily {tinted} windows for privacy.
e.zh: 他的车窗贴了深色膜以保护隐私。

e.en: She wore {tinted} sunglasses even on cloudy days.
e.zh: 即使阴天她也戴着有色太阳镜。

e.en: Window {tinting} can reduce heat inside the car significantly.
e.zh: 贴车窗膜能显著降低车内温度。

e.en: She is {tinting} her eyebrows a slightly darker shade.
e.zh: 她正在把眉毛染成稍深一点的颜色。

tinto.t: n. 红葡萄酒（西语借词）

e.en: He ordered a glass of Spanish {tinto} with dinner.
e.zh: 他点了一杯西班牙红葡萄酒配晚餐。

e.en: The restaurant features a rich vino {tinto} from Rioja.
e.zh: 餐厅主推一款浓郁的里奥哈红葡萄酒。

tintoretto.t: n. 丁托列托（意大利画家）

e.en: The museum displays a famous {Tintoretto} painting from Venice.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅著名的丁托列托的威尼斯画作。

e.en: {Tintoretto} was known for his dramatic use of light.
e.zh: 丁托列托以戏剧性的光影运用而闻名。

tintype.t: n. 锡版照相（旧式摄影）

e.en: She found an old family {tintype} in the attic.
e.zh: 她在阁楼里发现了一张老家族锡版照片。

e.en: The {tintype} portrait dated back to the Civil War era.
e.zh: 这张锡版肖像照可追溯到南北战争时期。

tinware.t: n. 锡制器皿；铁皮制品

e.en: The antique shop sold colorful painted {tinware} from Mexico.
e.zh: 古董店出售来自墨西哥的彩绘锡器。

e.en: Pioneer kitchens were stocked with simple, durable {tinware}.
e.zh: 拓荒者的厨房里备着简单耐用的锡制器皿。

e.en: She lives in a {tiny} apartment in downtown Tokyo.
e.zh: 她住在东京市中心一间很小的公寓里。

e.en: Even a {tiny} change in code can break production.
e.zh: 即使是代码里一点小改动也可能搞垮生产环境。

tip.t:
n. 小贴士；小费；顶端
v. 倾斜；给小费

tipi.t: n. 美洲原住民圆锥形帐篷

e.en: The family camped in a traditional {tipi} by the lake.
e.zh: 那家人在湖边的传统圆锥帐篷里露营。

e.en: Children love sleeping in a backyard {tipi}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在后院的圆锥帐篷里睡觉。

tipped.t:
v. 倾斜；给了小费
adj. 带尖的

e.en: She {tipped} the waiter twenty percent for great service.
e.zh: 她给了服务员百分之二十的小费以感谢出色的服务。

e.en: The vase {tipped} over and shattered on the floor.
e.zh: 花瓶倒下来摔碎在地板上。

tipper.t: n. 给小费的人；翻斗车

e.en: Generous {tipper} customers make a server's day.
e.zh: 慷慨给小费的顾客让服务员一天都开心。

e.en: The {tipper} truck unloaded gravel at the site.
e.zh: 自卸卡车在工地卸下了砂石。

tipperary.t: n. 蒂珀雷里（爱尔兰地名）

e.en: Her grandparents emigrated from {Tipperary} long ago.
e.zh: 她的祖父母很久以前从蒂珀雷里移民出来。

e.en: "It's a long way to {Tipperary}" is a famous old song.
e.zh: 《去蒂珀雷里路途遥远》是一首著名老歌。

e.en: She wore a fur {tippet} around her shoulders.
e.zh: 她肩上披着一条毛皮披肩。

e.en: The priest's white {tippet} hung neatly over his robe.
e.zh: 牧师洁白的披肩整齐地搭在长袍上。

e.en: She used {Tippex} to cover the typo on the form.
e.zh: 她用修正液涂掉了表格上的错字。

e.en: The bottle of {Tippex} dried up before she finished.
e.zh: 还没用完，那瓶修正液就干了。

tipping.t:
n. 给小费
v. 倾斜；翻倒

e.en: {Tipping} customs vary widely from country to country.
e.zh: 各国的小费习俗差异很大。

e.en: The economy may be reaching a {tipping} point.
e.zh: 经济可能正在达到一个临界点。

tipple.t:
v. 常喝酒；小酌
n. 常喝的酒

e.en: His evening {tipple} is usually a glass of red wine.
e.zh: 他晚间小酌通常是一杯红酒。

e.en: The old sailors would {tipple} rum after a long voyage.
e.zh: 老水手们在长途航行后会小酌朗姆酒。

tippy.t: adj. 容易倾翻的；不稳的

e.en: That little canoe is awfully {tippy} on rough water.
e.zh: 那条小独木舟在浪里特别容易翻。

e.en: The tall stool felt {tippy} when she sat down.
e.zh: 她坐下时那把高凳感觉摇摇晃晃的。

tips.t:
n. 小贴士（复数）；小费
v. 倾斜

e.en: The article shares useful {tips} for saving money.
e.zh: 这篇文章分享了一些实用的省钱小贴士。

e.en: Servers rely on {tips} to supplement their income.
e.zh: 服务员靠小费来补贴收入。

tipster.t: n. 提供内幕消息的人（尤指赛马）

e.en: The racing {tipster} predicted the winning horse three weeks running.
e.zh: 那位赛马情报员连续三周成功预测出冠军马。

e.en: A reliable {tipster} sent the journalist details about the scandal.
e.zh: 一位可靠的线人向记者透露了丑闻细节。

e.en: After two glasses of wine she felt pleasantly {tipsy}.
e.zh: 喝完两杯酒后她感到微微有些醉意。

e.en: He gave a {tipsy} speech at his cousin's wedding.
e.zh: 他在堂妹的婚礼上发表了一段醉醺醺的致辞。

tiptoe.t:
v. 踮着脚走
n. 脚尖

e.en: She walked on {tiptoe} to avoid waking the baby.
e.zh: 她踮着脚走路,免得吵醒宝宝。

e.en: The dancer can {tiptoe} across the stage almost silently.
e.zh: 那位舞者几乎能无声地踮脚穿过舞台。

tiptoeed.t: v. tiptoe 的过去式；踮脚走过

e.en: He {tiptoed} past the sleeping dog and out the door.
e.zh: 他踮着脚绕过睡着的狗,走出了门。

e.en: She {tiptoed} into the dark bedroom holding a candle.
e.zh: 她举着蜡烛踮脚走进漆黑的卧室。

tiptoeing.t: v. 踮着脚走（现在分词）

e.en: I caught the kids {tiptoeing} downstairs to find presents.
e.zh: 我抓到孩子们正踮脚下楼去找礼物。

e.en: The cat is {tiptoeing} along the narrow garden fence.
e.zh: 那只猫正踮着脚沿着窄窄的花园篱笆走。

tiptoes.t:
n. 脚尖
v. 踮脚而行

e.en: She stood on {tiptoes} to reach the top shelf.
e.zh: 她踮起脚尖去够最上面那层架子。

e.en: The toddler {tiptoes} around the puddle on the sidewalk.
e.zh: 那个小孩踮着脚绕开人行道上的水坑。

e.en: The vintage car is in {tiptop} condition for its age.
e.zh: 这辆老爷车以它的车龄来说保养得极好。

e.en: After surgery she's back to {tiptop} shape again.
e.zh: 手术后她又恢复到了最佳状态。

e.en: He launched into a furious {tirade} about his landlord.
e.zh: 他开始对房东大发雷霆,滔滔不绝地咒骂。

e.en: Her online {tirade} against the airline went viral overnight.
e.zh: 她抨击那家航空公司的长篇怒文一夜之间走红。

tiramisu.t: n. 提拉米苏（意式甜点）

e.en: The Italian restaurant serves the best {tiramisu} in town.
e.zh: 那家意大利餐厅做的提拉米苏是城里最好的。

e.en: She layered ladyfingers and mascarpone to make homemade {tiramisu}.
e.zh: 她用手指饼干和马斯卡彭芝士分层做了自制提拉米苏。

tirana.t: n. 地拉那（阿尔巴尼亚首都）

e.en: We spent three days exploring the colorful streets of {Tirana}.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览地拉那五彩缤纷的街道。

e.en: {Tirana} is the bustling capital of Albania.
e.zh: 地拉那是阿尔巴尼亚热闹的首都。

tire.t:
n. 轮胎
v. 使疲倦

e.en: My front {tire} went flat on the highway yesterday.
e.zh: 我的前轮胎昨天在高速公路上爆了。

e.en: Long meetings really {tire} me out by Friday.
e.zh: 漫长的会议到周五真的让我筋疲力尽。

e.en: I'm too {tired} to cook dinner tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚累得没法做饭了。

e.en: She's {tired} of hearing the same excuses every week.
e.zh: 她已经厌倦了每周听到同样的借口。

e.en: He waved {tiredly} at his coworkers and left early.
e.zh: 他疲惫地向同事们挥了挥手,提前下班了。

e.en: She {tiredly} closed the laptop after twelve hours of work.
e.zh: 工作了十二个小时后,她疲惫地合上了笔记本。

e.en: The {tiredness} in her voice was hard to ignore.
e.zh: 她声音里的疲倦让人难以忽视。

e.en: Constant screen time can cause significant eye {tiredness}.
e.zh: 长时间盯着屏幕会引起明显的眼部疲劳。

e.en: Doctors distinguish between physical and mental {tirednesses} in their patients.
e.zh: 医生会区分病人身上的身体疲劳和精神疲劳。

e.en: The study mapped different {tirednesses} reported by night shift workers.
e.zh: 该研究记录了夜班工人报告的各种不同疲劳状态。

e.en: She is a {tireless} advocate for children's education rights.
e.zh: 她是儿童受教育权利的不懈倡导者。

e.en: His {tireless} work on the project earned him a promotion.
e.zh: 他在这个项目上不知疲倦的努力让他获得了晋升。

e.en: Volunteers worked {tirelessly} through the night after the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震后志愿者们彻夜不知疲倦地工作。

e.en: She campaigned {tirelessly} for cleaner air in the city.
e.zh: 她为改善城市空气质量不懈地奔走呼吁。

tires.t:
n. 轮胎（复数）
v. 使疲倦（第三人称单数）

e.en: You should rotate your {tires} every six thousand miles.
e.zh: 每行驶六千英里就该给轮胎换位一次。

e.en: Hiking uphill quickly {tires} even experienced trekkers.
e.zh: 上坡徒步会很快让经验丰富的旅行者也疲惫不堪。

e.en: Filling out the same forms every month is {tiresome}.
e.zh: 每个月填一样的表格真让人烦不胜烦。

e.en: His constant complaining became {tiresome} to everyone in the office.
e.zh: 他不停的抱怨让办公室里每个人都感到厌烦。

e.en: The lecture dragged on {tiresomely} for nearly three hours.
e.zh: 那场讲座令人厌烦地拖了将近三个小时。

e.en: He {tiresomely} repeated the same joke at every party.
e.zh: 他在每场派对上都没完没了地重复同一个笑话。

tiring.t: adj. 令人疲倦的；累人的

e.en: Moving apartments was more {tiring} than I expected.
e.zh: 搬家比我想象的要累得多。

e.en: Teaching energetic toddlers all day can be incredibly {tiring}.
e.zh: 整天教精力旺盛的小朋友可能会非常累人。

e.en: She brewed a chamomile {tisane} to help her sleep.
e.zh: 她泡了一杯洋甘菊花草茶来助眠。

e.en: This herbal {tisane} is caffeine-free and great for digestion.
e.zh: 这款草本花草茶不含咖啡因,有助于消化。

e.en: Could you pass me a {tissue}? I need to sneeze.
e.zh: 能递给我一张纸巾吗?我要打喷嚏了。

e.en: Doctors examined the {tissue} sample under a microscope.
e.zh: 医生用显微镜检查了那份组织样本。

e.en: Keep a box of {tissues} nearby during allergy season.
e.zh: 过敏季节最好在身边放一盒纸巾。

e.en: Damaged {tissues} take time to heal after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后受损的组织需要时间才能愈合。

tit.t:
n. 山雀
n. 乳房（俚）

e.en: He became a {titan} of the tech industry in his thirties.
e.zh: 他三十多岁就成了科技业的巨头。

e.en: Saturn's largest moon, {Titan}, has lakes of liquid methane.
e.zh: 土星最大的卫星泰坦上有液态甲烷湖。

titania.t: n. 泰坦妮娅（仙后）；二氧化钛

e.en: In the play, {Titania} is the queen of the fairies.
e.zh: 在那部戏里,提泰妮娅是仙后。

e.en: Uranus's moon {Titania} was discovered by William Herschel.
e.zh: 天王星的卫星泰坦尼亚是由威廉·赫歇尔发现的。

titanic.t:
adj. 巨大的
n. 泰坦尼克号

e.en: The two teams fought a {titanic} battle for the championship.
e.zh: 两支队伍为冠军展开了一场惊天动地的较量。

e.en: The {Titanic} sank on its very first voyage in 1912.
e.zh: 泰坦尼克号在1912年的首航中就沉没了。

e.en: Surgeons used a {titanium} plate to repair his broken jaw.
e.zh: 医生用钛金属板修复了他破裂的下颌。

e.en: This laptop has a lightweight {titanium} casing.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑采用了轻巧的钛金属外壳。

e.en: She shared a juicy {titbit} of office gossip at lunch.
e.zh: 午餐时她分享了一条有趣的办公室八卦。

e.en: He fed his dog a {titbit} from his plate.
e.zh: 他从自己盘子里夹了一小块零食喂狗。

e.en: The tiniest puppy in the litter is just a {titch}.
e.zh: 那窝小狗里最小的那只就是个小不点。

e.en: Don't worry, kid, every {titch} grows up eventually.
e.zh: 别担心孩子,每个小不点最终都会长大的。

e.en: The kitchen in our flat is rather {titchy}.
e.zh: 我们公寓的厨房相当袖珍。

e.en: He owns a {titchy} car perfect for narrow city streets.
e.zh: 他有一辆很迷你的小车,正适合走城市的窄街。

e.en: The lab measured the antibody {titer} in her blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室测定了她血液样本中的抗体效价。

e.en: A high virus {titer} indicates an active infection.
e.zh: 病毒滴度高说明感染正处于活跃期。

tithe.t:
n. 什一税
v. 缴纳什一税

e.en: Members of the church traditionally pay a {tithe} of their income.
e.zh: 教会成员传统上要缴纳收入的十分之一作为什一税。

e.en: In medieval times, peasants had to {tithe} part of their harvest.
e.zh: 在中世纪,农民必须把部分收成作为什一税上缴。

tithing.t: n. 缴纳什一税；十户区

e.en: Many believers practice {tithing} as part of their faith.
e.zh: 许多信徒会把缴纳什一税作为信仰实践的一部分。

e.en: She's been {tithing} ten percent of her salary for years.
e.zh: 多年来她一直把工资的百分之十拿去奉献。

titi.t: n. 伶猴（南美小型猴类）

e.en: The {titi} monkey lives in the rainforests of South America.
e.zh: 伶猴生活在南美洲的雨林中。

e.en: Researchers tracked a family of {titi} monkeys for two months.
e.zh: 研究人员对一家伶猴跟踪观察了两个月。

titian.t:
adj. 金赤色的
n. 提香（画家）

e.en: Her {titian} hair caught the afternoon sunlight beautifully.
e.zh: 她那头红棕色的头发在午后的阳光下美极了。

e.en: The painting was clearly inspired by a {Titian} masterpiece.
e.zh: 这幅画显然是受了提香名作的启发。

e.en: Tabloid headlines are designed to {titillate} casual readers.
e.zh: 小报头条就是设计来刺激和吸引随意翻阅的读者的。

e.en: The novel tries to {titillate} more than it tries to inform.
e.zh: 这本小说更多是想撩拨读者,而不是提供资讯。

e.en: The magazine published a {titillating} interview with the actress.
e.zh: 那本杂志刊登了对那位女演员一篇撩人的访谈。

e.en: He shared a {titillating} rumor about the company merger.
e.zh: 他透露了一个关于公司合并的耸人听闻的传言。

e.en: The show offers cheap {titillation} but little real substance.
e.zh: 那档节目只能给人廉价的刺激,实质内容很少。

e.en: Some readers buy gossip magazines purely for the {titillation}.
e.zh: 有些读者买八卦杂志纯粹是为了寻求刺激。

e.en: What's the {title} of the book you're reading now?
e.zh: 你现在读的这本书叫什么书名?

e.en: She earned the {title} of world champion last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末她赢得了世界冠军的称号。

e.en: He published a memoir {titled} "Lost and Found."
e.zh: 他出版了一本回忆录,书名为《失而复得》。

e.en: The presentation was {titled} "The Future of AI."
e.zh: 那场演讲的标题是《人工智能的未来》。

e.en: Netflix added several new {titles} to its catalog this month.
e.zh: Netflix本月在片库里新增了好几部影片。

e.en: The opening {titles} of the movie last almost three minutes.
e.zh: 电影的片头字幕几乎播了三分钟。

titling.t:
v. 为……命名
n. 标题排版

e.en: He spent hours {titling} each chapter of his novel.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时给小说的每一章起标题。

e.en: The designer is {titling} the magazine cover with bold fonts.
e.zh: 设计师正用粗体字给杂志封面排标题。

e.en: The reigning {titlist} will defend her belt next month.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军将在下月捍卫她的腰带。

e.en: He became the youngest {titlist} in the league's history.
e.zh: 他成为联盟历史上最年轻的冠军获得者。

e.en: A small {titmouse} landed on the bird feeder this morning.
e.zh: 今早一只小山雀落在了喂鸟器上。

e.en: The tufted {titmouse} is common in eastern American forests.
e.zh: 凤头山雀在美国东部的森林里很常见。

e.en: Doctors slowly {titrate} the medication to find the right dose.
e.zh: 医生缓慢调整药量以找到合适的剂量。

e.en: Students learned to {titrate} acid against base in lab.
e.zh: 学生在实验室学习用酸滴定碱。

e.en: The chemistry exam included a {titration} problem on acids.
e.zh: 化学考试里有一道关于酸的滴定题。

e.en: Careful {titration} of the dose helped reduce side effects.
e.zh: 仔细调整剂量有助于减少副作用。

titre.t: n. 滴定度（titer 的英式拼写）

e.en: The blood test showed a high antibody {titre} for measles.
e.zh: 血液检测显示麻疹抗体效价很高。

e.en: Doctors check the vaccine {titre} to confirm immunity.
e.zh: 医生通过检测疫苗滴度来确认免疫力。

titter.t:
v. 窃笑；傻笑
n. 窃笑

e.en: A nervous {titter} ran through the audience after his joke.
e.zh: 他开完玩笑后,观众中传出一阵紧张的窃笑。

e.en: The students began to {titter} when the teacher tripped.
e.zh: 老师绊了一下时,学生们开始窃笑。

tittle.t: n. 一丁点；字母上的点

e.en: She wouldn't change one {tittle} of her original draft.
e.zh: 她连初稿里的一笔一划都不愿改动。

e.en: The dot above the letter i is called a {tittle}.
e.zh: 字母i上面的小点叫作字母点。

e.en: The crude comedian made another {titty} joke and groaned.
e.zh: 那个粗俗的喜剧演员又讲了个低俗的胸部笑话。

e.en: The baby kitten searched for its mother's {titty}.
e.zh: 小猫咪在寻找妈妈的乳头。

titular.t: adj. 名义上的；有头衔的

e.en: He's the {titular} head of the company but holds no power.
e.zh: 他是公司名义上的负责人,但没有实权。

e.en: The {titular} character of the film never actually appears.
e.zh: 这部电影的同名主角其实从未真正出场。

e.en: We stopped in {Tiverton} for tea on the way to Devon.
e.zh: 我们去德文郡的路上在蒂弗顿停下来喝茶。

e.en: The train from London passes through {Tiverton} Parkway.
e.zh: 从伦敦开出的火车会经过蒂弗顿帕克韦站。

tivoli.t: n. 蒂沃利（意大利城镇）

e.en: The fountains at {Tivoli} are a stunning sight near Rome.
e.zh: 蒂沃利的喷泉是罗马附近一道惊艳的风景。

e.en: Kids begged to ride the roller coaster at {Tivoli} Gardens.
e.zh: 孩子们求着要在蒂沃利公园坐过山车。

tizzy.t: n. 紧张慌乱；心烦意乱

e.en: Mom got in a {tizzy} when guests arrived early.
e.zh: 客人提前到时,妈妈一下子慌了神。

e.en: Don't work yourself into a {tizzy} over a typo.
e.zh: 别为了一个错别字把自己急得团团转。

tlc.t: n. 细致关怀（tender loving care）

tnt.t: n. 三硝基甲苯；烈性炸药

e.en: A fat {toad} hopped across the wet garden path.
e.zh: 一只肥蟾蜍从湿漉漉的花园小径上跳过。

e.en: The cane {toad} is an invasive species in Australia.
e.zh: 甘蔗蟾蜍在澳大利亚是一种入侵物种。

e.en: A bright red {toadstool} sprouted by the old oak tree.
e.zh: 老橡树旁冒出了一朵鲜红的毒蘑菇。

e.en: Don't pick that {toadstool} — it could be poisonous.
e.zh: 别采那朵毒菌——可能有毒。

toady.t:
n. 马屁精
v. 谄媚

e.en: Nobody respects a {toady} who flatters the boss constantly.
e.zh: 没人会尊重一个整天拍老板马屁的马屁精。

e.en: He refused to {toady} to executives just to get promoted.
e.zh: 他不愿为了升职去巴结高管。

toast.t:
n. 烤面包片；祝酒
v. 烤；敬酒

e.en: I had {toast} and jam for breakfast this morning.
e.zh: 我今天早餐吃了烤面包配果酱。

e.en: Let's raise a {toast} to the happy couple!
e.zh: 让我们为这对幸福的新人干杯!

e.en: She ordered a {toasted} bagel with cream cheese.
e.zh: 她点了一个烤过的贝果配奶油奶酪。

e.en: The chef lightly {toasted} the sesame seeds before grinding.
e.zh: 厨师把芝麻轻轻烘过再磨碎。

e.en: The {toaster} popped just as the kettle started whistling.
e.zh: 水壶刚响,烤面包机就弹了起来。

e.en: Our new {toaster} has six browning settings.
e.zh: 我们的新烤面包机有六档烘烤设置。

e.en: The crowd was {toasting} the bride and groom loudly.
e.zh: 人群高声向新娘新郎敬酒。

e.en: He's {toasting} marshmallows over the campfire.
e.zh: 他正在篝火上烤棉花糖。

toastmaster.t: n. 宴会司仪；祝酒主持

e.en: The {toastmaster} kept the wedding speeches running smoothly.
e.zh: 司仪让婚礼上的致辞环节顺利进行。

e.en: She joined a {toastmaster} club to practice public speaking.
e.zh: 她加入了演讲俱乐部来练习公开演讲。

e.en: The cabin felt {toasty} after we lit the fireplace.
e.zh: 点上壁炉后,小木屋里暖烘烘的。

e.en: Wear thick socks to keep your feet {toasty}.
e.zh: 穿厚袜子让脚保持暖和。

e.en: The shop sells pipe {tobacco} and hand-rolled cigars.
e.zh: 这家店卖烟斗烟丝和手卷雪茄。

e.en: {Tobacco} use has declined sharply among teenagers.
e.zh: 青少年中吸烟的比例已大幅下降。

tobaccoes.t: n. 烟草（复数，较少用拼法）

e.en: The shop showcases rare {tobaccoes} from Cuba and Virginia.
e.zh: 这家店陈列着来自古巴和弗吉尼亚的稀有烟草。

e.en: Different {tobaccoes} produce very different aromas when burned.
e.zh: 不同种类的烟草燃烧时香味差别很大。

e.en: The old {tobacconist} on the corner sells imported cigars.
e.zh: 街角那家老烟草店卖进口雪茄。

e.en: He worked as a {tobacconist} in London for thirty years.
e.zh: 他在伦敦做了三十年烟草商。

tobago.t: n. 多巴哥（加勒比岛屿）

e.en: We snorkeled along the coral reefs of {Tobago} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在多巴哥的珊瑚礁边浮潜。

e.en: Trinidad and {Tobago} share one government and parliament.
e.zh: 特立尼达和多巴哥共享一个政府和议会。

tobermory.t: n. 托伯莫里（苏格兰小镇）

e.en: The colorful houses of {Tobermory} line the harbor on Mull.
e.zh: 多伯莫里五颜六色的房子沿马尔岛港口排开。

e.en: We caught the ferry from {Tobermory} to the mainland.
e.zh: 我们从多伯莫里搭渡船到大陆。

toboggan.t:
n. 平底雪橇
v. 乘雪橇滑行

e.en: The kids raced their {toboggan} down the snowy hill.
e.zh: 孩子们驾着平底雪橇飞速冲下雪坡。

e.en: Grab your {toboggan} — the slope is finally open!
e.zh: 快拿上你的雪橇——雪坡终于开放了!

tobruk.t: n. 图卜鲁格（利比亚港城）

e.en: The siege of {Tobruk} was a key battle in 1941.
e.zh: 图卜鲁格围城战是 1941 年的一场关键战役。

e.en: Allied troops defended {Tobruk} for over two hundred days.
e.zh: 盟军在图卜鲁格坚守了两百多天。

e.en: Grandpa kept a porcelain {toby} jug on the mantel.
e.zh: 爷爷在壁炉架上摆着一个瓷制的托比酒壶。

e.en: The collector specializes in antique {toby} mugs from England.
e.zh: 这位收藏家专门收藏英国古董托比酒杯。

tock.t: n. 嗒（钟表声，常与tick连用）

e.en: The grandfather clock went tick-{tock} all through the night.
e.zh: 老式落地钟整夜滴答滴答地响。

e.en: Every {tock} of the clock made him more anxious.
e.zh: 时钟的每一声滴答都让他更加焦虑。

e.en: Vitamin E in skincare is usually listed as {tocopherol}.
e.zh: 护肤品中的维生素 E 通常标注为生育酚。

e.en: Almonds are a rich natural source of {tocopherol}.
e.zh: 杏仁是生育酚的天然丰富来源。

e.en: Palm oil contains a high amount of {tocotrienol}.
e.zh: 棕榈油含有大量的生育三烯酚。

e.en: Researchers study {tocotrienol} for its antioxidant properties.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究生育三烯酚的抗氧化作用。

today.t:
n. 今天
adv. 今日；如今

e.en: I have three meetings scheduled for {today}.
e.zh: 我今天安排了三场会议。

e.en: {Today}'s teenagers spend hours on short-video apps.
e.zh: 如今的青少年花大量时间刷短视频。

todays.t: adj. 今天的（today's 非规范写法）

e.en: {Todays} update fixed the login bug everyone reported.
e.zh: 今天的更新修复了大家反映的登录漏洞。

e.en: Have you read {todays} headlines on the news app?
e.zh: 你看新闻应用上今天的头条了吗?

e.en: Watch the baby {toddle} across the living room rug.
e.zh: 看宝宝摇摇晃晃地走过客厅的地毯。

e.en: Grandma began to {toddle} toward the garden gate.
e.zh: 奶奶开始慢悠悠地朝花园门口走去。

e.en: My {toddler} loves watching cartoons on the iPad.
e.zh: 我家小娃娃超爱在 iPad 上看动画片。

e.en: The {toddler} giggled and reached for the puppy.
e.zh: 小宝宝咯咯笑着伸手去抓小狗。

e.en: A hot {toddy} helps soothe a sore throat in winter.
e.zh: 冬天来一杯热托迪能缓解喉咙痛。

e.en: He sipped his whiskey {toddy} by the fire.
e.zh: 他在炉火旁啜饮着威士忌热托迪。

toe.t:
n. 脚趾；鞋尖
v. 用脚尖触

e.en: Her boots have a steel {toecap} for safety on site.
e.zh: 她的靴子有钢制鞋头,在工地上更安全。

e.en: The {toecap} of his shoe was scuffed and worn.
e.zh: 他鞋子的鞋头已经磨损得很厉害。

e.en: He {toed} the soccer ball gently to his teammate.
e.zh: 他用脚尖把足球轻轻拨给队友。

e.en: Recruits {toed} the line as the sergeant inspected them.
e.zh: 新兵们脚尖对齐站好线,听班长检阅。

e.en: The startup gained a small {toehold} in the Asian market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在亚洲市场站稳了一点点脚跟。

e.en: She found a {toehold} in the rock and pulled herself up.
e.zh: 她在岩缝中找到一个落脚点,撑着爬了上去。

e.en: I broke a {toenail} kicking the table leg.
e.zh: 我踢到桌腿,把脚趾甲弄断了。

e.en: She paints every {toenail} a different color in summer.
e.zh: 夏天她把每个脚趾甲都涂成不同颜色。

e.en: He trims his {toenails} every two weeks without fail.
e.zh: 他每两周准时剪一次脚趾甲。

e.en: Her {toenails} were polished a glittery shade of pink.
e.zh: 她的脚趾甲涂着闪亮的粉色甲油。

e.en: The ballet shoe's silk {toepiece} was worn through.
e.zh: 芭蕾舞鞋的丝质鞋头部分已经磨穿了。

e.en: Adjust the {toepiece} of your ski binding before skiing.
e.zh: 滑雪前请调整滑雪固定器的前掌部分。

e.en: My {toes} went numb after standing in the snow.
e.zh: 在雪里站久了,我的脚趾都冻麻了。

e.en: Wiggle your {toes} to keep the blood flowing.
e.zh: 动动脚趾保持血液循环。

toff.t: n. 花花公子；阔佬（英俚）

e.en: He dresses like a proper {toff} at every wedding.
e.zh: 每次去婚礼他都打扮得像个十足的贵族公子。

e.en: Don't be fooled — he's a {toff} who grew up rich.
e.zh: 别被骗了——他是个从小富贵的纨绔子弟。

e.en: This homemade {toffee} sticks to my back teeth.
e.zh: 这自制太妃糖粘得我后槽牙都要拔不开了。

e.en: She loves {toffee}-flavored coffee from the new café.
e.zh: 她很喜欢新开咖啡馆的太妃糖味咖啡。

e.en: The medieval {toft} once held a small farmhouse and barn.
e.zh: 这块中世纪宅地上曾有一座小农舍和谷仓。

e.en: Records show the {toft} belonged to a Norse settler.
e.zh: 记录显示这块宅地原属于一位北欧定居者。

e.en: I marinated the {tofu} in soy sauce and ginger.
e.zh: 我用酱油和姜把豆腐腌了一下。

e.en: Silken {tofu} blends perfectly into smoothies.
e.zh: 嫩豆腐打进奶昔里特别顺滑。

tog.t:
n. 衣服
v. 穿戴

e.en: He wore a bedsheet {toga} to the costume party.
e.zh: 他披着床单当托加袍去参加化装舞会。

e.en: Roman senators traditionally wore a white {toga}.
e.zh: 古罗马元老们传统上身穿白色托加袍。

e.en: Let's grab dinner {together} after work tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天下班我们一起去吃晚饭吧。

e.en: The team worked {together} to ship the feature on time.
e.zh: 团队齐心协力,按时上线了这个功能。

e.en: Family dinners create a real sense of {togetherness}.
e.zh: 家庭聚餐能带来真正的团聚感。

e.en: The retreat was designed to build team {togetherness}.
e.zh: 这次团建活动旨在增强团队的凝聚力。

toggle.t:
v. 切换（开关）
n. 开关；切换键

e.en: {Toggle} the dark-mode switch in the settings menu.
e.zh: 在设置菜单里切换深色模式开关。

e.en: Press Tab to {toggle} between the two windows.
e.zh: 按 Tab 键在两个窗口之间切换。

e.en: {Togo} is a small country in West Africa.
e.zh: 多哥是西非的一个小国家。

e.en: The capital of {Togo} is Lomé, on the coast.
e.zh: 多哥的首都是位于海岸的洛美。

togolese.t:
adj. 多哥的
n. 多哥人

e.en: The {Togolese} football team qualified for the World Cup in 2006.
e.zh: 多哥足球队在2006年闯进了世界杯。

e.en: She enjoyed the spicy {Togolese} stew at the festival.
e.zh: 她在节日上很喜欢那道辣味的多哥炖菜。

toil.t:
v. 辛苦工作
n. 苦工

e.en: Farmers {toil} from sunrise to sunset during harvest.
e.zh: 收获季节,农民们从日出忙到日落。

e.en: After years of {toil}, the novel was finally published.
e.zh: 经过多年辛劳,这部小说终于出版了。

e.en: The bedroom curtains are made of blue French {toile}.
e.zh: 卧室的窗帘是用蓝色法式印花布做的。

e.en: The designer made a quick {toile} to test the dress fit.
e.zh: 设计师快速做了一件白坯样衣来试裙子的版型。

e.en: He {toiled} for hours debugging the production server.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时辛苦调试生产服务器。

e.en: Workers {toiled} in the heat to finish the road.
e.zh: 工人们在酷热中辛苦劳作,把路修完。

e.en: She's a quiet {toiler} who never asks for credit.
e.zh: 她是个默默耕耘、从不邀功的劳动者。

e.en: Every {toiler} on the team deserves recognition.
e.zh: 团队里每一位辛勤付出的人都值得被看见。

e.en: The {toilet} on the second floor is clogged again.
e.zh: 二楼的马桶又堵了。

e.en: Excuse me, where's the {toilet} in this restaurant?
e.zh: 请问这家餐厅的洗手间在哪里?

e.en: The nurse helps elderly patients with {toileting} and bathing.
e.zh: 护士帮助年长病人如厕和洗澡。

e.en: {Toileting} a toddler takes patience and a steady routine.
e.zh: 训练幼儿如厕需要耐心和稳定的作息。

e.en: Pack a small {toiletry} bag for your weekend trip.
e.zh: 周末出行带上一个小的洗漱包。

e.en: Hotels usually provide basic {toiletry} items in each room.
e.zh: 酒店通常会在每间房提供基本的洗漱用品。

e.en: The public {toilets} at the park were recently renovated.
e.zh: 公园里的公共厕所最近翻新过。

e.en: Modern {toilets} use far less water than older models.
e.zh: 现代马桶比旧款省水得多。

e.en: She finished her morning {toilette} before the guests arrived.
e.zh: 她在客人到来前完成了晨间梳妆。

e.en: The eau de {toilette} smelled of citrus and jasmine.
e.zh: 那瓶淡香水带着柑橘和茉莉的香气。

e.en: Farmers were {toiling} in the fields under the hot sun.
e.zh: 农民们在烈日下在田里辛苦劳作。

e.en: She spent years {toiling} away on her debut novel.
e.zh: 她花了数年苦心创作她的处女作小说。

toils.t:
n. 劳作；罗网
v. 辛劳（单三）

e.en: He {toils} late into the night to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 他熬夜辛勤工作以赶上截止日期。

e.en: The novel describes the daily {toils} of factory workers.
e.zh: 这本小说描写了工厂工人的日常辛劳。

e.en: Building the railway was a long and {toilsome} project.
e.zh: 修建这条铁路是一项漫长而艰辛的工程。

e.en: Hand-copying manuscripts was {toilsome} work for medieval monks.
e.zh: 手抄手稿对中世纪的僧侣来说是件苦差事。

tokai.t: n. 托卡伊（匈牙利葡萄酒产地）

e.en: We tasted a sweet {Tokai} wine from northeastern Hungary.
e.zh: 我们品尝了一款来自匈牙利东北部的甜托卡伊葡萄酒。

e.en: The {Tokai} region is famous for its volcanic soil vineyards.
e.zh: 托卡伊地区以其火山土葡萄园而闻名。

tokamak.t: n. 托卡马克（核聚变装置）

e.en: Scientists ran fusion experiments inside the giant {tokamak} reactor.
e.zh: 科学家在巨大的托卡马克反应堆内进行核聚变实验。

e.en: A {tokamak} uses magnetic fields to confine extremely hot plasma.
e.zh: 托卡马克利用磁场约束极高温的等离子体。

e.en: He took a quick {toke} and passed the joint along.
e.zh: 他快速吸了一口,然后把烟传给了下一个人。

e.en: They sat on the porch sharing a {toke} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们坐在门廊上一起抽了一口。

token.t:
n. 令牌；代币；标记
adj. 象征性的

e.en: Please accept this gift as a {token} of our gratitude.
e.zh: 请收下这份礼物,作为我们感谢的一点心意。

e.en: You need an access {token} to call the API.
e.zh: 调用这个 API 需要一个访问令牌。

tokenism.t: n. 装点门面；象征性姿态

e.en: Critics called the hire {tokenism} rather than real change.
e.zh: 批评者称这次招聘只是装点门面,而非真正的改变。

e.en: Diversity programs must avoid sliding into mere {tokenism}.
e.zh: 多元化项目必须避免沦为表面文章。

tokugawa.t: n. 德川（日本幕府/姓氏）

e.en: The {Tokugawa} shogunate ruled Japan for over two centuries.
e.zh: 德川幕府统治日本超过两个世纪。

e.en: Edo flourished as the capital under {Tokugawa} rule.
e.zh: 江户在德川统治下作为首都繁荣发展。

e.en: We're flying to {Tokyo} for the cherry blossom season.
e.zh: 我们要飞往东京去看樱花季。

e.en: {Tokyo} has one of the busiest train networks in the world.
e.zh: 东京拥有世界上最繁忙的铁路网之一。

told.t: v. 告诉（tell 的过去式）

e.en: She {told} me the meeting was moved to Friday.
e.zh: 她告诉我会议改到了周五。

e.en: I was {told} to wait outside until my name was called.
e.zh: 有人叫我在外面等到点名为止。

tole.t:
n. 漆铁器
v. 引诱

e.en: The antique shop displayed a hand-painted {tole} tray.
e.zh: 那家古董店摆着一个手绘的彩绘金属托盘。

e.en: Her kitchen featured colorful {tole} canisters from the 1950s.
e.zh: 她的厨房里摆着五十年代色彩鲜艳的彩绘金属罐。

e.en: We spent the afternoon walking the old streets of {Toledo}.
e.zh: 我们用一个下午在托莱多的老城街道上漫步。

e.en: {Toledo}, Ohio sits on the western shore of Lake Erie.
e.zh: 俄亥俄州的托莱多市位于伊利湖西岸。

e.en: The drug's {tolerability} was tested in a small clinical trial.
e.zh: 该药物的耐受性在一项小型临床试验中得到检验。

e.en: Patients reported good {tolerability} with only mild side effects.
e.zh: 患者反馈耐受性良好,仅有轻微副作用。

tolerable.t: adj. 可忍受的；还不错的

e.en: The hotel was old but {tolerable} for one night.
e.zh: 那家酒店虽然老旧,但住一晚还能接受。

e.en: The pain was {tolerable} after she took the medication.
e.zh: 她服药后疼痛就在可以忍受的范围内了。

e.en: She speaks French {tolerably} well after only one year.
e.zh: 她学了仅一年法语,就说得相当不错。

e.en: The old laptop still runs {tolerably} for basic tasks.
e.zh: 这台旧笔记本处理基础任务还算过得去。

e.en: The school promotes {tolerance} of different cultures and beliefs.
e.zh: 这所学校倡导对不同文化和信仰的包容。

e.en: My {tolerance} for caffeine has dropped as I've gotten older.
e.zh: 随着年龄增长,我对咖啡因的耐受度下降了。

e.en: My grandmother is surprisingly {tolerant} of loud music.
e.zh: 我奶奶对吵闹的音乐意外地很包容。

e.en: These plants are highly {tolerant} of dry conditions.
e.zh: 这些植物对干旱环境的耐受性很强。

e.en: He smiled {tolerantly} as the toddler banged on the piano.
e.zh: 小孩乱敲钢琴时,他宽容地笑了笑。

e.en: The teacher listened {tolerantly} to every student's wild theory.
e.zh: 老师包容地听每个学生说出各种天马行空的想法。

e.en: I can't {tolerate} rude behavior from anyone on my team.
e.zh: 我无法容忍团队里任何人的粗鲁行为。

e.en: Some houseplants {tolerate} low light better than others.
e.zh: 有些室内植物比其他更能适应弱光环境。

e.en: Bullying is not {tolerated} at this school under any circumstance.
e.zh: 在这所学校,任何情况下都不容忍欺凌行为。

e.en: She {tolerated} the long commute for the higher salary.
e.zh: 为了更高的薪水,她忍受了漫长的通勤。

e.en: Our cat barely {tolerates} the new puppy at home.
e.zh: 我们家的猫勉强接受了新来的小狗。

e.en: This camera lens {tolerates} a wide range of temperatures.
e.zh: 这只相机镜头能适应较大的温度范围。

e.en: She is tired of {tolerating} her coworker's constant interruptions.
e.zh: 她已经厌倦了忍受同事不断的打断。

e.en: {Tolerating} mistakes is part of learning a new language.
e.zh: 容忍错误是学习一门新语言的一部分。

e.en: The act guaranteed religious {toleration} for all citizens.
e.zh: 这项法案保障所有公民的宗教宽容权利。

e.en: Genuine {toleration} requires more than just polite silence.
e.zh: 真正的宽容不仅仅是礼貌地沉默。

e.en: {Tolkien} created the languages of Middle-earth in remarkable detail.
e.zh: 托尔金极为细致地创造了中土世界的各种语言。

e.en: Many fantasy authors cite {Tolkien} as their biggest influence.
e.zh: 许多奇幻作家把托尔金奉为最大的影响来源。

toll.t:
n. 通行费；代价
v. 鸣（钟）

e.en: You have to pay a {toll} to cross this bridge.
e.zh: 过这座桥要交过路费。

e.en: The long hours took a serious {toll} on her health.
e.zh: 长时间的工作严重损害了她的健康。

e.en: Traffic backed up for miles at the highway {tollbooth}.
e.zh: 高速公路收费站前堵车堵了好几英里。

e.en: Most drivers now use transponders instead of stopping at the {tollbooth}.
e.zh: 如今大多数司机使用电子标签,不再在收费亭停车。

e.en: The church bells were {tolling} slowly for the funeral.
e.zh: 教堂的钟声为葬礼缓缓鸣响。

e.en: At midnight the great clock began {tolling} the new year.
e.zh: 午夜时分,那座大钟开始敲响新年的钟声。

tolls.t:
n. 通行费（复数）
v. 鸣钟

e.en: The state raised highway {tolls} to fund road repairs.
e.zh: 该州提高了高速公路通行费以筹措道路维修资金。

e.en: The bell {tolls} every hour from the old clock tower.
e.zh: 那座古老钟楼里的钟每小时鸣响一次。

e.en: We took the {tollway} to avoid the heavy city traffic.
e.zh: 我们走收费高速以避开市区的拥堵。

e.en: The new {tollway} cuts the drive to the airport in half.
e.zh: 这条新的收费高速把去机场的车程缩短了一半。

tolpuddle.t: n. 托尔帕德尔（英国地名）

e.en: The {Tolpuddle} Martyrs are honored as pioneers of trade unionism.
e.zh: 托尔普德尔烈士被尊为工会运动的先驱。

e.en: A small museum in {Tolpuddle} tells the farm laborers' story.
e.zh: 托尔普德尔的一座小博物馆讲述着这些农工的故事。

tolstoy.t: n. 托尔斯泰（俄国作家）

e.en: Many readers find {Tolstoy}'s novels long but deeply rewarding.
e.zh: 许多读者觉得托尔斯泰的小说虽长,却收获极大。

e.en: {Tolstoy} explored faith and morality in his later writings.
e.zh: 托尔斯泰在晚年的作品中探讨了信仰与道德。

e.en: {Toluene} is a common solvent used in paints and glues.
e.zh: 甲苯是油漆和胶水中常用的溶剂。

e.en: Workers must wear masks when handling {toluene} in the lab.
e.zh: 工作人员在实验室处理甲苯时必须戴口罩。

tomahawk.t: n. 印第安战斧；战斧巡航导弹

e.en: The museum displayed a beautifully carved wooden {tomahawk}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一把雕工精美的木柄战斧。

e.en: He ordered a thick {tomahawk} steak for the table.
e.zh: 他点了一块厚厚的战斧牛排给大家分着吃。

tomatillo.t: n. 粘果酸浆（墨西哥小番茄）

e.en: The salsa verde gets its tang from roasted {tomatillo}.
e.zh: 这款青酱的酸味来自烤过的墨西哥酸浆果。

e.en: Peel the husk off each {tomatillo} before chopping it.
e.zh: 切之前先把每个酸浆果外面的壳剥掉。

e.en: I sliced a ripe {tomato} for the sandwich.
e.zh: 我切了一个熟透的番茄夹三明治。

e.en: This sauce is made from fresh {tomato} and basil.
e.zh: 这款酱料是用新鲜番茄和罗勒做的。

e.en: Cherry {tomatoes} from the garden taste sweeter than store-bought ones.
e.zh: 自家花园种的小番茄比超市买的更甜。

e.en: Italian cooks often roast {tomatoes} to deepen their flavor.
e.zh: 意大利厨师常把番茄烤一下来加深风味。

e.en: Tourists lined up to enter the ancient pharaoh's {tomb}.
e.zh: 游客们排队进入那位古代法老的陵墓。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered a sealed {tomb} beneath the church floor.
e.zh: 考古学家在教堂地板下发现了一座封闭的墓穴。

e.en: The school fair raised money with a charity {tombola}.
e.zh: 学校集市通过慈善摸彩活动筹集资金。

e.en: She won a teddy bear in the village {tombola}.
e.zh: 她在村里的摸彩游戏中赢了一只泰迪熊。

tomboy.t: n. 假小子；男孩子气的女孩

e.en: As a kid she was a real {tomboy} who loved climbing trees.
e.zh: 小时候她是个十足的假小子,特别爱爬树。

e.en: The novel's heroine is a clever {tomboy} from a small town.
e.zh: 小说的女主角是一个来自小镇的机灵假小子。

tomboyish.t: adj. 像男孩子的；假小子般的

e.en: She kept her short hair and {tomboyish} style into adulthood.
e.zh: 她长大后仍保留着短发和假小子般的风格。

e.en: His daughter has a {tomboyish} love of skateboards and dirt.
e.zh: 他女儿有点假小子,喜欢滑板,也不怕弄脏。

e.en: The valley contains {tombs} of pharaohs from many dynasties.
e.zh: 这座山谷里安葬着许多朝代法老的陵墓。

e.en: Several royal {tombs} were looted long before archaeologists arrived.
e.zh: 考古学家到达之前,好几座王陵就已被盗。

e.en: Weather had worn the inscription on the old {tombstone}.
e.zh: 风雨已经磨损了那块旧墓碑上的铭文。

e.en: They placed flowers in front of his {tombstone} every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天他们都在他的墓碑前摆上鲜花。

e.en: A scruffy {tomcat} prowled the alley behind the restaurant.
e.zh: 一只邋遢的公猫在餐厅后面的小巷里巡视。

e.en: Our orange {tomcat} sleeps on the windowsill all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们家那只橘色公猫整下午都在窗台上睡觉。

tome.t: n. 大部头书；厚重的书

e.en: He pulled a dusty {tome} of Roman history off the shelf.
e.zh: 他从书架上取下了一本满是灰尘的罗马史巨著。

e.en: Her thesis grew into a 600-page {tome} on medieval trade.
e.zh: 她的论文最终写成了一部六百页的中世纪贸易巨著。

e.en: The teacher had no patience for {tomfoolery} during the exam.
e.zh: 考试期间老师不能容忍任何胡闹。

e.en: Their late-night {tomfoolery} woke everyone in the hostel.
e.zh: 他们半夜的胡闹把旅舍里所有人都吵醒了。

e.en: My nephew {Tommy} just started kindergarten this week.
e.zh: 我侄子汤米这周刚上幼儿园。

e.en: The old soldier was called a {Tommy} during the war.
e.zh: 那位老兵在战时被称为英国大兵。

e.en: The {tomographic} scan revealed a small tumor in her lung.
e.zh: 断层扫描显示她肺部有一个小肿瘤。

e.en: Engineers use {tomographic} imaging to inspect concrete structures.
e.zh: 工程师使用断层成像技术检查混凝土结构。

tomography.t: n. 断层扫描；断层成像

e.en: Computed {tomography} gives doctors detailed images of internal organs.
e.zh: 计算机断层扫描为医生提供详细的内脏图像。

e.en: Seismic {tomography} helps scientists map the Earth's interior.
e.zh: 地震层析成像帮助科学家绘制地球内部结构。

tomorrow.t:
adv. 明天
n. 未来

e.en: The meeting has been moved to {tomorrow} morning at nine.
e.zh: 会议已改到明天早上九点。

e.en: {Tomorrow} is going to be a really busy day.
e.zh: 明天将会是非常忙碌的一天。

e.en: We worry about today and forget the many {tomorrows} ahead.
e.zh: 我们只担心今天,却忘了未来还有许多明天。

e.en: Today's children are {tomorrows} leaders and innovators.
e.zh: 今天的孩子是未来的领袖和创新者。

e.en: Mandarin is a {tonal} language with four main tones.
e.zh: 普通话是有四个主要声调的声调语言。

e.en: The painting uses subtle {tonal} variations to create depth.
e.zh: 这幅画运用细微的色调变化来营造层次感。

e.en: The song shifts {tonality} halfway through the chorus.
e.zh: 这首歌在副歌中段转换了调性。

e.en: Her photography is known for its warm {tonality}.
e.zh: 她的摄影作品以温暖的色调著称。

tonally.t: adv. 在音调上；在色调上

e.en: The film is {tonally} inconsistent, mixing comedy with horror.
e.zh: 这部电影在基调上不太统一,喜剧与恐怖混杂。

e.en: The two pieces are {tonally} similar but rhythmically different.
e.zh: 这两首曲子调性相近,但节奏不同。

tonbridge.t: n. 汤布里奇（英国城镇）

e.en: She grew up in {Tonbridge}, a small town in Kent.
e.zh: 她在肯特郡的小镇汤布里奇长大。

e.en: The train to {Tonbridge} leaves from platform six.
e.zh: 开往汤布里奇的列车从六号站台发车。

e.en: The Renaissance {tondo} hangs in the museum's main hall.
e.zh: 那幅文艺复兴时期的圆形画挂在博物馆主厅。

e.en: Michelangelo carved a marble {tondo} of the Holy Family.
e.zh: 米开朗基罗雕刻了一幅圣家族大理石圆雕。

tone.t:
n. 语气；音调；色调
v. 调节

e.en: Please don't use that {tone} when speaking to your sister.
e.zh: 和你妹妹说话时请不要用那种语气。

e.en: The walls are painted in a soft cream {tone}.
e.zh: 墙壁刷成了柔和的奶油色调。

toned.t: adj. 紧致结实的（肌肉）；有色调的

e.en: After months of training, her arms looked beautifully {toned}.
e.zh: 经过几个月训练,她的手臂看起来线条紧致漂亮。

e.en: The photographer {toned} down the bright reds in editing.
e.zh: 摄影师在后期处理时减弱了画面中的鲜红色。

e.en: He answered in a flat, {toneless} voice.
e.zh: 他用平淡无起伏的声音回答。

e.en: Her {toneless} reply made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她毫无情感的回答让所有人都感到不自在。

e.en: She read the bad news {tonelessly} from the screen.
e.zh: 她毫无表情地从屏幕上念出这个坏消息。

e.en: He recited the apology {tonelessly}, clearly not meaning it.
e.zh: 他毫无感情地背出道歉,显然并非真心。

toner.t: n. 打印机墨粉；爽肤水

e.en: The printer is out of {toner} again.
e.zh: 打印机的墨粉又用完了。

e.en: She applies {toner} every night after washing her face.
e.zh: 她每晚洗脸后都会用爽肤水。

e.en: The room was decorated in warm earth {tones}.
e.zh: 房间装饰采用了温暖的大地色调。

e.en: Mandarin uses four different {tones} to distinguish words.
e.zh: 普通话用四种不同的声调来区分词义。

e.en: The chef used a {tong} to flip the steak.
e.zh: 厨师用夹子翻动牛排。

e.en: The Chinese {tong} once dominated parts of San Francisco.
e.zh: 华人堂会曾在旧金山部分地区颇具势力。

tonga.t: n. 汤加（南太平洋岛国）

e.en: {Tonga} is a Pacific island nation east of Fiji.
e.zh: 汤加是位于斐济东边的太平洋岛国。

e.en: They traveled to {Tonga} to swim with humpback whales.
e.zh: 他们前往汤加和座头鲸一起游泳。

e.en: Use the {tongs} to grab the bread from the toaster.
e.zh: 用夹子把面包从烤面包机里夹出来。

e.en: The blacksmith held the hot iron with heavy {tongs}.
e.zh: 铁匠用沉重的钳子夹住烧红的铁块。

e.en: He burned his {tongue} on the hot soup.
e.zh: 他被滚烫的汤烫到了舌头。

e.en: English is not her native {tongue}.
e.zh: 英语不是她的母语。

tongued.t: adj. 有舌的（常用于复合词）

e.en: The sharp-{tongued} critic tore the new film apart.
e.zh: 那位言辞犀利的影评人把这部新片批得体无完肤。

e.en: The dog {tongued} the ice cube curiously.
e.zh: 那只狗好奇地用舌头舔了舔冰块。

e.en: In the legend, the {tongueless} bird could no longer sing.
e.zh: 传说中那只失去舌头的鸟再也唱不出歌。

e.en: The villagers stood {tongueless} before the angry king.
e.zh: 村民们在愤怒的国王面前哑口无言地站着。

tongues.t: n. 舌头；语言（tongue 的复数）

e.en: The festival celebrates speakers of many native {tongues}.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝众多母语使用者的文化。

e.en: The flames licked the sky like orange {tongues}.
e.zh: 火焰像橙色的舌头一样舔舐着天空。

tonic.t:
n. 滋补品；奎宁水
adj. 使人精神振奋的

e.en: I'll have a gin and {tonic}, please.
e.zh: 请给我来一杯金汤力。

e.en: A weekend in the countryside is a real {tonic}.
e.zh: 在乡下过个周末真是身心的良药。

tonier.t: adj. 更高档的、更时髦的（tony 的比较级）

e.en: They moved to a {tonier} neighborhood after the promotion.
e.zh: 升职后他们搬到了更高档的小区。

e.en: This restaurant is {tonier} than the one downtown.
e.zh: 这家餐厅比市中心那家更上档次。

toniest.t: adj. 最高档的、最时髦的（tony 的最高级）

e.en: The hotel sits in the {toniest} part of Paris.
e.zh: 这家酒店坐落在巴黎最高档的地段。

e.en: She shopped at the city's {toniest} boutiques.
e.zh: 她在城里最高档的精品店购物。

tonight.t:
adv. 今晚
n. 今夜

e.en: Are you free for dinner {tonight}?
e.zh: 你今晚有空一起吃晚饭吗?

e.en: The concert {tonight} starts at eight sharp.
e.zh: 今晚的演唱会八点准时开始。

tonights.t: n. 今晚（tonight 的复数，罕用）

e.en: All of {tonights} performances are completely sold out.
e.zh: 今晚所有场次的演出票都已售罄。

e.en: {Tonights} dinner will feature locally sourced ingredients.
e.zh: 今晚的晚餐将采用本地食材。

toning.t: v. 调理（肌肉）、调色（toning 的现在分词）

e.en: She's been {toning} her legs with daily squats.
e.zh: 她每天做深蹲来锻炼腿部线条。

e.en: The artist is {toning} down the brightness in this corner.
e.zh: 画家正在调暗这个角落的亮度。

tonkin.t: n. 东京（越南北部地区名）

e.en: The Gulf of {Tonkin} lies between Vietnam and China.
e.zh: 东京湾位于越南和中国之间。

e.en: American history textbooks mention the {Tonkin} incident extensively.
e.zh: 美国历史教科书大量提及东京湾事件。

e.en: Nymphadora {Tonks} is a beloved character in Harry Potter.
e.zh: 尼法朵拉·唐克斯是《哈利·波特》中深受喜爱的角色。

e.en: The batsman {tonks} the ball over the boundary.
e.zh: 击球手把球猛击出界外。

e.en: The port handles huge {tonnage} of cargo each year.
e.zh: 这个港口每年处理巨大吨位的货物。

e.en: Shipping {tonnage} has dropped sharply during the recession.
e.zh: 航运吨位在经济衰退期间大幅下滑。

e.en: Each truck can haul about one {tonne} of gravel.
e.zh: 每辆卡车可装运约一公吨碎石。

e.en: The factory produces a {tonne} of plastic every hour.
e.zh: 该工厂每小时生产一公吨塑料。

tonneau.t: n. 汽车后座车厢；酒桶形表壳

e.en: He covered the truck bed with a vinyl {tonneau}.
e.zh: 他用一张乙烯基车斗罩盖住了卡车货厢。

e.en: The classic car still has its original leather {tonneau}.
e.zh: 这辆经典老爷车仍保留着原装皮质后舱罩。

e.en: The ship was carrying twenty thousand {tonnes} of grain.
e.zh: 那艘船装载了两万公吨粮食。

e.en: Farmers harvested record {tonnes} of wheat this season.
e.zh: 农民们这一季收获了创纪录的小麦吨数。

tons.t: n. 吨（ton 的复数）；大量

e.en: I have {tons} of homework to finish tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚有一大堆作业要做。

e.en: The mine produces thousands of {tons} of coal annually.
e.zh: 这座矿山每年生产数千吨煤炭。

e.en: The doctor noticed one swollen {tonsil} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时发现一侧扁桃体肿大。

e.en: A small stone formed in his left {tonsil}.
e.zh: 他的左侧扁桃体上长了一颗小结石。

e.en: The patient developed a painful {tonsillar} abscess.
e.zh: 病人长出了一个疼痛的扁桃体脓肿。

e.en: Doctors examined the {tonsillar} tissue under a microscope.
e.zh: 医生用显微镜检查扁桃体组织。

e.en: She had a {tonsillectomy} when she was seven years old.
e.zh: 她七岁时做过扁桃体切除手术。

e.en: Recovery from a {tonsillectomy} usually takes about two weeks.
e.zh: 扁桃体切除术后恢复通常需要约两周时间。

e.en: He missed school for a week with severe {tonsillitis}.
e.zh: 他因严重的扁桃体炎请了一周假。

e.en: {Tonsillitis} is often caused by a viral infection.
e.zh: 扁桃体炎通常由病毒感染引起。

e.en: The barber was famous for his {tonsorial} skills.
e.zh: 那位理发师以高超的理发技艺闻名。

e.en: He visited the {tonsorial} parlor every other Saturday.
e.zh: 他每隔一个星期六就去理发店一次。

e.en: The young monk received his {tonsure} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 那位年轻的僧侣在仪式上接受了剃度。

e.en: His shaved {tonsure} marked him as a member of the order.
e.zh: 他剃光的头顶标志着他是教团的成员。

e.en: Regular exercise improves muscle {tonus} and posture.
e.zh: 经常运动能改善肌肉张力和体态。

e.en: The therapist measured the patient's {tonus} during the session.
e.zh: 治疗师在治疗过程中测量了患者的肌张力。

tony.t:
adj. 时髦的、高档的
n. 托尼（人名）

e.en: They had dinner at a {tony} restaurant overlooking the bay.
e.zh: 他们在一家俯瞰海湾的高档餐厅吃了晚餐。

e.en: The musical won a {Tony} Award for best score.
e.zh: 这部音乐剧荣获托尼奖最佳音乐奖。

took.t: v. 拿、带（take 的过去式）

e.en: She {took} the train to work this morning.
e.zh: 她今天早上坐火车去上班。

e.en: He {took} a deep breath before answering the question.
e.zh: 他深吸了一口气才回答这个问题。

tool.t:
n. 工具
v. 用工具加工

e.en: A good search engine is an essential research {tool}.
e.zh: 一款好用的搜索引擎是必备的研究工具。

e.en: Please put every {tool} back in the toolbox after use.
e.zh: 使用后请把每件工具放回工具箱。

toolbar.t: n. 工具栏（界面中的按钮条）

e.en: Click the save icon on the {toolbar} to keep your changes.
e.zh: 点击工具栏上的保存图标以保留你的修改。

e.en: You can customize the {toolbar} to show your favorite tools.
e.zh: 你可以自定义工具栏以显示常用工具。

e.en: He keeps a hammer and screwdriver in his {toolbox}.
e.zh: 他的工具箱里放着锤子和螺丝刀。

e.en: Empathy is an important {toolbox} item for any manager.
e.zh: 同理心是任何管理者必备的一项工具。

tooled.t: adj. 用工具加工过的；皮具压花的

e.en: She bought a beautifully {tooled} leather wallet in Florence.
e.zh: 她在佛罗伦萨买了一个精美雕花的皮夹。

e.en: The factory is fully {tooled} for mass production.
e.zh: 工厂已完全配备好进行大规模生产。

tooling.t: n. 工具加工；工装、模具

e.en: The company invested millions in new {tooling} for the plant.
e.zh: 公司在工厂的新设备工装上投入了数百万。

e.en: Modern developer {tooling} makes debugging much easier.
e.zh: 现代的开发者工具让调试工作变得轻松许多。

e.en: The developer shared a free {toolkit} for building chatbots.
e.zh: 这位开发者分享了一个免费的聊天机器人开发工具包。

e.en: Patience is an essential {toolkit} for any teacher.
e.zh: 耐心是每位老师必备的素质之一。

toolmaker.t: n. 工具制造者；模具工

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a precision {toolmaker} for forty years.
e.zh: 她爷爷做了四十年的精密工具制造师。

e.en: The factory hired a skilled {toolmaker} to design new molds.
e.zh: 工厂聘请了一位熟练的工具师来设计新模具。

e.en: He keeps all his {tools} organized in the garage.
e.zh: 他把所有工具都整齐地放在车库里。

e.en: AI {tools} are changing how designers work.
e.zh: 人工智能工具正在改变设计师的工作方式。

e.en: The old {toolshed} behind the house leaks when it rains.
e.zh: 屋后那间旧工具棚一下雨就漏水。

e.en: Dad spent the weekend cleaning out the {toolshed}.
e.zh: 爸爸花了整个周末清理工具棚。

toon.t: n. 卡通人物（cartoon 的缩写）

e.en: My kid watches the same {toon} every morning.
e.zh: 我家孩子每天早上都看同一部动画片。

e.en: That streamer drew herself as a cute {toon} avatar.
e.zh: 那个主播把自己画成了一个可爱的卡通形象。

toot.t:
v. 鸣笛、嘟嘟响
n. 嘟嘟声

e.en: The driver gave a friendly {toot} of the horn.
e.zh: 司机友好地按了一下喇叭。

e.en: Don't {toot} your own horn too much at work.
e.zh: 在工作中不要太自吹自擂。

e.en: The dentist pulled out my broken {tooth} yesterday.
e.zh: 牙医昨天把我那颗坏牙拔掉了。

e.en: One {tooth} on the gear was chipped.
e.zh: 齿轮上有一个齿崩掉了。

e.en: I couldn't sleep because of a terrible {toothache}.
e.zh: 我牙疼得厉害,根本睡不着。

e.en: Sugary drinks gave him a sudden {toothache}.
e.zh: 含糖饮料让他突然牙疼起来。

e.en: Frequent {toothaches} can signal a deeper dental problem.
e.zh: 经常牙疼可能预示着更严重的牙齿问题。

e.en: She gets {toothaches} whenever she eats ice cream.
e.zh: 她一吃冰淇淋就会牙疼。

e.en: You should replace your {toothbrush} every three months.
e.zh: 牙刷应该每三个月换一次。

e.en: He forgot to pack his {toothbrush} for the trip.
e.zh: 他出差忘了带牙刷。

e.en: Electric {toothbrushes} clean better than manual ones, dentists say.
e.zh: 牙医说电动牙刷比普通牙刷刷得更干净。

e.en: The hotel provides free {toothbrushes} on request.
e.zh: 酒店可以应要求免费提供牙刷。

e.en: Investigators went through the files with a fine {toothcomb}.
e.zh: 调查人员把文件仔仔细细地查了一遍。

e.en: She used a {toothcomb} to remove tangles from her hair.
e.zh: 她用细齿梳把头发里的乱结理顺。

e.en: The saw has sharp {toothed} edges for cutting metal.
e.zh: 这把锯有锋利的锯齿,用来切割金属。

e.en: Dolphins are {toothed} whales that hunt in groups.
e.zh: 海豚是成群捕猎的齿鲸。

toothless.t: adj. 无牙的；没有威慑力的

e.en: The new regulation turned out to be completely {toothless}.
e.zh: 这项新法规结果完全没有约束力。

e.en: The {toothless} old man smiled warmly at the children.
e.zh: 那位没了牙的老人冲孩子们温暖地笑了。

e.en: I ran out of {toothpaste} this morning.
e.zh: 我今天早上牙膏用完了。

e.en: This brand of {toothpaste} contains natural mint extract.
e.zh: 这个牌子的牙膏含有天然薄荷提取物。

e.en: Whitening {toothpastes} have become very popular online.
e.zh: 美白牙膏在网上变得非常受欢迎。

e.en: Most {toothpastes} on the shelf contain fluoride.
e.zh: 货架上大多数牙膏都含有氟化物。

e.en: He used a {toothpick} after the steak dinner.
e.zh: 吃完牛排后他用了一根牙签。

e.en: The chef secured the wrap with a small {toothpick}.
e.zh: 厨师用一根小牙签把卷饼固定住。

toothsome.t: adj. 美味可口的；诱人的

e.en: The bakery serves a {toothsome} chocolate cake on weekends.
e.zh: 这家面包店周末供应一款美味的巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: Critics praised the {toothsome} flavors of the new menu.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这份新菜单上各种诱人的口味。

toothy.t: adj. 露齿的、牙齿突出的

e.en: She gave the camera a big, {toothy} grin.
e.zh: 她对着镜头露出大大的、龇牙的笑容。

e.en: The {toothy} shark glided silently past the divers.
e.zh: 那条满口利齿的鲨鱼悄无声息地从潜水员身边游过。

tooting.t: v. 鸣笛（toot 的现在分词）

e.en: Cars were {tooting} their horns in the morning traffic.
e.zh: 早高峰路上的汽车一直在按喇叭。

e.en: He keeps {tooting} his own horn about that promotion.
e.zh: 他一直在炫耀自己升职的事。

tootle.t: v. 轻快地吹奏（喇叭、笛等）

e.en: We'll {tootle} down to the cafe for breakfast.
e.zh: 我们慢悠悠地去咖啡馆吃早餐。

e.en: You could hear him {tootle} a tune on the flute.
e.zh: 可以听到他在用长笛轻轻吹着小调。

tootsie.t:
n. 小脚丫（儿语）
n. 亲爱的（昵称）

e.en: Come here, {tootsie}, let me tie your shoelace.
e.zh: 过来,小宝贝,我给你系鞋带。

e.en: My grandma still calls me her little {tootsie}.
e.zh: 我奶奶还叫我她的小宝贝。

top.t:
n. 顶部；上方
adj. 最高的；顶级的

e.en: She wore a stunning {topaz} ring to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚惊艳的黄玉戒指出席晚会。

e.en: The sky turned a brilliant {topaz} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时天空变成了灿烂的黄玉色。

topcoat.t:
n. 大衣；外套
n. 面漆

e.en: He grabbed his wool {topcoat} before heading outside.
e.zh: 他出门前抓起了那件羊毛外套。

e.en: Apply a clear {topcoat} to protect the nail polish.
e.zh: 涂一层透明的面漆来保护指甲油。

toped.t: v. 过量饮酒（tope 的过去式）

e.en: The old sailors {toped} together at the harbor tavern.
e.zh: 老水手们在港口的小酒馆里一起痛饮。

e.en: He {toped} heavily after losing his job.
e.zh: 他失业后开始酗酒。

e.en: The novel's hero is a charming but hopeless {toper}.
e.zh: 小说的主人公是个迷人却嗜酒如命的酒鬼。

e.en: Locals knew him as the village {toper}.
e.zh: 当地人都知道他是村里有名的酒鬼。

topiary.t: n. 树木造型艺术；绿雕

e.en: The garden featured elaborate {topiary} shaped like animals.
e.zh: 花园里有修剪成各种动物造型的精致绿雕。

e.en: He spends weekends trimming his {topiary} hedges.
e.zh: 他周末都在修剪他的造型树篱。

e.en: Climate change is a sensitive {topic} at family dinners.
e.zh: 气候变化在家庭聚餐时是个敏感话题。

e.en: Let's move on to the next {topic} on the agenda.
e.zh: 我们进入议程上的下一个议题吧。

topical.t:
adj. 热门的；时事的
adj. 局部的（药物）

e.en: The podcast covers {topical} issues in tech each week.
e.zh: 这档播客每周讨论科技领域的热点话题。

e.en: Apply the {topical} cream twice a day to the rash.
e.zh: 每天在皮疹处涂抹两次外用药膏。

e.en: The film's {topicality} made it an instant hit.
e.zh: 这部电影的时效性让它一上映就大受欢迎。

e.en: Editors look for {topicality} when picking cover stories.
e.zh: 编辑在挑选封面故事时很看重时效性。

topically.t:
adv. 就时事而言
adv. 局部地（用药）

e.en: The ointment must be applied {topically}, not swallowed.
e.zh: 这种药膏必须外用,不能吞服。

e.en: Her essay engaged {topically} with this year's election.
e.zh: 她的文章紧扣今年的选举这一时事话题。

e.en: We covered several {topics} during the team meeting.
e.zh: 我们在团队会议上讨论了好几个话题。

e.en: Trending {topics} on social media change every hour.
e.zh: 社交媒体上的热门话题每小时都在变。

toping.t: v. 酗酒（tope 的现在分词）

e.en: The men spent the evening {toping} by the fire.
e.zh: 那群男人在炉火旁喝了一晚上的酒。

e.en: He gave up {toping} after his doctor's warning.
e.zh: 医生警告之后他就戒了酒。

e.en: She tied her hair into a neat {topknot} for class.
e.zh: 她把头发扎成整齐的丸子头去上课。

e.en: The samurai's traditional {topknot} symbolized his status.
e.zh: 武士传统的发髻象征着他的身份。

topless.t: adj. 袒露上身的；无上装的

e.en: The beach has a {topless} area for sunbathers.
e.zh: 这片海滩有一块可以裸上身日光浴的区域。

e.en: He drove a sleek {topless} convertible along the coast.
e.zh: 他开着一辆光鲜的敞篷车沿海岸行驶。

e.en: The eagle's nest sits on the {topmost} branch.
e.zh: 鹰巢筑在最顶端的那根树枝上。

e.en: Safety remains our {topmost} priority in this project.
e.zh: 安全始终是这个项目中最优先考虑的事。

topo.t: n. 地形图（topographic 的缩写）

e.en: Hikers should always carry a detailed {topo} map.
e.zh: 徒步者总是应该随身带一份详细的地形图。

e.en: The climber studied the {topo} before tackling the cliff.
e.zh: 攀岩者在挑战那面峭壁前仔细研究了线路图。

topographer.t: n. 地形测量员；地形学家

e.en: The {topographer} mapped the mountain range using drones.
e.zh: 这位地形测绘员用无人机绘制了这片山脉的地图。

e.en: A skilled {topographer} produced the detailed survey report.
e.zh: 一位资深的地形学家撰写了这份详尽的勘测报告。

e.en: Hikers rely on {topographic} maps to plan their routes.
e.zh: 徒步者依靠地形图来规划路线。

e.en: The {topographic} survey revealed hidden valleys nearby.
e.zh: 地形勘测发现了附近隐藏的山谷。

e.en: The atlas includes detailed {topographical} maps of every continent.
e.zh: 这本地图册收录了每个大洲的详细地形图。

e.en: Engineers studied the {topographical} features before building the road.
e.zh: 工程师在修路之前研究了当地的地形特征。

topographically.t: adv. 在地形上；从地貌看

e.en: The two regions are {topographically} very different.
e.zh: 这两个地区在地形上差异很大。

e.en: The island is {topographically} dominated by volcanic peaks.
e.zh: 这座岛屿的地形以火山山峰为主。

e.en: Mars and Earth have surprisingly similar {topographies} in places.
e.zh: 火星与地球在某些地方的地形竟然很相似。

e.en: The book compares the {topographies} of major desert regions.
e.zh: 这本书比较了主要沙漠地区的地形。

topography.t:
n. 地形；地势
n. 地形学

e.en: The rugged {topography} makes farming nearly impossible here.
e.zh: 这里崎岖的地形让农耕几乎无法进行。

e.en: Satellite images reveal the {topography} of the seafloor.
e.zh: 卫星图像揭示了海底的地形。

e.en: The professor explained {topological} spaces with everyday examples.
e.zh: 教授用日常例子解释了拓扑空间。

e.en: Networks have a {topological} structure that affects performance.
e.zh: 网络具有影响其性能的拓扑结构。

topology.t:
n. 拓扑结构
n. 拓扑学

e.en: The network's {topology} determines how data flows between servers.
e.zh: 网络的拓扑结构决定了数据在服务器之间的流动方式。

e.en: She studies {topology} as part of her math degree.
e.zh: 她在数学专业中学习拓扑学。

e.en: "Springfield" is a common {toponym} across America.
e.zh: “斯普林菲尔德”是美国常见的地名。

e.en: Each {toponym} on the map hints at local history.
e.zh: 地图上的每个地名都透露着当地的历史。

topos.t: n. 常见主题；文学母题

e.en: The hero's journey is a familiar {topos} in fiction.
e.zh: 英雄之旅是小说中常见的母题。

e.en: Forbidden love remains a powerful literary {topos}.
e.zh: 禁忌之爱仍是文学中一个有力的母题。

topper.t:
n. 高顶礼帽
n. 最棒的人或事

e.en: That joke was a real {topper} at the dinner.
e.zh: 那个笑话在晚宴上简直是压轴笑点。

e.en: She placed a star {topper} on the Christmas tree.
e.zh: 她把一颗星星树顶饰品放在了圣诞树上。

topping.t: n. 浇头；顶层配料（披萨、蛋糕等）

e.en: My favorite pizza {topping} is mushrooms and olives.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的披萨配料是蘑菇和橄榄。

e.en: She added whipped cream as a {topping} to the dessert.
e.zh: 她在甜点上加了一层奶油作为浇头。

e.en: Strong winds could {topple} the old tree any minute.
e.zh: 大风随时可能把那棵老树吹倒。

e.en: The protests threatened to {topple} the government.
e.zh: 抗议活动有可能会推翻政府。

toppled.t: v. 倒下；被推翻（topple 过去式）

e.en: Strong winds {toppled} the old oak tree last night.
e.zh: 昨晚的强风把那棵老橡树吹倒了。

e.en: Protesters {toppled} the statue in the city square.
e.zh: 抗议者推倒了城市广场上的雕像。

topples.t: v. 倒塌；推翻（第三人称单数）

e.en: One careless push {topples} the entire stack of books.
e.zh: 轻轻一推就能让整摞书倒下。

e.en: The startup {topples} industry giants with its new app.
e.zh: 这家初创公司用新应用撼动了行业巨头。

toppling.t: v. 倒塌中；推翻（现在分词）

e.en: The earthquake sent buildings {toppling} across the city.
e.zh: 地震使整座城市的建筑纷纷倒塌。

e.en: She kept the tower from {toppling} with steady hands.
e.zh: 她稳住双手,防止塔倒下。

tops.t:
n. 顶部（复数）
adj. 顶级的；最棒的

e.en: This song {tops} the charts for the third week.
e.zh: 这首歌已连续三周登上榜首。

e.en: She bought two new {tops} during the summer sale.
e.zh: 她在夏季促销时买了两件新上衣。

e.en: The crew unfurled the {topsail} as the wind picked up.
e.zh: 风势变强时船员展开了上桅帆。

e.en: A torn {topsail} slowed the ship considerably.
e.zh: 破损的上桅帆让船速明显变慢。

topside.t: n. 上层；甲板以上部分

e.en: The captain ordered everyone {topside} for the briefing.
e.zh: 船长命令所有人到甲板上集合听简报。

e.en: Flip the steak when the {topside} turns golden brown.
e.zh: 当牛排上面变成金黄色时就翻面。

e.en: Heavy rain washed away the rich {topsoil} from the field.
e.zh: 暴雨把田里肥沃的表层土冲走了。

e.en: Gardeners spread fresh {topsoil} before planting seeds.
e.zh: 园丁们在播种前铺上新鲜的表层土。

topspin.t: n. 上旋球（网球、乒乓球）

e.en: He hit the ball with heavy {topspin} down the line.
e.zh: 他用强烈的上旋球沿直线击出。

e.en: Adding {topspin} keeps the shot inside the baseline.
e.zh: 加上上旋能让球落在底线内。

topsy.t: adj. 颠倒的（多见于 topsy-turvy）

e.en: The kids ran around in a {topsy} mess after the party.
e.zh: 派对后孩子们在乱糟糟的房间里跑来跑去。

e.en: Her desk looked completely {topsy} after the deadline.
e.zh: 截止日期过后她的桌子乱成一团。

topsy-turvy.t: adj. 乱七八糟的；天翻地覆的

e.en: Life felt {topsy-turvy} after moving to a new country.
e.zh: 搬到新国家后生活变得乱七八糟。

e.en: The toddler's room was {topsy-turvy} with toys everywhere.
e.zh: 幼儿的房间到处是玩具,一片狼藉。

toque.t:
n. 厨师帽
n. 无檐女帽

e.en: The chef adjusted his white {toque} before entering the kitchen.
e.zh: 主厨进厨房前整理了一下他的白色高帽。

e.en: She wore a wool {toque} to fight the winter cold.
e.zh: 她戴着羊毛帽抵御冬天的严寒。

e.en: He studies the {torah} every Saturday at the synagogue.
e.zh: 他每周六都在犹太会堂研读妥拉。

e.en: The {torah} scroll was carefully removed from the ark.
e.zh: 妥拉经卷被小心地从约柜中取出。

e.en: We spent the weekend at a hotel in {Torbay}.
e.zh: 我们在托基的一家酒店度过了周末。

e.en: {Torbay} is famous for its sandy beaches and palm trees.
e.zh: 托基以其沙滩和棕榈树而闻名。

torch.t:
n. 手电筒；火把
v. 放火烧

e.en: Use your phone's {torch} to find the keys under the couch.
e.zh: 用手机手电筒找沙发下的钥匙。

e.en: Olympic runners carried the {torch} through every city.
e.zh: 奥运火炬手将火炬传遍每个城市。

e.en: She became a {torchbearer} for women in tech.
e.zh: 她成为科技领域女性的旗手。

e.en: The first {torchbearer} lit the cauldron at the ceremony.
e.zh: 第一棒火炬手在仪式上点燃了主火盆。

torched.t: v. 放火烧毁（torch 的过去式）

e.en: Vandals {torched} the abandoned warehouse last night.
e.zh: 昨晚破坏者纵火烧了那座废弃的仓库。

e.en: The critic completely {torched} the new movie online.
e.zh: 那位评论家在网上把这部新电影批得一无是处。

e.en: Hikers carried {torches} as they entered the dark cave.
e.zh: 徒步者带着火把走进漆黑的洞穴。

e.en: The protester {torches} a flag in front of the embassy.
e.zh: 抗议者在大使馆前点燃了一面旗帜。

torching.t: v. 纵火焚烧（torch 的现在分词）

e.en: The rioters were caught {torching} cars on the street.
e.zh: 暴徒被发现在街上焚烧汽车。

e.en: Reviewers are {torching} the buggy software online.
e.zh: 评论者们在网上猛烈批评这款漏洞百出的软件。

e.en: They explored the cave by {torchlight} after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后他们借着火把光探索洞穴。

e.en: A {torchlight} parade marched through the village square.
e.zh: 一支火炬游行队伍穿过村庄广场。

tore.t: v. tear 的过去式；撕开、扯破

e.en: She accidentally {tore} the page while turning it.
e.zh: 她翻页时不小心把纸撕破了。

e.en: The dog {tore} across the yard chasing a squirrel.
e.zh: 那只狗追着松鼠飞奔过院子。

toreador.t: n. 斗牛士（尤指骑马的）

e.en: The {toreador} faced the bull with a red cape.
e.zh: 斗牛士拿着红披风面对公牛。

e.en: Crowds cheered as the {toreador} entered the ring.
e.zh: 斗牛士进入斗牛场时观众欢呼。

e.en: The young {torero} trained for years before his debut.
e.zh: 这位年轻斗牛士在首次登场前训练了多年。

e.en: A famous {torero} signed autographs after the fight.
e.zh: 一位著名斗牛士在比赛后签名留念。

e.en: We took a train from Milan to {Torino} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从米兰乘火车到都灵。

e.en: {Torino} hosted the Winter Olympics back in 2006.
e.zh: 都灵曾在2006年举办冬季奥运会。

torment.t:
n. 痛苦、折磨
v. 使痛苦、折磨

e.en: The constant noise was a real {torment} to the neighbors.
e.zh: 持续的噪音对邻居来说真是一种折磨。

e.en: Bullies often {torment} classmates over small differences.
e.zh: 恶霸常因小小的差异折磨同学。

tormented.t:
adj. 饱受折磨的
v. torment 的过去式

e.en: She was {tormented} by guilt for years after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后她被内疚折磨了多年。

e.en: Mosquitoes {tormented} the campers throughout the night.
e.zh: 蚊子整夜折磨着露营者。

e.en: He finally confronted his childhood {tormenter} at the reunion.
e.zh: 他在同学聚会上终于面对了童年的施虐者。

e.en: The {tormenter} was eventually expelled from school.
e.zh: 那个折磨者最终被学校开除了。

tormenting.t: adj. 折磨人的、令人痛苦的

e.en: Stop {tormenting} your little brother with that toy spider.
e.zh: 别再用那只玩具蜘蛛吓唬你弟弟了。

e.en: The {tormenting} memories kept her awake every night.
e.zh: 那些折磨人的回忆让她每晚都难以入睡。

e.en: She wrote a memoir about confronting her {tormentor}.
e.zh: 她写了一本回忆录,讲述面对折磨者的经历。

e.en: The villain became the hero's lifelong {tormentor}.
e.zh: 那个反派成了主角终生的折磨者。

torments.t:
n. 痛苦（复数）
v. 折磨（第三人称单数）

e.en: Insomnia {torments} him almost every weeknight.
e.zh: 失眠几乎每个工作日的夜晚都折磨着他。

e.en: The novel describes the {torments} of war survivors.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了战争幸存者的痛苦。

torn.t:
adj. 撕破的；纠结的
v. tear 的过去分词

e.en: She wore jeans with stylishly {torn} knees to the party.
e.zh: 她穿着膝盖处时髦破洞的牛仔裤参加派对。

e.en: He was {torn} between two excellent job offers.
e.zh: 他在两份很棒的工作邀请之间难以抉择。

tornadic.t: adj. 龙卷风的、似龙卷风的

e.en: Forecasters warned of {tornadic} activity across the region.
e.zh: 气象预报员警告该地区可能出现龙卷风活动。

e.en: The storm produced {tornadic} winds reaching 200 mph.
e.zh: 这场风暴产生了高达每小时200英里的龙卷风风速。

e.en: A massive {tornado} flattened houses across the small town.
e.zh: 一场强烈的龙卷风夷平了小镇上的房屋。

e.en: Sirens warned residents to take shelter from the {tornado}.
e.zh: 警报提醒居民躲避龙卷风。

e.en: Several {tornadoes} touched down in Oklahoma yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天俄克拉荷马州有几场龙卷风着陆。

e.en: Spring brings frequent {tornadoes} to the central plains.
e.zh: 春季常给中部平原带来龙卷风。

e.en: The reactor uses a {toroidal} magnetic field to contain plasma.
e.zh: 反应堆使用环形磁场来约束等离子体。

e.en: Engineers designed a {toroidal} coil for the new transformer.
e.zh: 工程师为新变压器设计了一个环形线圈。

toronto.t: n. 多伦多（加拿大城市）

e.en: My cousin moved to {Toronto} for a software job.
e.zh: 我表哥为了一份软件工作搬到了多伦多。

e.en: {Toronto} is Canada's largest and most diverse city.
e.zh: 多伦多是加拿大最大、最多元化的城市。

torpedo.t:
n. 鱼雷
v. 用鱼雷击沉；破坏

e.en: The submarine fired a {torpedo} at the enemy ship.
e.zh: 潜艇向敌舰发射了一枚鱼雷。

e.en: Negative reviews could {torpedo} the product launch entirely.
e.zh: 负面评价可能彻底毁掉这次产品发布。

e.en: The summer heat left everyone feeling {torpid} and lazy.
e.zh: 夏天的炎热让每个人都感到迟钝懒散。

e.en: Bears become {torpid} during the long winter months.
e.zh: 熊在漫长的冬季会进入迟缓的状态。

e.en: After lunch, a heavy {torpor} settled over the office.
e.zh: 午饭后,办公室里弥漫着一种昏沉的倦意。

e.en: Hummingbirds enter {torpor} on cold nights to save energy.
e.zh: 蜂鸟在寒冷的夜晚进入蛰伏状态以节省能量。

torquay.t: n. 托基（英国海滨城市）

e.en: Tourists love the seafront promenade in {Torquay}.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢托基的海滨步道。

e.en: We rented a cottage near {Torquay} for the holidays.
e.zh: 我们假期在托基附近租了一间小屋。

e.en: This electric motor produces impressive {torque} from a standstill.
e.zh: 这台电动机从静止启动就能产生惊人的扭矩。

e.en: Use a wrench to {torque} the bolts to specification.
e.zh: 用扳手按规格拧紧螺栓。

torr.t: n. 托（压强单位，≈133.3 帕）

e.en: The vacuum chamber was pumped down to one {torr}.
e.zh: 真空室被抽到一托的压强。

e.en: Pressure measurements in {torr} are common in laboratories.
e.zh: 以托为单位的压力测量在实验室中很常见。

torrance.t: n. 托伦斯（美国加州城市；姓氏）

e.en: She grew up in {Torrance}, a quiet city near Los Angeles.
e.zh: 她在洛杉矶附近的安静城市托兰斯长大。

e.en: {Torrance} has many Japanese restaurants and supermarkets.
e.zh: 托兰斯有许多日式餐馆和超市。

e.en: The leaning {torre} in Pisa attracts millions of visitors.
e.zh: 比萨斜塔每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: We climbed the medieval {torre} for a panoramic view.
e.zh: 我们爬上中世纪的塔楼欣赏全景。

torrent.t:
n. 激流；（言语等）迸发
n. 种子下载（BT）

e.en: A {torrent} of complaints flooded the company's inbox.
e.zh: 大量投诉涌入公司的收件箱。

e.en: The mountain stream became a raging {torrent} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴雨过后山间小溪变成了汹涌的激流。

e.en: {Torrential} rain caused flash floods across the valley.
e.zh: 暴雨在山谷各处引发了山洪。

e.en: We canceled the picnic due to the {torrential} downpour.
e.zh: 由于倾盆大雨,我们取消了野餐。

e.en: {Torres} del Paine is a stunning national park in Chile.
e.zh: 托雷斯德尔潘恩是智利一个令人惊叹的国家公园。

e.en: Maria {Torres} won the marathon by a wide margin.
e.zh: 玛丽亚·托雷斯以巨大优势赢得了马拉松比赛。

e.en: They had a brief but {torrid} romance one summer.
e.zh: 他们在某个夏天有过一段短暂而炽热的恋情。

e.en: The desert hikers struggled in the {torrid} afternoon heat.
e.zh: 沙漠徒步者在酷热的午后艰难前行。

e.en: My grandmother lives in {Torrington}, Connecticut.
e.zh: 我祖母住在康涅狄格州的托灵顿。

e.en: The factory in {Torrington} closed after fifty years.
e.zh: 托灵顿的那家工厂在经营五十年后关闭了。

e.en: Engineers tested the bridge cables for {torsion} resistance.
e.zh: 工程师测试了桥梁缆绳的抗扭性能。

e.en: Excessive {torsion} can crack the metal shaft over time.
e.zh: 过度扭转随时间推移可能使金属轴出现裂纹。

e.en: The drill shaft must withstand high {torsional} stress.
e.zh: 钻杆必须承受很高的扭转应力。

e.en: Engineers measured {torsional} vibration in the new engine.
e.zh: 工程师测量了新引擎的扭转振动。

e.en: He sculpted a marble {torso} for the museum exhibit.
e.zh: 他为博物馆展览雕刻了一尊大理石躯干像。

e.en: The athlete twisted his {torso} to dodge the punch.
e.zh: 运动员扭动上身躲开了那一拳。

tort.t: n. 侵权行为（法律术语）

e.en: She studies {tort} law at a top university.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖大学攻读侵权法。

e.en: The lawsuit was filed as a {tort} claim.
e.zh: 该诉讼是以侵权索赔的形式提起的。

e.en: The bakery sells a rich chocolate {torte} on weekends.
e.zh: 那家面包店周末出售浓郁的巧克力多层蛋糕。

e.en: She baked a Sachertorte {torte} for the dinner party.
e.zh: 她为晚宴烤了一个萨赫多层蛋糕。

tortellini.t: n. 意式小馄饨、托特里尼

e.en: We ordered cheese {tortellini} in a creamy mushroom sauce.
e.zh: 我们点了奶油蘑菇酱配奶酪意式饺。

e.en: Homemade {tortellini} takes hours to fold by hand.
e.zh: 手工折制的意式饺要花好几个小时。

tortilla.t: n. 玉米/面粉薄饼（墨西哥）

e.en: She warmed a corn {tortilla} on the skillet.
e.zh: 她在平底锅上加热了一张玉米薄饼。

e.en: Wrap the chicken inside a soft flour {tortilla}.
e.zh: 把鸡肉卷进一张柔软的面粉薄饼里。

e.en: The court ruled the conduct was {tortious} interference.
e.zh: 法院裁定该行为构成侵权干扰。

e.en: He faces liability for {tortious} acts against the company.
e.zh: 他将为针对公司的侵权行为承担责任。
