e.en: Historical attitudes toward {transvestism} varied widely between cultures.
e.zh: 不同文化对异装的历史态度差异很大。

e.en: The cabaret featured a famous {transvestite} performer.
e.zh: 这场歌舞秀邀请了一位著名的异装表演者。

e.en: He played a {transvestite} character in the award-winning film.
e.zh: 他在那部获奖电影中扮演了一个异装角色。

e.en: Philosophers debate whether {transworld} identity is even coherent.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论跨世界同一性是否能自洽。

e.en: The argument relies on a {transworld} comparison of possible outcomes.
e.zh: 该论证依赖于对可能结果的跨世界比较。

transylvania.t: n. 特兰西瓦尼亚（罗马尼亚地区）

e.en: Tourists flock to {Transylvania} hoping to find Dracula's castle.
e.zh: 游客们涌向特兰西瓦尼亚，希望找到德古拉的城堡。

e.en: The folk music of {Transylvania} blends Hungarian and Romanian styles.
e.zh: 特兰西瓦尼亚的民间音乐融合了匈牙利和罗马尼亚的风格。

transylvanian.t:
adj. 特兰西瓦尼亚的
n. 当地人

e.en: He spoke with a thick {Transylvanian} accent.
e.zh: 他说话带着浓重的特兰西瓦尼亚口音。

e.en: The chef prepared a traditional {Transylvanian} stew for dinner.
e.zh: 厨师为晚餐准备了一道传统的特兰西瓦尼亚炖菜。

e.en: In the old village, a {tranter} hauled goods between farms.
e.zh: 在那个老村子里，一位货运车夫在各农场间运送货物。

e.en: Hardy's novel features a friendly {tranter} as a main character.
e.zh: 哈代的小说以一位友善的货运车夫为主要人物。

trap.t:
n. 陷阱；圈套
v. 设陷阱；困住

e.en: Don't fall into the {trap} of buying things you don't need.
e.zh: 别掉进买不必要东西的陷阱。

e.en: The hunter set a {trap} to catch wild rabbits.
e.zh: 猎人设了一个陷阱来抓野兔。

e.en: A hidden {trapdoor} led down to the wine cellar.
e.zh: 一扇隐藏的活板门通向地下酒窖。

e.en: The magician disappeared through a {trapdoor} on stage.
e.zh: 魔术师从舞台上的活板门中消失了。

e.en: She performed a daring flip on the {trapeze}.
e.zh: 她在高空秋千上表演了惊险的翻转。

e.en: Circus acrobats train daily on the {trapeze}.
e.zh: 马戏团杂技演员每天都在高空秋千上训练。

e.en: Stretching can relieve tension in your {trapezius} muscles.
e.zh: 做拉伸可以缓解斜方肌的紧张。

e.en: Carrying heavy bags strains the {trapezius}.
e.zh: 背重包会让斜方肌过度紧张。

e.en: The kids learned to draw a {trapezoid} in geometry class.
e.zh: 孩子们在几何课上学画梯形。

e.en: The roof has a distinctive {trapezoid} shape.
e.zh: 这屋顶有一个独特的梯形形状。

e.en: The architect designed a {trapezoidal} window for the entrance.
e.zh: 建筑师为入口设计了一扇梯形窗户。

e.en: Engineers prefer a {trapezoidal} channel for irrigation efficiency.
e.zh: 工程师为提高灌溉效率更倾向于使用梯形渠道。

e.en: The hunter checked his {trapline} every morning before sunrise.
e.zh: 猎人每天日出前都会查看他的捕兽线。

e.en: Generations of trappers have run this {trapline} through the woods.
e.zh: 几代猎人都在这片林子里布设这条捕兽线。

trapped.t:
v. 被困住（过去式）
adj. 受困的

e.en: She felt {trapped} in a job she no longer enjoyed.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被困在一份不再喜欢的工作里。

e.en: The cat got {trapped} behind the washing machine again.
e.zh: 猫又被卡在洗衣机后面了。

trapper.t: n. 设陷阱捕兽者（尤指毛皮猎人）

e.en: The old {trapper} sold beaver pelts at the trading post.
e.zh: 那个老猎人在贸易站卖海狸皮。

e.en: A {trapper} taught her how to read animal tracks in snow.
e.zh: 一位捕猎人教她如何辨认雪地里的动物足迹。

trapping.t:
n. 诱捕，设陷阱
v. trap 的现在分词

e.en: The park bans {trapping} of any wild animals.
e.zh: 公园禁止捕捉任何野生动物。

e.en: He spent the winter {trapping} foxes in the mountains.
e.zh: 他整个冬天都在山里捕狐狸。

trappings.t: n. 外在装饰；象征性排场

e.en: He enjoyed all the {trappings} of fame but missed his privacy.
e.zh: 他享受名气带来的种种排场,却怀念隐私。

e.en: The office had all the {trappings} of a successful startup.
e.zh: 那间办公室具备成功创业公司的一切外在派头。

e.en: The monastery brews a famous {Trappist} beer loved worldwide.
e.zh: 这家修道院酿造一款举世闻名的特拉普啤酒。

e.en: A {Trappist} monk took a vow of silence years ago.
e.zh: 一位特拉普派修士多年前立下了静默誓言。

traps.t:
n. 陷阱（复数）
v. 使陷入（第三人称单数）

e.en: The exterminator set mouse {traps} along the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 灭虫工沿厨房墙边放置了几个捕鼠器。

e.en: Avoid the common {traps} that new investors fall into.
e.zh: 避开新手投资者常掉进的那些陷阱。

trash.t:
n. 垃圾
v. 丢弃；损毁

e.en: Please take the {trash} out before bed.
e.zh: 睡前请把垃圾拿出去。

e.en: Critics called the movie complete {trash}.
e.zh: 影评人把这部电影骂得一文不值。

e.en: The {trashcan} in the corner was overflowing again.
e.zh: 角落里的垃圾桶又满出来了。

e.en: He tossed the empty bottle into the {trashcan}.
e.zh: 他把空瓶子扔进了垃圾桶。

trashed.t:
adj. 被丢弃的；烂醉的
v. trash 的过去式

e.en: The hotel room got completely {trashed} after the party.
e.zh: 派对结束后那间酒店房间被彻底糟蹋了。

e.en: Reviewers {trashed} the new sequel online.
e.zh: 评论家在网上把这部续集骂得一无是处。

trashes.t: v. trash 的第三人称单数

e.en: The blog regularly {trashes} overhyped tech products.
e.zh: 那个博客经常痛批被过度炒作的科技产品。

e.en: Whenever he loses, he {trashes} the controller in frustration.
e.zh: 他一输就气得砸手柄。

trashing.t: v. 丢弃；损毁（trash 的 ing 形式）

e.en: Stop {trashing} her cooking — she tried her best.
e.zh: 别再贬损她做的饭了,她已经尽力了。

e.en: The toddler is {trashing} the living room again.
e.zh: 那个小孩又在把客厅弄得一团糟。

e.en: I love reading {trashy} romance novels on vacation.
e.zh: 我度假时喜欢看那种没营养的爱情小说。

e.en: The reality show is total {trashy} entertainment.
e.zh: 这档真人秀完全是低俗娱乐。

e.en: We had pasta at a tiny family-run {trattoria} in Rome.
e.zh: 我们在罗马一家家庭经营的小餐馆吃了意面。

e.en: The {trattoria} on the corner serves the best tiramisu.
e.zh: 街角那家小馆做的提拉米苏是最棒的。

e.en: Therapy helped her process the {trauma} from the accident.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她处理了车祸带来的创伤。

e.en: The ER specializes in treating severe {trauma} patients.
e.zh: 急诊室专门治疗严重创伤患者。

e.en: Childhood {traumas} can shape adult relationships in subtle ways.
e.zh: 童年创伤可能以微妙的方式影响成年后的人际关系。

e.en: The veteran spoke openly about the {traumas} of war.
e.zh: 那位老兵坦率地谈及战争带来的种种创伤。

traumatic.t: adj. 令人痛苦的；外伤的

e.en: Losing the championship was a {traumatic} experience for the team.
e.zh: 输掉冠军赛对球队来说是一次惨痛的经历。

e.en: She still has nightmares about the {traumatic} accident.
e.zh: 她还会做关于那场惨痛事故的噩梦。

traumatise.t: v. 使受精神创伤（英式拼写）

e.en: Horror films can really {traumatise} young children.
e.zh: 恐怖片真的会让小孩留下心理阴影。

e.en: Don't let one bad review {traumatise} your whole career.
e.zh: 别让一条差评毁掉你整个职业生涯的心态。

traumatised.t: adj. 心灵受创的（英式拼写）

e.en: The dog was {traumatised} by the fireworks last night.
e.zh: 那只狗被昨晚的烟花吓出了心理阴影。

e.en: She felt deeply {traumatised} after the burglary.
e.zh: 那次入室盗窃后她受了严重的心理创伤。

e.en: Watching that movie alone might {traumatize} you.
e.zh: 一个人看那部电影可能会让你留下心理阴影。

e.en: Public speaking failures can {traumatize} students for years.
e.zh: 演讲失败可能让学生留下多年的心理阴影。

e.en: He was {traumatized} after witnessing the car crash.
e.zh: 目睹那场车祸后他受到了严重的心理创伤。

e.en: The puppy seems {traumatized} every time it sees the vacuum.
e.zh: 小狗每次看到吸尘器都像受了惊吓。

e.en: After much {travail}, she finally finished her dissertation.
e.zh: 历经千辛万苦,她终于完成了博士论文。

e.en: The novel describes the {travail} of immigrant families.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了移民家庭的艰辛。

travel.t:
v. 旅行；行进
n. 旅行

e.en: I love to {travel} during the off-season for cheaper flights.
e.zh: 我喜欢在淡季出行,因为机票更便宜。

e.en: Sound waves {travel} faster through water than through air.
e.zh: 声波在水中传播比在空气中快。

traveled.t:
v. travel 的过去式
adj. 阅历丰富的

e.en: She has {traveled} to over thirty countries on five continents.
e.zh: 她已经游历过五大洲三十多个国家。

e.en: News of the discovery {traveled} fast across social media.
e.zh: 这一发现的消息在社交媒体上传得飞快。

e.en: Every seasoned {traveler} packs a portable charger.
e.zh: 每个老练的旅行者都会带便携充电器。

e.en: The lone {traveler} checked into the hostel after midnight.
e.zh: 那位独行旅客午夜后才入住青年旅舍。

e.en: Many {travelers} were stranded at the airport during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间许多旅客被困在机场。

e.en: The app helps {travelers} find affordable last-minute hotels.
e.zh: 这款应用帮旅客寻找临时入住的实惠酒店。

traveling.t:
v. travel 的进行式
adj. 旅行的；巡回的

e.en: I'll be {traveling} for work most of next month.
e.zh: 下个月大部分时间我都要出差。

e.en: A {traveling} circus arrived in town over the weekend.
e.zh: 一个流动马戏团周末来到了镇上。

e.en: The young {traveller} backpacked across Southeast Asia for a year.
e.zh: 这位年轻的旅行者背包穿越东南亚走了一年。

e.en: Every experienced {traveller} learns to pack light.
e.zh: 每位有经验的旅行者都学会轻装出行。

e.en: The hostel is popular with budget {travellers} from Europe.
e.zh: 这家青旅深受欧洲穷游旅客的欢迎。

e.en: Heavy snow stranded thousands of {travellers} overnight.
e.zh: 大雪让数千名旅客滞留了一整夜。

travelling.t: v. travel 的进行式（英式拼写）

e.en: She enjoys {travelling} solo to remote mountain villages.
e.zh: 她喜欢独自前往偏远的山村旅行。

e.en: Avoid {travelling} during peak holiday weekends.
e.zh: 尽量避开假期高峰周末出行。

travelogue.t: n. 旅行见闻；旅游纪录片

e.en: His latest {travelogue} chronicles a year crossing Patagonia.
e.zh: 他最新的游记记录了横穿巴塔哥尼亚的一年。

e.en: The film is part documentary, part {travelogue}.
e.zh: 这部电影一半是纪录片,一半是游记。

travels.t:
n. 游历见闻
v. travel 的第三人称单数

e.en: Her {travels} through Asia inspired three bestselling books.
e.zh: 她在亚洲的游历催生了三本畅销书。

e.en: Light {travels} in straight lines through empty space.
e.zh: 光在真空中沿直线传播。

e.en: Tree {traversal} algorithms are essential for any computer science student.
e.zh: 树的遍历算法是计算机系学生必学的内容。

e.en: The hikers planned a careful {traversal} of the glacier.
e.zh: 登山者仔细规划了穿越冰川的路线。

traverse.t: v. 穿越；遍历（数据结构）

e.en: It took six hours to {traverse} the mountain ridge.
e.zh: 穿越这条山脊花了六个小时。

e.en: The function will {traverse} every node in the graph.
e.zh: 该函数会遍历图中的每一个节点。

traverses.t: v. traverse 的第三人称单数

e.en: The trail {traverses} dense forest before reaching the lake.
e.zh: 这条小径穿过茂密的森林后通向湖边。

e.en: The script {traverses} the directory and indexes every file.
e.zh: 该脚本会遍历目录并为每个文件建立索引。

travertine.t: n. 石灰华（一种建筑石材）

e.en: The bathroom features beautiful cream-colored {travertine} tiles.
e.zh: 浴室铺着漂亮的米色洞石瓷砖。

e.en: Ancient Romans built temples from local {travertine}.
e.zh: 古罗马人用本地洞石建造神庙。

travesty.t: n. 歪曲；令人不齿的伪劣版本

e.en: The trial was a {travesty} of justice from start to finish.
e.zh: 这场审判从头到尾都是对司法公正的歪曲。

e.en: Critics called the remake a {travesty} of the original.
e.zh: 评论家称这部翻拍是对原作的拙劣模仿。

travois.t: n. 印第安人用的 V 形拖橇

e.en: The Plains tribes used a {travois} to haul belongings across grasslands.
e.zh: 平原部落用拖橇在草原上运送物品。

e.en: A simple {travois} can carry surprising loads behind a horse.
e.zh: 一个简单的拖橇拴在马后能拉相当多的货物。

trawl.t:
v. 拖网捕鱼；大量搜寻
n. 拖网

e.en: Recruiters {trawl} LinkedIn for promising candidates every day.
e.zh: 招聘人员每天在领英上搜罗有潜力的候选人。

e.en: Fishermen {trawl} the deep waters for shrimp and cod.
e.zh: 渔民在深海拖网捕捞虾和鳕鱼。

e.en: The rusty {trawler} returned to port at dawn.
e.zh: 那艘锈迹斑斑的拖网渔船黎明时分返港。

e.en: A small {trawler} caught fire off the coast last night.
e.zh: 昨夜近海一艘小型拖网渔船起火。

trawling.t: v. 拖网捕鱼；大范围搜罗

e.en: She spent hours {trawling} through old emails for the receipt.
e.zh: 她花了几个小时翻找旧邮件想找那张收据。

e.en: Bottom {trawling} damages fragile coral ecosystems.
e.zh: 海底拖网会破坏脆弱的珊瑚生态。

e.en: He carried the breakfast {tray} carefully up the stairs.
e.zh: 他小心地端着早餐托盘上楼。

e.en: Place the cookies on the baking {tray} an inch apart.
e.zh: 把饼干隔约一英寸地摆在烤盘上。

e.en: Stack the empty {trays} by the kitchen entrance.
e.zh: 把空托盘堆在厨房入口处。

e.en: The cafeteria provides plastic {trays} at the start of the line.
e.zh: 食堂在打饭队伍开头处提供塑料餐盘。

e.en: The novel exposes the small {treacheries} of office politics.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了办公室政治中那些小小的背叛。

e.en: History remembers his {treacheries} long after his death.
e.zh: 在他死后多年,历史仍记得他的种种背叛。

treacherous.t: adj. 背信弃义的；暗藏危险的

e.en: The mountain road becomes {treacherous} after heavy rain.
e.zh: 暴雨过后这条山路变得非常危险。

e.en: He turned out to be a {treacherous} business partner.
e.zh: 事实证明他是个背信弃义的生意伙伴。

treacherously.t: adv. 背信弃义地；阴险地

e.en: The ice cracked {treacherously} beneath the skater's feet.
e.zh: 冰面在溜冰者脚下危险地裂开了。

e.en: He {treacherously} leaked his teammate's plans to rivals.
e.zh: 他背信弃义地把队友的计划泄露给了对手。

e.en: His {treachery} cost the company millions in stolen secrets.
e.zh: 他的背叛让公司因机密泄露损失了数百万。

e.en: The general was executed for {treachery} against the crown.
e.zh: 那位将军因背叛王室而被处死。

e.en: Grandma's pudding always tastes of warm {treacle} and ginger.
e.zh: 奶奶做的布丁总有暖暖的糖蜜和姜的味道。

e.en: The film's ending was drowned in sentimental {treacle}.
e.zh: 影片的结尾被过度煽情的腻味淹没了。

treacly.t: adj. 甜腻的；过于感伤的

e.en: The pop ballad was too {treacly} for my taste.
e.zh: 那首流行慢歌对我来说太过腻歪。

e.en: She gave him a {treacly} smile that fooled no one.
e.zh: 她对他露出一个甜得发腻、骗不了任何人的笑。

tread.t:
v. 踩；踏
n. 胎面花纹

e.en: Please {tread} carefully on the freshly waxed floor.
e.zh: 刚打过蜡的地板上请小心走动。

e.en: The tire's {tread} is too worn to pass inspection.
e.zh: 这条轮胎的花纹磨得太薄,过不了年检。

treading.t: v. 踩踏（tread 的现在分词）

e.en: She was {treading} carefully on the icy sidewalk.
e.zh: 她在结冰的人行道上小心翼翼地走着。

e.en: He kept {treading} water until the lifeguard arrived.
e.zh: 他一直踩着水直到救生员赶到。

e.en: My grandmother still uses a {treadle} sewing machine.
e.zh: 我奶奶仍然在用脚踏式缝纫机。

e.en: Press the {treadle} gently to start the wheel spinning.
e.zh: 轻踩踏板就能让轮子转起来。

treadmill.t: n. 跑步机；单调的工作

e.en: I run on the {treadmill} for thirty minutes every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上在跑步机上跑三十分钟。

e.en: He felt stuck on the corporate {treadmill} for years.
e.zh: 他觉得自己多年来困在公司这台机器里转个不停。

treads.t:
n. 胎面花纹
v. 踩踏

e.en: The tire {treads} are too worn to drive safely.
e.zh: 轮胎花纹磨损得太严重,开起来不安全了。

e.en: She {treads} lightly to avoid waking the baby.
e.zh: 她走路很轻,生怕吵醒宝宝。

e.en: He was charged with {treason} for selling state secrets.
e.zh: 他因出卖国家机密被指控犯有叛国罪。

e.en: In wartime, {treason} carries the harshest penalties.
e.zh: 战时叛国罪会受到最严厉的惩罚。

e.en: The leaked documents contained {treasonable} communications with the enemy.
e.zh: 泄露的文件中含有与敌方进行的叛国性通讯。

e.en: Speaking against the king was once considered {treasonable}.
e.zh: 反对国王的言论曾被视为叛国行为。

e.en: His {treasonous} acts shocked the entire nation.
e.zh: 他的叛国行为震惊了整个国家。

e.en: The novel portrays a {treasonous} general plotting a coup.
e.zh: 小说描绘了一位策划政变的叛国将军。

treasure.t:
n. 宝藏；珍宝
v. 珍视

e.en: The pirates buried their {treasure} on a remote island.
e.zh: 海盗们把宝藏埋在了一座偏远的小岛上。

e.en: I {treasure} the time I spend with my grandparents.
e.zh: 我非常珍惜和爷爷奶奶在一起的时光。

e.en: This photo is one of my most {treasured} possessions.
e.zh: 这张照片是我最珍爱的物品之一。

e.en: She {treasured} every letter her father had written.
e.zh: 她珍藏着父亲写的每一封信。

e.en: The club {treasurer} reported a healthy budget surplus.
e.zh: 俱乐部财务主管报告了一笔可观的预算盈余。

e.en: She was elected {treasurer} of the student council.
e.zh: 她当选为学生会的财务负责人。

treasures.t:
n. 珍宝（复数）
v. 珍视

e.en: The museum displays ancient {treasures} from around the world.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自世界各地的古代珍宝。

e.en: She {treasures} every drawing her son brings home.
e.zh: 她珍藏着儿子带回家的每一幅画。

e.en: The national {treasury} announced new bond rates today.
e.zh: 国家财政部今天公布了新的债券利率。

e.en: This anthology is a {treasury} of classic short stories.
e.zh: 这本选集是经典短篇小说的宝库。

treat.t:
v. 对待；治疗
n. 款待；乐事

e.en: Let me {treat} you to dinner for your birthday.
e.zh: 你生日我请你吃晚饭吧。

e.en: The doctors used antibiotics to {treat} the infection.
e.zh: 医生用抗生素治疗这次感染。

treatable.t: adj. 可治疗的；可处理的

e.en: Most early-stage cancers are highly {treatable} today.
e.zh: 如今大多数早期癌症都是可以治疗的。

e.en: The condition is chronic but completely {treatable} with medication.
e.zh: 这种病虽是慢性的,但完全可以靠药物控制。

treated.t:
v. 对待；治疗（过去式）
adj. 经过处理的

e.en: She was {treated} unfairly by her former employer.
e.zh: 她被前雇主不公平地对待。

e.en: The wood is {treated} to resist moisture and insects.
e.zh: 这种木材经过处理,能防潮防虫。

e.en: The water {treater} removes harmful chemicals from the supply.
e.zh: 这台水处理器能去除供水中的有害化学物质。

e.en: She works as a wastewater {treater} at the plant.
e.zh: 她在工厂里担任污水处理工。

e.en: The two countries signed several trade {treaties} last year.
e.zh: 两国去年签署了多项贸易条约。

e.en: Climate {treaties} require cooperation from every major economy.
e.zh: 气候条约需要所有主要经济体的合作。

treating.t: v. 对待；治疗（现在分词）

e.en: The vet is {treating} my dog for an ear infection.
e.zh: 兽医正在给我的狗治疗耳部感染。

e.en: Stop {treating} me like a child, I'm twenty-five.
e.zh: 别再把我当小孩子了,我都二十五岁了。

e.en: He published a {treatise} on modern economic theory.
e.zh: 他发表了一篇关于现代经济理论的专论。

e.en: Her {treatise} on ethics is required reading in philosophy classes.
e.zh: 她那篇伦理学论文是哲学课的必读文献。

e.en: The new cancer {treatment} has shown promising results.
e.zh: 这种新的癌症疗法已显示出令人鼓舞的效果。

e.en: Workers protested the unfair {treatment} from management.
e.zh: 工人们抗议管理层的不公平对待。

treatments.t: n. 治疗；处理方式（复数）

e.en: She tried several {treatments} before finding one that worked.
e.zh: 她尝试了好几种疗法才找到一种有效的。

e.en: The spa offers facial {treatments} and massages.
e.zh: 这家水疗中心提供面部护理和按摩服务。

treats.t:
n. 零食；款待
v. 对待

e.en: I gave the puppy some {treats} for sitting nicely.
e.zh: 小狗乖乖坐下后,我给了它一些零食。

e.en: She always {treats} her coworkers with kindness and respect.
e.zh: 她对同事总是友善又尊重。

e.en: The peace {treaty} ended decades of border conflict.
e.zh: 这份和平条约结束了数十年的边境冲突。

e.en: Both nations agreed to renegotiate the trade {treaty}.
e.zh: 两国同意重新谈判这份贸易条约。

treble.t:
adj. 三倍的；高音的
v. 增至三倍

e.en: Turn down the {treble} on the speakers a bit.
e.zh: 把音箱的高音稍微调低一点。

e.en: His income has {treble} what it was five years ago.
e.zh: 他的收入是五年前的三倍。

trebling.t: v. 增至三倍（现在分词）

e.en: Demand for electric cars is {trebling} every few years.
e.zh: 电动汽车的需求每隔几年就翻三倍。

e.en: The company is {trebling} its workforce in Asia.
e.zh: 该公司正在将其在亚洲的员工人数扩大到三倍。

e.en: The medieval army used a {trebuchet} to breach the walls.
e.zh: 中世纪的军队用投石机攻破了城墙。

e.en: Students built a working {trebuchet} for the physics fair.
e.zh: 学生们为物理展制作了一台能用的投石机。

trecento.t: n. 十四世纪（意大利艺术时期）

e.en: Giotto was a major painter of the Italian {trecento}.
e.zh: 乔托是意大利十四世纪重要的画家。

e.en: The museum's {trecento} collection includes rare illuminated manuscripts.
e.zh: 博物馆的十四世纪藏品包括珍贵的彩绘手抄本。

tredegar.t: n. 特雷德加（地名/人名）

e.en: The {Tredegar} Iron Works supplied cannons during the Civil War.
e.zh: 特雷德加铁厂在内战期间供应大炮。

e.en: We visited the small Welsh town of {Tredegar} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天去了威尔士的小镇特雷德加。

e.en: There's a huge oak {tree} in our backyard.
e.zh: 我们后院有一棵巨大的橡树。

e.en: The folder structure forms a {tree} with nested directories.
e.zh: 文件夹结构形成了一个嵌套目录的树形结构。

e.en: The kids built a {treehouse} in the old maple tree.
e.zh: 孩子们在那棵老枫树上搭了一个树屋。

e.en: We rented a luxury {treehouse} for the weekend getaway.
e.zh: 我们租了一间豪华树屋度过周末。

e.en: The hills were bare and {treeless} after the wildfire.
e.zh: 野火过后,山丘光秃秃的,一棵树也没有。

e.en: Tundra regions are mostly flat and {treeless}.
e.zh: 苔原地区大多平坦,没有树木。

e.en: The data is organized in a {treelike} hierarchy.
e.zh: 数据以树状层级结构组织。

e.en: Coral can grow into beautiful {treelike} shapes underwater.
e.zh: 珊瑚在水下能长成漂亮的树状形态。

treeline.t: n. 树木线（山上树木生长的上限）

e.en: We hiked above the {treeline} into the rocky alpine zone.
e.zh: 我们徒步走到林木线之上,进入了岩石高山地带。

e.en: The {treeline} is much lower in colder northern latitudes.
e.zh: 在寒冷的北方高纬度地区,林木线要低得多。

e.en: The {trees} along the river turn gold every autumn.
e.zh: 河边的树木每到秋天都会变成金黄色。

e.en: Volunteers planted hundreds of {trees} in the empty park.
e.zh: 志愿者在空旷的公园里种下了数百棵树。

e.en: A red bird perched on the highest {treetop}.
e.zh: 一只红鸟停在最高的树梢上。

e.en: The zip line glides through the {treetop} canopy.
e.zh: 滑索从树冠顶部穿过。

e.en: The window features a stained-glass {trefoil} design.
e.zh: 这扇窗户采用了三叶形彩色玻璃图案。

e.en: Bees love the small yellow flowers of bird's-foot {trefoil}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜欢百脉根那种黄色的小花。

trek.t: n./v. 长途跋涉；徒步旅行

e.en: We're planning a two-week {trek} through the Himalayas.
e.zh: 我们计划进行为期两周的喜马拉雅山徒步旅行。

e.en: My commute is a long {trek} across the city.
e.zh: 我每天上下班要穿越整个城市,路程非常远。

e.en: The experienced {trekker} carried only essential gear up the mountain.
e.zh: 那位经验丰富的徒步者只带必需装备上山。

e.en: Every {trekker} must register before entering the national park.
e.zh: 每位徒步者进入国家公园前都必须登记。

trekking.t:
n. 徒步旅行
v. 长途跋涉（现在分词）

e.en: We went {trekking} in Nepal for our honeymoon.
e.zh: 我们蜜月期间去尼泊尔徒步旅行了。

e.en: Good boots are essential for {trekking} in rough terrain.
e.zh: 在崎岖地形徒步,一双好靴子是必不可少的。

treks.t: n./v. 长途跋涉（复数/第三人称）

e.en: She {treks} two miles to school every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上要走两英里去上学。

e.en: The guidebook lists the best {treks} in Patagonia.
e.zh: 这本指南列出了巴塔哥尼亚最棒的徒步路线。

e.en: Professor {Trelawney} taught Divination at Hogwarts.
e.zh: 特里劳妮教授在霍格沃茨教占卜课。

e.en: The {Trelawney} family has lived here for generations.
e.zh: 特里劳妮家族在这里已经生活了好几代。

trellis.t: n. 格子棚架（供植物攀爬）

e.en: Roses climb up the wooden {trellis} by the gate.
e.zh: 玫瑰沿着大门旁的木格子架往上爬。

e.en: He built a {trellis} to support his tomato plants.
e.zh: 他搭了一个棚架来支撑番茄植株。

e.en: The {trellised} vines produced an excellent harvest this year.
e.zh: 今年棚架上的葡萄藤收成非常好。

e.en: A {trellised} archway leads into the rose garden.
e.zh: 一座格子拱门通向玫瑰园。

e.en: The guitarist added a smooth {trem} effect to the solo.
e.zh: 吉他手给独奏加上了流畅的颤音效果。

e.en: Adjust the {trem} arm to bend the note slightly.
e.zh: 调整颤音摇杆,让音符稍微弯曲一下。

tremble.t:
v. 颤抖；发抖
n. 战栗

e.en: His hands began to {tremble} as he opened the letter.
e.zh: 他打开信时双手开始颤抖。

e.en: You could feel the building {tremble} during the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震时能感觉到大楼在颤动。

e.en: Her voice {trembled} as she read the goodbye letter.
e.zh: 她念告别信时声音在颤抖。

e.en: The leaves {trembled} in the cold autumn breeze.
e.zh: 树叶在秋天寒冷的微风中颤动。

e.en: Politics in this country has become deeply {tribal}.
e.zh: 这个国家的政治已经变得严重部落化。

e.en: The museum displays beautiful {tribal} masks.
e.zh: 博物馆里展出着精美的部落面具。

tribalism.t: n. 部落主义；族群至上

e.en: Online {tribalism} makes honest debate almost impossible.
e.zh: 网络上的部落主义让理性辩论几乎不可能。

e.en: Sports fandom can slip into harmless {tribalism}.
e.zh: 体育迷的热情有时会变成无伤大雅的部落主义。

e.en: The {tribe} has lived in this valley for centuries.
e.zh: 这个部族在这片山谷里已经生活了几百年。

e.en: Online creators talk about finding their {tribe}.
e.zh: 网络创作者常说要找到自己的同类圈子。

e.en: Several Indigenous {tribes} signed the treaty together.
e.zh: 几个原住民部落共同签署了那份条约。

e.en: Modern fandoms behave a lot like ancient {tribes}.
e.zh: 现代粉丝群体的行为很像古老的部落。

e.en: An old {tribesman} guided us through the rainforest.
e.zh: 一位年长的部落男子带我们穿过雨林。

e.en: The {tribesman} spoke a language few outsiders understood.
e.zh: 那位部落男子说着一种外人几乎无法听懂的语言。

e.en: Local {tribespeople} welcomed the visiting researchers warmly.
e.zh: 当地的部落居民热情地欢迎来访的研究人员。

e.en: The {tribespeople} have protected this forest for generations.
e.zh: 这些部落居民世世代代守护着这片森林。

tribology.t: n. 摩擦学（研究摩擦、磨损）

e.en: {Tribology} studies how surfaces wear when they rub together.
e.zh: 摩擦学研究表面相互摩擦时的磨损规律。

e.en: Engineers use {tribology} to design longer-lasting bearings.
e.zh: 工程师运用摩擦学来设计更耐用的轴承。

e.en: After months of {tribulation}, the family finally found a stable home.
e.zh: 经历了数月的苦难，这家人终于找到了安定的住所。

e.en: Starting a business brings joy and {tribulation} in equal measure.
e.zh: 创业带来的喜悦与磨难是同等的。

tribunal.t: n. 特别法庭；裁决机构

e.en: The international {tribunal} ruled against the corrupt official.
e.zh: 国际法庭对那名腐败官员作出了不利裁决。

e.en: She testified before the war crimes {tribunal} last week.
e.zh: 上周她在战争罪法庭上作了证。

e.en: Several {tribunals} were established to handle the disputes.
e.zh: 为处理这些争端设立了几个特别法庭。

e.en: Employment {tribunals} hear thousands of unfair dismissal cases each year.
e.zh: 劳动仲裁庭每年审理成千上万起不当解雇案件。

tribune.t:
n. 护民官
n. 论坛报（常用作报名）

e.en: The newspaper {tribune} published an exposé on city hall.
e.zh: 《论坛报》刊登了一篇揭露市政厅的报道。

e.en: He saw himself as a {tribune} of the working class.
e.zh: 他视自己为工人阶级的代言人。

tributary.t:
n. 支流
adj. 进贡的

e.en: The river has a small {tributary} flowing in from the north.
e.zh: 这条河有一条小支流从北面汇入。

e.en: Ancient kingdoms sent gold as {tributary} payments to the empire.
e.zh: 古代王国向帝国进贡黄金作为附庸贡品。

tribute.t:
n. 致敬；颂词
n. 贡品

e.en: The concert was a heartfelt {tribute} to the late singer.
e.zh: 这场演唱会是对已故歌手的深情致敬。

e.en: His success is a {tribute} to years of hard work.
e.zh: 他的成功是多年努力的见证。

e.en: Fans left flowers and {tributes} outside the singer's home.
e.zh: 粉丝们在歌手家外献上鲜花和悼念物。

e.en: Heartfelt {tributes} poured in from around the world.
e.zh: 世界各地纷纷送来真挚的悼念。

trice.t: n. 顷刻（多用 in a trice）

e.en: The waiter cleared the table in a {trice}.
e.zh: 服务员一眨眼就把桌子收拾干净了。

e.en: She solved the puzzle in a {trice} and grinned.
e.zh: 她转眼间就解开了谜题，笑了起来。

e.en: Push-ups are great for building your {triceps}.
e.zh: 俯卧撑非常适合锻炼三头肌。

e.en: He pulled a {triceps} muscle during the bench press.
e.zh: 他在卧推时拉伤了三头肌。

e.en: The museum's new {triceratops} skeleton drew huge crowds.
e.zh: 博物馆新展出的三角龙骨架吸引了大批观众。

e.en: My nephew won't stop talking about his toy {triceratops}.
e.zh: 我侄子一直在念叨他那只三角龙玩具。

trichloroethylene.t: n. 三氯乙烯（工业溶剂）

e.en: Workers were exposed to {trichloroethylene} at the old factory.
e.zh: 工人们曾在老工厂里接触到三氯乙烯。

e.en: The EPA classifies {trichloroethylene} as a hazardous chemical.
e.zh: 美国环保署将三氯乙烯列为有害化学品。

trichotillomania.t: n. 拔毛癖（强迫性拔头发）

e.en: Therapy helped her manage her {trichotillomania} effectively.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她有效控制了拔毛癖。

e.en: {Trichotillomania} causes people to compulsively pull out their hair.
e.zh: 拔毛癖会让人强迫性地拔掉自己的头发。

trick.t:
n. 把戏；诡计
v. 欺骗

e.en: The magician taught me a card {trick} after the show.
e.zh: 演出结束后魔术师教了我一个纸牌戏法。

e.en: Don't let them {trick} you into clicking that link.
e.zh: 别让他们骗你点开那个链接。

tricked.t: v. 欺骗（trick 的过去式）

e.en: He {tricked} the chatbot into revealing its system prompt.
e.zh: 他骗过聊天机器人，让它泄露了系统提示词。

e.en: I felt {tricked} after reading the fine print.
e.zh: 看完那些小字条款后我觉得被骗了。

e.en: The scam relied on clever {trickery} and fake urgency.
e.zh: 这场骗局靠的是巧妙的伎俩和制造紧迫感。

e.en: Politicians are often accused of using verbal {trickery}.
e.zh: 政客常被指责玩弄文字游戏。

tricking.t: v. 欺骗（trick 的现在分词）

e.en: He's {tricking} the AI into revealing its hidden prompt.
e.zh: 他在诱骗人工智能透露隐藏的提示词。

e.en: The ad is {tricking} users into signing up for subscriptions.
e.zh: 这个广告在欺骗用户订阅服务。

trickle.t:
v. 细流；慢慢流下
n. 涓滴

e.en: Only a thin {trickle} of water came out of the faucet.
e.zh: 水龙头只流出细细的一股水。

e.en: Donations began to {trickle} in after the news report aired.
e.zh: 新闻播出后,捐款开始陆陆续续涌入。

trickling.t: v. 细细流淌（trickle 的 ing 形式）

e.en: Rain was {trickling} down the window all afternoon.
e.zh: 雨水整个下午都顺着窗户慢慢滴下来。

e.en: New job offers are slowly {trickling} into her inbox.
e.zh: 新的工作邀请正慢慢地涌入她的邮箱。

e.en: The magician performed card {tricks} for the kids.
e.zh: 魔术师为孩子们表演了纸牌戏法。

e.en: My dog knows about ten different {tricks}.
e.zh: 我家狗会大概十种不同的把戏。

trickster.t: n. 骗子；爱捉弄人的人

e.en: In the folktale, the fox plays the role of the {trickster}.
e.zh: 在这个民间故事里,狐狸扮演骗术高手的角色。

e.en: He's a charming {trickster} who always talks his way out.
e.zh: 他是个迷人的骗术高手,总能靠嘴皮子脱身。

e.en: Parallel parking on a steep hill can be {tricky}.
e.zh: 在陡坡上侧方停车可能有点棘手。

e.en: That's a {tricky} question with no easy answer.
e.zh: 那是个棘手的问题,没有简单的答案。

tricolor.t:
n. 三色旗
adj. 三色的

e.en: The French {tricolor} flew above the embassy entrance.
e.zh: 法国三色旗在大使馆入口上方飘扬。

e.en: She adopted a beautiful {tricolor} cat from the shelter.
e.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只漂亮的三色猫。

e.en: Fans waved the Irish {tricolour} during the match.
e.zh: 球迷们在比赛中挥舞着爱尔兰三色旗。

e.en: The {tricolour} ribbon symbolized national unity.
e.zh: 这条三色绶带象征着国家团结。

tricorder.t: n. 三录仪（星际迷航道具）

e.en: In Star Trek, the {tricorder} can scan almost anything instantly.
e.zh: 在《星际迷航》里,三录仪几乎可以瞬间扫描任何东西。

e.en: Researchers are building a real-life medical {tricorder} prototype.
e.zh: 研究人员正在打造现实版医用三录仪的原型。

tricuspid.t:
adj. 三尖的
n. 三尖瓣

e.en: The {tricuspid} valve sits between two chambers of the heart.
e.zh: 三尖瓣位于心脏的两个心腔之间。

e.en: She was diagnosed with a leaky {tricuspid} valve.
e.zh: 她被诊断出三尖瓣关闭不全。

e.en: My niece just learned to ride her new {tricycle}.
e.zh: 我侄女刚学会骑她的新三轮车。

e.en: The toddler pedaled the {tricycle} down the driveway.
e.zh: 小朋友踩着三轮车沿着车道骑了出去。

tricyclic.t: adj. 三环的（一类抗抑郁药）

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {tricyclic} antidepressant for her insomnia.
e.zh: 医生开了三环类抗抑郁药来治她的失眠。

e.en: {Tricyclic} drugs were widely used before SSRIs became common.
e.zh: 在SSRI流行之前,三环类药物曾被广泛使用。

e.en: Statues of Poseidon often show him holding a {trident}.
e.zh: 波塞冬的雕像通常都拿着一支三叉戟。

e.en: The logo features a sleek black {trident} symbol.
e.zh: 这个标志的特色是一个简约的黑色三叉戟图案。

tridentine.t: adj. 特伦特会议的（天主教）

e.en: Some Catholics still prefer the {Tridentine} Latin Mass.
e.zh: 一些天主教徒仍然偏爱特伦特拉丁弥撒。

e.en: The {Tridentine} rite dates back to the sixteenth century.
e.zh: 特伦特礼仪可以追溯到十六世纪。

tried.t:
v. 尝试（try 的过去式）
adj. 可靠的

e.en: I {tried} the new ramen place on Main Street.
e.zh: 我去试了大街上新开的那家拉面店。

e.en: She {tried} to fix the bug for hours without success.
e.zh: 她试了好几个小时也没修好那个错误。

triennial.t:
adj. 每三年一次的
n. 三年期活动

e.en: The art {triennial} draws thousands of visitors each time.
e.zh: 这场三年一度的艺术展每届都吸引数千名观众。

e.en: Our company holds a {triennial} review of all policies.
e.zh: 我们公司每三年对所有政策进行一次审查。

trier.t:
n. 努力尝试的人
n. 特里尔（德国城市）

e.en: He's not the most talented player, but he's a real {trier}.
e.zh: 他不是最有天赋的球员,但绝对是个肯拼的人。

e.en: Coaches love a {trier} who never gives up on a play.
e.zh: 教练就喜欢这种从不放弃的拼搏型球员。

tries.t:
v. 尝试（try 的三单）
n. 尝试（复数）

e.en: She {tries} her best at every interview she attends.
e.zh: 她在每场面试中都全力以赴。

e.en: The puzzle took me three {tries} to finally solve.
e.zh: 这道谜题我试了三次才终于解开。

trieste.t: n. 的里雅斯特（意大利港市）

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring the cafes of {Trieste}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末逛遍了的里雅斯特的咖啡馆。

e.en: {Trieste} sits on the Adriatic coast near the Slovenian border.
e.zh: 的里雅斯特位于亚得里亚海岸,靠近斯洛文尼亚边境。

e.en: Winning all three awards was a perfect {trifecta} for the studio.
e.zh: 包揽三项大奖对这家工作室来说是完美的三连胜。

e.en: Good food, good service, and good prices — the {trifecta}.
e.zh: 好吃、服务好、价格实惠,简直是完美三件套。

trifle.t:
n. 琐事
n. 松糕甜点

e.en: Don't waste energy arguing over such a small {trifle}.
e.zh: 别为这种小事浪费精力去争论了。

e.en: She made a strawberry {trifle} for the holiday dinner.
e.zh: 她为节日晚餐做了一道草莓松糕。

trifled.t: v. 轻视；玩弄（trifle 的过去式）

e.en: He has never {trifled} with anyone's feelings before.
e.zh: 他以前从来没有玩弄过任何人的感情。

e.en: The professor isn't someone to be {trifled} with lightly.
e.zh: 那位教授可不是能随便招惹的人。

e.en: She refuses to argue about petty {trifles} at work.
e.zh: 她拒绝在工作中为鸡毛蒜皮的小事争论。

e.en: Don't sweat the small {trifles} — focus on what matters.
e.zh: 别在小事上烦恼,专注于真正重要的事。

trifling.t: adj. 微不足道的；琐碎的

e.en: The bug fix required only a {trifling} change to the code.
e.zh: 修复这个错误只需要对代码做一点微不足道的改动。

e.en: He dismissed the complaint as a {trifling} matter.
e.zh: 他把这个投诉当作微不足道的小事打发掉了。

triforium.t: n. 教堂拱廊（中殿上方）

e.en: Light streamed through the cathedral's narrow {triforium} windows.
e.zh: 光线透过大教堂狭窄的三层拱廊窗户洒了进来。

e.en: Tourists gazed up at the carved arches of the {triforium}.
e.zh: 游客们仰望着三层拱廊上雕刻精美的拱门。

trig.t: n. 三角学（trigonometry 的缩写）

e.en: I'm struggling with my {trig} homework tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚被三角函数作业搞得焦头烂额。

e.en: You'll need basic {trig} to understand wave equations.
e.zh: 要理解波动方程,你需要一些基本的三角学知识。

e.en: {Trigeminal} neuralgia causes intense facial pain in patients.
e.zh: 三叉神经痛会给患者带来剧烈的面部疼痛。

e.en: The dentist mentioned a possible {trigeminal} nerve issue.
e.zh: 牙医提到可能存在三叉神经的问题。

trembles.t:
v. 颤抖；发抖
n. 震颤

e.en: The puppy {trembles} whenever there's a thunderstorm outside.
e.zh: 外面一打雷,小狗就浑身发抖。

e.en: His lower lip {trembles} when he's about to cry.
e.zh: 他要哭的时候下嘴唇会颤抖。

trembling.t:
adj. 颤抖的
n. 发抖

e.en: She answered the phone with a {trembling} voice.
e.zh: 她用颤抖的声音接起了电话。

e.en: The child stood {trembling} in the cold rain.
e.zh: 那孩子在冷雨中瑟瑟发抖地站着。

e.en: My legs felt {trembly} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后,我的双腿直打颤。

e.en: She gave a {trembly} smile and wiped her tears.
e.zh: 她颤抖地笑了笑,擦掉了眼泪。

e.en: The team made {tremendous} progress on the project this week.
e.zh: 团队这周在项目上取得了巨大的进展。

e.en: There was a {tremendous} crash from the kitchen.
e.zh: 厨房传来一声巨响。

e.en: The new update has {tremendously} improved the app's performance.
e.zh: 新版本极大地提升了应用的性能。

e.en: She has grown {tremendously} as a leader this year.
e.zh: 今年她作为领导者成长了非常多。

e.en: The mineral sample turned out to be {tremolite}, a form of asbestos.
e.zh: 这块矿物样本原来是透闪石,一种石棉。

e.en: Geologists found {tremolite} crystals embedded in the marble.
e.zh: 地质学家在大理石中发现了透闪石晶体。

e.en: She added a soft {tremolo} to the final note.
e.zh: 她在最后一个音符上加了轻柔的颤音。

e.en: The guitarist used the {tremolo} bar for that wavy sound.
e.zh: 吉他手用摇把弹出那种波浪般的颤音。

tremor.t: n. 轻微地震；（身体）颤抖

e.en: A small {tremor} shook the building just after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后一阵轻微的地震让大楼晃动了一下。

e.en: There was a slight {tremor} in his voice as he spoke.
e.zh: 他说话时声音里带着一丝颤抖。

e.en: Aftershock {tremors} continued for several days following the quake.
e.zh: 地震之后余震持续了好几天。

e.en: The patient experienced hand {tremors} as a side effect.
e.zh: 患者出现了手部颤抖的副作用。

e.en: She gave a {tremulous} smile before walking on stage.
e.zh: 她颤抖地笑了一下,然后走上了舞台。

e.en: His {tremulous} voice betrayed how nervous he really was.
e.zh: 他颤抖的声音暴露了他有多紧张。

e.en: She {tremulously} accepted the award in front of the crowd.
e.zh: 她在众人面前颤抖着接过了奖项。

e.en: He spoke {tremulously} about losing his childhood home.
e.zh: 他颤抖地讲述了失去童年家园的事。

trench.t:
n. 壕沟；战壕
v. 挖沟

e.en: Workers dug a deep {trench} to lay the new pipes.
e.zh: 工人们挖了一条深沟来铺设新管道。

e.en: Soldiers spent weeks in the muddy {trench} during the battle.
e.zh: 士兵们在战斗期间在泥泞的战壕里待了好几周。

e.en: Her {trenchant} criticism of the policy went viral online.
e.zh: 她对该政策的犀利批评在网上迅速传播。

e.en: The article offered a {trenchant} analysis of the election.
e.zh: 这篇文章对选举进行了一针见血的分析。

e.en: He {trenchantly} dismissed the proposal as completely unworkable.
e.zh: 他尖锐地斥责这项提议根本行不通。

e.en: The reviewer wrote {trenchantly} about the film's weak plot.
e.zh: 影评人犀利地评论了这部电影薄弱的情节。

e.en: She wore a beige {trenchcoat} on the rainy commute.
e.zh: 她在下雨天上下班时穿着一件米色风衣。

e.en: The detective in the film had a classic {trenchcoat} look.
e.zh: 电影里的侦探有一身经典的风衣造型。

e.en: Medieval diners served stew on a wooden {trencher}.
e.zh: 中世纪人们用木制餐盘盛炖菜。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {trencher} used in the castle.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了城堡里曾用过的旧木餐盘。

trend.t:
n. 趋势；潮流
v. 趋向

e.en: Oversized blazers are the latest fashion {trend} this season.
e.zh: 宽肩西装外套是本季最新的时尚潮流。

e.en: Housing prices continue to {trend} upward in major cities.
e.zh: 主要城市的房价继续呈上升趋势。

e.en: The cafe is known more for its {trendiness} than its coffee.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆出名的是它的潮流感,而不是咖啡。

e.en: Critics dismissed the album as chasing pure {trendiness}.
e.zh: 评论家批评这张专辑只是在追逐潮流。

e.en: She follows the latest design {trends} on social media.
e.zh: 她在社交媒体上关注最新的设计潮流。

e.en: The hashtag {trends} every time she posts a video.
e.zh: 每次她发视频,这个话题标签就上热搜。

e.en: She's a real {trendsetter} in the streetwear community.
e.zh: 她在街头服饰圈里真的是潮流引领者。

e.en: The brand built its reputation as a {trendsetter} in tech.
e.zh: 这个品牌以科技领域的潮流引领者著称。

e.en: That café is the {trendy} new spot downtown.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆是市中心新潮的网红店。

e.en: She always wears the most {trendy} sneakers.
e.zh: 她总是穿最时髦的运动鞋。

trent.t: n. 特伦特（人名或英国河名）

e.en: The River {Trent} flows through the heart of England.
e.zh: 特伦特河流经英格兰的中心地带。

e.en: {Trent} grew up in a small town near Nottingham.
e.zh: 特伦特在诺丁汉附近的一个小镇长大。

e.en: She opened the exam results with some {trepidation}.
e.zh: 她带着几分忐忑打开了考试成绩。

e.en: He approached the interview with obvious {trepidation}.
e.zh: 他带着明显的不安去参加面试。

e.en: The dress is {tres} chic, as the French would say.
e.zh: 用法国人的话说,这条裙子非常时髦。

e.en: That restaurant is {tres} expensive but worth it.
e.zh: 那家餐厅非常贵,但物有所值。

trespass.t:
v. 擅自进入；侵犯
n. 非法侵入

e.en: You shouldn't {trespass} on private farmland.
e.zh: 你不该擅自闯入私人农田。

e.en: Hikers were warned not to {trespass} on the ranch.
e.zh: 徒步者被警告不要擅闯那片牧场。

e.en: The guard caught a {trespasser} climbing the fence.
e.zh: 保安抓到一个翻越围栏的非法闯入者。

e.en: Signs warn that any {trespasser} will be prosecuted.
e.zh: 告示牌警告任何擅闯者都将被起诉。

trespassing.t:
n. 非法侵入
v. 擅闯

e.en: The sign clearly says no {trespassing} after dark.
e.zh: 标志牌清楚地写着天黑后禁止入内。

e.en: They were arrested for {trespassing} on the construction site.
e.zh: 他们因擅闯施工现场而被逮捕。

e.en: A single golden {tress} fell across her shoulder.
e.zh: 一缕金色的发丝垂落在她的肩头。

e.en: She tucked a loose {tress} behind her ear.
e.zh: 她把一缕散落的头发别到耳后。

e.en: Her long dark {tresses} shone in the candlelight.
e.zh: 她乌黑的长发在烛光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: The shampoo ad promised silky, healthy {tresses}.
e.zh: 那则洗发水广告承诺让你拥有柔顺健康的秀发。

e.en: The train rumbled across the wooden {trestle} bridge.
e.zh: 火车隆隆驶过那座木制栈桥。

e.en: They set up a {trestle} table for the picnic.
e.zh: 他们为野餐架起了一张折叠支架桌。

e.en: Tourists toss coins into the {Trevi} Fountain for luck.
e.zh: 游客们把硬币扔进特雷维喷泉以求好运。

e.en: We finally saw the {Trevi} Fountain on our Rome trip.
e.zh: 我们罗马之行终于见到了特雷维喷泉。

e.en: In old ballads, the knight stayed {trew} to his lady.
e.zh: 在古老的歌谣里,那位骑士对他的女士忠贞不渝。

e.en: The poet spelled "true" as {trew} for an archaic feel.
e.zh: 诗人把"true"拼成{trew},以营造古朴的感觉。

e.en: He sank a clutch {trey} with seconds left on the clock.
e.zh: 他在比赛仅剩几秒时投进了一记关键的三分。

e.en: She drew a {trey} of hearts from the deck.
e.zh: 她从牌堆里抽到一张红桃三。

triad.t: n. 三人组；三合会；三和弦

e.en: Mind, body, and spirit form a classic {triad}.
e.zh: 身、心、灵构成一个经典的三位一体。

e.en: The piano teacher demonstrated a major {triad}.
e.zh: 钢琴老师示范了一个大三和弦。

triadic.t: adj. 三元的；三位一体的

e.en: The chord has a clean {triadic} structure.
e.zh: 这个和弦有着清晰的三和弦结构。

e.en: Their relationship developed a complicated {triadic} dynamic.
e.zh: 他们之间发展出一种复杂的三方关系动态。

triage.t:
n. 伤患分诊；优先级分类
v. 分诊

e.en: Nurses {triage} patients by how serious their injuries are.
e.zh: 护士根据伤情严重程度对病人进行分诊。

e.en: The team had to {triage} bug reports before the release.
e.zh: 团队不得不在发布前给 bug 报告分优先级。

trial.t:
n. 审判；试验
v. 试用

e.en: The murder {trial} lasted nearly three weeks.
e.zh: 那场谋杀案审判持续了近三周。

e.en: You can use the app free during the seven-day {trial}.
e.zh: 在七天试用期内你可以免费使用该应用。

trialist.t: n. 试训选手；出庭律师

e.en: The young {trialist} impressed the coach during practice.
e.zh: 那名年轻的试训球员在训练中给教练留下了深刻印象。

e.en: He signed a contract after a week as a {trialist}.
e.zh: 他试训一周后签下了合同。

e.en: The drug is now in late-stage clinical {trials}.
e.zh: 这款药物目前正处于临床试验后期。

e.en: She faced many {trials} before becoming a successful writer.
e.zh: 她在成为成功的作家之前经历了许多考验。

e.en: Draw a {triangle} with three equal sides.
e.zh: 画一个三条边都相等的三角形。

e.en: Their love {triangle} made the show addictive to watch.
e.zh: 他们的三角恋让这部剧让人欲罢不能。

e.en: The roof is divided into several large {triangles}.
e.zh: 屋顶被分成几个大三角形。

e.en: Cut the sandwich into four neat {triangles}.
e.zh: 把三明治切成四个整齐的三角形。

e.en: The lot has an awkward {triangular} shape.
e.zh: 那块地形状怪异,呈三角形。

e.en: She wore a {triangular} silver pendant.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚三角形的银吊坠。

triangulate.t: v. 三角测量；三角定位

e.en: Engineers used three towers to {triangulate} the signal.
e.zh: 工程师利用三座信号塔对信号进行三角定位。

e.en: Reporters {triangulate} sources to verify the story.
e.zh: 记者通过交叉比对多方信源来核实报道。

e.en: Police {triangulated} the suspect's phone within minutes.
e.zh: 警方几分钟内就对嫌疑人的手机进行了三角定位。

e.en: She {triangulated} the data from three independent surveys.
e.zh: 她对来自三项独立调查的数据进行了交叉验证。

triangulation.t: n. 三角测量；三角定位

e.en: GPS uses {triangulation} to pinpoint your location.
e.zh: GPS 通过三角定位来精确确定你的位置。

e.en: The reporter relied on {triangulation} of multiple sources.
e.zh: 那位记者依靠对多个信源进行交叉印证。

triassic.t:
adj. 三叠纪的
n. 三叠纪

e.en: These fossils date back to the {Triassic} period.
e.zh: 这些化石可以追溯到三叠纪。

e.en: Dinosaurs first appeared during the late {Triassic}.
e.zh: 恐龙最早出现在三叠纪晚期。

e.en: She trained all year for her first {triathlon}.
e.zh: 她为自己的第一场铁人三项训练了一整年。

e.en: A {triathlon} combines swimming, cycling, and running.
e.zh: 铁人三项由游泳、骑行和跑步组成。

tripos.t: n. (剑桥大学) 荣誉学位考试

e.en: She earned a first in the Cambridge mathematical {tripos}.
e.zh: 她在剑桥数学荣誉学位考试中取得了一等成绩。

e.en: Preparing for the {tripos} consumed her entire final year.
e.zh: 备战剑桥荣誉学位考试占据了她的整个最后一年。

tripped.t: v. 绊倒；被触发（trip 的过去式）

e.en: He {tripped} over the cable and spilled his coffee everywhere.
e.zh: 他被电线绊了一下,咖啡洒得到处都是。

e.en: The smoke detector {tripped} the fire alarm at midnight.
e.zh: 烟雾探测器在午夜触发了火警警报。

e.en: The seaside town fills with day {tripper} crowds every summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天这个海滨小镇都挤满了一日游的游客。

e.en: A circuit {tripper} cut the power during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中跳闸器切断了电源。

trippier.t: n. 特里皮尔（人名，英格兰足球运动员）

e.en: The sequel is even {trippier} than the original film.
e.zh: 这部续集比原版影片更加迷幻奇异。

e.en: His later paintings became progressively {trippier} and more abstract.
e.zh: 他后期的画作变得越来越迷幻和抽象。

tripping.t:
v. 绊倒；轻快走动
adj. 轻快的

e.en: She kept {tripping} over the cat's toys in the hallway.
e.zh: 她在走廊里不停地被猫的玩具绊到。

e.en: Stop {tripping} and just answer the question honestly.
e.zh: 别想太多,坦率地回答问题就行了。

trippy.t: adj. 迷幻的；像嗑药般的

e.en: The music video has really {trippy} visuals and colors.
e.zh: 这支音乐视频的画面和色彩非常迷幻。

e.en: That documentary about deep-sea creatures was genuinely {trippy}.
e.zh: 那部关于深海生物的纪录片真的让人脑洞大开。

trips.t:
n. 旅行
v. 绊倒（trip 的第三人称单数）

e.en: She {trips} to Tokyo at least twice a year for work.
e.zh: 她每年至少为工作出差去东京两次。

e.en: Don't run on the wet floor or you'll take {trips}.
e.zh: 别在湿地板上跑,否则你会摔跤的。

triptych.t: n. 三联画；三折式作品

e.en: The artist unveiled a haunting {triptych} at the gallery opening.
e.zh: 画家在画廊开幕式上展出了一幅令人难忘的三联画。

e.en: A medieval {triptych} hangs above the chapel altar.
e.zh: 一幅中世纪三联画悬挂在小教堂的祭坛上方。

tripwire.t: n. 绊线；触发警报的装置

e.en: The hikers accidentally set off a {tripwire} hidden in the brush.
e.zh: 徒步者不小心触发了藏在灌木里的绊线。

e.en: Rising inflation became a political {tripwire} for the new government.
e.zh: 通胀上升成了新政府的政治雷区。

e.en: The patient developed {trismus} after the wisdom tooth surgery.
e.zh: 病人在智齿手术后出现了牙关紧闭。

e.en: Severe {trismus} can make eating and speaking difficult.
e.zh: 严重的牙关紧闭会让人难以进食和说话。

tristar.t: n. 三星（品牌/机型名，如洛克希德 L-1011）

e.en: The vintage {tristar} airliner is on display at the museum.
e.zh: 那架老式三星客机正在博物馆展出。

e.en: He collects model planes, including a Lockheed {tristar}.
e.zh: 他收藏飞机模型,其中包括一架洛克希德三星。

e.en: The movie's ending felt {trite} and predictable.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局显得老套又可预测。

e.en: Avoid {trite} phrases like 'thinking outside the box' in your essay.
e.zh: 作文里要避免使用“跳出固有思维”这种陈词滥调。

e.en: Critics complained about the {triteness} of the song's lyrics.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨这首歌的歌词太陈腐。

e.en: The speech was ruined by its {triteness} and lack of original ideas.
e.zh: 演讲因为陈腐空洞、缺乏新意而很失败。

triticale.t: n. 小黑麦（小麦与黑麦杂交作物）

e.en: Farmers grow {triticale} as a hardy feed crop for livestock.
e.zh: 农民种植小黑麦作为耐寒的饲料作物。

e.en: {Triticale} is a hybrid of wheat and rye.
e.zh: 小黑麦是小麦和黑麦的杂交品种。

e.en: Watch dials sometimes use {tritium} to glow in the dark.
e.zh: 手表表盘有时会用氚来在黑暗中发光。

e.en: Fusion reactors typically rely on deuterium and {tritium} as fuel.
e.zh: 聚变反应堆通常以氘和氚作为燃料。

triton.t: n. 海卫一；海神特里同

e.en: In Greek myth, {Triton} blew a conch shell to calm the seas.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,特里同吹响海螺让大海平静。

e.en: Voyager 2 captured stunning images of Neptune's moon {Triton}.
e.zh: 旅行者2号拍下了海王星卫星海卫一的惊艳影像。

triumph.t:
n. 胜利；重大成就
v. 获胜

e.en: Winning the championship was a personal {triumph} for the rookie.
e.zh: 赢得冠军是这位新秀的个人胜利。

e.en: The team will {triumph} if they keep playing this well.
e.zh: 如果继续保持这种状态,这支队伍一定会获胜。

triumphal.t: adj. 凯旋的；庆祝胜利的

e.en: The general rode through a {triumphal} arch built in his honor.
e.zh: 将军骑马穿过为他建造的凯旋门。

e.en: The mayor delivered a {triumphal} speech after the election victory.
e.zh: 市长在选举获胜后发表了一篇凯旋式的讲话。

triumphalism.t: n. 必胜主义；炫耀胜利的态度

e.en: The party's {triumphalism} after the win alienated some voters.
e.zh: 该党胜选后的得意洋洋让一些选民感到反感。

e.en: Critics warned against {triumphalism} so early in the campaign.
e.zh: 评论人士警告说,在竞选初期就洋洋得意为时尚早。

triumphalist.t:
n. 必胜主义者
adj. 宣扬胜利的

e.en: The CEO gave a {triumphalist} speech celebrating the merger.
e.zh: 首席执行官发表了一番得意洋洋的演讲庆祝合并。

e.en: His {triumphalist} tone annoyed the journalists in the room.
e.zh: 他那副自鸣得意的口吻惹恼了在场的记者。

triumphant.t: adj. 得胜的；洋洋得意的

e.en: She raised her arms, {triumphant}, after crossing the finish line.
e.zh: 冲过终点线后,她得意地举起双臂。

e.en: The team made a {triumphant} return home with the trophy.
e.zh: 球队捧着奖杯凯旋而归。

triumphantly.t: adv. 得意洋洋地；凯旋地

e.en: He held up the trophy {triumphantly} for the cameras.
e.zh: 他得意洋洋地举起奖杯让镜头拍摄。

e.en: She announced {triumphantly} that the bug was finally fixed.
e.zh: 她得意地宣布那个bug终于修好了。

triumphs.t:
n. 胜利（复数）
v. 获胜（第三人称单数）

e.en: The documentary covers the {triumphs} and failures of early space missions.
e.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了早期太空任务的成功与失败。

e.en: In the end, kindness usually {triumphs} over cruelty.
e.zh: 到最后,善良通常会战胜残忍。

triumvirate.t: n. 三巨头；三人执政团

e.en: A {triumvirate} of senior engineers leads the platform team.
e.zh: 由三位资深工程师组成的三人组领导着平台团队。

e.en: Ancient Rome was once ruled by a powerful {triumvirate}.
e.zh: 古罗马曾由一个强大的三巨头统治。

e.en: Christians worship a {triune} God of Father, Son, and Spirit.
e.zh: 基督徒敬拜圣父、圣子、圣灵三位一体的神。

e.en: The book explores the {triune} nature of consciousness.
e.zh: 这本书探讨意识的三位一体本质。

e.en: Place the hot pan on a {trivet} to protect the table.
e.zh: 把热锅放在隔热垫上,以免烫坏桌子。

e.en: She bought a cast-iron {trivet} at the flea market.
e.zh: 她在跳蚤市场买了一个铸铁隔热架。

e.en: Our bar hosts a {trivia} night every Wednesday.
e.zh: 我们这家酒吧每周三都举办一场知识问答之夜。

e.en: He remembers all sorts of useless movie {trivia}.
e.zh: 他能记住各种没用的电影冷知识。

trivial.t: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的

e.en: Don't waste time arguing over such {trivial} details.
e.zh: 别浪费时间在这些琐碎的细节上争论。

e.en: Fixing the typo turned out to be a {trivial} change.
e.zh: 修正这个错别字其实是个微不足道的小改动。

trivialise.t: v. 使显得无足轻重（英式拼写）

e.en: Don't {trivialise} the struggles that immigrants face every day.
e.zh: 不要把移民每天面对的困难看得轻描淡写。

e.en: Some commentators {trivialise} climate change as just bad weather.
e.zh: 有些评论员把气候变化轻描淡写成不过是糟糕天气。

e.en: He dismissed her concerns as a mere {triviality}.
e.zh: 他把她的担忧当作鸡毛蒜皮的小事一笔带过。

e.en: The meeting got bogged down in office {triviality}.
e.zh: 会议陷入了办公室里的琐碎小事中。

trivialization.t: n. 轻视化；使变得无足轻重

e.en: The film's {trivialization} of war upset many veterans.
e.zh: 这部电影对战争的轻描淡写让许多老兵感到不满。

e.en: She criticized the {trivialization} of mental health issues online.
e.zh: 她批评网上对心理健康问题的轻视化处理。

trivialize.t: v. 使显得无足轻重；小看

e.en: Memes can sometimes {trivialize} serious political issues.
e.zh: 表情包有时会让严肃的政治议题变得轻浮。

e.en: Please don't {trivialize} how hard this job actually is.
e.zh: 请不要把这份工作的辛苦看得不当回事。

trivially.t: adv. 琐碎地；轻而易举地

e.en: The bug is {trivially} easy to reproduce on any browser.
e.zh: 这个bug在任何浏览器上都极其容易复现。

e.en: Once you know the trick, the puzzle is solved {trivially}.
e.zh: 一旦知道窍门,这道谜题轻轻松松就能解开。

trna.t: n. 转运 RNA（transfer RNA 缩写）

e.en: Each {tRNA} molecule carries a specific amino acid to the ribosome.
e.zh: 每个tRNA分子把特定的氨基酸送到核糖体。

e.en: Mutations in {tRNA} genes can disrupt protein synthesis.
e.zh: tRNA基因的突变会扰乱蛋白质合成。

trocadero.t: n. 特罗卡德罗（巴黎地名）

e.en: Tourists gather at the {Trocadero} for the best view of the Eiffel Tower.
e.zh: 游客们聚集在特罗卡德罗广场,欣赏埃菲尔铁塔最美的景色。

e.en: We took our wedding photos at the {Trocadero} in Paris.
e.zh: 我们在巴黎的特罗卡德罗广场拍了婚纱照。

trochanter.t: n. 股骨转子；（昆虫）转节

e.en: The greater {trochanter} is a bony bump on the upper femur.
e.zh: 大转子是股骨上端的一处骨性隆起。

e.en: She fractured her {trochanter} after slipping on the ice.
e.zh: 她在冰面上滑倒后摔伤了转子部位。

trod.t: v. 踩；行走（tread 的过去式）

e.en: Generations of pilgrims have {trod} this winding mountain path.
e.zh: 一代又一代朝圣者走过这条蜿蜒的山路。

e.en: He {trod} carefully through the muddy field.
e.zh: 他小心翼翼地踏过泥泞的田地。

trodden.t: v. 踏过（tread 的过去分词）

e.en: The well-{trodden} trail leads straight to the waterfall.
e.zh: 这条人来人往的小路一直通到瀑布。

e.en: She prefers paths less {trodden} by other tourists.
e.zh: 她偏爱那些游客较少踏足的小径。

troglodyte.t: n. 穴居人；离群索居者

e.en: Stop calling your brother a {troglodyte} just because he loves caves.
e.zh: 别因为你弟弟喜欢洞穴就叫他穴居人。

e.en: He's such a {troglodyte} that he refuses to use a smartphone.
e.zh: 他真是个老古板,连智能手机都不愿用。

troika.t: n. 三驾马车；三人领导小组

e.en: A {troika} of senior partners now runs the consulting firm.
e.zh: 如今由三位资深合伙人组成的三驾马车掌管这家咨询公司。

e.en: Snow flew as the {troika} raced across the frozen lake.
e.zh: 三驾马车飞驰过冰封的湖面,雪花四溅。

trojan.t:
n. 木马病毒；特洛伊人
adj. 特洛伊的

e.en: Antivirus software detected a {Trojan} hiding in the email attachment.
e.zh: 杀毒软件在邮件附件里检测到一个木马。

e.en: The Greeks used a wooden horse to enter the city of {Troy}.
e.zh: 希腊人用一匹木马进入了特洛伊城。

troll.t:
n. 网络喷子；巨魔
v. 恶意挑衅；拖钓

e.en: Don't feed the {troll} in the comments section.
e.zh: 别理评论区里那个挑事的喷子。

e.en: In the fairy tale, a {troll} guards the bridge.
e.zh: 在童话故事里,有只巨魔守在桥头。

e.en: The forum banned a serial {troller} who kept posting fake news.
e.zh: 论坛封禁了一个不停发假新闻的惯犯喷子。

e.en: He's a notorious {troller} on every gaming subreddit.
e.zh: 他在每个游戏版块上都是出了名的喷子。

e.en: Please return your shopping {trolley} to the rack after use.
e.zh: 购物车用完后请放回推车架。

e.en: Tourists love riding the historic {trolley} through downtown.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢乘坐这趟历史悠久的有轨电车穿过市区。

trolleys.t: n. 手推车（复数）；有轨电车

e.en: All the {trolleys} were taken at the busy supermarket.
e.zh: 繁忙的超市里所有的购物车都被用走了。

e.en: San Francisco's iconic {trolleys} climb the steep hills downtown.
e.zh: 旧金山标志性的电车爬上市中心陡峭的山坡。

e.en: He got banned for {trolling} streamers in the chat.
e.zh: 他因为在聊天里挑衅主播而被封号。

e.en: The fishermen spent the morning {trolling} for salmon.
e.zh: 渔民们花了一上午时间拖钓鲑鱼。

trigger.t:
v. 触发，引发
n. 扳机；触发器

e.en: Press this button to {trigger} the automated workflow.
e.zh: 按这个按钮就能触发自动化工作流。

e.en: Loud noises can {trigger} her migraine headaches.
e.zh: 巨大的噪音会引发她的偏头痛。

triggered.t:
adj. 被触发的；情绪受刺激的
v. trigger 的过去式

e.en: The smoke detector {triggered} the fire alarm at 3 a.m.
e.zh: 烟雾探测器在凌晨三点触发了火警。

e.en: His comment {triggered} a heated debate in the comments section.
e.zh: 他的评论在评论区引发了激烈的争论。

triggering.t:
v. 触发（trigger 的现在分词）
adj. 引发情绪的

e.en: The film contains scenes that may be {triggering} for some viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影包含一些可能会让部分观众产生不适的场景。

e.en: A small code change is {triggering} the entire deploy pipeline.
e.zh: 一处小小的代码改动正在触发整个部署流程。

e.en: Police identified the {triggerman} from security camera footage.
e.zh: 警方通过监控录像确认了开枪者的身份。

e.en: The {triggerman} pleaded guilty in exchange for a lighter sentence.
e.zh: 开枪者认罪以换取较轻的判决。

triggers.t:
v. 触发
n. 扳机；触发条件

e.en: This script {triggers} a notification whenever a user signs up.
e.zh: 每当有用户注册时,这个脚本就会触发一条通知。

e.en: Knowing your emotional {triggers} helps you manage stress better.
e.zh: 了解自己的情绪触发点能帮你更好地管理压力。

triglyceride.t: n. 甘油三酯（血脂指标）

e.en: His doctor said his {triglyceride} levels were too high.
e.zh: 医生说他的甘油三酯水平太高了。

e.en: Cutting sugar can lower your {triglyceride} count significantly.
e.zh: 减少糖分摄入可以显著降低甘油三酯水平。

e.en: {Trigonometry} is essential for understanding game physics.
e.zh: 三角学对理解游戏物理至关重要。

e.en: She tutors high school students in {trigonometry} on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末给高中生辅导三角学。

e.en: The search engine uses {trigram} indexing to match partial queries.
e.zh: 该搜索引擎使用三元组索引来匹配部分查询。

e.en: He drew the I Ching {trigram} for heaven on the page.
e.zh: 他在纸上画下代表天的易经卦象。

e.en: My toddler rode his red {trike} around the driveway.
e.zh: 我家小孩骑着他的红色三轮车在车道上转圈。

e.en: They rented a motorized {trike} to tour the island.
e.zh: 他们租了一辆机动三轮车环岛游览。

e.en: The three nations signed a {trilateral} trade agreement yesterday.
e.zh: 三国昨天签署了一项三边贸易协定。

e.en: Leaders held a {trilateral} summit to discuss regional security.
e.zh: 各国领导人举行三方峰会讨论地区安全。

e.en: He wore a brown {trilby} tilted over one eye.
e.zh: 他歪戴着一顶棕色窄边软毡帽。

e.en: The vintage shop sells classic wool {trilby} hats.
e.zh: 那家古着店出售经典款羊毛软呢帽。

e.en: She is {trilingual} in English, Mandarin, and Spanish.
e.zh: 她精通英语、普通话和西班牙语三种语言。

e.en: The airport signs are {trilingual} for international travelers.
e.zh: 机场的指示牌使用三种语言方便国际旅客。

trill.t:
n. 颤音
v. 发颤音

e.en: The soprano ended the aria with a brilliant {trill}.
e.zh: 女高音以一段华丽的颤音结束了咏叹调。

e.en: Birds outside the window {trill} every morning at dawn.
e.zh: 窗外的鸟儿每天清晨都婉转鸣叫。

e.en: A canary was {trilling} happily in the sunlit cage.
e.zh: 金丝雀在洒满阳光的笼中欢快地颤鸣。

e.en: She struggled with {trilling} the Spanish double R sound.
e.zh: 她很难发出西班牙语双R的颤舌音。

e.en: The national debt has surpassed thirty {trillion} dollars.
e.zh: 国家债务已经超过三十万亿美元。

e.en: There are roughly a {trillion} galaxies in the observable universe.
e.zh: 可观测宇宙中大约有一万亿个星系。

trillionth.t: num. 第万亿；万亿分之一

e.en: Lasers can measure time to a {trillionth} of a second.
e.zh: 激光可以测量到一万亿分之一秒的时间。

e.en: That coin is the company's one-{trillionth} sold worldwide.
e.zh: 那枚硬币是该公司全球售出的第一万亿件商品。

e.en: White {trillium} blooms cover the forest floor in spring.
e.zh: 春天里白色的延龄草开满整个林地。

e.en: She photographed a rare pink {trillium} on the trail.
e.zh: 她在小径上拍到一株罕见的粉色延龄草。

e.en: The museum displays a {trilobite} fossil from the Cambrian period.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块寒武纪的三叶虫化石。

e.en: Kids love hunting for {trilobite} fossils in the quarry.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在采石场寻找三叶虫化石。

e.en: The Lord of the Rings {trilogy} won seventeen Academy Awards.
e.zh: 《指环王》三部曲共获得十七项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: She just finished writing the final book of her {trilogy}.
e.zh: 她刚刚完成了她三部曲的最后一本书。

trim.t:
v. 修剪；削减
adj. 整洁的

e.en: Could you {trim} the hedges before the guests arrive?
e.zh: 客人到来之前你能把树篱修剪一下吗?

e.en: He stayed in {trim} shape by running every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上跑步保持身材匀称。

e.en: The {trimaran} sliced through the waves at impressive speed.
e.zh: 这艘三体船以惊人的速度劈波斩浪。

e.en: They sailed across the Pacific on a custom-built {trimaran}.
e.zh: 他们乘坐定制的三体帆船横渡太平洋。

trimester.t: n. 三学期制的一学期；孕期三阶段之一

e.en: Morning sickness usually fades after the first {trimester}.
e.zh: 孕吐通常在怀孕头三个月之后会减轻。

e.en: The school divides the year into a fall and winter {trimester}.
e.zh: 学校把一年分为秋季和冬季两个学期。

trimmed.t:
adj. 修剪过的
v. trim 的过去式

e.en: He {trimmed} his beard before the job interview.
e.zh: 他在面试前修剪了胡子。

e.en: The company {trimmed} its workforce by ten percent.
e.zh: 公司将员工人数削减了百分之十。

e.en: I bought a cordless hedge {trimmer} from the hardware store.
e.zh: 我从五金店买了一台无绳绿篱修剪机。

e.en: After dieting, he looked noticeably {trimmer} than before.
e.zh: 节食之后,他看起来比以前明显苗条多了。

trimming.t:
n. 修剪；装饰边
v. 修剪

e.en: The dress had delicate lace {trimming} along the sleeves.
e.zh: 那条裙子的袖口镶有精致的蕾丝花边。

e.en: He spent the morning {trimming} the apple tree branches.
e.zh: 他花了一上午修剪苹果树的枝条。

trims.t:
v. 修剪
n. 装饰条；修剪

e.en: The barber {trims} my hair every three weeks.
e.zh: 理发师每三周给我修剪一次头发。

e.en: This editor automatically {trims} whitespace from saved files.
e.zh: 这个编辑器会自动去除保存文件中的空白字符。

e.en: We stopped for tea at a quiet café in {Tring}.
e.zh: 我们在特灵镇一家安静的咖啡馆停下喝茶。

e.en: The train from London to {Tring} takes about forty minutes.
e.zh: 从伦敦到特灵的火车大约需要四十分钟。

trinidad.t: n. 特立尼达（加勒比岛国）

e.en: We honeymooned on the beautiful island of {Trinidad}.
e.zh: 我们在美丽的特立尼达岛度蜜月。

e.en: Carnival in {Trinidad} attracts visitors from around the world.
e.zh: 特立尼达的狂欢节吸引着世界各地的游客。

trinidadian.t:
n. 特立尼达人
adj. 特立尼达的

e.en: The chef prepared an authentic {Trinidadian} doubles for breakfast.
e.zh: 厨师准备了正宗的特立尼达豆饼当早餐。

e.en: My neighbor is a {Trinidadian} who moved here in 2010.
e.zh: 我邻居是2010年搬来的特立尼达人。

trinitarian.t:
adj. 三位一体论的
n. 三位一体论者

e.en: The church holds a strong {Trinitarian} view of God.
e.zh: 这间教会持有坚定的三位一体神观。

e.en: Augustine wrote extensively on {Trinitarian} theology.
e.zh: 奥古斯丁就三位一体神学写了大量著作。

trinity.t: n. 三位一体；三人组合

e.en: Christians believe in the {Trinity} of Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
e.zh: 基督徒相信圣父、圣子、圣灵的三位一体。

e.en: Speed, power, and accuracy form the {trinity} of great pitching.
e.zh: 速度、力量和准度构成了优秀投手的三要素。

e.en: She bought a cheap {trinket} as a souvenir.
e.zh: 她买了一件廉价的小饰品作为纪念。

e.en: His drawer was full of childhood {trinket} keepsakes.
e.zh: 他的抽屉里装满了童年的小玩意儿。

e.en: The jazz {trio} played softly in the corner of the bar.
e.zh: 爵士三重奏组在酒吧角落里轻柔地演奏着。

e.en: A {trio} of hikers got lost in the mountains overnight.
e.zh: 三名徒步者一夜之间在山中迷了路。

trioes.t: n. trio 的复数（罕用，标准为 trios）

e.en: The festival featured several string {trioes} from local conservatories.
e.zh: 音乐节展演了多支来自当地音乐学院的弦乐三重奏。

e.en: Two {trioes} of dancers performed back to back on stage.
e.zh: 两组三人舞团在舞台上接连登场表演。

triomphe.t: n. 凯旋（法语，常见于 Arc de Triomphe 凯旋门）

e.en: Tourists crowded around the Arc de {Triomphe} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时分游客挤满了凯旋门周围。

e.en: The Champs-Élysées leads straight to the Arc de {Triomphe}.
e.zh: 香榭丽舍大街一直通向凯旋门。

trip.t:
n. 旅行；行程
v. 绊倒；触发

e.en: We're planning a road {trip} along the California coast.
e.zh: 我们正计划沿加州海岸来一次自驾游。

e.en: Be careful not to {trip} on that loose carpet.
e.zh: 小心别被那块松动的地毯绊倒。

e.en: The {tripartite} agreement involves the government, unions, and employers.
e.zh: 这份三方协议涉及政府、工会和雇主。

e.en: His essay follows a {tripartite} structure of past, present, and future.
e.zh: 他的文章采用了过去、现在、未来的三段式结构。

e.en: The stew is made with slow-cooked beef {tripe} and onions.
e.zh: 这道炖菜是用慢炖的牛肚和洋葱做的。

e.en: He dismissed the article as complete {tripe}.
e.zh: 他认为那篇文章纯属胡说八道。

e.en: Adenosine {triphosphate} powers nearly every cell in your body.
e.zh: 三磷酸腺苷为你身体里几乎每一个细胞提供能量。

e.en: The textbook explains how {triphosphate} bonds release energy.
e.zh: 课本讲解了三磷酸键如何释放能量。

triple.t:
adj. 三倍的；三重的
v. 增至三倍

e.en: The startup saw its revenue {triple} in just one year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的收入在短短一年内增长了三倍。

e.en: I'll have a {triple} espresso to get through this meeting.
e.zh: 我要一杯三倍浓缩咖啡才能熬过这场会议。

tripled.t: v. triple 的过去式，增至三倍

e.en: Housing prices have {tripled} in the city since 2010.
e.zh: 自2010年以来,这座城市的房价已经涨了两倍。

e.en: She {tripled} her savings by investing wisely.
e.zh: 她通过明智的投资让自己的存款翻了三倍。

triplet.t: n. 三元组；三胞胎之一

e.en: The middle child of the {triplet} set is the tallest.
e.zh: 三胞胎中排行中间的那个个子最高。

e.en: The drummer played a quick {triplet} to end the song.
e.zh: 鼓手以一段快速的三连音结束了这首歌。

triplex.t:
adj. 三层的；三联的
n. 三层公寓

e.en: They bought a {triplex} and rent out two of the units.
e.zh: 他们买下一栋三户连体公寓,把其中两户出租出去。

e.en: The penthouse {triplex} has stunning views of the skyline.
e.zh: 这套三层顶层公寓拥有壮观的城市天际线景观。

triplicate.t:
adj. 一式三份的
v. 制成三份

e.en: Please submit the customs forms in {triplicate}.
e.zh: 请将海关表格一式三份提交。

e.en: The contract must be signed in {triplicate} by all parties.
e.zh: 合同必须由各方一式三份签署。

tripling.t: v. 增至三倍（triple 的现在分词）

e.en: Demand for the product is {tripling} each quarter.
e.zh: 该产品的需求每个季度都在翻三倍增长。

e.en: The startup focused on {tripling} its user base this year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司今年专注于将用户数翻三倍。

e.en: Most farmed oysters today are sterile {triploid} varieties.
e.zh: 如今养殖的牡蛎大多是不育的三倍体品种。

e.en: Seedless watermelons are produced from {triploid} hybrid plants.
e.zh: 无籽西瓜是由三倍体杂交植株培育出来的。

e.en: The vault is {triply} secured with biometric and code locks.
e.zh: 金库通过生物识别和密码锁实现了三重防护。

e.en: She felt {triply} blessed by family, health, and meaningful work.
e.zh: 她为家庭、健康和有意义的工作三重幸福而感恩。

e.en: He mounted his camera on a sturdy {tripod} for the long exposure.
e.zh: 他把相机架在稳固的三脚架上拍摄长曝光照片。

e.en: The surveyor set up his {tripod} at the corner of the field.
e.zh: 测量员在田地角落架起了他的三脚架。

tripoli.t: n. 的黎波里（利比亚首都）

e.en: Our flight to {Tripoli} was delayed by the sandstorm.
e.zh: 我们飞往的黎波里的航班因沙尘暴延误了。

e.en: {Tripoli} is the capital and largest city of Libya.
e.zh: 的黎波里是利比亚的首都和最大城市。

e.en: The old novel unfairly labels the heroine a {trollop}.
e.zh: 那本老小说不公平地把女主角说成是放荡女人。

e.en: Calling someone a {trollop} is considered offensive and outdated.
e.zh: 骂人“荡妇”被认为既冒犯又过时。

e.en: He plays the {trombone} in his school's jazz band.
e.zh: 他在学校的爵士乐队里吹长号。

e.en: The {trombone} solo brought the whole audience to its feet.
e.zh: 那段长号独奏让全场观众起立鼓掌。

e.en: The {trombonist} stole the show with a soulful solo.
e.zh: 那位长号手以一段动人的独奏抢尽了风头。

e.en: She's training to become a professional jazz {trombonist}.
e.zh: 她正在训练成为一名职业爵士长号手。

trommel.t: n. 圆筒筛；滚筒筛分机

e.en: The recycling plant uses a giant {trommel} to sort waste.
e.zh: 这家回收厂用一个巨大的滚筒筛来分拣垃圾。

e.en: Gold miners run gravel through a {trommel} to find nuggets.
e.zh: 淘金者把砾石放进滚筒筛里筛出金块。

e.en: The kids love to {tromp} through the autumn leaves.
e.zh: 孩子们最爱踩着秋天的落叶哗啦啦地走过。

e.en: Don't {tromp} mud through the kitchen, please.
e.zh: 拜托别把泥踩得满厨房都是。

e.en: The ceiling features a stunning {trompe} l'oeil of an open sky.
e.zh: 天花板上画着令人惊叹的天空错视画。

e.en: That painted door is just a {trompe} l'oeil on the wall.
e.zh: 那扇看似真实的门只是墙上的错视画而已。

tron.t: n. 旧时公用磅秤（罕用）

e.en: My kid is obsessed with the neon visuals from {Tron}.
e.zh: 我家孩子迷上了《电子世界争霸战》里的霓虹画面。

e.en: The arcade was decked out in {Tron}-style glowing lines.
e.zh: 游戏厅装饰成了《电子世界争霸战》风格的发光线条。

trondheim.t: n. 特隆赫姆（挪威城市）

e.en: {Trondheim} is one of the oldest cities in Norway.
e.zh: 特隆赫姆是挪威最古老的城市之一。

e.en: We took a train from Oslo to {Trondheim} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从奥斯陆坐火车到特隆赫姆。

troon.t: n. 特伦（苏格兰海滨小镇）

e.en: The Open Championship returned to Royal {Troon} this year.
e.zh: 今年的英国公开赛又回到了皇家特鲁恩高尔夫球场。

e.en: We spent a windy weekend on the beach at {Troon}.
e.zh: 我们在特鲁恩的海滩度过了一个大风的周末。

troop.t:
n. 部队；一群
v. 成群结队地走

e.en: A scout {troop} hiked up the mountain at dawn.
e.zh: 一支童子军小队在黎明时分徒步上山。

e.en: The kids {troop} into the classroom after recess.
e.zh: 课间结束后孩子们成群结队地走进教室。

e.en: A state {trooper} pulled me over for speeding on the highway.
e.zh: 一名州警在高速上拦下我超速。

e.en: She worked through her cold like a real {trooper}.
e.zh: 她带病坚持工作,真是个铁人。

e.en: Thousands of {troops} were deployed along the border.
e.zh: 数千名军队部署在边境一线。

e.en: The general rallied the {troops} before the big match.
e.zh: 教练在大赛前给队员们打气加油。

e.en: The {troopship} carried thousands of soldiers across the Atlantic.
e.zh: 那艘运兵船把数千名士兵运过大西洋。

e.en: A rusting {troopship} from the war sat in the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘战时遗留的生锈运兵船停在港口里。

e.en: The lone hero is a tired {trope} in action movies.
e.zh: 孤胆英雄是动作片里用滥的套路。

e.en: She subverts every romance {trope} in her novel.
e.zh: 她在小说里颠覆了每一个爱情套路。

trophic.t: adj. 营养的；与食物链相关的

e.en: Each {trophic} level loses energy to the next.
e.zh: 每个营养级向下一级传递时都会损失能量。

e.en: Wolves sit at the top of the {trophic} chain here.
e.zh: 狼在这里位于食物链的顶端。

e.en: Her shelf is crowded with swimming {trophies}.
e.zh: 她的架子上摆满了游泳奖杯。

e.en: The kids unlocked rare {trophies} in the game last night.
e.zh: 孩子们昨晚在游戏里解锁了稀有成就。

trophoblast.t: n. 滋养层（胚胎外层细胞）

e.en: The {trophoblast} forms the outer layer of the early embryo.
e.zh: 滋养层构成早期胚胎的最外层。

e.en: Doctors study the {trophoblast} to understand placental development.
e.zh: 医生研究滋养层以了解胎盘的发育。

e.en: He lifted the championship {trophy} above his head.
e.zh: 他把冠军奖杯高高举过头顶。

e.en: The win felt like a personal {trophy} for the team.
e.zh: 这场胜利对球队来说就像是一座荣誉奖杯。

tropic.t:
n. 回归线
adj. 热带的

e.en: The ship crossed the {tropic} of Cancer at dawn.
e.zh: 船在黎明时分越过了北回归线。

e.en: A warm {tropic} breeze drifted across the deck.
e.zh: 一阵温暖的热带微风拂过甲板。

e.en: We spent a week on a {tropical} island last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天在一座热带岛屿上待了一周。

e.en: A {tropical} storm is heading toward the coast tonight.
e.zh: 今晚有一场热带风暴正逼近海岸。

e.en: Many fruits grow only in the {tropics}.
e.zh: 许多水果只生长在热带地区。

e.en: She moved to the {tropics} to escape cold winters.
e.zh: 她搬到热带地区,逃离寒冷的冬天。

e.en: The professor offered a {tropological} reading of the parable.
e.zh: 教授对那则寓言给出了道德比喻式的解读。

e.en: Medieval scholars loved {tropological} interpretations of Bible stories.
e.zh: 中世纪学者喜欢对圣经故事作道德寓意解读。

e.en: Most weather happens in the {troposphere}.
e.zh: 大部分天气现象都发生在对流层。

e.en: Airliners often cruise near the top of the {troposphere}.
e.zh: 客机通常在接近对流层顶的高度巡航。

e.en: {Tropospheric} ozone is harmful to human lungs.
e.zh: 对流层臭氧对人类肺部有害。

e.en: Scientists track {tropospheric} winds to forecast storms.
e.zh: 科学家通过追踪对流层风来预报风暴。

trossachs.t: n. 特罗萨克斯（苏格兰山区）

e.en: We hiked through the {Trossachs} on a misty morning.
e.zh: 我们在一个雾蒙蒙的早晨徒步穿越特罗萨克斯山区。

e.en: The {Trossachs} inspired many of Walter Scott's poems.
e.zh: 特罗萨克斯山区启发了沃尔特·斯科特的许多诗作。

trot.t:
v. 小跑；快步走
n. 快步

e.en: The dog began to {trot} alongside the jogger.
e.zh: 那只狗开始小跑着跟在慢跑者身边。

e.en: She kept her horse at a steady {trot} down the trail.
e.zh: 她让马沿着小径保持稳定的小跑。

e.en: They pledged their {troth} in a quiet garden ceremony.
e.zh: 他们在一场安静的花园仪式上立下婚约。

e.en: By my {troth}, I shall not break this promise.
e.zh: 我以诚信起誓,绝不违背此诺。

e.en: He set a {trotline} across the river to catch catfish.
e.zh: 他在河上拉了一根延绳钓来钓鲶鱼。

e.en: The old fisherman checked his {trotline} every morning.
e.zh: 那位老渔夫每天早晨都查看他的延绳钓。

e.en: He joined a small {trotskyist} group at university.
e.zh: 他在大学里加入了一个小型托洛茨基派团体。

e.en: The pamphlet outlined classic {trotskyist} theory on revolution.
e.zh: 这本小册子阐述了经典的托派革命理论。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a naive {trotskyite}.
e.zh: 批评者把他贬为天真的托派分子。

e.en: The old {trotskyite} newspaper finally stopped printing last year.
e.zh: 那份老牌托派报纸去年终于停刊了。

e.en: The chef braised a pig's {trotter} for hours.
e.zh: 厨师把猪蹄炖了好几个小时。

e.en: That horse is a champion {trotter} on the local circuit.
e.zh: 那匹马是本地赛圈的冠军快步马。

trotting.t: v. 小跑（trot 的现在分词）

e.en: The dog came {trotting} happily down the lane.
e.zh: 小狗欢快地小跑着沿小路过来。

e.en: She kept {trotting} out the same tired excuses.
e.zh: 她不停地搬出那些老掉牙的借口。

troubadour.t: n. 游吟诗人；行吟歌手

e.en: The medieval {troubadour} sang ballads of courtly love.
e.zh: 中世纪的吟游诗人吟唱宫廷爱情谣曲。

e.en: He styles himself as a modern folk {troubadour}.
e.zh: 他把自己塑造成现代民谣吟游诗人。

trouble.t:
n. 麻烦；问题
v. 使烦恼

e.en: I'm having {trouble} logging into my account.
e.zh: 我登录账号时遇到了问题。

e.en: Don't go looking for {trouble} at the party tonight.
e.zh: 今晚的派对上别去惹麻烦。

e.en: She looked {troubled} after reading the email.
e.zh: 她看完邮件后神情困扰。

e.en: The company has a {troubled} financial history.
e.zh: 这家公司有一段坎坷的财务史。

troublemaker.t: n. 捣乱者；惹麻烦的人

e.en: The teacher seated the class {troublemaker} at the front.
e.zh: 老师把班里的捣蛋鬼安排坐到前排。

e.en: Online forums often attract anonymous {troublemaker} accounts.
e.zh: 网络论坛常常吸引匿名捣乱的账号。

e.en: She shared her financial {troubles} with a close friend.
e.zh: 她向一位密友倾诉了自己的经济困境。

e.en: The startup's {troubles} began after a failed product launch.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的麻烦始于一次失败的产品发布。

troubleshoot.t: v. 排查故障；解决问题

e.en: Engineers worked overnight to {troubleshoot} the server outage.
e.zh: 工程师通宵排查服务器宕机的问题。

e.en: Please {troubleshoot} the printer before calling support.
e.zh: 请先排查一下打印机再联系客服。

troubleshooter.t: n. 故障排查员；问题解决者

e.en: The CEO hired a {troubleshooter} to fix the failing division.
e.zh: CEO聘请了一位救火专家来整顿亏损部门。

e.en: Run the Windows {troubleshooter} to diagnose the error.
e.zh: 运行Windows故障排除程序来诊断错误。

troubleshooting.t: n. 故障排查；问题诊断

e.en: The manual includes a helpful {troubleshooting} section at the back.
e.zh: 手册后面附有实用的故障排除章节。

e.en: He spent the morning {troubleshooting} a tricky network bug.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在排查一个棘手的网络故障。

e.en: That {troublesome} bug keeps reappearing after every release.
e.zh: 那个讨厌的bug每次发版后都会再冒出来。

e.en: Her noisy neighbor has become increasingly {troublesome}.
e.zh: 她那位吵闹的邻居越来越让人头疼。

e.en: The report contains some deeply {troubling} statistics.
e.zh: 这份报告包含一些极其令人不安的数据。

e.en: It's {troubling} how quickly the misinformation spread.
e.zh: 虚假信息传播之快令人担忧。

e.en: The infection rate is rising {troublingly} fast this month.
e.zh: 本月感染率上升之快令人忧心。

e.en: Many users {troublingly} reuse the same weak password.
e.zh: 令人担忧的是许多用户反复使用同一个弱密码。

e.en: The pigs gathered noisily around the feeding {trough}.
e.zh: 猪群吵闹地聚集在食槽周围。

e.en: Sales hit a {trough} in February before recovering.
e.zh: 销售在二月份触底,随后开始回升。

e.en: Our team is expected to {trounce} the rivals on Saturday.
e.zh: 我们的球队预计周六将大胜对手。

e.en: The startup managed to {trounce} bigger competitors in user growth.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在用户增长上完胜规模更大的对手。

e.en: The home team suffered an embarrassing {trouncing} last night.
e.zh: 主队昨晚遭遇了一场难堪的惨败。

e.en: They are {trouncing} every opponent in the regional league.
e.zh: 他们在地区联赛中横扫了每一个对手。

e.en: A traveling dance {troupe} performed at the festival.
e.zh: 一支巡回舞蹈团在节日上演出。

e.en: The theatre {troupe} rehearses every weeknight at seven.
e.zh: 这个剧团每个工作日晚上七点排练。

trouper.t: n. 老练的演员；可靠的人

e.en: Despite the flu, she's a real {trouper} on stage.
e.zh: 尽管得了流感,她在台上仍是个敬业的老戏骨。

e.en: Thanks for staying late — you're such a {trouper}.
e.zh: 谢谢你加班到这么晚,你真是个靠谱的人。

e.en: A {trousered} figure stepped quietly out of the shadows.
e.zh: 一个穿着长裤的身影悄悄从阴影中走了出来。

e.en: She felt more confident in {trousered} business attire.
e.zh: 穿着长裤套装让她在商务场合更自信。

e.en: He spilled coffee all over his new {trousers}.
e.zh: 他把咖啡洒了一裤子,新长裤全弄脏了。

e.en: These {trousers} need to be ironed before the meeting.
e.zh: 这条长裤开会前需要熨一下。

e.en: Her grandmother helped her prepare a beautiful wedding {trousseau}.
e.zh: 她祖母帮她备好了一份漂亮的嫁妆。

e.en: The {trousseau} included handmade linens and silver cutlery.
e.zh: 这套嫁妆里有手工亚麻制品和银餐具。

e.en: He caught a large {trout} in the mountain stream.
e.zh: 他在山间小溪里钓到了一条大鳟鱼。

e.en: The chef grilled the {trout} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草烤制了这条鳟鱼。

e.en: Researchers uncovered a {trove} of medieval manuscripts.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一批中世纪手稿珍藏。

e.en: The leaked database is a {trove} of useful insights.
e.zh: 泄露的数据库是一座有用见解的宝库。

trowbridge.t: n. 特罗布里奇（英国地名）

e.en: The train to {Trowbridge} departs from platform three.
e.zh: 开往特罗布里奇的火车在三号站台发车。

e.en: She grew up in a small village near {Trowbridge}.
e.zh: 她在特罗布里奇附近的一个小村庄长大。

trowel.t:
n. 泥铲；小铲子
v. 用铲子抹

e.en: He smoothed the cement with a small {trowel}.
e.zh: 他用一把小泥铲把水泥抹平。

e.en: The gardener planted seedlings using a hand {trowel}.
e.zh: 园丁用手铲栽种幼苗。

e.en: Gold prices are usually quoted per {troy} ounce.
e.zh: 黄金价格通常以金衡盎司报价。

e.en: Archaeologists are still excavating ancient {Troy} today.
e.zh: 考古学家至今仍在挖掘古城特洛伊。

e.en: The medieval fairs of {Troyes} attracted merchants from across Europe.
e.zh: 特鲁瓦的中世纪集市吸引了来自全欧洲的商人。

e.en: We stopped in {Troyes} to admire its half-timbered houses.
e.zh: 我们在特鲁瓦停下来欣赏它的木骨架房屋。

e.en: The school is cracking down on persistent {truancy}.
e.zh: 学校正在严厉打击长期逃学行为。

e.en: His {truancy} record made it hard to get into college.
e.zh: 他的逃学记录让他很难考上大学。

truant.t:
n. 逃学者
v. 旷课

e.en: The boy played {truant} to spend the day at the arcade.
e.zh: 那男孩逃学,一整天泡在电玩城里。

e.en: A {truant} officer stopped them outside the shopping mall.
e.zh: 一名查逃学的警员在商场外拦下了他们。

e.en: The two sides agreed to a temporary {truce}.
e.zh: 双方同意暂时停战。

e.en: The siblings finally called a {truce} after weeks of arguing.
e.zh: 兄妹俩争吵了几周后终于休战了。

truck.t:
n. 卡车；货车
v. 用卡车运

e.en: A delivery {truck} blocked the entire street this morning.
e.zh: 今早一辆送货卡车把整条街都堵住了。

e.en: They rented a {truck} to move into the new apartment.
e.zh: 他们租了辆卡车搬进新公寓。

e.en: The long-haul {trucker} stopped at a diner for coffee.
e.zh: 那位长途卡车司机在路边餐馆停下来喝咖啡。

e.en: His father worked as a {trucker} for thirty years.
e.zh: 他父亲当了三十年卡车司机。

e.en: The {trucking} industry is facing a serious driver shortage.
e.zh: 货运业正面临严重的司机短缺问题。

e.en: They started a small {trucking} company in Texas.
e.zh: 他们在德州办起了一家小型货运公司。

e.en: A whole {truckload} of donations arrived at the shelter.
e.zh: 整整一卡车的捐赠物资送到了收容所。

e.en: She bought a {truckload} of supplies for the festival.
e.zh: 她为节日活动买了一大卡车的物资。

e.en: Several {trucks} were parked outside the warehouse overnight.
e.zh: 几辆卡车整夜停在仓库外面。

e.en: The company's electric {trucks} cover most local routes now.
e.zh: 公司的电动卡车现在已覆盖大部分本地路线。

e.en: His {truculence} in meetings made colleagues avoid him.
e.zh: 他在会议上的好斗让同事们都躲着他。

e.en: The negotiator was unfazed by the union's {truculence}.
e.zh: 谈判代表对工会的强硬态度毫不在意。

e.en: The {truculent} customer demanded to see the manager immediately.
e.zh: 那位粗暴的顾客非要立刻见经理。

e.en: He gave a {truculent} reply and slammed the door.
e.zh: 他粗暴地回了一句,然后摔门而去。

e.en: She glared {truculently} across the negotiating table.
e.zh: 她隔着谈判桌凶狠地瞪着对方。

e.en: The toddler {truculently} refused to put on his shoes.
e.zh: 那个小孩犟头犟脑地不肯穿鞋。

trudge.t:
v. 步履沉重地走
n. 长途跋涉

e.en: We had to {trudge} home through the deep snow.
e.zh: 我们不得不踩着深雪艰难地走回家。

e.en: Workers {trudge} up the hill to the factory each morning.
e.zh: 工人们每天清晨拖着脚步上山去工厂。

true.t:
adj. 真的；真实的
adj. 忠实的

e.en: Is it {true} that the office will close on Friday?
e.zh: 周五办公室真的要关门吗?

e.en: She finally found her {true} calling as a teacher.
e.zh: 她终于找到了当老师这个真正的志业。

e.en: Most modern websites still rely on {TrueType} fonts.
e.zh: 大多数现代网站仍在使用TrueType字体。

e.en: Designers can install custom {TrueType} files on any operating system.
e.zh: 设计师可以在任何操作系统上安装自定义的TrueType字体文件。

e.en: The pasta was topped with shaved black {truffle}.
e.zh: 这道意大利面上撒着黑松露薄片。

e.en: She bought a single chocolate {truffle} at the bakery.
e.zh: 她在面包店买了一颗松露巧克力。

e.en: The chef served {truffled} scrambled eggs for brunch.
e.zh: 厨师在早午餐时端上了松露炒蛋。

e.en: Their signature dish is {truffled} mashed potatoes with butter.
e.zh: 他们的招牌菜是松露黄油土豆泥。

truism.t: n. 自明之理；老生常谈

e.en: It's a {truism} that hard work pays off eventually.
e.zh: 努力终有回报，这是老生常谈了。

e.en: His speech was full of tired political {truism}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了陈腐的政治套话。

e.en: The book is full of {truisms} about success.
e.zh: 这本书里满是关于成功的老生常谈。

e.en: Avoid empty {truisms} when giving career advice.
e.zh: 给职业建议时，别说那些空洞的套话。

trujillo.t: n. 特鲁希略（人名/地名）

e.en: {Trujillo} is a coastal city in northern Peru.
e.zh: 特鲁希略是秘鲁北部的一座沿海城市。

e.en: The dictator {Trujillo} ruled the Dominican Republic for decades.
e.zh: 独裁者特鲁希略统治多米尼加共和国数十年。

e.en: I'm {truly} sorry for missing your birthday.
e.zh: 我真的很抱歉错过了你的生日。

e.en: This is a {truly} remarkable piece of engineering.
e.zh: 这真是一件了不起的工程作品。

trump.t:
n. 王牌；特朗普
v. 胜过

e.en: Speed will {trump} strength in this kind of match.
e.zh: 在这种比赛中，速度会胜过力量。

e.en: She played the ace of {trump} to win the round.
e.zh: 她打出王牌赢下了这一局。

trumpery.t: n. 华而不实之物；废话

e.en: The gift shop was full of cheap {trumpery} for tourists.
e.zh: 礼品店里满是卖给游客的廉价小玩意儿。

e.en: He dismissed the report as utter {trumpery}.
e.zh: 他斥责那份报告纯属胡扯。

trumpet.t:
n. 小号（乐器）
v. 吹嘘；宣扬

e.en: She learned to play the {trumpet} in middle school.
e.zh: 她在初中学会了吹小号。

e.en: Companies love to {trumpet} their quarterly earnings online.
e.zh: 公司很喜欢在网上大肆宣扬季度财报。

trumpeted.t: v. 吹响；大肆宣扬（过去式）

e.en: The startup {trumpeted} its new AI feature on every platform.
e.zh: 那家创业公司在各个平台上大力宣传新的 AI 功能。

e.en: An elephant {trumpeted} loudly in the distance.
e.zh: 远处一头大象高声鸣叫。

e.en: The jazz {trumpeter} performed a stunning solo last night.
e.zh: 那位爵士小号手昨晚演奏了一段精彩的独奏。

e.en: A {trumpeter} swan landed gracefully on the lake.
e.zh: 一只号声天鹅优雅地降落在湖面上。

trumpeting.t: v. 吹号；鼓吹（现在分词）

e.en: The CEO kept {trumpeting} the company's growth on Twitter.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 一直在推特上吹嘘公司的增长。

e.en: We heard elephants {trumpeting} from across the savanna.
e.zh: 我们听到大象在大草原对面发出鸣叫声。

e.en: The royal procession was announced by golden {trumpets}.
e.zh: 皇家队伍由金色的号角宣告出场。

e.en: The brass section has four {trumpets} and two trombones.
e.zh: 铜管组有四把小号和两把长号。

trumpington.t: n. 特朗普顿（英国地名）

e.en: They moved to a quiet flat in {Trumpington} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他们搬到了特鲁平顿的一间安静公寓。

e.en: The bus to {Trumpington} runs every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 开往特鲁平顿的公交车每十五分钟一班。

truncate.t: v. 截断；截短（文本、数字）

e.en: The database will {truncate} any text longer than 280 characters.
e.zh: 数据库会截断任何超过 280 个字符的文本。

e.en: Please don't {truncate} the URL when sharing the link.
e.zh: 分享链接时请不要把网址截短。

e.en: The error log was {truncated} and missing key details.
e.zh: 错误日志被截断了，缺失了关键信息。

e.en: Her {truncated} reply suggested she was busy.
e.zh: 她那简短的回复说明她正在忙。

e.en: Avoid silent {truncation} of user input in the form field.
e.zh: 要避免在表单字段中悄悄截断用户输入。

e.en: The {truncation} of the headline changed its meaning entirely.
e.zh: 标题被截短后意思完全变了。

e.en: The officer drew his {truncheon} to disperse the crowd.
e.zh: 警官抽出警棍驱散人群。

e.en: A rubber {truncheon} hung from his belt.
e.zh: 他的腰带上挂着一根橡皮警棍。

e.en: Old buses still {trundle} along the country roads.
e.zh: 老式公交车仍然在乡间公路上慢悠悠地行驶。

e.en: We pulled out the {trundle} bed for our guests.
e.zh: 我们拉出折叠床给客人睡。

trunk.t:
n. 树干；后备箱
n. 象鼻；行李箱

e.en: I packed the groceries into the car {trunk}.
e.zh: 我把日用品放进了汽车后备箱。

e.en: The elephant lifted the log with its powerful {trunk}.
e.zh: 大象用强壮的鼻子把那根木头举了起来。

e.en: She brought home a {trunkful} of vintage records.
e.zh: 她带了满满一后备箱的老式黑胶唱片回家。

e.en: Grandma kept a {trunkful} of letters in the attic.
e.zh: 奶奶在阁楼里存着满满一箱子信件。

trunks.t: n. 男式泳裤；树干（复数）

e.en: He forgot his swim {trunks} and had to buy new ones.
e.zh: 他忘了带泳裤，只好新买了一条。

e.en: The forest is dense with thick tree {trunks}.
e.zh: 森林里密密麻麻全是粗壮的树干。

e.en: The cannon rotated smoothly on its {trunnion}.
e.zh: 大炮绕着耳轴顺畅地转动。

e.en: Engineers replaced the worn {trunnion} during maintenance.
e.zh: 工程师在维护时更换了磨损的耳轴。

e.en: We took the train down to {Truro} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去特鲁罗度过周末。

e.en: {Truro} is the only city in Cornwall, England.
e.zh: 特鲁罗是英国康沃尔郡唯一的城市。

truss.t:
n. 桁架；疝气带
v. 捆绑

e.en: The roof's wooden {truss} supports the entire structure.
e.zh: 屋顶的木桁架支撑着整个结构。

e.en: The chef will {truss} the chicken before roasting it.
e.zh: 厨师会先把鸡捆好再烤。

trussed.t: adj. 被捆紧的；用桁架支撑的

e.en: The turkey was {trussed} neatly before going into the oven.
e.zh: 火鸡在送进烤箱前被整齐地捆好了。

e.en: He felt {trussed} up by all the bureaucratic rules.
e.zh: 他觉得自己被各种官僚规则捆得死死的。

trust.t:
v. 信任
n. 信任；信托

e.en: Don't blindly {trust} content generated by AI models.
e.zh: 不要盲目相信 AI 模型生成的内容。

e.en: Building {trust} with users takes years but seconds to lose.
e.zh: 赢得用户的信任要花数年，失去却只在一瞬间。

trusted.t: adj. 可信赖的；受信任的

e.en: She's a {trusted} reviewer in the open-source community.
e.zh: 她是开源社区里备受信赖的代码审阅者。

e.en: He {trusted} the GPS even though it looked wrong.
e.zh: 他相信了 GPS，尽管看起来不太对。

e.en: She was appointed {trustee} of the family foundation.
e.zh: 她被任命为家族基金会的受托人。

e.en: The {trustee} signed off on the annual budget yesterday.
e.zh: 受托人昨天批准了年度预算。

e.en: The board of {trustees} meets quarterly to review investments.
e.zh: 董事会每季度开会审查投资情况。

e.en: University {trustees} voted to raise tuition next year.
e.zh: 大学董事会投票决定明年上调学费。

e.en: She accepted the {trusteeship} of the historic museum.
e.zh: 她接受了那家历史博物馆的托管职务。

e.en: His {trusteeship} ended after a five-year term.
e.zh: 他的受托人任期在五年后结束了。

trustful.t: adj. 轻信的；深信不疑的

e.en: Children are naturally {trustful} of the adults around them.
e.zh: 孩子天生信任身边的大人。

e.en: Her {trustful} smile made everyone feel at ease.
e.zh: 她那充满信任的微笑让大家都放松下来。

e.en: He's too {trusting} when it comes to online strangers.
e.zh: 他对网上的陌生人太过轻信了。

e.en: A {trusting} relationship between manager and team takes effort.
e.zh: 经理和团队之间建立信任关系需要花心思。

e.en: The puppy {trustingly} placed its paw in my hand.
e.zh: 小狗信任地把爪子放在我手里。

e.en: She nodded {trustingly} and signed the contract.
e.zh: 她信任地点点头，签下了合同。

trusts.t:
v. 信任（第三人称单数）
n. 信托（复数）

e.en: My boss {trusts} me to ship the release on time.
e.zh: 我的老板相信我能按时发布版本。

e.en: Wealthy families often set up {trusts} for their children.
e.zh: 富裕家庭常为子女设立信托基金。

e.en: The model's {trustworthiness} depends on its training data.
e.zh: 模型的可信度取决于它的训练数据。

e.en: Banks rely heavily on customer perceptions of {trustworthiness}.
e.zh: 银行非常依赖客户对其可信度的看法。

trustworthy.t: adj. 值得信赖的；可靠的

e.en: Always cite {trustworthy} sources in your research papers.
e.zh: 在研究论文中要引用可信的来源。

e.en: He's the most {trustworthy} colleague on the team.
e.zh: 他是团队里最值得信赖的同事。

e.en: I still use my {trusty} old laptop for travel.
e.zh: 我出差时还是用那台靠得住的老笔记本。

e.en: His {trusty} bicycle has lasted nearly twenty years.
e.zh: 他那辆可靠的自行车已经骑了近二十年。

e.en: Sometimes the {truth} is stranger than fiction.
e.zh: 有时候真相比小说还要离奇。

e.en: Tell me the {truth} about what happened last night.
e.zh: 告诉我昨晚到底发生了什么。

e.en: Please give me a {truthful} answer, not a polite one.
e.zh: 请给我一个真实的回答，而不是客套话。

e.en: AI assistants should aim to be helpful and {truthful}.
e.zh: AI 助手应当努力做到既有用又诚实。

e.en: Answer the survey {truthfully} so we can improve the product.
e.zh: 请如实填写问卷，这样我们才能改进产品。

e.en: {Truthfully}, I didn't enjoy the movie at all.
e.zh: 老实说，我一点也不喜欢那部电影。

e.en: Researchers measure the {truthfulness} of language model outputs.
e.zh: 研究人员会衡量语言模型输出的真实性。

e.en: Her reputation for {truthfulness} made her testimony powerful.
e.zh: 她以诚实著称，因此她的证词极具说服力。

e.en: The {truthfulnesses} of competing witnesses were carefully compared in court.
e.zh: 法庭仔细比较了几位证人的诚实程度。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {truthfulnesses} required of different professions.
e.zh: 哲学家们讨论不同职业所需的各种真实性。

truthiness.t: n. 看似真实感（凭直觉而非事实）

e.en: The post had a vague {truthiness} but no real evidence.
e.zh: 那条帖子貌似真实,却毫无实据。

e.en: Politicians often rely on {truthiness} rather than facts.
e.zh: 政客们常常靠似真感而非事实取胜。

e.en: The documentary reveals uncomfortable {truths} about the industry.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了行业里令人不安的真相。

e.en: Some {truths} only become clear with time.
e.zh: 有些真相要随着时间才会显现。

try.t:
v. 尝试；试用
n. 尝试

trying.t:
adj. 难熬的；烦人的
v. 正在尝试

e.en: I'm {trying} to learn Spanish using a free app.
e.zh: 我正在用一个免费应用学西班牙语。

e.en: Caring for a newborn can be incredibly {trying}.
e.zh: 照顾新生儿可能会令人非常疲惫。

e.en: The store offers a virtual {tryon} for sunglasses online.
e.zh: 这家店提供线上墨镜的虚拟试戴功能。

e.en: She booked a wedding dress {tryon} for Saturday.
e.zh: 她预约了周六的婚纱试穿。

e.en: He nailed his basketball {tryout} and made the team.
e.zh: 他篮球选拔表现出色,顺利入选了球队。

e.en: The studio held a {tryout} for new voice actors.
e.zh: 工作室为新配音演员举办了一场试镜。

e.en: {Trypsin} helps the small intestine break down proteins.
e.zh: 胰蛋白酶帮助小肠分解蛋白质。

e.en: Researchers used {trypsin} to detach cells from the dish.
e.zh: 研究人员用胰蛋白酶将细胞从培养皿上剥离。

e.en: Turkey contains {tryptophan}, which may make you sleepy.
e.zh: 火鸡含有色氨酸,吃了可能让人犯困。

e.en: The body uses {tryptophan} to produce serotonin.
e.zh: 人体利用色氨酸来合成血清素。

e.en: They arranged a secret {tryst} at the old café.
e.zh: 他们约好在那间老咖啡馆秘密幽会。

e.en: The novel opens with a moonlit {tryst} in the garden.
e.zh: 小说以花园里月下的私会开篇。

e.en: The last {tsar} of Russia was overthrown in 1917.
e.zh: 俄国末代沙皇于1917年被推翻。

e.en: He was appointed cybersecurity {tsar} by the president.
e.zh: 他被总统任命为网络安全总管。

e.en: The {tsarina} held great influence over court decisions.
e.zh: 那位皇后对宫廷决策有极大影响力。

e.en: Catherine became one of Russia's most famous {tsarina}.
e.zh: 叶卡捷琳娜成为俄国最著名的女沙皇之一。

tsarist.t:
adj. 沙皇的
n. 沙皇拥护者

e.en: The film depicts life under the {tsarist} regime.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了沙皇政权下的生活。

e.en: Many fled abroad after the {tsarist} government collapsed.
e.zh: 沙皇政府倒台后,许多人逃往国外。
