e.zh: 工程师在电路中测试了一个三端晶体管器件。

e.en: A {trisistor} can appear in older electronics literature.
e.zh: 三端晶体管器件这个词可能出现在较早的电子学文献中。

e.en: His {triskaidekaphobia} made Friday the thirteenth stressful.
e.zh: 他的十三数字恐惧症让十三号星期五变得很有压力。

e.en: The hotel avoided room thirteen because of {triskaidekaphobia}.
e.zh: 这家酒店因十三数字恐惧症而避开了十三号房。

e.en: A {triskaidekaphobic} guest refused the room number.
e.zh: 一位恐惧十三的客人拒绝了那个房号。

e.en: The building's design seemed oddly {triskaidekaphobic}.
e.zh: 这栋楼的设计似乎奇怪地避讳数字十三。

e.en: The shield bore a silver {triskele}.
e.zh: 盾牌上有一个银色的三曲腿纹。

e.en: She carved a {triskele} into the wooden pendant.
e.zh: 她在木吊坠上刻了一个三旋纹。

e.en: The flag features a bold {triskelion} at its center.
e.zh: 旗帜中央有一个醒目的三曲腿纹。

e.en: The ancient coin showed a small {triskelion}.
e.zh: 那枚古币上有一个小小的三旋纹。

e.en: The crystal resembled a {trisoctahedron} under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后，这块晶体看起来像三八面体。

e.en: A {trisoctahedron} has faces related to an octahedral form.
e.zh: 三八面体的面与八面体形态有关。

e.en: The old pharmacology text listed {trisodarsen} among arsenical compounds.
e.zh: 那本旧药理学教材把三钠砷化合物列在砷剂中。

e.en: Researchers handled {trisodarsen} only under strict laboratory controls.
e.zh: 研究人员只在严格实验室管控下处理三钠砷化合物。

e.en: The label listed {trisodium} phosphate as an ingredient.
e.zh: 标签把磷酸三钠列为一种成分。

e.en: A {trisodium} salt may dissolve readily in water.
e.zh: 三钠盐可能很容易溶于水。

e.en: The plant was identified as a {trisome} after chromosome counts.
e.zh: 染色体计数后，这株植物被确定为三体个体。

e.en: A {trisome} carries one chromosome in three copies.
e.zh: 三体个体带有某条染色体的三份拷贝。

e.en: The lab confirmed a {trisomic} cell line.
e.zh: 实验室确认了一种三体细胞系。

e.en: A {trisomic} condition can affect development.
e.zh: 三体状态可能影响发育。

trisomy.t: 三体综合征；三染色体现象

e.en: The test screened for {trisomy} in the fetus.
e.zh: 这项检测筛查胎儿是否存在三体异常。

e.en: Down syndrome is caused by {trisomy} of chromosome 21.
e.zh: 唐氏综合征由二十一号染色体三体引起。

trisoralen.t: 三甲沙林；补骨脂素类药

e.en: The dermatologist prescribed {trisoralen} for light therapy.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生为光疗开了三甲沙林。

e.en: Patients taking {trisoralen} must avoid excess sunlight.
e.zh: 服用三甲沙林的患者必须避免过度日晒。

e.en: The fruit is usually {trispermous} when mature.
e.zh: 这种果实成熟时通常有三粒种子。

e.en: A {trispermous} pod contains exactly three seeds.
e.zh: 有三粒种子的荚果正好含有三颗种子。

triphthongal.t: 三合元音的；含三重元音的

e.en: The teacher marked the {triphthongal} sound in the dialect sample.
e.zh: 老师标出了方言样本中的三合元音。

e.en: Her accent gives that word a distinctly {triphthongal} quality.
e.zh: 她的口音让那个词明显带有三重元音的感觉。

e.en: The specimen contained a small vein of {triphylite}.
e.zh: 这块标本里有一小脉磷铁锂矿。

e.en: Geologists identified the dark mineral as {triphylite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种深色矿物鉴定为磷铁锂矿。

e.en: The botanist described the seedling as {triphyllous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这株幼苗描述为三叶的。

e.en: A {triphyllous} arrangement appeared at the end of each stem.
e.zh: 每根茎的末端都出现了三片叶的排列。

e.en: The fossil evidence suggested a {triphyodont} pattern of tooth replacement.
e.zh: 化石证据显示它有一生换三套牙的模式。

e.en: Some reptiles are discussed as potentially {triphyodont} in older studies.
e.zh: 一些旧研究把某些爬行动物讨论为可能有三套牙列。

e.en: The fern has delicate {tripinnate} fronds.
e.zh: 这种蕨类有纤细的三回羽状叶。

e.en: A {tripinnate} leaf divides again and again into smaller leaflets.
e.zh: 三回羽状复叶会一再分裂成更小的小叶。

e.en: The drawing showed a finely {tripinnated} leaf.
e.zh: 图中画的是一片细密三回羽状分裂的叶子。

e.en: Collectors prized the plant for its {tripinnated} foliage.
e.zh: 收藏者看重这种植物三回羽状分裂的叶形。

e.en: The leaves are {tripinnately} divided near the base.
e.zh: 这些叶子在基部附近呈三回羽状分裂。

e.en: Its foliage spreads {tripinnately} from the central stalk.
e.zh: 它的叶片从中央叶柄呈三回羽状展开。

e.en: The herb is recognized by its {tripinnatifid} leaves.
e.zh: 这种草本植物可凭三回羽状浅裂的叶子辨认。

e.en: A {tripinnatifid} blade is cut deeply but not into separate leaflets.
e.zh: 三回羽状浅裂的叶片裂得很深，但没有分成独立小叶。

e.en: The parsley relative has {tripinnatisect} leaves.
e.zh: 这种欧芹近缘植物有三回羽状全裂叶。

e.en: In the key, {tripinnatisect} foliage separates this species from its relatives.
e.zh: 在检索表中，三回羽状全裂的叶形把该物种与近缘种区分开。

e.en: The monastery preserved an old copy of the {Tripitaka}.
e.zh: 这座寺院保存着一部古老的三藏经典。

e.en: Scholars compare versions of the {Tripitaka} across languages.
e.zh: 学者会比较不同语言版本的佛教三藏。

e.en: The museum restored a World War I {triplane}.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一架一战时期的三翼飞机。

e.en: A {triplane} has three stacked wings instead of one or two.
e.zh: 三翼飞机有三层叠置机翼，而不是一层或两层。

e.en: Please {triple-check} the address before sending the package.
e.zh: 寄包裹前请反复核对地址。

e.en: She {triple-checked} every figure in the report.
e.zh: 她把报告里的每个数字都再三检查了一遍。

e.en: The horse won the {Triple Crown} after three major races.
e.zh: 那匹马赢下三场大赛后获得了三冠王称号。

e.en: Fans still debate whether he deserved the batting {Triple Crown}.
e.zh: 球迷仍在争论他是否配得上击球三冠王。

e.en: He ordered a {triple-decker} sandwich for lunch.
e.zh: 他午饭点了一个三层三明治。

e.en: They rented an apartment in an old {triple-decker}.
e.zh: 他们在一栋老式三层住宅里租了公寓。

e.en: The city faced {triple-digit} temperatures all week.
e.zh: 这座城市整周都遭遇超过一百度华氏的高温。

e.en: The company reported {triple-digit} growth in online sales.
e.zh: 公司报告线上销售实现了三位数增长。

e.en: She recorded a {triple-double} with rebounds, assists, and points.
e.zh: 她在篮板、助攻和得分上都上双，拿下三双。

e.en: A {triple-double} can change the rhythm of a basketball game.
e.zh: 一次三双表现可能改变一场篮球比赛的节奏。

e.en: Rain forced the teams into a rare {triple-header}.
e.zh: 雨天迫使这些球队进行少见的连续三场比赛。

e.en: The stadium sold one ticket for the entire {triple-header}.
e.zh: 体育场为整组三连赛只卖一张通票。

e.en: The electrician installed a {triple-pole} breaker for the circuit.
e.zh: 电工为这条电路安装了三极断路器。

e.en: Use a {triple-pole} switch when all three lines must open together.
e.zh: 三条线路必须同时断开时，要使用三极开关。

e.en: The editor asked us to {triple-space} the manuscript.
e.zh: 编辑要求我们把稿件设为三倍行距。

e.en: A {triple-spaced} draft leaves room for handwritten comments.
e.zh: 三倍行距的草稿会留出手写批注的空间。

triple-team.t: 三人包夹；三人合力对付

e.en: The defense tried to {triple-team} the star receiver.
e.zh: 防守方试图用三个人包夹那名明星接球手。

e.en: Three reporters seemed to {triple-team} the minister with questions.
e.zh: 三名记者似乎合力用问题围攻那位部长。

e.en: She is a {triple-threat} who can sing, dance, and act.
e.zh: 她能唱、能跳、能演，是个多才多艺的人。

e.en: Their new policy created a {triple-threat} to small businesses.
e.zh: 他们的新政策对小企业形成了三重威胁。

e.en: Brass players learn to {triple-tongue} fast passages.
e.zh: 铜管乐手会学习用三吐音演奏快速乐句。

e.en: The teacher demonstrated the {triple-tongue} pattern slowly.
e.zh: 老师慢慢示范了三吐音的模式。

e.en: The solo included several {triple-tongued} runs.
e.zh: 这段独奏包含几处用三吐音演奏的快速音阶。

e.en: He practiced the {triple-tongued} passage until it sounded even.
e.zh: 他反复练习那段三吐音乐句，直到听起来均匀。

e.en: She {triple-tongues} the final measures with impressive clarity.
e.zh: 她用三吐音演奏最后几个小节，清晰得令人印象深刻。

e.en: The trumpeter {triple-tongues} whenever the tempo becomes extreme.
e.zh: 速度极快时，那位小号手就会使用三吐音。

e.en: {Triple-tonguing} helps players articulate very rapid notes.
e.zh: 三吐音技巧能帮助演奏者清楚吹出极快的音符。

e.en: Her {triple-tonguing} improved after weeks of slow practice.
e.zh: 经过数周慢练，她的三吐音技巧进步了。

e.en: The composer marked a {tripton} in the slow passage.
e.zh: 作曲家在慢速乐段标出了一个三联音。

e.en: She practiced the {tripton} until the rhythm felt even.
e.zh: 她反复练习这个三重音组，直到节奏变得均匀。

e.en: The museum displayed a medieval {triptyque} behind glass.
e.zh: 博物馆把一幅中世纪三联画陈列在玻璃后。

e.en: His poem is arranged like a {triptyque} of memories.
e.zh: 他的诗像一组三折记忆作品那样编排。

e.en: The old catalog described the shell as {tripy}.
e.zh: 旧目录把这种贝壳描述为有三部分的形态。

e.en: Botanists noted a {tripy} structure in the specimen.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这个标本有三重结构。

e.en: The fossil showed a {tripylean} pattern under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这块化石呈现出三孔式结构。

e.en: A {tripylean} chamber appears in the technical drawing.
e.zh: 技术图纸中出现了一个有三门的腔室。

triquat.t: 三季铵盐；三季铵化合物

e.en: The chemist tested a {triquat} for surface activity.
e.zh: 化学家测试了一种三季铵盐的表面活性。

e.en: A {triquat} compound was added to the formulation.
e.zh: 配方中加入了一种三季铵化合物。

e.en: The ring was engraved with a {triquetra}.
e.zh: 戒指上刻着一个三角结图案。

e.en: A Celtic {triquetra} decorated the manuscript margin.
e.zh: 手稿边缘饰有凯尔特三曲枝纹样。

e.en: The scan showed a small {triquetral} fracture.
e.zh: 扫描显示三角骨有一处小骨折。

e.en: The architect used a {triquetral} motif above the doorway.
e.zh: 建筑师在门楣上用了三角形装饰母题。

e.en: The plant has a {triquetrous} stem.
e.zh: 这种植物长着三棱形的茎。

e.en: The mineral sample looked {triquetrous} from the side.
e.zh: 从侧面看，这块矿物样本呈三角柱状。

e.en: The paper described a new route to {triquinacene}.
e.zh: 论文描述了一条合成三喹烯的新路线。

e.en: Students modeled {triquinacene} to understand strained rings.
e.zh: 学生们建立三喹烯模型来理解张力环结构。

e.en: The study examined a {triracial} community in the region.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了该地区一个涉及三个种族的社区。

e.en: Her family history reflects a {triracial} heritage.
e.zh: 她的家族史体现了三种族混合的传承。

e.en: The fossil has a {triradiate} mark at its center.
e.zh: 这块化石中心有一个三射状标记。

e.en: A {triradiate} pattern spread across the shell.
e.zh: 一个三辐状图案铺展在贝壳表面。

e.en: The specimen displayed a {triradiated} spine arrangement.
e.zh: 这个标本显示出三射状的刺排列。

e.en: A {triradiated} symbol was carved into the stone.
e.zh: 石头上刻着一个有三辐的符号。

e.en: The fingerprint analyst marked the {triradius} on the palm print.
e.zh: 指纹分析员在掌纹图上标出了三叉纹汇点。

e.en: Each {triradius} helps classify the dermatoglyphic pattern.
e.zh: 每个三辐点都有助于分类皮纹图案。

e.en: The problem involved a {trirectangular} spherical triangle.
e.zh: 这道题涉及一个有三个直角的球面三角形。

e.en: A {trirectangular} corner cannot exist in ordinary plane geometry.
e.zh: 在普通平面几何中，不可能存在有三个直角的角形。

e.en: The ancient navy relied on the fast {trireme}.
e.zh: 古代海军依靠速度很快的三列桨战船。

e.en: A replica {trireme} sailed across the bay.
e.zh: 一艘复制的古希腊三列桨战船驶过海湾。

e.en: The sample contained mostly {triricinoleiden}.
e.zh: 该样品主要含有三蓖麻油酸甘油酯。

e.en: Researchers measured the viscosity of {triricinoleiden}.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了三蓖麻油酸甘油酯的黏度。

tris.t: 三羟甲基氨基甲烷缓冲剂

e.en: The lab prepared a {Tris} buffer for the assay.
e.zh: 实验室为这项测定配制了Tris缓冲液。

e.en: Dissolve the {tris} before adjusting the pH.
e.zh: 先溶解三羟甲基氨基甲烷，再调节酸碱度。

tris-hcl.t: 三羟甲基氨基甲烷盐酸盐

e.en: The protocol calls for {Tris-HCl} at pH 7.5.
e.zh: 实验方案要求使用pH值为7.5的Tris-HCl。

e.en: She stored the {tris-HCl} solution at room temperature.
e.zh: 她把三羟甲基氨基甲烷盐酸盐溶液放在室温下保存。

e.en: Raffinose is a common {trisaccharide}.
e.zh: 棉子糖是一种常见的三糖。

e.en: The enzyme breaks the {trisaccharide} into smaller sugars.
e.zh: 这种酶会把三糖分解成更小的糖。

e.en: The curve admits a {trisecant} through those points.
e.zh: 这条曲线存在一条经过那些点的三割线。

e.en: A {trisecant} line intersects the surface in three places.
e.zh: 三重割线与该曲面相交于三处。

e.en: Use this construction to {trisect} the segment.
e.zh: 用这个作图方法把线段三等分。

e.en: It is impossible to {trisect} every angle with compass and straightedge.
e.zh: 并非每个角都能用圆规和直尺三等分。

e.en: The board was {trisected} into equal panels.
e.zh: 这块板被三等分成相等的面板。

e.en: A {trisected} angle appears in the diagram.
e.zh: 图中出现了一个被三等分的角。

trisecting.t: 正在三等分的；三等分用的

e.en: She was {trisecting} the line with a ruler.
e.zh: 她正用尺子把这条线三等分。

e.en: The {trisecting} marks must be placed accurately.
e.zh: 这些三等分标记必须放得准确。

e.en: Angle {trisection} is a famous classical problem.
e.zh: 角的三等分是一个著名的古典问题。

e.en: The teacher explained the {trisection} of the interval.
e.zh: 老师讲解了这个区间的三等分法。

e.en: Draw the first {trisector} from the vertex.
e.zh: 从顶点画出第一条三等分线。

e.en: The device works as a mechanical {trisector}.
e.zh: 这个装置可作为机械式三等分工具使用。

trisulphide.t: 三硫化物；含三硫键化合物

e.en: The chemist identified the compound as a {trisulphide} after testing it.
e.zh: 经过检测，化学家确认这种化合物是三硫化物。

e.en: Some garlic aromas come from organic {trisulphides} released during cooking.
e.zh: 大蒜烹调时释放的有机三硫化物会带来部分香气。

e.en: The teacher chose a {trisyllabic} word for the pronunciation drill.
e.zh: 老师选了一个三音节词来做发音练习。

e.en: Her name sounded {trisyllabic} in the local dialect.
e.zh: 在当地口音里，她的名字听起来像三音节。

e.en: The poem begins with a {trisyllable} that slows the rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗开头用了一个三音节词，使节奏慢下来。

e.en: Each {trisyllable} in the chant was stressed on the first beat.
e.zh: 吟唱中的每个三音节单位都在第一拍重读。

tritagonist.t: 第三主角；第三重要角色

e.en: In the tragedy, the {tritagonist} often challenges the hero's choices.
e.zh: 在这部悲剧中，第三主角常常质疑英雄的选择。

e.en: Critics argued that the film's {tritagonist} deserved more screen time.
e.zh: 评论家认为影片里的第三重要角色应该有更多戏份。

tritanomaly.t: 蓝黄色弱；第三色觉异常

e.en: The eye test suggested mild {tritanomaly} rather than complete color blindness.
e.zh: 眼科测试显示是轻度蓝黄色弱，而不是完全色盲。

e.en: Designers checked the palette for users with {tritanomaly}.
e.zh: 设计师为有蓝黄色弱的用户检查了配色方案。

e.en: A {tritanope} may confuse certain blues and greens.
e.zh: 蓝黄色盲者可能会混淆某些蓝色和绿色。

e.en: The study asked each {tritanope} to identify colored signals.
e.zh: 研究要求每位蓝黄色盲者辨认彩色信号。

e.en: People with {tritanopia} have difficulty distinguishing blue from yellow.
e.zh: 患有蓝黄色盲的人难以区分蓝色和黄色。

e.en: The app includes a filter that simulates {tritanopia}.
e.zh: 这个应用包含一个模拟蓝黄色盲效果的滤镜。

tritaph.t: 三人合葬墓；三联墓碑铭

e.en: Archaeologists found a damaged {tritaph} near the old church.
e.zh: 考古学家在老教堂附近发现了一座受损的三人合葬墓。

e.en: The inscription was arranged like a {tritaph} for three relatives.
e.zh: 这段铭文的排列像是为三位亲属写的三联墓碑铭。

e.en: The textbook used {tritencephalon} as an older term for the hindbrain.
e.zh: 这本教材把tritencephalon作为后脑的旧称。

e.en: Damage near the {tritencephalon} can affect balance and basic functions.
e.zh: 后脑附近的损伤可能影响平衡和基本生理功能。

triternate.t: 三回三出的；三重三小叶的

e.en: The botanist described the leaf as {triternate} in her notes.
e.zh: 植物学家在笔记中把这片叶子描述为三回三出的。

e.en: A {triternate} pattern gives the plant a delicate, divided appearance.
e.zh: 三重三小叶的形态让这种植物显得细致而分裂。

e.en: Geologists use {triterpane} markers to trace the source of crude oil.
e.zh: 地质学家用三萜烷标志物追踪原油来源。

e.en: The sample contained a stable {triterpane} formed from ancient organic matter.
e.zh: 样品中含有由古代有机物形成的稳定三萜烷。

e.en: The plant extract contains a bitter {triterpene} with medicinal potential.
e.zh: 这种植物提取物含有一种有药用潜力的苦味三萜。

e.en: Researchers measured each {triterpene} in the resin by chromatography.
e.zh: 研究人员用色谱法测定树脂中的每种三萜类化合物。

e.en: The fungus produces a {triterpenoid} that may reduce inflammation.
e.zh: 这种真菌会产生一种可能减轻炎症的三萜类化合物。

e.en: Several {triterpenoids} in the herb were isolated for testing.
e.zh: 草药中的几种三萜类化合物被分离出来进行测试。

e.en: The council condemned {tritheism} as a distortion of doctrine.
e.zh: 会议谴责三神论是对教义的歪曲。

e.en: His opponents accused the argument of implying {tritheism}.
e.zh: 他的反对者指责这一论证暗含三神论。

e.en: The theologian denied that he was a {tritheist}.
e.zh: 这位神学家否认自己是三神论者。

e.en: A {tritheist} treats the three divine persons as separate gods.
e.zh: 三神论者把三个神圣位格视为彼此分离的神。

e.en: The bishop rejected the {tritheistic} interpretation of the creed.
e.zh: 主教拒绝了对信经的三神论解释。

e.en: Some readers found the passage accidentally {tritheistic}.
e.zh: 有些读者觉得这段文字无意中带有三神论色彩。

e.en: The essay was criticized for its {tritheistical} language.
e.zh: 这篇文章因使用三神论式的措辞而受到批评。

e.en: He avoided any {tritheistical} phrasing in the final statement.
e.zh: 他在最终声明中避免了任何三神论式表述。

e.en: The museum label identified the purple mineral as {trithilite}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这块紫色矿物标为磷锂锰矿。

e.en: Collectors value {trithilite} specimens with clear crystal faces.
e.zh: 收藏者看重晶面清晰的磷锂锰矿标本。

e.en: In medieval records, the county was divided into a northern {trithing}.
e.zh: 在中世纪记录中，该郡被划分出一个北部三分区。

e.en: The old {trithing} name survived in local legal documents.
e.zh: 这个古三区名称保留在当地法律文件中。

e.en: The laboratory prepared {trithioacetaldehyde} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 实验室在受控条件下制备了三硫代乙醛。

e.en: Older chemistry texts mention {trithioacetaldehyde} as a sulfur compound.
e.zh: 较早的化学教材把三硫代乙醛列为一种含硫化合物。

trithiocarbonate.t: 三硫代碳酸盐；三硫碳酸酯

e.en: The reaction produced a yellow {trithiocarbonate} salt.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种黄色的三硫代碳酸盐。

e.en: A {trithiocarbonate} group can act as a chain-transfer agent.
e.zh: 三硫碳酸酯基团可以充当链转移剂。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a {trithiophosphite} for further analysis.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种三硫代亚磷酸盐以便进一步分析。

e.en: This {trithiophosphite} reacts quickly with moisture in the air.
e.zh: 这种三硫代亚磷酸盐会迅速与空气中的水分反应。

e.en: Scientists {tritiate} the molecule to track it in cells.
e.zh: 科学家使该分子氚化，以便在细胞中追踪它。

e.en: The lab planned to {tritiate} the drug for a metabolism study.
e.zh: 实验室计划用氚标记这种药物，用于代谢研究。

e.en: The team injected a {tritiated} compound into the sample.
e.zh: 研究团队向样品中注入了一种氚化化合物。

e.en: Safety rules apply when handling {tritiated} water.
e.zh: 处理氚化水时必须遵守安全规定。

tritiation.t: 氚化；引入氚标记的过程

e.en: The lab used {tritiation} to label the compound.
e.zh: 实验室用氚化方法给该化合物做标记。

e.en: Careful {tritiation} helped trace the drug's path.
e.zh: 细致的氚化处理有助于追踪药物的去向。

e.en: Researchers measured {triticin} in the wheat sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了小麦样品中的小麦贮藏蛋白含量。

e.en: The paper links {triticin} with grain quality.
e.zh: 这篇论文把小麦贮藏蛋白与谷物品质联系起来。

e.en: The old diagram showed a {tritish} division of duties.
e.zh: 那张旧图显示了职责的三重划分。

e.en: His argument had a strangely {tritish} structure.
e.zh: 他的论证结构带着一种奇特的三分性质。

e.en: The culture produced {tritisporin} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 该培养物在受控条件下产生了三孢菌素。

e.en: They tested whether {tritisporin} affected fungal growth.
e.zh: 他们测试三孢菌素是否会影响真菌生长。

e.en: The insect's {tritocerebrum} connects with the stomodaeal nerves.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的第三脑部与口前肠神经相连。

e.en: She labeled the {tritocerebrum} in the anatomy sketch.
e.zh: 她在解剖示意图中标出了第三脑部。

e.en: The chemist identified the product as a {tritol}.
e.zh: 化学家把该产物鉴定为一种三醇。

e.en: A {tritol} contains three alcohol groups.
e.zh: 三醇含有三个醇羟基。

e.en: The gardener planted {tritoma} near the wall.
e.zh: 园丁在墙边种了火炬花属植物。

e.en: Old catalogues often list red-hot pokers as {tritoma}.
e.zh: 旧目录常把火炬花列作tritoma。

e.en: The melody opens with a sharp {tritone}.
e.zh: 这段旋律一开始就是一个尖锐的三全音。

e.en: Composers once treated the {tritone} with caution.
e.zh: 作曲家过去曾谨慎使用三全音。

e.en: The dry tablet is easily {triturable}.
e.zh: 这种干燥药片很容易研碎。

e.en: Only {triturable} minerals were chosen for the test.
e.zh: 实验只选用了可研磨成粉的矿物。

e.en: The pharmacy kept a small {tritural} mortar.
e.zh: 药房备有一个小型研磨用研钵。

e.en: He described the {tritural} process in detail.
e.zh: 他详细描述了研磨过程。

e.en: Use a mortar to {triturate} the crystals.
e.zh: 用研钵把这些晶体研碎。

e.en: Pharmacists sometimes {triturate} powders for even mixing.
e.zh: 药剂师有时会研磨粉末以便混合均匀。

e.en: The {triturated} powder dissolved more quickly.
e.zh: 研细后的粉末溶解得更快。

e.en: She added the {triturated} sample to the flask.
e.zh: 她把研碎的样品加入烧瓶。

e.en: He {triturates} the mixture before heating it.
e.zh: 加热前他先把混合物研碎。

e.en: The technician stored the {triturates} in labeled jars.
e.zh: 技术员把磨细物装进贴好标签的罐子里。

e.en: She spent ten minutes {triturating} the herbs.
e.zh: 她花了十分钟研磨这些草药。

e.en: The {triturating} machine reduced the tablets to powder.
e.zh: 研磨机把药片粉碎成粉末。

e.en: Proper {trituration} makes the mixture uniform.
e.zh: 适当研磨能让混合物变得均匀。

e.en: The recipe calls for slow {trituration} in a mortar.
e.zh: 这个配方要求在研钵中缓慢研磨。

e.en: The lab bought a new {triturator} for samples.
e.zh: 实验室买了一台新的样品研磨器。

e.en: A noisy {triturator} ran behind the pharmacy counter.
e.zh: 药房柜台后面有一台吵闹的粉碎机在运转。

e.en: The molecule carried a {trityl} protecting group.
e.zh: 该分子带有一个三苯甲基保护基。

e.en: They removed the {trityl} group under acidic conditions.
e.zh: 他们在酸性条件下去除了三苯甲基。

e.en: Each {triumvir} controlled a different province.
e.zh: 每位三人执政者分别控制一个不同的行省。

e.en: The historian called him a cautious {triumvir}.
e.zh: 历史学家称他是一位谨慎的三人执政者。

triumviral.t: 三人执政的；三头政治的

e.en: The state adopted a {triumviral} arrangement.
e.zh: 这个国家采用了三人执政的安排。

e.en: Their {triumviral} authority soon became unstable.
e.zh: 他们的三头政治权力很快变得不稳定。

e.en: The {triumviri} issued coins in their own names.
e.zh: 这些三人执政官以自己的名义发行硬币。

e.en: Roman sources mention the {triumviri} frequently.
e.zh: 罗马史料经常提到这些三人执政官。

e.en: The three {triumvirs} divided power uneasily.
e.zh: 三位执政者不安地瓜分了权力。

e.en: Modern critics compare the executives to {triumvirs}.
e.zh: 现代评论者把这些高管比作三人执政者。

e.en: The sermon explored the doctrine of {triunity}.
e.zh: 这篇布道探讨了三位一体的教义。

e.en: She used {triunity} to describe the design's threefold unity.
e.zh: 她用三合一来描述这个设计的三重统一。

e.en: The analysis detected traces of {triuret}.
e.zh: 分析检测到了微量缩三脲。

e.en: Heating urea can produce {triuret} among other compounds.
e.zh: 加热尿素可能生成缩三脲等化合物。

e.en: Iron can show {trivalence} in certain compounds.
e.zh: 铁在某些化合物中可以表现出三价性。

e.en: The theory assigns {trivalence} to the symbol.
e.zh: 该理论赋予这个符号三重价值。

e.en: The biologist studied a {troglobiotic} shrimp found deep underground.
e.zh: 生物学家研究了一种在地下深处发现的完全洞穴生活虾。

e.en: Many {troglobiotic} animals lose their eyesight over generations.
e.zh: 许多完全洞穴生活的动物会在几代之后失去视力。

e.en: A blind cave fish is a classic {troglobite}.
e.zh: 盲洞鱼是典型的专性洞穴生物。

e.en: The survey listed each {troglobite} found in the limestone cave.
e.zh: 调查记录了石灰岩洞中发现的每一种专性洞穴生物。

e.en: The ruins showed traces of a {troglodytic} settlement.
e.zh: 这些遗迹显示出一个穴居聚落的痕迹。

e.en: He mocked their {troglodytic} refusal to use email.
e.zh: 他嘲笑他们原始粗野地拒绝使用电子邮件。

e.en: The old text described a {troglodytical} way of life.
e.zh: 这部旧文献描述了一种穴居式的生活方式。

e.en: Her essay criticized the policy as {troglodytical} and cruel.
e.zh: 她在文章中批评这项政策像穴居人般落后而残酷。

e.en: The spider is {troglophilous} but can survive outside caves.
e.zh: 这种蜘蛛喜洞穴环境，但也能在洞外生存。

e.en: Researchers marked several {troglophilous} species near the cave entrance.
e.zh: 研究人员在洞口附近标记了几种喜洞穴环境的物种。

e.en: We spotted a green {trogon} in the forest canopy.
e.zh: 我们在森林树冠层看见了一只绿色咬鹃。

e.en: The guide identified the bird as a {trogon} by its tail.
e.zh: 向导根据尾巴认出那只鸟是咬鹃。

e.en: The fossil had a {trogonoid} beak unlike nearby specimens.
e.zh: 这块化石有一个似咬鹃的喙，与附近标本不同。

e.en: Ornithologists debated whether the bird's {trogonoid} features were significant.
e.zh: 鸟类学家争论这只鸟似咬鹃的特征是否重要。

e.en: The article discussed {troilism} in clinical terms.
e.zh: 这篇文章以临床术语讨论三人性关系偏好。

e.en: They mentioned {troilism} only briefly during the lecture.
e.zh: 他们在讲座中只是简短提到了三人性关系偏好。

e.en: The meteorite contained small grains of {troilite}.
e.zh: 这块陨石中含有小颗粒的陨硫铁矿。

e.en: Geologists identified {troilite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 地质学家在显微镜下鉴定出了陨硫铁矿。

e.en: The {trolley-bus} stopped quietly beside the market.
e.zh: 无轨电车安静地停在市场旁边。

e.en: She took a {trolley-bus} across town every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上乘无轨电车穿过城区。

e.en: An old {trolley-car} rattled down the main street.
e.zh: 一辆老式有轨电车哐当哐当地驶过主街。

e.en: The museum restored a wooden {trolley-car} from 1910.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一辆1910年的木制有轨电车。

e.en: The nurse rolled a {trolley-table} toward the bed.
e.zh: 护士把一张推车式小桌推到床边。

e.en: Desserts were displayed on a silver {trolley-table}.
e.zh: 甜点摆在一张银色推车式小桌上。

e.en: The {trolleybus} drew power from overhead wires.
e.zh: 无轨电车从头顶电线获取电力。

e.en: Our city replaced several diesel routes with a {trolleybus}.
e.zh: 我们城市把几条柴油车线路换成了无轨电车。

e.en: New {trolleybuses} arrived for the busiest routes.
e.zh: 新的无轨电车被调到最繁忙的线路上。

e.en: The depot stores twenty {trolleybuses} overnight.
e.zh: 车场夜间停放二十辆无轨电车。

e.en: The {trolleyman} rang the bell before crossing the square.
e.zh: 电车司机在穿过广场前按响了铃。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a {trolleyman} in Boston.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在波士顿当电车工。

e.en: The novelist gave her a deliberately {trollopy} appearance.
e.zh: 小说家故意把她写成一副邋遢放荡的样子。

e.en: That old insult sounds {trollopy} and cruel today.
e.zh: 那个旧时侮辱词如今听起来既粗俗又刻薄。

e.en: The anatomist described a {trochal} surface near the joint.
e.zh: 解剖学家描述了关节附近一个滑车状表面。

e.en: The fossil showed a {trochal} pattern of ridges.
e.zh: 这块化石显出环状排列的脊纹。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a {trochar} through the small incision.
e.zh: 外科医生把套管针从小切口插入。

e.en: An old {trochar} lay in the museum's surgical case.
e.zh: 一枚旧穿刺器放在博物馆的外科器械柜里。

e.en: She dissolved a cough {troche} slowly under her tongue.
e.zh: 她把一片止咳含片放在舌下慢慢含化。

e.en: The pharmacist prepared a medicated {troche} for the patient.
e.zh: 药剂师为病人配制了一枚药用锭剂。

e.en: The poem begins with a strong {trochee}.
e.zh: 这首诗开头用了一个重音在前的扬抑格。

e.en: A {trochee} reverses the rhythm of an iamb.
e.zh: 扬抑格的节奏正好与抑扬格相反。

e.en: The microscope revealed a tiny {trochelminth} in the pond water.
e.zh: 显微镜显示池水里有一只微小的轮虫类动物。

e.en: A {trochelminth} moves with cilia around its head.
e.zh: 轮虫类动物靠头部周围的纤毛运动。

e.en: The critic noticed a {trochilic} beat in the chant.
e.zh: 评论家注意到这段吟唱里有扬抑格节拍。

e.en: The diagram marks the {trochilic} ring around the larva.
e.zh: 图中标出了幼体周围的轮状环带。

e.en: Her lecture on {trochilics} was difficult but precise.
e.zh: 她关于扬抑格诗律的讲座很难懂，但讲得很精确。

e.en: Ancient {trochilics} gave the song a marching pulse.
e.zh: 古代扬抑格诗律让这首歌有了行进般的节奏。

e.en: The column base includes a narrow {trochilus}.
e.zh: 柱基上有一道狭窄的凹圆线脚。

e.en: The shell's {trochilus} was noted in the old description.
e.zh: 旧描述中提到了贝壳的轮状结构。

e.en: The mason began {troching} the stone for the column base.
e.zh: 石匠开始给柱基石料凿出环槽。

e.en: Careless {troching} left uneven marks on the block.
e.zh: 粗心的挖槽在石块上留下了不平的痕迹。

e.en: The tendon passes over the {trochlea} of the humerus.
e.zh: 肌腱越过肱骨的滑车部位。

e.en: In anatomy, a {trochlea} works like a small pulley.
e.zh: 在解剖学中，滑车像一个小滑轮一样起作用。

e.en: The atlas compared the {trochleae} of several bird species.
e.zh: 图谱比较了几种鸟类的滑车状结构。

e.en: Both {trochleae} were visible in the scan.
e.zh: 扫描图中两个滑车结构都清晰可见。

e.en: The injury affected the {trochlear} nerve.
e.zh: 这次损伤影响了滑车神经。

e.en: Doctors examined the {trochlear} groove in his knee.
e.zh: 医生检查了他膝部的滑车沟。

e.en: The report mentioned possible {trochocephalia} in the infant.
e.zh: 报告提到这名婴儿可能有圆头畸形。

e.en: Historical physicians classified {trochocephalia} among skull deformities.
e.zh: 早期医生把圆颅症归入颅骨畸形。

e.en: The engineer plotted a {trochoid} traced by the wheel.
e.zh: 工程师绘出了车轮形成的次摆线。

e.en: A {trochoid} joint allows rotation around a pivot.
e.zh: 轮转关节允许围绕一个支点旋转。

e.en: The old carriage used a {trochometer} to record distance.
e.zh: 那辆旧马车用车程计记录行驶距离。

e.en: A laboratory {trochometer} measured the wheel's rotations.
e.zh: 实验室里的转速测量器测量了轮子的转数。

e.en: The larva developed into a swimming {trochophore}.
e.zh: 幼虫发育成了会游动的担轮幼虫。

e.en: A {trochophore} has a band of beating cilia.
e.zh: 担轮幼虫有一圈不断摆动的纤毛带。

e.en: The biologist identified the specimen as a {trochosphere}.
e.zh: 生物学家把这个标本鉴定为担轮幼虫。

e.en: A {trochosphere} stage appears early in some marine worms.
e.zh: 一些海生蠕虫早期会出现轮状幼体阶段。

e.en: The archive contained drawings of a wartime {trochotron}.
e.zh: 档案中保存着战时回旋电子管的图纸。

e.en: A {trochotron} can act as a specialized vacuum tube.
e.zh: 回旋电子管可以作为一种专用真空管。

e.en: The collector found a polished {trochus} shell on the beach.
e.zh: 收藏者在海滩上发现了一枚磨亮的圆锥螺壳。

e.en: The child spun a wooden {trochus} across the floor.
e.zh: 孩子把一个木制陀螺形玩具在地板上旋转。

trockenbeerenauslese.t: 逐粒精选贵腐甜白葡萄酒

e.en: They served {trockenbeerenauslese} with the apricot tart.
e.zh: 他们用逐粒精选贵腐甜白葡萄酒搭配杏子挞。

e.en: A good {trockenbeerenauslese} is intensely sweet and complex.
e.zh: 好的逐粒精选贵腐甜白葡萄酒甜味浓郁而层次复杂。

e.en: He {trode} carefully across the icy path.
e.zh: 他小心地踏过结冰的小路。

e.en: The soldiers {trode} the muddy field in silence.
e.zh: 士兵们默默踩过泥泞的田地。

e.en: The office ceiling held a row of fluorescent {troffers}.
e.zh: 办公室天花板上装着一排荧光槽形灯具。

e.en: An LED {troffer} replaced the old recessed fixture.
e.zh: 一盏LED槽形嵌入灯替换了旧的嵌入式灯具。

e.en: The novel describes him as a modern {trog}.
e.zh: 小说把他描写成一个现代穴居人般的人。

e.en: Don't act like a {trog} at the dinner table.
e.zh: 在餐桌上别表现得像个粗俗迟钝的人。

e.en: The chemist measured the metal's {trivalency} in solution.
e.zh: 化学家测定了这种金属在溶液中的三价状态。

e.en: Its {trivalency} affects how the ion bonds with oxygen.
e.zh: 它的三价性会影响该离子与氧结合的方式。

e.en: Aluminum is commonly {trivalent} in its compounds.
e.zh: 铝在其化合物中通常是三价的。

e.en: The vaccine was designed as a {trivalent} formulation.
e.zh: 这种疫苗被设计成三价配方。

e.en: The botanist described a {trivalve} seed capsule.
e.zh: 植物学家描述了一个三瓣裂开的蒴果。

e.en: A rare {trivalve} shell was found in the collection.
e.zh: 馆藏中发现了一枚罕见的三壳贝壳。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {trivalvular} structure near the opening.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到开口附近有一个三瓣膜结构。

e.en: The plant has a {trivalvular} capsule that splits when dry.
e.zh: 这种植物有一个干燥后会裂开的三瓣蒴果。

e.en: The essay sinks into {trivialism} near the end.
e.zh: 这篇文章到结尾时陷入了琐碎而平庸的议论。

e.en: He rejected {trivialism} and asked deeper questions.
e.zh: 他拒绝停留在琐碎主义上，转而提出更深的问题。

e.en: A {trivialist} might dismiss every moral problem as minor.
e.zh: 琐碎主义者可能会把每个道德问题都看得无足轻重。

e.en: The philosopher was called a {trivialist} by his critics.
e.zh: 批评者称这位哲学家为琐碎主义者。

e.en: Grammar formed one part of the medieval {trivium}.
e.zh: 语法是中世纪三艺的一部分。

e.en: Students studied the {trivium} before advanced subjects.
e.zh: 学生在学习高深科目前先研习中世纪三艺。

e.en: The moth is {trivoltine} in warmer regions.
e.zh: 这种蛾在较暖地区一年可繁殖三代。

e.en: Farmers monitored the {trivoltine} pest through summer.
e.zh: 农民整个夏季都在监测这种一年三代的害虫。

e.en: Climate change may increase {trivoltinism} in some insects.
e.zh: 气候变化可能会增强某些昆虫的一年三代性。

e.en: The study examined {trivoltinism} in regional butterfly populations.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了当地蝴蝶种群的一年三代现象。

triweekly.t: 每周三次的；每三周一次的

e.en: She attends a {triweekly} language class after work.
e.zh: 她下班后每周上三次语言课。

e.en: The magazine moved to a {triweekly} publication schedule.
e.zh: 这本杂志改为每三周出版一次。

e.en: The parasite's {trixeny} complicates disease control.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫的三宿主生活史使疾病控制更复杂。

e.en: Researchers documented {trixeny} in the tick's life cycle.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了这种蜱生命周期中的三宿主寄生现象。

e.en: The report detected {trixylenylphosphate} in the lubricant sample.
e.zh: 报告在润滑剂样品中检出了磷酸三二甲苯酯。

e.en: Workers handled {trixylenylphosphate} under strict safety rules.
e.zh: 工人在严格的安全规定下处理磷酸三二甲苯酯。

trizoic.t: 有三种动物的；三动物的

e.en: The fossil bed suggested a {trizoic} assemblage.
e.zh: 这处化石层显示出由三种动物组成的群集。

e.en: She used {trizoic} to describe the three-animal pattern.
e.zh: 她用三动物的这个术语来描述这种三种动物的模式。

e.en: The stag began to {troat} in the mist.
e.zh: 雄鹿在雾中开始发出低沉的叫声。

e.en: Hunters heard a distant {troat} before dawn.
e.zh: 猎人在黎明前听到远处一声低沉的鹿鸣。

e.en: The deer {troated} softly in the wood.
e.zh: 那只鹿在树林里轻轻发出低沉叫声。

e.en: A {troated} call echoed across the valley.
e.zh: 一声低沉的鸣叫在山谷中回荡。

e.en: The {troating} of deer carried through the forest.
e.zh: 鹿群低沉的鸣叫声传遍了森林。

e.en: He heard a stag {troating} beyond the hill.
e.zh: 他听见山那边有一头雄鹿在低沉鸣叫。

e.en: The old stag {troats} during the rutting season.
e.zh: 那头老雄鹿在发情季会发出低沉叫声。

e.en: Several {troats} came from the dark woods.
e.zh: 几声低沉的鹿鸣从黑暗的树林里传来。

e.en: The actor wore a white {trobe} on stage.
e.zh: 演员在舞台上穿着一件白色长袍。

e.en: The museum displayed a reconstructed Roman {trobe}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件复原的古罗马女袍。

e.en: The anthropologist interviewed a {Trobriander} about trade customs.
e.zh: 人类学家采访了一位特罗布里恩群岛居民，了解贸易习俗。

e.en: A {Trobriander} canoe appeared in the exhibition.
e.zh: 展览中出现了一艘特罗布里恩群岛居民使用的独木舟。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a {trocar} through the small incision.
e.zh: 外科医生通过小切口插入了一根套管针。

e.en: A sterile {trocar} is essential for laparoscopic surgery.
e.zh: 无菌穿刺器对腹腔镜手术至关重要。

e.en: The trader accepted {trocas} as a form of shell money.
e.zh: 商人接受托罗卡贝作为一种贝壳货币。

e.en: Old accounts mention {trocas} used in island exchange.
e.zh: 旧记录提到岛上交易中使用过托罗卡贝。

e.en: The poem begins with a {trochaic} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗开头采用扬抑格节奏。

e.en: Children often enjoy the bounce of {trochaic} verse.
e.zh: 孩子们常喜欢扬抑格诗句那种跳跃的节奏。

e.en: The porter pushed a {trolly} load of suitcases across the station.
e.zh: 搬运工推着一车行李穿过车站。

e.en: A {trolly} cart rattled behind the kitchen door.
e.zh: 一辆手推车在厨房门后咔嗒作响。

e.en: A sudden {tromba} rose over the warm sea.
e.zh: 一股突来的水龙卷在温暖海面上升起。

e.en: The villagers watched the dark {tromba} twist across the plain.
e.zh: 村民看着黑色龙卷风在平原上扭动前进。

e.en: A {trombiculid} larva can cause intense itching after a bite.
e.zh: 恙螨幼虫叮咬后会引起剧烈瘙痒。

e.en: The biologist identified the tiny mite as a {trombiculid}.
e.zh: 生物学家确认这只小螨虫属于恙螨科。

e.en: The rash was diagnosed as {trombidiasis} after the camping trip.
e.zh: 露营回来后，那片皮疹被诊断为恙螨叮咬病。

e.en: Doctors treated the child's {trombidiasis} with medicine for itching.
e.zh: 医生用止痒药治疗孩子的恙螨叮咬病。

e.en: Several hikers developed {trombidiosis} after walking through tall grass.
e.zh: 几名徒步者穿过高草后患上了恙螨侵袭症。

e.en: The veterinarian suspected {trombidiosis} in the irritated dog.
e.zh: 兽医怀疑这只皮肤发炎的狗有恙螨侵袭症。

e.en: The injection used {trometamol} as a buffering agent.
e.zh: 这种注射液使用氨丁三醇作为缓冲剂。

e.en: Pharmacists checked the dose of {trometamol} in the solution.
e.zh: 药剂师核对了溶液中氨丁三醇的剂量。

e.en: The quarry uses a {trommelsieve} to sort crushed stone.
e.zh: 采石场用滚筒筛分拣碎石。

e.en: Wet compost clogged the old {trommelsieve} during processing.
e.zh: 潮湿的堆肥在处理时堵住了旧滚筒筛。

e.en: The doctor used a {tromometer} to measure the patient's tremor.
e.zh: 医生用震颤测量仪测量病人的手抖。

e.en: Engineers installed a {tromometer} near the vibrating machine.
e.zh: 工程师在振动机器旁安装了震颤测量仪。

e.en: The mural used {trompe-l'oeil} to make the wall look like marble.
e.zh: 这幅壁画用逼真错视画法让墙面看起来像大理石。

e.en: Her cake had a {trompe-l'oeil} design that resembled a leather bag.
e.zh: 她的蛋糕采用错视设计，看起来像一个皮包。

e.en: The mine produces {trona} for making soda ash.
e.zh: 这座矿山开采天然碱矿，用来制造纯碱。

e.en: Large beds of {trona} formed as ancient lakes evaporated.
e.zh: 古代湖泊蒸发后形成了大片天然碱矿层。

e.en: The old poem speaks of a golden {trone}.
e.zh: 这首古诗提到一张金色王座。

e.en: In the manuscript, throne is spelled {trone}.
e.zh: 在这份手稿中，throne 被拼作 trone。

e.en: The roof was covered with {troolie} from nearby palms.
e.zh: 屋顶铺着附近棕榈树取来的棕榈叶茅草。

e.en: Workers tied bundles of {troolie} before thatching the hut.
e.zh: 工人先把棕榈叶茅草捆好，再给小屋铺顶。

e.en: The old {troopership} carried soldiers across the ocean.
e.zh: 那艘旧运兵船把士兵运过海洋。

e.en: Her grandfather served as a cook on a {troopership}.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在一艘运兵船上当厨师。

e.en: A bright {troopial} sang from the cactus fence.
e.zh: 一只鲜艳的拟鹂在仙人掌篱笆上歌唱。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {troopial} with orange feathers.
e.zh: 导游指出一只长着橙色羽毛的美洲黄鹂。

e.en: The young {troopie} wrote home after basic training.
e.zh: 这名年轻士兵在基础训练后给家里写信。

e.en: A local {troopie} stopped to help the stranded driver.
e.zh: 一名当地州警察停下来帮助被困司机。

e.en: The metallurgist found {troostite} in the hardened steel sample.
e.zh: 冶金学家在淬硬钢样品中发现了屈氏体。

e.en: Collectors value green {troostite} as a variety of willemite.
e.zh: 收藏者看重作为硅锌矿变种的绿色屈氏体。

e.en: The suffix {trop} often suggests turning toward something.
e.zh: 后缀 trop 常表示朝某物转向。

e.en: In biology, a {trop} is a response to a stimulus.
e.zh: 在生物学中，trop 指对刺激产生的趋向反应。

e.en: The old formulary listed {tropacine} among antispasmodic drugs.
e.zh: 旧药典把托品类药物列在解痉药之中。

e.en: Researchers compared {tropacine} with related alkaloid compounds.
e.zh: 研究人员把托品类药物与相关生物碱化合物作比较。

e.en: The chemist added {tropaeolin} to test the acidity of the sample.
e.zh: 化学家加入橙黄染料来测试样品酸度。

e.en: A small bottle of {tropaeolin} stood beside the other dyes.
e.zh: 一小瓶橙黄染料放在其他染料旁边。

e.en: The lab used {tropaeoline} as an acid-base indicator.
e.zh: 实验室用橙黄染料作酸碱指示剂。

e.en: Drops of {tropaeoline} turned the solution a vivid color.
e.zh: 几滴橙黄染料让溶液变成鲜明的颜色。

e.en: Different {tropaeolines} respond to acids with distinct color changes.
e.zh: 不同橙黄染料类遇酸会出现不同的颜色变化。

e.en: The catalogue grouped several synthetic dyes as {tropaeolines}.
e.zh: 目录把几种合成染料归为橙黄染料类。

e.en: The lab used {tropeolin} to stain the sample.
e.zh: 实验室用曲洛品染料给样本染色。

e.en: Old manuals list {tropeolin} among acid dyes.
e.zh: 旧手册把曲洛品列在酸性染料中。

e.en: The parasite entered a {trophal} stage after feeding.
e.zh: 寄生虫摄食后进入营养阶段。

e.en: Researchers measured the insect's {trophal} activity.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种昆虫的摄食活动。

e.en: Ants share food through {trophallaxis} in the colony.
e.zh: 蚂蚁在群体中通过交哺分享食物。

e.en: The study filmed {trophallaxis} between worker bees.
e.zh: 这项研究拍摄了工蜂之间的口对口传食。

e.en: The biologist examined the rotifer's {trophi} under magnification.
e.zh: 生物学家在放大镜下检查轮虫的口器部件。

e.en: Different species have differently shaped {trophi}.
e.zh: 不同物种的轮虫口器形状各不相同。

e.en: The hall displayed {trophied} weapons from old battles.
e.zh: 大厅陈列着作为战利品装饰的旧武器。

e.en: Her {trophied} career began with a small local race.
e.zh: 她硕果累累的职业生涯始于一场地方小赛。

trophism.t: 营养作用；组织营养状态

e.en: Poor nerve supply can disturb tissue {trophism}.
e.zh: 神经供应不足会扰乱组织营养状态。

e.en: The lecture discussed {trophism} in plant development.
e.zh: 讲座讨论了植物发育中的营养作用。

trophobiosis.t: 营养共生；取食互利关系

e.en: Ants and aphids often live in {trophobiosis}.
e.zh: 蚂蚁和蚜虫常处于营养共生关系。

e.en: The paper described {trophobiosis} as a stable exchange.
e.zh: 论文把营养共生描述为一种稳定交换。

e.en: The slide showed scattered {trophochromidia} in the cell.
e.zh: 载玻片显示细胞内有分散的营养染色质小体。

e.en: Older cytology texts mention {trophochromidia} in protozoa.
e.zh: 较早的细胞学文献提到原生动物中的营养染色质小体。

e.en: A single {trophochromidium} was visible near the nucleus.
e.zh: 细胞核附近可见一个营养染色质小体。

e.en: The term {trophochromidium} appears in older microscopy reports.
e.zh: 营养染色质小体这个术语见于较早的显微镜报告。

e.en: Each {trophocyte} stored nutrients for the developing egg.
e.zh: 每个营养细胞都为发育中的卵储存养分。

e.en: The gland contained a large {trophocyte} beside smaller cells.
e.zh: 腺体中有一个大的供养细胞位于较小细胞旁。

e.en: The lake's {trophogenic} layer receives enough sunlight.
e.zh: 湖泊的产营养层能获得足够阳光。

e.en: Doctors considered the drug's possible {trophogenic} effect.
e.zh: 医生考虑了这种药物可能的促营养作用。

e.en: A {trophogenist} studied how diet shaped growth.
e.zh: 一名营养学研究者研究饮食如何影响生长。

e.en: The old journal credited the {trophogenist} with the theory.
e.zh: 那本旧期刊把该理论归功于这位营养学研究者。

e.en: The {trophogone} was described in the early embryology paper.
e.zh: 那篇早期胚胎学论文描述了营养生殖细胞。

e.en: Scientists debated whether the cell was a {trophogone}.
e.zh: 科学家争论该细胞是否为营养生殖细胞。

e.en: He read widely in {trophology} and public health.
e.zh: 他广泛阅读营养学和公共卫生方面的资料。

e.en: Early {trophology} mixed observation with speculation.
e.zh: 早期营养学把观察和推测混在一起。

trophoneurosis.t: 营养神经症；神经营养障碍

e.en: The physician diagnosed a rare {trophoneurosis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断出一种罕见的神经营养障碍。

e.en: Pain and skin changes suggested {trophoneurosis}.
e.zh: 疼痛和皮肤变化提示可能是营养神经症。

e.en: The protozoan's {trophonucleus} controls ordinary cell functions.
e.zh: 这种原生动物的营养核控制普通细胞功能。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {trophonucleus} looked granular.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，营养核呈颗粒状。

e.en: The larva carried reserves in a {trophothylax}.
e.zh: 幼虫把储备养分装在储食囊中。

e.en: A damaged {trophothylax} reduced the insect's survival.
e.zh: 受损的营养贮囊降低了昆虫的存活率。

e.en: The microscope revealed a moving {trophozoite} in the sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示样本中有一个活动的滋养体。

e.en: A {trophozoite} feeds actively before forming a cyst.
e.zh: 滋养体在形成包囊前会积极摄食。

e.en: The botanist classified the organism as a {trophyte}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种生物归为营养型生物。

e.en: A {trophyte} depends on available nutrients in its habitat.
e.zh: 营养型生物依赖栖息地中的可用养分。

e.en: The child was treated for {tropia} after an eye exam.
e.zh: 眼科检查后，这个孩子接受了斜视治疗。

e.en: Intermittent {tropia} may appear only when the patient is tired.
e.zh: 间歇性斜视可能只在患者疲劳时出现。

tropicalian.t: 热带地区的人；热带居民

e.en: The writer called himself a {tropicalian} in exile.
e.zh: 那位作家称自己是流亡中的热带居民。

e.en: Her essays used {tropicalian} as a playful identity.
e.zh: 她的散文把热带人作为一种俏皮身份。

e.en: The engine required {tropicalization} before export.
e.zh: 这台发动机出口前需要进行热带化改造。

e.en: Urban planners studied the {tropicalization} of modern housing.
e.zh: 城市规划者研究了现代住宅的热带化。

e.en: Engineers had to {tropicalize} the equipment for humid climates.
e.zh: 工程师必须让设备适应潮湿的热带气候。

e.en: The resort tried to {tropicalize} its menu with local fruit.
e.zh: 度假村尝试用本地水果让菜单更具热带风味。

tropicalized.t: 已热带化的；适应热带的

e.en: The {tropicalized} radio worked well in heavy humidity.
e.zh: 这台经过热带化处理的收音机在高湿环境下运行良好。

e.en: They served a {tropicalized} version of the classic dessert.
e.zh: 他们供应了一款带热带风味的经典甜点。

e.en: The school punished repeated {truantry} harshly.
e.zh: 学校严厉处罚反复逃学的行为。

e.en: His sudden {truantry} worried his parents.
e.zh: 他突然旷课让父母很担心。

e.en: The old letter spoke of grief and {trub}.
e.zh: 那封旧信谈到悲伤和苦恼。

e.en: He wanted no more {trub} in the village.
e.zh: 他不想村里再有麻烦。

e.en: The foreman called him a {trublemaker}.
e.zh: 工头说他是个惹麻烦的人。

e.en: In the old pamphlet, every reformer was branded a {trublemaker}.
e.zh: 在那本旧小册子里，每个改革者都被打成惹事者。

e.en: She listed her many {trubs} in the diary.
e.zh: 她在日记里列下许多烦恼。

e.en: These petty {trubs} delayed the journey.
e.zh: 这些琐碎麻烦耽误了行程。

e.en: The poem describes a {truceless} war.
e.zh: 这首诗描写一场不停战的战争。

e.en: They lived under {truceless} pressure from creditors.
e.zh: 他们长期承受债主无休止的压力。

e.en: The negotiators drafted a {trucial} agreement at dawn.
e.zh: 谈判代表在黎明起草了一份停战协定。

e.en: A {trucial} period allowed families to cross the border.
e.zh: 休战期间，许多家庭得以越过边境。

e.en: The mechanic inspected the {truck-bolster} for cracks.
e.zh: 机械师检查转向架枕梁是否有裂纹。

e.en: A damaged {truck-bolster} can make the railcar unsafe.
e.zh: 损坏的转向架枕梁会让轨道车辆不安全。

e.en: The invoice included {truckage} from the port.
e.zh: 发票里包含从港口来的货车运费。

e.en: Local {truckage} became costly after the bridge closed.
e.zh: 桥关闭后，当地货运变得昂贵。

e.en: The {truckdriver} stopped for coffee before dawn.
e.zh: 卡车司机在天亮前停下来喝咖啡。

e.en: My uncle worked as a {truckdriver} for years.
e.zh: 我叔叔当了很多年卡车司机。

e.en: The company bought a new {truckhead} for long hauls.
e.zh: 公司买了一辆新的牵引车头跑长途。

e.en: The {truckhead} was parked without its trailer.
e.zh: 那辆卡车车头停在那里，没有挂拖车。

e.en: An Australian {truckie} gave us directions.
e.zh: 一位澳大利亚卡车司机给我们指路。

e.en: The tired {truckie} slept in his cab.
e.zh: 疲惫的卡车司机睡在驾驶室里。

e.en: He refused to {truckle} to powerful donors.
e.zh: 他拒绝向有权势的捐助者低头。

e.en: Courtiers learned to {truckle} with polished smiles.
e.zh: 朝臣们学会带着得体的笑容谄媚。

e.en: The editor never {truckled} to political pressure.
e.zh: 那位编辑从不屈从于政治压力。

e.en: He {truckled} shamelessly before every rich guest.
e.zh: 他在每位富客面前都无耻地谄媚。

e.en: No honest critic would become a {truckler}.
e.zh: 诚实的批评家不会变成谄媚者。

e.en: The king trusted the bold adviser more than any {truckler}.
e.zh: 国王更信任那位直言顾问，而不是谄媚之徒。

e.en: She never {truckles} to fashion or fame.
e.zh: 她从不向时尚或名声低头。

e.en: The clerk {truckles} whenever the manager enters.
e.zh: 经理一进来，那名职员就开始谄媚。

e.en: The new {truckline} connects farms with the market.
e.zh: 新的货运线路把农场和市场连接起来。

e.en: His father owned a small {truckline} in Ohio.
e.zh: 他父亲在俄亥俄经营一家小卡车运输公司。

e.en: His {truckling} manner annoyed the committee.
e.zh: 他那副谄媚的样子惹恼了委员会。

e.en: They accused the paper of {truckling} to advertisers.
e.zh: 他们指责那家报纸向广告商屈从。

e.en: He smiled {trucklingly} at the visiting official.
e.zh: 他谄媚地对来访官员微笑。

e.en: The servant answered {trucklingly}, fearing dismissal.
e.zh: 仆人害怕被解雇，便低声下气地回答。

e.en: The {truckman} delivered coal before breakfast.
e.zh: 那名卡车司机早饭前送来了煤。

e.en: A strong {truckman} carried the crates upstairs.
e.zh: 一名强壮的搬运工把箱子搬上楼。

e.en: The {truckmaster} assigned routes to each driver.
e.zh: 货运主管给每位司机分配路线。

e.en: During the war, the {truckmaster} kept supplies moving.
e.zh: 战争期间，车队负责人保证物资持续运输。

e.en: The {truckmen} unloaded furniture in the rain.
e.zh: 搬运工们冒雨卸下家具。

e.en: Several {truckmen} waited outside the warehouse.
e.zh: 几名卡车司机在仓库外等候。

e.en: The mine built a {truckway} through the hill.
e.zh: 矿场修了一条穿过山丘的运输通道。

e.en: Keep pedestrians away from the busy {truckway}.
e.zh: 让行人远离繁忙的货车道。

e.en: His {truculency} frightened the younger clerks.
e.zh: 他的凶狠吓到了年轻职员。

e.en: The speech mixed patriotism with open {truculency}.
e.zh: 那场演讲把爱国情绪和公开的好斗态度混在一起。

e.en: The island used {troposcatter} links before fiber arrived.
e.zh: 光纤铺设前，这座岛使用对流层散射链路通信。

e.en: Engineers tested the {troposcatter} system during bad weather.
e.zh: 工程师在恶劣天气中测试了这套对流层散射系统。

e.en: The larvae showed {tropotaxis} toward the light source.
e.zh: 幼虫表现出朝向光源的趋向性运动反应。

e.en: Researchers measured {tropotaxis} in several small aquatic animals.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了几种小型水生动物的趋向性反应。

e.en: The chemist identified a {tropoyl} group in the compound.
e.zh: 化学家在该化合物中识别出托品酰基。

e.en: A {tropoyl} derivative was prepared for further analysis.
e.zh: 他们制备了一种托品酰基衍生物以便进一步分析。

e.en: The pianist played the passage {troppo} fast.
e.zh: 钢琴家把这一段弹得过快了。

e.en: His praise sounded a little {troppo} for such a minor success.
e.zh: 对这样一个小成就，他的赞美听起来有点过头。

e.en: The clinic used a {troptometer} to measure eye rotation.
e.zh: 诊所用眼旋转测量仪来测量眼球旋转。

e.en: A damaged {troptometer} delayed the vision study.
e.zh: 一台损坏的眼旋转测量仪耽误了这项视觉研究。

e.en: The spectrum confirmed the presence of {tropylium}.
e.zh: 光谱确认存在环庚三烯正离子。

e.en: Students learned why {tropylium} is unusually stable.
e.zh: 学生们学习了环庚三烯正离子为何异常稳定。

e.en: They crossed the lake in a noisy {trotboat}.
e.zh: 他们乘一艘吵闹的小快艇穿过湖面。

e.en: The old {trotboat} carried supplies to the pier.
e.zh: 那艘旧轻便汽艇把补给运到码头。

e.en: She tucked a {trotcozy} around her knees.
e.zh: 她把马车保暖毯裹在膝盖周围。

e.en: The coachman kept a spare {trotcozy} under the seat.
e.zh: 马车夫在座位下备了一条保暖毯。

e.en: The ballad tells of a {trothless} lover.
e.zh: 这首民谣讲述了一个背信弃义的恋人。

e.en: He was condemned as {trothless} by the old court.
e.zh: 他被旧时法庭斥为不忠不信之人。

e.en: The families celebrated their {trothplight} with a feast.
e.zh: 两家人设宴庆祝他们订下婚约。

e.en: To {trothplight} was once a solemn public promise.
e.zh: 订婚在过去曾是一种庄重的公开承诺。

e.en: The {trothplighted} couple exchanged simple silver rings.
e.zh: 这对已订婚的伴侣交换了朴素的银戒指。

e.en: She remained {trothplighted} to him for seven years.
e.zh: 她与他保持婚约长达七年。

e.en: Cafe tables crowded the narrow {trottoir}.
e.zh: 咖啡馆的桌子挤满了狭窄的人行道。

e.en: He waited on the {trottoir} outside the station.
e.zh: 他在车站外的人行道上等候。

e.en: The pony moved with a {trotty} little gait.
e.zh: 那匹小马迈着小跑般的碎步前进。

e.en: Her {trotty} rhythm made the dance look comic.
e.zh: 她碎步般的节奏让这支舞显得很滑稽。

e.en: The report listed {trotyl} among the stored explosives.
e.zh: 报告把梯恩梯列入储存的爆炸物清单。

e.en: Workers handled {trotyl} only under strict supervision.
e.zh: 工人只能在严格监督下处理梯恩梯炸药。

e.en: The old map marked a deep {trou} near the hill.
e.zh: 旧地图标出山丘附近有一个深洞。

e.en: A small {trou} in the fabric let in cold air.
e.zh: 布料上的一个小洞让冷空气钻了进来。

e.en: The fort was protected by a hidden {trou-de-loup}.
e.zh: 这座堡垒受到一处隐藏狼坑陷阱的保护。

e.en: Soldiers filled the {trou-de-loup} before crossing the field.
e.zh: 士兵们在穿过田地前填平了狼坑陷阱。

e.en: The software update was completely {trouble-free}.
e.zh: 这次软件更新完全没有出问题。

e.en: They wanted a {trouble-free} holiday by the sea.
e.zh: 他们想要一次省心的海边假期。

e.en: The {trouble-plagued} project missed another deadline.
e.zh: 这个问题缠身的项目又错过了一个截止日期。

e.en: Investors avoided the {trouble-plagued} airline for months.
e.zh: 投资者好几个月都避开那家麻烦不断的航空公司。

trouble-proof.t: 防故障的；不易出问题的

e.en: No machine is truly {trouble-proof} in constant use.
e.zh: 没有机器在持续使用中能真正完全不出故障。

e.en: They advertised the pump as {trouble-proof} and easy to repair.
e.zh: 他们宣传这台泵不易出问题，而且容易维修。

e.en: This {trouble-saving} checklist prevents common filing mistakes.
e.zh: 这份省麻烦的清单能避免常见的归档错误。

e.en: Her {trouble-saving} advice helped us finish early.
e.zh: 她那些省事的建议帮助我们提前完成。

e.en: The {trouble-shooters} arrived after the network failed.
e.zh: 网络瘫痪后，故障排除人员赶到了。

e.en: Good {trouble-shooters} ask careful questions first.
e.zh: 优秀的排障人员会先仔细提问。

e.en: The teacher separated the {troublemaking} students.
e.zh: 老师把那些爱捣乱的学生分开了。

e.en: His {troublemaking} at work finally cost him his job.
e.zh: 他在工作中不断惹事，最后丢了饭碗。

troubleproof.t: 防故障的；不易出问题的

e.en: The company claimed its new lock was {troubleproof}.
e.zh: 公司声称它的新锁不容易出故障。

e.en: We tried to {troubleproof} the process before launch.
e.zh: 我们在发布前尽量让这个流程不出问题。

tropicopolitan.t: 分布于热带各地的广布种

e.en: The botanist described the fern as {tropicopolitan}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种蕨类描述为热带各地广布。

e.en: A {tropicopolitan} insect may appear on many islands.
e.zh: 一种热带广布昆虫可能出现在许多岛屿上。

tropide.t: 托品类化合物；莨菪烷衍生物

e.en: The paper identified a new {tropide} in the extract.
e.zh: 论文在提取物中鉴定出一种新的托品类化合物。

e.en: Each {tropide} was tested for possible medical effects.
e.zh: 每种莨菪烷衍生物都被测试其潜在药效。

tropidine.t: 托品啶；一种生物碱相关化合物

e.en: The chemist compared {tropidine} with related alkaloids.
e.zh: 化学家把托品啶与相关生物碱进行了比较。

e.en: Pure {tropidine} requires careful handling in the lab.
e.zh: 纯托品啶在实验室中需要谨慎处理。

e.en: The reaction produced {tropin} as a minor product.
e.zh: 该反应生成了少量托品作为副产物。

e.en: Students learned why {tropin} matters in alkaloid chemistry.
e.zh: 学生们学习了托品为何在生物碱化学中重要。

e.en: Atropine can be broken down into {tropine}.
e.zh: 阿托品可以分解生成托品。

e.en: The lab stored {tropine} in a sealed bottle.
e.zh: 实验室把托品存放在密封瓶中。

tropinone.t: 托品酮；合成生物碱中间体

e.en: Robinson's synthesis of {tropinone} became famous.
e.zh: 罗宾逊的托品酮合成法变得很有名。

e.en: The route uses {tropinone} as a key intermediate.
e.zh: 这条路线把托品酮用作关键中间体。

e.en: Plants show {tropism} when they grow toward light.
e.zh: 植物朝光生长时表现出向性。

e.en: The virus has a {tropism} for nerve tissue.
e.zh: 这种病毒对神经组织有趋向性。

tropist.t: 研究向性的人；比喻解释者

e.en: A plant {tropist} studies how roots sense gravity.
e.zh: 植物向性研究者会研究根如何感知重力。

e.en: The critic was a bold {tropist} of ancient myths.
e.zh: 这位评论家是古代神话的大胆阐释者。

e.en: The poem uses a {tropo} reading of exile.
e.zh: 这首诗对流亡作了比喻式解读。

e.en: His argument depends on a {tropo} shift in meaning.
e.zh: 他的论证依赖于意义上的转义变化。

tropocollagen.t: 原胶原；胶原蛋白基本分子

e.en: Each collagen fiber begins with {tropocollagen} molecules.
e.zh: 每根胶原纤维都由原胶原分子开始形成。

e.en: The microscope image showed aligned {tropocollagen}.
e.zh: 显微镜图像显示出排列整齐的原胶原。

tropoelastin.t: 原弹性蛋白；弹性蛋白前体

e.en: Cells secrete {tropoelastin} before forming elastic fibers.
e.zh: 细胞先分泌原弹性蛋白，再形成弹性纤维。

e.en: The implant coating included synthetic {tropoelastin}.
e.zh: 这种植入物涂层含有合成原弹性蛋白。

tropologic.t: 比喻解释的；寓意解读的

e.en: The sermon offered a {tropologic} reading of the story.
e.zh: 这篇布道对故事作了寓意式解读。

e.en: Medieval scholars favored {tropologic} interpretation.
e.zh: 中世纪学者偏爱比喻性的解释方法。

e.en: Her thesis examines {tropology} in medieval poetry.
e.zh: 她的论文研究中世纪诗歌中的比喻法。

e.en: Biblical {tropology} treats events as moral symbols.
e.zh: 圣经寓意解释学把事件视为道德象征。

tropolone.t: 托品酚酮；芳香族化合物

e.en: The molecule {tropolone} has unusual aromatic properties.
e.zh: 托品酚酮这种分子具有不寻常的芳香性。

e.en: Researchers derived antibiotics from a {tropolone} structure.
e.zh: 研究人员从托品酚酮结构衍生出抗生素。

tropometer.t: 转角计；眼球偏斜测量器

e.en: The doctor used a {tropometer} during the eye exam.
e.zh: 医生在眼科检查中使用了转角计。

e.en: A {tropometer} measures the angle of ocular deviation.
e.zh: 转角计用于测量眼球偏斜的角度。

tropomyosin.t: 原肌球蛋白；肌肉调节蛋白

e.en: Calcium changes how {tropomyosin} sits on actin.
e.zh: 钙会改变原肌球蛋白在肌动蛋白上的位置。

e.en: Shellfish allergy can involve {tropomyosin}.
e.zh: 贝类过敏可能与原肌球蛋白有关。

tropone.t: 环庚三烯酮；托品酮类母体

e.en: Chemists study {tropone} for its aromatic character.
e.zh: 化学家研究环庚三烯酮的芳香性特征。

e.en: The compound {tropone} forms several useful derivatives.
e.zh: 环庚三烯酮能形成多种有用衍生物。

troponin.t: 肌钙蛋白；心肌损伤标志物

e.en: High {troponin} levels may indicate a heart attack.
e.zh: 肌钙蛋白水平高可能提示心脏病发作。

e.en: The muscle fiber uses {troponin} to regulate contraction.
e.zh: 肌纤维利用肌钙蛋白来调节收缩。

troponoid.t: 托品酮样的；七元芳香环的

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {troponoid} compound.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的托品酮样化合物。

e.en: Some {troponoid} structures show strong biological activity.
e.zh: 一些七元芳香环结构表现出很强的生物活性。

tropopause.t: 对流层顶；平流层下边界

e.en: Jet streams often form near the {tropopause}.
e.zh: 急流常常在对流层顶附近形成。

e.en: The balloon carried sensors up to the {tropopause}.
e.zh: 气球把传感器带到了对流层顶。

e.en: A {tropophilous} forest survives both rain and drought.
e.zh: 适应干湿季交替的森林能熬过雨季和旱季。

e.en: These {tropophilous} plants shed leaves in the dry season.
e.zh: 这些旱雨季适应植物会在旱季落叶。

e.en: A baobab is often treated as a {tropophyte}.
e.zh: 猴面包树常被视为干湿季适应植物。

e.en: The {tropophyte} stores water during the rainy months.
e.zh: 这种干湿季适应植物会在雨季储水。

e.en: The region's {tropophytia} reflects its seasonal rainfall.
e.zh: 该地区的干湿季适应植被状态反映了季节性降雨。

e.en: Botanists mapped {tropophytia} across the savanna edge.
e.zh: 植物学家绘制了稀树草原边缘的干湿季适应植被分布。

e.en: We had to {trudgen} through mud all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都得在泥里吃力跋涉。

e.en: The tired porter {trudgened} behind the wagon.
e.zh: 疲惫的搬运工在马车后面慢吞吞地走着。

e.en: She remained a {true-blue} supporter through every crisis.
e.zh: 每次危机中，她都始终是忠诚可靠的支持者。

e.en: He is a {true-blue} New Yorker at heart.
e.zh: 他骨子里是个地道的纽约人。

e.en: The quiz ended with ten {true-false} questions.
e.zh: 测验最后有十道判断正误题。

e.en: Use a {true-false} format for younger students.
e.zh: 给低年级学生使用是非题形式。

true-life.t: 真实生活的；真人真事的

e.en: The film is based on a {true-life} rescue story.
e.zh: 这部电影改编自一个真实的救援故事。

e.en: She writes {true-life} essays about working in hospitals.
e.zh: 她写关于医院工作的真实生活随笔。

e.en: The actor gave a {true-to-life} performance.
e.zh: 这位演员的表演非常逼真。

e.en: Her dialogue feels {true-to-life} and never forced.
e.zh: 她写的对白很贴近现实，一点也不生硬。

e.en: He claimed to be a {trueborn} heir to the estate.
e.zh: 他声称自己是这份产业血统纯正的继承人。

e.en: She had the confidence of a {trueborn} leader.
e.zh: 她有一种天生领导者的自信。

e.en: The farmer prized his {truebred} horses.
e.zh: 农夫很珍视他的纯种马。

e.en: He spoke with the manners of a {truebred} gentleman.
e.zh: 他说话举止像个教养纯正的绅士。

e.en: The old deed named her as the {truee}.
e.zh: 那份旧契约把她列为受托人。

e.en: A {truee} must manage the property honestly.
e.zh: 受托人必须诚实地管理财产。

e.en: He was a {truehearted} friend in difficult times.
e.zh: 在艰难时期，他是个忠诚真挚的朋友。

e.en: Her {truehearted} apology softened the room.
e.zh: 她诚心的道歉缓和了现场气氛。

e.en: His {trueheartedness} won their trust.
e.zh: 他的忠诚真挚赢得了他们的信任。

e.en: The letter showed rare {trueheartedness}.
e.zh: 这封信流露出少见的诚心诚意。

e.en: She believed he was her {truelove}.
e.zh: 她相信他就是自己的真爱。

e.en: The song mourns a lost {truelove}.
e.zh: 这首歌哀悼一位失去的心上人。

e.en: The witness refused to give his {truename}.
e.zh: 证人拒绝透露自己的真实姓名。

e.en: In the tale, knowing a spirit's {truename} gives power.
e.zh: 在这个故事里，知道精灵的本名就能获得力量。

e.en: Old Jack was a {truepenny} in every bargain.
e.zh: 老杰克做每笔交易都诚实可靠。

e.en: Trust her; she is a {truepenny}.
e.zh: 相信她吧，她是个靠得住的人。

e.en: The cook shaved {truff} over the hot pasta.
e.zh: 厨师把松露刨在热意面上。

e.en: They searched the woods for rare {truff}.
e.zh: 他们在林中寻找稀有的块菌。

e.en: She carried roses in a wooden {trug}.
e.zh: 她用一个木制浅篮提着玫瑰。

e.en: The gardener filled the {trug} with herbs.
e.zh: 园丁把园艺提篮装满了香草。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {trugs} for gardeners.
e.zh: 这家店出售给园丁用的手工浅木篮。

e.en: Two {trugs} of apples sat by the door.
e.zh: 门边放着两篮苹果。

e.en: His {truistic} style avoids romantic exaggeration.
e.zh: 他的真实主义风格避免浪漫化的夸张。

e.en: The critic praised the novel's {truistic} detail.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部小说重视真实细节。

e.en: The old play calls her a {trull}.
e.zh: 那出老戏把她称作娼妇。

e.en: He used {trull} as a harsh insult.
e.zh: 他用这个词作为刺耳的侮辱。

e.en: The score spells trombone as {trumbone}.
e.zh: 这份乐谱把长号拼成了旧式写法trumbone。

e.en: He found {trumbone} in an eighteenth-century music book.
e.zh: 他在一本十八世纪音乐书里看到长号的旧拼法。

e.en: A carved {trumeau} divided the two doorways.
e.zh: 一根雕刻过的门间壁柱隔开了两道门。

e.en: The antique {trumeau} mirror hung above the mantel.
e.zh: 那面古董镜饰挂在壁炉架上方。

e.en: He dismissed the ceremony as empty {trumoery}.
e.zh: 他把这场仪式斥为毫无意义的虚饰。

e.en: The contract hid its risks behind legal {trumoery}.
e.zh: 合同把风险藏在法律花招后面。

e.en: Her experience was the team's {trump-card}.
e.zh: 她的经验是这个团队的王牌。

e.en: He saved his {trump-card} for the final debate.
e.zh: 他把制胜法宝留到了最后一场辩论。

e.en: The kingdom endured a {troublous} winter of famine and revolt.
e.zh: 王国经历了一个饥荒与叛乱交织的动荡冬天。

e.en: She wrote calmly about those {troublous} years.
e.zh: 她平静地写下那些多事的岁月。

e.en: The negotiations began {troublously} and soon collapsed.
e.zh: 谈判一开始就很不顺，很快便破裂了。

e.en: Clouds gathered {troublously} over the dark hills.
e.zh: 乌云令人不安地聚集在黑暗的山丘上空。

e.en: The memoir captures the {troublousness} of postwar life.
e.zh: 这本回忆录捕捉了战后生活的动荡不安。

e.en: He sensed a certain {troublousness} beneath her polite smile.
e.zh: 他察觉到她礼貌微笑背后有某种不安。

e.en: A small {troup} of actors arrived before dusk.
e.zh: 一小队演员在黄昏前抵达。

e.en: The village hired a traveling {troup} for the festival.
e.zh: 村里为节日请来了一支巡回演出剧团。

troupial.t: 拟黄鹂类鸟；橙黑色鸣禽

e.en: A bright {troupial} perched on the fence at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时，一只鲜艳的拟黄鹂停在篱笆上。

e.en: The guide identified the orange bird as a {troupial}.
e.zh: 向导认出那只橙色的鸟是拟黄鹂。

e.en: His old {trouse} was patched at both knees.
e.zh: 他的旧裤子两个膝盖处都打了补丁。

e.en: The tailor measured the boy for a new {trouse}.
e.zh: 裁缝给男孩量尺寸，准备做一条新裤子。

e.en: The jacket had a matching {trouser} stripe.
e.zh: 这件夹克有一条相配的裤侧条纹。

e.en: He tried to {trouser} the cash before anyone noticed.
e.zh: 他想在别人发现前把现金私吞。

e.en: He kept the key in his {trouser-pocket}.
e.zh: 他把钥匙放在裤兜里。

e.en: A coin fell from her {trouser-pocket} onto the floor.
e.zh: 一枚硬币从她的裤子口袋里掉到地上。

e.en: The hotel room included a wall-mounted {trouser-press}.
e.zh: 酒店房间里有一台壁挂式烫裤机。

e.en: He used the {trouser-press} before the morning meeting.
e.zh: 早会前他用烫裤机压好了裤线。

e.en: The shop sold heavy wool {trousering} for winter suits.
e.zh: 那家店出售适合冬季西装的厚羊毛裤料。

e.en: The official was accused of {trousering} public funds.
e.zh: 那名官员被指控私吞公款。

e.en: The sisters prepared their {trousseaux} in embroidered trunks.
e.zh: 姐妹们把嫁妆衣物装进绣花箱子里。

e.en: Old letters described the brides' {trousseaux} in great detail.
e.zh: 旧信里详细描写了新娘们的嫁妆用品。

e.en: He wore a {trout-colored} jacket with tiny speckles.
e.zh: 他穿着一件带细小斑点的鳟鱼色夹克。

e.en: The painter mixed a soft {trout-colored} gray for the river stones.
e.zh: 画家调出柔和的斑点灰褐色来画河石。

e.en: Her scarf was {trout-coloured}, silver with faint pink spots.
e.zh: 她的围巾是鳟鱼色的，银灰中带着淡粉斑点。

e.en: The old ceramic bowl had a {trout-coloured} glaze.
e.zh: 那只旧陶碗有一层斑点灰褐色釉面。

e.en: A {troutlet} flickered in the shallow stream.
e.zh: 一条小鳟鱼在浅溪中一闪而过。

e.en: The children watched each {troutlet} dart between the stones.
e.zh: 孩子们看着一条条幼鳟在石头间迅速穿梭。

e.en: The fish had a {troutlike} shape and silver sides.
e.zh: 那条鱼外形像鳟鱼，身体两侧泛着银光。

e.en: Its {troutlike} markings made identification difficult.
e.zh: 它鳟鱼般的斑纹让人很难辨认。

e.en: The angler released the tiny {troutling} back into the brook.
e.zh: 钓鱼人把那条小鳟鱼放回溪流里。

e.en: A single {troutling} hid beneath the floating leaves.
e.zh: 一条幼小鳟鱼躲在漂浮的叶子下面。

e.en: The biologist found a {troutperch} in the clear lake water.
e.zh: 生物学家在清澈的湖水中发现了一条鳟鲈。

e.en: A {troutperch} is often mistaken for a young game fish.
e.zh: 鳟鲈常被误认为是幼小的游钓鱼。

e.en: The cold stream looked wonderfully {trouty} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后那条冷溪看起来很适合鳟鱼栖息。

e.en: The chef praised the fish for its clean, {trouty} flavor.
e.zh: 厨师称赞这鱼有清爽的鳟鱼般风味。

trouvaille.t: 意外发现的珍品；妙得之物

e.en: The dusty atlas was a real {trouvaille} for the historian.
e.zh: 那本布满灰尘的地图集对历史学家来说是真正的意外珍品。

e.en: Her best design idea came as a {trouvaille} during lunch.
e.zh: 她最好的设计点子是在午餐时偶然得到的妙想。

trouvere.t: 中世纪法国北方吟游诗人

e.en: The {trouvere} sang of courts, battles, and distant love.
e.zh: 那位中世纪法国北方吟游诗人歌唱宫廷、战斗和远方的爱情。

e.en: Scholars compared the {trouvere} with the southern troubadour tradition.
e.zh: 学者们把这种北方吟游诗人与南方游吟诗人传统作比较。

e.en: I {trow} he will not return before nightfall.
e.zh: 我想他天黑前不会回来。

e.en: What do you {trow} she meant by that remark?
e.zh: 你认为她那句话是什么意思？

e.en: The {trowelman} smoothed the plaster with quick strokes.
e.zh: 泥瓦匠用利落的动作把灰泥抹平。

e.en: A skilled {trowelman} can finish a wall in hours.
e.zh: 熟练的抹灰工几小时就能完成一面墙。

e.en: She {trows} that the tale is older than the castle.
e.zh: 她认为这个传说比城堡还要古老。

e.en: Who {trows} what secrets lie under the floor?
e.zh: 谁知道地板下面藏着什么秘密呢？

e.en: The police dropped the {trumped-up} charges.
e.zh: 警方撤销了那些捏造的指控。

e.en: She dismissed the scandal as a {trumped-up} story.
e.zh: 她把这桩丑闻斥为凭空编造的故事。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {trumpet-leaf} near the stream.
e.zh: 向导指出溪边有一株喇叭形叶植物。

e.en: A {trumpet-leaf} can trap rainwater after storms.
e.zh: 暴雨过后，喇叭形叶植物能积住雨水。

e.en: The flower opened into a {trumpetlike} shape.
e.zh: 那朵花展开成喇叭状。

e.en: A {trumpetlike} call echoed across the valley.
e.zh: 一声像喇叭的叫声在山谷中回荡。

e.en: The ditch was full of {trumpetweed} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天沟渠里长满了喇叭草。

e.en: Children picked {trumpetweed} for its bright flowers.
e.zh: 孩子们采摘喇叭草，因为它的花很鲜艳。

e.en: The rash was mainly {truncal} rather than facial.
e.zh: 皮疹主要出现在躯干，而不是脸部。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {truncal} artery carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了主干动脉。

e.en: The statue showed a clean {truncature} at the shoulder.
e.zh: 雕像肩部有一道整齐的截断处。

e.en: The editor marked the {truncature} of the long quotation.
e.zh: 编辑标出了那段长引文被删截的位置。

e.en: The textbook labeled the {truncus} in the diagram.
e.zh: 教材在图中标出了躯干。

e.en: Damage to the {truncus} affected several branches.
e.zh: 主干受损影响了几个分支。

e.en: The carpenter drove a {trunk-nail} into the beam.
e.zh: 木匠把一枚木钉钉进横梁。

e.en: An old {trunk-nail} held the joint together.
e.zh: 一枚旧木栓把接缝固定在一起。

e.en: The village lies beside a busy {trunk-road}.
e.zh: 这个村庄位于一条繁忙的干线公路旁。

e.en: Freight usually moves along the {trunk-road} at night.
e.zh: 货运通常在夜间沿主干道行驶。

e.en: The old chair had a {trunkback} wooden frame.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子有个背部隆起的木框。

e.en: A {trunkback} fish drifted near the reef.
e.zh: 一条高背鱼在礁石附近游动。

e.en: A yellow {trunkfish} hovered above the coral.
e.zh: 一条黄色箱鲀悬游在珊瑚上方。

e.en: The diver photographed a spotted {trunkfish}.
e.zh: 潜水员拍下了一条有斑点的箱鲀。

e.en: The garden had several {trunkless} palms.
e.zh: 花园里有几棵无明显树干的棕榈。

e.en: A {trunkless} statue stood in the museum hall.
e.zh: 一尊无躯干的雕像立在博物馆大厅里。

e.en: The {trunkmaker} repaired the broken leather handle.
e.zh: 皮箱匠修好了断裂的皮提手。

e.en: A skilled {trunkmaker} built cases for travelers.
e.zh: 一位熟练的箱子制造者为旅客制作箱子。

e.en: The shipwright fitted a {trunnel} through the plank.
e.zh: 造船工把一根木钉穿进木板。

e.en: Each {trunnel} swelled tight when it became wet.
e.zh: 每根木钉受潮后都会膨胀并卡紧。

e.en: The senator supported new {trust-busting} laws.
e.zh: 那位参议员支持新的反托拉斯法律。

e.en: His {trust-busting} campaign targeted railroad monopolies.
e.zh: 他的打击垄断运动针对铁路垄断企业。

e.en: We need a {trustable} source for the figures.
e.zh: 我们需要一个可靠的数据来源。

e.en: The app is simple and {trustable} enough for daily use.
e.zh: 这个应用简单且足够可信，适合日常使用。

e.en: The newspaper called her a fearless {trustbuster}.
e.zh: 报纸称她是无畏的反托拉斯执法者。

e.en: A famous {trustbuster} challenged the oil monopoly.
e.zh: 一位著名的反托拉斯人士挑战了石油垄断。

e.en: This backup system is {trustier} than the old one.
e.zh: 这个备份系统比旧系统更可靠。

e.en: She chose the {trustier} guide for the mountain trip.
e.zh: 她为登山行程选择了更可信赖的向导。

e.en: The seal helps {trustify} the online payment page.
e.zh: 这个认证标志有助于让在线支付页面显得可信。

e.en: Clear records can {trustify} a disputed transaction.
e.zh: 清楚的记录可以为有争议的交易建立可信度。

e.en: The old engine ran {trustily} through the winter.
e.zh: 那台旧发动机整个冬天都可靠地运转。

e.en: She {trustily} carried every message without delay.
e.zh: 她总是可靠地传递每条消息，从不拖延。

e.en: The audit tested the {trustiness} of the accounts.
e.zh: 审计检验了这些账目的可信赖性。

e.en: His calm manner gave an impression of {trustiness}.
e.zh: 他沉稳的举止给人一种可靠的印象。

e.en: She told me all her {tsuris} over coffee.
e.zh: 她喝咖啡时把自己的烦心事都告诉了我。

e.en: The family had enough {tsuris} without another argument.
e.zh: 这家人麻烦已经够多了，经不起再吵一架。

e.en: A {tu-whit} sounded from the dark trees.
e.zh: 黑暗的树林里传来一声猫头鹰的叫声。

e.en: The poem echoes with {tu-whit} and tu-whoo.
e.zh: 这首诗里回荡着“tu-whit”和“tu-whoo”的鸟叫声。

e.en: We heard a lonely {tu-whoo} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，我们听见一声孤零零的猫头鹰叫。

e.en: Children imitated the owl's {tu-whoo} in the play.
e.zh: 孩子们在剧中模仿猫头鹰“呜呜”的叫声。

e.en: The spray contained {tuaminoheptane} as a decongestant.
e.zh: 这种喷剂含有作为减充血剂的图阿氨庚烷。

e.en: Athletes should check whether {tuaminoheptane} is banned.
e.zh: 运动员应核查图阿氨庚烷是否属于禁用成分。

e.en: A tall {tuart} shaded the sandy track.
e.zh: 一棵高大的图阿特桉遮住了沙地小路。

e.en: The old {tuart} forest survived near the coast.
e.zh: 那片古老的图阿特桉林在海岸附近保存了下来。

e.en: The {tuatara} looks like a lizard but is not one.
e.zh: 喙头蜥看起来像蜥蜴，但并不属于蜥蜴。

e.en: New Zealand protects the rare {tuatara} carefully.
e.zh: 新西兰对稀有的喙头蜥进行严格保护。

e.en: The college {tub-eight} trained before sunrise.
e.zh: 学院的八桨赛艇队在日出前训练。

e.en: He joined the {tub-eight} despite little rowing experience.
e.zh: 尽管划船经验不多，他还是加入了八桨赛艇队。

e.en: He called himself a {tub-of-guts} after the holiday meals.
e.zh: 假期大吃之后，他自嘲自己成了个大肚胖子。

e.en: Don't call anyone a {tub-of-guts}; it's cruel.
e.zh: 别叫别人“大肚胖子”，那很刻薄。

e.en: The {tub-pair} moved slowly through the mist.
e.zh: 那支双人赛艇队在雾中缓缓前行。

e.en: She coached a beginner {tub-pair} on the river.
e.zh: 她在河上指导一组初学者双人赛艇队。

tub-thumper.t: 激烈鼓吹者；煽动演说者

e.en: The candidate sounded like a {tub-thumper} at the rally.
e.zh: 那位候选人在集会上听起来像个激烈鼓动者。

e.en: He dismissed the preacher as a noisy {tub-thumper}.
e.zh: 他把那位传教士斥为吵闹的煽动演说者。

e.en: The speech was full of patriotic {tub-thumping}.
e.zh: 这场演讲充满了爱国主义的激烈鼓吹。

e.en: Voters tired of the minister's {tub-thumping} tone.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了那位部长慷慨激昂的煽动腔调。

e.en: The specimen had a narrow {tubate} structure.
e.zh: 这个标本有一个狭窄的管状结构。

e.en: Botanists described the flower as {tubate} near the base.
e.zh: 植物学家描述这种花在基部呈管状。

e.en: The label says the curtains are {tubbable}.
e.zh: 标签上写着这些窗帘可以放进盆里洗。

e.en: Choose a {tubbable} rug for the children's room.
e.zh: 儿童房最好选一块可以水洗的小地毯。

e.en: The old {tubber} repaired barrels by hand.
e.zh: 那位老木桶匠手工修理木桶。

e.en: A careful {tubber} packed the plants for sale.
e.zh: 一个细心的装盆工把植物装好准备出售。

e.en: The {tubbiest} puppy slept beside the bowl.
e.zh: 最胖乎乎的小狗睡在碗旁边。

e.en: She picked the {tubbiest} vase on the shelf.
e.zh: 她选了架子上最矮胖的那个花瓶。

e.en: The old tale follows a young {tsarevitch} through the forest.
e.zh: 这个古老故事讲述一位年轻沙皇之子穿过森林的经历。

e.en: Courtiers bowed when the {tsarevitch} entered the hall.
e.zh: 沙皇皇太子走进大厅时，朝臣们都低头行礼。

e.en: The {tsarevna} waited in the tower for news.
e.zh: 沙皇的公主在塔楼里等待消息。

e.en: A brave {tsarevna} appears in many Russian folktales.
e.zh: 许多俄罗斯民间故事里都有勇敢的沙皇公主。

e.en: The revolution ended centuries of {tsarism}.
e.zh: 这场革命结束了数百年的沙皇制度。

e.en: Critics used {tsarism} as a symbol of harsh autocracy.
e.zh: 批评者把沙皇制度当作严酷专制的象征。

e.en: The sample contained green {tschermakite} crystals.
e.zh: 这个样本含有绿色的钙角闪石晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {tschermakite} in the metamorphic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在变质岩中鉴定出了钙角闪石。

e.en: My grandmother served {tsimmes} with carrots and honey.
e.zh: 我祖母端上了用胡萝卜和蜂蜜做的甜炖菜。

e.en: Don't make a {tsimmes} over one missing button.
e.zh: 别为少了一颗纽扣就大惊小怪。

e.en: She studied {Tsimshian} stories from the northern coast.
e.zh: 她研究北部海岸的钦西安人故事。

e.en: The museum displayed a {Tsimshian} ceremonial mask.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件钦西安人的仪式面具。

e.en: They drank {tsipouro} after the seafood dinner.
e.zh: 吃完海鲜晚餐后，他们喝了希腊葡萄渣烈酒。

e.en: A small glass of {tsipouro} warmed the cold evening.
e.zh: 一小杯希腊葡萄渣烈酒让寒冷的夜晚暖和起来。

e.en: She gave a sharp {tsk} when he spilled the tea.
e.zh: 他把茶洒了，她立刻啧了一声。

e.en: The teacher's quiet {tsk} made everyone look up.
e.zh: 老师轻轻的啧声让大家都抬起头来。

e.en: Grandma would {tsk-tsk} at such careless manners.
e.zh: 奶奶看到这种粗心的举止会啧啧责备。

e.en: The editor gave a soft {tsk-tsk} over the typo.
e.zh: 编辑看到那个错字，轻轻啧啧了一声。

e.en: He {tsked} when the report arrived late.
e.zh: 报告迟到时，他不满地啧了一声。

e.en: The nurse {tsked} softly at the messy bandage.
e.zh: 护士看到凌乱的绷带，轻轻啧了一声。

e.en: Her only reply was a dry {tsktsk}.
e.zh: 她唯一的回应是一声冷淡的啧啧。

e.en: I heard a {tsktsk} from the back row.
e.zh: 我听见后排传来一阵啧啧的责备声。

e.en: He learned {Tsonga} from neighbors in Mozambique.
e.zh: 他从莫桑比克的邻居那里学了聪加语。

e.en: The festival featured {Tsonga} music and dance.
e.zh: 这个节日展示了聪加人的音乐和舞蹈。

e.en: After months of {tsoris}, the family finally relaxed.
e.zh: 经历几个月的烦心事后，这家人终于放松下来。

e.en: Why bring more {tsoris} into an already hard week?
e.zh: 这一周已经够难了，为什么还要添更多麻烦？

e.en: The old man feared the {tsotsi} near the station.
e.zh: 老人害怕车站附近那个南非小混混。

e.en: In the novel, a young {tsotsi} struggles with guilt.
e.zh: 小说里，一个年轻流氓在内疚中挣扎。

e.en: She had enough {tsouris} without another bill.
e.zh: 不再多一张账单，她的烦心事已经够多了。

e.en: His wedding plans brought unexpected {tsouris}.
e.zh: 他的婚礼计划带来了意想不到的麻烦。

e.en: The kimono was made from soft {tsumugi}.
e.zh: 这件和服是用柔软的日本手纺丝绸做成的。

e.en: Collectors value old {tsumugi} for its subtle texture.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视旧的日本手纺丝绸，因为它纹理细腻。

e.en: The scandal produced a {tsunamic} wave of anger.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻激起了海啸般的愤怒浪潮。

e.en: Scientists studied the {tsunamic} deposits along the coast.
e.zh: 科学家研究了海岸沿线的海啸沉积物。

trustless.t: 不依赖信任的；无人信任的

e.en: Bitcoin is often described as a {trustless} payment system.
e.zh: 比特币常被描述为一种不依赖信任的支付系统。

e.en: After the scandal, the committee became {trustless} and divided.
e.zh: 丑闻过后，委员会变得互不信任并且分裂。

e.en: The {trustor} transferred property into the family trust.
e.zh: 信托委托人把财产转入了家族信托。

e.en: A careful {trustor} still checks the agent's record.
e.zh: 谨慎的信任者仍会核查代理人的记录。

e.en: The witness spoke {trustworthily} about what she had seen.
e.zh: 证人可信地讲述了她所看到的情况。

e.en: Data must be stored {trustworthily} for the audit.
e.zh: 为了审计，数据必须以可靠方式保存。

e.en: Philosophers debate whether {truth-predicates} apply to moral claims.
e.zh: 哲学家争论真理谓词是否适用于道德主张。

e.en: The paper defines several {truth-predicates} for formal languages.
e.zh: 这篇论文为形式语言定义了几个真值谓词。

e.en: The report was a {truthless} attack on her character.
e.zh: 那份报告是对她人格的虚假攻击。

e.en: He lived in a {truthless} world of rumors and flattery.
e.zh: 他生活在一个充满谣言和奉承的不真实世界里。

e.en: The witness answered {truthlessly} under pressure.
e.zh: 证人在压力下作了不真实的回答。

e.en: The advertisement {truthlessly} promised instant results.
e.zh: 广告虚假地承诺会立刻见效。

e.en: The judge noted the {truthlessness} of the statement.
e.zh: 法官指出了这份陈述的虚假性。

e.en: Her novel explores the {truthlessness} of public myths.
e.zh: 她的小说探讨了公共神话的不真实性。

e.en: The chemist isolated {truxilline} from the coca extract.
e.zh: 化学家从古柯提取物中分离出托昔林。

e.en: Older pharmacology texts mention {truxilline} only briefly.
e.zh: 较早的药理学文献只简略提到托昔林。

e.en: The shop offers a virtual {try-on} for glasses.
e.zh: 这家店提供眼镜的虚拟试戴服务。

e.en: Her quick {try-on} showed the dress was too long.
e.zh: 她快速试穿后发现这条裙子太长了。

e.en: We will {try-out} the new software next week.
e.zh: 我们下周会试用这款新软件。

e.en: He attended a basketball {try-out} after school.
e.zh: 放学后他参加了一场篮球选拔赛。

e.en: The theater held {try-outs} for the spring musical.
e.zh: 剧院为春季音乐剧举行了演员选拔。

e.en: Several product {try-outs} helped the team find bugs.
e.zh: 几次产品试用帮助团队发现了漏洞。

e.en: The assayer heated the sample in a {try-pot}.
e.zh: 化验员把样品放在试金杯里加热。

e.en: An old {try-pot} sat beside the furnace.
e.zh: 一个旧试验坩埚放在炉子旁边。

e.en: I'm {tryin} to call you, but the line is busy.
e.zh: 我正想给你打电话，可线路一直占线。

e.en: He kept {tryin} even after everyone else quit.
e.zh: 即使其他人都放弃了，他还一直在努力。

e.en: The carpenter checked the board with a {tryingplane}.
e.zh: 木匠用试平面刨检查木板。

e.en: A sharp {tryingplane} can reveal uneven grain.
e.zh: 锋利的检验平面刨能显出不平的木纹。

tryma.t: 核果状果实；胡桃类果实

e.en: Botanists classify the walnut as a {tryma}.
e.zh: 植物学家把核桃归为核果状果实。

e.en: The lecture compared a drupe with a {tryma}.
e.zh: 讲座把普通核果和胡桃类果实作了比较。

e.en: The lab used {trypaflavine} as an antiseptic dye.
e.zh: 实验室把锥虫黄素用作消毒染料。

e.en: Early doctors tested {trypaflavine} against parasitic infections.
e.zh: 早期医生曾测试锥虫黄素治疗寄生虫感染的效果。

e.en: The cells were stained with {trypanblau} before counting.
e.zh: 计数前，细胞用台盼蓝染料染色。

e.en: Researchers used {trypanblau} to identify dead cells.
e.zh: 研究人员用台盼蓝来识别死亡细胞。

e.en: The physician prescribed a {trypanid} for the infection.
e.zh: 医生为这种感染开了一种抗锥虫药。

e.en: The article reviewed older {trypanid} compounds.
e.zh: 这篇文章回顾了较早的抗锥虫化合物。

e.en: The new compound showed strong {trypanocidal} activity.
e.zh: 这种新化合物表现出很强的杀锥虫活性。

e.en: Doctors selected a {trypanocidal} drug for the patient.
e.zh: 医生为患者选择了一种杀锥虫药物。

e.en: Several {trypanocides} are used in veterinary medicine.
e.zh: 兽医领域使用几种杀锥虫药物。

e.en: Resistance to older {trypanocides} has become a concern.
e.zh: 对旧型杀锥虫药的耐药性已成为一个问题。

e.en: A {trypanosome} can be carried by the tsetse fly.
e.zh: 锥虫可由采采蝇携带传播。

e.en: The microscope revealed a moving {trypanosome} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示血样中有一条活动的锥虫。

e.en: African {trypanosomiasis} is spread by tsetse flies.
e.zh: 非洲锥虫病由采采蝇传播。

e.en: Untreated {trypanosomiasis} can damage the nervous system.
e.zh: 未经治疗的锥虫病可能损害神经系统。

e.en: The study examined how {trypanotoxin} affects red blood cells.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了锥虫毒素如何影响红细胞。

e.en: Researchers purified {trypanotoxin} from infected samples.
e.zh: 研究人员从受感染样本中纯化出锥虫毒素。

trypanthrin.t: 色胺蒽醌；靛玉红相关生物碱

e.en: The plant extract contained measurable {trypanthrin}.
e.zh: 这种植物提取物中含有可测量的色胺蒽醌。

e.en: Scientists studied {trypanthrin} for its anti-inflammatory effects.
e.zh: 科学家研究色胺蒽醌的抗炎作用。

tryparsamide.t: 锥虫病药曲帕沙胺硫胂

e.en: Doctors once used {tryparsamide} to treat sleeping sickness.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用曲帕沙胺治疗昏睡病。

e.en: The old report described resistance to {tryparsamide}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告描述了对曲帕沙胺的耐药性。

e.en: The pharmacist checked the dose of {tryparsone}.
e.zh: 药剂师核对了曲帕松的剂量。

e.en: Older texts list {tryparsone} among arsenical drugs.
e.zh: 旧教材把曲帕松列为含砷药物之一。

e.en: The blood smear showed a {trypomastigote} under the microscope.
e.zh: 血涂片在显微镜下显示出一个锥鞭毛体。

e.en: A {trypomastigote} can infect host cells during the parasite cycle.
e.zh: 锥鞭毛体可在寄生虫生活周期中感染宿主细胞。

e.en: The lab measured {trypsase} activity in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了样本中的胰蛋白酶样酶活性。

e.en: Some papers use {trypsase} for a trypsin-like enzyme.
e.zh: 有些论文用trypsase指一种胰蛋白酶样酶。

e.en: The cells detached after brief {trypsinization}.
e.zh: 细胞经过短暂胰蛋白酶消化后脱落。

e.en: Excessive {trypsinization} can damage surface proteins.
e.zh: 过度胰蛋白酶处理会损伤表面蛋白。

e.en: Researchers {trypsinize} the culture before counting the cells.
e.zh: 研究人员在计数细胞前用胰蛋白酶处理培养物。

e.en: Do not {trypsinize} the tissue for too long.
e.zh: 不要对这块组织进行过久的胰蛋白酶消化。

e.en: The pancreas secretes {trypsinogen} into the small intestine.
e.zh: 胰腺把胰蛋白酶原分泌到小肠中。

e.en: Premature activation of {trypsinogen} may injure pancreatic tissue.
e.zh: 胰蛋白酶原过早激活可能损伤胰腺组织。

e.en: The molecule {tryptamine} occurs in some plants.
e.zh: 色胺这种分子存在于一些植物中。

e.en: Several drugs are built around a {tryptamine} structure.
e.zh: 有几种药物以色胺结构为基础。

tryptathionine.t: 色氨酸衍生含硫化合物

e.en: The study identified {tryptathionine} in the fungal extract.
e.zh: 这项研究在真菌提取物中鉴定出色氨酸衍生含硫化合物。

e.en: Chemists debated the structure of {tryptathionine}.
e.zh: 化学家们讨论了tryptathionine的结构。

e.en: The archive mentioned {tryptazine} in an old pharmacology note.
e.zh: 档案中的一则旧药理笔记提到了色氨嗪类化合物。

e.en: Few modern clinicians recognize the name {tryptazine}.
e.zh: 如今很少有临床医生认识tryptazine这个名称。

e.en: Analysts isolated {trypterygine} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 分析人员从植物提取物中分离出雷公藤碱类成分。

e.en: The paper compared {trypterygine} with related alkaloids.
e.zh: 论文把trypterygine与相关生物碱作了比较。

e.en: The protein was cut into {tryptic} peptides.
e.zh: 这种蛋白被切成了胰蛋白酶肽段。

e.en: A {tryptic} digest helped identify the unknown sample.
e.zh: 一次胰蛋白酶消化帮助鉴定了未知样本。

e.en: The bacteria grew well in broth containing {tryptone}.
e.zh: 细菌在含胰蛋白胨的肉汤中生长良好。

e.en: Add {tryptone} before sterilizing the culture medium.
e.zh: 在灭菌培养基前加入胰蛋白胨。

e.en: Some bacteria produce {tryptophanase} during metabolism.
e.zh: 有些细菌在代谢过程中产生色氨酸酶。

e.en: The test detects {tryptophanase} by measuring indole formation.
e.zh: 该测试通过测量吲哚生成来检测色氨酸酶。

e.en: The old label spelled the amino acid as {tryptophane}.
e.zh: 旧标签把这种氨基酸拼作tryptophane。

e.en: Early nutrition papers often used {tryptophane} instead of tryptophan.
e.zh: 早期营养学论文常用tryptophane而不是tryptophan。

e.en: The medium contained {tryptose} and yeast extract.
e.zh: 这种培养基含有胰蛋白胨类营养物和酵母提取物。

e.en: Manufacturers sell {tryptose} for microbiology work.
e.zh: 厂家销售供微生物实验使用的tryptose。

e.en: The crew set a {trysail} during the storm.
e.zh: 船员在暴风雨中升起了斜桁小帆。

e.en: A {trysail} is useful when the mainsail is too large.
e.zh: 主帆太大时，斜桁小帆很有用。

e.en: The old whaler still had its {tryworks} on deck.
e.zh: 那艘旧捕鲸船甲板上仍有熬油设备。

e.en: Smoke from the {tryworks} stained the ship's rigging.
e.zh: 熬油设备冒出的烟熏黑了船上的索具。

e.en: The teacher wrote {tsade} on the board.
e.zh: 老师把希伯来字母察德写在黑板上。

e.en: In Hebrew, {tsade} has a distinctive final form.
e.zh: 在希伯来语中，察德有独特的词尾形式。

e.en: The alphabet chart placed {tsadi} near the end.
e.zh: 字母表把察德放在接近末尾的位置。

e.en: Students practiced writing {tsadi} in block script.
e.zh: 学生练习用方体字书写希伯来字母察德。

e.en: The travelers ate {tsamba} with butter tea.
e.zh: 旅人们把糌粑配酥油茶一起吃。

e.en: In Tibet, {tsamba} is a common staple food.
e.zh: 在西藏，糌粑是一种常见主食。

e.en: The novel is set during the Russian {tsardom}.
e.zh: 这部小说以俄国沙皇统治时期为背景。

e.en: Historians debate how the {tsardom} shaped later politics.
e.zh: 历史学家争论沙皇国如何塑造了后来的政治。

e.en: The scan showed a small {tuberculoma} in the brain.
e.zh: 扫描显示脑部有一个小结核瘤。

e.en: Doctors treated the {tuberculoma} with long-term antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生用长期抗生素治疗这个结核瘤。

e.en: The infected tissue began to {tuberculose} slowly.
e.zh: 受感染的组织开始慢慢结核化。

e.en: Old records said the cattle might {tuberculose} after exposure.
e.zh: 旧记录称牛接触病源后可能患上结核病。

e.en: The doctor chose a {tuberculostatic} drug for the patient.
e.zh: 医生为病人选择了一种抑制结核菌的药物。

e.en: Researchers measured the compound's {tuberculostatic} effect in culture.
e.zh: 研究人员在培养物中测量了该化合物的抑结核作用。

e.en: Early clinics sometimes tried {tuberculotherapy} for chronic cases.
e.zh: 早期诊所有时会对慢性病例尝试结核菌素疗法。

e.en: The textbook mentions {tuberculotherapy} as a historical treatment.
e.zh: 这本教材把结核菌素疗法列为一种历史疗法。

e.en: The anatomist pointed to the {tuberculum} on the bone.
e.zh: 解剖学家指着骨头上的小隆起。

e.en: A tiny {tuberculum} marked the surface of the shell.
e.zh: 贝壳表面有一个细小的结节。

e.en: The farmer selected a {tuberiferous} plant for propagation.
e.zh: 农民挑选了一株生有块茎的植物来繁殖。

e.en: Botanists noted its {tuberiferous} roots during the survey.
e.zh: 植物学家在调查中注意到它长有块茎状根。

e.en: The fungus produced a {tuberiform} mass underground.
e.zh: 这种真菌在地下形成了块茎状团块。

e.en: She sketched the {tuberiform} swelling at the root base.
e.zh: 她画下了根部基部的块茎状膨大。

e.en: Short days can encourage {tuberization} in potatoes.
e.zh: 短日照会促进马铃薯形成块茎。

e.en: The study tracked {tuberization} under different temperatures.
e.zh: 这项研究追踪了不同温度下的块茎形成过程。

e.en: The plant developed a {tuberoid} swelling near the stem.
e.zh: 这株植物在茎附近长出一个似块茎的膨大部。

e.en: A {tuberoid} body was visible in the soil sample.
e.zh: 土壤样本中可以看到一个似块茎的结构。

e.en: Dahlias are {tuberous-rooted} plants that store food underground.
e.zh: 大丽花是具块根的植物，会在地下储存养分。

e.en: The gardener divided the {tuberous-rooted} clump in spring.
e.zh: 园丁在春天分开了这丛具块根的植物。

e.en: A red-plumed {tubeworm} lived near the hot vent.
e.zh: 一只有红色羽状冠的管虫生活在热泉口附近。

e.en: The diver photographed a {tubeworm} on the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石上拍到了一只管虫。

e.en: Giant {tubeworms} thrive around deep-sea vents.
e.zh: 巨型管虫在深海热泉周围繁盛生长。

e.en: The reef was covered with tiny {tubeworms}.
e.zh: 礁石上覆盖着细小的管虫。

e.en: She washed a {tubful} of muddy clothes.
e.zh: 她洗了一整桶沾满泥的衣服。

e.en: The child splashed in a {tubful} of warm water.
e.zh: 孩子在一浴缸温水里扑腾。

e.en: They carried {tubfuls} of water to the garden.
e.zh: 他们把一桶桶水搬到花园里。

e.en: The laundry room processed {tubfuls} of sheets each morning.
e.zh: 洗衣房每天早上处理好几桶床单。

e.en: The biologist studied a {tubicolous} worm from the shore.
e.zh: 生物学家研究了一种来自海岸的栖管蠕虫。

e.en: Some {tubicolous} animals build protective tubes from sand.
e.zh: 有些栖管动物会用沙粒建造保护性的管。

e.en: The old zoology book described a {tubicorn} antelope.
e.zh: 那本旧动物学书描述了一种管角羚羊。

e.en: A {tubicorn} skull was displayed in the museum case.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里陈列着一个管状角动物的头骨。

e.en: Aquarium fish often eat dried {tubifex} worms.
e.zh: 水族箱里的鱼常吃干燥的水丝蚓。

e.en: The muddy ditch contained many {tubifex}.
e.zh: 泥泞的沟渠里有许多颤蚓。

e.en: The flower has a narrow {tubiform} corolla.
e.zh: 这种花有狭长的管状花冠。

e.en: Engineers tested a {tubiform} metal frame.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一个管状金属框架。

e.en: The insect's {tubilingual} mouthpart helps it sip nectar.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的管状舌口器帮助它吸食花蜜。

e.en: A {tubilingual} structure is visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以看到一种管状舌结构。

e.en: The anesthetist administered {tubocurarine} during surgery.
e.zh: 麻醉师在手术中使用了筒箭毒碱。

e.en: Pharmacology students learned how {tubocurarine} blocks nerve signals.
e.zh: 药理学学生学习了筒箭毒碱如何阻断神经信号。

e.en: The device used a small {tuboid} chamber.
e.zh: 该装置使用了一个小型管状腔室。

e.en: A pale {tuboid} lay beside the specimen tray.
e.zh: 一个浅色管状物放在标本托盘旁。

tuboplasty.t: 输卵管整形术；管道成形术

e.en: She underwent {tuboplasty} to repair a blocked fallopian tube.
e.zh: 她接受了输卵管整形术来修复堵塞的输卵管。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {tuboplasty} as one possible treatment.
e.zh: 外科医生把管道成形术作为一种可能疗法来讨论。

e.en: The technician will {tubulate} the glass before sealing it.
e.zh: 技术员会先把玻璃制成管状再封口。

e.en: Some cells {tubulate} as the membrane begins to fold.
e.zh: 当膜开始折叠时，一些细胞会形成管状结构。

e.en: The chemist used a {tubulated} retort for the experiment.
e.zh: 化学家在实验中使用了带管的曲颈甑。

e.en: A {tubulated} surface appeared after the membrane changed shape.
e.zh: 膜形状改变后出现了管状表面。

e.en: Membrane {tubulation} increased after the protein was added.
e.zh: 加入蛋白质后，膜的管状形成增加了。

e.en: The lab checked the glassware's {tubulation} before use.
e.zh: 实验室在使用前检查了玻璃器皿的装管情况。

tubuliflorous.t: 具管状花的植物学特征

e.en: The botanist described the daisy as {tubuliflorous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这株雏菊描述为具管状花。

e.en: Several {tubuliflorous} species grew near the path.
e.zh: 小路旁生长着几种具管状花的植物。

e.en: Cells use {tubulin} to build microtubules.
e.zh: 细胞利用微管蛋白来构建微管。

e.en: The drug blocks {tubulin} during cell division.
e.zh: 这种药物会在细胞分裂时阻断微管蛋白。

e.en: The fossil had a {tubulose} inner structure.
e.zh: 这块化石内部有管状结构。

e.en: A {tubulose} organ can carry fluid through the body.
e.zh: 管状器官可以在体内输送液体。

e.en: The sponge showed a {tubulous} pattern under magnification.
e.zh: 海绵在放大后呈现出管状纹理。

e.en: Its {tubulous} roots helped absorb water quickly.
e.zh: 它的管状根有助于快速吸收水分。

e.en: The chemist sealed the glass {tubulure} carefully.
e.zh: 化学师小心地封住了玻璃管口。

e.en: Gas escaped through a narrow {tubulure} in the vessel.
e.zh: 气体从容器上一根狭窄的小管逸出。

e.en: The old travel book spelled toucan as {tucan}.
e.zh: 那本旧旅行书把巨嘴鸟拼作tucan。

e.en: A bright {tucan} appeared in the margin illustration.
e.zh: 页边插图里画着一只鲜艳的巨嘴鸟。

e.en: The children enjoyed a hot {tuck-in} after the game.
e.zh: 孩子们赛后享用了一顿热乎乎的丰盛饭食。

e.en: Everyone expected a proper {tuck-in} at the school party.
