e.en: The extract contained a small amount of {taraxasterol}.
e.zh: 提取物中含有少量蒲公英甾醇。

e.en: Scientists studied {taraxasterol} for its biological activity.
e.zh: 科学家研究蒲公英甾醇的生物活性。

e.en: The bitter taste came partly from {taraxin}.
e.zh: 这种苦味部分来自蒲公英苦味成分。

e.en: Older pharmacology books mention {taraxin} in dandelion roots.
e.zh: 较早的药理书提到蒲公英根中的taraxin成分。

e.en: The shed was patched with a black {tarboard}.
e.zh: 棚屋用一块黑色涂焦油木板补上了。

e.en: Rain slid off the rough {tarboard} roof.
e.zh: 雨水顺着粗糙的涂焦油木板屋顶滑落。

e.en: He wore a red {tarboosh} at the ceremony.
e.zh: 他在仪式上戴着一顶红色土耳其毡帽。

e.en: The portrait shows a merchant in a {tarboosh}.
e.zh: 画像中是一位戴着红毡帽的商人。

e.en: The shop window displayed several red {tarbooshes}.
e.zh: 商店橱窗里陈列着几顶红色土耳其毡帽。

e.en: Old photographs show officials wearing {tarbooshes}.
e.zh: 老照片显示官员们戴着土耳其毡帽。

e.en: The sailor cleaned the sticky {tarbrush} after work.
e.zh: 水手干完活后清洗了那把黏糊糊的涂焦油刷。

e.en: A {tarbrush} hung beside the barrel of pitch.
e.zh: 一把涂焦油用的刷子挂在沥青桶旁边。

e.en: The insult {tard} is offensive and should be avoided.
e.zh: tard这个辱骂词带有冒犯性，应该避免使用。

e.en: He apologized for using {tard} in anger.
e.zh: 他为自己生气时用了tard这个冒犯词而道歉。

e.en: This year's spring was {tardier} than usual.
e.zh: 今年的春天来得比往常更迟。

e.en: His replies grew {tardier} as the project dragged on.
e.zh: 随着项目拖延，他的回复变得更慢了。

e.en: She wore a white {tank-top} to the gym.
e.zh: 她穿着白色背心去健身房。

e.en: A cotton {tank-top} is comfortable in summer.
e.zh: 棉质无袖上衣在夏天很舒服。

e.en: The refinery increased its oil {tankage} last year.
e.zh: 炼油厂去年增加了石油储罐容量。

e.en: The port charged extra {tankage} for the chemicals.
e.zh: 港口对这些化学品收取了额外储存费。

tankbuster.t: 反坦克武器；反坦克飞机

e.en: The old aircraft was designed as a {tankbuster}.
e.zh: 这架旧飞机原本是按反坦克飞机设计的。

e.en: Soldiers carried a portable {tankbuster} into the field.
e.zh: 士兵把一件便携式反坦克武器带上了战场。

e.en: The {tankerman} checked the hoses before unloading fuel.
e.zh: 油轮船员在卸燃料前检查了软管。

e.en: A licensed {tankerman} supervised the transfer of chemicals.
e.zh: 一名持证油罐船工监督了化学品转运。

e.en: The museum displayed a tiny wartime {tankette}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一辆战时小型坦克。

e.en: A {tankette} could move quickly but carried little armor.
e.zh: 超轻坦克行动很快，但装甲很薄。

e.en: The {tankman} climbed out after the exercise.
e.zh: 演习结束后，坦克兵爬了出来。

e.en: A {tankman} delivered fuel to the remote station.
e.zh: 一名油罐车工人把燃料送到偏远站点。

tankoscope.t: 油罐检查镜；罐内观测器

e.en: The engineer used a {tankoscope} to inspect the vessel.
e.zh: 工程师用油罐检查镜查看容器内部。

e.en: A damaged {tankoscope} made the tank inspection difficult.
e.zh: 罐内观测器损坏后，检查油罐变得很困难。

e.en: The {tankship} anchored outside the harbor overnight.
e.zh: 那艘油轮夜里停泊在港口外。

e.en: A modern {tankship} can carry several kinds of liquid cargo.
e.zh: 现代液货船可以运输好几种液体货物。

e.en: The village built a new {tankstand} for clean water.
e.zh: 村里为清洁用水建了新的水箱支架。

e.en: Rust weakened the metal {tankstand} behind the factory.
e.zh: 锈蚀削弱了工厂后面的金属储罐架。

e.en: He packed a {tanktop} for the beach.
e.zh: 他为去海滩带了一件背心。

e.en: That black {tanktop} goes well with jeans.
e.zh: 那件黑色无袖上衣很配牛仔裤。

e.en: The hides were still {tannable} after careful drying.
e.zh: 这些兽皮经过仔细干燥后仍可鞣制成革。

e.en: Not every animal skin is equally {tannable}.
e.zh: 并不是每种动物皮都同样适合鞣制。

e.en: The quality of {tannage} affects the leather's strength.
e.zh: 鞣革过程的质量会影响皮革强度。

e.en: The invoice included {tannage} and transport costs.
e.zh: 发票里包括鞣制费和运输费用。

tannaim.t: 坦拿学者；犹太律法教师

e.en: The {tannaim} helped shape early rabbinic teaching.
e.zh: 坦拿学者帮助形成了早期拉比教义。

e.en: Her research compares sayings of different {tannaim}.
e.zh: 她的研究比较了不同犹太律法教师的言论。

e.en: The fungus produces {tannase} during fermentation.
e.zh: 这种真菌在发酵过程中产生单宁酶。

e.en: Researchers added {tannase} to reduce bitterness in tea.
e.zh: 研究人员加入鞣酸酶来降低茶的苦味。

e.en: The medicine contains an iron {tannate} compound.
e.zh: 这种药含有一种铁鞣酸盐化合物。

e.en: A dark {tannate} formed in the solution.
e.zh: 溶液中形成了一种深色单宁酸盐。

e.en: He was the {tannest} person on the beach.
e.zh: 他是海滩上晒得最黑的人。

e.en: The {tannest} leather was used for the saddle.
e.zh: 颜色最棕褐的皮革被用来做马鞍。

e.en: My {tannie} sent sweets from Cape Town.
e.zh: 我的阿姨从开普敦寄来了糖果。

e.en: The children called the neighbor {tannie} out of respect.
e.zh: 孩子们出于尊敬称那位邻居为阿姨。

e.en: Her arms looked {tannier} after the holiday.
e.zh: 假期过后，她的胳膊看起来晒得更黑了。

e.en: Choose the {tannier} shade for the leather repair.
e.zh: 修补皮革时选更棕褐的那种色调。

e.en: Oak bark is a {tanniferous} material used in tanning.
e.zh: 橡树皮是鞣革中使用的含单宁材料。

e.en: The wine had a strong {tanniferous} character.
e.zh: 这款酒有明显富含鞣质的口感。

e.en: The wall was painted a {tannish} gray.
e.zh: 墙被刷成了略带棕褐色的灰色。

e.en: She chose a {tannish} fabric for the curtains.
e.zh: 她为窗帘选了略带棕褐色的布料。

e.en: Doctors warned that {tanorexia} can damage the skin.
e.zh: 医生警告说，晒黑成瘾会损害皮肤。

e.en: Her article described {tanorexia} among young adults.
e.zh: 她的文章描述了年轻人中的美黑强迫症。

tardiest.t: 最迟的；最拖拉的；最晚到的

e.en: He was the {tardiest} student in the class.
e.zh: 他是班里最常迟到的学生。

e.en: The {tardiest} reply arrived after midnight.
e.zh: 最晚的回复在午夜后才到。

e.en: A {tardigrade} can survive extreme dryness.
e.zh: 水熊虫能在极度干燥中存活。

e.en: The scientist photographed a {tardigrade} under the microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下拍下了一只水熊虫。

e.en: {Tardigrades} are famous for surviving harsh conditions.
e.zh: 水熊虫以能在恶劣环境中存活而闻名。

e.en: The pond sample contained several tiny {tardigrades}.
e.zh: 池塘样本里有几只微小的水熊虫。

e.en: The patient developed {tardive} symptoms after long treatment.
e.zh: 患者在长期治疗后出现了迟发性症状。

e.en: Doctors monitored him for signs of {tardive} dyskinesia.
e.zh: 医生监测他是否有迟发性运动障碍的迹象。

e.en: A {tardyon} travels slower than light.
e.zh: 慢子的运动速度低于光速。

e.en: The theory contrasts a {tardyon} with a hypothetical tachyon.
e.zh: 该理论把慢子与假想的超光速粒子作对比。

e.en: Medieval writers described {tarentism} as a dancing mania.
e.zh: 中世纪作者把塔兰台拉舞狂症描述为一种舞蹈狂热。

e.en: The lecture treated {tarentism} as a cultural phenomenon.
e.zh: 这场讲座把塔兰台拉舞狂症视为一种文化现象。

e.en: The warrior raised his {targe} against the blow.
e.zh: 战士举起小圆盾挡住那一击。

e.en: A leather {targe} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一面皮制小圆盾。

e.en: The caravan hired a {targeman} for the journey.
e.zh: 商队为这趟旅程雇了一名译员。

e.en: A skilled {targeman} explained the treaty aloud.
e.zh: 一名熟练的口译者当众解释了条约内容。

e.en: The shooter pinned a fresh {target-card} to the frame.
e.zh: 射手把一张新的靶卡钉在架子上。

e.en: Each sales team received a monthly {target-card}.
e.zh: 每个销售团队都收到了一张月度目标卡片。

e.en: The scholar compared several {targumim} in class.
e.zh: 那位学者在课上比较了几种塔古姆译本。

e.en: Ancient {targumim} helped readers understand Hebrew scripture.
e.zh: 古代塔古姆译本帮助读者理解希伯来经文。

e.en: The {targumist} rendered the verse into Aramaic.
e.zh: 这位塔古姆译者把诗句译成了阿拉姆语。

e.en: A modern {targumist} studies ancient interpretive traditions.
e.zh: 现代塔古姆研究者会研究古代释经传统。

e.en: The library owns rare {targums} of biblical books.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏有罕见的圣经书卷塔古姆译本。

e.en: These {targums} preserve old Aramaic interpretations.
e.zh: 这些塔古姆译本保存了古老的阿拉姆语解释。

e.en: They imagined a {tariffless} market across the region.
e.zh: 他们设想整个地区形成一个无关税市场。

e.en: The treaty promised {tariffless} trade in basic goods.
e.zh: 该条约承诺基础商品实行免关税贸易。

e.en: The costume was made from stiff {tarlatan}.
e.zh: 这套戏服是用挺括的塔拉坦薄纱做成的。

e.en: She covered the lantern with red {tarlatan}.
e.zh: 她用红色塔拉坦薄纱罩住灯笼。

e.en: That {tarnal} gate sticks every morning.
e.zh: 那扇讨厌的门每天早上都卡住。

e.en: He muttered about the {tarnal} weather all day.
e.zh: 他一整天都在嘟囔这该死的天气。

e.en: What in {tarnation} are you doing here?
e.zh: 你到底在这里干什么，见鬼？

e.en: He shouted {tarnation} when the wheel broke.
e.zh: 轮子坏掉时，他气得喊了一声该死。

taskwork.t: 按件计酬的工作；定额工作

e.en: The workshop paid women for {taskwork} rather than hours.
e.zh: 这家作坊按完成的任务给女工付钱，而不是按小时计酬。

e.en: Old factory records mention {taskwork} during the busy season.
e.zh: 旧工厂记录提到旺季时采用定额工作制。

e.en: She poured the cordial into a tiny {tasset}.
e.zh: 她把甜酒倒进一个小杯里。

e.en: The antique {tasset} had a painted rim.
e.zh: 那只古董小杯的杯沿上有彩绘。

e.en: The wool mill employed a {tassor} to prepare tangled fleece.
e.zh: 这家毛纺厂雇了一名工人来整理缠结的羊毛。

e.en: A skilled {tassor} could save damaged fibers.
e.zh: 熟练的整理工能挽救受损的纤维。

e.en: The salt was barely {tastable} in the soup.
e.zh: 汤里的盐味几乎尝不出来。

e.en: Only a faint bitterness was {tastable} after brewing.
e.zh: 冲泡之后只能尝出一点淡淡的苦味。

e.en: Each {taste-bud} responds to chemicals in food.
e.zh: 每个味蕾都会对食物中的化学物质作出反应。

e.en: A cold can dull your {taste-buds} for days.
e.zh: 感冒可能会让你的味蕾迟钝好几天。

e.en: We held a blind {taste-test} of three coffees.
e.zh: 我们对三种咖啡做了一次盲品测试。

e.en: The chef will {taste-test} the sauce before dinner.
e.zh: 厨师会在晚餐前试尝这道酱汁。

e.en: The herbs were clearly {tasteable} in the stew.
e.zh: 炖菜里能明显尝到香草的味道。

e.en: The medicine leaves a {tasteable} sweetness on the tongue.
e.zh: 这种药会在舌头上留下尝得出的甜味。

e.en: The vegetables were {tastily} seasoned with garlic.
e.zh: 这些蔬菜用大蒜调味，味道很好。

e.en: He ate the leftovers {tastily} despite their plain look.
e.zh: 虽然剩菜看起来普通，他还是吃得津津有味。

e.en: He waved and called {tata} from the gate.
e.zh: 他在门口挥手说了声拜拜。

e.en: The toddler said {tata} to everyone in the room.
e.zh: 那个幼儿对房间里的每个人都说再见。

e.en: The explorer saw a {tatou} near the riverbank.
e.zh: 探险者在河岸附近看见一只犰狳。

e.en: Early travelers described the {tatou} in their journals.
e.zh: 早期旅行者在日记中描述过这种南美犰狳。

e.en: A {tatouay} digs deep burrows in the forest.
e.zh: 大犰狳会在森林里挖很深的洞穴。

e.en: The museum displayed a {tatouay} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具巨犰狳骨架。

e.en: In Sanskrit grammar, a {tatpurusha} links two nouns closely.
e.zh: 在梵语语法中，依主释复合词把两个名词紧密连接起来。

e.en: The linguist classified the compound as a {tatpurusha}.
e.zh: 那位语言学家把这个复合词归为依主释。

tartarizing.t: 使形成酒石；涂酒石酸盐；变尖刻起来

e.en: The winemaker was {tartarizing} the young wine to stabilize it.
e.zh: 酿酒师正在给新酒作酒石处理以稳定品质。

e.en: Her remarks were {tartarizing} into open contempt.
e.zh: 她的话渐渐变得尖刻，流露出明显的轻蔑。

e.en: A {tartarous} crust formed inside the old wine cask.
e.zh: 旧酒桶内形成了一层酒石状硬壳。

e.en: The chemist noted a {tartarous} deposit in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家注意到样品中有酒石质沉淀。

e.en: This was the {tartest} apple in the basket.
e.zh: 这是篮子里最酸的苹果。

e.en: Her {tartest} reply silenced the whole room.
e.zh: 她最尖刻的一句回应让全屋都安静下来。

e.en: She answered {tartily} when he questioned her decision.
e.zh: 他质疑她的决定时，她尖刻地回了一句。

e.en: The critic wrote {tartily} about the film's ending.
e.zh: 评论家酸溜溜地评价了这部电影的结尾。

tartine.t: 法式开放三明治；涂酱面包片

e.en: She ordered a smoked salmon {tartine} for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐点了一份烟熏三文鱼开放三明治。

e.en: The cafe serves a simple {tartine} with butter and jam.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应抹黄油和果酱的简单面包片。

e.en: The berries tasted {tartish} but still pleasant.
e.zh: 这些浆果尝起来有点酸，但仍然可口。

e.en: He gave a {tartish} answer to the obvious question.
e.zh: 面对这个明摆着的问题，他给了个略带尖刻的回答。

e.en: Potassium {tartrate} can appear as crystals in wine.
e.zh: 酒石酸钾会以晶体形式出现在葡萄酒中。

e.en: The lab measured the {tartrate} content of the solution.
e.zh: 实验室测量了该溶液中的酒石酸盐含量。

tartrated.t: 含酒石酸盐的；经酒石酸处理的

e.en: The recipe called for {tartrated} soda in the mixture.
e.zh: 配方要求在混合物中加入含酒石酸盐的苏打。

e.en: The chemist stored the {tartrated} solution in a dark bottle.
e.zh: 化学家把经酒石酸处理的溶液存放在深色瓶中。

tartrazine.t: 柠檬黄；一种合成黄色食用色素

e.en: The label says the sweets contain {tartrazine}.
e.zh: 标签上写着这些糖果含有柠檬黄。

e.en: Some people avoid {tartrazine} because it may trigger allergies.
e.zh: 有些人避免摄入柠檬黄，因为它可能诱发过敏。

e.en: He exposed the preacher as a {tartufe}.
e.zh: 他揭露那位传道人其实是个伪善者。

e.en: The novel mocks every social {tartufe} in town.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了城里每个装模作样的伪君子。

e.en: The reformer proved to be a political {tartuffe}.
e.zh: 那位改革者原来是个政治上的伪君子。

e.en: She distrusted his saintly pose and called him a {tartuffe}.
e.zh: 她不信他那副圣人姿态，称他为道貌岸然的人。

e.en: The essay attacks the {tartuffeism} of public moralists.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击公共道德家的伪善作态。

e.en: His charity speeches had a smell of {tartuffeism}.
e.zh: 他的慈善演说带着一股假仁假义的味道。

tarweed.t: 焦油草；有黏性气味的野草

e.en: The roadside was dotted with yellow {tarweed}.
e.zh: 路边点缀着开黄花的焦油草。

e.en: After the heat, the {tarweed} gave off a strong resinous smell.
e.zh: 天气变热后，焦油草散发出浓重的树脂气味。

taser.t: 泰瑟电击枪；用电击枪击中

e.en: The officer carried a {taser} instead of a firearm.
e.zh: 那名警员携带的是泰瑟电击枪，而不是枪械。

e.en: Police warned they might {taser} the suspect if he attacked.
e.zh: 警方警告说，如果嫌疑人攻击，他们可能会用电击枪制服他。

e.en: He grew a thick {tash} over the winter.
e.zh: 他整个冬天留出了一撮浓密的小胡子。

e.en: That curly {tash} makes him look older.
e.zh: 那撮卷曲的胡子让他显得更老。

e.en: The patient showed marked {tasikinesia} after the medication changed.
e.zh: 换药后，患者表现出明显的坐立不安。

e.en: The report described {tasikinesia} as a distressing urge to move.
e.zh: 报告把运动性躁动描述为一种令人痛苦的活动冲动。

tasimeter.t: 微压计；微小膨胀测量仪

e.en: The old laboratory displayed Edison's {tasimeter}.
e.zh: 旧实验室展出了爱迪生的微压计。

e.en: A {tasimeter} can detect extremely small changes in expansion.
e.zh: 微小膨胀测量仪能检测极细微的膨胀变化。

task-based.t: 基于任务的；以任务为导向的

e.en: The course uses a {task-based} approach to language learning.
e.zh: 这门课程采用基于任务的语言学习方法。

e.en: Their team moved to {task-based} scheduling this month.
e.zh: 他们团队本月改用以任务为导向的排班方式。

taskmistress.t: 严厉的女监工；严苛的女负责人

e.en: The editor was a demanding {taskmistress} during deadline week.
e.zh: 截稿周里，那位编辑是个要求很严的女负责人。

e.en: History is a harsh {taskmistress} for careless leaders.
e.zh: 历史对粗心的领导者来说是一位严苛的女教师。

tarnishable.t: 会失去光泽的；会玷污的

e.en: The jeweler warned that the silver was {tarnishable}.
e.zh: 珠宝商提醒说这件银器会失去光泽。

e.en: A public reputation is easily {tarnishable} by scandal.
e.zh: 公众声誉很容易因丑闻而受损。

tarnishproof.t: 防失去光泽的；防污损的

e.en: The case has a {tarnishproof} lining for silver spoons.
e.zh: 这个盒子有防止银匙变色的内衬。

e.en: No policy can make a leader's image completely {tarnishproof}.
e.zh: 没有哪项政策能让领导人的形象完全不受玷污。

e.en: They played {taroc} after dinner in the old cafe.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们在老咖啡馆里玩塔罗纸牌。

e.en: The rules of {taroc} vary from one region to another.
e.zh: 塔罗纸牌游戏的规则因地区而异。

e.en: My grandfather taught us {tarok} on rainy evenings.
e.zh: 下雨的晚上，祖父教我们玩塔罗克牌。

e.en: A full game of {tarok} can last for hours.
e.zh: 一整局塔罗克纸牌可能会玩上几个小时。

e.en: The {tarpan} once roamed across parts of Europe.
e.zh: 欧洲野马曾在欧洲部分地区游荡。

e.en: Some breeders try to recreate the look of the {tarpan}.
e.zh: 一些育种者试图重现塔尔潘马的外貌。

e.en: His excuse sounded like a complete {tarradiddle}.
e.zh: 他的借口听起来完全是在胡扯。

e.en: Children sometimes invent a {tarradiddle} to avoid trouble.
e.zh: 孩子们有时会编个小谎来躲避麻烦。

e.en: The old wall was repaired with {tarras}.
e.zh: 那堵老墙是用火山灰水泥修补的。

e.en: Builders valued {tarras} because it hardened under water.
e.zh: 建筑工人看重凝灰砂浆，因为它能在水下硬化。

e.en: The captain tried to {tarre} the men to fight.
e.zh: 队长试图煽动那些人去战斗。

e.en: Old pamphlets would {tarre} readers against the king.
e.zh: 旧传单会怂恿读者反对国王。

e.en: Her long {tarriance} worried the servants.
e.zh: 她久久逗留不归让仆人们担心。

e.en: The poem describes a lover's sweet {tarriance} at the gate.
e.zh: 这首诗描写情人在门前甜蜜地徘徊逗留。

e.en: Every {tarrier} at the gate delayed the procession.
e.zh: 每个在门口逗留的人都拖慢了队伍。

e.en: He was a habitual {tarrier} in bookshops.
e.zh: 他是个总爱在书店里流连的人。

e.en: The chemist noted the {tarriness} of the residue.
e.zh: 化学家注意到残留物呈焦油般黏黑。

e.en: Rain brought out the {tarriness} of the old roof coating.
e.zh: 雨水显出了旧屋顶涂层的焦油黏性。

tarsectomy.t: 跗骨切除术；睑板切除术

e.en: The surgeon recommended a {tarsectomy} after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后，外科医生建议做跗骨切除术。

e.en: A limited {tarsectomy} corrected the eyelid deformity.
e.zh: 一次有限的睑板切除术矫正了眼睑畸形。

e.en: The cabinet door was decorated with {tarsia}.
e.zh: 柜门上装饰着精细的镶嵌工艺。

e.en: Italian churches often display beautiful {tarsia} panels.
e.zh: 意大利教堂常陈列美丽的木石镶嵌板。

e.en: The fossil preserved both {tarsometatarsi} almost intact.
e.zh: 这块化石几乎完整保存了两块跗跖骨。

e.en: Bird specialists compared the {tarsometatarsi} of several species.
e.zh: 鸟类专家比较了几个物种的跗跖骨。

e.en: A bird's {tarsometatarsus} helps support its foot.
e.zh: 鸟类的跗跖骨有助于支撑脚部。

e.en: The museum labeled the bone as a {tarsometatarsus}.
e.zh: 博物馆把这块骨头标注为跗跖骨。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {tarsoptosia} after examination.
e.zh: 检查后，患者被诊断为睑板下垂症。

e.en: Severe {tarsoptosia} can affect the position of the eyelid.
e.zh: 严重的睑板下垂症会影响眼睑位置。

e.en: The anatomist pointed to a tiny {tarsulus}.
e.zh: 解剖学家指着一块很小的跗骨。

e.en: A damaged {tarsulus} made the eyelid unstable.
e.zh: 受损的小睑板使眼睑变得不稳定。

tartarated.t: 酒石酸化的；含酒石酸盐的

e.en: The pharmacist prepared a {tartarated} solution.
e.zh: 药剂师配制了一种含酒石酸盐的溶液。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes mention {tartarated} antimony.
e.zh: 旧配方有时会提到酒石酸化的锑剂。

e.en: She ordered steak {tartare} with capers.
e.zh: 她点了配酸豆的鞑靼牛肉。

e.en: The fish was served with {tartare} sauce.
e.zh: 这道鱼配了塔塔酱一起上桌。

e.en: The bottle had a {tartareous} crust inside.
e.zh: 瓶子内壁有一层酒石状硬壳。

e.en: The dentist removed a {tartareous} deposit from the tooth.
e.zh: 牙医清除了牙齿上的牙石状沉积物。

e.en: Grapes naturally contain {tartaric} acid.
e.zh: 葡萄天然含有酒石酸。

e.en: The lab measured the {tartaric} content of the wine.
e.zh: 实验室测量了葡萄酒中的酒石酸含量。

tartarize.t: 使成酒石酸盐；使生牙石

e.en: The chemist tried to {tartarize} the compound.
e.zh: 化学家试图使这种化合物形成酒石酸盐。

e.en: Neglected teeth may {tartarize} over time.
e.zh: 长期不护理的牙齿可能会逐渐形成牙石。

e.en: A {tatterdemalion} beggar slept beside the station.
e.zh: 一个衣衫褴褛的乞丐睡在车站旁。

e.en: The old coat made him look {tatterdemalion}.
e.zh: 那件旧外套让他显得破破烂烂。

e.en: She served mince with boiled {tatties}.
e.zh: 她端上肉末配煮土豆。

e.en: The farmer lifted each {tattie} from the dark soil.
e.zh: 农夫从黑土里挖出一个个马铃薯。

e.en: She chose the {tattiest} chair in the room.
e.zh: 她选了房间里最破旧的那把椅子。

e.en: It was the {tattiest} cafe on the street.
e.zh: 那是这条街上最寒酸的咖啡馆。

e.en: The room was {tattily} furnished with mismatched chairs.
e.zh: 房间里摆着不配套的椅子，陈设很寒酸。

e.en: He dressed {tattily} but spoke with confidence.
e.zh: 他穿得破旧，却说话很有自信。

e.en: The lobby's {tattiness} surprised the guests.
e.zh: 大堂的破旧让客人们很意外。

e.en: A little {tattiness} gave the pub character.
e.zh: 一点寒酸反而让这家酒吧有了味道。

e.en: The village adopted {taungya} to restore the hillside.
e.zh: 村里采用农林间作造林法来修复山坡。

e.en: Under {taungya}, farmers grow crops between young trees.
e.zh: 在农林间作造林法下，农民在幼树之间种庄稼。

e.en: A {tauon} is heavier than an electron.
e.zh: 陶子比电子重。

e.en: The detector recorded a possible {tauon} decay.
e.zh: 探测器记录到一次可能的τ轻子衰变。

e.en: The temple entrance had a {tauriform} guardian statue.
e.zh: 神庙入口有一尊牛形守护雕像。

e.en: Scholars noted the mask's {tauriform} horns.
e.zh: 学者们注意到面具上似公牛的角。

e.en: The supplement contains {taurin} for metabolic support.
e.zh: 这种补充剂含有牛磺酸，用于支持代谢。

e.en: Older chemistry texts sometimes spell taurine as {taurin}.
e.zh: 较早的化学文献有时把牛磺酸拼作taurin。

e.en: The lab measured {taurocholic} acid in bile samples.
e.zh: 实验室测量了胆汁样本中的牛磺胆酸。

e.en: A {taurocholic} compound appeared in the analysis.
e.zh: 分析中出现了一种牛磺胆酸类化合物。

e.en: The museum displayed {tauromachian} costumes from Spain.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自西班牙的斗牛服饰。

e.en: His essay studied {tauromachian} imagery in poetry.
e.zh: 他的论文研究诗歌中的斗牛意象。

e.en: The painting presents {tauromachy} as ritual drama.
e.zh: 这幅画把斗牛表现成一种仪式性的戏剧。

e.en: Critics questioned the ethics of {tauromachy}.
e.zh: 批评者质疑斗牛的伦理问题。

e.en: The deity was shown in {tauromorphic} form.
e.zh: 这位神祇以牛形形象呈现。

e.en: Archaeologists found a {tauromorphic} clay figure.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一件牛形陶塑。

e.en: This rope is the {tautest} one on the boat.
e.zh: 这根绳子是船上绷得最紧的一根。

e.en: Her final draft was the {tautest} version.
e.zh: 她的最终稿是最简练的版本。

e.en: The cycloid is a classic {tautochrone}.
e.zh: 摆线是一种经典的等时曲线。

e.en: Students modeled the {tautochrone} in a mechanics class.
e.zh: 学生们在力学课上模拟了等时曲线。

e.en: The experiment demonstrated {tautochronism} in the pendulum path.
e.zh: 实验展示了摆动路径中的等时性。

e.en: Engineers discussed {tautochronism} when designing the track.
e.zh: 工程师在设计轨道时讨论了等时现象。

e.en: A {tautochronous} curve gives equal descent times.
e.zh: 等时曲线会产生相同的下降时间。

e.en: The signals were treated as {tautochronous} events.
e.zh: 这些信号被视为同时发生的事件。

e.en: He caught a {tautog} near the rocky shore.
e.zh: 他在岩石海岸附近钓到一条黑鲷。

e.en: The restaurant served grilled {tautog} with lemon.
e.zh: 餐厅供应配柠檬的烤黑鲷。

e.en: A careless {tautologist} keeps repeating the same idea.
e.zh: 粗心的赘言者会不断重复同一个意思。

e.en: The logician called him a {tautologist} after the debate.
e.zh: 辩论后，逻辑学家称他为同义反复者。

e.en: The lecturer tended to {tautologize} simple points.
e.zh: 那位讲师常把简单观点说成同义反复。

e.en: Do not {tautologize} by saying free gift.
e.zh: 不要说免费赠品这种同义反复的话。

e.en: The definition was {tautologized} beyond usefulness.
e.zh: 这个定义被说成同义反复，已经没什么用处。

e.en: He {tautologized} the rule in every paragraph.
e.zh: 他在每一段里都把那条规则重复成同义反复。

e.en: She was {tautologizing} instead of explaining the idea.
e.zh: 她不是解释这个想法，而是在同义反复。

e.en: The slogan keeps {tautologizing} its own claim.
e.zh: 这个口号不断用同义反复支撑自己的说法。

e.en: This {tautomer} is less stable in water.
e.zh: 这种互变异构体在水中不太稳定。

e.en: The chemist identified another {tautomer} of the compound.
e.zh: 化学家确认了该化合物的另一种互变异构体。

e.en: The paper describes a {tautomeral} change in solution.
e.zh: 论文描述了溶液中的一种互变异构变化。

e.en: They compared two {tautomeral} forms of the molecule.
e.zh: 他们比较了该分子的两种互变异构形式。

e.en: Keto-enol {tautomerism} affects the reaction pathway.
e.zh: 酮-烯醇互变异构会影响反应路径。

e.en: Students studied {tautomerism} in organic chemistry.
e.zh: 学生们在有机化学中学习互变异构现象。

e.en: The molecule can {tautomerize} under acidic conditions.
e.zh: 该分子在酸性条件下会发生互变异构。

e.en: Some bases {tautomerize} before forming hydrogen bonds.
e.zh: 有些碱基在形成氢键前会发生互变异构。

e.en: The poem suffers from dull {tautophony}.
e.zh: 这首诗有乏味的同音重复问题。

e.en: Editors removed the accidental {tautophony} from the line.
e.zh: 编辑删去了这一行里意外出现的音韵单调。

e.en: The gears showed {tautorotation} during the test.
e.zh: 测试中这些齿轮表现出同向旋转。

e.en: Engineers modeled {tautorotation} in the coupled shafts.
e.zh: 工程师模拟了联动轴中的同向旋转。

e.en: The consonants are {tautosyllabic} in this analysis.
e.zh: 在这个分析中，这些辅音属于同一个音节。

e.en: A {tautosyllabic} cluster occurs at the word's start.
e.zh: 这个词开头出现了一个同音节辅音群。

e.en: The letter {tav} ends the Hebrew alphabet.
e.zh: 字母塔夫位于希伯来字母表的末尾。

e.en: She wrote a {tav} on the classroom board.
e.zh: 她在教室黑板上写了一个塔夫字母。

e.en: He greeted me as {tavarish} at the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会上用“同志”这个俄式称呼问候我。

e.en: The old novel uses {tavarish} for Soviet comrades.
e.zh: 那本旧小说用tavarish来称呼苏联同志。

e.en: The witness began to {tave} under pressure.
e.zh: 证人在压力下开始胡言乱语。

e.en: Stop {tave} about things you never saw.
e.zh: 别再对你没见过的事乱扯了。

e.en: The {tavernkeeper} served ale to the travelers.
e.zh: 酒馆老板给旅人们端上麦芽酒。

e.en: A suspicious {tavernkeeper} watched the stranger closely.
e.zh: 一个多疑的客栈掌柜紧盯着那个陌生人。

e.en: He lost his favorite {taw} in the marble game.
e.zh: 他在弹珠游戏中输掉了最喜欢的那颗弹珠。

e.en: Workers used alum to {taw} the pale leather.
e.zh: 工人们用明矾来鞣制那张浅色皮革。

tawdrier.t: 更俗丽的；更廉价花哨的

e.en: The second costume looked {tawdrier} than the first.
e.zh: 第二套服装比第一套显得更俗艳廉价。

e.en: His excuses grew {tawdrier} with each retelling.
e.zh: 他的借口越讲越显得拙劣俗气。

tawdriest.t: 最俗丽的；最廉价花哨的

e.en: That was the {tawdriest} necklace in the shop.
e.zh: 那是店里最俗气廉价的一条项链。

e.en: The scandal became the {tawdriest} story of the year.
e.zh: 那桩丑闻成了当年最庸俗难堪的故事。

e.en: The room was {tawdrily} decorated for the party.
e.zh: 房间为聚会布置得俗艳又廉价。

e.en: He spoke {tawdrily} about fame and money.
e.zh: 他谈起名利时显得庸俗不堪。

e.en: The critic disliked the film's {tawdriness}.
e.zh: 评论家不喜欢这部电影的俗艳感。

e.en: There was a sad {tawdriness} in the faded hotel.
e.zh: 那家破旧旅馆里有一种令人心酸的廉价俗气。

e.en: The book was bound in {tawed} leather.
e.zh: 这本书用鞣成的白革装订。

e.en: They {tawed} the hide with alum and salt.
e.zh: 他们用明矾和盐鞣制兽皮。

e.en: The {tawer} prepared soft white leather.
e.zh: 白革鞣制工制备了柔软的白色皮革。

e.en: A skilled {tawer} knew how much alum to use.
e.zh: 熟练的鞣革工知道该用多少明矾。

e.en: The old poem calls her a {tawie} for missing the joke.
e.zh: 那首旧诗说她没听懂笑话，是个迟钝的人。

e.en: He felt like a {tawie} among the clever students.
e.zh: 在那些聪明学生中间，他觉得自己像个笨人。

e.en: The workshop was {tawing} soft skins for gloves.
e.zh: 作坊正在用明矾鞣制柔软的皮料来做手套。

e.en: Old manuals describe {tawing} as different from tanning with bark.
e.zh: 旧手册把明矾鞣革描述为不同于用树皮鞣革的方法。

e.en: His skin looked {tawnier} after a month at sea.
e.zh: 在海上待了一个月后，他的皮肤显得更黄褐。

e.en: This paint is {tawnier} than the shade we chose yesterday.
e.zh: 这种颜料比我们昨天选的色调更偏黄褐。

e.en: The {tawniest} leaves gathered near the gate.
e.zh: 最黄褐的叶子都堆在大门附近。

e.en: She picked the {tawniest} fabric for the costume.
e.zh: 她为戏服挑了颜色最黄褐的布料。

e.en: The photographer liked the {tawniness} of the evening light.
e.zh: 摄影师喜欢傍晚光线里的黄褐色调。

e.en: The leather gained a warm {tawniness} with age.
e.zh: 那块皮革随着年月呈现出温暖的茶色感。

e.en: The Scots tale teases the lazy girl as a {tawpie}.
e.zh: 那个苏格兰故事把懒姑娘打趣成一个笨女孩。

e.en: No one liked being called a {tawpie} in public.
e.zh: 没人喜欢在公共场合被叫作邋遢女人。

e.en: The children played {taws} in the dusty lane.
e.zh: 孩子们在尘土飞扬的小巷里玩弹珠游戏。

e.en: The schoolmaster kept the {taws} in his desk.
e.zh: 校长把惩戒用的皮鞭带放在书桌里。

e.en: The old teacher once used a {tawse} for punishment.
e.zh: 那位老教师曾用苏格兰皮鞭来惩罚学生。

e.en: A museum displayed the leather {tawse} beside school photographs.
e.zh: 博物馆把那条皮制惩戒鞭和学校照片放在一起展出。

e.en: The company defended its {tax-avoidance} scheme as legal.
e.zh: 该公司辩称自己的避税方案是合法的。

e.en: Governments lose revenue when aggressive {tax-avoidance} becomes common.
e.zh: 激进避税变得普遍时，政府会流失税收。

e.en: A {tax-collector} visited each shop in the village.
e.zh: 一名收税员走访了村里的每家商店。

e.en: In the story, the {tax-collector} is feared by everyone.
e.zh: 在这个故事里，税吏让所有人害怕。

e.en: Donations to the charity are {tax-deductible}.
e.zh: 给这家慈善机构的捐款可以抵税。

e.en: Keep receipts for any {tax-deductible} business expense.
e.zh: 所有可抵税的业务开支都要保留收据。

e.en: She moved her savings into a {tax-deferred} account.
e.zh: 她把储蓄转入一个递延纳税账户。

e.en: A {tax-deferred} plan delays taxes until withdrawal.
e.zh: 递延纳税计划会把税款推迟到提款时缴纳。

e.en: The minister called the loophole a {tax-dodge}.
e.zh: 部长把这个漏洞称为逃税花招。

e.en: Reporters exposed a clever {tax-dodge} used by investors.
e.zh: 记者曝光了投资者使用的一种巧妙避税手段。

e.en: The newspaper branded him a {tax-dodger}.
e.zh: 报纸把他称作逃税者。

e.en: No candidate wants to look like a {tax-dodger}.
e.zh: 没有候选人愿意显得像个逃税者。

e.en: The church owns several {tax-exempt} properties.
e.zh: 这座教堂拥有几处免税房产。

e.en: Some bonds provide {tax-exempt} interest income.
e.zh: 有些债券提供免税的利息收入。

e.en: Tourists can buy {tax-free} goods at the airport.
e.zh: 游客可以在机场购买免税商品。

e.en: The prize money is not completely {tax-free}.
e.zh: 这笔奖金并不是完全免税的。

e.en: The villagers hid when the {tax-gatherer} arrived.
e.zh: 收税人到来时，村民们都躲了起来。

e.en: In older English, a {tax-gatherer} often meant a local tax official.
e.zh: 在较早的英语里，tax-gatherer常指地方税吏。

e.en: Small firms asked the government for {tax-relief}.
e.zh: 小企业请求政府给予税收减免。

e.en: Homeowners may qualify for {tax-relief} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，房主可能有资格获得税务宽减。

e.en: He invested through a {tax-sheltered} retirement plan.
e.zh: 他通过享有税务庇护的退休计划进行投资。

e.en: A {tax-sheltered} account can reduce current taxable income.
e.zh: 享税务庇护的账户可以减少当前应税收入。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {taxability} of the settlement payment.
e.zh: 律师们争论这笔和解款是否应纳税。

e.en: The report explains the {taxability} of foreign dividends.
e.zh: 报告解释了境外股息的应税性。

e.en: The botanist identified a {taxaceous} shrub near the trail.
e.zh: 植物学家在小径旁认出一株红豆杉科灌木。

e.en: The fossil shows features typical of {taxaceous} plants.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出红豆杉科植物的典型特征。

e.en: The driver reset the {taxameter} before we left.
e.zh: 司机在我们出发前重置了出租车计价器。

e.en: Early cabs used a mechanical {taxameter} to calculate fares.
e.zh: 早期出租车用机械计价器来计算车费。

e.en: The linguist treated tense as a {taxeme} in the analysis.
e.zh: 那位语言学家在分析中把时态视为一个区别语法特征单位。

e.en: A {taxeme} can mark a contrast within a grammatical system.
e.zh: taxeme可以标示语法系统内部的一种对立。

e.en: We took a {taxi-cab} to the station.
e.zh: 我们坐出租车去了车站。

e.en: A yellow {taxi-cab} stopped outside the hotel.
e.zh: 一辆黄色出租车停在酒店外面。

e.en: The {taxi-driver} knew a faster route.
e.zh: 出租车司机知道一条更快的路。

e.en: She thanked the {taxi-driver} before leaving.
e.zh: 她下车前向出租车司机道了谢。

e.en: We waited at the {taxi-rank} after the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后，我们在出租车候客站等车。

e.en: The hotel has a {taxi-rank} near the entrance.
e.zh: 酒店入口附近有一个出租车候客站。

e.en: The museum stored several {taxidermal} specimens upstairs.
e.zh: 博物馆把几件动物标本制作的藏品存放在楼上。

e.en: She studied {taxidermal} techniques for preserving birds.
e.zh: 她学习了保存鸟类的动物标本制作技术。

e.en: The old shop displayed {taxidermic} work in the window.
e.zh: 那家老店在橱窗里展示动物标本制作作品。

e.en: His {taxidermic} collection included foxes and owls.
e.zh: 他的动物标本收藏里有狐狸和猫头鹰。

e.en: The {taxidriver} helped us with our bags.
e.zh: 出租车司机帮我们搬了行李。

e.en: My uncle works as a {taxidriver} at night.
e.zh: 我叔叔晚上当出租车司机。

e.en: The {taximan} waited while she found her keys.
e.zh: 她找钥匙时，出租车司机一直等着。

e.en: A friendly {taximan} told us stories about the city.
e.zh: 一位友好的出租车司机给我们讲了这座城市的故事。

e.en: The {taximeter} showed a higher fare than expected.
e.zh: 出租车计价器显示的车费比预想的高。

e.en: He checked the {taximeter} before paying the driver.
e.zh: 他付款给司机前看了一眼出租车计价器。

e.en: The small {taxiplane} moved slowly toward the runway.
e.zh: 那架地面滑行飞机慢慢驶向跑道。

e.en: Engineers tested the {taxiplane} on a quiet airfield.
e.zh: 工程师在一处安静机场测试这架地面滑行飞机。

e.en: There is a {taxistand} beside the train station.
e.zh: 火车站旁边有一个出租车候客站。

e.en: Passengers lined up at the {taxistand} in the rain.
e.zh: 乘客们冒雨在出租车候客站排队。

e.en: A {taxite} moves toward or away from a stimulus.
e.zh: 趋性生物体会朝刺激源移动或远离刺激源。

e.en: The biologist described the organism as a simple {taxite}.
e.zh: 生物学家把这种有机体描述为简单的趋性生物体。

e.en: The island promoted itself as a {taxless} haven.
e.zh: 这个岛把自己宣传成免税避风港。

e.en: A truly {taxless} society is difficult to finance.
e.zh: 一个真正无税的社会很难维持财政。

e.en: The city sent a {taxmobile} to rural neighborhoods.
e.zh: 市政府派出流动税务服务车前往乡村社区。

e.en: Residents filed returns at the {taxmobile} outside city hall.
e.zh: 居民们在市政厅外的流动税务服务车上报税。

e.en: The researcher treated shell shape as a {taxogen}.
e.zh: 研究人员把贝壳形状视为一种分类性特征。

e.en: A useful {taxogen} helps separate related species.
e.zh: 有用的分类性特征能帮助区分相近物种。

e.en: His book introduced the basics of {taxology}.
e.zh: 他的书介绍了分类学的基础知识。

e.en: Modern {taxology} often relies on genetic evidence.
e.zh: 现代分类学常常依赖遗传证据。

e.en: The paper applied {taxometrics} to personality data.
e.zh: 这篇论文把分类计量学用于人格数据。

e.en: She used {taxometrics} to test whether groups were distinct.
e.zh: 她用分类计量学检验这些群体是否彼此不同。

e.en: The {taxonomer} identified a new beetle species.
e.zh: 这位分类学家鉴定出一种新的甲虫。

e.en: A careful {taxonomer} compares many physical details.
e.zh: 细心的分类学家会比较许多身体细节。

e.en: The receipt proved the goods were {taxpaid}.
e.zh: 收据证明这些货物已经纳税。

e.en: Only {taxpaid} fuel could be sold at the port.
e.zh: 港口只能销售已纳税的燃料。

e.en: The policy affected every {taxpaying} household in town.
e.zh: 这项政策影响了镇上每个纳税家庭。

e.en: She spoke as a {taxpaying} citizen demanding accountability.
e.zh: 她以纳税公民的身份要求追责。

e.en: She made jam from fresh {tayberries}.
e.zh: 她用新鲜泰莓做了果酱。

e.en: A {tayberry} tastes like a cross between raspberry and blackberry.
e.zh: 泰莓吃起来像树莓和黑莓的杂交风味。

e.en: The {tayra} moved quickly through the forest canopy.
e.zh: 那只泰拉貂迅速穿过森林树冠。

e.en: A {tayra} can eat fruit as well as small animals.
e.zh: 泰拉貂既会吃水果，也会吃小动物。

e.en: The museum displayed a silver {tazza} from the Renaissance.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件文艺复兴时期的银制浅杯形高脚盘。

e.en: She placed grapes in a glass {tazza} at the center of the table.
e.zh: 她把葡萄放在桌子中央的玻璃高脚浅盘里。

e.en: She said {tch} when she saw the broken cup.
e.zh: 她看到杯子碎了，啧了一声。

e.en: '{Tch}, that was careless,' he muttered.
e.zh: “啧，太不小心了，”他低声说。

e.en: The lock made a soft {tchick} in the dark hallway.
e.zh: 黑暗的走廊里，锁轻轻发出一声咔嗒。

e.en: He heard the camera {tchick} behind him.
e.zh: 他听见身后的相机咔嗒响了一下。

e.en: Her desk was covered with colorful {tchotchkes}.
e.zh: 她的书桌上摆满了五颜六色的小摆设。

e.en: The conference handed out a plastic {tchotchke} to every visitor.
e.zh: 会议给每位访客发了一个塑料小纪念品。

e.en: Put one {tea-bag} in the cup first.
e.zh: 先把一个茶包放进杯子里。

e.en: She threw the used {tea-bag} into the bin.
e.zh: 她把用过的茶包扔进垃圾桶。

e.en: He started work as a {tea-boy} in the office.
e.zh: 他最初在办公室当倒茶杂役。

e.en: The old firm still employed a {tea-boy} for visitors.
e.zh: 那家老公司仍雇着一个茶水小工招待访客。

e.en: Let's discuss the problem after the {tea-break}.
e.zh: 我们喝茶休息后再讨论这个问题。

e.en: The workers took a short {tea-break} at ten.
e.zh: 工人们十点钟短暂休息喝茶。

e.en: She dried the plates with a clean {tea-cloth}.
e.zh: 她用一块干净的茶巾擦干盘子。

e.en: The striped {tea-cloth} hung beside the sink.
e.zh: 那条条纹茶巾挂在水槽旁边。

e.en: Grandma covered the pot with a woolen {tea-cosy}.
e.zh: 奶奶用羊毛茶壶罩盖住茶壶保温。

e.en: The bright {tea-cosy} kept the tea warm for hours.
e.zh: 那个鲜艳的茶壶保温罩让茶水热了好几个小时。

e.en: They attended a {tea-dance} at the seaside hotel.
e.zh: 他们参加了海滨酒店的下午茶舞会。

e.en: The club still holds a Sunday {tea-dance}.
e.zh: 那家俱乐部仍在周日举办下午茶舞会。

e.en: The {tea-dealer} imported leaves from India and China.
e.zh: 这名茶叶商从印度和中国进口茶叶。

e.en: A local {tea-dealer} taught us how to taste oolong.
e.zh: 一位本地茶商教我们怎样品乌龙茶。

e.en: We rested in a small {tea-house} by the river.
e.zh: 我们在河边一家小茶馆里休息。

e.en: The old {tea-house} serves jasmine tea and snacks.
e.zh: 那家老茶楼供应茉莉花茶和点心。

e.en: The {tea-kettle} whistled on the stove.
e.zh: 炉子上的烧水壶鸣响了。

e.en: He filled the {tea-kettle} before breakfast.
e.zh: 早饭前他把烧水壶装满了水。

e.en: A single {tea-leaf} floated in her cup.
e.zh: 一片茶叶漂在她的杯子里。

e.en: The merchant checked each dried {tea-leaf} carefully.
e.zh: 商人仔细查看每一片干茶叶。

e.en: An antique {tea-poy} stood beside the sofa.
e.zh: 沙发旁放着一张古董三脚茶几。

e.en: The servant brought the caddy on a carved {tea-poy}.
e.zh: 仆人把茶叶盒放在雕花茶几上端了过来。

e.en: The museum has a quiet {tea-room} upstairs.
e.zh: 博物馆楼上有一间安静的茶室。

e.en: They opened a village {tea-room} for walkers.
e.zh: 他们为徒步游客开了一家乡村小茶馆。

e.en: I bought green tea at a small {tea-shop}.
e.zh: 我在一家小茶叶店买了绿茶。

e.en: The old {tea-shop} was crowded after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后那家老茶馆里挤满了人。

e.en: Add one {tea-spoon} of sugar to the cup.
e.zh: 往杯子里加一茶匙糖。

e.en: She stirred the medicine with a {tea-spoon}.
e.zh: 她用小匙搅拌药水。

e.en: Pour the tea through a {tea-strainer}.
e.zh: 把茶倒过茶漏过滤。

e.en: The silver {tea-strainer} caught the loose leaves.
e.zh: 银色滤茶器拦住了散茶叶。

e.en: The cups were arranged on the {tea-table}.
e.zh: 杯子整齐摆在茶几上。

e.en: Guests gathered around the small {tea-table}.
e.zh: 客人们围在小茶桌旁。

e.en: She packed the {tea-things} after breakfast.
e.zh: 早饭后她把茶具收了起来。

e.en: The old cupboard held all the {tea-things}.
e.zh: 旧橱柜里放着所有喝茶用具。

e.en: We usually stop work at {tea-time}.
e.zh: 我们通常在下午茶时间停下工作。

e.en: Grandmother served cakes at {tea-time}.
e.zh: 祖母在茶点时间端上蛋糕。

e.en: Dry the plates with a clean {tea-towel}.
e.zh: 用干净的擦碗布把盘子擦干。

e.en: She hung the damp {tea-towel} by the sink.
e.zh: 她把湿茶巾挂在水槽旁。

e.en: He carried the cups on a {tea-tray}.
e.zh: 他用茶盘端着杯子。

e.en: The wooden {tea-tray} smelled faintly of jasmine.
e.zh: 木制茶盘隐约有茉莉香。

e.en: A brass {tea-urn} stood in the hall.
e.zh: 大厅里放着一只黄铜大茶壶。

e.en: Volunteers filled mugs from the {tea-urn}.
e.zh: 志愿者从茶水保温桶里给杯子倒茶。

e.en: The porcelain cups rested on a lacquered {teaboard}.
e.zh: 瓷杯放在漆面的茶盘上。

e.en: He polished the old {teaboard} before guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来前，他擦亮了旧茶桌板。

e.en: She warmed the {teabowl} before pouring tea.
e.zh: 倒茶前她先温了茶碗。

e.en: The monk drank quietly from a clay {teabowl}.
e.zh: 僧人安静地用陶茶碗喝茶。

e.en: The waiter pushed a {teacart} into the room.
e.zh: 服务员把茶点推车推进房间。

e.en: Her antique {teacart} held cups and biscuits.
e.zh: 她的古董茶车上放着杯子和饼干。

teach-in.t: 专题宣讲会；讨论式讲座

e.en: Students organized a {teach-in} on climate policy.
e.zh: 学生组织了一场气候政策专题宣讲会。

e.en: The union held a {teach-in} during lunch.
e.zh: 工会在午餐时间举办了讨论式讲座。

teach-ins.t: 专题宣讲会；讨论式讲座

e.en: Several {teach-ins} followed the protest.
e.zh: 抗议之后举行了几场专题宣讲会。

e.en: Campus {teach-ins} drew large evening crowds.
e.zh: 校园讨论式讲座在晚上吸引了很多人。

e.en: The coach praised the player's {teachability}.
e.zh: 教练称赞这名球员愿意受教。

e.en: Good design improves a system's {teachability}.
e.zh: 好的设计能提高系统的易学程度。

e.en: She listened {teachably} to every correction.
e.zh: 她很受教地听取每一处纠正。

e.en: The manual presents each step {teachably}.
e.zh: 这本手册把每一步都讲得易学易懂。

e.en: The village built a small {teacherage} beside the school.
e.zh: 村里在学校旁建了一座小教师住宅。

e.en: New staff shared the old {teacherage}.
e.zh: 新来的教职员共住在旧教员宿舍里。

e.en: He accepted a {teachership} at a rural school.
e.zh: 他接受了乡村学校的教师职位。

e.en: Her {teachership} shaped her public life.
e.zh: 她的教师身份影响了她的公共生活。

e.en: The college offers {teachertraining} courses online.
e.zh: 这所学院在线提供教师培训课程。

e.en: Better {teachertraining} can improve classroom practice.
e.zh: 更好的师资培养能改善课堂实践。

e.en: His {teachery} tone annoyed the staff.
e.zh: 他那种像老师训人的语气惹恼了员工。

e.en: The article felt too {teachery} for young readers.
e.zh: 这篇文章对年轻读者来说说教味太重。

e.en: The school bought new {teachware} for science lessons.
e.zh: 学校为科学课购买了新的教学软件。

e.en: Interactive {teachware} helps pupils practise at home.
e.zh: 互动教学课件能帮助学生在家练习。

e.en: The guide sounded a bit {teachy}.
e.zh: 这位导游听起来有点爱说教。

e.en: She avoided a {teachy} style in the video.
e.zh: 她在视频里避免使用教师腔。

e.en: Add a {teacupful} of milk to the batter.
e.zh: 往面糊里加一茶杯牛奶。

e.en: He drank a {teacupful} of broth.
e.zh: 他喝了一茶杯肉汤。

e.en: She measured two {teacupfuls} of flour.
e.zh: 她量了两茶杯面粉。

e.en: The recipe needs three {teacupfuls} of water.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要三茶杯水。

e.en: The {teadealer} imported leaves from India.
e.zh: 这位茶商从印度进口茶叶。

e.en: A local {teadealer} supplied the hotel.
e.zh: 当地茶叶经销商给酒店供货。

e.en: The office {teagirl} brought cups every morning.
e.zh: 办公室端茶女工每天早上送来茶杯。

e.en: In the novel, a shy {teagirl} hears the secret.
e.zh: 在小说中，一个羞怯的送茶女孩听到了秘密。

e.en: The old field guide called the bird a {teagle}.
e.zh: 那本旧野外指南把这种鸟称为茶鹰。

e.en: A {teagle} circled above the moor at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，一只茶鹰在荒原上空盘旋。

e.en: A single {tealeaf} floated in my cup.
e.zh: 一片茶叶漂在我的杯子里。

e.en: She studied the dried {tealeaf} under a lens.
e.zh: 她用放大镜观察那片干茶叶。

e.en: We endured a {tealess} morning at the campsite.
e.zh: 我们在营地度过了一个没有茶喝的早晨。

e.en: The cafe offered a {tealess} herbal blend.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供一种不含茶的草本饮品。

e.en: She placed a {tealight} inside the glass holder.
e.zh: 她把一枚茶蜡放进玻璃烛台里。

e.en: The room was lit by one small {tealight}.
e.zh: 房间只靠一支小蜡烛照亮。

e.en: The {team-manager} arranged transport for everyone.
e.zh: 团队管理者为所有人安排了交通。

e.en: Our {team-manager} spoke to the referee after the match.
e.zh: 赛后我们的球队经理和裁判谈了话。

e.en: My {team-mate} scored the winning goal.
e.zh: 我的队友打进了制胜球。

e.en: Ask your {team-mate} before changing the plan.
e.zh: 改计划前先问问你的同组伙伴。

e.en: Her {team-mates} cheered when she finished.
e.zh: 她完成时，队友们为她欢呼。

e.en: The {team-mates} shared notes after class.
e.zh: 这些同组伙伴下课后分享了笔记。

e.en: Each {team-member} has a clear role.
e.zh: 每个团队成员都有明确职责。

e.en: A new {team-member} joined the project today.
e.zh: 今天有一名新成员加入了项目。

e.en: We need a {team-oriented} designer for this project.
e.zh: 这个项目需要一位重视团队合作的设计师。

e.en: Her {team-oriented} style improved the office mood.
e.zh: 她注重团队的工作风格改善了办公室气氛。

e.en: The village depends on {teaplanting} for income.
e.zh: 这个村庄靠种茶获得收入。

e.en: Modern {teaplanting} requires careful soil management.
e.zh: 现代茶树栽培需要细致的土壤管理。

e.en: The porcelain cups stood on a carved {teapoy}.
e.zh: 瓷杯摆在一张雕花小茶几上。

e.en: An antique {teapoy} filled the corner of the room.
e.zh: 一张古董三脚茶桌占据了房间角落。

e.en: A {tear-drop} rolled down her cheek.
e.zh: 一滴泪从她脸颊滑落。

e.en: The necklace had a blue {tear-drop} pendant.
e.zh: 那条项链有一个蓝色水滴形吊坠。

e.en: Police used {tear-gas} to disperse the crowd.
e.zh: 警方使用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

e.en: The protesters covered their faces against {tear-gas}.
e.zh: 抗议者捂住脸以防催泪瓦斯。

e.en: The film is a classic {tear-jerker}.
e.zh: 这部电影是典型的催泪片。

e.en: His speech became a political {tear-jerker}.
e.zh: 他的演讲变成了一段政治煽情故事。

e.en: She avoids {tear-jerkers} when she feels tired.
e.zh: 她累的时候会避开催泪片。

e.en: Publishers know that holiday {tear-jerkers} sell well.
e.zh: 出版商知道节日煽情故事很畅销。

e.en: Use the {tear-off} slip at the bottom.
e.zh: 请使用底部可撕下的回执。

e.en: The calendar has {tear-off} pages for each day.
e.zh: 这本日历每天都有可撕下的页面。

e.en: She held a {tear-stained} letter in her hand.
e.zh: 她手里拿着一封泪痕斑斑的信。

e.en: His {tear-stained} face softened the judge's tone.
e.zh: 他满是泪痕的脸让法官语气缓和下来。

e.en: Please do not {tear-up} the contract.
e.zh: 请不要撕毁这份合同。

e.en: They decided to {tear-up} the old carpet.
e.zh: 他们决定把旧地毯拆掉撕开。

e.en: The package uses {tearable} paper tape.
e.zh: 这个包裹使用可撕开的纸胶带。

e.en: This fabric is thin but not easily {tearable}.
e.zh: 这种布很薄，但不容易撕破。

e.en: A blocked {tearduct} made the baby cry often.
e.zh: 泪管堵塞让这个婴儿经常流泪。

e.en: The doctor examined her {tearduct} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了她的泪道。

e.en: That novel is a real {tearjerker}.
e.zh: 那本小说真是一部催泪作品。

e.en: The advertisement turned into a sentimental {tearjerker}.
e.zh: 这则广告变成了煽情的催泪短片。

e.en: A tiny {tearlet} shone under her eye.
e.zh: 她眼下闪着一小滴泪珠。

e.en: The poet described each {tearlet} as silver.
e.zh: 诗人把每一小滴眼泪都描写成银色。

e.en: Fill in the {tearoff} and keep the receipt.
e.zh: 填好可撕下部分，并保留收据。

e.en: The notebook includes a handy {tearoff} section.
e.zh: 这本笔记本有一块方便撕下的区域。

e.en: The magazine included a {tearout} map.
e.zh: 这本杂志附有一张可撕下的地图。

e.en: Save the recipe from the {tearout} section.
e.zh: 把可撕页部分里的食谱留好。

e.en: The envelope is made from {tearproof} paper.
e.zh: 这个信封是用防撕裂纸做的。

e.en: Hikers prefer {tearproof} maps in wet weather.
e.zh: 徒步者在潮湿天气更喜欢撕不破的地图。

e.en: A dark {tearstain} marked the pillowcase.
e.zh: 枕套上留着一道深色泪痕。

e.en: The groomer cleaned the dog's {tearstain} gently.
e.zh: 美容师轻轻清理了狗眼下的泪痕。

tearstained.t: 泪痕斑斑的；沾满泪水的

e.en: She folded the {tearstained} letter away.
e.zh: 她把那封泪痕斑斑的信收了起来。

e.en: His {tearstained} face softened when she smiled.
e.zh: 她一笑，他那张沾满泪水的脸柔和下来。

e.en: A dried {teasel} stood beside the winter path.
e.zh: 一株干枯的起绒草立在冬日小路旁。

e.en: Workers once used {teasel} to raise woolen cloth.
e.zh: 工人过去曾用起绒草给羊毛布起绒。

e.en: The mill sold finely {teaseled} wool.
e.zh: 那家纺织厂出售经过精细起绒的羊毛织物。

e.en: Her coat had a softly {teaseled} surface.
e.zh: 她的大衣表面有柔软的起绒质感。

e.en: The old {teaseler} worked by the mill window.
e.zh: 那位老起绒工在纺织厂窗边干活。

e.en: A mechanical {teaseler} replaced the hand tools.
e.zh: 机械起绒机取代了手工工具。

e.en: The cloth needed careful {teaseling} before dyeing.
e.zh: 这块布在染色前需要仔细起绒。

e.en: She learned {teaseling} from an old textile manual.
e.zh: 她从一本旧纺织手册里学会了起绒工艺。

e.en: The blanket was {teaselled} for extra softness.
e.zh: 这条毯子经过起绒处理，摸起来更柔软。

e.en: He admired the {teaselled} finish on the cloth.
e.zh: 他很欣赏布料上经起绒处理后的质感。

e.en: Traditional {teaselling} required patience and skill.
e.zh: 传统起绒需要耐心和技巧。

e.en: The factory modernized its {teaselling} process.
e.zh: 工厂把起绒处理流程现代化了。

e.en: Wild {teasels} grew along the fence.
e.zh: 野生起绒草沿着篱笆生长。

e.en: The weavers kept dried {teasels} in bundles.
e.zh: 织工把晒干的起绒草成捆保存。

e.en: Grandmother kept her china {teaset} in a cabinet.
e.zh: 祖母把她的瓷茶具放在柜子里。

e.en: They bought a simple {teaset} for the new apartment.
e.zh: 他们给新公寓买了一套简单的茶具。

e.en: He grew {teasy} after hours of waiting.
e.zh: 等了几个小时后，他变得烦躁起来。

e.en: The child was {teasy} from hunger and heat.
e.zh: 孩子又饿又热，显得很易怒。

e.en: The botanist identified the plant as a {teazel}.
e.zh: 植物学家认出这株植物是起绒草。

e.en: They used a {teazel} to finish the cloth.
e.zh: 他们用起绒草刷来整理布面。

e.en: The village {teazer} always made sharp jokes.
e.zh: 村里那个爱戏弄人的人总开尖刻玩笑。

e.en: A skilled {teazer} could improve rough wool.
e.zh: 熟练的起绒工能改善粗糙的羊毛布。

e.en: A purple {teazle} attracted bees in the garden.
e.zh: 花园里一株紫色起绒草吸引了蜜蜂。

e.en: The clothiers would {teazle} the fabric by hand.
e.zh: 制布工会手工给织物起绒。

e.en: The workshop demonstrated {teazling} with old tools.
e.zh: 作坊用旧工具演示了起绒工艺。

e.en: Careless {teazling} could damage delicate wool.
e.zh: 粗心的起绒处理可能损坏细羊毛。

e.en: The company wants {tech-savvy} customer support staff.
e.zh: 公司想招聘懂技术的客服人员。

e.en: Even {tech-savvy} users can miss security warnings.
e.zh: 即使科技熟练的用户也可能忽略安全警告。

e.en: She answered {techily} when interrupted again.
e.zh: 再次被打断时，她烦躁地回答。

e.en: The clerk spoke {techily} to the impatient crowd.
e.zh: 店员对焦躁的人群说话时显得很不耐烦。

e.en: His {techiness} made the meeting uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他的易怒让会议气氛很不舒服。

e.en: Lack of sleep explained her morning {techiness}.
e.zh: 睡眠不足解释了她早上的烦躁。

e.en: Her painting {technic} improved after months of practice.
e.zh: 经过几个月练习，她的绘画技法提高了。

e.en: The essay discusses the {technic} of early photographers.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论早期摄影师的技术方法。

e.en: The {technicalization} of farming changed rural labor.
e.zh: 农业的技术化改变了农村劳作方式。

e.en: Excessive {technicalization} can make policy debates harder to follow.
e.zh: 过度的专门化处理会让政策讨论更难理解。

e.en: Managers tried to {technicalize} the simple repair process.
e.zh: 管理人员试图把简单的维修流程技术化。

e.en: The report may {technicalize} the issue for legal readers.
e.zh: 这份报告可能会为法律读者把问题术语化。

e.en: A strict {technicist} may ignore social consequences.
e.zh: 严格的技术至上者可能会忽视社会后果。

e.en: The factory hired a {technicist} to improve the machines.
e.zh: 工厂聘请了一名技术专家来改进机器。

e.en: He wrote about {technicology} in modern education.
e.zh: 他写过现代教育中的技术学问题。

e.en: The museum displayed tools important to early {technicology}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了对早期工艺学很重要的工具。

e.en: She studied engineering at a local {technicum}.
e.zh: 她在当地一所技术学校学习工程。

e.en: The old {technicum} trained mechanics for the railway.
e.zh: 那所旧工艺学院为铁路培养机械师。

e.en: The {technification} of medicine brought new ethical questions.
e.zh: 医学的技术化带来了新的伦理问题。

e.en: Village life changed after the {technification} of water systems.
e.zh: 供水系统技术改造后，乡村生活发生了变化。

e.en: The company plans to {technify} its delivery network.
e.zh: 公司计划用技术改造配送网络。

e.en: Some teachers worry that schools may {technify} childhood too much.
e.zh: 一些教师担心学校可能把童年过度技术化。

e.en: He earned a diploma from a {technikon} in Durban.
e.zh: 他在德班一所技术学院获得了文凭。

e.en: The {technikon} focused on practical industrial training.
e.zh: 这所职业学院侧重实用的工业培训。

e.en: The essay criticizes modern {technism} in urban planning.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评城市规划中的现代技术主义。

e.en: A certain {technism} marks the architect's later work.
e.zh: 某种技术特征体现了这位建筑师后期作品的特点。

e.en: The manual was full of {techno-babble} and vague promises.
e.zh: 这本手册满是技术行话和含糊的承诺。

e.en: He hid a weak idea behind impressive {techno-babble}.
e.zh: 他用听起来厉害的科技胡扯掩盖一个薄弱的想法。

techno-industrial.t: 技术工业的；科技工业风的

e.en: The region became a {techno-industrial} center after decades of investment.
e.zh: 经过数十年投资，该地区成了技术工业中心。

e.en: The band used a harsh {techno-industrial} sound on the album.
e.zh: 这支乐队在专辑中采用了粗粝的科技工业风音色。

e.en: Loud {techno-music} filled the club after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，俱乐部里响满了高音量电子舞曲。

e.en: She studies {techno-music} as part of youth culture.
e.zh: 她把科技音乐作为青年文化的一部分来研究。

e.en: The singer moved from rock into bright {techno-pop}.
e.zh: 这位歌手从摇滚转向明快的电子流行乐。

e.en: Their early {techno-pop} still sounds fresh today.
e.zh: 他们早期的电子流行乐今天听起来仍然新鲜。

e.en: The salesman used {technobabble} to impress the buyers.
e.zh: 销售员用技术行话来唬住买家。

e.en: Good science writing avoids empty {technobabble}.
e.zh: 好的科普写作会避免空洞的科技胡扯。

e.en: The military {technocomplex} shaped national research priorities.
e.zh: 军事技术综合体影响了国家研究重点。

e.en: Modern hospitals form a dense {technocomplex} of machines and staff.
e.zh: 现代医院形成了由机器和人员组成的密集技术体系。

e.en: Her {technofear} faded after a patient friend taught her.
e.zh: 一位有耐心的朋友教过她后，她的技术恐惧减轻了。

e.en: The article links {technofear} to rapid workplace automation.
e.zh: 这篇文章把科技焦虑与职场快速自动化联系起来。

e.en: My brother is a {technofreak} who buys every new gadget.
e.zh: 我弟弟是个科技迷，每种新设备都要买。

e.en: Only a real {technofreak} would enjoy configuring that server.
e.zh: 只有真正的技术狂人才会喜欢配置那台服务器。

e.en: The engineer attached a {technograph} to the report.
e.zh: 工程师在报告后附上了一张技术图表。

e.en: The archive preserves a {technograph} of the early machine.
e.zh: 档案馆保存了那台早期机器的技术记录。

e.en: Her dissertation used {technography} to study factory routines.
e.zh: 她的论文用技术志方法研究工厂日常流程。

e.en: Early {technography} described tools with unusual precision.
e.zh: 早期工艺记录法以异常精确的方式描述工具。

technolatry.t: 技术崇拜；迷信技术万能论

e.en: His essay criticized the company's {technolatry} after every meeting became about new tools.
e.zh: 他的文章批评公司迷信技术，因为每次会议都变成讨论新工具。

e.en: The museum display treated early computers with almost religious {technolatry}.
e.zh: 博物馆展览用近乎宗教般的技术崇拜来呈现早期电脑。

e.en: The district plans to {technologize} classrooms with tablets and online lessons.
e.zh: 该学区计划用平板和在线课程使课堂技术化。

e.en: Some critics say managers try to {technologize} every human problem.
e.zh: 一些批评者说，管理者试图把每个人的问题都技术化。

technologized.t: 已技术化的；经技术改造的

e.en: The factory became highly {technologized} after robots replaced most manual work.
e.zh: 机器人取代大部分手工劳动后，这家工厂变得高度技术化。

e.en: She worried that a fully {technologized} childhood would leave little room for boredom.
e.zh: 她担心完全技术化的童年会让孩子几乎没有发呆的空间。

technology-assisted.t: 技术辅助的；借助技术的

e.en: The school introduced {technology-assisted} reading lessons for struggling students.
e.zh: 学校为阅读困难的学生推出了技术辅助阅读课。

e.en: Doctors used a {technology-assisted} procedure to monitor the patient's heart remotely.
e.zh: 医生采用技术辅助程序远程监测病人的心脏。

technomania.t: 技术狂热；对技术的迷恋

e.en: The mayor's {technomania} led to sensors being installed on every streetlight.
e.zh: 市长的技术狂热导致每盏路灯都装上了传感器。

e.en: During the boom, {technomania} made even ordinary gadgets seem revolutionary.
e.zh: 在那段热潮中，技术狂热让普通小工具也显得像革命性产品。

technometrics.t: 技术计量学；技术指标分析

e.en: The report used {technometrics} to compare innovation across several industries.
e.zh: 这份报告用技术计量学比较多个行业的创新情况。

e.en: Her team studies {technometrics} rather than consumer opinions about gadgets.
e.zh: 她的团队研究技术指标分析，而不是消费者对电子产品的看法。

technonomy.t: 技术法则；技术体系规律

e.en: The philosopher used {technonomy} to describe rules created by modern machines.
e.zh: 那位哲学家用技术法则来描述现代机器产生的规则。

e.en: In this course, {technonomy} refers to how tools organize social life.
e.zh: 在这门课中，技术体系规律指工具如何组织社会生活。

technophilia.t: 技术爱好；对技术的热爱

e.en: Her {technophilia} began when she built a radio as a child.
e.zh: 她小时候组装收音机时，就开始对技术产生热爱。

e.en: The article contrasts {technophilia} with fear of automation.
e.zh: 这篇文章把技术爱好与对自动化的恐惧作了对比。

e.en: His {technophobia} made online banking feel impossible.
e.zh: 他的技术恐惧让网上银行看起来根本无法使用。

e.en: The campaign tried to reduce {technophobia} among older workers.
e.zh: 这项活动试图减轻年长员工对新科技的害怕。

technophobic.t: 害怕技术的；排斥新科技的

e.en: My grandfather is not {technophobic}; he just dislikes tiny phone screens.
e.zh: 我爷爷并不害怕技术，他只是讨厌手机屏幕太小。

e.en: The policy sounded {technophobic} to engineers who wanted better tools.
e.zh: 对想要更好工具的工程师来说，这项政策听起来很排斥新科技。

technopolis.t: 科技城；技术主导的城市

e.en: The government promoted the area as a new {technopolis} for software firms.
e.zh: 政府把该地区宣传为面向软件公司的新科技城。

e.en: In his book, the {technopolis} is a society ruled by technical systems.
e.zh: 在他的书中，技术主导的城市是由技术系统支配的社会。

technopolitan.t: 科技都市人的；技术都市化的

e.en: The magazine described him as a {technopolitan} traveler with three phones.
e.zh: 杂志把他描述成带着三部手机的科技都市旅行者。

e.en: Their office has a polished, {technopolitan} style common in start-up districts.
e.zh: 他们的办公室有一种创业区常见的精致科技都市风格。

technopsychology.t: 技术心理学；科技与心理研究

e.en: The seminar on {technopsychology} examined how apps shape attention.
e.zh: 这场技术心理学研讨会研究应用程序如何塑造注意力。

e.en: She applies {technopsychology} when designing calmer interfaces for hospitals.
e.zh: 她在为医院设计更平和的界面时运用科技与心理研究。

e.en: Satellites and data centers are part of the modern {technosphere}.
e.zh: 卫星和数据中心都是现代技术圈的一部分。

e.en: The novel imagines a {technosphere} that grows beyond human control.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了一个超出人类控制的人造技术环境。

technostructure.t: 技术官僚结构；技术管理层

e.en: The economist argued that the {technostructure} shaped decisions more than owners did.
e.zh: 这位经济学家认为，技术管理层比所有者更能影响决策。

e.en: A large {technostructure} can make a company efficient but slow to change.
e.zh: 庞大的技术官僚结构能提高公司效率，但也会让变革变慢。

technotronic.t: 技术电子化的；受科技电子控制的

e.en: The author predicted a {technotronic} age shaped by computers and communications.
e.zh: 作者预言了一个由电脑和通信塑造的技术电子化时代。

e.en: Their music had a cold, {technotronic} sound built from loops and pulses.
e.zh: 他们的音乐由循环和脉冲构成，带有冷峻的电子科技感。

e.en: The old cabinet was made of dark {teck} from a colonial workshop.
e.zh: 这个旧柜子是殖民时期工坊用深色柚木做成的。

e.en: Builders valued {teck} because it resisted water and insects.
e.zh: 建筑工人看重柚木，因为它能防水并抵抗虫害。

e.en: The sign said {tecnology}, but the teacher corrected it to technology.
e.zh: 牌子上写成了tecnology，但老师把它改成technology。

e.en: He typed {tecnology} by mistake in the title of his report.
e.zh: 他在报告标题里误把technology打成了tecnology。

tectogene.t: 成构造的；构造形成因素

e.en: The geologist described the fault as a {tectogene} feature of the mountain belt.
e.zh: 地质学家把这条断层描述为山带中的成构造特征。

e.en: Researchers debated whether heat flow was the main {tectogene} in the region.
e.zh: 研究人员争论热流是否是该地区主要的构造形成因素。

tectogenesis.t: 构造发生；地壳构造形成

e.en: The lecture explained {tectogenesis} in terms of plate movement and stress.
e.zh: 讲座用板块运动和应力解释了地壳构造形成。

e.en: Ancient {tectogenesis} shaped the basin long before humans arrived.
e.zh: 在人类到来很久以前，古老的构造发生塑造了这个盆地。

e.en: His notes on {tectology} linked geology with general systems theory.
e.zh: 他关于构造学的笔记把地质学与一般系统理论联系起来。

e.en: Bogdanov used {tectology} to describe principles of organization in nature and society.
e.zh: 波格丹诺夫用组织结构理论描述自然和社会中的组织原则。

tectonically.t: 从构造上；在地壳构造方面

e.en: The island is {tectonically} active and often experiences small earthquakes.
e.zh: 这座岛在地壳构造上很活跃，经常发生小地震。

e.en: Two regions that look similar may be {tectonically} very different.
e.zh: 两个看起来相似的地区，在构造方面可能非常不同。

e.en: A quiet {tee-hee} came from the back row.
e.zh: 后排传来一声轻轻的嘻嘻笑。

e.en: She said {tee-hee} after the silly joke.
e.zh: 听完那个傻笑话后，她嘻嘻笑了一声。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes call sesame oil {teel}.
e.zh: 老食谱有时把芝麻油称作teel。

e.en: The trader sold {teel} in small clay jars.
e.zh: 商人用小陶罐出售芝麻油。

e.en: The pond was {teemful} of tiny fish.
e.zh: 池塘里满是小鱼。

e.en: She described a {teemful} market at dawn.
e.zh: 她描述了黎明时人头攒动的市场。

e.en: The old poem calls the desert {teemless}.
e.zh: 那首古诗把沙漠称作荒芜无生。

e.en: They feared a {teemless} field after the drought.
e.zh: 干旱过后，他们担心田地寸草不生。

e.en: Her {teen-age} years were spent in Chicago.
e.zh: 她的青少年时期是在芝加哥度过的。

e.en: The magazine targeted {teen-age} readers.
e.zh: 这本杂志面向青少年读者。

e.en: A {teen-aged} boy answered the door.
e.zh: 一个十几岁的男孩来开门。

e.en: The program helps {teen-aged} mothers finish school.
e.zh: 这个项目帮助青少年母亲完成学业。

e.en: Every {teen-ager} needs some private space.
e.zh: 每个青少年都需要一点私人空间。

e.en: The film follows a {teen-ager} moving to a new city.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一个青少年搬到新城市后的经历。

e.en: She found a {teenie} crack in the cup.
e.zh: 她发现杯子上有一道极小的裂缝。

e.en: Could I have just a {teenie} bit more cake?
e.zh: 我能再吃一小点蛋糕吗？

e.en: This screw is {teenier} than the last one.
e.zh: 这颗螺丝比上一颗还要小。

e.en: Her handwriting grew {teenier} near the margin.
e.zh: 写到页边时，她的字变得更小了。

e.en: The shop became popular with every local {teenster}.
e.zh: 这家店很受当地青少年的欢迎。

e.en: A confident {teenster} led the school debate.
e.zh: 一名自信的少年主持了学校辩论。

e.en: There was a {teensy-weensy} spider in the sink.
e.zh: 水槽里有一只丁点儿大的蜘蛛。

e.en: I made one {teensy-weensy} mistake on the form.
e.zh: 我在表格上犯了一个很小很小的错误。

e.en: Add a {teentsy} pinch of salt.
e.zh: 加一丁点儿盐。

e.en: She gave him a {teentsy} smile.
e.zh: 她朝他露出一个很浅的小笑。

e.en: A {teenty} bead rolled under the table.
e.zh: 一颗极小的珠子滚到了桌子下面。

e.en: He asked for a {teenty} slice of pie.
e.zh: 他要了一小片派。

teeny-bopper.t: 追星少女；少年流行乐迷

e.en: She was a {teeny-bopper} when that band became famous.
e.zh: 那个乐队走红时，她还是个追星少女。

e.en: The article mocked every young {teeny-bopper} at the concert.
e.zh: 那篇文章嘲笑了演唱会上那些年轻的少年乐迷。

teeny-boppers.t: 追星少年少女；少年乐迷

e.en: The stadium was packed with screaming {teeny-boppers}.
e.zh: 体育场里挤满了尖叫的追星少年少女。

e.en: Critics dismissed the fans as {teeny-boppers}.
e.zh: 评论家把这些粉丝贬称为少年流行乐迷。

e.en: She kept a {teeny-tiny} kitten in her coat.
e.zh: 她把一只丁点儿大的小猫藏在外套里。

e.en: There is one {teeny-tiny} problem with your plan.
e.zh: 你的计划有一个非常小的问题。

e.en: He drew a {teeny-weeny} heart on the note.
e.zh: 他在便条上画了一颗小小的心。

e.en: I only want a {teeny-weeny} piece of chocolate.
e.zh: 我只想要一丁点儿巧克力。

teenybop.t: 少年流行文化；追星风格

e.en: The song had a bright {teenybop} sound.
e.zh: 这首歌带着明快的少年流行风格。

e.en: Magazines sold {teenybop} dreams to young readers.
e.zh: 杂志向年轻读者兜售少年追星式的梦想。

e.en: The first {teeoff} is scheduled for eight o'clock.
e.zh: 第一组开球定在八点。

e.en: His rude comment would {teeoff} any listener.
e.zh: 他那句粗鲁的话会惹恼任何听众。

e.en: The children played on the {teeter-totter} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后，孩子们在跷跷板上玩。

e.en: Prices seemed to {teeter-totter} all week.
e.zh: 整个星期价格似乎都在上下摇摆。

e.en: The acrobat jumped from the {teeterboard}.
e.zh: 杂技演员从跷板上弹跳起来。

e.en: They built a simple {teeterboard} for the playground.
e.zh: 他们给游乐场做了一个简易跷跷板。

tectonician.t: 构造地质学家；大地构造学家

e.en: The {tectonician} mapped faults across the basin.
e.zh: 这位构造地质学家绘制了盆地内断层分布图。

e.en: A skilled {tectonician} can read mountain history from folded rocks.
e.zh: 熟练的大地构造学家能从褶皱岩层中读出山脉历史。

tectonism.t: 地壳构造运动；构造作用

e.en: Regional {tectonism} lifted the old seabed into hills.
e.zh: 区域性地壳构造运动把古海床抬升成丘陵。

e.en: The paper links the fractures to late-stage {tectonism}.
e.zh: 论文把这些裂缝归因于晚期构造作用。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as a {tectonite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样品鉴定为构造岩。

e.en: A polished slice of {tectonite} showed aligned minerals.
e.zh: 一片抛光的变形构造岩显示出定向排列的矿物。

tectonization.t: 构造变形作用；构造化过程

e.en: Intense {tectonization} altered the original sedimentary layers.
e.zh: 强烈的构造变形作用改变了原来的沉积层。

e.en: The ore body shows signs of repeated {tectonization}.
e.zh: 这个矿体显示出反复构造化过程的迹象。

tectonomagnetism.t: 构造磁学；构造相关磁现象

e.en: Researchers used {tectonomagnetism} to study stress changes before earthquakes.
e.zh: 研究人员利用构造磁学研究地震前的应力变化。

e.en: The station recorded small signals of {tectonomagnetism} near the fault.
e.zh: 监测站在断层附近记录到微弱的构造相关磁现象。

e.en: The team installed a {tectonometer} beside the active fault.
e.zh: 小组在活动断层旁安装了一台地壳构造测量仪。

e.en: A sensitive {tectonometer} can detect tiny crustal movements.
e.zh: 灵敏的地壳构造测量仪能够探测微小的地壳运动。

tectonophysics.t: 构造物理学；地壳构造物理

e.en: She published her first article in {tectonophysics}.
e.zh: 她发表了第一篇构造物理学方面的论文。

e.en: Modern {tectonophysics} combines field geology with numerical models.
e.zh: 现代地壳构造物理结合了野外地质和数值模型。

e.en: The insect had a {tectorial} plate over its wing base.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的翅基上有一块覆盖状板片。

e.en: The surgeon noted a thin {tectorial} membrane in the joint.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到关节内有一层薄的覆盖膜。

e.en: Quartz is a common {tectosilicate} mineral.
e.zh: 石英是一种常见的架状硅酸盐矿物。

e.en: The class compared feldspar with another {tectosilicate}.
e.zh: 课堂上把长石同另一种网硅酸盐作了比较。

e.en: The ancient {tectosome} was bounded by two major faults.
e.zh: 这个古老构造体由两条主要断层限定。

e.en: Mapping the {tectosome} helped explain the region's mineral deposits.
e.zh: 绘制该地质构造单元有助于解释本区矿床分布。

e.en: The model treats the lithosphere as part of the {tectosphere}.
e.zh: 该模型把岩石圈视为构造圈的一部分。

e.en: Changes in the {tectosphere} can shape entire mountain belts.
e.zh: 地球构造层圈的变化能塑造整条山脉带。

e.en: The bird's {tectrices} partly covered the flight feathers.
e.zh: 这只鸟的覆羽部分遮住了飞羽。

e.en: Bright {tectrices} made the tail look larger during display.
e.zh: 鲜艳的尾部覆羽使展示时的尾巴显得更大。

e.en: One damaged {tectrix} stuck out from the wing.
e.zh: 一片受损的覆羽从翅膀上翘了出来。

e.en: The guide pointed to a brown {tectrix} near the tail.
e.zh: 向导指着尾部附近一片棕色的覆羽。

e.en: The {tectum} receives visual signals in many vertebrates.
e.zh: 许多脊椎动物的中脑顶盖接收视觉信号。

e.en: A bony {tectum} protected the delicate structure beneath it.
e.zh: 一层骨质顶盖保护着下面脆弱的结构。

e.en: The farmer will {tedd} the hay before noon.
e.zh: 农夫会在中午前翻晒干草。

e.en: They {tedd} the cut grass across the meadow.
e.zh: 他们把割下的草在草地上摊晒开来。

e.en: The hay was {tedded} twice before baling.
e.zh: 打捆前，干草被翻晒了两次。

e.en: Freshly {tedded} grass smelled sweet in the field.
e.zh: 刚翻晒过的草在田里散发出清甜气味。

e.en: The old {tedder} scattered hay across the field.
e.zh: 那台旧干草翻晒机把干草撒开在田里。

e.en: A careful {tedder} kept the rows loose and airy.
e.zh: 细心的翻晒工让草垄保持松散通风。

e.en: The {teddered} hay dried quickly in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 用翻晒机翻过的干草在午后阳光下很快变干。

e.en: Fields of {teddered} grass lay in pale green swaths.
e.zh: 一片片翻晒过的草地呈现出淡绿色条带。

teddering.t: 用翻晒机翻晒；翻晒作业

e.en: The farmer began {teddering} as soon as the dew lifted.
e.zh: 露水一干，农夫就开始用翻晒机翻晒。

e.en: Good {teddering} helps hay dry before evening rain.
e.zh: 良好的翻晒作业有助于干草在晚雨前变干。

teddie.t: 泰迪连身内衣；女式连体内衣

e.en: She packed a silk {teddie} for the weekend trip.
e.zh: 她为周末旅行带了一件丝质泰迪连身内衣。

e.en: The shop displayed a vintage {teddie} in the window.
e.zh: 商店橱窗里展示着一件复古女式连体内衣。

e.en: Early {tedding} kept the cut hay from molding.
e.zh: 及早翻晒干草防止割下的草发霉。

e.en: The crew finished {tedding} before the clouds returned.
e.zh: 云层回来之前，工人们完成了摊晒作业。

teddy-boy.t: 泰迪男孩；英式不良少年

e.en: The film follows a young {teddy-boy} in 1950s London.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了二十世纪五十年代伦敦一个年轻泰迪男孩的故事。

e.en: He dressed like a {teddy-boy} with a long jacket and narrow trousers.
e.zh: 他穿着长外套和窄裤，打扮得像个英式泰迪男孩。

e.en: The {tediosity} of the meeting exhausted everyone.
e.zh: 会议的冗长乏味让所有人都筋疲力尽。

e.en: She described the paperwork's {tediosity} with dry humor.
e.zh: 她用冷幽默描述了文书工作的令人厌烦之处。

e.en: The children played on the {teetertotter} after school.
e.zh: 放学后，孩子们在跷跷板上玩。

e.en: The old chair seemed to {teetertotter} on the uneven floor.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子在不平的地板上似乎摇摇晃晃。

e.en: He took a {teetery} step toward the door.
e.zh: 他摇摇晃晃地朝门口迈了一步。

e.en: The ladder felt {teetery} in the strong wind.
e.zh: 大风中，那架梯子感觉很不稳。

e.en: The baby began to {teethe} at six months.
e.zh: 宝宝六个月大时开始长牙。

e.en: New companies often {teethe} on small but painful mistakes.
e.zh: 新公司常常在一些虽小却痛的错误中经历起步磨合。

e.en: The fossil showed a clear {teethridge} along the jaw.
e.zh: 这块化石的颌骨上有一条清晰的齿状脊。

e.en: The dentist noticed a raised {teethridge} behind the front teeth.
e.zh: 牙医注意到门牙后方有一道凸起的牙脊。

e.en: Her family practiced {teetotalism} for religious reasons.
e.zh: 她家出于宗教原因奉行滴酒不沾。

e.en: The movement promoted {teetotalism} as a path to public health.
e.zh: 这个运动把禁酒主义宣传为改善公共健康的途径。

e.en: My grandfather was a strict {teetotalist} all his life.
e.zh: 我祖父一生都是严格的滴酒不沾者。

e.en: As a {teetotalist}, she ordered sparkling water at the bar.
e.zh: 作为不喝酒的人，她在酒吧点了气泡水。

e.en: The child spun a wooden {teetotum} on the table.
e.zh: 孩子在桌上转动一个木制陀螺。

e.en: The old game used a {teetotum} instead of dice.
e.zh: 这种老游戏用旋转陀螺来代替骰子。

e.en: The kids watched {teevee} before dinner.
e.zh: 孩子们晚饭前看了电视。

e.en: He bought a new {teevee} for the living room.
e.zh: 他给客厅买了一台新电视机。

e.en: The farmer sold a healthy {teg} at market.
e.zh: 农夫在集市上卖了一只健康的两岁羊。

e.en: A {teg} grazed quietly near the stone wall.
e.zh: 一只青年母羊在石墙旁安静地吃草。

e.en: His interest in {tegestology} began with one old coaster.
e.zh: 他对啤酒杯垫收藏的兴趣始于一张旧杯垫。

e.en: The museum hosted a small exhibit on {tegestology}.
e.zh: 博物馆举办了一个关于啤酒杯垫收藏研究的小展览。

e.en: The insect's {tegillum} protected a delicate joint.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的小盖片保护着一个脆弱的关节。

e.en: The specimen showed a tiny {tegillum} under the lens.
e.zh: 标本在镜头下显出一片细小的覆盖片。

e.en: The diagram labeled several brain {tegmenta} in different colors.
e.zh: 图表用不同颜色标出了几处脑部被盖。

e.en: Damaged {tegmenta} can affect movement and alertness.
e.zh: 被盖组织受损可能影响运动和清醒程度。

e.en: The beetle's {tegmina} looked hard and glossy.
e.zh: 这只甲虫的覆翅看起来坚硬而有光泽。

e.en: Scientists examined the {tegmina} to identify the species.
e.zh: 科学家检查这些翅盖来鉴定物种。

e.en: The roof had a {tegular} pattern of red clay tiles.
e.zh: 屋顶呈红色陶瓦的覆瓦式排列。

e.en: A {tegular} edge helped the panels overlap neatly.
e.zh: 瓦状边缘让这些板材整齐地相互搭接。

e.en: The parasite's {tegument} protects it inside the host.
e.zh: 寄生虫的外皮使它能在宿主体内受到保护。

e.en: A seed's {tegument} can be surprisingly tough.
e.zh: 种子的外被膜有时会相当坚硬。

e.en: She gave a small {tehee} behind her hand.
e.zh: 她用手掩着嘴轻轻嘻嘻一笑。

e.en: A nervous {tehee} escaped from the back row.
e.zh: 后排传来一声紧张的窃笑。

e.en: The road crew spread hot {tehr} over the cracks.
e.zh: 道路工人在裂缝上铺了一层热焦油。

e.en: His boots were stained with sticky {tehr}.
e.zh: 他的靴子沾上了黏糊糊的沥青。

e.en: The village belongs to a {tehsil} near Jaipur.
e.zh: 这个村庄隶属于斋浦尔附近的一个县级分区。

e.en: Land records are kept at the {tehsil} office.
e.zh: 土地记录保存在该县级分区办事处。

e.en: Grandma served sticky {teiglach} after the holiday meal.
e.zh: 节日餐后，奶奶端上了黏甜的蜂蜜面团点心。

e.en: The bakery makes {teiglach} with nuts and ginger.
e.zh: 这家面包店用坚果和姜制作蜂蜜面团甜点。

e.en: The biologist photographed a fast-moving {teiid} in the desert.
e.zh: 生物学家在沙漠中拍到一只行动迅速的鞭尾蜥科蜥蜴。

e.en: A {teiid} often has a long tail and slender body.
e.zh: 鞭尾蜥科蜥蜴通常尾巴很长，身体细长。

e.en: A large {teil} shaded the village square.
e.zh: 一棵高大的椴树为村庄广场遮阴。

e.en: They carved the statue from soft {teil} wood.
e.zh: 他们用柔软的椴木雕刻了这尊像。

e.en: The tenant once paid a {teind} to the church.
e.zh: 佃户过去曾向教会缴纳什一税。

e.en: In old law, {teind} meant a tenth of the produce.
e.zh: 在旧法律中，teind指收成的十分之一。

e.en: We tasted {tej} at an Ethiopian restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在一家埃塞俄比亚餐馆品尝了蜂蜜酒。

e.en: Traditional {tej} is often flavored with gesho leaves.
e.zh: 传统埃塞俄比亚蜂蜜酒常用格绍叶调味。

teknonymy.t: 以子女名号称呼父母的习俗

e.en: In some villages, {teknonymy} replaces personal names after childbirth.
e.zh: 在一些村庄，孩子出生后，人们会用子女名号来称呼父母。

e.en: The anthropologist studied {teknonymy} among several island communities.
e.zh: 这位人类学家研究了几个岛屿社群中的亲子名号称谓习俗。

e.en: She found a dark {tektite} near the old crater.
e.zh: 她在旧陨石坑附近发现了一块深色玻璃陨石。

e.en: A {tektite} forms when intense heat melts surface rocks.
e.zh: 玻璃陨石是在高温熔化地表岩石后形成的。

tektitic.t: 玻璃陨石的；似玻璃陨石的

e.en: The sample had a glossy, {tektitic} surface.
e.zh: 这个样本表面光亮，带有玻璃陨石般的质感。

e.en: Researchers compared the {tektitic} fragments with volcanic glass.
e.zh: 研究人员把这些玻璃陨石状碎片同火山玻璃作了比较。

e.en: The old text describes a fine {tela} woven by hand.
e.zh: 这部古籍描述了一种手工织成的精细织物。

e.en: The surgeon examined the damaged {tela} around the organ.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了器官周围受损的组织薄层。

e.en: Victorian writers sometimes treated {telaesthesia} as a psychic gift.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作者有时把远距离感知视为一种通灵天赋。

e.en: The report used {telaesthesia} to explain her knowledge of the event.
e.zh: 那份报告用遥感知觉来解释她为何知道那件事。

e.en: A carved {telamon} supported the balcony above the entrance.
e.zh: 入口上方的阳台由一尊雕刻男像柱支撑。

e.en: The doctor adjusted the {telamon} around the patient's chest.
e.zh: 医生调整了病人胸前的支撑带。

telamones.t: 男像柱复数；支撑带复数

e.en: Four stone {telamones} stood along the temple facade.
e.zh: 四尊石质男像柱立在神庙正面。

e.en: The museum guide pointed out the {telamones} above the doorway.
e.zh: 博物馆导览员指出了门廊上方的男像柱。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed mild {telangiectasia} on her cheeks.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生诊断她脸颊有轻度毛细血管扩张症。

e.en: Laser treatment can reduce visible {telangiectasia}.
e.zh: 激光治疗可以减轻可见的毛细血管扩张。

e.en: Chronic sun damage may cause {telangiectasis} on the nose.
e.zh: 长期日晒损伤可能导致鼻部毛细血管扩张。

e.en: The biopsy showed areas of {telangiectasis} in the tissue.
e.zh: 活检显示组织中有毛细血管扩张区域。

e.en: The physician noted {telangiectasy} around the scar.
e.zh: 医生注意到疤痕周围有毛细血管扩张。

e.en: Severe {telangiectasy} can appear as red lines on the skin.
e.zh: 严重的毛细血管扩张会在皮肤上呈现红色线条。

e.en: The inventor demonstrated a {telantograph} at the exhibition.
e.zh: 发明家在展会上演示了一台远程书写传送装置。

e.en: Messages sent by {telantograph} preserved the writer's handwriting.
e.zh: 用远程书写传送装置发送的信息保留了书写者的笔迹。

e.en: The office received a {telautogram} bearing the director's signature.
e.zh: 办公室收到了一份带有主任签名的远传手写电报。

e.en: A {telautogram} could reproduce handwriting across a wire.
e.zh: 远传手写电报能通过线路复制笔迹。

e.en: The banker signed the document through a {telautograph}.
e.zh: 那位银行家通过传真手写电报机签署了文件。

e.en: An early {telautograph} transmitted handwriting electrically.
e.zh: 早期的传真手写电报机用电信号传送手写字迹。

e.en: The article traces the history of {telautography} in business offices.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了手写传真传送技术在商务办公室中的历史。

e.en: Before modern fax machines, {telautography} offered remote signatures.
e.zh: 在现代传真机出现之前，手写传真技术可用于远程签名。

e.en: Engineers once used {telautomatics} to describe remote machine control.
e.zh: 工程师曾用远程自动控制技术来描述机器的远程操控。

e.en: The lecture connected {telautomatics} with early robotics.
e.zh: 讲座把远程自动控制技术同早期机器人学联系起来。

e.en: The storm damaged several {tele-communications} lines.
e.zh: 暴风雨损坏了几条电信线路。

e.en: Modern {tele-communications} connect hospitals across the region.
e.zh: 现代远程通信把该地区的医院连接起来。

e.en: A {tele-operated} robot entered the damaged reactor.
e.zh: 一台远程操作的机器人进入了受损反应堆。

e.en: The surgeon used a {tele-operated} device during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术过程中使用了一台遥控设备。

e.en: The company hired agents for its {tele-sale} campaign.
e.zh: 公司为电话销售活动雇用了客服人员。

e.en: A successful {tele-sale} depends on clear product information.
e.zh: 成功的远程销售取决于清楚的产品信息。

e.en: The technician read the current from a {teleammeter}.
e.zh: 技术员从遥测电流表上读取了电流值。

e.en: A {teleammeter} allowed measurements from a distant station.
e.zh: 遥测电流表可以让人从远处站点进行测量。

e.en: The old manual called the system {telearchics}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把这种系统称为远程控制学。

e.en: Early {telearchics} influenced later remote-control engineering.
e.zh: 早期远控技术影响了后来的远程控制工程。

e.en: The course introduced {teleautomatics} as a branch of control engineering.
e.zh: 这门课程把远程自动控制技术作为控制工程的一个分支来介绍。

e.en: Factories experimented with {teleautomatics} for dangerous tasks.
e.zh: 工厂曾试验用远程自动控制技术来完成危险任务。

telebar.t: 电视转播酒吧；远程酒吧

e.en: Fans gathered at the {telebar} to watch the match.
e.zh: 球迷们聚在电视转播酒吧观看比赛。

e.en: The resort advertised a {telebar} with live links to other cities.
e.zh: 度假村宣传设有一间可与其他城市实时连线的远程酒吧。

e.en: The lookout used a {telebinocular} instrument to scan the harbor.
e.zh: 瞭望员用一台远距双筒望远仪器扫视港口。

e.en: A {telebinocular} view made the distant ridge appear close.
e.zh: 远距双筒望远镜的视野让远处山脊显得很近。

e.en: The sensors send data through a {telebus} network.
e.zh: 这些传感器通过远程总线网络发送数据。

e.en: Engineers tested the {telebus} before connecting the control room.
e.zh: 工程师在连接控制室前测试了遥控总线。

telecamera.t: 电视摄像机；远程摄像机

e.en: The studio replaced its old {telecamera} with a digital model.
e.zh: 演播室把旧电视摄像机换成了数字型号。

e.en: A small {telecamera} monitored the entrance from another building.
e.zh: 一台小型远程摄像机从另一栋楼监控入口。

e.en: The clinic offers {telecardiography} for patients in distant villages.
e.zh: 诊所为偏远村庄的患者提供远程心电图检查。

e.en: Emergency doctors used {telecardiography} to review his heart rhythm.
e.zh: 急诊医生通过远程心电图检查查看他的心律。

e.en: The inspection system uses a {telecentric} lens for accurate measurements.
e.zh: 检测系统使用远心镜头来获得准确测量。

e.en: A {telecentric} design keeps object size stable across depth changes.
e.zh: 远心光学设计能在深度变化时保持物体大小稳定。

telecine.t: 胶片转电视设备；转录过程

e.en: The archive used {telecine} to transfer the film to video.
e.zh: 档案馆用胶片转电视设备把影片转成视频。

e.en: The restored movie went through {telecine} before broadcast.
e.zh: 修复后的电影在播出前经过了胶片转录。

e.en: The mine installed a {teleclinograph} to track ground movement.
e.zh: 矿井安装了遥测倾斜仪来跟踪地面移动。

e.en: Readings from the {teleclinograph} warned engineers of a slow tilt.
e.zh: 遥测倾斜仪的读数提醒工程师出现了缓慢倾斜。

e.en: The hospital updated its {telecobalt} unit last year.
e.zh: 医院去年更新了远距离钴放疗设备。

e.en: Doctors planned {telecobalt} treatment for the tumor.
e.zh: 医生为这个肿瘤安排了远距离钴放疗。

e.en: The patient received {telecobalttherapy} after surgery.
e.zh: 患者术后接受了远距离钴放射治疗。

e.en: Older cancer centers often relied on {telecobalttherapy}.
e.zh: 较早的癌症中心常依赖远距离钴放射治疗。

e.en: The two offices {telecommunicate} through a secure video link.
e.zh: 两个办公室通过安全视频连接进行电信交流。

e.en: Remote teams can {telecommunicate} without meeting in person.
e.zh: 远程团队无需见面也能通过电信方式沟通。

e.en: We have a {telecon} with the Tokyo team at noon.
e.zh: 我们中午要和东京团队开电话会议。

e.en: The project update was handled by {telecon}.
e.zh: 项目更新是通过远程会议处理的。

e.en: Scientists studied the {teleconnection} between ocean temperatures and rainfall.
e.zh: 科学家研究海温与降雨之间的遥相关。

e.en: The report describes a {teleconnection} linking distant climate patterns.
e.zh: 报告描述了连接远距离气候模式的遥相关。

e.en: She booked a {teleconsultation} with a dermatologist.
e.zh: 她预约了一次皮肤科远程咨询。

e.en: The rural clinic requested a {teleconsultation} with the city hospital.
e.zh: 乡村诊所请求与城市医院进行远程会诊。

e.en: The dam gates operate by {telecontrol} from the central station.
e.zh: 大坝闸门由中央站进行远程控制。

e.en: Engineers added {telecontrol} to reduce site visits.
e.zh: 工程师增加了遥控功能，以减少现场巡检。

e.en: He attached a {teleconverter} to photograph birds from farther away.
e.zh: 他装上增距镜，从更远处拍摄鸟类。

e.en: A cheap {teleconverter} can reduce image sharpness.
e.zh: 廉价增距镜可能会降低图像清晰度。

e.en: The crew launched a {telecopter} to inspect the roof.
e.zh: 工作人员放飞遥控直升机检查屋顶。

e.en: A small {telecopter} carried the camera over the crowd.
e.zh: 一架小型遥控直升机带着摄像机飞过人群上方。

e.en: The village opened a {telecottage} with computers and internet access.
e.zh: 村里开设了配有电脑和网络的乡村远程办公中心。

e.en: Freelancers used the {telecottage} as a shared workspace.
e.zh: 自由职业者把这个乡村远程办公中心当作共享工作场所。

telecoupler.t: 电话耦合器；远程耦合器

e.en: The modem needed a {telecoupler} to connect through the handset.
e.zh: 调制解调器需要电话耦合器才能通过听筒连接。

e.en: A damaged {telecoupler} interrupted the remote signal.
e.zh: 损坏的远程耦合器中断了远程信号。

e.en: She earned credits through a {telecourse} broadcast on public television.
e.zh: 她通过公共电视播出的电视课程获得了学分。

e.en: The college offered a {telecourse} for students living overseas.
e.zh: 学院为住在海外的学生开设了一门远程课程。

telectroscope.t: 远距电视装置；电望远镜

e.en: Early inventors imagined a {telectroscope} for seeing distant events.
e.zh: 早期发明家设想用电望远镜观看远方事件。

e.en: The novel describes a {telectroscope} that shows another city in real time.
e.zh: 小说描写了一种能实时显示另一座城市的远距电视装置。

e.en: The textbook describes {telecurietherapy} as an older radiation method.
e.zh: 教材把远距离镭放射治疗描述为一种较早的放疗方法。

e.en: Few hospitals still perform {telecurietherapy} today.
e.zh: 如今很少有医院仍进行远距离镭放射治疗。

e.en: The system supports {telediagnosis} using uploaded medical images.
e.zh: 该系统支持通过上传医学影像进行远程诊断。

e.en: Accurate {telediagnosis} depends on clear patient data.
e.zh: 准确的远程诊断依赖清晰的患者数据。

e.en: The channel aired a {teledrama} about rural doctors.
e.zh: 该频道播出了一部关于乡村医生的电视剧。

e.en: Her first script was a short {teledrama} for children.
e.zh: 她的第一部剧本是一部面向儿童的短篇电视戏剧。

e.en: The {teledu} is sometimes called the stink badger.
e.zh: 马来亚鼬獾有时被称为臭獾。

e.en: A {teledu} foraged near the forest path at night.
e.zh: 一只马来亚鼬獾夜里在林间小路旁觅食。

teledynamic.t: 远距离传力的；遥控动力的

e.en: The engineer described a {teledynamic} system for moving machinery remotely.
e.zh: 工程师描述了一套可远距离驱动机械的遥控动力系统。

e.en: Early inventors imagined {teledynamic} devices powered from far away.
e.zh: 早期发明家设想过由远处供能的远距离传力装置。

e.en: The contract arrived by {telefacsimile} before noon.
e.zh: 合同在中午前通过传真送达。

e.en: Scientists used {telefacsimile} equipment to transmit the image.
e.zh: 科学家用远程传真设备传送了这幅图像。

telefault.t: 远程故障；电话线路故障

e.en: The technician traced the {telefault} to a damaged cable.
e.zh: 技术员把这处电话线路故障追查到一根受损电缆。

e.en: A sudden {telefault} interrupted calls across the district.
e.zh: 一次突发的远程线路故障中断了全区通话。

e.en: She {telefaxed} the signed form to the office.
e.zh: 她把签好的表格传真到了办公室。

e.en: The {telefaxed} copy was hard to read.
e.zh: 那份传真过来的副本很难辨认。

e.en: The network aired a {telefeature} about rural hospitals.
e.zh: 电视网播出了一部关于乡村医院的电视专题片。

e.en: Her novel was adapted into a {telefeature} in 1982.
e.zh: 她的小说在1982年被改编成电视长片。

e.en: We reached the summit by a {teleferic} railway.
e.zh: 我们乘索道铁路到达了山顶。

e.en: The old {teleferic} cabin swayed above the valley.
e.zh: 老旧的缆车车厢在山谷上方摇晃。

e.en: The director made a {telefilm} for public television.
e.zh: 导演为公共电视台拍了一部电视电影。

e.en: This {telefilm} uses a quieter style than his cinema work.
e.zh: 这部电视电影的风格比他的院线作品更克制。

teleflash.t: 电视快讯；远传闪光信号

e.en: A {teleflash} interrupted the program with breaking news.
e.zh: 一条电视快讯打断节目播报了突发新闻。

e.en: The device sent a {teleflash} to mark the event.
e.zh: 这台装置发出远传闪光信号来标记事件。

e.en: The clinic used {telefluoroscopy} to examine the patient's chest.
e.zh: 诊所使用远距荧光透视检查病人的胸部。

e.en: Early {telefluoroscopy} reduced the doctor's exposure to radiation.
e.zh: 早期远距荧光透视减少了医生受到的辐射。

e.en: The warehouse installed a {telefork} on the lift truck.
e.zh: 仓库在叉车上安装了伸缩货叉。

e.en: A {telefork} lets the operator reach pallets farther inside the rack.
e.zh: 伸缩货叉让操作员能叉取货架更深处的托盘。

e.en: The peasant loaded hay onto a wooden {telega}.
e.zh: 农民把干草装上一辆木制俄式四轮马车。

e.en: A rattling {telega} passed the inn at dawn.
e.zh: 一辆嘎吱作响的俄式四轮马车在黎明时经过客栈。

e.en: The dam uses a {telegauge} to report water levels.
e.zh: 水坝使用远程测量仪报告水位。

e.en: A faulty {telegauge} sent the wrong pressure reading.
e.zh: 一台故障的遥测计发出了错误的压力读数。

e.en: The paper discussed {telegenesis} in unusual biological changes.
e.zh: 论文讨论了异常生物变化中的远因生成。

e.en: Some occult writers used {telegenesis} to explain distant effects.
e.zh: 一些神秘学作者用远距发生来解释远方效应。

e.en: The medium claimed {telegnomy} during the experiment.
e.zh: 那名灵媒声称在实验中具有遥知术。

e.en: Victorian writers treated {telegnomy} as a mysterious faculty.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作者把远距感知视为一种神秘能力。

e.en: His book links {telegnosis} with clairvoyance.
e.zh: 他的书把遥知与千里眼式的超感能力联系起来。

e.en: The investigator found no evidence for {telegnosis}.
e.zh: 调查者没有找到支持超感远知的证据。

e.en: She rejected the alleged {telegnostic} message as coincidence.
e.zh: 她把所谓的遥知信息视为巧合而不予接受。

e.en: The lecture examined {telegnostic} claims from early psychology.
e.zh: 讲座考察了早期心理学中的超感远知说法。

e.en: The breeder used {telegon} in an obsolete theory of heredity.
e.zh: 育种者在一种过时的遗传理论中使用了远子这个概念。

e.en: A supposed {telegon} would show traits from a previous sire.
e.zh: 所谓远子会表现出先前雄性亲本的特征。

telegonic.t: 先父遗传的；感孕遗传的

e.en: The article dismissed {telegonic} inheritance as unsupported.
e.zh: 文章否定了感孕遗传，认为它缺乏证据。

e.en: Old breeders sometimes feared a {telegonic} influence on later offspring.
e.zh: 旧时育种者有时担心后代会受到先父遗传影响。

e.en: The survey team carried a {telegoniometer} into the field.
e.zh: 测量队把远距测角仪带到野外。

e.en: A {telegoniometer} helped measure the angle from a distance.
e.zh: 远距测角仪帮助从远处测量角度。

e.en: Modern genetics has rejected {telegony}.
e.zh: 现代遗传学已经否定了先父遗传说。

e.en: The novel mentions {telegony} as a strange old belief.
e.zh: 小说把感孕遗传说作为一种古怪旧观念提到。

e.en: The note was written in clipped {telegraphese}.
e.zh: 这张便条用简短的电报体写成。

e.en: His wartime diary often slips into {telegraphese}.
e.zh: 他的战时日记常常变成省略很多的电报体。

telegraphically.t: 用电报方式；简略地；像电报文体地

e.en: The news was sent {telegraphically} across the country.
e.zh: 这条消息通过电报传遍全国。

e.en: She answered {telegraphically}, leaving out every polite phrase.
e.zh: 她回答得像电报一样简短，省去了所有客套话。

e.en: The {telegraphist} tapped out the message before dawn.
e.zh: 电报员在天亮前敲出了那条消息。

e.en: A skilled {telegraphist} could recognize a sender by rhythm.
e.zh: 熟练的报务员能凭节奏认出发报人。

e.en: The museum displayed a working {telegraphone} from 1900.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台1900年的可用电磁录音机。

e.en: Engineers saw the {telegraphone} as a breakthrough in sound recording.
e.zh: 工程师们把这种早期磁性录音机视为录音技术的突破。

e.en: Inventors imagined a {telegraphoscope} that could show distant scenes.
e.zh: 发明家曾设想一种能显示远方景象的远距影像装置。

e.en: The article used {telegraphoscope} for a fanciful television-like machine.
e.zh: 那篇文章用这个词指一种类似电视的幻想机器。

teleguide.t: 遥控导航装置；远程引导系统

e.en: The missile followed signals from a ground-based {teleguide}.
e.zh: 导弹按照地面遥控导航装置发出的信号飞行。

e.en: Engineers tested the {teleguide} on a small unmanned vehicle.
e.zh: 工程师在一辆小型无人车上测试了远程引导系统。

e.en: The patent described a {teleiophane} for transmitting pictures electrically.
e.zh: 专利描述了一种用电传送图像的早期远距成像装置。

e.en: Few people today have heard of the {teleiophane}.
e.zh: 如今很少有人听说过这种早期远距成像设备。

telekinetically.t: 以念动力方式；靠意念移物地

e.en: In the story, she {telekinetically} lifted the locked box.
e.zh: 在故事里，她用念动力举起了那个锁住的盒子。

e.en: The magician seemed to move the glass {telekinetically}.
e.zh: 那位魔术师看起来像是靠意念移动了玻璃杯。

e.en: The film's hero is a young {telekineticist}.
e.zh: 这部电影的主角是一名年轻的念动力者。

e.en: The researcher claimed the {telekineticist} could bend metal without touching it.
e.zh: 研究者声称这名意念移物者不用接触就能弯曲金属。

e.en: The inventor proposed a {telelectric} system for controlling machines at a distance.
e.zh: 发明家提出了一套远距离电控机器的遥电系统。

e.en: Old journals praised the {telelectric} apparatus as futuristic.
e.zh: 旧期刊称赞这种远距电力装置很有未来感。

e.en: The clinic installed a {telelectrocardiograph} for rural patients.
e.zh: 诊所为乡村患者安装了一台远程心电图仪。

e.en: A {telelectrocardiograph} sends heart signals to a distant specialist.
e.zh: 远程心电图仪会把心脏信号传给远处的专科医生。

telelectroscope.t: 远距验电器；遥测电位仪

e.en: The laboratory used a {telelectroscope} to observe electrical changes remotely.
e.zh: 实验室用远距验电器远程观察电荷变化。

e.en: His notes mention a crude {telelectroscope} connected by wire.
e.zh: 他的笔记提到一台用导线连接的简易远距验电器。

e.en: Students watched the professor's {telelecture} from another campus.
e.zh: 学生们在另一个校区观看教授的远程讲座。

e.en: The archive includes a 1960s {telelecture} on chemistry.
e.zh: 档案中有一段20世纪60年代的化学电视讲课。

e.en: She used a {telelens} to photograph birds across the lake.
e.zh: 她用长焦镜头拍摄湖对岸的鸟。

e.en: The old camera came with a heavy {telelens}.
e.zh: 那台旧相机配有一个沉重的远摄镜头。

telelibrary.t: 远程图书馆；电子图书馆

e.en: The university launched a {telelibrary} for off-campus students.
e.zh: 大学为校外学生开通了远程图书馆。

e.en: A {telelibrary} can deliver scanned articles within minutes.
e.zh: 电子图书馆能在几分钟内提供扫描文章。

teleman.t: 电信工人；电视工作人员

e.en: The {teleman} repaired the line after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，电信工人修好了线路。

e.en: As a studio {teleman}, he handled cables and lights.
e.zh: 作为电视台工作人员，他负责电缆和灯光。

telemechanics.t: 远程机械学；遥控机械技术

e.en: The course introduced the basics of {telemechanics}.
e.zh: 这门课介绍了远程机械学的基础。

e.en: Modern robotics still draws on ideas from early {telemechanics}.
e.zh: 现代机器人技术仍借鉴早期遥控机械技术的思想。

e.en: The gate opened by means of a hidden {telemechanism}.
e.zh: 大门通过隐藏的遥控机械装置打开。

e.en: Each {telemechanism} had to respond instantly to radio commands.
e.zh: 每个遥控机械装置都必须立即响应无线电指令。

e.en: The operator printed the {telemessage} on yellow paper.
e.zh: 操作员把电传信息打印在黄色纸上。
