e.en: Students learned {thermochemistry} after basic reaction kinetics.
e.zh: 学生在学习基础反应动力学后学习热化学。

e.en: Industrial safety often depends on accurate {thermochemistry}.
e.zh: 工业安全常常依赖准确的化学热效应研究。

thermochromism.t: 热致变色；随温度变色现象

e.en: The mug demonstrates {thermochromism} when hot coffee is poured in.
e.zh: 倒入热咖啡时，这个杯子会显示热致变色现象。

e.en: Researchers tested {thermochromism} in the new smart window film.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了新型智能窗膜的随温度变色特性。

e.en: Doctors used {thermocoagulation} to treat the tiny lesion.
e.zh: 医生用热凝治疗处理了那个小病灶。

e.en: Protein {thermocoagulation} changes the texture of cooked egg white.
e.zh: 蛋白质热凝固会改变熟蛋清的质地。

e.en: The label used {thermocolor} ink to show safe serving temperature.
e.zh: 标签使用热变色油墨来显示安全食用温度。

e.en: Designers liked the playful effect of {thermocolor} on the cup.
e.zh: 设计师喜欢杯子上温变颜色带来的趣味效果。

e.en: The British manual called the coating {thermocolour} paint.
e.zh: 英国手册把这种涂层称为温变涂料。

e.en: A strip of {thermocolour} paper darkened near the heater.
e.zh: 一条热变色纸靠近加热器时颜色变深了。

thermocompensator.t: 温度补偿器；热补偿装置

e.en: The clock used a {thermocompensator} to reduce timing errors.
e.zh: 这只钟使用温度补偿器来减少走时误差。

e.en: Engineers added a {thermocompensator} to stabilize the instrument.
e.zh: 工程师加装了热补偿装置来稳定仪器。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {thermogalvanometer} before the heat test.
e.zh: 工程师在热测试前校准了热电流计。

e.en: A sensitive {thermogalvanometer} detected tiny current changes.
e.zh: 灵敏的热电流计检测到了微小的电流变化。

e.en: Cold exposure can increase {thermogenesis} in brown fat.
e.zh: 寒冷暴露会增加棕色脂肪的产热作用。

e.en: The drug was studied for its effect on {thermogenesis}.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了这种药物对生热过程的影响。

thermogenetic.t: 产热的；生热遗传相关的

e.en: The paper described a {thermogenetic} response in insects.
e.zh: 论文描述了昆虫体内的一种产热反应。

e.en: Researchers used a {thermogenetic} tool to activate neurons.
e.zh: 研究人员使用热遗传工具来激活神经元。

e.en: Caffeine may have a mild {thermogenic} effect.
e.zh: 咖啡因可能有轻微的促进生热作用。

e.en: Brown fat is a highly {thermogenic} tissue.
e.zh: 棕色脂肪是一种产热能力很强的组织。

thermogeography.t: 热地理学；温度地理分布

e.en: The course introduced {thermogeography} through global climate maps.
e.zh: 这门课通过全球气候图介绍热地理学。

e.en: Her thesis examined the {thermogeography} of alpine plants.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了高山植物的温度地理分布。

e.en: The doctor examined the patient's {thermogram} for abnormal heat patterns.
e.zh: 医生查看病人的热像图，寻找异常热分布。

e.en: The {thermogram} showed heat loss around the window frame.
e.zh: 温度记录图显示窗框周围有热量流失。

e.en: A {thermograph} recorded the greenhouse temperature overnight.
e.zh: 温度记录仪记录了温室整夜的温度。

e.en: The inspector used a {thermograph} to find hidden leaks.
e.zh: 检查员用热成像仪寻找隐藏的漏水点。

thermographer.t: 热成像技师；温度记录人员

e.en: The {thermographer} scanned the electrical panel for hot spots.
e.zh: 热成像技师扫描配电板，寻找过热点。

e.en: A skilled {thermographer} can interpret subtle image patterns.
e.zh: 熟练的热成像人员能解读细微的图像模式。

thermographically.t: 用热成像方式；按热图法

e.en: The wall was inspected {thermographically} after the repair.
e.zh: 维修后，墙体接受了热成像检查。

e.en: The defect appeared {thermographically} as a bright patch.
e.zh: 这个缺陷在热图上表现为一块亮斑。

e.en: The lab ran a {thermogravimetric} analysis of the polymer.
e.zh: 实验室对这种聚合物进行了热重分析。

e.en: A {thermogravimetric} curve revealed when the sample decomposed.
e.zh: 热重曲线显示了样品开始分解的时间。

e.en: They used {thermogravimetry} to measure moisture loss.
e.zh: 他们用热重分析法测量水分损失。

e.en: In {thermogravimetry}, mass changes are tracked during heating.
e.zh: 在热重分析中，会跟踪加热时的质量变化。

thermohaline.t: 温盐的；由温度盐度驱动的

e.en: The {thermohaline} circulation moves heat through the oceans.
e.zh: 温盐环流在海洋中输送热量。

e.en: Scientists modeled {thermohaline} changes in the North Atlantic.
e.zh: 科学家模拟了北大西洋的温盐变化。

e.en: The resin is {thermohardening} and cannot be remelted easily.
e.zh: 这种树脂会受热硬化，不容易重新熔化。

e.en: A {thermohardening} coating protects the metal surface.
e.zh: 热硬化涂层保护金属表面。

e.en: The museum placed a {thermohygrograph} beside the paintings.
e.zh: 博物馆在画作旁放置了温湿度记录仪。

e.en: A faulty {thermohygrograph} gave misleading storage data.
e.zh: 故障的温湿度记录仪给出了误导性的储存数据。

e.en: The map showed each {thermoisopleth} across the valley.
e.zh: 地图显示了山谷中的每条等温线。

e.en: Meteorologists drew a {thermoisopleth} to compare daily temperatures.
e.zh: 气象学家绘制等温图线来比较每日温度。

e.en: The prototype used a {thermojet} to propel heated gas.
e.zh: 原型机使用热喷流来推动加热气体。

e.en: A small {thermojet} printer marked the packaging labels.
e.zh: 一台小型热喷射打印机给包装标签做标记。

e.en: The voltage depends on the temperature at the {thermojunction}.
e.zh: 电压取决于热电结处的温度。

e.en: Dust on the {thermojunction} distorted the sensor reading.
e.zh: 热电偶接点上的灰尘扭曲了传感器读数。

e.en: The lecture connected {thermokinematics} with molecular motion.
e.zh: 讲座把热运动学与分子运动联系起来。

e.en: Few textbooks treat {thermokinematics} as a separate topic.
e.zh: 很少有教材把热运动学作为独立主题来讲。

thermolabile.t: 热不稳定的；遇热易变的

e.en: The vaccine contains a {thermolabile} protein.
e.zh: 这种疫苗含有一种热不稳定蛋白。

e.en: Keep the {thermolabile} compound away from direct heat.
e.zh: 要让这种遇热易变的化合物远离直接热源。

e.en: The enzyme's {thermolability} limited its industrial use.
e.zh: 这种酶的热不稳定性限制了它的工业用途。

e.en: Researchers measured {thermolability} after repeated heating cycles.
e.zh: 研究人员在反复加热循环后测量热不稳定性。

thermolator.t: 温度调节器；热调节装置

e.en: The molding machine needs a {thermolator} to control water temperature.
e.zh: 这台成型机需要温度调节器来控制水温。

e.en: A broken {thermolator} caused uneven heating in the process.
e.zh: 损坏的热调节装置导致工艺中加热不均。

e.en: Early {thermology} focused on measuring heat accurately.
e.zh: 早期热学侧重于准确测量热量。

e.en: Medical {thermology} studies temperature patterns in the body.
e.zh: 医学温热研究关注人体内的温度模式。

e.en: The archaeologist dated the pottery with a {thermoluminescent} test.
e.zh: 考古学家用热释光测试来测定陶器年代。

e.en: A {thermoluminescent} crystal emits light when heated.
e.zh: 热释光晶体受热时会发光。

e.en: The experiment used {thermolysin} to digest the protein sample.
e.zh: 实验使用嗜热菌蛋白酶消化蛋白样品。

e.en: Purified {thermolysin} remains active at relatively high temperatures.
e.zh: 纯化的嗜热菌蛋白酶在较高温度下仍保持活性。

e.en: The polymer undergoes {thermolysis} at high temperatures.
e.zh: 这种聚合物在高温下会发生热分解。

e.en: Researchers studied {thermolysis} to improve fuel conversion.
e.zh: 研究人员研究热裂解以提高燃料转化效率。

thermomagnetic.t: 热磁的；与热磁效应有关的

e.en: The alloy showed unusual {thermomagnetic} behavior during heating.
e.zh: 这种合金在加热过程中表现出异常的热磁行为。

e.en: A {thermomagnetic} sensor can respond to changes in temperature.
e.zh: 热磁传感器可以对温度变化作出响应。

e.en: The paper explains {thermomagnetism} in rare-earth materials.
e.zh: 这篇论文解释了稀土材料中的热磁性。

e.en: Engineers used {thermomagnetism} to design a heat-driven device.
e.zh: 工程师利用热磁现象设计了一种热驱动装置。

e.en: The clinic offered {thermomastography} as a noninvasive screening method.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供乳房热成像检查作为无创筛查方法。

e.en: Doctors compared {thermomastography} with standard mammography results.
e.zh: 医生将乳房热成像检查结果与常规乳腺X光检查结果作比较。

e.en: The course covers {thermomechanics} of solids under stress.
e.zh: 这门课程讲授受力固体的热力机械学。

e.en: Modern engines require careful {thermomechanics} analysis.
e.zh: 现代发动机需要细致的热机械学分析。

e.en: The technician handled the {thermometal} with insulated tools.
e.zh: 技术员用绝缘工具处理受热金属材料。

e.en: A {thermometal} strip bends when its layers expand differently.
e.zh: 热金属片在各层膨胀不同的时候会弯曲。

e.en: The factory relies on {thermometallurgy} to extract nickel.
e.zh: 这家工厂依靠热法冶金提取镍。

e.en: Students learned how {thermometallurgy} changes ore composition.
e.zh: 学生们学习热冶金学如何改变矿石成分。

e.en: The rocks show signs of {thermometamorphism} near the intrusion.
e.zh: 这些岩石在侵入体附近显示出热变质作用的迹象。

e.en: Geologists mapped {thermometamorphism} around the old volcano.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了老火山周围的热变质作用分布图。

e.en: The nurse checked the child with a {thermometre}.
e.zh: 护士用温度计给孩子量体温。

e.en: This old {thermometre} uses mercury inside a glass tube.
e.zh: 这支旧温度计在玻璃管里使用水银。

e.en: The team recorded {thermometric} data every ten minutes.
e.zh: 团队每十分钟记录一次测温数据。

e.en: A {thermometric} scale must be calibrated carefully.
e.zh: 温度计刻度必须经过仔细校准。

e.en: The report included several {thermometrical} observations from the lab.
e.zh: 报告包含了实验室的几项温度测量观察。

e.en: Old instruments made {thermometrical} work slow but reliable.
e.zh: 旧仪器让测温工作缓慢但可靠。

thermometrically.t: 用温度计地；按测温方式

e.en: The samples were compared {thermometrically} after cooling.
e.zh: 样品冷却后按测温方式进行了比较。

e.en: The reaction was monitored {thermometrically} throughout the experiment.
e.zh: 整个实验过程中都用温度计监测该反应。

e.en: The station installed a {thermometrograph} to track daily changes.
e.zh: 气象站安装了一台自动温度记录仪来追踪每日变化。

e.en: A faulty {thermometrograph} gave misleading overnight readings.
e.zh: 一台故障的自动温度记录仪给出了误导性的夜间读数。

e.en: Accurate {thermometry} is essential in clinical care.
e.zh: 准确测温在临床护理中非常重要。

e.en: Infrared {thermometry} measures heat without touching the object.
e.zh: 红外测温法无需接触物体就能测量热量。

e.en: The {thermomicrograph} revealed cracks forming during heating.
e.zh: 这张热显微照片显示加热过程中形成了裂纹。

e.en: She compared each {thermomicrograph} with the control sample.
e.zh: 她把每张热显微图都与对照样品进行比较。

e.en: Chip designers studied {thermomigration} in tiny metal lines.
e.zh: 芯片设计人员研究微小金属线中的热迁移。

e.en: Strong temperature gradients can cause {thermomigration} of atoms.
e.zh: 强温度梯度会导致原子的温度驱动迁移。

e.en: The device uses a {thermomodule} to stabilize the sample.
e.zh: 该设备使用温控模块来稳定样品。

e.en: A compact {thermomodule} was fitted under the sensor plate.
e.zh: 一个紧凑的热模块被安装在传感器板下方。

e.en: The prototype {thermomotor} converted heat into mechanical motion.
e.zh: 这台原型热动机把热量转化为机械运动。

e.en: Early inventors tested a small {thermomotor} in the workshop.
e.zh: 早期发明者在车间里测试了一台小型热力发动机。

thermomultiplicator.t: 热电倍增器；热倍增装置

e.en: The old detector used a {thermomultiplicator} for weak signals.
e.zh: 这台旧探测器使用热电倍增器处理微弱信号。

e.en: A sensitive {thermomultiplicator} improved the measurement accuracy.
e.zh: 灵敏的热倍增装置提高了测量精度。

thermonasty.t: 感温性运动；热感应运动

e.en: Tulip petals show {thermonasty} as the day warms.
e.zh: 天气转暖时，郁金香花瓣会表现出感温性运动。

e.en: Botanists measured {thermonasty} in response to sudden cooling.
e.zh: 植物学家测量了植物对突然降温产生的热感应运动。

e.en: The desert deposit contained pale crystals of {thermonatrite}.
e.zh: 沙漠矿床中含有浅色的天然碳酸钠矿晶体。

e.en: Mineralogists identified {thermonatrite} in the evaporite sample.
e.zh: 矿物学家在蒸发岩样品中鉴定出天然碳酸钠矿。

thermoneutral.t: 热中性的；不耗温调能量的

e.en: Mice were kept in a {thermoneutral} environment during the study.
e.zh: 研究期间，小鼠被饲养在热中性环境中。

e.en: A {thermoneutral} zone reduces stress from cold or heat.
e.zh: 热中性区可以减少寒冷或高温带来的压力。

e.en: The laboratory once offered a course in {thermonucleonics}.
e.zh: 这家实验室曾开设一门热核子学课程。

e.en: Advances in {thermonucleonics} influenced reactor design.
e.zh: 热核工程学的进展影响了反应堆设计。

e.en: The novel imagines a city threatened by a {thermonuke}.
e.zh: 这部小说设想一座城市受到热核武器威胁。

e.en: Officials denied reports of a secret {thermonuke} test.
e.zh: 官员否认了秘密热核爆炸试验的报道。

e.en: Engineers applied {thermopaint} to reveal hot spots.
e.zh: 工程师涂上示温漆以显示热点位置。

e.en: The {thermopaint} changed color as the pipe heated.
e.zh: 管道升温时，热敏涂料改变了颜色。

e.en: Engineers measured {thermopenetration} through the insulation layer.
e.zh: 工程师测量了热量穿过绝缘层的渗透情况。

e.en: Low {thermopenetration} helps keep the package cool.
e.zh: 较低的热穿透性有助于让包装保持凉爽。

e.en: Seedlings responded strongly to daily {thermoperiodicity}.
e.zh: 幼苗对每日温度周期变化反应很明显。

e.en: The study compared {thermoperiodicity} across several habitats.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几个栖息地的温周期性。

thermoperiodism.t: 温周期现象；温周期作用

e.en: Plant flowering can be affected by {thermoperiodism}.
e.zh: 植物开花可能受到温周期作用的影响。

e.en: Researchers tested {thermoperiodism} under controlled night temperatures.
e.zh: 研究人员在受控夜间温度下测试温周期现象。

e.en: The sensor used a strip of {thermopermalloy}.
e.zh: 这个传感器使用了一条热磁坡莫合金片。

e.en: Heating changed the magnetic behavior of the {thermopermalloy}.
e.zh: 加热改变了这种热磁坡莫合金的磁性表现。

e.en: The circadian rhythm shifted during the warm {thermophase}.
e.zh: 在较暖的温度阶段，昼夜节律发生了偏移。

e.en: Scientists adjusted the {thermophase} in the growth chamber.
e.zh: 科学家调整了培养室中的热相位。

e.en: A {thermophil} thrives near hot springs.
e.zh: 嗜热生物能在温泉附近旺盛生长。

e.en: The culture contained an unusual {thermophil}.
e.zh: 这份培养物中含有一种不寻常的嗜热生物。

e.en: This {thermophile} survives in boiling water.
e.zh: 这种嗜热生物能在沸水中存活。

e.en: Enzymes from a {thermophile} are useful in industry.
e.zh: 来自嗜热菌的酶在工业上很有用。

e.en: The bacterium's {thermophily} surprised the researchers.
e.zh: 这种细菌的嗜热性让研究人员感到意外。

e.en: Extreme {thermophily} limits where the organism can live.
e.zh: 极强的嗜热性限制了这种生物的生存地点。

e.en: Her {thermophobia} made summer travel difficult.
e.zh: 她的怕热症让夏季旅行变得困难。

e.en: The patient described {thermophobia} after the fever episode.
e.zh: 患者说发烧之后出现了怕热症状。

e.en: The early {thermophone} produced sound by heating air.
e.zh: 早期热电话通过加热空气来产生声音。

e.en: A tiny {thermophone} can act as a simple acoustic source.
e.zh: 微型热声发声器可以作为简单的声源。

e.en: The nurse placed a {thermophore} on his shoulder.
e.zh: 护士把热敷器放在他的肩膀上。

e.en: In the model, each {thermophore} carries thermal energy.
e.zh: 在这个模型中，每个热载体都携带热能。

e.en: Particles moved because of {thermophoresis} in the gas.
e.zh: 颗粒因气体中的热泳现象而移动。

e.en: The device uses {thermophoresis} to collect fine dust.
e.zh: 该装置利用热泳来收集细小粉尘。

e.en: The crystal showed {thermophosphorescence} after gentle heating.
e.zh: 晶体在轻微加热后显示出热磷光。

e.en: They measured {thermophosphorescence} in the mineral sample.
e.zh: 他们测量了矿物样本的热致磷光。

e.en: The report lists the material's {thermophysical} properties.
e.zh: 报告列出了这种材料的热物理性质。

e.en: Accurate {thermophysical} data are essential for reactor design.
e.zh: 准确的热物理数据对反应器设计至关重要。

e.en: She specializes in {thermophysics} and heat transfer.
e.zh: 她专攻热物理学和传热学。

e.en: Modern {thermophysics} supports safer spacecraft design.
e.zh: 现代热物理学有助于设计更安全的航天器。

e.en: A {thermophyte} can grow in hot mineral soil.
e.zh: 嗜热植物能在高温矿质土壤中生长。

e.en: The expedition recorded a rare {thermophyte} near the vent.
e.zh: 考察队在喷口附近记录到一种罕见的嗜热植物。

e.en: The camera uses a {thermopile} to detect infrared radiation.
e.zh: 这台相机使用热电堆来探测红外辐射。

e.en: A {thermopile} converts heat differences into voltage.
e.zh: 热电堆能把温差转换成电压。

e.en: The factory molded the {thermoplast} into thin sheets.
e.zh: 工厂把热塑性塑料模压成薄片。

e.en: A recycled {thermoplast} can soften when heated again.
e.zh: 回收的热塑体再次受热时会变软。

e.en: The polymer's {thermoplasticity} allows repeated reshaping.
e.zh: 这种聚合物的热塑性使其可以反复重塑。

e.en: High {thermoplasticity} is useful in injection molding.
e.zh: 高热塑性在注塑成型中很有用。

e.en: The resin hardened through {thermopolymerization}.
e.zh: 这种树脂通过热聚合而硬化。

e.en: Engineers controlled {thermopolymerization} by adjusting the oven temperature.
e.zh: 工程师通过调节烘箱温度来控制加热聚合反应。

e.en: The technician inserted a {thermoprobe} into the sample.
e.zh: 技术员把热探针插入样本中。

e.en: A flexible {thermoprobe} monitored temperature inside the pipe.
e.zh: 柔性温度探头监测管道内部的温度。

e.en: The coating reduces {thermoradiation} from the surface.
e.zh: 这种涂层减少了表面的热辐射。

e.en: Astronomers studied {thermoradiation} from the dusty disk.
e.zh: 天文学家研究了尘埃盘发出的热辐射。

thermoradiography.t: 热辐射成像；热射线照相

e.en: Doctors tested {thermoradiography} for detecting inflammation.
e.zh: 医生测试了用热辐射成像来发现炎症。

e.en: The lab used {thermoradiography} to inspect the heated panel.
e.zh: 实验室用热射线照相检查受热面板。

e.en: A {thermoreceptor} in the skin detects cold.
e.zh: 皮肤中的温度感受器能感知寒冷。

e.en: The snake's {thermoreceptor} helps it locate warm prey.
e.zh: 蛇的热感受器帮助它定位温热的猎物。

e.en: The sensor layers were bonded by {thermocompression}.
e.zh: 这些传感器层通过热压结合在一起。

e.en: Engineers used {thermocompression} to join the metal films.
e.zh: 工程师用热压法连接这些金属薄膜。

e.en: The device relies on {thermocooling} to protect the chip.
e.zh: 该设备依靠热冷却来保护芯片。

e.en: Rapid {thermocooling} reduced stress in the material.
e.zh: 快速热冷却降低了材料内部的应力。

e.en: A small {thermocurrent} appeared across the junction.
e.zh: 接点两端出现了微弱的热电流。

e.en: The meter recorded the {thermocurrent} during heating.
e.zh: 仪表记录了加热过程中产生的温差电流。

thermocutout.t: 热断路器；过热保护开关

e.en: The kettle stopped when the {thermocutout} activated.
e.zh: 热断路器启动后，水壶就停止工作了。

e.en: Replace the faulty {thermocutout} before using the heater.
e.zh: 使用取暖器前要更换故障的过热保护开关。

e.en: {Thermodiffusion} moved particles toward the cooler side.
e.zh: 热扩散使颗粒向较冷的一侧移动。

e.en: The model includes {thermodiffusion} in liquid mixtures.
e.zh: 该模型包含液体混合物中的温差扩散。

e.en: A copper {thermoduct} carries heat away from the battery.
e.zh: 一根铜制导热管把热量从电池处带走。

e.en: The old furnace needed a wider {thermoduct}.
e.zh: 这台旧炉子需要一条更宽的热导管。

thermoduric.t: 耐热的；经加热仍存活的

e.en: Some {thermoduric} bacteria survive pasteurization.
e.zh: 一些耐热细菌能在巴氏杀菌后存活。

e.en: The lab tested milk for {thermoduric} organisms.
e.zh: 实验室检测牛奶中是否有耐热微生物。

e.en: The reaction is {thermodynamically} favorable at high pressure.
e.zh: 从热力学角度看，该反应在高压下有利。

e.en: This structure is not {thermodynamically} stable.
e.zh: 这种结构在热力学上并不稳定。

e.en: {Thermoelasticity} explains how heat changes the beam's shape.
e.zh: 热弹性解释了热量如何改变梁的形状。

e.en: Her thesis focused on {thermoelasticity} in composite plates.
e.zh: 她的论文研究复合板中的热弹性问题。

e.en: The furnace used a {thermoelec-triccouple} to measure temperature.
e.zh: 这台炉子用热电偶测量温度。

e.en: A damaged {thermoelec-triccouple} gave unstable readings.
e.zh: 损坏的热电偶给出了不稳定的读数。

e.en: A {thermoelec-triccurrent} flows when the junctions differ in temperature.
e.zh: 当接点温度不同时，就会有热电流流动。

e.en: The experiment measured the {thermoelec-triccurrent} in the wire.
e.zh: 实验测量了导线中的温差电流。

e.en: Each {thermoelecment} converts heat into voltage.
e.zh: 每个热电元件都会把热量转换成电压。

e.en: The cooler failed after one {thermoelecment} cracked.
e.zh: 一个热电元件裂开后，冷却器失效了。

e.en: The material showed unusual {thermoelectrical} behavior.
e.zh: 这种材料表现出异常的热电特性。

e.en: They improved the {thermoelectrical} efficiency of the module.
e.zh: 他们提高了该模块的热电效率。

e.en: The sample was {thermoelectrically} cooled during testing.
e.zh: 测试期间，样品通过热电方式冷却。

e.en: The sensor converts waste heat {thermoelectrically}.
e.zh: 该传感器以热电方式转换废热。

e.en: {Thermoelectricity} can turn temperature differences into power.
e.zh: 热电可以把温度差转化为电能。

e.en: The course covers the history of {thermoelectricity}.
e.zh: 这门课讲授热电现象的发展历史。

e.en: The crystal showed {thermoelectroluminescence} under controlled heating.
e.zh: 这块晶体在受控加热下出现热电致发光。

e.en: Researchers studied {thermoelectroluminescence} in the new ceramic.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了这种新陶瓷中的热电致发光。

e.en: The physicist calibrated the {thermoelectrometer} before the trial.
e.zh: 物理学家在试验前校准了热电计。

e.en: A sensitive {thermoelectrometer} detected the tiny voltage.
e.zh: 一台灵敏的热电测量仪检测到了微小电压。

e.en: The junction produced a {thermoelectromotive} force.
e.zh: 这个接点产生了热电动势。

e.en: They compared {thermoelectromotive} effects in two alloys.
e.zh: 他们比较了两种合金中的温差电动效应。

e.en: A {thermoelectron} escaped from the heated filament.
e.zh: 一个热电子从受热灯丝中逸出。

e.en: The detector counts each {thermoelectron} emitted by the cathode.
e.zh: 探测器会计数阴极发射出的每个热电子。

e.en: The {thermoelement} generated voltage from the heat gradient.
e.zh: 热电元件利用热梯度产生电压。

e.en: A broken {thermoelement} caused the thermometer to fail.
e.zh: 一个损坏的热敏元件导致温度计失灵。

e.en: She placed a {thermofor} against her sore back.
e.zh: 她把热敷器贴在酸痛的背部。

e.en: The nurse filled the {thermofor} with warm water.
e.zh: 护士往保温袋里装入温水。

e.en: Factories {thermoform} plastic sheets into food trays.
e.zh: 工厂把塑料片热成型为食品托盘。

e.en: The package design requires a clear {thermoform}.
e.zh: 这个包装设计需要一个透明的热成型外壳。

e.en: This {thermoformable} plastic softens at low heat.
e.zh: 这种可热成型塑料在低温加热时会变软。

e.en: Designers chose a {thermoformable} sheet for the tray.
e.zh: 设计师为托盘选择了可热成型板材。

thermoformed.t: 热成型的；经热成型加工的

e.en: The {thermoformed} tray holds six medical vials.
e.zh: 这个热成型托盘可放六个医用小瓶。

e.en: They shipped the parts in {thermoformed} packaging.
e.zh: 他们用热成型包装运送这些零件。

e.en: The machine {thermoforms} plastic into shallow cups.
e.zh: 这台机器把塑料热成型为浅杯。

e.en: Custom {thermoforms} protect the instruments during shipping.
e.zh: 定制热成型件在运输中保护这些仪器。

e.en: Mammals {thermoregulate} to keep their bodies stable.
e.zh: 哺乳动物会调节体温，以保持身体稳定。

e.en: The device can {thermoregulate} the sample chamber automatically.
e.zh: 这台设备能自动调节样品室的温度。

thermoregulator.t: 温度调节器；体温调节者

e.en: The implant works as a tiny {thermoregulator}.
e.zh: 这种植入物像一个微型温度调节器一样工作。

e.en: A lizard is a poor {thermoregulator} in cold weather.
e.zh: 蜥蜴在寒冷天气里调节体温的能力较差。

thermoregulatory.t: 体温调节的；温度调控的

e.en: Sweating is a key {thermoregulatory} response.
e.zh: 出汗是一种关键的体温调节反应。

e.en: The study measured {thermoregulatory} changes during sleep.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了睡眠期间的体温调节变化。

e.en: The lava recorded Earth's field through {thermoremanence}.
e.zh: 熔岩通过热剩磁记录了地球磁场。

e.en: Researchers measured {thermoremanence} in the ancient pottery.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了古陶器中的热剩磁。

e.en: The rock carries a strong {thermoremanent} signal.
e.zh: 这块岩石带有很强的热剩磁信号。

e.en: Scientists compared the {thermoremanent} magnetization of several samples.
e.zh: 科学家比较了几个样品的热剩磁磁化强度。

thermorunaway.t: 热失控；温度 runaway 现象

e.en: A damaged battery can enter {thermorunaway} under stress.
e.zh: 受损电池在受压时可能进入热失控状态。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the pack to prevent {thermorunaway}.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了电池组，以防止热失控。

e.en: Galileo's {thermoscope} showed changes in temperature.
e.zh: 伽利略的验温器能显示温度变化。

e.en: The museum displayed a glass {thermoscope}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件玻璃验温器。

e.en: The lecture described early {thermoscopic} instruments.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了早期的验温器具。

e.en: They repeated the {thermoscopic} experiment with colored liquid.
e.zh: 他们用有色液体重复了这个测温实验。

e.en: The satellite uses a {thermoscreen} to protect sensors.
e.zh: 这颗卫星使用热屏蔽来保护传感器。

e.en: Visitors passed through a {thermoscreen} at the entrance.
e.zh: 访客在入口处经过了体温筛查装置。

e.en: The paint contains {thermosensitive} pigments.
e.zh: 这种涂料含有热敏颜料。

e.en: Some neurons are highly {thermosensitive}.
e.zh: 有些神经元对温度非常敏感。

e.en: A {thermosensor} monitors the motor housing.
e.zh: 一个温度传感器监测电机外壳。

e.en: The insect uses a {thermosensor} to find warm skin.
e.zh: 这种昆虫利用热传感器寻找温暖的皮肤。

e.en: The handle is made from a durable {thermoset}.
e.zh: 这个手柄由耐用的热固性塑料制成。

e.en: A {thermoset} resin hardens permanently when heated.
e.zh: 热固性树脂受热后会永久硬化。

thermosets.t: 热固性塑料；热固性材料

e.en: Many electrical parts use {thermosets} for insulation.
e.zh: 许多电气零件使用热固性材料来绝缘。

e.en: Unlike thermoplastics, {thermosets} cannot be remelted easily.
e.zh: 与热塑性塑料不同，热固性塑料不易重新熔化。

e.en: The factory produces {thermosetting} epoxy coatings.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产热固性环氧涂层。

e.en: A {thermosetting} polymer forms a rigid network.
e.zh: 热固性聚合物会形成刚性的网络结构。

e.en: The heater relies on a {thermosiphon} for circulation.
e.zh: 这台加热器依靠热虹吸进行循环。

e.en: A passive {thermosiphon} can move coolant without a pump.
e.zh: 被动式热虹吸不用泵也能输送冷却液。

thermosizing.t: 热定形；热尺寸稳定处理

e.en: The fabric underwent {thermosizing} before cutting.
e.zh: 这块布料在裁剪前经过了热定形处理。

e.en: Proper {thermosizing} reduces shrinkage in synthetic fibers.
e.zh: 适当的热定形能减少合成纤维的缩水。

e.en: The switch makes a clear {thermosnap} at the set temperature.
e.zh: 开关在设定温度下会发生清晰的热致跳变。

e.en: Engineers tested the {thermosnap} action of the bimetal strip.
e.zh: 工程师测试了双金属片的热致快速动作。

thermosorter.t: 热分选器；按温度分拣装置

e.en: The recycling line added a {thermosorter} for plastics.
e.zh: 回收生产线增加了一台塑料热分选器。

e.en: A {thermosorter} separates particles by their heat response.
e.zh: 热分选器根据颗粒的热响应进行分离。

e.en: Satellites orbit within the upper {thermosphere}.
e.zh: 卫星在上部热层中运行。

e.en: The {thermosphere} expands when solar activity increases.
e.zh: 太阳活动增强时，热层会膨胀。

thermospheric.t: 热层的；大气热层相关的

e.en: The model predicts {thermospheric} density changes.
e.zh: 该模型预测热层密度的变化。

e.en: Solar storms can disturb {thermospheric} winds.
e.zh: 太阳风暴会扰动热层风。

thermostabilization.t: 热稳定化；温度稳定处理

e.en: The enzyme requires {thermostabilization} for industrial use.
e.zh: 这种酶需要热稳定化后才能用于工业。

e.en: Polymer {thermostabilization} improves resistance to aging.
e.zh: 聚合物热稳定化能提高抗老化能力。

e.en: The bacteria produce a {thermostable} enzyme.
e.zh: 这种细菌会产生一种耐热酶。

e.en: A {thermostable} coating protects the metal surface.
e.zh: 热稳定涂层能保护金属表面。

e.en: The therapy used mild {thermostimulation} on the skin.
e.zh: 这种疗法对皮肤使用了温和的热刺激。

e.en: Researchers recorded nerve activity after {thermostimulation}.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了热刺激后的神经活动。

e.en: The fan starts when the {thermoswitch} closes.
e.zh: 温控开关闭合时，风扇就会启动。

e.en: Replace the faulty {thermoswitch} before driving again.
e.zh: 再次开车前要更换故障的温控开关。

e.en: The solar heater uses a {thermosyphon} loop.
e.zh: 这台太阳能热水器使用热虹吸回路。

e.en: A {thermosyphon} transfers heat without mechanical pumping.
e.zh: 热虹吸无需机械泵送就能传递热量。

e.en: The larvae showed a {thermotactic} response in the warm chamber.
e.zh: 幼虫在温暖的腔室中表现出趋温反应。

e.en: Researchers measured {thermotactic} movement under a temperature gradient.
e.zh: 研究人员在温度梯度下测量了趋温运动。

e.en: The technician wrapped {thermotape} around the pipe joint.
e.zh: 技术员把热敏胶带缠在管道接头上。

e.en: A strip of {thermotape} changed color near the heater.
e.zh: 一条测温胶带在加热器附近变了颜色。

e.en: The bacterium displayed {thermotaxic} behavior in the assay.
e.zh: 这种细菌在实验中表现出温度趋性行为。

e.en: Its {thermotaxic} response helped it avoid extreme cold.
e.zh: 它的趋温反应帮助它避开极端寒冷。

e.en: Worms use {thermotaxis} to find favorable soil temperatures.
e.zh: 蠕虫利用趋温性寻找适宜的土壤温度。

e.en: The study links {thermotaxis} to a small group of neurons.
e.zh: 这项研究把温度趋性与一小组神经元联系起来。

e.en: The lab reported the alloy's {thermotensile} strength at high temperature.
e.zh: 实验室报告了这种合金在高温下的热抗拉强度。

e.en: Engineers ran {thermotensile} tests before approving the cable.
e.zh: 工程师在批准这种电缆前进行了热拉伸测试。

e.en: The clinic offers {thermotherapy} for chronic muscle pain.
e.zh: 这家诊所为慢性肌肉疼痛提供热疗。

e.en: Doctors combined {thermotherapy} with standard cancer treatment.
e.zh: 医生将温热治疗与常规癌症治疗结合使用。

e.en: Early physiologists discussed {thermothyrins} in relation to metabolism.
e.zh: 早期生理学家曾讨论热甲状腺素类物质与代谢的关系。

e.en: The paper used {thermothyrins} as an old term for thyroid hormones.
e.zh: 这篇论文把热甲状腺素类物质作为甲状腺激素的旧称。

e.en: The device recorded tiny {thermotic} changes in the tissue.
e.zh: 该装置记录了组织中细微的热变化。

e.en: His lecture covered {thermotic} effects in living cells.
e.zh: 他的讲座涉及活细胞中的热效应。

e.en: The course introduced {thermotics} before moving to thermodynamics.
e.zh: 这门课先介绍热学，然后再讲热力学。

e.en: Old textbooks often treated {thermotics} as a separate branch of physics.
e.zh: 旧教材常把热学作为物理学的一个独立分支来处理。

e.en: The brewery selected a {thermotolerant} yeast for summer fermentation.
e.zh: 啤酒厂选择了一种耐热酵母用于夏季发酵。

e.en: Some {thermotolerant} bacteria survive brief exposure to boiling water.
e.zh: 一些耐热细菌能在短暂接触沸水后存活。

e.en: Doctors used {thermotopography} to map inflammation in the knee.
e.zh: 医生用体表热成像绘制膝部炎症的热分布。

e.en: The report included {thermotopography} of the engine surface.
e.zh: 报告中包含发动机表面的热分布图。

e.en: The model describes {thermotransport} through a thin semiconductor layer.
e.zh: 该模型描述了热量穿过薄半导体层的输运过程。

e.en: Defects in the crystal changed its {thermotransport} properties.
e.zh: 晶体中的缺陷改变了它的热输运性质。

e.en: The plant showed a weak {thermotropic} bend toward the warmer side.
e.zh: 这株植物向较暖的一侧表现出轻微的向热弯曲。

e.en: The polymer forms a {thermotropic} liquid crystal when heated.
e.zh: 这种聚合物受热后会形成热致液晶。

e.en: Seedlings may display {thermotropism} in uneven soil temperatures.
e.zh: 幼苗在土温不均时可能表现出向热性。

e.en: The experiment tested {thermotropism} by warming only one side of the stem.
e.zh: 实验通过只加热茎的一侧来测试向热性。

e.en: The material's {thermotropy} appears as a sharp color shift.
e.zh: 这种材料的热致变化表现为明显的颜色转变。

e.en: Botanists once used {thermotropy} to describe growth toward heat.
e.zh: 植物学家曾用向热性来描述朝热源生长的现象。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {thermovoltmeter} before the test.
e.zh: 工程师在测试前校准了热电压表。

e.en: A {thermovoltmeter} can measure alternating voltage through heating effects.
e.zh: 热电压表可以通过热效应测量交流电压。

e.en: The old panel still used a {thermowattmeter} for power readings.
e.zh: 旧控制面板仍用热瓦特计读取功率。

e.en: A {thermowattmeter} estimates power from the heat produced by current.
e.zh: 热式功率计根据电流产生的热量估算功率。

thermowell.t: 温度计套管；热电偶套管

e.en: The sensor slides into a steel {thermowell} inside the tank.
e.zh: 传感器插入罐内的钢制温度计套管中。

e.en: A cracked {thermowell} can expose the thermometer to corrosive fluid.
e.zh: 破裂的温度计套管会让温度计接触腐蚀性液体。

e.en: The gas bill showed usage in {therms} instead of kilowatt-hours.
e.zh: 燃气账单用撒姆而不是千瓦时显示用量。

e.en: One hundred {therms} of gas can heat the building for weeks.
e.zh: 一百撒姆的燃气可以为这栋楼供暖数周。

e.en: The fossil had a {theroid} jaw unlike modern reptiles.
e.zh: 这块化石有一个不像现代爬行动物的兽状颌骨。

e.en: Writers described the monster's {theroid} face in lurid detail.
e.zh: 作家用夸张的细节描写了怪物那张野兽般的脸。

e.en: Her thesis in {therology} focused on desert mammals.
e.zh: 她的兽类学论文聚焦于沙漠哺乳动物。

e.en: The museum's {therology} collection includes rare bat specimens.
e.zh: 博物馆的兽类学藏品包括稀有的蝙蝠标本。

e.en: A desert {therophyte} survives drought as a seed.
e.zh: 沙漠一年生草本植物以种子的形式度过干旱。

e.en: The survey counted each {therophyte} after the spring rains.
e.zh: 春雨过后，调查人员统计了每株一年生草本植物。

thersitical.t: 像忒耳西忒斯般丑陋刻薄；讥刺的

e.en: The review was dismissed as {thersitical} abuse rather than criticism.
e.zh: 那篇评论被看作是刻薄辱骂，而不是批评。

e.en: His {thersitical} speech mocked everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他那番丑恶尖刻的话嘲弄了屋里所有人。

e.en: The editor added {thesaural} links to each entry.
e.zh: 编辑给每个词条加上了同义词词库链接。

e.en: A {thesaural} search can reveal related technical terms.
e.zh: 词库式检索可以找出相关的技术术语。

thesaurosis.t: 词语或知识的汇集；词库化

e.en: The project aimed at {thesaurosis} of regional plant names.
e.zh: 这个项目旨在汇集各地区的植物名称。

e.en: Digital {thesaurosis} made the archive easier to search.
e.zh: 数字化词库整理让档案更容易检索。

e.en: The old {thesp} still loved a crowded stage.
e.zh: 那位老演员仍然热爱观众满座的舞台。

e.en: Every young {thesp} in town auditioned for the role.
e.zh: 城里每个年轻戏剧人都来试演这个角色。

e.en: The linguist marked the sound with {thet}.
e.zh: 语言学家用θ来标记这个音。

e.en: In the formula, {thet} represents the angle.
e.zh: 在这个公式中，θ表示角度。

e.en: The laboratory tested a new {thetatron} last winter.
e.zh: 实验室去年冬天测试了一台新的θ粒子发生装置。

e.en: Few students had ever seen a working {thetatron}.
e.zh: 很少有学生见过能运转的θ粒子装置。

e.en: The philosopher called the claim a {thetic} judgment.
e.zh: 哲学家把这个主张称为一种断定性判断。

e.en: The poem opens with a {thetic} stress on the first syllable.
e.zh: 这首诗开头第一音节带有正立重音。

e.en: She stated the argument {thetically}, without offering proof.
e.zh: 她以断定的方式提出论点，却没有给出证明。

e.en: The line begins {thetically} and then softens.
e.zh: 这一行以强起方式开头，随后变得柔和。

e.en: The manuscript has {thetted} symbols in the margin.
e.zh: 手稿页边有用θ标出的符号。

e.en: He practiced a {thetted} pronunciation in the phonetics class.
e.zh: 他在语音课上练习发θ音的读法。

e.en: The ritual had a strongly {theurgic} character.
e.zh: 这个仪式带有很强的通神法术色彩。

e.en: She studied {theurgic} texts from late antiquity.
e.zh: 她研究晚期古代的神通术文献。

e.en: The temple preserved several {theurgical} instructions.
e.zh: 寺庙保存了几份通神仪式的说明。

e.en: His essay compares magical and {theurgical} practices.
e.zh: 他的文章比较了魔法实践和通神法术。

theurgist.t: 神通术士；通神法术修行者

e.en: The {theurgist} claimed to summon divine powers.
e.zh: 那名神通术士声称能召来神力。

e.en: A cautious historian would not call every magician a {theurgist}.
e.zh: 谨慎的历史学家不会把每个魔法师都称为通神术士。

e.en: Ancient {theurgy} mixed prayer, ritual, and philosophy.
e.zh: 古代神通术融合了祈祷、仪式和哲学。

e.en: He treated {theurgy} as a religious discipline, not entertainment.
e.zh: 他把通神法术视为宗教修行，而不是娱乐。

e.en: The toxicologist identified {thevetin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 毒理学家在植物提取物中鉴定出黄花夹竹桃毒苷。

e.en: Exposure to {thevetin} can affect the heart.
e.zh: 接触黄花夹竹桃毒苷可能影响心脏。

e.en: The blacksmith was known for his {thew} and patience.
e.zh: 那位铁匠以筋力和耐心闻名。

e.en: Old tales praise the hero's {thew} in battle.
e.zh: 古老故事赞颂英雄在战斗中的强大体力。

e.en: A broad-shouldered, {thewed} sailor lifted the crate.
e.zh: 一个肩膀宽阔、肌肉发达的水手抬起了箱子。

e.en: The statue shows a {thewed} warrior at rest.
e.zh: 这尊雕像表现了一名强壮武士休息时的样子。

e.en: After the fever, he felt {thewless} and faint.
e.zh: 发烧之后，他觉得浑身无力、头晕。

e.en: The poem describes a {thewless} age without courage.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一个缺乏勇气、软弱无力的时代。

e.en: The wrestler's {thews} impressed the crowd.
e.zh: 摔跤手强健的筋肉让观众惊叹。

e.en: The journey tested their {thews} and resolve.
e.zh: 这段旅程考验了他们的体力和决心。

e.en: The hero was drawn as a {thewy} giant.
e.zh: 画中的英雄是一个筋肉发达的巨人。

e.en: Her prose has a {thewy} strength that suits the subject.
e.zh: 她的散文有一种强健有力的质感，很适合这个主题。

e.en: {They'd} arrive earlier if the roads were clear.
e.zh: 如果路况顺畅，他们会更早到达。

e.en: {They'd} already left when we called.
e.zh: 我们打电话时，他们已经离开了。

e.en: The paper described {thiaazadisilacyclohexane} as a ring compound.
e.zh: 论文把噻氮二硅环己烷描述为一种环状化合物。

e.en: They synthesized {thiaazadisilacyclohexane} under dry nitrogen.
e.zh: 他们在干燥氮气中合成了噻氮二硅环己烷。

e.en: The veterinarian prescribed {thiabendazole} for the infection.
e.zh: 兽医开了噻苯达唑来治疗这种感染。

e.en: Farmers once used {thiabendazole} to protect stored fruit.
e.zh: 农民曾用噻苯达唑来保护贮藏水果。

e.en: They pushed through a {thickety} patch of brambles.
e.zh: 他们穿过一片灌木丛生的荆棘地。

e.en: The old path vanished into {thickety} woodland.
e.zh: 那条旧路消失在密林般的树林里。

e.en: Only a {thickhead} would ignore that warning sign.
e.zh: 只有笨蛋才会无视那个警告标志。

e.en: He called himself a {thickhead} for losing the keys.
e.zh: 他因为弄丢钥匙而骂自己是笨蛋。

e.en: His {thickheaded} answer annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 他那愚钝的回答惹恼了整个团队。

e.en: She was too {thickheaded} to admit the plan had failed.
e.zh: 她太固执不开窍，不肯承认计划失败了。

e.en: Don't be a {thickie}; read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别犯傻，先看说明。

e.en: The comedian played a lovable {thickie} on the show.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员在节目里扮演一个讨喜的傻瓜。

e.en: The soup was {thickish} but still easy to pour.
e.zh: 汤有点稠，但倒起来还算顺。

e.en: He wore a {thickish} jacket in the cool wind.
e.zh: 凉风中他穿了一件稍厚的夹克。

e.en: A {thickleaf} plant can store water in dry weather.
e.zh: 厚叶植物能在干旱天气里储存水分。

e.en: The {thickleaf} cutting rooted well on the windowsill.
e.zh: 那株厚叶插枝在窗台上生根很好。

e.en: He felt like a {thicko} after missing the obvious clue.
e.zh: 错过那么明显的线索后，他觉得自己像个笨蛋。

e.en: The bully kept calling new students {thickos}.
e.zh: 那个欺负人的学生一直骂新同学是蠢人。

e.en: This fruit has a tough {thickskin} that protects it.
e.zh: 这种水果有一层坚韧的厚皮保护它。

e.en: You need a {thickskin} to survive political criticism.
e.zh: 要承受政治批评，你得脸皮够厚。

e.en: Journalists become {thickskinned} after years of criticism.
e.zh: 记者经历多年批评后会变得不易受伤。

e.en: He was too {thickskinned} to notice her embarrassment.
e.zh: 他太迟钝脸皮太厚，没有察觉她的尴尬。

e.en: The {thief-taker} tracked stolen watches through the market.
e.zh: 那名捕贼人在市场里追查被盗的手表。

e.en: In old London, a {thief-taker} might work for a reward.
e.zh: 在旧时伦敦，缉盗者可能为赏金办事。

e.en: The villagers dreamed of a {thieveless} town.
e.zh: 村民们梦想有一座没有盗贼的小镇。

e.en: His {thieveless} habits made him trusted with money.
e.zh: 他从不偷窃的习惯让人放心把钱交给他。

e.en: The boy gave a {thievish} glance at the open drawer.
e.zh: 男孩像小偷一样瞥了一眼敞开的抽屉。

e.en: Her {thievish} fingers kept finding coins on the table.
e.zh: 她爱偷东西的手总能在桌上摸到硬币。

thievishly.t: 像小偷一样；偷偷摸摸地

e.en: He smiled {thievishly} as he hid the last cookie.
e.zh: 他偷偷藏起最后一块饼干时，像小偷一样笑了。

e.en: The cat moved {thievishly} toward the fish bowl.
e.zh: 那只猫偷偷摸摸地朝鱼缸走去。

e.en: Old ballads mention travelers who {thig} for bread.
e.zh: 古老歌谣提到为面包乞讨的旅人。

e.en: He would rather work than {thig} from neighbors.
e.zh: 他宁愿工作，也不愿向邻居讨施舍。

e.en: The {thigger} knocked softly at the farmhouse door.
e.zh: 那个乞讨者轻轻敲响农舍的门。

e.en: She described the wandering {thigger} in her poem.
e.zh: 她在诗里描写了那个四处讨施舍的人。

e.en: She chose a {thigh-length} coat for the concert.
e.zh: 她为音乐会选了一件长及大腿的外套。

e.en: The dancer wore {thigh-length} boots on stage.
e.zh: 舞者在台上穿着长及大腿的靴子。

e.en: His story was a real {thigh-slapper} at dinner.
e.zh: 他的故事在晚餐时真是令人捧腹。

e.en: The joke sounded like an old rural {thigh-slapper}.
e.zh: 那个笑话听起来像老派乡村里的爆笑段子。

e.en: Repeated brushing can cause {thigmomorphosis} in young plants.
e.zh: 反复轻刷会使幼苗发生受触形态变化。

e.en: The study measured {thigmomorphosis} after wind exposure.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了受风后植物的受触形态变化。

e.en: Mice often show {thigmotaxis} in a new arena.
e.zh: 小鼠在新场地里常表现出贴边行为。

e.en: The robot used {thigmotaxis} to follow the wall.
e.zh: 机器人利用趋触性沿墙移动。

e.en: Vines climb fences through {thigmotropism}.
e.zh: 藤蔓通过向触性攀上篱笆。

e.en: The lesson explained {thigmotropism} in curling tendrils.
e.zh: 这节课解释了卷须弯曲中的向触性。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a {thiiazole} derivative in the lab.
e.zh: 化学家在实验室合成了一种噻唑衍生物。

e.en: Some drugs contain a {thiiazole} ring.
e.zh: 一些药物含有噻唑环。

e.en: The horse stood between the cart's {thills}.
e.zh: 那匹马站在马车两侧的辕杆之间。

e.en: A broken {thill} made the wagon useless.
e.zh: 一根车辕断了，马车就没法用了。

thiacetate.t: 硫代乙酸盐或酯类化合物

e.en: The lab prepared a {thiacetate} for the reaction.
e.zh: 实验室为这次反应制备了一种硫代乙酸酯。

e.en: A {thiacetate} group can change the molecule's behavior.
e.zh: 硫代乙酸酯基团会改变分子的性质。

e.en: Doctors once used {thiacetazone} to treat tuberculosis.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用硫乙酰腙治疗结核病。

e.en: The patient reacted badly to {thiacetazone}.
e.zh: 这名患者对硫乙酰腙反应不良。

e.en: Researchers tested {thiactin} against several bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了硫菌素对几种细菌的作用。

e.en: The paper described {thiactin} as a sulfur-containing antibiotic.
e.zh: 论文把硫菌素描述为一种含硫抗生素。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {thiadiazin} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的噻二嗪衍生物。

e.en: A {thiadiazin} ring appears in the compound.
e.zh: 该化合物中含有一个噻二嗪环。

thialdine.t: 噻醛啶；含硫杂环化合物

e.en: {Thialdine} forms when aldehyde reacts with ammonia and sulfur compounds.
e.zh: 醛与氨和含硫化合物反应时会生成噻醛啶。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {thialdine}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量噻醛啶。

thiaminase.t: 硫胺素酶；维生素B1分解酶

e.en: Raw fish may contain {thiaminase}.
e.zh: 生鱼中可能含有硫胺素酶。

e.en: {Thiaminase} can destroy vitamin B1 in food.
e.zh: 硫胺素酶会破坏食物中的维生素B1。

e.en: The study compared {thiaprostacyclin} with natural prostacyclin.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了硫代前列环素与天然前列环素。

e.en: {Thiaprostacyclin} showed activity in vascular tissue.
e.zh: 硫代前列环素在血管组织中显示出活性。

e.en: The molecule includes a {thiapyran} ring.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个噻喃环。

e.en: They studied {thiapyran} derivatives in organic chemistry.
e.zh: 他们在有机化学中研究噻喃衍生物。

e.en: The dye contains a {thiasine} structure.
e.zh: 这种染料含有噻嗪结构。

e.en: A {thiasine} compound was isolated from the mixture.
e.zh: 他们从混合物中分离出一种噻嗪化合物。

e.en: The drug is based on a {thiaxanthene} skeleton.
e.zh: 这种药物以噻吨骨架为基础。

e.en: Chemists examined the reactions of {thiaxanthene}.
e.zh: 化学家研究了噻吨的反应。

e.en: The team measured the stability of {thiazamide}.
e.zh: 团队测量了噻唑酰胺的稳定性。

e.en: A {thiazamide} derivative appeared in the patent.
e.zh: 专利中出现了一种噻唑酰胺衍生物。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {thiazide} for high blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生给他开了一种噻嗪类药物治疗高血压。

e.en: A {thiazide} can help the body remove extra salt.
e.zh: 噻嗪类利尿药能帮助身体排出多余盐分。

e.en: Methylene blue has a {thiazine} ring.
e.zh: 亚甲蓝含有一个噻嗪环。

e.en: The chemist classified it as a {thiazine} dye.
e.zh: 化学家把它归为噻嗪类染料。

e.en: Vitamin B1 contains a {thiazole} ring.
e.zh: 维生素B1含有一个噻唑环。

e.en: The odor came from a volatile {thiazole}.
e.zh: 这种气味来自一种挥发性噻唑化合物。

e.en: The compound has a {thiazoline} ring.
e.zh: 该化合物含有一个噻唑啉环。

e.en: They synthesized several {thiazoline} derivatives.
e.zh: 他们合成了几种噻唑啉衍生物。

e.en: She stayed with him through {thick-and-thin}.
e.zh: 她无论顺境逆境都陪在他身边。

e.en: Old friends support each other through {thick-and-thin}.
e.zh: 老朋友会在各种境遇中互相支持。

e.en: The {thick-haired} child hated summer haircuts.
e.zh: 那个头发浓密的孩子讨厌夏天理发。

e.en: A {thick-haired} model appeared in the shampoo advertisement.
e.zh: 洗发水广告里出现了一位头发浓密的模特。

e.en: You need to be {thick-skinned} in politics.
e.zh: 从政需要脸皮厚，不容易被批评伤到。

e.en: The elephant is a {thick-skinned} animal.
e.zh: 大象是一种皮肤很厚的动物。

e.en: He was too {thick-skulled} to take the hint.
e.zh: 他太不开窍，听不出这个暗示。

e.en: Stop being {thick-skulled} and read the instructions.
e.zh: 别再犯糊涂了，好好读说明。

e.en: He sounded {thick-voiced} after the cold.
e.zh: 感冒之后，他的声音听起来低沉含混。

e.en: The actor gave a {thick-voiced} reply.
e.zh: 那位演员用含混低沉的声音回答。

e.en: They chose a {thick-wall} pipe for safety.
e.zh: 为了安全，他们选用了厚壁管。

e.en: The old house had {thick-wall} construction.
e.zh: 这栋老房子采用了厚墙结构。

e.en: The joke mocked a {thick-witted} official.
e.zh: 这个笑话嘲弄了一位愚钝的官员。

e.en: She grew impatient with his {thick-witted} answers.
e.zh: 她对他迟钝的回答越来越不耐烦。

e.en: The library kept a worn {thickback} on the shelf.
e.zh: 图书馆书架上放着一本磨损的厚背书。

e.en: Local fishermen sometimes call the fish a {thickback}.
e.zh: 当地渔民有时把这种鱼叫作厚背鱼。

e.en: We picked ripe {thimbleberries} along the forest path.
e.zh: 我们沿着林中小路采摘成熟的顶针莓。

e.en: The jam was made from wild {thimbleberries}.
e.zh: 这果酱是用野生顶针莓做的。

e.en: A {thimbleberry} grew beside the old fence.
e.zh: 旧篱笆旁长着一株顶针莓。

e.en: She tasted a soft red {thimbleberry}.
e.zh: 她尝了一颗柔软的红色顶针莓。

e.en: The {thimbleflower} opened after the spring rain.
e.zh: 春雨过后，那朵银莲花开了。

e.en: Botanists recorded {thimbleflower} in the meadow survey.
e.zh: 植物学家在草地调查中记录了银莲花。

e.en: The traveler lost money in a {thimblerig}.
e.zh: 那个旅人在杯球骗局中被骗了钱。

e.en: They tried to {thimblerig} the vote.
e.zh: 他们试图用骗术操纵投票。

e.en: The contest was clearly {thimblerigged} from the start.
e.zh: 这场比赛从一开始就明显被人用骗术操纵了。

e.en: He said the auction had been {thimblerigged}.
e.zh: 他说那场拍卖被人暗中做了手脚。

e.en: Police arrested him for {thimblerigging} near the station.
e.zh: 警方因他在车站附近玩杯球骗术而逮捕了他。

e.en: The report exposed {thimblerigging} in the bidding process.
e.zh: 报告揭露了招标过程中的欺诈操纵。

e.en: Tall {thimbleweed} grew near the creek.
e.zh: 小溪旁长着高高的银莲花类植物。

e.en: The guide pointed out {thimbleweed} on the trail.
e.zh: 向导在小路上指给我们看银莲花类植物。

e.en: Only a {thimblewit} would ignore that warning.
e.zh: 只有笨蛋才会无视那个警告。

e.en: He called himself a {thimblewit} after losing the keys.
e.zh: 丢了钥匙后，他骂自己是个傻瓜。

e.en: The {thin-shelled} eggs broke during transport.
e.zh: 那些壳薄的鸡蛋在运输途中破了。

e.en: A {thin-shelled} turtle needs careful protection.
e.zh: 外壳较薄的龟需要细心保护。

e.en: He is too {thin-skinned} to accept criticism.
e.zh: 他太敏感了，接受不了批评。

e.en: The {thin-skinned} fruit bruises very easily.
e.zh: 这种皮薄的水果很容易碰伤。

e.en: The {thinclad} hikers shivered in the wind.
e.zh: 衣着单薄的徒步者在风中发抖。

e.en: A {thinclad} child waited outside the shop.
e.zh: 一个穿得很单薄的孩子等在店外。

e.en: Kant called reality beyond experience the {thing-in-itself}.
e.zh: 康德把经验之外的实在称为物自体。

e.en: The artwork was discussed as a {thing-in-itself}.
e.zh: 那件艺术品被当作自在之物来讨论。

e.en: Pass me that metal {thingamabob} on the shelf.
e.zh: 把架子上那个金属小玩意儿递给我。

e.en: The machine needs a tiny {thingamabob} to lock properly.
e.zh: 这台机器需要一个小零件才能锁好。

e.en: The drawer was full of wires and {thingamabobs}.
e.zh: 抽屉里塞满了电线和各种叫不上名的小东西。

e.en: She sells buttons, clips, and other {thingamabobs}.
e.zh: 她卖纽扣、夹子和其他杂七杂八的小玩意儿。

e.en: Where did you put the {thingamy} for opening jars?
e.zh: 你把那个开罐子的玩意儿放哪儿了？

e.en: I met {thingamy} from accounting yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天见到了会计部那个叫什么来着的人。

e.en: The essay criticizes the {thingification} of workers.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了对工人的物化。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {thingification} of social relations.
e.zh: 哲学家讨论社会关系被物化的问题。

e.en: Kant argued that {things-in-themselves} cannot be fully known.
e.zh: 康德认为物自体无法被完全认识。

e.en: The seminar compared appearances with {things-in-themselves}.
e.zh: 研讨课把现象与自在之物作了比较。

e.en: This plastic {thingumajig} holds the cable in place.
e.zh: 这个塑料小玩意儿能把电缆固定住。

e.en: He forgot the name and called it a {thingumajig}.
e.zh: 他忘了名字，就叫它那个小玩意儿。

e.en: Tighten the {thingumbob} before you close the case.
e.zh: 合上外壳前，把那个小零件拧紧。

e.en: I gave the form to {thingumbob} at reception.
e.zh: 我把表格交给了前台那个叫什么的人。

e.en: Can you fix this {thingumboo} on my bike?
e.zh: 你能修一下我自行车上这个叫不上名的东西吗？

e.en: Old {thingumboo} from next door knocked again.
e.zh: 隔壁那个叫不上名的老家伙又来敲门了。

e.en: The box contains screws, washers, and other {thingummies}.
e.zh: 盒子里有螺丝、垫圈和其他叫不上名的小东西。

e.en: She collects little {thingummies} from every trip.
e.zh: 她每次旅行都会收集些小玩意儿。

e.en: Hand me the {thingummy} beside the lamp.
e.zh: 把灯旁边那个小玩意儿递给我。

e.en: I spoke to {thingummy} about the invoice.
e.zh: 我跟那个叫什么的人谈了发票的事。

e.en: Her answer was based on {think-so}, not evidence.
e.zh: 她的回答只是想当然，并不是基于证据。

e.en: We need data, not {think-so} from the committee.
e.zh: 我们需要数据，而不是委员会的主观猜测。

thiobarbital.t: 硫代巴比妥类药物；硫巴比妥酸盐

e.en: The anesthetic protocol once included {thiobarbital} for rapid induction.
e.zh: 这套麻醉方案过去曾使用硫代巴比妥类药物来快速诱导麻醉。

e.en: Researchers measured {thiobarbital} levels in the blood samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了血液样本中的硫代巴比妥含量。

e.en: The pesticide contains a {thiocarbamate} compound.
e.zh: 这种农药含有一种硫代氨基甲酸酯化合物。

e.en: A {thiocarbamate} ligand stabilized the metal complex.
e.zh: 一个硫代氨基甲酸酯配体稳定了该金属配合物。

e.en: The lab used {thiocarbamide} in the synthesis.
e.zh: 实验室在这次合成中使用了硫脲。

e.en: {Thiocarbamide} can form complexes with several metals.
e.zh: 硫脲可以与多种金属形成配合物。

e.en: The molecule has a {thiocarbamoyl} group attached to the ring.
e.zh: 这个分子有一个硫代氨甲酰基连接在环上。

e.en: A {thiocarbamoyl} derivative showed stronger activity in tests.
e.zh: 一种硫代氨甲酰基衍生物在测试中表现出更强活性。

thiocarbarsone.t: 硫卡巴胂；含砷抗原虫药

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {thiocarbarsone} for certain protozoal infections.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用硫卡巴胂治疗某些原虫感染。

e.en: The old formulary listed {thiocarbarsone} as an arsenical drug.
e.zh: 旧药典把硫卡巴胂列为一种含砷药物。

thiocarbonate.t: 硫代碳酸盐；硫代碳酸酯

e.en: The reaction produced a stable {thiocarbonate} salt.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种稳定的硫代碳酸盐。

e.en: Chemists examined the {thiocarbonate} ester by spectroscopy.
e.zh: 化学家用光谱法检测了这种硫代碳酸酯。

e.en: The team synthesized a new {thiochromanone} derivative.
e.zh: 该团队合成了一种新的硫色满酮衍生物。

e.en: A {thiochromanone} scaffold appears in several experimental drugs.
e.zh: 硫色满酮骨架存在于几种实验性药物中。

thiochrome.t: 硫色素；维生素B1氧化产物

e.en: Thiamine can be oxidized to fluorescent {thiochrome}.
e.zh: 硫胺素可以被氧化成有荧光的硫色素。

e.en: The assay measured {thiochrome} under ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 该测定在紫外光下检测硫色素。

e.en: The sample smelled strongly of {thiocresol}.
e.zh: 这个样品有很浓的甲苯硫酚气味。

e.en: {Thiocresol} derivatives are used in organic synthesis.
e.zh: 硫代甲酚衍生物用于有机合成。

e.en: The water test detected {thiocyanate} near the factory.
e.zh: 水质检测在工厂附近检出了硫氰酸盐。

e.en: Iron ions form a red complex with {thiocyanate}.
e.zh: 铁离子会与硫氰酸根形成红色配合物。

thiocyanide.t: 硫氰化物；异硫氰酸盐旧称

e.en: Older papers sometimes used {thiocyanide} for thiocyanate compounds.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时用硫氰化物来指硫氰酸盐化合物。

e.en: The chemist corrected {thiocyanide} to the modern term thiocyanate.
e.zh: 化学家把硫氰化物改成了现代术语硫氰酸盐。

e.en: The product bears a {thiocyano} substituent on the benzene ring.
e.zh: 该产物在苯环上带有一个硫氰基取代基。

e.en: They prepared several {thiocyano} compounds for screening.
e.zh: 他们制备了几种含硫氰基的化合物用于筛选。

e.en: The review discusses {thiocyanocarbons} in high-energy materials.
e.zh: 这篇综述讨论了高能材料中的硫氰碳化合物。

e.en: Some {thiocyanocarbons} decompose when heated rapidly.
e.zh: 一些硫氰碳化合物在快速加热时会分解。

e.en: The chloride content was determined by {thiocyanometry}.
e.zh: 氯化物含量是通过硫氰酸盐滴定法测定的。

e.en: Students compared argentometry with {thiocyanometry} in the lab.
e.zh: 学生们在实验室比较了银量法和硫氰酸盐滴定法。

e.en: The analog {thiocytosine} was tested in cell cultures.
e.zh: 这种类似物硫代胞嘧啶在细胞培养中进行了测试。

e.en: A {thiocytosine} base can alter nucleic acid behavior.
e.zh: 硫代胞嘧啶碱基可能改变核酸的行为。

e.en: Acetyl-CoA contains a reactive {thioester} bond.
e.zh: 乙酰辅酶A含有一个反应性很强的硫酯键。

e.en: The enzyme transfers the acyl group from a {thioester}.
e.zh: 这种酶从硫酯上转移酰基。

e.en: Methionine contains a {thioether} group.
e.zh: 蛋氨酸含有一个硫醚基团。

e.en: The {thioether} ligand bound tightly to the metal ion.
e.zh: 这个硫醚配体与金属离子结合得很紧。

thiofide.t: 硫化物；含硫化合物旧称

e.en: The mineral was described as a {thiofide} in older texts.
e.zh: 这种矿物在旧文献中被称为硫化物。

e.en: Modern chemists rarely use the term {thiofide}.
e.zh: 现代化学家很少使用硫化物旧称这个术语。

e.en: {Thioformaldehyde} is usually too unstable to isolate easily.
e.zh: 硫代甲醛通常太不稳定，难以轻易分离。

e.en: The spectrum suggested traces of {thioformaldehyde} in the mixture.
e.zh: 光谱显示混合物中有微量硫代甲醛。

e.en: The reaction used {thioformamide} as a sulfur source.
e.zh: 该反应用硫代甲酰胺作为硫源。

e.en: Pure {thioformamide} must be handled under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 纯硫代甲酰胺必须在受控条件下处理。

e.en: {Thioformin} appeared in early reports on diabetes treatment.
e.zh: 硫福明出现在早期糖尿病治疗报告中。

e.en: The physician recognized {thioformin} as an obsolete drug name.
e.zh: 医生认出硫福明是一个已经过时的药名。

e.en: Older nomenclature sometimes called thiophene {thiofuran}.
e.zh: 较旧的命名法有时把噻吩称为硫代呋喃。

e.en: The paper used {thiofuran} to describe a sulfur heterocycle.
e.zh: 这篇论文用硫代呋喃描述一种含硫杂环。

e.en: The plant enzyme {thioglucosidase} releases pungent compounds.
e.zh: 植物酶硫代葡萄糖苷酶会释放刺激性化合物。

e.en: Heat can reduce {thioglucosidase} activity in mustard seeds.
e.zh: 加热会降低芥菜籽中硫代葡萄糖苷酶的活性。

e.en: The formula lists {thioglycol} as a reducing agent.
e.zh: 配方中把硫代乙二醇列为还原剂。

e.en: Workers stored {thioglycol} away from strong oxidizers.
e.zh: 工人把硫代乙二醇存放在远离强氧化剂的地方。

e.en: The report came from a respected {think-tank}.
e.zh: 这份报告出自一家受尊敬的智库。

e.en: She joined a {think-tank} after leaving government.
e.zh: 她离开政府后加入了一家政策研究机构。

e.en: The former diplomat became a {think-tanker} in Washington.
e.zh: 那位前外交官后来在华盛顿成了一名智库研究员。

e.en: A {think-tanker} warned that the policy could backfire.
e.zh: 一名政策顾问警告说，这项政策可能适得其反。

e.en: Several {think-tanks} criticized the new tax plan.
e.zh: 几家智库批评了新的税收计划。

e.en: Universities and {think-tanks} often compete for research grants.
e.zh: 大学和政策研究机构常常争夺研究经费。

e.en: This is the best result {thinkably} possible.
e.zh: 这是可以想象到的最好结果。

e.en: No one could {thinkably} finish the work overnight.
e.zh: 没人可以合理地认为这项工作能一夜完成。

e.en: Early writers imagined a {thinking-machine} that could solve puzzles.
e.zh: 早期作家想象过一种能解谜的思维机器。

e.en: The computer was advertised as a {thinking-machine} for business.
e.zh: 这台电脑被宣传成面向商业的智能机器。

e.en: The chemist described the compound as a {thio} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物描述为硫代衍生物。

e.en: A {thio} group can change the molecule's reactivity.
e.zh: 硫代基团会改变分子的反应性。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new {thio-acid} for testing.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种新的硫代酸用于测试。

e.en: A {thio-acid} contains sulfur in place of oxygen.
e.zh: 硫代酸中有硫取代了氧的位置。

e.en: Some {thio-acids} have a strong unpleasant smell.
e.zh: 有些硫代酸有很强的难闻气味。

e.en: The paper compares several {thio-acids} used in synthesis.
e.zh: 这篇论文比较了几种用于合成的硫代酸。

e.en: The patient received {thio-tepa} during chemotherapy.
e.zh: 患者在化疗期间接受了噻替哌治疗。

e.en: Doctors monitored side effects after giving {thio-tepa}.
e.zh: 医生在使用噻替哌后监测副作用。

e.en: Researchers used {thioacetamide} in the toxicity study.
e.zh: 研究人员在毒性研究中使用了硫代乙酰胺。

e.en: Handle {thioacetamide} carefully in the laboratory.
e.zh: 在实验室中要小心处理硫代乙酰胺。

thioacetate.t: 硫代乙酸盐；硫代乙酸酯

e.en: The reaction produced a {thioacetate} intermediate.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种硫代乙酸酯中间体。

e.en: Sodium {thioacetate} is useful in organic synthesis.
e.zh: 硫代乙酸钠在有机合成中很有用。

e.en: A {thioalcohol} often has a powerful odor.
e.zh: 硫醇通常有很强烈的气味。

e.en: The textbook defines a {thioalcohol} as a sulfur analogue of alcohol.
e.zh: 教材把硫代醇定义为醇的含硫类似物。

e.en: The sample contained a trace of {thioallophanate}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量硫代脲基甲酸盐。

e.en: Few students recognized the term {thioallophanate}.
e.zh: 很少有学生认出硫代脲基甲酸盐这个术语。

e.en: The mineral includes a complex {thioantimonate} structure.
e.zh: 这种矿物含有复杂的硫代锑酸盐结构。

e.en: They prepared a {thioantimonate} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 他们在受控条件下制备了一种硫代锑酸盐。

e.en: The old paper used {thioantimoniate} for the same salt.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文用硫代锑酸盐这个词指同一种盐。

e.en: A {thioantimoniate} may form brightly colored crystals.
e.zh: 硫代锑酸盐可能形成颜色鲜明的晶体。

e.en: The compound was classified as a {thioantimonite}.
e.zh: 这种化合物被归类为硫代亚锑酸盐。

e.en: A {thioantimonite} can be unstable in air.
e.zh: 硫代亚锑酸盐在空气中可能不稳定。

e.en: Groundwater tests detected a {thioarsenate} species.
e.zh: 地下水测试检出了一种硫代砷酸盐形态。

e.en: The {thioarsenate} formed under sulfide-rich conditions.
e.zh: 这种硫代砷酸盐是在富含硫化物的条件下形成的。

e.en: The solution contained both arsenite and {thioarsenite}.
e.zh: 溶液中同时含有亚砷酸盐和硫代亚砷酸盐。

e.en: A {thioarsenite} species may appear in hot springs.
e.zh: 温泉中可能出现硫代亚砷酸盐形态。

e.en: Some {thiobacteria} oxidize sulfur compounds for energy.
e.zh: 有些硫细菌通过氧化硫化合物获取能量。

e.en: The pond's smell came partly from {thiobacteria}.
e.zh: 池塘的气味部分来自硫细菌。

e.en: The chemist used {thiourea} in the experiment.
e.zh: 化学家在实验中使用了硫脲。

e.en: {Thiourea} can affect some metal reactions.
e.zh: 硫脲会影响某些金属反应。

e.en: The paper described a {thioureylene} linkage.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种硫脲撑连接。

e.en: A {thioureylene} group changed the polymer properties.
e.zh: 一个硫脲撑基改变了聚合物性质。

e.en: The sample contained a trace of {thioxane}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量噻噁烷。

e.en: Researchers studied {thioxane} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 研究人员在受控条件下研究噻噁烷。

e.en: The drug has a {thioxanthene} structure.
e.zh: 这种药物具有噻吨结构。

e.en: Chemists synthesized a new {thioxanthene} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的噻吨衍生物。

e.en: Farmers used {thiram} to protect seeds.
e.zh: 农民使用福美双来保护种子。

e.en: The label warned that {thiram} is toxic.
e.zh: 标签警告说福美双有毒。

e.en: This was her {third-best} score of the season.
e.zh: 这是她本赛季第三好的成绩。

e.en: They chose the {third-best} design after debate.
e.zh: 经过讨论，他们选择了第三好的设计。

e.en: He bought a {third-class} train ticket.
e.zh: 他买了一张三等火车票。

e.en: The hotel gave us {third-class} service.
e.zh: 这家酒店给我们的服务很差。

e.en: She suffered {third-degree} burns in the fire.
e.zh: 她在火灾中遭受了三度烧伤。

e.en: My parents gave me the {third-degree} about the party.
e.zh: 父母就那场聚会对我严加盘问。

e.en: The model created a {third-dimensional} effect.
e.zh: 这个模型产生了三维效果。

e.en: Artists added {third-dimensional} depth to the scene.
e.zh: 艺术家给场景增加了立体深度。

e.en: She drives a {third-generation} electric car.
e.zh: 她开的是第三代电动汽车。

e.en: The study followed {third-generation} immigrants.
e.zh: 这项研究追踪了第三代移民。

e.en: Sales rose sharply in the {third-quarter} report.
e.zh: 第三季度报告显示销售额大幅上升。

e.en: The team scored twice in the {third-quarter}.
e.zh: 球队在第三节得了两次分。

e.en: They stayed in a {third-rate} motel.
e.zh: 他们住在一家三流汽车旅馆。

e.en: The review called the film {third-rate}.
e.zh: 影评称这部电影很低劣。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a {third-rater}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为三流人物。

e.en: Nobody wanted to buy that {third-rater}.
e.zh: 没人想买那件劣等货。

e.en: The concert featured {third-stream} jazz.
e.zh: 音乐会演出了第三潮流爵士乐。

e.en: She studied {third-stream} composition at college.
e.zh: 她在大学学习第三潮流音乐创作。

e.en: The app uses {thirdparty} payment services.
e.zh: 这个应用使用第三方支付服务。

e.en: They hired a {thirdparty} auditor.
e.zh: 他们聘请了一名第三方审计员。

e.en: The carpenter tried to {thirl} the board.
e.zh: 木匠试着在木板上钻孔。

e.en: Cold wind seemed to {thirl} through the wall.
e.zh: 冷风似乎穿透了墙壁。

e.en: The village once lived under {thirlage}.
e.zh: 这个村庄过去受磨坊佃役制约束。

e.en: Historians studied {thirlage} in Scotland.
e.zh: 历史学家研究苏格兰的磨坊佃役制。

e.en: The tenants were {thirled} to the local mill.
e.zh: 佃户被约束必须使用当地磨坊。

e.en: The shell had {thirled} the old door.
e.zh: 炮弹已经穿透了那扇旧门。

e.en: The medicine may cause {thirstiness}.
e.zh: 这种药可能会引起口渴。

e.en: Her {thirstiness} for power worried them.
e.zh: 她对权力的渴望让他们担心。

e.en: He remained strangely {thirstless} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午他都奇怪地不觉得渴。

e.en: The poem imagines a {thirstless} soul.
e.zh: 这首诗想象了一个无所渴求的灵魂。

e.en: She counted {thirty-eight} chairs in the hall.
e.zh: 她数了大厅里有三十八把椅子。

e.en: The temperature reached {thirty-eight} degrees.
e.zh: 气温达到了三十八度。

e.en: The bus arrived {thirty-five} minutes late.
e.zh: 公交车晚到了三十五分钟。

e.en: He paid {thirty-five} dollars for dinner.
e.zh: 他晚餐花了三十五美元。

e.en: There are {thirty-one} days in May.
e.zh: 五月有三十一天。

e.en: She turned {thirty-one} last week.
e.zh: 她上周满三十一岁。

thioglycolate.t: 巯基乙酸盐或酯类化合物

e.en: The chemist added {thioglycolate} to reduce the disulfide bonds.
e.zh: 化学师加入巯基乙酸盐来还原二硫键。

e.en: Some hair products use {thioglycolate} to soften the hair structure.
e.zh: 一些美发产品使用巯基乙酸盐来软化头发结构。

e.en: The patient received {thioguanine} during leukemia treatment.
e.zh: 这名患者在白血病治疗期间使用了硫鸟嘌呤。

e.en: Doctors monitored liver function while prescribing {thioguanine}.
e.zh: 医生开硫鸟嘌呤时监测了肝功能。

e.en: A {thioketone} contains sulfur in place of the ketone oxygen.
e.zh: 硫酮用硫取代了酮中的氧。

e.en: The bright color helped identify the unstable {thioketone}.
e.zh: 鲜明的颜色帮助识别这种不稳定的硫酮。

e.en: A {thiol} often has a strong unpleasant smell.
e.zh: 硫醇通常有强烈而难闻的气味。

e.en: The protein contains a reactive {thiol} group.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质含有一个活泼的巯基。

e.en: The metal ion bound tightly to the {thiolate}.
e.zh: 金属离子与硫醇盐结合得很牢。

e.en: Under basic conditions, the thiol forms a {thiolate}.
e.zh: 在碱性条件下，硫醇会形成硫醇负离子。

thiolhistidine.t: 硫醇组氨酸相关化合物

e.en: Researchers measured {thiolhistidine} levels in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了组织样本中的硫醇组氨酸水平。

e.en: The proposed pathway includes {thiolhistidine} as a minor intermediate.
e.zh: 提出的途径把硫醇组氨酸列为一种少量中间体。

e.en: The compound showed clear {thiolic} reactivity in the assay.
e.zh: 该化合物在测定中表现出明显的硫醇反应性。

e.en: A faint odor suggested a {thiolic} impurity.
e.zh: 淡淡的气味表明可能有含巯基杂质。

e.en: The lab used {thiolutin} to inhibit RNA synthesis.
e.zh: 实验室使用硫鲁汀来抑制RNA合成。

e.en: Bacterial cultures responded strongly to {thiolutin}.
e.zh: 细菌培养物对硫鲁汀反应很强。

thiolysis.t: 硫解，由硫醇参与的裂解

e.en: The ester underwent {thiolysis} in the presence of a catalyst.
e.zh: 这种酯在催化剂存在下发生了硫解。

e.en: Enzymes can promote {thiolysis} during fatty acid metabolism.
e.zh: 酶可在脂肪酸代谢中促进硫解反应。

e.en: Some older vaccines contained {thiomersal} as a preservative.
e.zh: 一些早期疫苗含有硫柳汞作为防腐剂。

e.en: The leaflet stated that the vial was free of {thiomersal}.
e.zh: 说明书写明该小瓶不含硫柳汞。

e.en: The reaction produced a stable {thionate} salt.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种稳定的硫代酸盐。

e.en: Analysts detected a trace {thionate} in the solution.
e.zh: 分析人员在溶液中检出了微量硫代酸盐。

e.en: Farmers once used {thionazin} to control soil nematodes.
e.zh: 农民曾用硫线磷防治土壤线虫。

e.en: Regulators reviewed the toxicity data for {thionazin}.
e.zh: 监管机构审查了硫线磷的毒性数据。

e.en: The study linked {thioneine} to cellular antioxidant defenses.
e.zh: 该研究把硫酮因与细胞抗氧化防御联系起来。

e.en: Samples were analyzed for {thioneine} and related metabolites.
e.zh: 样本被分析其中的硫酮因及相关代谢物。

e.en: The paper described several {thionic} acids.
e.zh: 论文描述了几种含硫酸。

e.en: A {thionic} compound appeared during the oxidation step.
e.zh: 氧化步骤中出现了一种含硫化合物。

e.en: The technician stained the cells with {thionin}.
e.zh: 技术员用硫堇给细胞染色。

e.en: A dilute {thionin} solution revealed the tissue structure.
e.zh: 稀释的硫堇溶液显示出了组织结构。

e.en: The slide was treated with {thionine} before microscopy.
e.zh: 显微镜观察前，载玻片用硫堇处理过。

e.en: Chemists studied {thionine} as a redox dye.
e.zh: 化学家把硫堇作为氧化还原染料来研究。

e.en: The lab ordered {thionyl} chloride for the synthesis.
e.zh: 实验室订购了亚硫酰氯用于合成。

e.en: A {thionyl} group changes the compound's reactivity.
e.zh: 亚硫酰基会改变化合物的反应性。

e.en: The assay used {thiooxine} to bind metal ions.
e.zh: 该测定使用硫羟喹啉来结合金属离子。

e.en: Researchers compared {thiooxine} with other chelating agents.
e.zh: 研究人员把硫羟喹啉与其他螯合剂作了比较。

thioparamizone.t: 硫帕拉米宗，药物化合物

e.en: The archive listed {thioparamizone} among older experimental drugs.
e.zh: 档案把硫帕拉米宗列在较早的实验药物中。

e.en: Few modern papers mention {thioparamizone} in treatment studies.
e.zh: 现代治疗研究中很少有论文提到硫帕拉米宗。

thiophanate.t: 托布津类杀菌剂化合物

e.en: Growers applied {thiophanate} to prevent fungal disease.
e.zh: 种植者施用托布津类药剂来预防真菌病害。

e.en: The report measured {thiophanate} residues on fruit.
e.zh: 报告测量了水果上的托布津残留。

thiophane.t: 噻烷，含硫饱和环化合物

e.en: The molecule contains a {thiophane} ring.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个噻烷环。

e.en: Chemists synthesized {thiophane} derivatives for testing.
e.zh: 化学家合成了噻烷衍生物用于测试。

e.en: The spectrum matched a {thiophanthrene} derivative.
e.zh: 光谱与一种噻蒽衍生物相符。

e.en: Oxidation changed the color of the {thiophanthrene} sample.
e.zh: 氧化改变了噻蒽样品的颜色。

e.en: The crude oil contained traces of {thiophen}.
e.zh: 原油中含有微量噻吩。

e.en: Students identified {thiophen} by its sulfur signal.
e.zh: 学生通过硫信号识别出噻吩。

e.en: {Thiophene} is a common sulfur-containing aromatic ring.
e.zh: 噻吩是一种常见的含硫芳香环。

e.en: The polymer included {thiophene} units for conductivity.
e.zh: 这种聚合物含有噻吩单元以提高导电性。

e.en: Fuel processing removes many {thiophenic} sulfur compounds.
e.zh: 燃料加工会去除许多噻吩类硫化合物。

e.en: The catalyst targets {thiophenic} molecules in heavy oil.
e.zh: 这种催化剂针对重油中的噻吩类分子。

e.en: The lab stored {thiophenol} in a sealed bottle.
e.zh: 实验室把苯硫酚存放在密封瓶中。

e.en: {Thiophenol} has a strong unpleasant odor.
e.zh: 苯硫酚有一种强烈难闻的气味。

e.en: The {thiophilic} surface binds sulfur-containing molecules well.
e.zh: 这种亲硫表面能很好地结合含硫分子。

e.en: Researchers used a {thiophilic} resin for purification.
e.zh: 研究人员使用亲硫树脂进行纯化。

e.en: The old paper misspelled {thiophnol} in the table.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文在表格中把硫酚拼错了。

e.en: He treated {thiophnol} as a variant name.
e.zh: 他把thiophnol当作一个变体名称处理。

e.en: The enzyme {thiophorase} helps process ketone bodies.
e.zh: 硫解酶有助于处理酮体。

e.en: A defect in {thiophorase} can disrupt energy metabolism.
e.zh: 硫解酶缺陷可能扰乱能量代谢。

e.en: The report classified {thiophos} as an organophosphorus compound.
e.zh: 报告把thiophos归为一种有机磷化合物。

e.en: Farm workers handled {thiophos} only with protective equipment.
e.zh: 农场工人只在佩戴防护装备时处理硫磷化合物。

e.en: Chemists used {thiophosgene} under strict ventilation.
e.zh: 化学家在严格通风条件下使用硫光气。

e.en: {Thiophosgene} is a reactive sulfur-containing reagent.
e.zh: 硫光气是一种活泼的含硫试剂。

e.en: The pesticide contains a {thiophosphate} group.
e.zh: 这种农药含有一个硫代磷酸基团。

e.en: A {thiophosphate} can form stable metal complexes.
e.zh: 硫代磷酸盐可以形成稳定的金属配合物。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {thiophosphite} ligand.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的硫代亚磷酸盐配体。

e.en: This {thiophosphite} decomposes slowly in water.
e.zh: 这种硫代亚磷酸盐在水中缓慢分解。

e.en: The reaction caused {thiophosphorylation} of the alcohol.
e.zh: 该反应使这种醇发生了硫代磷酰化。

e.en: They studied {thiophosphorylation} as a protein-labeling method.
e.zh: 他们研究硫代磷酰化作为一种蛋白标记方法。

e.en: The sample of {thiopropionamide} was kept dry.
e.zh: 这份硫代丙酰胺样品被保持干燥。

e.en: {Thiopropionamide} can be used in organic synthesis.
e.zh: 硫代丙酰胺可用于有机合成。

e.en: The product formed a {thiopropionate} ester.
e.zh: 产物形成了一种硫代丙酸酯。

e.en: They detected {thiopropionate} in the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 他们在反应混合物中检测到了硫代丙酸盐。

e.en: The medium contained {thioproteose} for bacterial growth.
e.zh: 这种培养基含有含硫蛋白胨以促进细菌生长。

e.en: Older manuals list {thioproteose} among protein derivatives.
e.zh: 较早的手册把含硫蛋白胨列为蛋白质衍生物之一。

e.en: The molecule includes a {thiopyran} ring.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个噻喃环。

e.en: Researchers prepared {thiopyran} derivatives for testing.
e.zh: 研究人员制备了噻喃衍生物用于测试。

e.en: The dye reaction used {thioresorcinol} as a reagent.
e.zh: 该染料反应用硫代间苯二酚作试剂。

e.en: {Thioresorcinol} is related to resorcinol chemistry.
e.zh: 硫代间苯二酚与间苯二酚化学有关。

e.en: The doctor reduced the patient's {thioridazine} dose.
e.zh: 医生降低了患者的硫利达嗪剂量。

e.en: {Thioridazine} can affect the heart rhythm.
e.zh: 硫利达嗪可能影响心律。

e.en: The prefix {thiosa} appears in some chemical names.
e.zh: 前缀thiosa出现在一些化学名称中。

e.en: Students rarely meet {thiosa} outside nomenclature.
e.zh: 学生很少在命名法之外遇到thiosa。

e.en: The aldehyde formed a {thiosemicarbazone} derivative.
e.zh: 这种醛形成了硫代氨基脲缩腙衍生物。

e.en: Some {thiosemicarbazone} compounds show antiviral activity.
e.zh: 一些硫代氨基脲缩腙化合物表现出抗病毒活性。

e.en: Old pharmacology texts mention {thiosinamine} for scar treatment.
e.zh: 旧药理学教材提到硫芥子胺可用于瘢痕治疗。

e.en: {Thiosinamine} is now mainly of historical interest.
e.zh: 硫芥子胺如今主要具有历史研究意义。

e.en: The solution produced a yellow {thiostannate} precipitate.
e.zh: 该溶液生成了黄色的硫代锡酸盐沉淀。

e.en: A {thiostannate} contains tin and sulfur atoms.
e.zh: 硫代锡酸盐含有锡原子和硫原子。

e.en: They prepared {thiostannite} under oxygen-free conditions.
e.zh: 他们在无氧条件下制备硫代亚锡酸盐。

e.en: The {thiostannite} ion is less common in textbooks.
e.zh: 硫代亚锡酸根离子在教材中较少见。

e.en: Photographers once used sodium {thiosulphate} as fixer.
e.zh: 摄影师过去使用硫代硫酸钠作定影剂。

e.en: The test measured {thiosulphate} in the water sample.
e.zh: 这项测试测量了水样中的硫代硫酸盐。

e.en: The oncology team prescribed {thiotepa} before transplantation.
e.zh: 肿瘤科团队在移植前开具了塞替派。

e.en: {Thiotepa} is a chemotherapy drug with serious risks.
e.zh: 塞替派是一种有严重风险的化疗药物。

e.en: The psychiatrist discussed {thiothixene} with the patient.
e.zh: 精神科医生与患者讨论了替沃噻吨。

e.en: {Thiothixene} may cause drowsiness in some people.
e.zh: 替沃噻吨可能使一些人嗜睡。

e.en: The drug {thiouracil} reduces thyroid hormone production.
e.zh: 药物硫尿嘧啶会减少甲状腺激素生成。

e.en: Researchers measured {thiouracil} levels in plasma.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了血浆中的硫尿嘧啶水平。

thirty-twomo.t: 三十二开本的书页尺寸或书

e.en: The pamphlet was printed in {thirty-twomo} format.
e.zh: 这本小册子采用三十二开本格式印刷。

e.en: Collectors prized the tiny {thirty-twomo} volume.
e.zh: 收藏者很看重那本小巧的三十二开本书。

e.en: The investment brought a {thirtyfold} return.
e.zh: 这笔投资带来了三十倍的回报。

e.en: Demand increased {thirtyfold} after the report.
e.zh: 报告发布后，需求增加了三十倍。

e.en: His sermons warned against excessive {this-worldliness}.
e.zh: 他的布道告诫人们不要过分执着于现世。

e.en: The novel treats {this-worldliness} as a moral strength.
e.zh: 这部小说把重视现实生活看作一种道德力量。

e.en: The plant had {thistlelike} leaves along its stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎上长着像蓟一样多刺的叶子。

e.en: Her drawing showed a {thistlelike} flower.
e.zh: 她的画里有一朵形似蓟的花。

e.en: We crossed a {thistly} field at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时我们穿过一片长满蓟草的田地。

e.en: The sheep avoided the {thistly} patch.
e.zh: 羊群避开了那块多刺的蓟草地。

e.en: The path was easy {thitherto}, then vanished.
e.zh: 到那里为止小路还很好走，随后就消失了。

e.en: The plan had worked {thitherto} without serious trouble.
e.zh: 直到那时，这个计划一直没有出大问题。

e.en: The riders turned {thitherward} before sunrise.
e.zh: 骑手们在日出前转向那边。

e.en: Her thoughts drifted {thitherward} again.
e.zh: 她的思绪又飘向了那里。

e.en: The crowd moved {thitherwards} after the bell.
e.zh: 铃响后，人群朝那边移动。

e.en: He pointed {thitherwards} with his cane.
e.zh: 他用手杖指向那边。

e.en: The gloves contained a {thiuram} accelerator.
e.zh: 这些手套含有一种秋兰姆类促进剂。

e.en: She reacted badly to {thiuram} in the rubber.
e.zh: 她对橡胶中的秋兰姆类物质反应很强烈。

e.en: The gel was {thixolabile} under repeated stirring.
e.zh: 这种凝胶在反复搅拌下呈触变不稳定状态。

e.en: Engineers rejected the {thixolabile} coating.
e.zh: 工程师们淘汰了这种触变不稳定的涂层。

e.en: The paint is {thixotropic} and spreads easily when brushed.
e.zh: 这种油漆具有触变性，刷开时很容易铺展。

e.en: A {thixotropic} gel thickens again after standing.
e.zh: 触变性凝胶静置后会重新变稠。

e.en: The lab measured {thixotropism} in the clay sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了这份黏土样品的触变现象。

e.en: Strong {thixotropism} made the fluid hard to pump.
e.zh: 强烈的触变性使这种流体难以泵送。

e.en: The sauce shows {thixotropy} when shaken.
e.zh: 这种酱汁摇晃时会表现出触变性。

e.en: Engineers studied the {thixotropy} of drilling mud.
e.zh: 工程师研究了钻井泥浆的触变性。

e.en: She could barely {thole} his complaints any longer.
e.zh: 她几乎再也忍受不了他的抱怨了。

e.en: The oar rested against a wooden {thole}.
e.zh: 船桨靠在一个木制桨架钉上。

e.en: He {tholed} the pain without speaking.
e.zh: 他一声不吭地忍受了疼痛。

e.en: The old boat was {tholed} for two oars.
e.zh: 那条旧船装有供两支桨使用的桨架钉。

e.en: The island is built mainly of {tholeiite}.
e.zh: 这座岛主要由拉斑玄武岩构成。

e.en: Geologists sampled {tholeiite} from the lava flow.
e.zh: 地质学家从熔岩流中采集了拉斑玄武岩样本。

e.en: The volcano produced {tholeiitic} basalt.
e.zh: 这座火山喷出了拉斑玄武岩质玄武岩。

e.en: They analyzed the {tholeiitic} lava chemically.
e.zh: 他们对这些拉斑玄武岩质熔岩进行了化学分析。

e.en: The broken {tholepin} made rowing awkward.
e.zh: 断裂的桨架钉让划船变得很别扭。

e.en: He carved a new {tholepin} from oak.
e.zh: 他用橡木削了一个新的桨架钉。

tholin.t: 托林；行星表面有机混合物

e.en: Titan's haze contains complex {tholin} particles.
e.zh: 泰坦的雾霾中含有复杂的托林颗粒。

e.en: Researchers made {tholin} in a laboratory chamber.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室舱内制备了托林。

e.en: He was {tholing} hardship with quiet patience.
e.zh: 他正默默耐心地忍受艰苦。

e.en: The carpenter was {tholing} the small boat.
e.zh: 木匠正在给那条小船装桨架钉。

e.en: The dome rises from a carved {tholobate}.
e.zh: 圆顶从一座雕刻过的穹顶基座上升起。

e.en: Restorers repaired the cracked {tholobate} first.
e.zh: 修复人员先修补了开裂的圆顶鼓座。

tholos.t: 圆形古墓或圆顶建筑遗迹

e.en: The archaeologists measured the ancient {tholos} before sunset.
e.zh: 考古学家在日落前测量了那座古代圆形墓。

e.en: A small {tholos} stood near the ruined sanctuary.
e.zh: 一座小圆顶建筑立在废弃圣所旁。

e.en: The probe photographed a volcanic {tholus} on the planet's surface.
e.zh: 探测器拍下了行星表面的一座火山穹丘。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {tholus} using radar images.
e.zh: 研究人员用雷达图像绘制了这座圆顶状小山。

e.en: The lab tested the sample for {thomboplastin} activity.
e.zh: 实验室检测了样本中的凝血活酶活性。

e.en: Low {thomboplastin} levels may affect clotting results.
e.zh: 凝血活酶水平偏低可能影响凝血结果。

thon.t: 物质粒子单位；吨的异拼

e.en: The physicist described the excitation as a {thon}.
e.zh: 物理学家把这种激发描述为一个物质粒子单位。

e.en: The old ledger wrote one {thon} of coal.
e.zh: 旧账本上写着一吨煤，拼法用了thon。

e.en: The surgeon reviewed the patient's {thoracal} scan carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细查看了病人的胸部扫描。

e.en: A {thoracal} injury can make breathing painful.
e.zh: 胸部损伤会让呼吸变得疼痛。

e.en: The team planned a limited {thoracectomy} for the tumor.
e.zh: 团队计划为这个肿瘤进行有限的胸壁切除术。

e.en: Recovery after {thoracectomy} required careful pain control.
e.zh: 胸壁切除术后的恢复需要谨慎控制疼痛。

e.en: The paper mentioned {thoracene} in an old chemical index.
e.zh: 论文在一本旧化学索引中提到了thoracene这种化合物名。

e.en: Few modern databases list {thoracene} as a common substance.
e.zh: 现代数据库很少把thoracene列为常见物质。

e.en: The doctor performed {thoracentesis} to drain excess fluid.
e.zh: 医生进行了胸腔穿刺术，以排出多余积液。

e.en: After {thoracentesis}, her breathing became much easier.
e.zh: 胸腔穿刺术后，她呼吸轻松多了。

e.en: The insects had dark markings on their {thoraces}.
e.zh: 这些昆虫的胸部有深色斑纹。

e.en: Medical students compared the two skeletal {thoraces}.
e.zh: 医学生比较了两具骨骼的胸廓。

e.en: The device was inserted {thoracically} under imaging guidance.
e.zh: 该装置在影像引导下经胸部置入。

e.en: The symptoms presented {thoracically} rather than abdominally.
e.zh: 这些症状表现于胸部，而不是腹部。

e.en: The patient had a {thoracicolumbar} spinal fracture.
e.zh: 这名患者有胸腰段脊柱骨折。

e.en: They ordered braces for {thoracicolumbar} support.
e.zh: 他们订购了用于胸腰部支撑的支具。

e.en: The chest pain was diagnosed as {thoracochondritis}.
e.zh: 这阵胸痛被诊断为胸肋软骨炎。

e.en: Mild {thoracochondritis} often improves with rest.
e.zh: 轻度胸肋软骨炎通常会随休息而好转。

e.en: The report described {thoracopagus} twins joined at the chest.
e.zh: 报告描述了一对胸部相连的连体双胞胎。

e.en: Surgery for {thoracopagus} cases requires detailed planning.
e.zh: 胸部连体胎病例的手术需要周密规划。

e.en: He underwent {thoracoplasty} after severe lung disease.
e.zh: 严重肺病之后，他接受了胸廓成形术。

e.en: Modern {thoracoplasty} is far less common than before.
e.zh: 现代胸廓成形术远没有过去常见。

e.en: The newborn was diagnosed with {thoracoschisis} at birth.
e.zh: 这个新生儿出生时被诊断为胸裂畸形。

e.en: Prenatal imaging can sometimes reveal {thoracoschisis}.
e.zh: 产前影像有时能发现胸裂畸形。

e.en: Emergency {thoracostomy} relieved the pressure in his chest.
e.zh: 紧急胸腔造口术缓解了他胸腔内的压力。

e.en: A tube {thoracostomy} was placed after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后医生为他置入了胸腔引流管。

e.en: The mineral sample contained small grains of {thoreaulite}.
e.zh: 这份矿物样本含有少量锰锡钽矿颗粒。

e.en: Collectors value {thoreaulite} for its unusual composition.
e.zh: 收藏者看重锰锡钽矿特殊的成分。

thoreauvian.t: 梭罗式的；崇尚简朴自然的

e.en: She admired a {Thoreauvian} life close to the woods.
e.zh: 她向往一种贴近森林的梭罗式生活。

e.en: His essay has a strongly {Thoreauvian} tone.
e.zh: 他的文章带有很强的梭罗式语气。

e.en: Old gas mantles sometimes contained {thoria}.
e.zh: 旧式煤气灯纱罩有时含有二氧化钍。

e.en: The ceramic used {thoria} for heat resistance.
e.zh: 这种陶瓷使用二氧化钍来提高耐热性。

thorianite.t: 钍铀氧化矿物；方钍石类矿物

e.en: The geologist identified {thorianite} in the heavy black sand.
e.zh: 地质学家在黑色重砂中认出了钍铀氧化矿物。

e.en: Old reports described {thorianite} as a source of thorium.
e.zh: 早期报告把钍铀氧化矿物描述为钍的来源。

thoriate.t: 使与钍化合；制成钍酸盐

e.en: The chemist tried to {thoriate} the oxide under controlled heat.
e.zh: 化学家试图在受控加热下使这种氧化物与钍化合。

e.en: They used the process to {thoriate} the ceramic surface.
e.zh: 他们用这道工艺给陶瓷表面进行钍化处理。

e.en: The sample contained yellow-brown {thorite} crystals.
e.zh: 样品中含有黄褐色的钍石晶体。

e.en: Miners once mistook {thorite} for a less valuable mineral.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾把钍石误认为价值较低的矿物。

thornback.t: 刺背鳐；背有刺的人或物

e.en: The fisherman released the {thornback} into deeper water.
e.zh: 渔民把那条刺背鳐放回了更深的水域。

e.en: The old chair was a {thornback} of splintered wood.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子像背上长刺一样满是木刺。

e.en: A tiny {thornbill} hovered beside the red flower.
e.zh: 一只小小的刺嘴蜂鸟在红花旁悬停。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {thornbill} in the eucalyptus.
e.zh: 向导指出桉树上有一只刺嘴鸟。

e.en: The plant had {thornlike} hairs along its stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎上长着像刺一样的细毛。

e.en: A {thornlike} pain shot through his thumb.
e.zh: 一阵刺痛从他的拇指传来。

e.en: The {thorntail} flashed green in the morning light.
e.zh: 刺尾蜂鸟在晨光中闪着绿色。

e.en: Researchers recorded a rare {thorntail} near the forest edge.
e.zh: 研究人员在森林边缘记录到一只罕见的刺尾鸟。

e.en: Cattle rested in the shade of a {thorntree}.
e.zh: 牛群在一棵带刺树的树荫下休息。

e.en: The dry plain was dotted with {thorntree} branches.
e.zh: 干燥的平原上散布着带刺树的枝条。

e.en: Antelope moved quietly through the {thornveld}.
e.zh: 羚羊静静地穿过南非多刺灌木草原。

e.en: Fires can spread quickly across dry {thornveld}.
e.zh: 火势会在干燥的多刺灌木草原上迅速蔓延。

e.en: The mechanic gave the engine a {thoro} inspection.
e.zh: 技师对发动机做了一次彻底检查。

e.en: Her notes were informal but surprisingly {thoro}.
e.zh: 她的笔记写得随意，却出人意料地详尽。

e.en: The paper discussed {thorocene} as an unusual organometallic compound.
e.zh: 论文把thorocene作为一种少见的含钍有机金属化合物来讨论。

e.en: Students compared {thorocene} with better-known actinide complexes.
e.zh: 学生们把thorocene与更常见的锕系金属配合物作比较。

e.en: The old map marked the river as a main {thorofare}.
e.zh: 旧地图把这条河标为主要通道。

e.en: Wagons crowded the muddy {thorofare} after market day.
e.zh: 集市日后，马车挤满了泥泞的大道。

e.en: The detector measured {thoron} escaping from the rock.
e.zh: 探测器测量了从岩石中逸出的钍射气。

e.en: Poor ventilation can let {thoron} collect indoors.
e.zh: 通风不良可能让钍射气在室内积聚。

thorotungstite.t: 钍钨矿；含钍钨酸盐矿物

e.en: The rare mineral {thorotungstite} was found in the vein.
e.zh: 矿脉中发现了罕见的钍钨矿。

e.en: Collectors prize {thorotungstite} for its unusual composition.
e.zh: 收藏者因钍钨矿成分特殊而珍视它。

thorough-paced.t: 彻头彻尾的；训练有素的

e.en: He was a {thorough-paced} liar with a charming smile.
e.zh: 他是个彻头彻尾的骗子，却笑得很迷人。

e.en: The horse was {thorough-paced} and steady on rough roads.
e.zh: 这匹马训练有素，在崎岖路上也很稳。

e.en: The harpsichord supplied the {thoroughbass} for the aria.
e.zh: 羽管键琴为这首咏叹调提供通奏低音。

e.en: Students learned {thoroughbass} before writing their own chorales.
e.zh: 学生们先学习数字低音，再创作自己的众赞歌。

e.en: The carriage rode smoothly on its leather {thoroughbrace}.
e.zh: 马车靠皮制吊带行驶得很平稳。

e.en: A broken {thoroughbrace} made the coach lurch badly.
e.zh: 一根马车吊带断了，车厢剧烈摇晃。

thoroughpaced.t: 彻头彻尾的；训练有素的

e.en: The memoir portrays him as a {thoroughpaced} opportunist.
e.zh: 这本回忆录把他写成一个彻头彻尾的机会主义者。

e.en: A {thoroughpaced} mount could travel all day without tiring.
e.zh: 一匹训练有素的坐骑能走上一整天而不疲惫。

thoroughpin.t: 马腿关节肿胀；跗关节软肿

e.en: The veterinarian diagnosed {thoroughpin} in the gelding's hock.
e.zh: 兽医诊断这匹阉马的跗关节有软肿。

e.en: Rest reduced the {thoroughpin} before the next race.
e.zh: 休息让下一场比赛前的马腿关节肿胀减轻了。

thoroughwax.t: 透茎柴胡；贯叶草本植物

e.en: The herbalist dried {thoroughwax} for winter remedies.
e.zh: 草药师晒干透茎柴胡，留作冬季药材。

e.en: Yellow {thoroughwax} grew along the chalky bank.
e.zh: 黄色的透茎柴胡长在白垩质河岸边。

e.en: Settlers brewed {thoroughwort} as a bitter tea.
e.zh: 移民把贯叶泽兰煮成味苦的茶。

e.en: White {thoroughwort} flowers attracted bees near the fence.
e.zh: 白色的贯叶泽兰花在篱笆旁吸引了蜜蜂。

e.en: The fisher photographed a {threadfin} near the reef.
e.zh: 渔民在礁石附近拍到一条丝鳍鱼。

e.en: A {threadfin} has long, delicate fin rays.
e.zh: 丝鳍鱼有细长而精巧的鳍条。

e.en: The market sold fresh {threadfish} in the morning.
e.zh: 市场早上售卖新鲜的丝鳍鱼。

e.en: A {threadfish} darted through the shallow water.
e.zh: 一条线鳍鱼在浅水中迅速游过。

e.en: The cheese lost its {threadiness} as it cooled.
e.zh: 奶酪冷却后失去了拉丝的质感。

e.en: She disliked the {threadiness} of the overcooked beans.
e.zh: 她不喜欢煮过头的豆子那种纤维感。

e.en: The collar was edged with antique {threadlace}.
e.zh: 衣领镶着古旧的线织花边。

e.en: She repaired the torn {threadlace} by hand.
e.zh: 她亲手修补了撕裂的细线蕾丝。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a {threadworm} infection.
e.zh: 医生诊断出蛲虫感染。

e.en: Children can catch {threadworm} at school.
e.zh: 孩子们可能在学校感染蛲虫。

e.en: They continued to {threap} about the old boundary.
e.zh: 他们继续为旧边界争辩不休。

e.en: He would {threap} that his story was true.
e.zh: 他会固执地断言自己的故事是真的。

e.en: The neighbors {threaped} over the fence line.
e.zh: 邻居们曾为篱笆界线争辩。

e.en: She {threaped} that no promise had been made.
e.zh: 她固执声称从未作出过承诺。

e.en: Their {threaping} lasted until midnight.
e.zh: 他们的争辩一直持续到午夜。

e.en: He kept {threaping} that the map was wrong.
e.zh: 他一直固执地说那张地图错了。

e.en: The play follows a classic {three-act} structure.
e.zh: 这部戏采用经典的三幕式结构。

e.en: She outlined a {three-act} film for class.
e.zh: 她为课堂勾勒了一部三段结构的电影。

three-bagger.t: 三垒安打；涨三倍的投资

e.en: He hit a {three-bagger} in the seventh inning.
e.zh: 他在第七局打出一记三垒安打。

e.en: That stock became a {three-bagger} within a year.
e.zh: 那只股票一年内涨成了三倍股。

e.en: They played a {three-ball} match after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后他们打了一场三人组比赛。

e.en: The {three-ball} format kept the game moving quickly.
e.zh: 三球赛制让比赛推进得很快。

e.en: He learned a simple {three-card} trick.
e.zh: 他学会了一个简单的三张牌魔术。

e.en: The casino offered a {three-card} poker table.
e.zh: 赌场设有一张三牌扑克桌。

e.en: The logo uses a {three-color} design.
e.zh: 这个标志采用三色设计。

e.en: She printed the chart in a {three-color} scheme.
e.zh: 她用三种颜色的方案打印了图表。

e.en: The flag has a {three-colour} pattern.
e.zh: 这面旗帜有三色图案。

e.en: He chose a {three-colour} palette for the poster.
e.zh: 他为海报选择了三种颜色的配色。

e.en: He wore a {three-cornered} hat at the parade.
e.zh: 他在游行中戴着一顶三角帽。

e.en: The election became a {three-cornered} contest.
e.zh: 这场选举变成了三方角逐。

e.en: The kids watched a {three-D} movie.
e.zh: 孩子们看了一部三维电影。

e.en: The designer built a {three-D} model.
e.zh: 设计师制作了一个立体模型。

e.en: They rented a flat in a {three-decker}.
e.zh: 他们在一栋三层住宅里租了套公寓。

e.en: The cafe served a huge {three-decker} sandwich.
e.zh: 咖啡馆供应一种巨大的三层三明治。

e.en: The sculptures reveal different {three-dimensionalities} under light.
e.zh: 这些雕塑在光线下呈现出不同的立体感。

e.en: The essay compares the {three-dimensionalities} of several models.
e.zh: 这篇文章比较了几个模型的三维性。

e.en: Lighting gave the painting a sense of {three-dimensionality}.
e.zh: 灯光让这幅画有了立体感。

e.en: The software measures the object's {three-dimensionality}.
e.zh: 这款软件测量物体的三维性。

e.en: The diagram shows the shape in {three-dimensions}.
e.zh: 这张图以三维方式展示形状。

e.en: We measured the box in {three-dimensions}.
e.zh: 我们从三个维度测量了这个盒子。

e.en: The company reported a {three-figure} loss.
e.zh: 公司报告了一笔三位数的亏损。

e.en: She paid a {three-figure} price for the ticket.
e.zh: 她为这张票付了三位数的价格。

e.en: She drank {three-fourths} of the bottle.
e.zh: 她喝掉了那瓶水的四分之三。

e.en: About {three-fourths} of the class passed.
e.zh: 全班大约四分之三的人通过了。

e.en: The judge admired the {three-gaited} horse.
e.zh: 裁判欣赏那匹有三种步态的马。

e.en: A {three-gaited} class was added to the show.
e.zh: 马展增加了一个三步态组别。

e.en: They played a {three-handed} game of cards.
e.zh: 他们玩了一局三人纸牌游戏。

e.en: The myth described a {three-handed} giant.
e.zh: 神话中描写了一个三只手的巨人。

e.en: We took a {three-hour} train ride.
e.zh: 我们坐了三小时的火车。

e.en: The exam includes a {three-hour} writing section.
e.zh: 这场考试包括三小时的写作部分。

e.en: The therapist asked him to describe his {thought-contents} during the panic attack.
e.zh: 治疗师让他描述惊恐发作时的思想内容。

e.en: The study compared the {thought-contents} of anxious and non-anxious participants.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了焦虑者和非焦虑者的思维内容。

e.en: Einstein used a {thought-experiment} to explore the nature of light.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦用思想实验来探索光的本质。

e.en: As a {thought-experiment}, imagine a city with no private cars.
e.zh: 作为一个思想实验，请想象一座没有私家车的城市。

e.en: Philosophers often use {thought-experiments} to test moral intuitions.
e.zh: 哲学家常用思想实验来检验道德直觉。

e.en: Her physics class discussed several famous {thought-experiments}.
e.zh: 她的物理课讨论了几个著名的思想实验。

e.en: The proposal was carefully {thought-out} and practical.
e.zh: 这份提案经过仔细思考，而且很务实。

e.en: We need a more {thought-out} plan before we begin.
e.zh: 开始之前，我们需要一个更周密的计划。

e.en: The teacher asked students to explain their {thought-processes}.
e.zh: 老师要求学生解释自己的思维过程。

e.en: Different cultures may encourage different {thought-processes}.
e.zh: 不同文化可能会培养不同的思考方式。

e.en: In the story, the alien could {thought-read} anyone nearby.
e.zh: 在故事里，那个外星人能读懂附近任何人的想法。

e.en: She seemed to {thought-read} his hesitation before he spoke.
e.zh: 他还没开口，她似乎就看出了他的犹豫。

thought-reader.t: 读心者；能读懂想法的人

e.en: The magician pretended to be a {thought-reader} on stage.
e.zh: 魔术师在舞台上假装自己是读心者。

e.en: A skilled negotiator can seem like a {thought-reader}.
e.zh: 老练的谈判者有时看起来像能读懂别人想法。

e.en: The novel treats {thought-reading} as a dangerous political weapon.
e.zh: 这部小说把读心术写成一种危险的政治武器。

e.en: Good listening is not the same as {thought-reading}.
e.zh: 善于倾听并不等于能揣摩出所有心思。

e.en: The machine supposedly detected a person's {thought-wave}.
e.zh: 据说这台机器能探测人的思想波。

e.en: Old science fiction often imagined messages sent by {thought-wave}.
e.zh: 早期科幻小说常想象用脑电波传递信息。

e.en: The diary opens a window into her {thought-world}.
e.zh: 这本日记让人得以窥见她的内心世界。

e.en: Medieval theology shaped the {thought-world} of the period.
e.zh: 中世纪神学塑造了那个时代的思想世界。

e.en: In the dystopian state, doubt itself became {thoughtcrime}.
e.zh: 在那个反乌托邦国家，怀疑本身就成了思想罪。

e.en: He used {thoughtcrime} jokingly to describe an unpopular opinion.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地用“思想罪”来形容一个不受欢迎的观点。

e.en: The essay traces a traditional {thoughtway} in rural communities.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了乡村社区中的一种传统思维方式。

e.en: Learning another language can change your {thoughtway}.
e.zh: 学习另一门语言可能会改变你的思维方式。

e.en: The old farmer called the boy {thowless} after a morning of idling.
e.zh: 那男孩闲晃了一上午，老农说他懒散无用。

e.en: A {thowless} effort would not save the failing harvest.
e.zh: 无力的努力救不了歉收的庄稼。

e.en: The rebels fought to escape centuries of {thraldom}.
e.zh: 叛军为摆脱数百年的奴役而战。

e.en: He lived in {thraldom} to debt and fear.
e.zh: 他一直受债务和恐惧的束缚。

e.en: A noisy {thrang} filled the market before noon.
e.zh: 中午前，喧闹的人群挤满了市场。

e.en: She was {thrang} with work all winter.
e.zh: 整个冬天她都忙得不可开交。

e.en: The singer wrapped a scarf around his sore {thrapple}.
e.zh: 歌手用围巾裹住疼痛的喉咙。
