e.en: He grabbed the villain by the {thrapple} in the old ballad.
e.zh: 在那首古老民谣里，他一把扼住恶人的咽喉。

e.en: His {thrasonical} speech bored everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他那番自吹自擂的讲话让晚餐上的人都厌烦。

e.en: The critic mocked the play's {thrasonical} hero.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑剧中那个爱夸口的英雄。

e.en: He spoke {thrasonically} about victories he had never won.
e.zh: 他自吹自擂地谈论自己从未赢得的胜利。

e.en: The soldier {thrasonically} promised to defeat the army alone.
e.zh: 那个士兵夸口说自己能独自击败整支军队。

e.en: The reapers stacked each {thrave} beside the field path.
e.zh: 收割者把每捆谷物堆在田边小路旁。

e.en: An old account listed a {thrave} of wheat as payment.
e.zh: 一份旧账把一捆小麦记作报酬。

e.en: Cold wind seemed to {thraw} the branches overnight.
e.zh: 寒风似乎一夜之间把树枝吹得扭曲了。

e.en: Do not {thraw} the facts to suit your argument.
e.zh: 不要为了迎合你的论点而歪曲事实。

e.en: The sailor tied a {thrawart} beam across the opening.
e.zh: 水手把一根横梁绑在开口处。

e.en: His {thrawart} temper made every discussion difficult.
e.zh: 他乖戾的脾气让每次讨论都很难进行。

e.en: The old gate hung on a {thrawn} iron hinge.
e.zh: 旧门挂在一个扭曲的铁铰链上。

e.en: She gave him a {thrawn} answer and walked away.
e.zh: 她倔强地回了他一句，然后走开了。

e.en: The branch grew {thrawnly} toward the low stone wall.
e.zh: 那根树枝弯弯扭扭地朝低矮的石墙长去。

e.en: He {thrawnly} refused every reasonable compromise.
e.zh: 他倔强地拒绝了每一个合理的妥协。

e.en: She learned to {thread-needle} without her glasses.
e.zh: 她学会了不戴眼镜也能给针穿线。

e.en: The tailor showed the child how to {thread-needle} carefully.
e.zh: 裁缝教那个孩子怎样小心地穿针。

e.en: This {three-in-one} printer can scan, copy, and print documents.
e.zh: 这台三合一打印机可以扫描、复印和打印文件。

e.en: She bought a {three-in-one} jacket for the mountain trip.
e.zh: 她为登山旅行买了一件一衣三用的夹克。

e.en: The bridge has a {three-lane} road in each direction.
e.zh: 这座桥每个方向都有一条三车道路。

e.en: Traffic slowed where the highway became {three-lane}.
e.zh: 高速公路变成三车道的地方，车流慢了下来。

e.en: A {three-legged} stool stood beside the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉旁放着一张三条腿的凳子。

e.en: They organized a {three-legged} race at the school picnic.
e.zh: 他们在学校野餐会上组织了两人三足赛跑。

e.en: The company introduced a {three-level} approval process.
e.zh: 公司推出了三级审批流程。

e.en: They live in a {three-level} house near the river.
e.zh: 他们住在河边一栋三层的房子里。

e.en: The old {three-master} crossed the Atlantic with a full crew.
e.zh: 那艘老三桅船载着全体船员横渡大西洋。

e.en: A model {three-master} sat inside the glass case.
e.zh: 一个三桅船模型放在玻璃柜里。

three-peat.t: 三连冠；连续第三次获胜

e.en: The team completed a {three-peat} with another finals victory.
e.zh: 球队再次赢下决赛，完成了三连冠。

e.en: Fans began chanting about a possible {three-peat} next season.
e.zh: 球迷开始高喊下赛季可能实现三连冠。

e.en: The project followed a {three-phase} development plan.
e.zh: 这个项目采用了三阶段开发计划。

e.en: The factory uses {three-phase} power for heavy machinery.
e.zh: 工厂用三相电驱动重型机械。

e.en: He wore a dark {three-piece} suit to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿了一套深色三件套西装去面试。

e.en: The band played as a tight {three-piece} in small clubs.
e.zh: 这个三人乐队在小俱乐部里配合得很紧密。

e.en: The towels are made from soft {three-ply} paper.
e.zh: 这些毛巾纸由柔软的三层纸制成。

e.en: She knitted the scarf with {three-ply} wool.
e.zh: 她用三股羊毛线织了这条围巾。

e.en: He made a {three-pointer} just before the buzzer.
e.zh: 他在终场哨响前投进了一个三分球。

e.en: That missed {three-pointer} cost them the game.
e.zh: 那个投丢的三分球让他们输掉了比赛。

e.en: The mayor announced a {three-pronged} plan to reduce crime.
e.zh: 市长宣布了一项三管齐下的减犯罪计划。

e.en: A {three-pronged} fork lay beside the old cooking pot.
e.zh: 一把三叉叉子放在旧锅旁边。

e.en: He made a {three-putt} on the final green.
e.zh: 他在最后一个果岭上三推才进洞。

e.en: A nervous {three-putt} dropped her out of first place.
e.zh: 一次紧张的三推让她跌出了第一名。

e.en: She chose a coat with {three-quarter} sleeves.
e.zh: 她选了一件七分袖外套。

e.en: The portrait shows him in {three-quarter} view.
e.zh: 这幅肖像以四分之三侧面角度描绘他。

e.en: The collector found a {three-quarter-bound} volume from 1890.
e.zh: 收藏家找到了一本1890年的四分之三装订本。

e.en: Her library includes several {three-quarter-bound} editions of classics.
e.zh: 她的藏书中有几本四分之三装订的经典版本。

e.en: About {three-quarters} of the class passed the exam.
e.zh: 班上大约四分之三的学生通过了考试。

e.en: The bottle was {three-quarters} full when we arrived.
e.zh: 我们到的时候，瓶子还有四分之三满。

e.en: The shelter gives residents {three-square} meals a day.
e.zh: 收容所每天给住户提供三顿正餐。

e.en: After weeks on the road, he wanted {three-square} meals and a bed.
e.zh: 在路上奔波数周后，他只想要三顿正餐和一张床。

e.en: They booked a {three-star} hotel near the station.
e.zh: 他们订了车站附近一家三星级酒店。

e.en: The general wore a {three-star} insignia on his uniform.
e.zh: 那位将军的制服上佩着三星徽章。

e.en: A {three-storeyed} house stood at the end of the lane.
e.zh: 巷子尽头有一栋三层楼的房子。

e.en: The museum occupies a narrow {three-storeyed} building downtown.
e.zh: 博物馆位于市中心一栋狭窄的三层建筑里。

e.en: She is a {three-time} world champion in skating.
e.zh: 她是三度夺冠的滑冰世界冠军。

e.en: The form asks for a {three-time} password confirmation.
e.zh: 表格要求进行三次密码确认。

e.en: The engineer used {three-valued} logic in the circuit design.
e.zh: 工程师在电路设计中使用了三值逻辑。

e.en: A {three-valued} variable can represent true, false, or unknown.
e.zh: 三值变量可以表示真、假或未知。

e.en: They held a {three-way} meeting with the client and supplier.
e.zh: 他们与客户和供应商开了一场三方会议。

e.en: Turn left at the {three-way} intersection after the bridge.
e.zh: 过桥后在三岔路口左转。

e.en: He delivers vegetables on a small {three-wheeler}.
e.zh: 他用一辆小三轮车送蔬菜。

e.en: The old {three-wheeler} rattled through the narrow street.
e.zh: 那辆旧三轮机动车吱嘎作响地穿过窄街。

e.en: Many {three-wheelers} waited outside the railway station.
e.zh: 许多三轮车等在火车站外。

e.en: Electric {three-wheelers} are becoming common in the city.
e.zh: 电动三轮车在这座城市越来越常见。

e.en: She chose a {three-wood} for the long fairway shot.
e.zh: 她选择三号木杆来打这记长距离球道球。

e.en: His {three-wood} carried the ball over the water hazard.
e.zh: 他的三号木杆把球打过了水障碍。

threehalfpence.t: 一便士半；旧英国小额硬币

e.en: The old price was marked as {threehalfpence} in the ledger.
e.zh: 账本上的旧价格标为一便士半。

e.en: He found a worn {threehalfpence} coin in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里发现了一枚磨旧的一便士半硬币。

threeman.t: 三人组成的小组或岗位；三人艇员

e.en: The old records list a {threeman} crew for the boat.
e.zh: 旧记录显示这条船配有三人艇员。

e.en: They formed a {threeman} team for the night watch.
e.zh: 他们组成了一个三人小组值夜班。

e.en: He lived for {threescore} years and ten.
e.zh: 他活了七十年。

e.en: The hall held {threescore} guests at dinner.
e.zh: 大厅晚宴时容纳了六十位客人。

e.en: Her thesis in {thremmatology} examined cattle breeding.
e.zh: 她的育种学论文研究了牛的繁殖。

e.en: Early {thremmatology} linked agriculture with heredity.
e.zh: 早期育种学把农业和遗传联系起来。

e.en: The poem ends in a {threnetic} whisper.
e.zh: 这首诗以悲悼般的低语收尾。

e.en: A {threnetic} mood filled the memorial service.
e.zh: 追悼会上弥漫着哀伤的气氛。

e.en: Critics noted the novel's {threnetical} final chapter.
e.zh: 评论家注意到小说最后一章带有哀歌式色彩。

e.en: The choir sang in a {threnetical} style.
e.zh: 合唱团以悲悼的风格演唱。

e.en: He composed a {threnode} for his lost friend.
e.zh: 他为逝去的朋友写了一首挽歌。

e.en: The speech sounded less like praise than a {threnode}.
e.zh: 那篇讲话听起来不像赞美，更像一首哀悼诗。

e.en: The opera closes with a {threnodic} chorus.
e.zh: 这部歌剧以挽歌般的合唱结束。

e.en: Her voice took on a {threnodic} tone.
e.zh: 她的声音带上了哀悼诗般的语调。

e.en: The court hired a {threnodist} after the king died.
e.zh: 国王去世后，宫廷请来一位挽歌作者。

e.en: As a {threnodist}, she wrote with grave restraint.
e.zh: 作为哀悼诗人，她写得庄重而克制。

e.en: The culture was treated with {threomycin} overnight.
e.zh: 研究人员用苏氨霉素处理培养物过夜。

e.en: Old pharmacology texts mention {threomycin} as an antibiotic.
e.zh: 旧药理学教材把苏氨霉素列为一种抗生素。

e.en: Eggs contain the amino acid {threonine}.
e.zh: 鸡蛋含有氨基酸苏氨酸。

e.en: The supplement adds {threonine} to the feed.
e.zh: 这种补充剂在饲料中添加苏氨酸。

e.en: The chemist compared {threose} with other simple sugars.
e.zh: 化学家把苏糖与其他简单糖作比较。

e.en: In the diagram, {threose} has four carbon atoms.
e.zh: 在图示中，苏糖有四个碳原子。

e.en: The lecture on {threpsology} focused on infant feeding.
e.zh: 这场营养学讲座重点谈婴儿喂养。

e.en: Nineteenth-century {threpsology} mixed medicine and dietetics.
e.zh: 十九世纪的营养学融合了医学和饮食学。

thrice-blessed.t: 极其有福的；三重蒙福的

e.en: She called the child {thrice-blessed} after his recovery.
e.zh: 孩子康复后，她称他极其有福。

e.en: The monk described the quiet valley as {thrice-blessed}.
e.zh: 那位修士把宁静的山谷称作三重蒙福之地。

thrice-favored.t: 备受眷顾的；三重受宠的

e.en: The prince was {thrice-favored} by fortune.
e.zh: 那位王子备受命运眷顾。

e.en: She felt {thrice-favored} to survive the storm.
e.zh: 她觉得能从风暴中生还是格外受眷顾。

thrice-favoured.t: 备受眷顾的；三重受宠的

e.en: The old poet praised a {thrice-favoured} homeland.
e.zh: 老诗人赞美备受眷顾的故土。

e.en: They saw themselves as {thrice-favoured} by heaven.
e.zh: 他们认为自己受到上天格外眷顾。

thrice-happy.t: 极其幸福的；三倍快乐的

e.en: He was {thrice-happy} to return home alive.
e.zh: 他能活着回家，感到无比幸福。

e.en: The letter speaks of a {thrice-happy} marriage.
e.zh: 信中提到一段极其幸福的婚姻。

e.en: The path seemed to {thrid} the dark wood.
e.zh: 那条小路似乎穿过了幽暗的树林。

e.en: She tried to {thrid} the needle in dim light.
e.zh: 她在昏暗的光线下试着穿针。

thridace.t: 莴苣汁药膏；莴苣提取物

e.en: The apothecary sold {thridace} as a mild sedative.
e.zh: 药剂师把莴苣汁药膏当作温和镇静剂出售。

e.en: Old medical books describe {thridace} made from lettuce.
e.zh: 古老医书描述了用莴苣制成的莴苣提取物。

thridded.t: 穿过了；穿行于；穿好了线

e.en: The river {thridded} the valley like silver thread.
e.zh: 河流像银线一样穿过山谷。

e.en: She {thridded} the beads onto a cord.
e.zh: 她把珠子穿到一根绳上。

e.en: We spent the morning {thridding} narrow lanes.
e.zh: 我们整个上午都在狭窄小巷中穿行。

e.en: The tailor was {thridding} a fine needle.
e.zh: 裁缝正在给一根细针穿线。

e.en: This model is {thriftier} with fuel.
e.zh: 这个型号更省油。

e.en: She became {thriftier} after moving out.
e.zh: 搬出去住以后，她变得更节俭了。

e.en: He is the {thriftiest} person in our family.
e.zh: 他是我们家最节俭的人。

e.en: The {thriftiest} option was still reliable.
e.zh: 最省钱的选择仍然很可靠。

e.en: They lived {thriftily} while saving for a house.
e.zh: 他们为了攒钱买房，生活得很节俭。

e.en: The shop was {thriftily} decorated with reused wood.
e.zh: 这家店用再利用木材装饰，既省钱又朴素。

e.en: She bought the jacket at a {thriftshop}.
e.zh: 她在一家二手商店买了那件夹克。

e.en: The local {thriftshop} raises money for shelters.
e.zh: 当地的慈善旧货店为收容所筹款。

thrin.t: 三倍的；由三部分组成的

e.en: The manuscript uses {thrin} to mean threefold.
e.zh: 这份手稿用thrin表示三倍的意思。

e.en: A {thrin} pattern appears in the old verse.
e.zh: 这首古诗中出现了三部分结构。

thuggee.t: 印度历史上的图格教匪帮崇拜或活动

e.en: The novel refers to {thuggee} in colonial India.
e.zh: 这部小说提到殖民时期印度的图格教匪帮活动。

e.en: Historians debate how widespread {thuggee} really was.
e.zh: 历史学家争论图格教匪帮活动究竟有多普遍。

e.en: The mayor condemned the gang's {thuggism}.
e.zh: 市长谴责该团伙的暴徒行径。

e.en: Political {thuggism} silenced many local critics.
e.zh: 政治流氓作风让许多地方批评者噤声。

e.en: A row of {thuja} trees bordered the garden.
e.zh: 一排侧柏树围在花园边上。

e.en: The oil comes from crushed {thuja} leaves.
e.zh: 这种油来自压碎的侧柏叶。

e.en: The chemist identified {thujaketone} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家在植物提取物中鉴定出侧柏酮类化合物。

e.en: Researchers measured {thujaketone} levels after distillation.
e.zh: 研究人员在蒸馏后测量了侧柏酮类化合物的含量。

e.en: The spectrum suggested a {thujane} structure.
e.zh: 光谱显示它可能具有侧柏烷结构。

e.en: Several {thujane} derivatives occur in essential oils.
e.zh: 几种侧柏烷衍生物存在于精油中。

e.en: {Thujaplicin} can inhibit some bacterial growth.
e.zh: 侧柏素能抑制某些细菌的生长。

e.en: The wood contains small amounts of {thujaplicin}.
e.zh: 这种木材含有少量侧柏素。

thujaplicine.t: 侧柏素；桧木醇类化合物

e.en: The sample was tested for {thujaplicine}.
e.zh: 样品被检测是否含有侧柏素。

e.en: {Thujaplicine} gives the extract antimicrobial properties.
e.zh: 侧柏素使这种提取物具有抗菌特性。

e.en: They isolated {thujaplicinol} from cedar heartwood.
e.zh: 他们从雪松心材中分离出侧柏醇类化合物。

e.en: The paper compares {thujaplicinol} with related tropolones.
e.zh: 论文把侧柏醇类化合物与相关的托品酮类物质作了比较。

e.en: The essential oil is rich in {thujene}.
e.zh: 这种精油富含侧柏烯。

e.en: Analysts detected {thujene} in the herbal vapor.
e.zh: 分析人员在草药蒸气中检测到侧柏烯。

e.en: The botanist noted {thujin} in the leaf extract.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶片提取物中有侧柏苷。

e.en: Older pharmacopoeias list {thujin} among plant glycosides.
e.zh: 较早的药典把侧柏苷列入植物糖苷。

e.en: The shrub has a {thujoid} form.
e.zh: 这种灌木呈现类似侧柏的形态。

e.en: Botanists described the scale leaves as {thujoid}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这些鳞叶描述为侧柏状。

e.en: The distillate contained traces of {thujol}.
e.zh: 蒸馏液中含有微量侧柏醇。

e.en: {Thujol} contributes to the oil's sharp aroma.
e.zh: 侧柏醇赋予这种油尖锐的香气。

e.en: Absinthe contains small amounts of {thujone}.
e.zh: 苦艾酒含有少量侧柏酮。

e.en: Regulations limit {thujone} in alcoholic drinks.
e.zh: 法规限制酒精饮料中的侧柏酮含量。

e.en: The molecule includes a {thujyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子包含一个侧柏基。

e.en: They synthesized several {thujyl} esters.
e.zh: 他们合成了几种侧柏基酯。

e.en: The mineral sample contained {thulia}.
e.zh: 这份矿物样品含有氧化铥。

e.en: Chemists separated {thulia} from other rare earth oxides.
e.zh: 化学家把氧化铥从其他稀土氧化物中分离出来。

e.en: {Thulium} is a rare earth element.
e.zh: 铥是一种稀土元素。

e.en: The laser uses {thulium} as an active material.
e.zh: 这种激光器使用铥作为活性材料。

e.en: She painted her {thumb-nail} bright red.
e.zh: 她把拇指指甲涂成鲜红色。

e.en: Click the {thumb-nail} to open the full image.
e.zh: 点击缩略图即可打开完整图片。

e.en: He gave me a {thumb-up} from across the room.
e.zh: 他从房间另一头向我竖起拇指。

e.en: The app shows a {thumb-up} when the file uploads.
e.zh: 文件上传后，应用会显示一个点赞图标。

e.en: The hoodie has a {thumbhole} in each sleeve.
e.zh: 这件连帽衫每只袖子都有一个拇指孔。

e.en: His bowling ball needed a larger {thumbhole}.
e.zh: 他的保龄球需要一个更大的拇指孔。

thumbkin.t: 拇指；童谣中的拇指角色

e.en: The child sang about {thumbkin} at preschool.
e.zh: 孩子在幼儿园唱了一首关于拇指角色的歌。

e.en: In the rhyme, {thumbkin} comes out to play.
e.zh: 在这首童谣里，拇指出来玩耍。

e.en: The museum displayed iron {thumbkins} from the prison.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了监狱里用过的铁制拇指夹。

e.en: Prisoners feared the {thumbkins} more than the cells.
e.zh: 囚犯害怕拇指夹更甚于牢房。

e.en: The statue's hand is {thumbless} after years of damage.
e.zh: 多年损坏后，这座雕像的手已经没有拇指。

e.en: A {thumbless} glove covered his injured hand.
e.zh: 一只没有拇指部分的手套套住了他受伤的手。

thumbling.t: 小拇指般的人；矮小童话人物

e.en: The tale follows a brave {thumbling} through the forest.
e.zh: 这个故事讲述一个勇敢的小矮人穿过森林。

e.en: Villagers laughed at the tiny {thumbling}.
e.zh: 村民们嘲笑那个拇指般大小的小人。

thumbmark.t: 拇指印；拇指留下的痕迹

e.en: The contract bore his {thumbmark}.
e.zh: 合同上有他的拇指印。

e.en: A greasy {thumbmark} stained the page.
e.zh: 一枚油腻的拇指印弄脏了书页。

e.en: The autopsy showed {thromboendocarditis} on the damaged valve.
e.zh: 尸检显示受损瓣膜上有血栓性心内膜炎。

e.en: Doctors treated the suspected {thromboendocarditis} with urgent anticoagulation.
e.zh: 医生对疑似血栓性心内膜炎进行了紧急抗凝治疗。

e.en: The report identified fibrin as a possible {thrombogen}.
e.zh: 报告把纤维蛋白列为一种可能的促血栓物质。

e.en: Researchers tested each {thrombogen} for its effect on clotting speed.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了每种促血栓形成物质对凝血速度的影响。

e.en: Older textbooks often call tissue factor {thrombokinase}.
e.zh: 旧教材常把组织因子称为凝血活酶。

e.en: The assay measured {thrombokinase} activity in the plasma sample.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了血浆样本中的凝血活酶活性。

e.en: Severe {thrombopenia} can increase the risk of bleeding.
e.zh: 严重血小板减少症会增加出血风险。

e.en: The drug was stopped after {thrombopenia} appeared in routine tests.
e.zh: 常规检查发现血小板减少后，这种药被停用了。

e.en: The old paper described widespread clotting as {thrombophthisis}.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文把广泛凝血描述为消耗性凝血障碍。

e.en: Modern clinicians rarely use the term {thrombophthisis}.
e.zh: 现代临床医生很少使用消耗性凝血障碍这个术语。

e.en: The lab added {thromboplastin} to start the clotting test.
e.zh: 实验室加入凝血活酶来启动凝血测试。

e.en: Low {thromboplastin} activity can change the test result.
e.zh: 凝血活酶活性低可能会改变检测结果。

e.en: The article proposed {thromboplastinogen} as a precursor in clot formation.
e.zh: 文章提出凝血活酶原是血凝块形成中的一种前体。

e.en: Few current manuals still list {thromboplastinogen}.
e.zh: 现在很少有手册还列出凝血活酶原这个术语。

e.en: The liver produces much of the body's {thrombopoietin}.
e.zh: 人体大部分血小板生成素由肝脏产生。

e.en: Synthetic {thrombopoietin} can stimulate platelet production in some patients.
e.zh: 合成血小板生成素可刺激部分患者生成血小板。

e.en: The injured vein may {thrombose} after surgery.
e.zh: 受伤的静脉在手术后可能形成血栓。

e.en: Doctors watched the graft closely in case it began to {thrombose}.
e.zh: 医生密切观察移植物，以防它开始发生血栓。

e.en: Multiple venous {thromboses} complicated his recovery.
e.zh: 多处静脉血栓形成使他的康复变得复杂。

e.en: The scan found two old {thromboses} near the catheter site.
e.zh: 扫描在导管部位附近发现了两个旧血栓。

e.en: The ultrasound showed a {thrombosing} aneurysm behind the knee.
e.zh: 超声显示膝后有一个正在形成血栓的动脉瘤。

e.en: Surgeons repaired the {thrombosing} graft before it failed completely.
e.zh: 外科医生在移植物完全失效前修复了正在形成血栓的部位。

e.en: Platelets contain {thrombosthenin}, a contractile protein involved in clot retraction.
e.zh: 血小板含有血小板收缩蛋白，这是一种参与血块回缩的收缩蛋白。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {thrombosthenin} only as a historical term.
e.zh: 讲座只是把血小板收缩蛋白作为历史术语提了一下。

e.en: Early researchers called platelet serotonin {thrombotonin}.
e.zh: 早期研究者把血小板中的血清素称为血小板血清素。

e.en: The term {thrombotonin} is uncommon in modern hematology.
e.zh: 血小板血清素这个说法在现代血液学中并不常见。

e.en: The {throneless} king wandered through his former kingdom.
e.zh: 失去王位的国王在自己昔日的王国中流亡。

e.en: A {throneless} prince still attracted loyal supporters.
e.zh: 一位无王位的王子仍然吸引着忠诚的支持者。

e.en: The old farmer cleared his {thropple} before speaking.
e.zh: 老农夫说话前清了清喉咙。

e.en: Dust caught in his {thropple} and made him cough.
e.zh: 灰尘呛进他的喉咙，使他咳了起来。

e.en: A {throstle} sang from the hedge at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，一只画眉鸟在树篱上歌唱。

e.en: The mill still displayed an old {throstle} in the corner.
e.zh: 工厂角落里仍陈列着一台旧式纺纱机。

e.en: The children found a fallen {throstling} under the hedge.
e.zh: 孩子们在树篱下发现了一只掉落的小画眉。

e.en: A hungry {throstling} called from the nest.
e.zh: 一只饥饿的幼画眉在巢中叫着。

e.en: The engine is {throttleable} across a wide power range.
e.zh: 这台发动机可在很宽的功率范围内调节节流。

e.en: The service is {throttleable} during heavy traffic.
e.zh: 流量很大时，这项服务可以被限速。

e.en: The wrestler escaped a tight {throttlehold} near the ropes.
e.zh: 那名摔跤手在绳边挣脱了一个紧紧的掐喉控制。

e.en: The cartel kept a {throttlehold} on local fuel prices.
e.zh: 该垄断集团严密控制着当地燃油价格。

e.en: The {throttleman} eased the boat through the narrow channel.
e.zh: 操纵油门的人让船缓缓穿过狭窄水道。

e.en: A skilled {throttleman} can keep the engine steady under load.
e.zh: 熟练的油门操纵手能让发动机在负载下保持稳定。

e.en: Schubert wrote many {through-composed} songs without repeated stanzas.
e.zh: 舒伯特写了许多通谱歌曲，没有重复的分节旋律。

e.en: The opera feels {through-composed}, with music flowing between scenes.
e.zh: 这部歌剧有通谱创作的感觉，音乐在场景之间连贯流动。

e.en: Grief is the emotional {through-line} of the novel.
e.zh: 悲伤是这部小说的情感主线。

e.en: The new {through-line} lets commuters avoid changing trains downtown.
e.zh: 新的直达线路让通勤者不用在市中心换乘。

e.en: Scientists measured {throughfall} beneath the forest canopy.
e.zh: 科学家测量了森林冠层下的林冠透雨。

e.en: Heavy leaves reduced {throughfall} during the brief storm.
e.zh: 浓密的叶片减少了短时暴雨中的穿透降水。

e.en: Engineers improved {throughflow} by widening the channel.
e.zh: 工程师通过拓宽通道改善了贯流。

e.en: After rain, {throughflow} carried water downslope through the soil.
e.zh: 雨后，土壤侧向流把水沿坡地向下输送。

e.en: His papers lay in a {throughither} heap on the desk.
e.zh: 他的文件在桌上乱成一堆。

e.en: The plan sounded {throughither} after three hurried revisions.
e.zh: 经过三次匆忙修改后，这个计划听起来杂乱无章。

thrinter.t: 三岁小羊或小牛；第三年动物

e.en: The farmer sold a {thrinter} at the autumn market.
e.zh: 农夫在秋季市场卖掉了一只三岁小羊。

e.en: In old farm accounts, a {thrinter} was valued below a mature ewe.
e.zh: 在旧农场账簿里，三岁羊的估价低于成年母羊。

thripid.t: 色氨酸；旧称胰蛋白胨成分

e.en: The chemist identified {thripid} in the old protein sample.
e.zh: 化学家在那份旧蛋白样本中鉴定出色氨酸。

e.en: Older papers sometimes used {thripid} for a substance now called tryptophan.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时用thripid指如今称为色氨酸的物质。

e.en: She found a worn {thrippence} in the drawer.
e.zh: 她在抽屉里发现了一枚磨旧的三便士硬币。

e.en: The pie cost only {thrippence} in the old story.
e.zh: 在那个老故事里，这个馅饼只卖三便士。

e.en: The {thripple} swung freely from the handle of the flail.
e.zh: 打谷连枷的活动节段从柄上自由摆动。

e.en: He repaired the broken {thripple} before threshing began.
e.zh: 打谷开始前，他修好了断裂的连枷活动节段。

e.en: The village had {thriven} after the new road opened.
e.zh: 新路开通后，这个村庄兴旺了起来。

e.en: Only the hardiest plants had {thriven} in that poor soil.
e.zh: 只有最耐受的植物在那片贫瘠土壤里长得很好。

e.en: She sang the {throatiest} blues number of the night.
e.zh: 她唱出了当晚最沙哑低沉的一首布鲁斯。

e.en: That engine has the {throatiest} roar in the whole garage.
e.zh: 那台发动机在整个车库里轰鸣声最浑厚。

e.en: A slight {throatiness} made his speech sound dramatic.
e.zh: 轻微的沙哑低沉感让他的讲话显得很有戏剧性。

e.en: The singer's {throatiness} suited the smoky jazz club.
e.zh: 这位歌手低沉沙哑的嗓音很适合那家烟雾缭绕的爵士俱乐部。

e.en: She tightened the {throatlatch} before leading the horse out.
e.zh: 她牵马出去前收紧了马喉扣。

e.en: A loose {throatlatch} can let the bridle slip off.
e.zh: 马喉扣太松可能会让马笼头滑脱。

e.en: He felt a dull {throbb} behind his eyes.
e.zh: 他感到眼后有一阵隐隐的跳痛。

e.en: The old spelling {throbb} appears in a few dialect notes.
e.zh: 这种旧拼写throbb出现在少数方言记录中。

thromasthenia.t: 血小板无力症；凝血功能障碍

e.en: The specialist suspected {thromasthenia} after the child bruised easily.
e.zh: 孩子很容易出现瘀斑后，专科医生怀疑是血小板无力症。

e.en: Treatment for {thromasthenia} depends on the severity of bleeding.
e.zh: 血小板无力症的治疗取决于出血的严重程度。

e.en: The old textbook referred to the enzyme as {thrombase}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把这种酶称为凝血酶。

e.en: Researchers measured {thrombase} activity in the clotting sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了凝血样本中的凝血酶活性。

e.en: Genetic testing confirmed {thrombasthenia} in the patient.
e.zh: 基因检测确认这名患者患有血小板无力症。

e.en: People with {thrombasthenia} may bleed for a long time after injury.
e.zh: 患有血小板无力症的人受伤后可能会长时间出血。

e.en: Doctors performed a {thrombectomy} to restore blood flow.
e.zh: 医生进行了取栓术以恢复血流。

e.en: An emergency {thrombectomy} can limit damage after some strokes.
e.zh: 某些中风后，紧急血栓切除术可以限制损伤。

e.en: The scan showed several {thrombi} in the deep veins.
e.zh: 扫描显示深静脉中有几个血栓。

e.en: Small {thrombi} can break loose and travel through the bloodstream.
e.zh: 小血栓可能脱落并随血流移动。

e.en: The laboratory measured {thrombinogen} levels in the plasma.
e.zh: 实验室测量了血浆中的凝血酶原水平。

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes discuss {thrombinogen} during clot formation.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献有时会在血块形成过程中讨论凝血酶原。

e.en: Heavy smoking increases the risk of {thromboangiitis}.
e.zh: 大量吸烟会增加患血栓性脉管炎的风险。

e.en: The doctor linked his leg pain to {thromboangiitis}.
e.zh: 医生认为他的腿痛与血栓性脉管炎有关。

e.en: Each {thrombocyte} helps the blood form a clot.
e.zh: 每个血小板都帮助血液形成凝块。

e.en: The report showed a low {thrombocyte} count after chemotherapy.
e.zh: 报告显示化疗后血小板计数偏低。

thrombocytin.t: 血小板因子；凝血相关物质

e.en: The paper described {thrombocytin} as a factor released by platelets.
e.zh: 论文把thrombocytin描述为血小板释放的一种因子。

e.en: Early researchers studied {thrombocytin} in blood-clotting experiments.
e.zh: 早期研究人员在凝血实验中研究这种血小板因子。

thrombocytocrit.t: 血小板压积；血小板比容

e.en: The analyzer reported a high {thrombocytocrit} value.
e.zh: 分析仪报告血小板压积数值偏高。

e.en: Clinicians use {thrombocytocrit} to estimate the total platelet mass.
e.zh: 临床医生用血小板压积来估计血小板总量。

e.en: Persistent {thrombocytosis} may require further blood tests.
e.zh: 持续性血小板增多症可能需要进一步验血。

e.en: Inflammation can sometimes cause temporary {thrombocytosis}.
e.zh: 炎症有时会引起暂时性的血小板增多症。

e.en: The team used {thromboelastography} during the liver transplant.
e.zh: 团队在肝移植过程中使用了血栓弹力图检测。

e.en: {Thromboelastography} shows how quickly a patient's blood clots.
e.zh: 血栓弹力图检测能显示患者血液凝固的速度。

e.en: Surgeons planned a {thromboembolectomy} for the blocked artery.
e.zh: 外科医生计划为阻塞的动脉进行血栓栓子切除术。

e.en: After the {thromboembolectomy}, circulation returned to the foot.
e.zh: 血栓栓子切除术后，足部血液循环恢复了。

e.en: A {thromboembolus} lodged in the pulmonary artery.
e.zh: 一个血栓栓子卡在了肺动脉里。

e.en: The scan helped locate the suspected {thromboembolus}.
e.zh: 扫描帮助定位了疑似血栓栓子。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {thromboendarterectomy} for the narrowed vessel.
e.zh: 外科医生建议对狭窄血管进行血栓内膜切除术。

e.en: Recovery after {thromboendarterectomy} requires careful monitoring.
e.zh: 血栓内膜切除术后的恢复需要仔细监测。

thylose.t: 含有木质部的；木质化的

e.en: The botanist described the stem as {thylose} under the microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下把这段茎描述为木质化的。

e.en: A {thylose} structure can make old vessels harder to examine.
e.zh: 含有木质部的结构会让老化导管更难观察。

thymacetin.t: 百里香乙酰苯胺类药物

e.en: The old pharmacology text listed {thymacetin} among synthetic analgesics.
e.zh: 那本旧药理书把百里香乙酰苯胺类药物列入合成止痛药。

e.en: Few modern physicians would recognize {thymacetin} by name.
e.zh: 如今很少有医生会听名字就认出百里香乙酰苯胺类药物。

e.en: The surgeons planned to {thymectomize} the patient after further tests.
e.zh: 外科医生计划在进一步检查后为患者切除胸腺。

e.en: Researchers sometimes {thymectomize} laboratory mice to study immune development.
e.zh: 研究人员有时会给实验鼠切除胸腺，以研究免疫发育。

e.en: She recovered well after the {thymectomy}.
e.zh: 她在胸腺切除术后恢复得很好。

e.en: A {thymectomy} may be considered for some patients with myasthenia gravis.
e.zh: 部分重症肌无力患者可以考虑接受胸腺切除术。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {thymegol} in the essential oil fraction.
e.zh: 样品的精油部分含有微量百里香酚类化合物。

e.en: Older chemical catalogues sometimes mention {thymegol} as a thymol derivative.
e.zh: 较早的化学目录有时把百里香酚类化合物列为麝香草酚衍生物。

e.en: The shrub has several {thymelaeaceous} features in its flowers.
e.zh: 这种灌木的花具有几个瑞香科植物的特征。

e.en: A {thymelaeaceous} plant may have tough bark and small clustered blossoms.
e.zh: 瑞香科植物可能有坚韧的树皮和成簇的小花。

e.en: The soup had a warm, {thymey} smell.
e.zh: 这碗汤散发着温暖的百里香味。

e.en: She added a {thymey} note to the roast chicken.
e.zh: 她给烤鸡添了一点百里香般的香气。

e.en: The physician used {thymiasis} to describe a disorder of the thymus.
e.zh: 医生用胸腺疾病这个词来描述胸腺的异常。

e.en: Historical case notes sometimes mention {thymiasis} in infants with breathing problems.
e.zh: 早期病例记录有时会提到呼吸困难婴儿的胸腺异常。

e.en: The autopsy report described a {thymicolymphatic} condition.
e.zh: 尸检报告描述了一种胸腺淋巴体质状态。

e.en: Older doctors linked sudden death to a {thymicolymphatic} constitution.
e.zh: 过去的医生曾把猝死与胸腺淋巴体质联系起来。

e.en: DNA contains {thymidine} as one of its nucleosides.
e.zh: DNA中含有胸苷这种核苷之一。

e.en: The cells incorporated labeled {thymidine} during replication.
e.zh: 细胞在复制过程中掺入了带标记的胸苷。

e.en: Several modified {thymidines} were tested in the assay.
e.zh: 实验中测试了几种修饰过的胸苷类物质。

e.en: The paper compared natural and synthetic {thymidines}.
e.zh: 论文比较了天然和合成的胸苷类物质。

e.en: The reagent bottle was labeled {thymocrescin}.
e.zh: 试剂瓶上标着百里香甲酚类化合物。

e.en: Chemists once studied {thymocrescin} as a derivative of thymol.
e.zh: 化学家曾把百里香甲酚类化合物作为麝香草酚衍生物来研究。

e.en: The dentist applied {thymoform} as an old antiseptic preparation.
e.zh: 牙医使用麝香草酚甲醛缩合物作为旧式防腐制剂。

e.en: A medical catalogue advertised {thymoform} for wound treatment.
e.zh: 一份医疗目录曾宣传麝香草酚甲醛缩合物可用于伤口处理。

e.en: The reaction produced {thymohydroquinone} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 该反应生成了百里香氢醌作为中间体。

e.en: Pure {thymohydroquinone} must be stored away from strong oxidants.
e.zh: 纯百里香氢醌必须远离强氧化剂保存。

e.en: The mouthwash contains {thymol} as an antiseptic ingredient.
e.zh: 这款漱口水含有麝香草酚作为防腐抗菌成分。

e.en: Oil of thyme is rich in {thymol}.
e.zh: 百里香精油富含百里香酚。

e.en: The manual described {thymoloform} as a dental antiseptic.
e.zh: 手册把麝香草酚甲醛制剂描述为牙科防腐剂。

e.en: Some early wound powders included {thymoloform}.
e.zh: 一些早期伤口粉剂含有麝香草酚甲醛制剂。

e.en: The chemist used {thymolphthalein} as a pH indicator.
e.zh: 化学家使用麝香草酚酞作为酸碱指示剂。

e.en: In alkaline solution, {thymolphthalein} turns blue.
e.zh: 在碱性溶液中，麝香草酚酞会变蓝。

e.en: The lab prepared {thymolsulfonphthalein} for renal function testing.
e.zh: 实验室制备了麝香草酚磺酞用于肾功能检测。

e.en: A solution of {thymolsulfonphthalein} changes color with pH.
e.zh: 麝香草酚磺酞溶液会随酸碱度改变颜色。

e.en: The paper proposed {thymonucleodepolymerase} as the active enzyme.
e.zh: 论文提出胸腺核酸解聚酶是起作用的酶。

e.en: They measured {thymonucleodepolymerase} activity in the tissue extract.
e.zh: 他们测量了组织提取物中的胸腺核酸解聚酶活性。

e.en: The thymus produces {thymosin}, which helps immune cells mature.
e.zh: 胸腺产生胸腺素，帮助免疫细胞成熟。

e.en: Doctors studied {thymosin} as a possible immune therapy.
e.zh: 医生研究胸腺素作为一种可能的免疫疗法。

e.en: The extract was said to contain {thymosterin}.
e.zh: 据称该提取物含有胸腺甾醇类物质。

e.en: Older biochemical studies mentioned {thymosterin} in thymus tissue.
e.zh: 较早的生化研究提到胸腺组织中的胸腺甾醇类物质。

e.en: The formulary listed {thymotal} among antiseptic preparations.
e.zh: 处方集把麝香草酚类药剂列入防腐制剂。

e.en: Pharmacists rarely dispense {thymotal} today.
e.zh: 如今药剂师很少配发麝香草酚类药剂。

e.en: The old label identified the liquid as {thymotrol}.
e.zh: 旧标签显示这种液体是麝香草酚类制剂。

e.en: A physician prescribed {thymotrol} before newer antiseptics became common.
e.zh: 在更新的防腐剂普及前，医生曾开麝香草酚类制剂。

e.en: The sauce tasted pleasantly {thymy}.
e.zh: 这份酱汁尝起来有宜人的百里香香味。

e.en: A {thymy} breeze drifted across the herb garden.
e.zh: 一阵带着百里香气息的微风吹过香草园。

e.en: The synthesis yielded {thymylamine} in a small amount.
e.zh: 这次合成得到少量百里香基胺。

e.en: The chemist compared {thymylamine} with related aromatic amines.
e.zh: 化学家把百里香基胺与相关芳香胺进行了比较。

thundrous.t: 如雷的；雷鸣般的声音洪亮的

e.en: A {thundrous} roar rolled across the valley.
e.zh: 雷鸣般的吼声滚过山谷。

e.en: The actor's {thundrous} voice filled the old hall.
e.zh: 那位演员洪亮如雷的嗓音充满了老大厅。

e.en: He tied the bundle with a worn {thunge}.
e.zh: 他用一根磨旧的皮带把包裹捆起来。

e.en: The old whip had a cracked {thunge} at the end.
e.zh: 那条旧鞭子的末端有一截开裂的鞭带。

e.en: The collector labeled the amber-like lump as {thuresite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把那块像琥珀的团块标为石化松香。

e.en: Traces of {thuresite} were found in the old coal seam.
e.zh: 旧煤层中发现了树脂化石的痕迹。

e.en: The priest swung the {thurible} before the altar.
e.zh: 神父在祭坛前摆动礼拜用的香炉。

e.en: Smoke rose slowly from the silver {thurible}.
e.zh: 烟从银色香炉里缓缓升起。

thurifer.t: 持香炉者；礼拜中摇香炉的人

e.en: The young {thurifer} walked ahead of the choir.
e.zh: 年轻的持香炉者走在唱诗班前面。

e.en: During the procession, the {thurifer} kept the incense burning.
e.zh: 游行礼拜时，持香炉的人让香一直燃着。

e.en: The botanist described the tree as {thuriferous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种树描述为产乳香的树。

e.en: A {thuriferous} scent drifted through the chapel.
e.zh: 一股带着香气的味道飘过小教堂。

e.en: The service included a brief {thurification} of the altar.
e.zh: 礼拜中包括一次简短的祭坛焚香礼。

e.en: Visitors watched the {thurification} in respectful silence.
e.zh: 参观者肃静地观看熏香仪式。

e.en: The priest paused to {thurify} the altar.
e.zh: 神父停下来向祭坛焚香。

e.en: They would {thurify} the room before the ceremony began.
e.zh: 仪式开始前，他们会用香熏这个房间。

thuringione.t: 图林根化合物；一种有机酮

e.en: The chemist isolated {thuringione} from the sample.
e.zh: 化学家从样品中分离出图林根化合物。

e.en: A paper described {thuringione} as a rare natural ketone.
e.zh: 一篇论文把图林根化合物描述为一种罕见的天然酮。

thurl.t: 穿孔；矿井通道；开凿通道

e.en: Miners cut a {thurl} between the two shafts.
e.zh: 矿工在两条竖井之间开凿了一条通道。

e.en: The carpenter made a clean {thurl} through the beam.
e.zh: 木匠在横梁上凿出一个整齐的穿孔。

e.en: The crew began {thurling} through the soft rock.
e.zh: 工队开始在软岩中开凿通道。

e.en: Careless {thurling} could weaken the old support wall.
e.zh: 草率的穿孔作业可能削弱那堵旧支撑墙。

e.en: She saved every {thurm} for mending socks.
e.zh: 她把每一段线头都留着补袜子。

e.en: The tailor swept the {thurm} from the cutting table.
e.zh: 裁缝把裁剪台上的织物边角料扫掉。

e.en: The clerk wrote the rule {thusand} sealed the notice.
e.zh: 书记员这样写下规定，并因此封好了通知。

e.en: He spoke {thusand} left no room for doubt.
e.zh: 他以这种方式说话，不留任何疑问。

e.en: Arrange the stones {thuswise} along the path.
e.zh: 把石头这样沿着小路摆好。

e.en: The old recipe begins {thuswise} in the manuscript.
e.zh: 手稿里的旧食谱是这样开头的。

e.en: The cabinet was made from polished {thuya}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用抛光的崖柏木做成的。

e.en: A row of {thuya} trees sheltered the garden.
e.zh: 一排崖柏树为花园挡风。

e.en: The cottage stood in a quiet {thwaite}.
e.zh: 那座小屋坐落在一片安静的林中空地上。

e.en: Farmers once used the {thwaite} for grazing sheep.
e.zh: 农民从前把这片开垦地用来放羊。

e.en: They measured the {thwartship} distance between the rails.
e.zh: 他们测量了两条栏杆之间横过船身的距离。

e.en: A {thwartship} beam strengthened the small boat.
e.zh: 一根横向船梁加固了那艘小船。

e.en: The cargo shifted {thwartships} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中货物横向移到了船身一侧。

e.en: A narrow bench ran {thwartships} near the mast.
e.zh: 一条窄凳在桅杆附近横跨船身。

e.en: Lay the planks {thwartwise} across the frame.
e.zh: 把木板横向铺在框架上。

e.en: The scar ran {thwartwise} over his palm.
e.zh: 那道疤斜横着穿过他的手掌。

e.en: The last known {thylacine} died in captivity.
e.zh: 已知最后一只袋狼死于圈养环境。

e.en: Researchers still debate possible {thylacine} sightings.
e.zh: 研究人员仍在争论可能的袋狼目击记录。

e.en: Photosynthesis begins inside the {thylakoid} membranes.
e.zh: 光合作用始于类囊体膜内部。

e.en: Each {thylakoid} helps organize the chloroplast's light reactions.
e.zh: 每个类囊体都有助于组织叶绿体的光反应。

e.en: The meaning emerges {throughother} voices in the poem.
e.zh: 这层意义通过诗中其他声音显现出来。

e.en: He learned himself {throughother} people's reactions.
e.zh: 他通过他人的反应认识了自己。

e.en: The old path {throuther} led across the marsh.
e.zh: 那条叫throuther的老路穿过沼泽。

e.en: A {throuther} current ran beneath the ice.
e.zh: 一股贯通的暗流在冰层下流动。

e.en: The small shop {throve} after the market opened.
e.zh: 市场开张后，这家小店兴旺起来。

e.en: Wildflowers {throve} in the abandoned field.
e.zh: 野花在废弃的田地里茁壮生长。

e.en: The defender took the {throw-in} near midfield.
e.zh: 后卫在中场附近掷了边线球。

e.en: The seller added a case as a {throw-in}.
e.zh: 卖家把一个保护套作为附送品加了进去。

e.en: Both teams wasted several {throw-ins} in the first half.
e.zh: 两队在上半场都浪费了好几次边线球。

e.en: The package includes a few useful {throw-ins}.
e.zh: 这个套装还包括几样有用的附送品。

e.en: She tried to {throw-off} her pursuers in the crowd.
e.zh: 她试图在人群中摆脱追赶她的人。

e.en: One wrong figure can {throw-off} the whole calculation.
e.zh: 一个错误数字就可能让整个计算出偏差。

e.en: Please {throw-out} the spoiled food tonight.
e.zh: 今晚请把变质的食物扔掉。

e.en: The judge may {throw-out} the weak evidence.
e.zh: 法官可能会排除这份薄弱证据。

e.en: He decided to {throw-over} his old allies.
e.zh: 他决定抛弃自己的旧盟友。

e.en: The committee may {throw-over} tradition for efficiency.
e.zh: 委员会可能为了效率而放弃传统做法。

e.en: Analysts compared each missile's {throw-weight} carefully.
e.zh: 分析人士仔细比较了每种导弹的投掷载荷。

e.en: The athlete increased his {throw-weight} during training.
e.zh: 那名运动员在训练中提高了投掷重量。

e.en: The rivals agreed to a public {throwdown}.
e.zh: 这对对手同意来一场公开较量。

e.en: Friday's cooking {throwdown} drew a huge crowd.
e.zh: 周五的厨艺挑战赛吸引了大批观众。

e.en: The {thrown-away} bottles covered the riverbank.
e.zh: 被扔掉的瓶子铺满了河岸。

e.en: It felt like a {thrown-away} chance to apologize.
e.zh: 那感觉像是一次被浪费掉的道歉机会。

e.en: Put the broken parts in the {throwout} pile.
e.zh: 把坏掉的零件放进废弃物堆里。

e.en: The proposal became a quick {throwout} after review.
e.zh: 这项提案审查后很快就被否决了。

e.en: The {throwster} prepared silk thread for weaving.
e.zh: 捻丝工为织布准备丝线。

e.en: A modern {throwster} can process many filaments at once.
e.zh: 现代丝线加捻机能同时处理许多细丝。

e.en: The engine began to {thrumm} under the floor.
e.zh: 发动机开始在地板下嗡嗡作响。

e.en: Loose {thrumm} clung to the edge of the rug.
e.zh: 松散的线头绒毛粘在地毯边上。

e.en: A {thrummy} vibration came through the wall.
e.zh: 墙里传来一阵嗡嗡的震动。

e.en: The old blanket felt {thrummy} along the seams.
e.zh: 那条旧毯子的接缝处摸起来线头很多。

e.en: Someone began to {thrump} on the locked door.
e.zh: 有人开始砰砰地敲那扇锁着的门。

e.en: The drums {thrump} steadily behind the singer.
e.zh: 鼓声在歌手身后稳定地低沉敲响。

e.en: The river had {thrun} the valley for centuries.
e.zh: 这条河几个世纪以来贯穿着山谷。

e.en: Light {thrun} the cracked shutters at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，光线穿过破裂的百叶窗照进来。

e.en: The spelling appears {thruout} the informal notes.
e.zh: 这种拼写在非正式笔记中到处出现。

e.en: Rain continued {thruout} the long afternoon.
e.zh: 整个漫长的下午雨一直下着。

e.en: Her {thrustful} speech changed the mood of the room.
e.zh: 她充满冲劲的演讲改变了全场气氛。

e.en: The design has a {thrustful} forward motion.
e.zh: 这个设计带有一种强烈向前推进的动感。

e.en: The satellite fired a small {thrustor} to adjust course.
e.zh: 卫星启动了一个小推进器来调整航向。

e.en: Engineers replaced the damaged {thrustor} before launch.
e.zh: 工程师在发射前更换了受损的推力装置。

e.en: The paper briefly defines {thryptophytism} in fungi.
e.zh: 论文简要定义了真菌中的腐生植物生活方式。

e.en: Students confused {thryptophytism} with ordinary parasitism.
e.zh: 学生把腐生植物生活方式和普通寄生混淆了。

e.en: The label printed {thteonine} instead of threonine.
e.zh: 标签把threonine误印成了thteonine。

e.en: Search results for {thteonine} mostly show spelling errors.
e.zh: 搜索thteonine的结果大多显示为拼写错误。

e.en: The ball landed with a dull {thuck}.
e.zh: 球落地时发出沉闷的一声砰响。

e.en: Arrows {thuck} into the wooden target.
e.zh: 箭砰砰地扎进木靶。

e.en: Heavy boots {thudd} along the hallway.
e.zh: 沉重的靴子在走廊里砰砰作响。

e.en: The box hit the floor with a {thudd}.
e.zh: 箱子落到地板上，发出一声沉闷的响声。

e.en: She fixed the note with a {thumbpin}.
e.zh: 她用一枚图钉把便条固定住。

e.en: A rusty {thumbpin} lay on the classroom floor.
e.zh: 教室地板上有一枚生锈的图钉。

e.en: The committee gave the plan a {thumbs-down}.
e.zh: 委员会对这个计划给出了否定意见。

e.en: His new video received many {thumbs-down} ratings.
e.zh: 他的新视频收到了很多差评。

e.en: She gave me a {thumbs-up} from across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头向我竖起大拇指表示认可。

e.en: The manager gave the proposal a {thumbs-up}.
e.zh: 经理批准了这项提案。

e.en: The tailor wore a leather {thumbstall} while sewing.
e.zh: 裁缝缝衣时戴着一个皮制护拇套。

e.en: A {thumbstall} protected his injured thumb from pressure.
e.zh: 一个拇指套保护他受伤的拇指免受压迫。

e.en: Some babies {thumbsuck} when they feel tired.
e.zh: 有些婴儿累了就会吮拇指。

e.en: The forecast looked like a {thumbsuck} rather than analysis.
e.zh: 这份预测看起来像凭空臆测，而不是分析。

e.en: The child was still a {thumbsucker} at night.
e.zh: 那个孩子晚上仍然会吮拇指。

e.en: Critics called him a {thumbsucker} with no real evidence.
e.zh: 批评者说他是个没有真凭实据的空想者。

e.en: The children hid during the {thunder-and-lightning}.
e.zh: 雷电交加时，孩子们躲了起来。

e.en: We watched the {thunder-and-lightning} from the porch.
e.zh: 我们在门廊上看着雷鸣闪电。

e.en: A sudden {thunder-gust} bent the trees sharply.
e.zh: 一阵突来的雷暴阵风把树吹得猛然弯下。

e.en: The sailors feared a {thunder-gust} near the coast.
e.zh: 水手们担心海岸附近会出现雷雨突风。

e.en: A {thunder-storm} kept us indoors all afternoon.
e.zh: 一场雷雨让我们整个下午都待在室内。

e.en: The sky turned black before the {thunder-storm}.
e.zh: 雷暴来临前，天空变得漆黑。

e.en: {Thunderation}, I forgot the keys again.
e.zh: 哎呀，我又忘带钥匙了。

e.en: He shouted {thunderation} when the wagon broke.
e.zh: 马车坏掉时，他喊了一声该死。

e.en: The villagers claimed they saw a {thunderball} in the storm.
e.zh: 村民们声称在暴风雨中看见了球状闪电。

e.en: A bright {thunderball} seemed to float over the field.
e.zh: 一个明亮的雷球似乎漂浮在田野上空。

e.en: The {thunderboat} roared across the lake.
e.zh: 那艘高速赛艇轰鸣着掠过湖面。

e.en: Crowds gathered to watch the {thunderboat} race.
e.zh: 人群聚集起来观看高速赛艇比赛。

e.en: The old cabin had only a {thunderbox} outside.
e.zh: 那间旧小屋外面只有一个简易厕所。

e.en: He joked about the freezing {thunderbox} in winter.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说冬天那个便桶冷得要命。

e.en: A loud {thunderburst} shook the windows.
e.zh: 一阵突发的雷声震得窗户发抖。

e.en: The picnic ended with a sudden {thunderburst}.
e.zh: 野餐因雷雨骤发而结束。

e.en: A {thunderflash} lit the valley for a second.
e.zh: 一道闪雷瞬间照亮了山谷。

e.en: The soldiers used a {thunderflash} during the exercise.
e.zh: 士兵们在演习中使用了爆闪雷火器。

e.en: The poem praises a warrior with a {thunderheart}.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美一位有勇猛之心的战士。

e.en: Her {thunderheart} would not yield to fear.
e.zh: 她那雷霆般的心不肯向恐惧屈服。

e.en: Rain fell from a {thunderless} sky.
e.zh: 雨从没有雷声的天空落下。

e.en: The night was stormy but strangely {thunderless}.
e.zh: 那个夜晚风雨交加，却奇怪地没有雷声。

e.en: A deep {thunderpeal} rolled over the hills.
e.zh: 一阵低沉的雷鸣滚过群山。

e.en: The final drumbeat sounded like a {thunderpeal}.
e.zh: 最后一声鼓响听起来像雷声轰鸣。

e.en: The stagehand shook a {thundersheet} behind the curtain.
e.zh: 舞台工作人员在帘幕后摇动雷声板。

e.en: A metal {thundersheet} created the storm effect.
e.zh: 一块金属拟雷声薄板制造出暴风雨效果。

e.en: The boat turned back during a {thundersquall}.
e.zh: 船在雷暴狂风中掉头返回。

e.en: A fierce {thundersquall} swept across the harbor.
e.zh: 一阵猛烈的雷雨飑横扫港口。

thunderstone.t: 雷石；古人以为雷击落的石

e.en: The farmer kept a {thunderstone} above the door.
e.zh: 农夫把一块雷石放在门上方。

e.en: Ancient people thought a {thunderstone} fell from lightning.
e.zh: 古人认为雷石是闪电打下来形成的。

e.en: She stood {thunderstricken} after hearing the verdict.
e.zh: 听到判决后，她像遭雷击一样站在那里。

e.en: The {thunderstricken} tree split down the middle.
e.zh: 那棵遭雷击的树从中间裂开了。

e.en: Lightning can {thunderstrike} a lone tree on the hill.
e.zh: 闪电可能会雷击山坡上一棵孤立的树。

e.en: The news seemed to {thunderstrike} the whole room.
e.zh: 这个消息似乎震惊了整个房间。

e.en: The oak showed marks of a {thunderstroke}.
e.zh: 那棵橡树显出遭雷击的痕迹。

e.en: His dismissal came as a {thunderstroke} to the team.
e.zh: 他的解雇对团队来说像晴天霹雳。

e.en: The old tale spoke of a {thunderworm} after storms.
e.zh: 这个古老传说讲到暴风雨后出现的雷虫。

e.en: A child drew a {thunderworm} in the margins.
e.zh: 一个孩子在页边画了一条传说中的雷虫。

thyrotomy.t: 甲状腺切开术；喉切开术

e.en: The surgeon performed a {thyrotomy} to reach the lesion.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了甲状腺切开术以接近病灶。

e.en: A planned {thyrotomy} can expose part of the larynx.
e.zh: 有计划的喉切开术可以暴露喉部的一部分。

e.en: She developed a {thyrotoxic} crisis after stopping treatment.
e.zh: 她停止治疗后出现了甲状腺毒症危象。

e.en: The doctor noted several {thyrotoxic} symptoms during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查中注意到几种甲状腺毒症症状。

e.en: Untreated {thyrotoxicosis} can strain the heart.
e.zh: 未经治疗的甲状腺毒症会给心脏造成负担。

e.en: Her weight loss was later linked to {thyrotoxicosis}.
e.zh: 她的体重下降后来被认为与甲状腺毒症有关。

e.en: The lab measured a {thyrotrophic} hormone in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了样本中的一种促甲状腺激素。

e.en: Some pituitary cells have a {thyrotrophic} function.
e.zh: 一些垂体细胞具有促甲状腺功能。

e.en: The blood test showed low {thyrotrophin} levels.
e.zh: 血液检查显示促甲状腺激素水平偏低。

e.en: Doctors use {thyrotrophin} results to assess thyroid function.
e.zh: 医生会用促甲状腺激素结果来评估甲状腺功能。

e.en: A {thyrotropic} signal can increase thyroid hormone production.
e.zh: 促甲状腺信号可以增加甲状腺激素的生成。

e.en: The study focused on {thyrotropic} activity in the pituitary gland.
e.zh: 这项研究关注垂体中的促甲状腺活性。

e.en: High {thyrotropin} often suggests an underactive thyroid.
e.zh: 促甲状腺激素偏高通常提示甲状腺功能低下。

e.en: The nurse explained why {thyrotropin} was tested again.
e.zh: 护士解释了为什么要再次检测促甲状腺激素。

e.en: The tablets contain synthetic {thyroxin}.
e.zh: 这些药片含有合成甲状腺素。

e.en: Low {thyroxin} can cause tiredness and weight gain.
e.zh: 甲状腺素偏低可能导致疲劳和体重增加。

e.en: Her doctor adjusted the {thyroxine} dose.
e.zh: 她的医生调整了甲状腺素剂量。

e.en: The thyroid gland releases {thyroxine} into the bloodstream.
e.zh: 甲状腺会把甲状腺素释放到血液中。

e.en: The plant bears flowers in a loose {thyrse}.
e.zh: 这种植物的花呈疏松的聚伞圆锥花序。

e.en: A botanist sketched the {thyrse} before pressing the specimen.
e.zh: 植物学家在压制标本前画下了这个聚伞圆锥花序。

e.en: Ancient dancers carried {thyrsi} in the procession.
e.zh: 古代舞者在游行中携带酒神杖。

e.en: The shrubs produced several compact {thyrsi} in spring.
e.zh: 这些灌木在春天长出几个紧密的聚伞圆锥花序。

e.en: The botanist described the species as {thyrsiferous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个物种描述为具聚伞圆锥花序。

e.en: Its {thyrsiferous} branches made the plant easy to identify.
e.zh: 它具聚伞圆锥花序的枝条使这种植物容易辨认。

thyrsiform.t: 酒神杖状的；花序似聚伞圆锥的

e.en: The sculpture has a {thyrsiform} staff beside the figure.
e.zh: 雕塑中人物旁有一根酒神杖状的手杖。

e.en: The flowers formed a {thyrsiform} cluster at the stem tip.
e.zh: 花朵在茎端形成了似聚伞圆锥的花簇。

e.en: The specimen showed a {thyrsoid} arrangement of small blossoms.
e.zh: 这个标本显示出小花似聚伞圆锥花序排列。

e.en: A {thyrsoid} cluster appeared at the end of each branch.
e.zh: 每根枝条末端都出现一个似聚伞圆锥花序的花簇。

e.en: The herb is known for its {thyrsoidal} flower heads.
e.zh: 这种草本植物以其似聚伞圆锥花序的花头而闻名。

e.en: She noted the {thyrsoidal} shape in her field journal.
e.zh: 她在野外记录本中记下了这种似聚伞圆锥花序的形态。

e.en: Dionysus is often shown holding a {thyrsus}.
e.zh: 狄俄尼索斯常被描绘为手持酒神杖。

e.en: The lilac displayed a dense {thyrsus} of purple flowers.
e.zh: 丁香展现出一簇密集的紫色聚伞圆锥花序。

e.en: A silverfish is a familiar {thysanuran} found indoors.
e.zh: 蠹鱼是一种常见于室内的缨尾目昆虫。

e.en: The class examined {thysanuran} features under a microscope.
e.zh: 课堂上学生用显微镜观察缨尾目昆虫的特征。

e.en: The aquarium displayed a rare {tiacarana} from South America.
e.zh: 水族馆展出了一条来自南美的稀有提阿卡拉纳鱼。

e.en: Local fishers recognized the {tiacarana} by its shape.
e.zh: 当地渔民根据外形认出了这条提阿卡拉纳鱼。

e.en: The old portrait shows a ruler wearing a {tiar}.
e.zh: 这幅旧肖像显示一位统治者戴着头冠。

e.en: A jeweled {tiar} rested in the museum case.
e.zh: 一顶镶宝石的头冠陈列在博物馆展柜里。

e.en: The X-ray showed fractures in both {tibiae}.
e.zh: X光片显示两根胫骨都有骨折。

e.en: The insect's {tibiae} were covered with tiny spines.
e.zh: 这只昆虫的足胫节上布满细小的刺。

e.en: The old clock made a steady {ticktack} in the hall.
e.zh: 那只旧钟在走廊里发出稳定的滴答声。

e.en: I could hear the typewriter {ticktack} through the door.
e.zh: 我隔着门都能听见打字机嗒嗒作响。

e.en: We played {ticktacktoe} while waiting for lunch.
e.zh: 等午饭时，我们玩了井字棋。

e.en: The child drew a {ticktacktoe} board on the napkin.
e.zh: 那个孩子在餐巾纸上画了一个井字棋盘。

e.en: The {ticktock} of the clock kept me awake.
e.zh: 钟表的滴答声让我睡不着。

e.en: The kitchen timer began to {ticktock} loudly.
e.zh: 厨房计时器开始大声滴答作响。

e.en: The old clock {ticktocked} through the quiet night.
e.zh: 那只旧钟在寂静的夜里滴答作响。

e.en: Minutes {ticktocked} away as we waited for news.
e.zh: 我们等待消息时，时间一分一秒地流逝。

e.en: A {ticktocking} clock hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一只滴答作响的钟。

e.en: With the deadline {ticktocking}, everyone worked faster.
e.zh: 截止时间一分一秒逼近，大家都加快了速度。

e.en: The tiny {ticktocks} sounded huge in the empty room.
e.zh: 空房间里，那些细小的滴答声显得格外响。

e.en: The watch {ticktocks} softly beside my bed.
e.zh: 那块手表在我床边轻轻滴答作响。

e.en: The dog came back {ticky} after running through the grass.
e.zh: 狗穿过草地回来后身上沾了不少蜱虫。

e.en: He grew {ticky} whenever the meeting ran late.
e.zh: 会议一拖长，他就变得紧张烦躁。

e.en: Rows of {ticky-tacky} houses covered the hillside.
e.zh: 山坡上排满了廉价又千篇一律的房子。

e.en: She refused to buy the {ticky-tacky} souvenir.
e.zh: 她不愿买那个俗气又劣质的纪念品。

e.en: A friendly {Tico} showed us the best bus route.
e.zh: 一位友好的哥斯达黎加人告诉我们最好的公交路线。

e.en: Many {Ticos} are proud of their country's biodiversity.
e.zh: 许多哥斯达黎加人为本国的生物多样性感到自豪。

e.en: The clock's {tictac} echoed in the silent shop.
e.zh: 钟表的滴答声在安静的店里回响。

e.en: The bookmaker used {tictac} to signal changing odds.
e.zh: 那名赌注登记人用手势暗号表示赔率变化。

e.en: I heard a faint {tictak} behind the wall.
e.zh: 我听见墙后有微弱的滴答声。

e.en: The toy train went {tictak} along the track.
e.zh: 玩具火车沿着轨道嗒嗒地跑着。

e.en: The {tictoc} from the clock filled the room.
e.zh: 钟发出的滴答声充满了房间。

e.en: Her heels made a sharp {tictoc} on the tiles.
e.zh: 她的高跟鞋在瓷砖上发出清脆的嗒嗒声。

e.en: He {tiddled} with the radio until it worked.
e.zh: 他摆弄了一会儿收音机，直到它能用了。

e.en: The puppy {tiddled} on the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 小狗在厨房地板上尿了一泡。

e.en: She packed the drawer with buttons and other {tiddledies}.
e.zh: 她把纽扣和其他小零碎塞进抽屉。

e.en: The {tiddledies} were sent to bed before the film started.
e.zh: 电影开始前，孩子们就被打发去睡觉了。

e.en: They played {tiddledywinks} on the carpet after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，他们在地毯上玩弹圆片游戏。

e.en: The club treats {tiddledywinks} as a serious sport.
e.zh: 这个俱乐部把弹圆片游戏当成一项严肃的运动。

e.en: He was a little {tiddley} after two glasses of wine.
e.zh: 喝了两杯酒后，他有点微醉。

e.en: They met in a quiet {tiddley} near the station.
e.zh: 他们在车站附近一家安静的小酒馆见面。

e.en: Choose the {tiddlier} screws for this hinge.
e.zh: 给这个铰链选那些更小的螺丝。

e.en: That problem is {tiddlier} than the budget crisis.
e.zh: 那个问题比预算危机要小得多。

e.en: The {tiddliest} kitten hid under the blanket.
e.zh: 最小的那只小猫躲在毯子下面。

e.en: Even the {tiddliest} detail mattered to the designer.
e.zh: 即使最微小的细节，对设计师来说也很重要。

e.en: One {tiddly-wink} landed neatly inside the cup.
e.zh: 一个弹圆片游戏的小圆片正好落进杯子里。

e.en: He flicked the blue {tiddly-wink} across the table.
e.zh: 他把蓝色的小圆片弹过桌面。

e.en: The red {tiddlywink} bounced off the rim.
e.zh: 红色的小圆片从杯沿弹开了。

e.en: She lost a {tiddlywink} under the sofa.
e.zh: 她把一个弹圆片游戏的小圆片弄丢在沙发底下。

e.en: We learned {tiddlywinks} at a family party.
e.zh: 我们在家庭聚会上学会了弹圆片游戏。

e.en: Competitive {tiddlywinks} has surprisingly detailed rules.
e.zh: 竞技弹圆片游戏的规则细得出人意料。

e.en: Check the {tide-table} before walking across the bay.
e.zh: 步行穿过海湾前，先查一下潮汐表。

e.en: The sailor kept a printed {tide-table} in his bag.
e.zh: 那名水手把一份打印的潮汐表放在包里。

tidehead.t: 潮水源头；潮汐顶端水位

e.en: The channel narrows near the {tidehead}.
e.zh: 水道在潮水源头附近变窄。

e.en: Boats waited below the {tidehead} until morning.
e.zh: 船只在潮汐顶端水位以下等到早晨。

tideland.t: 潮间带土地；受潮汐影响的海岸地

e.en: The birds feed across the exposed {tideland}.
e.zh: 鸟儿在露出的潮间带土地上觅食。

e.en: New rules protect the fragile {tideland} habitat.
e.zh: 新规定保护脆弱的受潮汐影响海岸栖息地。

tideless.t: 无潮汐的；不受潮汐影响的

e.en: The lake seemed calm and {tideless}.
e.zh: 这个湖显得平静，没有潮汐变化。

e.en: They sailed into a nearly {tideless} sea.
e.zh: 他们驶入一片几乎不受潮汐影响的海域。

e.en: The old {tidewaiter} rested beside the quay.
e.zh: 那艘老候潮船停靠在码头旁。

e.en: A patient {tidewaiter} knows when to leave port.
e.zh: 有耐心等潮的人知道何时离港。

e.en: He studied {tidology} before mapping the coast.
e.zh: 他在绘制海岸图前研究了潮汐学。

e.en: Modern {tidology} helps predict dangerous currents.
e.zh: 现代潮汐研究有助于预测危险洋流。

e.en: The meadow was bright with yellow {tidytips}.
e.zh: 草地上开满黄色黄尖小花，十分明亮。

e.en: Her blog shares weekly {tidytips} for small apartments.
e.zh: 她的博客每周分享小公寓的整洁窍门。

e.en: They learned {tie-and-dye} at the workshop.
e.zh: 他们在工作坊学习了扎染工艺。

e.en: Her scarf used a bright {tie-and-dye} pattern.
e.zh: 她的围巾用了鲜艳的扎染图案。

e.en: She used a silk {tie-back} for the curtains.
e.zh: 她用丝质窗帘束带把窗帘拢住。

e.en: The design should {tie-back} to the main campaign.
e.zh: 这个设计应当和主宣传活动形成呼应。

e.en: The carpenter replaced the cracked {tie-beam}.
e.zh: 木匠更换了开裂的系梁。

e.en: A strong {tie-beam} holds the roof frame together.
e.zh: 坚固的横拉梁把屋顶框架连接在一起。

e.en: She won the set in a {tie-break}.
e.zh: 她在决胜局中赢下了这一盘。

e.en: The quiz used a {tie-break} question.
e.zh: 这场问答用了一个平局决胜题。

e.en: The final goal was the {tie-breaker}.
e.zh: 最后一球打破了平局。

e.en: We need a {tie-breaker} to choose the winner.
e.zh: 我们需要一个决胜题来选出获胜者。

tie-breaks.t: 决胜局；平局决胜方式复数

e.en: He practices {tie-breaks} after every training session.
e.zh: 他每次训练后都会练习决胜局。

e.en: Several {tie-breaks} decided the tournament rankings.
e.zh: 几场平局决胜决定了锦标赛排名。

e.en: Use a {tie-down} to secure the bike.
e.zh: 用固定带把自行车固定好。

e.en: The contract became a serious {tie-down}.
e.zh: 那份合同成了很大的束缚。

e.en: We will {tie-dye} shirts this afternoon.
e.zh: 我们今天下午要扎染衬衫。

e.en: He wore a bright {tie-dye} hoodie.
e.zh: 他穿了一件鲜艳的扎染连帽衫。

e.en: She bought a {tie-dyed} dress at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场买了一条扎染连衣裙。

e.en: The children brought home {tie-dyed} napkins.
e.zh: 孩子们带回了扎染过的餐巾。

e.en: {Tie-dyeing} can create surprising patterns.
e.zh: 扎染能做出令人意外的图案。

e.en: They spent the weekend {tie-dyeing} old T-shirts.
e.zh: 他们周末花时间给旧T恤做扎染。

tie-dyes.t: 扎染作品；扎染复数形式

e.en: The shop sells handmade {tie-dyes}.
e.zh: 这家店出售手工扎染作品。

e.en: She {tie-dyes} cotton bags for festivals.
e.zh: 她为节日扎染棉布袋。

tie-in.t: 关联；配套产品；搭售安排

e.en: The novel was a {tie-in} with the film.
e.zh: 这本小说是那部电影的配套作品。

e.en: There is a clear {tie-in} between diet and health.
e.zh: 饮食和健康之间有明显关联。

e.en: The regulator investigated the {tie-in-sale}.
e.zh: 监管机构调查了这项搭售安排。

e.en: A {tie-in-sale} forced buyers to take both products.
e.zh: 捆绑销售迫使买家同时购买两种产品。

e.en: Remember to {tie-off} the thread securely.
e.zh: 记得把线牢牢打结收尾。

e.en: The nurse had to {tie-off} the bandage.
e.zh: 护士必须把绷带扎紧固定。

e.en: The apron has a simple {tie-on} strap.
e.zh: 这条围裙有一根简单的系带。

e.en: They chose {tie-on} labels for the gift bags.
e.zh: 他们为礼品袋选择了系上的标签。

e.en: He wore a silver {tie-pin} to dinner.
e.zh: 他去晚餐时戴了一枚银色领带别针。

e.en: The {tie-pin} kept his tie in place.
e.zh: 领带别针把他的领带固定住了。

e.en: The old report described fatigue as {thyrasthenia}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把疲劳描述为甲状腺功能衰弱。

e.en: Modern doctors rarely use the term {thyrasthenia}.
e.zh: 现代医生很少使用thyrasthenia这个术语。

e.en: The vintage radar used a {thyratron} for switching.
e.zh: 那台老式雷达用闸流管进行开关控制。

e.en: Engineers replaced the failed {thyratron} with a solid-state device.
e.zh: 工程师用固态器件替换了失效的闸流管。

e.en: The surgeon checked the {thyrector} before the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前检查了甲状腺切除器械。

e.en: A museum displayed an antique {thyrector} beside other surgical tools.
e.zh: 博物馆把一件古老的甲状腺切除器械和其他手术工具一起展出。

e.en: The paper used {thyreoid} as an older spelling.
e.zh: 这篇论文把thyreoid作为旧式拼写使用。

e.en: The gland had a {thyreoid} appearance under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这个腺体呈甲状腺样外观。

thyreoidea.t: 甲状腺；甲状腺相关结构

e.en: The atlas labeled the gland as {thyreoidea}.
e.zh: 这本图谱把该腺体标注为thyreoidea。

e.en: Older anatomical notes mention the {thyreoidea} repeatedly.
e.zh: 较早的解剖笔记多次提到甲状腺。

e.en: The physician prescribed {thyreoidin} for the patient.
e.zh: 医生给病人开了甲状腺素制剂。

e.en: Early textbooks discussed {thyreoidin} as glandular therapy.
e.zh: 早期教材把甲状腺素制剂作为腺体疗法来讨论。

e.en: The diagnosis mentioned abnormal {thyreoidism}.
e.zh: 诊断中提到了异常的甲状腺功能状态。

e.en: Researchers compared {thyreoidism} in several endocrine disorders.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种内分泌疾病中的甲状腺功能状态。

e.en: The patient was monitored for signs of {thyreosis}.
e.zh: 医生监测病人是否出现甲状腺病变迹象。

e.en: The article classified {thyreosis} by hormone changes.
e.zh: 这篇文章按激素变化对甲状腺病变进行分类。

e.en: The insect wing was described as {thyridiate}.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的翅被描述为有小窗孔。

e.en: A {thyridiate} pattern appeared on the shell.
e.zh: 贝壳上出现了有小窗孔的纹样。

e.en: A {thyristor} controls the motor speed.
e.zh: 晶闸管控制电机转速。

e.en: The dimmer failed when its {thyristor} overheated.
e.zh: 调光器里的晶闸管过热后失效了。

e.en: The arrester used {thyrite} to absorb surges.
e.zh: 避雷器使用碳化硅电阻材料来吸收浪涌。

e.en: Old electrical manuals specify {thyrite} discs.
e.zh: 旧电气手册规定使用thyrite圆片。

e.en: The biopsy suggested {thyroadenitis}.
e.zh: 活检结果提示甲状腺炎。

e.en: Untreated {thyroadenitis} can affect hormone levels.
e.zh: 未经治疗的甲状腺炎可能影响激素水平。

e.en: The thyroid releases {thyrocalcitonin} into the blood.
e.zh: 甲状腺会把降钙素释放到血液中。

e.en: Doctors measured {thyrocalcitonin} during the cancer workup.
e.zh: 医生在癌症检查过程中测量了甲状腺降钙素。

e.en: The specimen had a {thyrode} structure.
e.zh: 这个标本具有甲状腺样结构。

e.en: Pathologists noted {thyrode} tissue in the sample.
e.zh: 病理医生注意到样本中有甲状腺样组织。

e.en: The lab measured {thyroglobulin} after surgery.
e.zh: 实验室在手术后测量了甲状腺球蛋白。

e.en: High {thyroglobulin} may suggest recurrent thyroid cancer.
e.zh: 甲状腺球蛋白偏高可能提示甲状腺癌复发。

e.en: The doctor examined the {thyroidean} tissue carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了甲状腺组织。

e.en: Older texts used {thyroidean} where modern texts say thyroid.
e.zh: 旧文献用thyroidean表示现代所说的甲状腺的。

e.en: Surgeons may {thyroidectomize} patients with aggressive tumors.
e.zh: 外科医生可能会为侵袭性肿瘤患者切除甲状腺。

e.en: The team decided not to {thyroidectomize} the child immediately.
e.zh: 团队决定不立即给这个孩子切除甲状腺。

e.en: The {thyroidectomized} patient needed hormone replacement.
e.zh: 这名已切除甲状腺的病人需要激素替代治疗。

e.en: Researchers monitored {thyroidectomized} rats for metabolic changes.
e.zh: 研究人员监测已切除甲状腺的大鼠是否出现代谢变化。

e.en: The case report described {thyroidomania} after endocrine changes.
e.zh: 病例报告描述了内分泌变化后的甲状腺相关躁狂。

e.en: Clinicians distinguished {thyroidomania} from primary mania.
e.zh: 临床医生把甲状腺相关躁狂与原发性躁狂区分开来。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {thyroidotomy} to reach the larynx.
e.zh: 外科医生实施甲状软骨切开术以进入喉部。

e.en: A historical text explains {thyroidotomy} in detail.
e.zh: 一本历史医学文献详细解释了甲状软骨切开术。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {thyroncus}.
e.zh: 扫描显示有一个小的甲状腺肿块。

e.en: Doctors evaluated the {thyroncus} for malignancy.
e.zh: 医生评估这个甲状腺肿块是否为恶性。

e.en: Severe {thyropenia} slowed the patient's metabolism.
e.zh: 严重的甲状腺功能不足使病人的代谢变慢。

e.en: The study linked {thyropenia} with fatigue and cold intolerance.
e.zh: 研究把甲状腺功能不足与疲劳和畏寒联系起来。

e.en: Farmers once added {thyroprotein} to animal feed.
e.zh: 农民过去曾把甲状腺蛋白制剂加进动物饲料。

e.en: Regulators questioned the use of {thyroprotein} in livestock.
e.zh: 监管机构质疑在牲畜中使用甲状腺蛋白制剂。

e.en: The patient showed mild {thyrosis}.
e.zh: 这名病人表现出轻度甲状腺病。

e.en: The manual grouped several disorders under {thyrosis}.
e.zh: 手册把几种疾病归入甲状腺病。

e.en: The surgeon selected a {thyrotome} for the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生为这项操作选择了甲状软骨切开刀。

e.en: The antique {thyrotome} was kept in a glass case.
e.zh: 那把古老的甲状软骨切开刀被放在玻璃柜里。

e.en: A {tigercat} moved silently through the brush.
e.zh: 一只虎猫悄无声息地穿过灌木丛。

e.en: The shelter nicknamed the striped kitten a {tigercat}.
e.zh: 收容所把那只条纹小猫昵称为虎猫。

e.en: She wore a ring set with {tigereye}.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚镶有虎眼石的戒指。

e.en: The polished wood had a warm {tigereye} sheen.
e.zh: 抛光后的木头泛着温暖的虎眼般光泽。

e.en: The gardener planted a bright {tigerflower} near the path.
e.zh: 园丁在小路旁种了一株鲜艳的虎花。

e.en: Its spotted petals made the lily look like a {tigerflower}.
e.zh: 斑点花瓣让这朵百合看起来像虎纹花。

tigerland.t: 老虎出没之地；危险地带

e.en: The old hunters called that valley {tigerland}.
e.zh: 老猎人把那座山谷称为老虎出没之地。

e.en: In politics, the budget debate is real {tigerland}.
e.zh: 在政治中，预算辩论是真正的危险地带。

e.en: The boxer moved with {tigerlike} speed.
e.zh: 那名拳击手动作快得像老虎。

e.en: Her {tigerlike} focus impressed the whole team.
e.zh: 她那种凶猛专注的劲头让全队印象深刻。

e.en: Don't be such a {tight-arse} about dinner.
e.zh: 吃顿晚饭别这么小气。

e.en: The manager was known as a {tight-arse} with expenses.
e.zh: 那位经理在开支上出了名地抠门。

e.en: He called me a {tight-ass} for saving every receipt.
e.zh: 我每张收据都留着，他就说我是小气鬼。

e.en: At parties, she stops acting like a {tight-ass}.
e.zh: 在聚会上，她就不再那么古板拘谨了。

e.en: His {tight-assed} rules annoyed the staff.
e.zh: 他那些古板拘谨的规定惹恼了员工。

e.en: The company seemed {tight-assed} about travel costs.
e.zh: 这家公司在差旅费上显得很吝啬。

e.en: My uncle is {tight-fisted} with his money.
e.zh: 我叔叔花自己的钱很吝啬。

e.en: The council took a {tight-fisted} approach to funding.
e.zh: 委员会对拨款采取了很抠门的做法。

e.en: She wore a {tight-fitting} black dress.
e.zh: 她穿了一条紧身黑裙。

e.en: Avoid {tight-fitting} shoes on long walks.
e.zh: 长时间走路时不要穿太紧的鞋。

e.en: They grew up in a {tight-knit} village.
e.zh: 他们在一个关系紧密的村庄长大。

e.en: The project depends on a {tight-knit} team.
e.zh: 这个项目依赖一支团结紧密的团队。

tight-laced.t: 束紧带子的；拘谨古板的

e.en: Her {tight-laced} boots left marks on her ankles.
e.zh: 她那双系得很紧的靴子在脚踝上勒出了印子。

e.en: The school had a {tight-laced} attitude toward dancing.
e.zh: 那所学校对跳舞持很拘谨古板的态度。

tight-lipped.t: 守口如瓶的；嘴唇紧闭的

e.en: Officials remained {tight-lipped} about the investigation.
e.zh: 官员们对调查仍然守口如瓶。

e.en: She gave a {tight-lipped} smile and walked away.
e.zh: 她抿嘴一笑，然后走开了。

e.en: The witness stayed {tight-mouthed} during questioning.
e.zh: 证人在询问过程中一直沉默不语。

e.en: He gave a {tight-mouthed} nod at the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息，他嘴唇紧闭地点了点头。

e.en: The dancer chose a {tightfitting} costume.
e.zh: 那位舞者选了一套贴身服装。

e.en: Doctors warned him against {tightfitting} socks.
e.zh: 医生提醒他不要穿太紧的袜子。

e.en: Ours is a small, {tightknit} community.
e.zh: 我们这里是个小而团结的社区。

e.en: The rescue required a {tightknit} group of volunteers.
e.zh: 这次救援需要一群配合紧密的志愿者。

tightlipped.t: 守口如瓶的；嘴唇紧闭的

e.en: The lawyer stayed {tightlipped} after court.
e.zh: 庭审结束后，律师依然守口如瓶。

e.en: He answered with a {tightlipped} expression.
e.zh: 他嘴唇紧闭，带着那样的表情回答。

tightrope-walkers.t: 走钢丝的人；冒险平衡者

e.en: The {tightrope-walkers} crossed above the crowd.
e.zh: 走钢丝的人从人群上方走过。

e.en: Diplomats can feel like {tightrope-walkers} during crises.
e.zh: 危机期间，外交官有时像在走钢丝。

e.en: The acrobat stepped carefully onto the {tightwire}.
e.zh: 杂技演员小心翼翼地踏上高空钢丝。

e.en: Budget planning became a {tightwire} between cuts and growth.
e.zh: 预算规划成了在削减与增长之间走钢丝。

e.en: The chemist detected {tiglaldehyde} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中检测到了惕各醛。

e.en: {Tiglaldehyde} can contribute to a sharp odor.
e.zh: 惕各醛可能带来一种刺鼻气味。

e.en: The paper discussed a {tiglic} acid derivative.
e.zh: 论文讨论了一种惕各酸衍生物。

e.en: They measured the {tiglic} compound in the extract.
e.zh: 他们测量了提取物中的惕各酸相关化合物。

e.en: The lab synthesized a {tiglinic} acid sample.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一份惕各酸样品。

e.en: A {tiglinic} ester appeared in the analysis.
e.zh: 分析中出现了一种惕各酸酯。

e.en: A {tiglon} has a tiger father and a lion mother.
e.zh: 虎狮兽的父亲是老虎，母亲是狮子。

e.en: The zoo displayed information about a rare {tiglon}.
e.zh: 动物园展示了关于一只罕见虎狮兽的信息。

e.en: His silver {tie-pins} matched his cuff links.
e.zh: 他的银色领带夹和袖扣很相配。

e.en: The antique shop displayed several Victorian {tie-pins}.
e.zh: 古董店陈列着几枚维多利亚时期的领带别针。

e.en: The mechanic replaced a bent {tie-rod}.
e.zh: 修理工更换了一根弯曲的转向横拉杆。

e.en: A steel {tie-rod} held the wall together.
e.zh: 一根钢制拉杆把墙体固定在一起。

e.en: The companies announced a new {tie-up} yesterday.
e.zh: 两家公司昨天宣布建立新的合作关系。

e.en: A crash caused a long {tie-up} downtown.
e.zh: 一场撞车事故造成市中心长时间堵塞。

e.en: She won the match in a tense {tiebreak}.
e.zh: 她在紧张的决胜局中赢得了比赛。

e.en: The league uses goal difference as a {tiebreak}.
e.zh: 这个联赛用净胜球作为平局判定标准。

e.en: Use a {tiedown} to secure the motorcycle.
e.zh: 用捆绑带把摩托车固定好。

e.en: Each cargo box needs a separate {tiedown}.
e.zh: 每个货箱都需要单独的固定装置。

e.en: The skilled {tieer} finished every knot quickly.
e.zh: 那位熟练的打结者很快完成了每个绳结。

e.en: A careful {tieer} can make the package safer.
e.zh: 细心的捆扎者能让包裹更安全。

e.en: She practiced {tieing} knots before sailing.
e.zh: 出航前，她练习打绳结。

e.en: The old spelling {tieing} still appears in manuals.
e.zh: 这种旧拼法tieing仍会出现在手册里。

e.en: He looked relaxed and {tieless} at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时他没戴领带，看起来很放松。

e.en: The office adopted a {tieless} dress code.
e.zh: 办公室采用了不必戴领带的着装规定。

e.en: The geologist identified {tiemannite} in the sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在样本中鉴定出了硒汞矿。

e.en: Rare {tiemannite} crystals formed near the mercury deposit.
e.zh: 稀有的硒汞矿晶体形成在汞矿床附近。

e.en: The carpenter fitted a wooden {tiepiece} across the frame.
e.zh: 木匠在框架上装了一块木制连接件。

e.en: A small {tiepiece} keeps the cords aligned.
e.zh: 一个小系结部件让这些绳线保持整齐。

e.en: He wore a gold {tiepin} to the wedding.
e.zh: 他戴着金色领带夹去参加婚礼。

e.en: The {tiepin} stopped his tie from slipping.
e.zh: 领带别针防止他的领带滑动。

e.en: The melody rises by a {tierce} here.
e.zh: 这段旋律在这里上行一个三度音。

e.en: The tavern ordered a {tierce} of wine.
e.zh: 酒馆订购了一只三分之一桶容量的葡萄酒。

e.en: The falconer released the young {tiercel}.
e.zh: 驯鹰人放飞了那只年轻的雄隼。

e.en: A smaller {tiercel} circled above the field.
e.zh: 一只体型较小的雄鹰在田野上空盘旋。

e.en: The chapel ceiling includes a carved {tierceron}.
e.zh: 小礼拜堂的天花板有一条雕刻的次肋拱。

e.en: Architects studied the {tierceron} in the medieval vault.
e.zh: 建筑师研究了中世纪拱顶中的次肋拱。

e.en: The poem ends with a graceful {tiercet}.
e.zh: 这首诗以一个优雅的三行诗节结尾。

e.en: The opera features a dramatic {tiercet}.
e.zh: 这部歌剧中有一段富有戏剧性的三重唱。

e.en: The judge wore a powdered {tiewig}.
e.zh: 法官戴着一顶扑粉的旧式束发假发。

e.en: A faded {tiewig} hung in the costume room.
e.zh: 一顶褪色的束发假发挂在服装间里。

e.en: The chemist added {tiferron} to test the solution.
e.zh: 化学家加入铁试剂来检测溶液。

e.en: Old methods used {tiferron} for measuring iron.
e.zh: 旧方法曾使用tiferron来测定铁含量。

e.en: They stopped for {tiffin} at noon.
e.zh: 他们中午停下来吃了一顿便餐。

e.en: The club served tea and {tiffin} on the veranda.
e.zh: 俱乐部在阳台上供应茶和午餐。

e.en: Children played {tig} behind the school.
e.zh: 孩子们在学校后面玩碰人游戏。

e.en: He gave the door a quick {tig}.
e.zh: 他轻轻快速拍了一下门。

e.en: The old rug was made from {tiger-skin}.
e.zh: 那张旧地毯是用虎皮制成的。

e.en: She chose a bold {tiger-skin} pattern.
e.zh: 她选择了醒目的虎纹图案。

e.en: The zoo displayed a rare {tigon} in its big-cat area.
e.zh: 动物园在大型猫科动物区展出了一只罕见的虎狮兽。

e.en: A {tigon} has a tiger father and a lion mother.
e.zh: 虎狮兽的父亲是老虎，母亲是狮子。

e.en: The kitten had a {tigretier} pattern across its back.
e.zh: 那只小猫背上有像小老虎一样的条纹。

e.en: Her scarf looked {tigretier} in the evening light.
e.zh: 她的围巾在暮色中显得带有虎斑感。

e.en: The moth's wings showed a {tigrine} pattern.
e.zh: 那只蛾子的翅膀呈现出虎纹般的图案。

e.en: He admired the cat's {tigrine} grace.
e.zh: 他欣赏那只猫像老虎般的优雅姿态。

e.en: The dancer moved with a {tigrish} confidence.
e.zh: 那名舞者带着虎一般的自信移动。

e.en: Its coat had a faintly {tigrish} look.
e.zh: 它的皮毛隐约有些像老虎。

e.en: Police warned that {tik} was spreading through the neighborhood.
e.zh: 警方警告说，甲基苯丙胺正在这个社区蔓延。

e.en: The clinic treats people addicted to {tik}.
e.zh: 这家诊所治疗对这种毒品上瘾的人。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {tika} near the wetland.
e.zh: 导游指着湿地附近的一只蒂卡鸟给大家看。

e.en: A {tika} searched for food among the reeds.
e.zh: 一只新西兰秧鸡在芦苇丛中寻找食物。

e.en: The old clock was a steady {tikker} in the hallway.
e.zh: 走廊里的旧钟一直稳定地滴答作响。

e.en: He called the telegraph operator a fast {tikker}.
e.zh: 他把那名电报员称作手脚很快的敲键人。

e.en: Children were frightened by stories of the {tikoloshe}.
e.zh: 孩子们被关于提科洛舍恶灵的故事吓坏了。

e.en: The novel uses the {tikoloshe} as a symbol of hidden fear.
e.zh: 这部小说用提科洛舍来象征潜藏的恐惧。

e.en: The priest placed a red {tilak} on his forehead.
e.zh: 祭司在他的额头上点了一个红色的提拉克标记。
