e.zh: 仪式期间，她额头上戴着一个小小的印度教标记。

e.en: The restaurant served grilled {tilefish} with lemon.
e.zh: 那家餐厅供应配柠檬的烤方头鱼。

e.en: A {tilefish} lives in a burrow on the sea floor.
e.zh: 方头鱼生活在海底的洞穴里。

e.en: Several old {tileries} stood beside the river.
e.zh: 河边立着几座旧瓦厂。

e.en: The town's {tileries} once supplied roofs across the county.
e.zh: 这个镇上的制瓦场曾为全郡的屋顶供应瓦片。

e.en: He worked at a {tilery} outside the village.
e.zh: 他在村外的一家瓦厂工作。

e.en: The abandoned {tilery} was converted into studios.
e.zh: 那座废弃的制瓦作坊被改造成了工作室。

e.en: The roof was covered with local {tilestone}.
e.zh: 屋顶铺的是当地出产的片瓦石。

e.en: Builders split the {tilestone} into thin slabs.
e.zh: 建筑工人把这种可作瓦的石材劈成薄片。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {tiliaceous} features.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物具有椴树科特征。

e.en: Its broad leaves gave it a {tiliaceous} appearance.
e.zh: 它宽大的叶子让它看起来像椴树。

e.en: Researchers isolated {tiliacorine} from the plant sample.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物样本中分离出一种名为替利亚可林的生物碱。

e.en: The paper examined the effects of {tiliacorine} on cells.
e.zh: 那篇论文研究了这种植物生物碱对细胞的影响。

e.en: Only a narrow strip of land was {tillable}.
e.zh: 只有一小条土地适合耕种。

e.en: The farm has fifty acres of {tillable} soil.
e.zh: 这座农场有五十英亩可耕种的土地。

e.en: She hung a {tillandsia} in the kitchen window.
e.zh: 她把一株空气凤梨挂在厨房窗边。

e.en: A {tillandsia} can absorb moisture through its leaves.
e.zh: 铁兰属植物可以通过叶片吸收水分。

e.en: The {tillerman} kept the boat steady in the current.
e.zh: 舵手让小船在水流中保持平稳。

e.en: A skilled {tillerman} guided the long fire truck around the corner.
e.zh: 一名熟练的后舵手引导长消防车转过街角。

e.en: The avenue of {tilleuls} smelled sweet in June.
e.zh: 六月里，那条椴树大道散发着甜香。

e.en: She ordered {tilleuls} after dinner at the cafe.
e.zh: 晚饭后，她在咖啡馆点了一杯椴花茶。

e.en: He greeted his old {tillicum} at the dock.
e.zh: 他在码头向老朋友打招呼。

e.en: In local slang, {tillicum} meant a trusted companion.
e.zh: 在当地俚语中，tillicum 指值得信赖的伙伴。

e.en: The geologist found {tillite} beneath the sandstone layer.
e.zh: 地质学家在砂岩层下面发现了冰碛岩。

e.en: Ancient {tillite} can reveal past glacial climates.
e.zh: 古老的冰碛岩能揭示过去的冰川气候。

e.en: She shook a {timbrel} during the folk dance.
e.zh: 她在民间舞蹈中摇着小手鼓。

e.en: The old hymn mentions a {timbrel} and a harp.
e.zh: 那首古老圣歌提到铃鼓和竖琴。

timbreled.t: 饰有小手鼓的；伴铃鼓的

e.en: The dancers entered with {timbreled} music.
e.zh: 舞者随着伴有铃鼓的音乐入场。

e.en: A {timbreled} procession crossed the square.
e.zh: 一支有小手鼓伴奏的队伍穿过广场。

timbrelled.t: 饰有小手鼓的；伴铃鼓的

e.en: The village held a {timbrelled} celebration at dusk.
e.zh: 村里在黄昏举行了有铃鼓伴奏的庆典。

e.en: Her poem describes a {timbrelled} march.
e.zh: 她的诗描写了一场伴着小手鼓的行进。

e.en: Workers earned {time-and-a-half} on Sunday.
e.zh: 工人周日拿到一点五倍工资。

e.en: The contract promises {time-and-a-half} for overtime.
e.zh: 合同承诺加班按一点五倍工资支付。

e.en: The factory hired consultants for a {time-and-motion} study.
e.zh: 工厂聘请顾问做工时动作研究。

e.en: A {time-and-motion} analysis reduced wasted steps.
e.zh: 一次工时动作分析减少了多余步骤。

e.en: Sailors once checked noon by the harbor {time-ball}.
e.zh: 水手过去靠港口的报时球确认正午。

e.en: The restored {time-ball} drops every afternoon.
e.zh: 修复后的授时球每天下午落下报时。

e.en: The broker explained the risks of a {time-bargain}.
e.zh: 经纪人解释了定期买卖合约的风险。

e.en: A {time-bargain} fixed delivery for next month.
e.zh: 这份定期交易约定下月交割。

e.en: The oscilloscope needs a stable {time-base}.
e.zh: 示波器需要稳定的时基。

e.en: The video system uses a common {time-base}.
e.zh: 这个视频系统使用共同的时间基准。

e.en: Police found a {time-bomb} in the station.
e.zh: 警方在车站发现了一枚定时炸弹。

e.en: The debt problem became a political {time-bomb}.
e.zh: 债务问题成了政治上的巨大隐患。

e.en: Students buried a {time-capsule} under the schoolyard.
e.zh: 学生们把时间胶囊埋在校园地下。

e.en: The old apartment felt like a {time-capsule}.
e.zh: 那套旧公寓像是一件时代见证物。

e.en: Let's do a quick {time-check} before the meeting ends.
e.zh: 会议结束前我们快速核对一下时间。

e.en: The radio gave a {time-check} at midnight.
e.zh: 电台在午夜播报了报时提示。

e.en: The editor marked the scene with a {time-code}.
e.zh: 剪辑师用时间码标记了这个场景。

e.en: Each subtitle line includes a precise {time-code}.
e.zh: 每行字幕都包含精确的时间编码。

time-critical.t: 时间紧迫的；时效关键的

e.en: The hospital handles {time-critical} deliveries by helicopter.
e.zh: 医院用直升机处理时间紧迫的递送。

e.en: Backups are essential for {time-critical} systems.
e.zh: 备份对时效关键的系统至关重要。

e.en: The screen showed a {time-expired} parking notice.
e.zh: 屏幕显示停车时间已超时的通知。

e.en: A {time-expired} offer cannot be used online.
e.zh: 期限已满的优惠不能在线使用。

e.en: We need a realistic {time-frame} for the repairs.
e.zh: 我们需要一个现实的维修期限。

e.en: The study covers a ten-year {time-frame}.
e.zh: 这项研究涵盖十年的时间范围。

e.en: There was a long {time-gap} between the two calls.
e.zh: 两通电话之间隔了很长时间。

e.en: The {time-gap} made the witness less certain.
e.zh: 时间差让证人的把握变小了。

time-honored.t: 历史悠久的；久经认可的

e.en: They followed a {time-honored} family tradition.
e.zh: 他们遵循了历史悠久的家族传统。

e.en: Negotiation is a {time-honored} way to avoid conflict.
e.zh: 谈判是避免冲突的久经认可的方法。

time-honoured.t: 历史悠久的；久经认可的

e.en: The ceremony preserved a {time-honoured} custom.
e.zh: 这场仪式保留了一项历史悠久的习俗。

e.en: She used the {time-honoured} method of slow cooking.
e.zh: 她采用了久经认可的慢炖方法。

e.en: Investors should choose a realistic {time-horizon}.
e.zh: 投资者应选择现实的规划期。

e.en: The policy has a twenty-year {time-horizon}.
e.zh: 这项政策的时间跨度为二十年。

e.en: The referee asked the {time-keeper} to stop the clock.
e.zh: 裁判让计时员停表。

e.en: My grandfather was a strict {time-keeper}.
e.zh: 我祖父是个非常守时的人。

e.en: There is a slight {time-lag} in the video call.
e.zh: 视频通话里有一点时间延迟。

e.en: Policy effects often appear after a {time-lag}.
e.zh: 政策效果往往会在一段滞后后才显现。

e.en: The film used {time-lapse} to show the flower opening.
e.zh: 影片用延时摄影展示花朵开放。

e.en: A {time-lapse} sequence captured the city at night.
e.zh: 一段延时画面记录了夜晚的城市。

e.en: Draw a {time-line} of the main events.
e.zh: 画一条主要事件的时间线。

e.en: The project {time-line} changed after the delay.
e.zh: 项目时间表在延期后发生了变化。

e.en: Traffic depends on the {time-of-day}.
e.zh: 交通状况取决于一天中的时段。

e.en: The watch shows the {time-of-day} and the date.
e.zh: 这块表显示钟点和日期。

e.en: The bell rang {tinily} in the distance.
e.zh: 远处的铃声细小地响着。

e.en: She wrote {tinily} in the margin.
e.zh: 她在页边写得很小。

e.en: The {tininess} of the apartment surprised us.
e.zh: 这套公寓的小得惊人让我们很意外。

e.en: He noticed the {tininess} of the printed warning.
e.zh: 他注意到那条印刷警告字很小。

e.en: The merchant sold {tinkal} to glassmakers.
e.zh: 商人把粗硼砂卖给玻璃匠。

e.en: Old chemistry books mention {tinkal} as a borax source.
e.zh: 旧化学书把天然硼砂列为硼砂来源。

e.en: The village {tinman} repaired the leaking kettle.
e.zh: 村里的锡匠修好了漏水的水壶。

e.en: A traveling {tinman} sold pans door to door.
e.zh: 一个流动锡器商挨家挨户卖锅。

e.en: The {tinmen} worked beside the furnace all morning.
e.zh: 锡匠们整个上午都在炉旁干活。

e.en: Several {tinmen} carried their wares through the market.
e.zh: 几个锡器商带着货物穿过市场。

e.en: The {tinner} covered the sheet with a bright coating.
e.zh: 镀锡工给金属片覆上了一层亮亮的锡。

e.en: A Cornish {tinner} knew the old mines well.
e.zh: 一名康沃尔锡矿工很熟悉那些老矿井。

e.en: The old {tinnery} closed after the ore ran out.
e.zh: 矿石耗尽后，那座老锡矿场关闭了。

e.en: Smoke rose from the {tinnery} near the river.
e.zh: 河边的炼锡厂升起了烟。

tinnient.t: 发丁当声的；清脆作响的

e.en: A {tinnient} note came from the tiny bell.
e.zh: 小铃传来一声清脆的丁当响。

e.en: The poet loved the {tinnient} music of coins.
e.zh: 诗人喜欢硬币那种丁当作响的声音。

tinnier.t: 更细薄刺耳的；更像锡的

e.en: This speaker sounds {tinnier} than the old one.
e.zh: 这个扬声器听起来比旧的更尖薄刺耳。

e.en: The cheap cup felt {tinnier} in my hand.
e.zh: 这个廉价杯子拿在手里更像薄锡做的。

tinniest.t: 最细薄刺耳的；最像锡的

e.en: The {tinniest} radio still picked up the news.
e.zh: 那台声音最单薄的小收音机仍能收到新闻。

e.en: It was the {tinniest} little bell in the shop.
e.zh: 那是店里最小最清脆的铃。

e.en: The song played {tinnily} from his phone.
e.zh: 那首歌从他的手机里尖薄地播放出来。

e.en: Coins rattled {tinnily} in the metal box.
e.zh: 硬币在金属盒里丁当作响。

e.en: The recording had an unpleasant {tinniness}.
e.zh: 这段录音有一种难听的尖薄感。

e.en: The {tinniness} of the toy trumpet made us laugh.
e.zh: 玩具小号那种刺耳的薄金属声让我们笑了。

tinpot.t: 小而差劲的；微不足道的

e.en: He ruled a {tinpot} dictatorship for years.
e.zh: 他统治着一个小而糟糕的独裁政权多年。

e.en: They dismissed it as a {tinpot} local club.
e.zh: 他们把它看作一个不起眼的地方小俱乐部。

e.en: They {tinsell} the stage before every holiday show.
e.zh: 每次节日演出前，他们都会用闪亮饰物装饰舞台。

e.en: Cheap praise can {tinsell} a weak argument.
e.zh: 廉价的赞美可以给薄弱的论点镀上一层虚光。

e.en: Use {tinsnips} to cut the metal sheet.
e.zh: 用铁皮剪来剪这张金属薄板。

e.en: The roofer kept his {tinsnips} on his belt.
e.zh: 屋顶工把白铁剪挂在腰带上。

e.en: Miners searched the stream for {tinstone}.
e.zh: 矿工们在溪流里寻找锡石。

e.en: The museum displayed a dark piece of {tinstone}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块深色锡矿石。

e.en: She fixed the label with a {tintack}.
e.zh: 她用一枚小平头钉固定标签。

e.en: A loose {tintack} lay on the workshop floor.
e.zh: 一枚松落的小钉子躺在工坊地板上。

e.en: He bought {tintacks} for the notice board.
e.zh: 他给公告板买了些图钉。

e.en: The box of {tintacks} spilled across the desk.
e.zh: 一盒小平头钉洒满了桌面。

e.en: The painter adjusted the {tintage} of the sky.
e.zh: 画家调整了天空的色调。

e.en: A faint blue {tintage} softened the photograph.
e.zh: 淡淡的蓝色色调让照片显得柔和。

e.en: The choir entered with a {tintinnabular} shimmer.
e.zh: 合唱团一开声便带着铃声般的颤亮。

e.en: Her poem is full of {tintinnabular} phrases.
e.zh: 她的诗里满是丁当作响般的词句。

e.en: The composer wanted a {tintinnabulary} effect.
e.zh: 作曲家想要一种铃声般的效果。

e.en: Its {tintinnabulary} rhythm echoed through the hall.
e.zh: 它丁当作响的节奏在大厅里回荡。

e.en: The {tintinnabulation} of bells filled the square.
e.zh: 钟铃的丁当声充满了广场。

e.en: Poe praised the {tintinnabulation} that swells from bells.
e.zh: 坡赞美从铃中渐渐涌出的丁当声。

e.en: The farmer kept rainwater in a large {tinaja} beside the house.
e.zh: 农民把雨水储存在屋旁一个大陶罐里。

e.en: A cracked {tinaja} stood in the museum courtyard.
e.zh: 一个有裂纹的大陶罐立在博物馆庭院里。

e.en: A shy {tinamou} moved quietly through the grass.
e.zh: 一只胆小的䳍形鸟悄悄穿过草丛。

e.en: The guide identified the call as a {tinamou} in the forest.
e.zh: 向导认出那叫声来自林中的一只䳍形鸟。

e.en: The old trade route carried {tincal} from desert deposits.
e.zh: 那条古老商路把沙漠矿床中的天然硼砂运出。

e.en: Chemists once purified {tincal} to make borax for industry.
e.zh: 化学家曾提纯粗硼砂，用来制造工业硼砂。

e.en: She opened a {tincan} of beans for dinner.
e.zh: 她晚饭开了一只豆子锡罐。

e.en: The sailor joked that their old boat was only a {tincan}.
e.zh: 水手开玩笑说他们那条旧船不过是只破铁罐。

e.en: The roof had a {tinclad} surface that flashed in the sun.
e.zh: 屋顶有一层包锡表面，在阳光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: They stored the documents in a {tinclad} chest.
e.zh: 他们把文件存放在一个镀锡箱子里。

e.en: The evening light seemed to {tinct} the clouds with gold.
e.zh: 傍晚的光像是把云朵染成了金色。

e.en: A faint bitterness {tincts} the sweetness of the drink.
e.zh: 一丝苦味给这饮料的甜味添了点变化。

e.en: Her scarf was {tincted} with a pale blue dye.
e.zh: 她的围巾被淡蓝色染料染上了颜色。

e.en: The story is {tincted} with regret and quiet anger.
e.zh: 这个故事带着遗憾和压抑的怒意。

e.en: The artist was {tincting} the paper with diluted ink.
e.zh: 画家正用稀释墨水给纸张着色。

e.en: Fear was {tincting} every decision they made that night.
e.zh: 恐惧影响着他们那晚作出的每一个决定。

e.en: The fabric showed a delicate {tinction} after one wash.
e.zh: 这块布洗过一次后呈现出细腻的色调。

e.en: His praise carried a slight {tinction} of envy.
e.zh: 他的赞美里带着一丝嫉妒的味道。

e.en: The lab measured the {tinctorial} strength of the new dye.
e.zh: 实验室测量了这种新染料的着色强度。

e.en: Certain minerals have strong {tinctorial} properties in glassmaking.
e.zh: 某些矿物在玻璃制造中有很强的染色特性。

e.en: The two pigments behaved differently {tinctorially} in the test.
e.zh: 这两种颜料在测试中的染色表现不同。

e.en: The compound is weak {tinctorially} but useful as a stabilizer.
e.zh: 这种化合物着色力较弱，但可用作稳定剂。

e.en: A red glow {tincts} the river at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时一片红光给河面染上颜色。

e.en: Personal grief {tincts} many passages in the memoir.
e.zh: 个人悲痛给这本回忆录的许多段落染上了色彩。

e.en: A single spark can {tind} dry straw in seconds.
e.zh: 一点火星几秒内就能点燃干稻草。

e.en: His speech helped {tind} anger among the workers.
e.zh: 他的演讲激起了工人们的怒气。

e.en: The cabinet was made from dark, polished {tindalo}.
e.zh: 这个柜子由深色抛光的菲律宾硬木制成。

e.en: Builders valued {tindalo} for its strength and rich color.
e.zh: 建筑工看重菲律宾硬木的强度和浓郁色泽。

e.en: The forest floor was dry and {tindery} after weeks without rain.
e.zh: 数周无雨后，森林地面干燥得很易燃。

e.en: He touched the {tindery} bark and it crumbled in his hand.
e.zh: 他摸了摸那像火绒般的树皮，它在手中碎开。

e.en: A small {tineid} damaged the wool coat in storage.
e.zh: 一只小谷蛾科昆虫在储藏时蛀坏了羊毛大衣。

e.en: The museum traps showed a rise in {tineid} activity.
e.zh: 博物馆的诱捕器显示谷蛾科昆虫活动增加。

e.en: She poured a {tinful} of paint into the tray.
e.zh: 她把一罐油漆倒进托盘里。

e.en: A {tinful} of nails spilled across the workshop floor.
e.zh: 一罐钉子撒满了车间地板。

e.en: We heard a {ting-a-ling} as the shop door opened.
e.zh: 店门打开时，我们听见一声叮铃响。

e.en: The bicycle bell went {ting-a-ling} behind us.
e.zh: 自行车铃在我们身后叮铃叮铃地响。

e.en: The paper described {tingitamine} as an alkaloid from woad.
e.zh: 论文把菘蓝碱描述为来自菘蓝的一种生物碱。

e.en: Researchers isolated {tingitamine} during the plant extract analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员在植物提取物分析中分离出菘蓝碱。

e.en: The stove window used thin {tinglass} instead of ordinary glass.
e.zh: 炉窗使用薄云母片，而不是普通玻璃。

e.en: Miners sold sheets of {tinglass} for lanterns and small windows.
e.zh: 矿工出售云母片，用于灯笼和小窗。

e.en: The town dismissed him as a {tinhorn} politician with big promises.
e.zh: 镇民把他看作只会夸口的三流政客。

e.en: A {tinhorn} gambler tried to impress everyone at the table.
e.zh: 一个装腔作势的小赌徒想在牌桌上震住所有人。

e.en: The old {tillmen} worked the heavy soil before dawn.
e.zh: 那些老农夫在黎明前耕作沉重的土地。

e.en: Medieval {tillmen} depended on the weather for survival.
e.zh: 中世纪的耕作者靠天气维持生计。

tilloid.t: 像钱箱的；似柜台抽屉的

e.en: The antique desk had a {tilloid} compartment under the lid.
e.zh: 那张古董书桌盖子下面有个像钱箱的隔层。

e.en: He described the device as {tilloid} in shape.
e.zh: 他把这个装置的形状描述为类似钱箱。

e.en: The {tilt-rotor} aircraft lifted off like a helicopter.
e.zh: 那架倾转旋翼飞机像直升机一样起飞。

e.en: Engineers tested a new {tilt-rotor} design in strong winds.
e.zh: 工程师在强风中测试一种新的倾转旋翼设计。

e.en: The crew used a {tiltdozer} to shape the roadside ditch.
e.zh: 施工队用可倾铲推土机修整路边沟渠。

e.en: A {tiltdozer} can angle its blade for rough grading.
e.zh: 可倾铲推土机能调整铲刀角度来做粗平整。

e.en: The volcano observatory installed a {tiltmeter} near the crater.
e.zh: 火山观测站在火山口附近安装了倾斜仪。

e.en: A sensitive {tiltmeter} recorded movement in the dam wall.
e.zh: 一台灵敏的测倾计记录到坝墙的位移。

e.en: Crowds gathered around the {tiltyard} for the joust.
e.zh: 人群聚集在骑士比武场周围观看马上长枪比武。

e.en: The castle's old {tiltyard} is now a quiet lawn.
e.zh: 城堡旧时的比武场如今成了一片安静的草坪。

e.en: The percussionist struck the {timbal} with a quick roll.
e.zh: 打击乐手用快速滚奏敲响了小定音鼓。

e.en: The chef served a crab {timbal} with herbs.
e.zh: 厨师端上一份加香草的蟹肉模制馅饼。

e.en: We spotted a {timberdoodle} probing the wet leaves.
e.zh: 我们看见一只美洲丘鹬在湿叶间探食。

e.en: Hunters sometimes call the American woodcock a {timberdoodle}.
e.zh: 猎人有时把美洲丘鹬称作timberdoodle。

e.en: Only a {timberhead} would ignore that warning sign.
e.zh: 只有笨人才会无视那个警告标志。

e.en: The sailor cursed the broken {timberhead} on the deck.
e.zh: 水手咒骂甲板上坏掉的木桩头。

e.en: His {timberheaded} reply made the teacher sigh.
e.zh: 他那愚钝的回答让老师叹了口气。

e.en: It was a {timberheaded} plan from the start.
e.zh: 那从一开始就是个笨拙的计划。

e.en: The {timberjack} sharpened his saw before sunrise.
e.zh: 伐木工在日出前磨好了锯子。

e.en: A heavy {timberjack} dragged logs out of the forest.
e.zh: 一台重型林业机械把原木拖出森林。

e.en: The {timbermen} floated the logs downriver in spring.
e.zh: 伐木工人春天把原木顺河漂下去。

e.en: Local {timbermen} argued over the price of pine.
e.zh: 当地木材商为松木价格争论不休。

e.en: A pack of {timberwolves} crossed the snowy valley.
e.zh: 一群灰狼穿过积雪的山谷。

e.en: The reserve tracks {timberwolves} with radio collars.
e.zh: 保护区用无线电项圈追踪林狼。

e.en: The old bridge's {timberwork} needed careful repair.
e.zh: 那座老桥的木结构需要细致修复。

e.en: His finest {timberwork} appears in the chapel roof.
e.zh: 他最精湛的木工活体现在礼拜堂屋顶上。

e.en: The {timberyard} smelled of fresh pine after rain.
e.zh: 雨后木材场弥漫着新鲜松木的气味。

e.en: Trucks lined up outside the {timberyard} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时卡车在贮木场外排起了队。

e.en: The composer wanted a darker {timbral} color from the strings.
e.zh: 作曲家希望弦乐呈现更阴暗的音色。

e.en: Small {timbral} changes made the recording feel warmer.
e.zh: 细微的音质变化让录音听起来更温暖。

e.en: The new {time-table} starts on Monday.
e.zh: 新的时间表从星期一开始执行。

e.en: She checked the train {time-table} before leaving.
e.zh: 她出发前查看了火车时刻表。

e.en: We used a {time-tested} method to solve the problem.
e.zh: 我们用了久经考验的方法来解决这个问题。

e.en: Her advice was simple but {time-tested}.
e.zh: 她的建议很简单，但经得起时间检验。

e.en: The team reduced {time-to-market} by automating tests.
e.zh: 团队通过自动化测试缩短了产品上市时间。

e.en: Fast {time-to-market} can give a startup an advantage.
e.zh: 快速上市能给初创公司带来优势。

e.en: The model includes {time-varying} interest rates.
e.zh: 这个模型包含随时间变化的利率。

e.en: Engineers measured the {time-varying} signal every second.
e.zh: 工程师每秒测量一次随时间变化的信号。

time-warped.t: 时间扭曲的；变形老旧的

e.en: The film follows a {time-warped} journey through history.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一段穿越历史的时间扭曲之旅。

e.en: The old boards looked {time-warped} and uneven.
e.zh: 那些旧木板看起来因岁月变形而高低不平。

e.en: That meeting was a complete {time-waster}.
e.zh: 那场会议完全是在浪费时间。

e.en: He called the game a harmless {time-waster}.
e.zh: 他说这个游戏只是个无伤大雅的消遣。

e.en: Stop those {time-wasting} arguments and decide.
e.zh: 别再进行那些浪费时间的争论了，赶紧决定吧。

e.en: The manager removed several {time-wasting} steps from the process.
e.zh: 经理删掉了流程中几个耗时无用的步骤。

e.en: He repeated the same {time-worn} excuses.
e.zh: 他又重复了那些老掉牙的借口。

e.en: The cottage had a {time-worn} wooden door.
e.zh: 那间小屋有一扇饱经岁月的木门。

e.en: We live in a different {time-zone} now.
e.zh: 我们现在住在不同的时区。

e.en: Check the {time-zone} before scheduling the call.
e.zh: 安排电话会议前先确认时区。

e.en: The editor wrote down the exact {timecode}.
e.zh: 剪辑师记下了准确的时间码。

e.en: Each subtitle line has its own {timecode}.
e.zh: 每一行字幕都有自己的时间码。

e.en: They followed a {timehonored} family tradition.
e.zh: 他们遵循了一项历史悠久的家族传统。

e.en: The ceremony used a {timehonored} form of greeting.
e.zh: 仪式采用了一种传统而受尊重的问候方式。

e.en: The report requires {timeous} submission to the office.
e.zh: 这份报告需要及时提交给办公室。

e.en: Her {timeous} warning prevented a serious mistake.
e.zh: 她及时发出警告，避免了严重错误。

e.en: Please respond {timeously} to the request.
e.zh: 请及时回复这项请求。

e.en: The documents were filed {timeously} by the clerk.
e.zh: 文件由职员及时归档。

e.en: The coach used both {timeouts} before halftime.
e.zh: 教练在半场前用掉了两次暂停。

e.en: Network {timeouts} caused the upload to fail.
e.zh: 网络超时导致上传失败。

e.en: Critics called him a {timepleaser} with no principles.
e.zh: 批评者说他是个没有原则、只讨好时代潮流的人。

e.en: The essay attacks the {timepleaser} in modern politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了现代政治中迎合时势的人。

timesaver.t: 节省时间的工具或做法

e.en: This template is a real {timesaver}.
e.zh: 这个模板确实很省时间。

e.en: A dishwasher can be a useful {timesaver}.
e.zh: 洗碗机可以是很有用的省时工具。

e.en: The app offers several {timesaving} features.
e.zh: 这个应用提供了几项节省时间的功能。

e.en: She taught us a {timesaving} way to prepare meals.
e.zh: 她教了我们一种省时的备餐方法。

timeserver.t: 趋炎附势者；时间服务器

e.en: The senator was dismissed as a {timeserver}.
e.zh: 那位参议员被斥为趋炎附势的人。

e.en: The device checks a {timeserver} every night.
e.zh: 这台设备每晚都会校对时间服务器。

timeservers.t: 趋炎附势者；时间服务器

e.en: The reform exposed several political {timeservers}.
e.zh: 这场改革暴露了几个政治上的趋炎附势者。

e.en: Our computers sync with external {timeservers}.
e.zh: 我们的电脑会与外部时间服务器同步。

timeserving.t: 趋炎附势的；迎合时势的

e.en: His {timeserving} speeches changed with every election.
e.zh: 他那些迎合时势的演讲每逢选举就变。

e.en: The article mocked the party's {timeserving} policy.
e.zh: 文章嘲讽了该党趋炎附势的政策。

e.en: Please submit your {timesheet} by Friday.
e.zh: 请在星期五前提交你的工时表。

e.en: The accountant checked each {timesheet} for errors.
e.zh: 会计检查了每张工时表是否有错误。

e.en: I booked a morning {timeslot} for the interview.
e.zh: 我为面试预约了上午的时段。

e.en: The show moved to a later {timeslot}.
e.zh: 这个节目被调到了更晚的播出时段。

e.en: Each message includes a {timestamp}.
e.zh: 每条消息都包含一个时间戳。

e.en: The system will {timestamp} every uploaded file.
e.zh: 系统会给每个上传的文件加上时间戳。

e.en: The word {timetalbe} is a common typo.
e.zh: timetalbe 这个词是一个常见拼写错误。

e.en: She wrote {timetalbe} instead of timetable.
e.zh: 她把 timetable 错写成了 timetalbe。

e.en: The company relied on a {timetested} strategy.
e.zh: 公司依靠一种久经考验的策略。

e.en: His {timetested} approach still works well.
e.zh: 他那套经得起时间检验的方法仍然很有效。

e.en: She took two days of {time-off} after the project ended.
e.zh: 项目结束后，她休了两天假。

e.en: Employees must request {time-off} through the online system.
e.zh: 员工必须通过网上系统申请休假。

e.en: The coach called a {time-out} before the final play.
e.zh: 最后一次进攻前，教练叫了暂停。

e.en: The child needed a short {time-out} to calm down.
e.zh: 那个孩子需要短暂独处一下，好冷静下来。

e.en: The model compares each {time-path} of the particle.
e.zh: 该模型会比较粒子的每条时间路径。

e.en: Engineers traced the {time-path} through the timing circuit.
e.zh: 工程师追踪了定时电路中的时序路径。

e.en: The study covered a ten-year {time-period}.
e.zh: 这项研究涵盖了十年的时间段。

e.en: Prices changed sharply during that {time-period}.
e.zh: 在那个时期，价格变化很剧烈。

e.en: The medicine uses a {time-release} coating.
e.zh: 这种药采用定时释放的包衣。

e.en: A {time-release} capsule can work throughout the night.
e.zh: 缓释胶囊可以整夜发挥作用。

e.en: The template is a real {time-saver} for weekly reports.
e.zh: 这个模板对写周报来说真的很省时间。

e.en: Using frozen vegetables can be a useful {time-saver}.
e.zh: 使用冷冻蔬菜可以是个很省事的办法。

e.en: The app includes several {time-saving} features.
e.zh: 这个应用包含几项节省时间的功能。

e.en: She shared a {time-saving} method for cleaning the kitchen.
e.zh: 她分享了一种省时的厨房清洁方法。

e.en: The software handles {time-sequencing} for the animation frames.
e.zh: 这个软件负责动画帧的时间排序。

e.en: Good {time-sequencing} helps students understand historical events.
e.zh: 良好的时序安排有助于学生理解历史事件。

e.en: We analyzed a {time-series} of daily temperatures.
e.zh: 我们分析了一组每日气温的时间序列。

e.en: The chart shows {time-series} data for online sales.
e.zh: 这张图显示了网上销售的时间序列数据。

e.en: Each computer checks the {time-server} once an hour.
e.zh: 每台电脑每小时都会校对一次时间服务器。

e.en: A faulty {time-server} caused the logs to show wrong dates.
e.zh: 时间服务器故障导致日志显示了错误日期。

time-serving.t: 趋炎附势的；投机迎合的

e.en: The senator gave a {time-serving} speech before the election.
e.zh: 那位参议员在选举前发表了一番投机迎合的演讲。

e.en: His {time-serving} attitude made colleagues distrust him.
e.zh: 他趋炎附势的态度让同事们不信任他。

e.en: They bought a {time-share} near the beach.
e.zh: 他们在海边买了一处分时度假房产。

e.en: The resort tried to sell us a {time-share}.
e.zh: 那家度假村想向我们推销分时度假房产。

e.en: Many {time-shares} come with yearly maintenance fees.
e.zh: 许多分时度假房产都要缴纳年度维护费。

e.en: They compared several {time-shares} before choosing one.
e.zh: 他们比较了几处分时度假房产后才选定一处。

e.en: Early computers used {time-sharing} to serve many users.
e.zh: 早期计算机通过分时使用来服务多个用户。

e.en: The couple regretted joining a {time-sharing} vacation plan.
e.zh: 这对夫妇后悔参加了分时度假的计划。

e.en: Please submit your {time-sheet} by Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 请在周五下午前提交你的工时表。

e.en: The manager checked every {time-sheet} before approving pay.
e.zh: 经理在批准工资前核对了每张考勤表。

e.en: The editor used a {time-shift} to align the audio.
e.zh: 编辑使用时间平移来对齐音频。

e.en: Viewers can {time-shift} the program and watch it later.
e.zh: 观众可以时移该节目，之后再观看。

e.en: Modern recorders make {time-shifting} television programs easy.
e.zh: 现代录像设备让电视节目的时移播放变得很方便。

e.en: The software supports {time-shifting} of multiple audio tracks.
e.zh: 该软件支持多条音轨的时间平移。

e.en: The radio station broadcasts a {time-signal} at noon.
e.zh: 这家电台在中午播出报时信号。

e.en: The device uses a satellite {time-signal} for accuracy.
e.zh: 该设备利用卫星时间信号来保证准确。

e.en: This song has a 3/4 {time-signature}.
e.zh: 这首歌的拍号是四三拍。

e.en: The drummer struggled with the unusual {time-signature}.
e.zh: 鼓手很难适应这个不寻常的拍号。

e.en: The project had a short {time-span} of six weeks.
e.zh: 这个项目的时间跨度很短，只有六周。

e.en: Over that {time-span}, the city grew rapidly.
e.zh: 在那段期间，这座城市发展迅速。

e.en: Each message includes a {time-stamp} showing when it was sent.
e.zh: 每条消息都带有显示发送时间的时间戳。

e.en: The camera can {time-stamp} every photo automatically.
e.zh: 这台相机可以自动给每张照片加时间戳。

e.en: The files were {time-stamped} when they reached the server.
e.zh: 这些文件到达服务器时都被加上了时间戳。

e.en: We kept a {time-stamped} record of every change.
e.zh: 我们保存了每次修改的带时间戳记录。

e.en: Automatic {time-stamping} makes the audit trail clearer.
e.zh: 自动加时间戳让审计记录更清楚。

e.en: The app supports {time-stamping} for voice notes.
e.zh: 这个应用支持给语音笔记加时间戳。

e.en: The simulation advances one {time-step} at a time.
e.zh: 模拟程序每次推进一个时间步。

e.en: A smaller {time-step} can improve numerical accuracy.
e.zh: 较小的时间步长可以提高数值精度。

e.en: The heater is controlled by a {time-switch}.
e.zh: 这台取暖器由定时开关控制。

e.en: Install a {time-switch} to turn the lights off automatically.
e.zh: 安装一个定时开关，让灯自动关闭。

timework.t: 按工时计酬的工作或制度

e.en: The factory still used {timework} for older contracts.
e.zh: 这家工厂仍对旧合同采用按工时计酬的制度。

e.en: He preferred {timework} to piecework because the pay was steadier.
e.zh: 他更喜欢按工时计酬而不是计件，因为收入更稳定。

e.en: A {timeworker} is paid for hours rather than output.
e.zh: 按工时计酬的工人按工作时间而不是产量拿工资。

e.en: The union defended the rights of every {timeworker}.
e.zh: 工会维护每一名按工时计酬工人的权利。

timeworks.t: 按工时计酬工作复数或动词

e.en: The old payroll file lists several kinds of {timeworks}.
e.zh: 旧工资档案列出了几种按工时计酬的工作。

e.en: She {timeworks} at the mill during the busy season.
e.zh: 旺季时她在磨坊做按工时计酬的活。

e.en: Singapore is in the same {timezone} as Beijing.
e.zh: 新加坡和北京在同一个时区。

e.en: Check the meeting {timezone} before you join the call.
e.zh: 加入电话会议前先确认会议的时区。

e.en: The philosopher was called a {timist} by his critics.
e.zh: 批评者称这位哲学家是把时间视为根本的人。

e.en: As a {timist}, she argued that change defines reality.
e.zh: 作为时间本位论者，她认为变化界定了现实。

timocracy.t: 由有产者或重荣誉者统治

e.en: Plato described {timocracy} as rule by honor-loving soldiers.
e.zh: 柏拉图把重荣誉者的统治描述为荣誉政体。

e.en: In a strict {timocracy}, political power depends on property.
e.zh: 在严格的财产资格政体中，政治权力取决于财产。

timocratic.t: 财产资格统治的；重荣誉的

e.en: The city adopted a {timocratic} constitution after the war.
e.zh: 战后这座城市采用了按财产资格分配权力的宪法。

e.en: His values were proudly {timocratic}, centered on honor and rank.
e.zh: 他的价值观明显重视荣誉与等级，带有荣誉政体色彩。

timocratical.t: 财产资格统治的；重荣誉的

e.en: The historian used the older word {timocratical} in her essay.
e.zh: 这位历史学家在论文中使用了较旧的“财产资格统治的”一词。

e.en: Their laws reflected a {timocratical} view of citizenship.
e.zh: 他们的法律体现了按财产和荣誉划分公民身份的观点。

e.en: A {timous} warning saved the crew from danger.
e.zh: 一次及时的警告使船员避开了危险。

e.en: The judge praised the {timous} filing of the appeal.
e.zh: 法官称赞上诉提交得很及时。

timpano.t: 定音鼓；意式鼓形烤面食

e.en: The orchestra added a deep {timpano} roll.
e.zh: 管弦乐队加入了一段低沉的定音鼓滚奏。

e.en: She baked a huge {timpano} filled with pasta and sauce.
e.zh: 她烤了一个巨大的意式鼓形面食，里面塞满意面和酱汁。

e.en: His article on {timpanology} discussed diseases of the eardrum.
e.zh: 他关于鼓膜学的文章讨论了鼓膜疾病。

e.en: The music course included a lecture on {timpanology}.
e.zh: 这门音乐课程包括一堂关于定音鼓研究的讲座。

e.en: We need a {tin-opener} for the beans.
e.zh: 我们需要一个开罐器来打开豆子罐头。

e.en: The camping kit includes a small {tin-opener}.
e.zh: 露营工具包里有一个小开罐器。

e.en: The cook grabbed a dented {tin-pan} from the shelf.
e.zh: 厨师从架子上拿起一个凹陷的锡锅。

e.en: The old piano had a {tin-pan} sound.
e.zh: 那架旧钢琴发出廉价而刺耳的声音。

e.en: The box was made from bright {tin-plate}.
e.zh: 这个盒子是用亮亮的镀锡铁皮做成的。

e.en: Workers {tin-plate} the steel to prevent rust.
e.zh: 工人给钢材镀锡以防生锈。

tin-pot.t: 微不足道的；廉价小气的

e.en: The country was ruled by a {tin-pot} dictator.
e.zh: 这个国家由一个小气又无足轻重的独裁者统治。

e.en: He refused to join their {tin-pot} little club.
e.zh: 他拒绝加入他们那个不入流的小俱乐部。

e.en: She {tittle-tattled} about every neighbor on the street.
e.zh: 她把街上每个邻居的闲话都说了一遍。

e.en: The children {tittle-tattled} instead of finishing their work.
e.zh: 孩子们没有完成作业，反而在闲聊。

e.en: He {tittle-tattles} whenever the office gets quiet.
e.zh: 办公室一安静下来，他就开始说闲话。

e.en: Her letters were full of village {tittle-tattles}.
e.zh: 她的信里满是村里的流言琐事。

tittle-tattling.t: 闲聊；搬弄是非；说三道四

e.en: Stop {tittle-tattling} and tell me what really happened.
e.zh: 别再说闲话了，告诉我到底发生了什么。

e.en: The report dismissed the rumors as mere {tittle-tattling}.
e.zh: 报告把那些传闻斥为纯粹的闲言碎语。

e.en: A {tittlebat} flickered under the bridge at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，一只小蝙蝠在桥下掠过。

e.en: The boy tried to catch a {tittlebat} in the shallow stream.
e.zh: 男孩想在浅溪里抓一条小鱼。

e.en: The pony began to {tittup} across the field.
e.zh: 小马开始轻快地小跑穿过田野。

e.en: She walked with a cheerful {tittup} in her step.
e.zh: 她走路时步子轻快，带着愉快的跳动感。

e.en: The horse seemed to {tittupp} along the lane.
e.zh: 那匹马似乎沿着小路轻快地小跑。

e.en: He made the puppet {tittupp} across the tiny stage.
e.zh: 他让木偶在小舞台上轻快地跳动。

e.en: The mare {tittupped} proudly past the gate.
e.zh: 母马神气地小跑着经过大门。

e.en: She {tittupped} down the steps in new shoes.
e.zh: 她穿着新鞋轻快地跳下台阶。

e.en: The foal was {tittupping} beside its mother.
e.zh: 小马驹正挨着母马轻快地小跑。

e.en: Her {tittupping} walk made everyone notice her mood.
e.zh: 她那轻快跳跃的步态让大家都看出她心情不错。

e.en: The dog had a {tittuppy} little run.
e.zh: 那只狗跑起来有点轻快蹦跳。

e.en: His {tittuppy} manner seemed oddly old-fashioned.
e.zh: 他那种蹦跳般的举止显得有些古怪而老派。

e.en: The pony {tittups} whenever it hears the bell.
e.zh: 小马一听见铃声就轻快地小跑起来。

e.en: Her voice {tittups} through the song playfully.
e.zh: 她的嗓音在歌里俏皮地跳动着。

e.en: After the illness, he began to {titubate} while walking.
e.zh: 病后，他走路开始摇晃蹒跚。

e.en: The doctor watched the patient {titubate} across the room.
e.zh: 医生看着病人踉跄地走过房间。

e.en: The examination revealed slight {titubation} of the head.
e.zh: 检查发现他的头部有轻微摇晃。

e.en: Persistent {titubation} made walking difficult for her.
e.zh: 持续的身体摇晃让她走路很困难。

titularies.t: 有名无实的职位；头衔持有者

e.en: The court kept several {titularies} with no real authority.
e.zh: 宫廷保留了几个没有实权的头衔职位。

e.en: Ancient {titularies} still appeared in the ceremony.
e.zh: 古老的头衔持有者仍出现在仪式中。

titularity.t: 有名无实；名义上的地位

e.en: His power was reduced to mere {titularity}.
e.zh: 他的权力被削弱到只剩名义地位。

e.en: The office carried honor but also a sense of {titularity}.
e.zh: 这个职位有荣誉，却也带着有名无实的意味。

e.en: The riders came {tivy} down the hill.
e.zh: 骑手们飞快地冲下山坡。

e.en: He drove {tivy} through the rain to reach home.
e.zh: 他冒雨急速开车回家。

e.en: The villagers brewed {tizwin} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 村民们为仪式酿造了玉米发酵酒。

e.en: He tasted {tizwin} during his travels in the Southwest.
e.zh: 他在美国西南部旅行时尝过玉米发酵酒。

e.en: She was in a {tizz} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前她紧张得有些慌乱。

e.en: The missing keys put him into a {tizz}.
e.zh: 钥匙不见了，让他一下子慌了神。

e.en: The road cracked when the {tjaele} thawed in spring.
e.zh: 春天冻土层融化时，道路开裂了。

e.en: Engineers studied the {tjaele} before building the pipeline.
e.zh: 工程师在建管道前研究了那里的冻土层。

e.en: A restored {tjalk} sailed slowly along the canal.
e.zh: 一艘修复过的荷兰平底帆船沿运河缓缓航行。

e.en: The museum displayed a model of a trading {tjalk}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘贸易用荷兰平底帆船模型。

e.en: The {tjotter} carried two sailors across the lake.
e.zh: 那艘荷兰小帆船载着两名水手穿过湖面。

e.en: He painted a red {tjotter} moored by the quay.
e.zh: 他画了一艘停在码头边的红色荷兰小帆船。

e.en: The scholar identified a {tmema} in the ancient phrase.
e.zh: 学者在那句古语中辨认出一个插入成分。

e.en: A {tmema} can split a word for rhetorical effect.
e.zh: 分割词段可以把一个词拆开以产生修辞效果。

e.en: The phrase uses {tmesis} for comic emphasis.
e.zh: 这个短语用插词法来制造喜剧性的强调。

e.en: In English, {tmesis} appears in expressions like abso-bloody-lutely.
e.zh: 在英语中，插词法会出现在像 abso-bloody-lutely 这样的表达里。

tipburn.t: 烟草叶尖烧焦病斑；尖端灼伤病

e.en: The farmer noticed {tipburn} on the tobacco leaves after the heat wave.
e.zh: 热浪过后，农民注意到烟草叶上出现了叶尖灼伤。

e.en: Calcium deficiency can cause {tipburn} in lettuce grown indoors.
e.zh: 缺钙会导致室内种植的生菜出现叶尖灼伤。

e.en: The workers loaded bricks into a wooden {tipcart}.
e.zh: 工人们把砖装进一辆木制翻斗车里。

e.en: A {tipcart} can unload soil by tilting its body backward.
e.zh: 翻斗车可以把车斗向后倾斜来卸土。

tipcat.t: 打短木棒游戏；游戏用短棒

e.en: The children played {tipcat} in the village lane.
e.zh: 孩子们在村巷里玩打短木棒游戏。

e.en: He carved a new {tipcat} from a scrap of wood.
e.zh: 他用一块废木头削出了一根新的游戏短棒。

e.en: Police received a {tipoff} about the stolen car.
e.zh: 警方收到了一条关于被盗汽车的密报。

e.en: The crowd cheered before the opening {tipoff}.
e.zh: 开场跳球前，观众欢呼起来。

tippee.t: 收小费的人；受赠小费者

e.en: The {tippee} thanked the customer for the generous amount.
e.zh: 收小费的人感谢顾客给了这么大方的一笔钱。

e.en: A delivery driver is often the expected {tippee} after late-night service.
e.zh: 深夜送餐后，外卖司机常常是人们预期要给小费的对象。

e.en: The chair's {tippiness} made it unsafe for children.
e.zh: 这把椅子容易倾倒，对孩子来说不安全。

e.en: Engineers reduced the {tippiness} of the narrow boat.
e.zh: 工程师降低了这艘窄船的不稳当程度。

e.en: She crossed the room on {tippytoe} to avoid waking him.
e.zh: 她踮着脚穿过房间，以免把他吵醒。

e.en: The dancer balanced briefly on one {tippytoe}.
e.zh: 舞者短暂地用一只脚尖保持平衡。

e.en: He grew {tipsier} after the second glass of wine.
e.zh: 喝完第二杯酒后，他变得更有些醉意了。

e.en: The boat felt {tipsier} as the wind increased.
e.zh: 风越来越大时，这艘船显得更摇晃了。

e.en: She was the {tipsiest} guest at the party.
e.zh: 她是聚会上最有醉意的客人。

e.en: The old stool was the {tipsiest} seat in the kitchen.
e.zh: 那张旧凳子是厨房里最不稳的座位。

e.en: A small glass of sherry may {tipsify} an empty stomach.
e.zh: 空腹时一小杯雪利酒就可能让人微醉。

e.en: The warm room seemed to {tipsify} the tired guests.
e.zh: 温暖的房间似乎让疲惫的客人们有了醉意。

e.en: He laughed {tipsily} and spilled his drink.
e.zh: 他带着醉意笑了起来，还洒出了饮料。

e.en: The vase stood {tipsily} on the uneven shelf.
e.zh: 花瓶歪歪斜斜地立在不平的架子上。

e.en: Her slight {tipsiness} made her more talkative.
e.zh: 她微微有些醉意，因此话也多了起来。

e.en: The table's {tipsiness} worried the waiter.
e.zh: 这张桌子摇晃不稳，让服务员很担心。

e.en: The judge sent a {tipstaff} to summon the witness.
e.zh: 法官派了一名执达吏去传唤证人。

e.en: The officer carried a ceremonial {tipstaff} in court.
e.zh: 那名官员在法庭上持有一根礼仪执法杖。

e.en: Two {tipstaves} stood near the courtroom doors.
e.zh: 两名执达吏站在法庭门口附近。

e.en: The museum displayed old silver {tipstaves} used by court officers.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了法院官员曾使用的旧银质执法杖。

e.en: A slight {tiptilt} changed the angle of the lamp.
e.zh: 轻微的尖端倾斜改变了灯的角度。

e.en: The pilot corrected the aircraft's {tiptilt} during the test.
e.zh: 飞行员在测试中修正了飞机的俯仰倾斜。

e.en: I felt {tiredest} after the last exam.
e.zh: 最后一场考试后，我觉得最累。

e.en: The youngest child looked the {tiredest} on the long walk home.
e.zh: 回家的长路上，最小的孩子看起来最疲惫。

e.en: The queen's {tirewoman} arranged her hair before court.
e.zh: 王后的女侍妆者在上朝前为她整理头发。

e.en: An experienced {tirewoman} prepared the actress's costume backstage.
e.zh: 一位有经验的女服装侍从在后台为女演员准备服装。

e.en: The geologist identified {tirilite} in the dark rock sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在那块深色岩石样本中鉴定出了提里莱特矿。

e.en: A small crystal of {tirilite} was kept in the mineral collection.
e.zh: 一小块提里莱特矿晶体被收藏在矿物标本中。

tiring-house.t: 剧场后台更衣室；演员化装间

e.en: Actors waited in the {tiring-house} before the scene began.
e.zh: 场景开始前，演员们在后台更衣室等候。

e.en: The old play mentions a noisy {tiring-house} behind the stage.
e.zh: 那部旧剧提到舞台后面有一间嘈杂的演员化装间。

e.en: She left her cloak in the {tiring-room}.
e.zh: 她把斗篷留在了演员更衣室里。

e.en: The comedian paced in the {tiring-room} before going onstage.
e.zh: 上台前，那名喜剧演员在化装间里来回踱步。

e.en: The {tintinnabulations} of the bells filled the square.
e.zh: 铃铛的叮当声充满了广场。

e.en: She loved the soft {tintinnabulations} from the wind chimes.
e.zh: 她喜欢风铃发出的轻柔叮当声。

e.en: A {tintinnabulous} sound drifted from the chapel tower.
e.zh: 教堂塔楼传来一阵铃声般悦耳的声音。

e.en: The poet described the city as {tintinnabulous} at dawn.
e.zh: 诗人把黎明时的城市写得满是叮当铃响。

e.en: A bronze {tintinnabulum} hung above the doorway.
e.zh: 门口上方挂着一个青铜小铃。

e.en: The museum displayed a Roman {tintinnabulum} with tiny bells.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件带小铃的罗马护符铃饰。

e.en: The sample contained a tiny {tintinnid} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下的样本里有一只微小的钟虫类原生生物。

e.en: Marine biologists tracked {tintinnid} populations after the bloom.
e.zh: 海洋生物学家在藻华后追踪钟虫类种群。

e.en: The winter sky looked pale and {tintless}.
e.zh: 冬天的天空显得苍白而没有色彩。

e.en: Her photograph felt oddly {tintless} after the filter was removed.
e.zh: 滤镜去掉后，她的照片显得异常缺少色调。

e.en: The technician used a {tintometer} to compare the liquid samples.
e.zh: 技术员用色度计比较这些液体样本。

e.en: A {tintometer} helps measure slight changes in color.
e.zh: 测色仪有助于测量细微的颜色变化。

e.en: The glass had a {tinty} green edge in the sunlight.
e.zh: 阳光下，玻璃边缘带着淡淡的绿色。

e.en: Her watercolor style is soft, {tinty}, and delicate.
e.zh: 她的水彩风格柔和，色调轻淡而细腻。

e.en: The restorer matched the old frame with {tinwhite} paint.
e.zh: 修复师用锡白色颜料来匹配旧画框。

e.en: A thin {tinwhite} line brightened the edge of the design.
e.zh: 一道细细的锡白色线条让图案边缘更明亮。

e.en: The shop sold handmade {tinwork} from local artisans.
e.zh: 这家店出售当地工匠手工制作的锡制品。

e.en: He learned {tinwork} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里学会了锡器制作。

e.en: The old {tinworks} closed before the war.
e.zh: 那家老锡器厂在战前就关闭了。

e.en: Many families depended on the nearby {tinworks}.
e.zh: 许多家庭依靠附近的锡加工厂谋生。

tip-and-run.t: 短打快跑的；肇事逃逸式的

e.en: They played a {tip-and-run} shot to surprise the fielders.
e.zh: 他们打出一记短打快跑，让守场员措手不及。

e.en: The police investigated a {tip-and-run} accident downtown.
e.zh: 警方调查了市中心一起肇事逃逸式事故。

e.en: His last-second {tip-in} won the basketball game.
e.zh: 他最后一秒的补篮赢下了那场篮球赛。

e.en: The printer added a glossy {tip-in} to the book.
e.zh: 印刷厂给书中加了一张光面插页。

e.en: An anonymous {tip-off} led police to the warehouse.
e.zh: 一条匿名密报把警方引到了仓库。

e.en: The game begins with the {tip-off} at seven.
e.zh: 比赛在七点以跳球开场。

e.en: Several {tip-offs} helped investigators find the suspect.
e.zh: 几条密报帮助调查人员找到了嫌疑人。

e.en: The coach reviewed all the opening {tip-offs} from last season.
e.zh: 教练回顾了上赛季所有开场跳球。

tip-tilted.t: 尖端上翘的；微微倾斜的

e.en: She wore {tip-tilted} glasses on her nose.
e.zh: 她鼻梁上架着一副微微上翘的眼镜。

e.en: The bird's {tip-tilted} beak made it easy to identify.
e.zh: 这只鸟尖端上翘的喙让人很容易辨认。

e.en: Please {tip-toe} past the baby's room.
e.zh: 请踮着脚走过婴儿房。

e.en: She stood on {tip-toe} to reach the shelf.
e.zh: 她踮起脚尖去够架子。

e.en: He {tip-toed} across the hall at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时他踮着脚穿过走廊。

e.en: The children {tip-toed} into the kitchen for cookies.
e.zh: 孩子们踮着脚进厨房拿饼干。

e.en: The hotel service was absolutely {tip-top}.
e.zh: 这家酒店的服务绝对是一流的。

e.en: Keep the engine in {tip-top} condition.
e.zh: 要让发动机保持最佳状态。

e.en: He set a {tip-up} over the hole in the ice.
e.zh: 他在冰洞上方放好一个冰钓竿架。

e.en: The cinema installed {tip-up} seats to save space.
e.zh: 电影院安装了可翻起座椅来节省空间。

e.en: The {toastee} smiled as everyone raised a glass.
e.zh: 大家举杯时，那位被敬酒的人笑了。

e.en: At the dinner, the retiring professor was the honored {toastee}.
e.zh: 晚宴上，那位即将退休的教授是受敬酒祝贺的主角。

e.en: She ordered a cheese {toastie} for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐点了一个奶酪烤三明治。

e.en: The kitchen felt {toastie} after the oven had been on.
e.zh: 烤箱开了一会儿后，厨房变得暖烘烘的。

e.en: This room is {toastier} than the hallway.
e.zh: 这个房间比走廊更暖和。

e.en: Leave the bread in longer if you want it {toastier}.
e.zh: 如果你想让面包烤得更香，就多放一会儿。

e.en: He held the bread over the fire with a {toasting-fork}.
e.zh: 他用烤面包叉把面包举在火上烤。

e.en: The old kitchen still had an iron {toasting-fork} by the hearth.
e.zh: 那间老厨房的炉边还放着一把铁制烤面包叉。

e.en: The {toastmistress} introduced each speaker with wit.
e.zh: 女宴会主持人风趣地介绍了每位发言者。

e.en: As {toastmistress}, she kept the formal dinner moving smoothly.
e.zh: 作为女主持，她让这场正式晚宴顺利进行。

e.en: The waiter brought warm slices in a silver {toastrack}.
e.zh: 服务员用银色吐司架端来了热吐司片。

e.en: A {toastrack} keeps the toast crisp at breakfast.
e.zh: 早餐时，吐司架能让吐司保持酥脆。

e.en: The barn was built for {tobacco-curing} in late summer.
e.zh: 这座谷仓是为夏末烘烤调制烟叶而建的。

e.en: Poor {tobacco-curing} can ruin the flavor of the leaves.
e.zh: 烟叶调制不当会破坏叶子的风味。

e.en: The {tobaccoman} knew which pipe tobacco his customers preferred.
e.zh: 那位烟草商知道顾客喜欢哪种斗烟。

e.en: In the old novel, a cheerful {tobaccoman} runs the corner shop.
e.zh: 在那本老小说里，一个开朗的烟草店老板经营着街角小店。

e.en: The cement sample contained traces of {tobermorite}.
e.zh: 水泥样品中含有微量托勃莫来石。

e.en: Researchers studied {tobermorite} to understand ancient concrete.
e.zh: 研究人员研究托勃莫来石，以了解古代混凝土。

e.en: The {tobogganist} leaned forward as the sled gathered speed.
e.zh: 雪橇加速时，乘平底雪橇的人身体向前倾。

e.en: A careful {tobogganist} checks the hill before starting.
e.zh: 谨慎的平底雪橇手出发前会先查看坡道。

e.en: The child tried {tobreak} the stick across his knee.
e.zh: 那个孩子想用膝盖把木棍折断。

e.en: In old spelling, {tobreak} could mean to break apart.
e.zh: 在旧式拼写中，tobreak 可以表示把东西打破或拆开。

e.en: The organist opened the concert with a dramatic {toccata}.
e.zh: 管风琴师以一首气势强烈的托卡塔曲开场。

e.en: Her {toccata} demanded quick fingers and precise rhythm.
e.zh: 她演奏的托卡塔曲要求手指敏捷、节奏精准。

e.en: Bach's {toccatas} remain popular with organ students.
e.zh: 巴赫的托卡塔曲仍然很受管风琴学生欢迎。

e.en: The album collects several lively {toccatas} for harpsichord.
e.zh: 这张专辑收录了几首活泼的大键琴托卡塔曲。

e.en: Her family promised a generous {tocher} before the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼前，她家承诺给一份丰厚的嫁妆。

e.en: In that dialect, parents might {tocher} a daughter with land.
e.zh: 在那种方言里，父母可能会用土地给女儿作嫁妆。

e.en: The nurse watched the {toco} reading during labor.
e.zh: 分娩时，护士观察子宫收缩监测读数。

e.en: The {toco} toucan has a huge orange bill.
e.zh: 托科巨嘴鸟有一个巨大的橙色鸟喙。

e.en: The doctor adjusted the {tocodynamometer} on the patient's abdomen.
e.zh: 医生调整了患者腹部的子宫收缩测量仪。

e.en: A {tocodynamometer} records contractions during childbirth.
e.zh: 子宫收缩测量仪会记录分娩时的宫缩。

e.en: Early books on {tocology} mixed medicine with practical advice.
e.zh: 早期产科学书籍把医学知识和实用建议结合在一起。

e.en: She studied {tocology} before training as a midwife.
e.zh: 她在接受助产士培训前学习了产科学。

e.en: The {tocometer} showed contractions every five minutes.
e.zh: 宫缩计显示每五分钟出现一次宫缩。

e.en: A wireless {tocometer} let the patient move around more easily.
e.zh: 无线宫缩计让患者活动起来更方便。

e.en: The young {tiro} made several mistakes in court.
e.zh: 那个年轻新手在法庭上犯了好几个错误。

e.en: She wrote like a {tiro}, full of confidence but short on craft.
e.zh: 她写得像个初学者，信心十足却缺少技巧。

e.en: His {tirocinium} in medicine lasted several difficult years.
e.zh: 他的医学学徒期持续了好几年，过程很艰难。

e.en: The essay reads like a scholar's {tirocinium}.
e.zh: 这篇文章读起来像是一位学者的初学阶段作品。

e.en: A {tirralirra} of song came from the garden.
e.zh: 花园里传来一阵鸟鸣般欢快的歌声。

e.en: She laughed a light {tirralirra} as she ran downstairs.
e.zh: 她下楼时发出一串轻快悦耳的笑声。

e.en: The {tirwit} of birds woke him before sunrise.
e.zh: 日出前，鸟儿的啁啾声把他叫醒了。

e.en: A faint {tirwit} sounded from the hedge.
e.zh: 树篱里传来一声微弱的鸟叫。

e.en: She said {tish} and waved the complaint away.
e.zh: 她啧了一声，把那句抱怨挥手打发掉了。

e.en: '{Tish}, that is nonsense,' the old man replied.
e.zh: “啧，那是胡说，”老人回答道。

e.en: The dress was made from a {tissuey} silk.
e.zh: 那条裙子是用一种薄纸般轻柔的丝绸做成的。

e.en: A {tissuey} layer peeled from the old paint.
e.zh: 旧油漆上剥落了一层又薄又脆的薄片。

e.en: The doctor noted {tissular} changes around the wound.
e.zh: 医生注意到伤口周围有组织方面的变化。

e.en: The sample showed unusual {tissular} growth.
e.zh: 样本显示出异常的组织生长。

e.en: The villagers served {tiswin} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 村民们在仪式期间端上了玉米发酵饮料。

e.en: He described {tiswin} as sour and mildly intoxicating.
e.zh: 他形容这种玉米酒味酸，并且有一点醉人。

e.en: She saved a {tit-bit} of cheese for the dog.
e.zh: 她给狗留了一小块奶酪。

e.en: The article offered one amusing {tit-bit} about his childhood.
e.zh: 文章里有一则关于他童年的有趣小轶事。

e.en: The argument became a {tit-for-tat} exchange of insults.
e.zh: 争论变成了一场针锋相对的互相辱骂。

e.en: Both countries adopted {tit-for-tat} trade restrictions.
e.zh: 两国都采取了以牙还牙的贸易限制措施。

e.en: The children played {tit-tat-toe} on the dusty window.
e.zh: 孩子们在满是灰尘的窗户上玩井字棋。

e.en: A quick game of {tit-tat-toe} filled the wait.
e.zh: 他们用一局很快的井字棋打发等待的时间。

e.en: Barium {titanate} is used in some electronic ceramics.
e.zh: 钛酸钡用于某些电子陶瓷材料。

e.en: The lab prepared a new {titanate} compound.
e.zh: 实验室制备了一种新的钛酸盐化合物。

e.en: The basalt sample contained dark grains of {titanaugite}.
e.zh: 那块玄武岩样本中含有深色的含钛普通辉石颗粒。

e.en: Under the microscope, {titanaugite} showed strong coloration.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，含钛普通辉石呈现出明显的颜色。

e.en: The geologist identified {titanclinohumite} in the mantle rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在地幔岩中鉴定出了钛斜硅镁石。

e.en: Rare crystals of {titanclinohumite} appeared in the thin section.
e.zh: 薄片中出现了罕见的钛斜硅镁石晶体。

e.en: The mineral assemblage included {titandiopside} and olivine.
e.zh: 该矿物组合包括含钛透辉石和橄榄石。

e.en: Researchers measured the composition of {titandiopside} crystals.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了含钛透辉石晶体的成分。

e.en: She {titivates} the room with fresh flowers before guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到来前，她用鲜花把房间稍微装点一番。

e.en: He {titivates} his old jacket with a bright scarf.
e.zh: 他用一条鲜艳的围巾把旧外套打扮得精神些。

e.en: She spent the morning {titivating} the shop window.
e.zh: 她花了一上午装点商店橱窗。

e.en: He was {titivating} himself before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前他正在把自己收拾得更体面。

e.en: The hall needed a little {titivation} before the party.
e.zh: 聚会前大厅还需要稍微装点一下。

e.en: Her plain dress gained charm after some careful {titivation}.
e.zh: 经过一番细心点缀，她那件素裙显得更有味道。

e.en: A {titlark} rose suddenly from the wet grass.
e.zh: 一只小云雀突然从湿草丛中飞起。

e.en: The old guide called the meadow bird a {titlark}.
e.zh: 那位老向导把这种草地小鸟叫作titlark。

title-holder.t: 冠军保持者；头衔持有者

e.en: The {title-holder} defended her championship in straight sets.
e.zh: 这位冠军保持者直落两盘卫冕成功。

e.en: As the legal {title-holder}, he could sell the land.
e.zh: 作为法定产权持有人，他可以出售这块土地。

title-holders.t: 冠军保持者；头衔持有者

e.en: Several former {title-holders} attended the boxing ceremony.
e.zh: 几位前冠军保持者出席了拳击颁奖仪式。

e.en: The registry lists all property {title-holders} by name.
e.zh: 登记册按姓名列出了所有产权持有人。

e.en: The author's name appears on the {title-page}.
e.zh: 作者姓名印在书名页上。

e.en: Please check the {title-page} for the publication date.
e.zh: 请查看标题页上的出版日期。

titleholder.t: 冠军保持者；头衔持有者

e.en: The {titleholder} entered the ring with quiet confidence.
e.zh: 这位冠军保持者沉着自信地走进拳台。

e.en: The deed named her as the sole {titleholder}.
e.zh: 契约上写明她是唯一的产权持有人。

e.en: The monk placed a {titlo} above the sacred abbreviation.
e.zh: 修士在这个神圣缩写上方加了一个titlo符号。

e.en: A faded {titlo} can still be seen in the manuscript.
e.zh: 手稿中仍能看到一个褪色的古斯拉夫缩写符号。

e.en: The villagers mocked him as a {titman}, though he was brave.
e.zh: 村民嘲笑他是个小个子，尽管他很勇敢。

e.en: In dialect, a tiny creature might be called a {titman}.
e.zh: 在方言里，很小的动物有时会被叫作titman。

e.en: Several {titmice} gathered around the winter feeder.
e.zh: 几只山雀聚在冬季喂鸟器旁。

e.en: The children learned to identify {titmice} by their calls.
e.zh: 孩子们学着通过叫声辨认山雀。

e.en: The party expelled a suspected {Titoist} during the purge.
e.zh: 清洗期间，党内开除了一名被怀疑的铁托主义者。

e.en: His {Titoist} views favored independence from Moscow.
e.zh: 他的铁托派观点主张摆脱莫斯科的控制。

e.en: Add the {titrant} slowly until the solution changes color.
e.zh: 慢慢加入滴定剂，直到溶液变色。

e.en: The concentration of the {titrant} must be known precisely.
e.zh: 滴定液的浓度必须准确已知。

e.en: The automatic {titrator} recorded the endpoint accurately.
e.zh: 自动滴定仪准确记录了终点。

e.en: An experienced {titrator} can notice a faint color shift.
e.zh: 有经验的滴定操作员能察觉轻微的颜色变化。

e.en: The lab replaced its old {titrimeter} last year.
e.zh: 实验室去年更换了旧滴定计。

e.en: A calibrated {titrimeter} improves the reliability of the test.
e.zh: 校准过的滴定测量仪能提高测试可靠性。

titrimetric.t: 滴定分析的；容量分析的

e.en: The report describes a {titrimetric} method for chloride detection.
e.zh: 报告描述了一种用于检测氯化物的滴定分析方法。

e.en: They compared {titrimetric} results with spectroscopic measurements.
e.zh: 他们把滴定分析结果与光谱测量结果进行了比较。

e.en: Students practiced {titrimetry} in the analytical chemistry lab.
e.zh: 学生们在分析化学实验室练习滴定分析。

e.en: Classical {titrimetry} remains useful for routine quality control.
e.zh: 传统滴定分析在日常质量控制中仍然有用。

e.en: The tabloid used the childish word {tittie} in its headline.
e.zh: 那家小报在标题里用了tittie这个幼稚粗俗的词。

e.en: She told the toddler that a {tittie} was a private body part.
e.zh: 她告诉幼儿，乳房是身体的私密部位。

e.en: We should {tittivate} the patio before the neighbors arrive.
e.zh: 邻居来之前，我们该把露台稍微装点一下。

e.en: He stopped to {tittivate} his hair in the mirror.
e.zh: 他停下来对着镜子整理头发。

e.en: The small cafe was {tittivated} with candles and fresh paint.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆用蜡烛和新漆装点了一番。

e.en: She arrived carefully {tittivated} for the evening reception.
e.zh: 她为晚间招待会精心打扮后到场。

e.en: He {tittivates} the display before opening the shop.
e.zh: 开店前他把陈列稍微整理装饰一下。

e.en: She {tittivates} herself whenever she expects visitors.
e.zh: 只要预计有客人来，她就会把自己打扮一番。

e.en: They were {tittivating} the stage with ribbons and lamps.
e.zh: 他们正用丝带和灯饰装点舞台。

e.en: She kept {tittivating} her hat during the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式期间她不停地整理自己的帽子。

e.en: Ignore the office {tittle-tattle} and focus on your work.
e.zh: 别理办公室里的闲言碎语，专心工作。

e.en: Their conversation was mostly harmless {tittle-tattle} about neighbors.
e.zh: 他们的谈话多半只是关于邻居的无伤大雅的闲聊。

titanically.t: 巨大地；极其费力地；如巨人般

e.en: The ship moved {titanically} through the storm.
e.zh: 那艘船在暴风雨中如巨物般艰难前行。

e.en: She worked {titanically} to finish the project.
e.zh: 她为完成这个项目付出了极其巨大的努力。

e.en: The miners found {titaniferous} sand near the coast.
e.zh: 矿工们在海岸附近发现了含钛砂。

e.en: This {titaniferous} ore requires special processing.
e.zh: 这种含钛矿石需要特殊加工。

e.en: The geologist identified the crystal as {titanite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这块晶体鉴定为榍石。

e.en: Green {titanite} can be cut into small gems.
e.zh: 绿色榍石可以切割成小宝石。

e.en: Engineers tried to {titanize} the metal surface.
e.zh: 工程师们尝试对金属表面进行钛化处理。

e.en: The lab can {titanize} samples for corrosion tests.
e.zh: 实验室可以将样品钛化后用于腐蚀测试。

titanizing.t: 钛化处理；正在用钛处理

e.en: The factory is {titanizing} parts for aircraft engines.
e.zh: 工厂正在对飞机发动机部件进行钛化处理。

e.en: {Titanizing} improves the surface resistance of steel.
e.zh: 钛化处理能提高钢材表面的耐受性。

e.en: The sample contained flakes of {titanmica}.
e.zh: 样品中含有片状钛云母。

e.en: {Titanmica} gave the rock a dark shimmer.
e.zh: 钛云母让这块岩石泛出深色光泽。

e.en: The chemist used {titanometry} to measure the compound.
e.zh: 化学家用钛量法测定这种化合物。

e.en: {Titanometry} was once common in analytical laboratories.
e.zh: 钛量法曾在分析实验室中很常见。

e.en: A {titanosaur} could grow longer than a bus.
e.zh: 一只泰坦巨龙类恐龙可能长得比公共汽车还长。

e.en: The museum displayed a new {titanosaur} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具新的泰坦巨龙类恐龙骨架。

e.en: Long exposure to dust may cause {titanosis}.
e.zh: 长期接触粉尘可能导致钛尘肺。

e.en: The report described mild {titanosis} in the worker.
e.zh: 报告描述了这名工人轻度钛沉着病的情况。

e.en: The fossil belonged to a massive {titanothere}.
e.zh: 这块化石属于一头巨大的雷兽。

e.en: A {titanothere} had hornlike projections on its skull.
e.zh: 雷兽的头骨上有类似角的突起。

e.en: The solution contained {titanous} chloride.
e.zh: 该溶液含有三价氯化钛。

e.en: {Titanous} compounds are sensitive to oxidation.
e.zh: 低价钛化合物对氧化很敏感。

e.en: The thin section showed grains of {titanspinel}.
e.zh: 薄片中显示出钛尖晶石颗粒。

e.en: {Titanspinel} can indicate conditions in volcanic rocks.
e.zh: 钛尖晶石可以指示火山岩形成时的条件。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {titanyl} sulfate solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了硫酸钛酰溶液。

e.en: {Titanyl} groups affect the crystal structure.
e.zh: 钛酰基会影响晶体结构。

titfer.t: 帽子；旧式伦敦俚语帽儿

e.en: He tipped his {titfer} to the crowd.
e.zh: 他向人群轻轻抬了抬帽子致意。

e.en: That old {titfer} makes him look theatrical.
e.zh: 那顶旧帽子让他看起来很有戏剧感。

e.en: The market stall sold cheap {titfers} and scarves.
e.zh: 市场摊位卖便宜帽子和围巾。

e.en: They wore battered {titfers} in the old photograph.
e.zh: 那张老照片里他们戴着破旧的帽子。

e.en: The farmer listed his {tithable} crops carefully.
e.zh: 农夫仔细列出了应缴什一税的作物。

e.en: Some goods were not considered {tithable}.
e.zh: 有些货物不被视为应缴什一税。

tithingman.t: 什一税征收员；旧时治安员

e.en: The {tithingman} collected dues from the village.
e.zh: 什一税征收员向村民收取应缴款项。

e.en: A {tithingman} watched behavior during the church service.
e.zh: 旧时治安员在礼拜时监督人们的举止。

tithingmen.t: 什一税征收员们；旧时治安员们

e.en: The {tithingmen} met after the harvest.
e.zh: 什一税征收员们在收获之后会面。

e.en: Colonial {tithingmen} enforced local moral rules.
e.zh: 殖民时期的治安员们执行当地的道德规约。

e.en: Bright orange {tithonia} filled the garden bed.
e.zh: 鲜橙色的肿柄菊开满了花坛。

e.en: Butterflies often visit {tithonia} in late summer.
e.zh: 夏末时蝴蝶常会飞到肿柄菊上。

e.en: The article used a {titillative} headline.
e.zh: 那篇文章用了一个撩人眼球的标题。

e.en: Her speech had a mildly {titillative} tone.
e.zh: 她的讲话带着一点挑逗性的语气。

titillator.t: 挑逗者；刺激兴趣的人或物

e.en: The host acted as a skilled {titillator}.
e.zh: 主持人像个老练的挑逗气氛者。

e.en: The scandal became a public {titillator}.
e.zh: 那桩丑闻成了刺激公众兴趣的话题。

e.en: She paused to {titivate} her hair before dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐前她停下来整理了一下头发。

e.en: They plan to {titivate} the cafe with new lights.
e.zh: 他们打算用新灯饰装点这家咖啡馆。

titivated.t: 已打扮好的；已修饰过的

e.en: He arrived carefully {titivated} for the party.
e.zh: 他精心打扮后到了派对现场。

e.en: The room was {titivated} with flowers and candles.
e.zh: 房间用鲜花和蜡烛装点过了。

e.en: The church bell rang a {tocsin} before the attack.
e.zh: 袭击前，教堂钟声敲响了警钟。

e.en: The report sounded a {tocsin} about rising debt.
e.zh: 这份报告为债务上升敲响了警钟。

e.en: The sacks were made of rough {tocuyo}.
e.zh: 这些袋子是用粗糙的未漂棉布做的。

e.en: She bought cheap {tocuyo} for work shirts.
e.zh: 她买了便宜的粗棉布来做工作衬衫。

e.en: The child began to {toddel} across the room.
e.zh: 那个孩子开始蹒跚着穿过房间。

e.en: He watched the puppy {toddel} after its mother.
e.zh: 他看着小狗摇摇晃晃地跟在妈妈后面。

e.en: Language develops quickly during {toddlerhood}.
e.zh: 语言能力在幼儿时期发展得很快。

e.en: Her memories of {toddlerhood} are mostly from photos.
e.zh: 她对学步期的记忆大多来自照片。

e.en: I added it to my {todo} list.
e.zh: 我把这件事加进了待办清单。

e.en: The app shows every unfinished {todo}.
e.zh: 这个应用会显示每个未完成的待办事项。

e.en: A bright green {tody} perched on the branch.
e.zh: 一只鲜绿色的托迪鸟停在树枝上。

e.en: The guide pointed out a Cuban {tody}.
e.zh: 向导指出了一只古巴短尾翠鸟。

e.en: The leather {toe-cap} was badly scuffed.
e.zh: 皮鞋的鞋头包片磨损得很厉害。

e.en: Safety boots often include a metal {toe-cap}.
e.zh: 安全靴通常带有金属鞋尖护盖。

toe-curling.t: 尴尬得要命的；极强烈的

e.en: His speech was full of {toe-curling} jokes.
e.zh: 他的演讲里全是让人尴尬得要命的笑话。

e.en: The singer delivered a {toe-curling} high note.
e.zh: 那位歌手唱出了一个强烈到让人绷紧脚趾的高音。

e.en: She learned to {toe-dance} at a ballet school.
e.zh: 她在芭蕾学校学会了跳足尖舞。

e.en: The final {toe-dance} drew loud applause.
e.zh: 最后的足尖舞赢得了热烈掌声。

e.en: The mechanic adjusted the car's {toe-in}.
e.zh: 技师调整了汽车车轮的前束。

e.en: Too much {toe-in} can wear the tires quickly.
e.zh: 前束过大会让轮胎很快磨损。

e.en: The alignment showed slight {toe-out} on the front wheels.
e.zh: 定位结果显示前轮有轻微后束。

e.en: A dancer's natural {toe-out} can affect her stance.
e.zh: 舞者天生的脚尖外展会影响站姿。

toe-tapping.t: 用脚打拍子的；节奏欢快的

e.en: The band played a {toe-tapping} tune.
e.zh: 乐队演奏了一首节奏欢快、让人想打拍子的曲子。

e.en: His {toe-tapping} annoyed the people nearby.
e.zh: 他不停用脚打拍子惹恼了旁边的人。

e.en: The injury caused a noticeable {toedrop}.
e.zh: 这次受伤导致了明显的足下垂。

e.en: Her brace helped correct the {toedrop}.
e.zh: 她的支具帮助矫正了脚尖下垂。

e.en: He wore {toeless} compression socks after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他穿着露趾的压力袜。

e.en: The statue's {toeless} foot looked unfinished.
e.zh: 雕像那只没有脚趾的脚看起来还没完成。

e.en: A small {toeplate} protected the front of the shoe.
e.zh: 一块小鞋尖金属片保护着鞋子的前端。

e.en: The orthotic {toeplate} supported his forefoot.
e.zh: 矫形趾板支撑着他的前脚掌。

e.en: The pendulum swung {to-and-fro} above the table.
e.zh: 钟摆在桌子上方来回摆动。

e.en: They argued {to-and-fro} for hours.
e.zh: 他们你来我往地争论了好几个小时。

e.en: The {to-be} parents painted the nursery yellow.
e.zh: 这对准父母把婴儿房刷成了黄色。

e.en: Her {to-be} husband arrived late.
e.zh: 她未来的丈夫来晚了。

e.en: We leave for London {to-day}.
e.zh: 我们今天动身去伦敦。

e.en: Such manners seem strange {to-day}.
e.zh: 这样的礼节在今天看来很奇怪。

e.en: I wrote the task on my {to-do} list.
e.zh: 我把这项任务写进了待办清单。

e.en: There was a great {to-do} about the mistake.
e.zh: 那个错误引起了一阵大惊小怪。

e.en: She checked her {to-dos} before lunch.
e.zh: 她午饭前查看了自己的待办事项。

e.en: The app sorts daily {to-dos} by priority.
e.zh: 这个应用按优先级整理每天的待办事项。

e.en: I ordered a coffee {to-go}.
e.zh: 我点了一杯外带咖啡。

e.en: There are ten minutes {to-go} in the match.
e.zh: 比赛还剩十分钟。

e.en: All that {to-ing} and fro-ing exhausted everyone.
e.zh: 那样来来回回地折腾把大家都累坏了。

e.en: Her constant {to-ing} between offices delayed the decision.
e.zh: 她在各办公室之间不停奔走，耽误了决定。

e.en: We shall meet again {to-morrow} morning.
e.zh: 我们明天早上会再见面。

e.en: No one knows what {to-morrow} may bring.
e.zh: 没人知道来日会带来什么。

e.en: The guests will arrive {to-night}.
e.zh: 客人们今晚会到。

e.en: The moon is bright {to-night}.
e.zh: 今夜的月亮很明亮。

e.en: Grandma made {toad-in-the-hole} for Sunday dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶周日晚餐做了约克郡布丁烤香肠。

e.en: The pub serves excellent {toad-in-the-hole} with onion gravy.
e.zh: 那家酒馆供应很好吃的约克郡布丁烤香肠，配洋葱肉汁。

e.en: A red {toad-stool} grew under the oak tree.
e.zh: 一朵红色毒蘑菇长在橡树下。

e.en: Children were warned not to touch the {toad-stool}.
e.zh: 孩子们被提醒不要碰那朵毒蘑菇。

e.en: The minister kept a {toadeater} close at hand.
e.zh: 那位部长身边总跟着一个谄媚者。

e.en: No one trusted the office {toadeater}.
e.zh: 没人信任办公室里的那个马屁精。

e.en: His shameless {toadeating} annoyed the whole staff.
e.zh: 他无耻的拍马行为惹恼了全体员工。

e.en: She refused to win favor by {toadeating}.
e.zh: 她不愿靠谄媚来讨好别人。

e.en: A {toadfish} hid beneath the muddy sand.
e.zh: 一条蟾鱼藏在泥沙下面。

e.en: The fisherman released the noisy {toadfish}.
e.zh: 渔夫把那条会发声的蟾鱼放回去了。

e.en: Yellow {toadflax} spread along the roadside.
e.zh: 黄色柳穿鱼沿着路边蔓延开来。

e.en: She sketched a stem of {toadflax} in her notebook.
e.zh: 她在笔记本上画了一枝柳穿鱼。

e.en: He called the guard a {toadhead} under his breath.
e.zh: 他低声骂那个守卫是个笨蛋。

e.en: The old insult {toadhead} sounds comic today.
e.zh: toadhead这个旧骂法如今听起来有点滑稽。

e.en: His {toadish} grin made her uneasy.
e.zh: 他那像蟾蜍般的咧嘴笑让她不安。

e.en: The villain had a squat, {toadish} appearance.
e.zh: 那个反派身形矮胖，样子像蟾蜍一样讨厌。

e.en: A tiny {toadlet} hopped across the path.
e.zh: 一只小蟾蜍跳过了小路。

e.en: The pond was full of young {toadlets}.
e.zh: 池塘里满是幼小的蟾蜍。

e.en: Medieval doctors prized the {toadstone} as a charm.
e.zh: 中世纪医生把蟾石视为珍贵的护身符。

e.en: The ring was set with a supposed {toadstone}.
e.zh: 那枚戒指镶着一颗所谓的蟾石。

e.en: His {toadyish} compliments fooled no one.
e.zh: 他那些谄媚的恭维话骗不了任何人。

e.en: She disliked the assistant's {toadyish} manner.
e.zh: 她讨厌那个助理拍马屁的态度。

e.en: The court was full of {toadyism} and gossip.
e.zh: 宫廷里充满了谄媚作风和流言。

e.en: He advanced through {toadyism}, not talent.
e.zh: 他靠拍马屁而不是靠才干升迁。

e.en: That {toerag} stole my bike again.
e.zh: 那个卑鄙家伙又偷了我的自行车。

e.en: Don't talk to her like a {toerag}.
e.zh: 别像个无赖一样跟她说话。

e.en: She tightened the ribbons on her {toeshoe}.
e.zh: 她系紧了足尖鞋上的缎带。

e.en: A worn {toeshoe} can hurt a dancer.
e.zh: 磨旧的足尖鞋会弄疼舞者。

e.en: He felt {toey} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前他感到紧张不安。

e.en: The film left him oddly {toey}.
e.zh: 那部电影让他莫名有些性冲动。

e.en: The geologist found a {tofaceous} layer below the soil.
e.zh: 地质学家在土层下发现了一层凝灰岩质岩层。

e.en: Water had carved channels through the {tofaceous} rock.
e.zh: 水流在凝灰岩质岩石中冲出了沟槽。

e.en: Misfortune may {tofall} any careless traveler.
e.zh: 粗心的旅人可能会遭遇不幸。

e.en: No blame should {tofall} the child.
e.zh: 不该让这个孩子承担责备。

e.en: The child bought a {toffee-apple} at the fair.
e.zh: 孩子在集市上买了一个太妃糖苹果。

e.en: Her {toffee-apple} cracked when she bit it.
e.zh: 她一咬，太妃糖苹果的糖壳就裂开了。

e.en: His {toffee-nosed} relatives ignored the guests.
e.zh: 他那些势利亲戚不理会客人。

e.en: She sounded {toffee-nosed} when she corrected his accent.
e.zh: 她纠正他的口音时听起来很自命不凡。

e.en: He wore a rather {toffy} jacket to dinner.
e.zh: 他穿了一件颇有阔少派头的夹克去吃晚饭。

e.en: Her {toffy} voice annoyed the whole room.
e.zh: 她那种势利腔调让整屋人都不快。

e.en: The actors wore white {togae} on stage.
e.zh: 演员们在台上穿着白色宽外袍。

e.en: Ancient {togae} appear in the museum display.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里陈列着古代长袍。

e.en: A {togated} figure stood beside the column.
e.zh: 一个穿长袍的人影站在柱子旁。

e.en: The judge looked almost {togated} in the old robe.
e.zh: 法官穿着那件旧袍子，看起来几乎像披着古式长袍。

e.en: The lab identified a {togavirus} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室在样本中识别出一种披膜病毒。

e.en: Rubella is caused by a {togavirus}.
e.zh: 风疹是由一种披膜病毒引起的。

e.en: The children were warmly {toged} for the snow.
e.zh: 孩子们为雪天穿得很暖和。

e.en: He arrived smartly {toged} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 他衣着整齐地来参加典礼。

e.en: His winter {toggery} filled two cupboards.
e.zh: 他的冬季衣物装满了两个柜子。

e.en: The shop sold cheap {toggery} for sailors.
e.zh: 那家店卖给水手们便宜衣物。

e.en: Flip the {toggle-switch} to start the pump.
e.zh: 拨动开关来启动水泵。

e.en: The old lamp has a brass {toggle-switch}.
e.zh: 那盏旧灯有一个黄铜拨动开关。

e.en: He caught a large {togue} in the cold lake.
e.zh: 他在寒冷的湖里钓到一条大湖鳟。

e.en: The guide said {togue} prefer deep water.
e.zh: 向导说湖鳟更喜欢深水。

e.en: The lab built a small {tokomak} for plasma experiments.
e.zh: 实验室建了一台小型托卡马克装置来做等离子体实验。

e.en: A {tokomak} uses magnetic fields to confine hot plasma.
e.zh: 托卡马克利用磁场约束高温等离子体。

e.en: A scroll hung in the {tokonoma} of the tea room.
e.zh: 茶室的日式壁龛里挂着一幅卷轴。

e.en: Guests admired the flowers arranged in the {tokonoma}.
e.zh: 客人欣赏摆在床之间里的插花。

e.en: The old receipt listed the silver in {tolas}.
e.zh: 那张旧收据用托拉记下了白银重量。

e.en: A jeweler weighed the bracelet by the {tola}.
e.zh: 珠宝商按托拉给这只手镯称重。

e.en: The dye sample contained traces of {tolamine}.
e.zh: 这份染料样品含有微量甲苯胺类化合物。

e.en: Chemists handled {tolamine} only inside the fume hood.
e.zh: 化学人员只在通风橱内处理甲苯胺。

e.en: The carpenter chose {tolan} for the cabinet panels.
e.zh: 木匠选用托兰木来做橱柜面板。

e.en: A tall {tolan} shaded the edge of the village.
e.zh: 一棵高大的托兰树遮住了村边。

e.en: The reaction produced a yellow {tolane} derivative.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种黄色的二苯乙炔衍生物。

e.en: Students identified {tolane} from its melting point.
e.zh: 学生根据熔点鉴定出二苯乙炔。

e.zh: 医生开了甲苯磺丁脲类降糖药来治疗二型糖尿病。

e.en: She stopped taking {tolazamide} after a low blood sugar episode.
e.zh: 她出现低血糖后停用了托拉扎胺。

e.en: The clinician discussed {tolazoline} with the neonatal team.
e.zh: 临床医生和新生儿团队讨论了妥拉唑林的使用。

e.en: Older references describe {tolazoline} as a vasodilator.
e.zh: 较早的资料把妥拉唑林描述为血管扩张药。

e.en: The prisoners were kept in the town {tolbooth}.
e.zh: 囚犯被关在镇上的旧市政监狱里。

e.en: The old {tolbooth} now serves as a local museum.
e.zh: 那座旧市政厅兼监狱如今成了地方博物馆。

e.en: Her grandfather once took {tolbutamide} for diabetes.
e.zh: 她祖父曾服用甲苯磺丁脲来控制糖尿病。

e.en: The pharmacist checked whether {tolbutamide} was still appropriate.
e.zh: 药剂师核查甲苯磺丁脲是否仍然适合使用。

e.en: A more {tolerative} policy reduced conflict in the office.
e.zh: 更宽容的政策减少了办公室里的冲突。

e.en: Some crops are {tolerative} of salty soil.
e.zh: 有些作物能忍受盐碱土壤。

e.en: She collected antique {toleware} from country auctions.
e.zh: 她从乡村拍卖会上收藏古董彩绘金属器皿。

e.en: The tray was bright {toleware} with painted flowers.
e.zh: 那个托盘是画着花的鲜艳彩绘金属器。

e.en: The test used {tolidine} as a chemical reagent.
e.zh: 这项测试使用联甲苯胺作为化学试剂。

e.en: Workers avoided direct contact with {tolidine}.
e.zh: 工人避免直接接触联甲苯胺。

e.en: The carriage stopped at the {toll-bar} before entering town.
e.zh: 马车进城前停在收费栅门处。

e.en: An old map marks the former {toll-bar} on the road.
e.zh: 一张旧地图标出了那条路上从前的收费路障。

e.en: Drivers crossed the {toll-bridge} into the city.
e.zh: 司机们通过收费桥进入城市。

e.en: The county plans to remove fees from the {toll-bridge}.
e.zh: 县政府计划取消这座收费桥的通行费。

toll-free.t: 免费通话的；免通行费的

e.en: Call the {toll-free} number for customer support.
e.zh: 请拨打免费电话联系客户支持。

e.en: The new highway is {toll-free} for local residents.
e.zh: 这条新高速对当地居民免收通行费。

e.en: The keeper lived beside the old {toll-house}.
e.zh: 看守人住在那座旧收费站房旁边。

e.en: The restored {toll-house} displays tools from the turnpike era.
e.zh: 修复后的收费站房展示着收费公路时代的工具。

e.en: The museum label identified the crystal as {toienite}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这块晶体标为托因石。

e.en: Few collectors have ever seen genuine {toienite}.
e.zh: 很少有收藏者见过真正的托因石。

e.en: We need more {toilet paper} in the bathroom.
e.zh: 浴室里需要更多卫生纸。

e.en: She packed a roll of {toilet paper} for the camping trip.
e.zh: 她为露营旅行带了一卷厕纸。

e.en: There is a spare {toilet roll} under the sink.
e.zh: 水槽下面有一卷备用卫生纸。

e.en: He replaced the empty {toilet roll} before leaving.
e.zh: 他离开前换上了新的厕纸卷。

e.en: They began to {toilet-train} their toddler gently.
e.zh: 他们开始温和地训练幼儿如厕。

e.en: It takes patience to {toilet-train} a puppy.
e.zh: 训练小狗定点排便需要耐心。

e.en: Most children are {toilet-trained} before starting school.
e.zh: 大多数孩子上学前已经会自己上厕所。

e.en: The shelter said the dog was {toilet-trained}.
e.zh: 收容所说这只狗受过定点排便训练。

e.en: {Toilet-training} can be stressful for new parents.
e.zh: 如厕训练可能让新手父母感到压力很大。

e.en: The book gives practical tips on {toilet-training}.
e.zh: 这本书提供了关于如厕训练的实用建议。

e.en: She {toilet-trains} puppies for busy owners.
e.zh: 她为忙碌的主人训练小狗定点排便。

e.en: The nursery slowly {toilet-trains} each child.
e.zh: 托儿所会慢慢训练每个孩子如厕。

e.en: The farmers endured a {toilful} harvest season.
e.zh: 农民们熬过了一个辛苦的收获季节。

e.en: His {toilful} climb ended at sunrise.
e.zh: 他艰难的攀登在日出时结束。

e.en: They worked {toilfully} through the hot afternoon.
e.zh: 他们在炎热的下午辛苦地干活。

e.en: She {toilfully} copied every line by hand.
e.zh: 她费力地逐行手抄下来。

e.en: He dreamed of a {toilless} life by the sea.
e.zh: 他梦想在海边过一种无须辛劳的生活。

e.en: The machine promised a nearly {toilless} harvest.
e.zh: 这台机器承诺几乎不用费力就能收割。

e.en: Her {toilworn} hands showed years of farm work.
e.zh: 她因劳作而粗糙疲惫的双手显出多年农活的痕迹。

e.en: A {toilworn} face looked out from the doorway.
e.zh: 一张饱经辛劳的脸从门口望出来。

e.en: The children were {toing} and froing all morning.
e.zh: 孩子们整个上午都来来回回地跑动。

e.en: Staff kept {toing} between the kitchen and hall.
e.zh: 工作人员不停地在厨房和大厅之间来回走动。

toise.t: 古法制长度单位托瓦兹

e.en: The old map measured the wall in {toises}.
e.zh: 这张旧地图用托瓦兹来标注城墙长度。

e.en: A French {toise} was roughly two meters long.
e.zh: 法国的一个托瓦兹大约有两米长。

e.en: They served a sweet {tokay} after dinner.
e.zh: 他们饭后端上了一种甜的托卡伊酒。

e.en: A {tokay} gecko clung to the wall.
e.zh: 一只大壁虎贴在墙上。

e.en: The doctor checked the reading on the {tokodynamometer}.
e.zh: 医生查看了子宫收缩力测量仪上的读数。

e.en: A {tokodynamometer} can monitor contractions during labor.
e.zh: 子宫收缩力测量仪可以在分娩时监测宫缩。

e.en: She studied {tokology} in a nineteenth-century medical text.
e.zh: 她在一本十九世纪医学书中研究产科学。

e.en: The lecture treated {tokology} as a public health subject.
e.zh: 这场讲座把助产学作为公共卫生议题来讨论。

e.en: We took the {toll-road} to save time.
e.zh: 我们走收费公路来节省时间。

e.en: The new {toll-road} reduced traffic through the town.
e.zh: 新收费道路减少了穿过镇子的车流。

tollable.t: 可征费的；应缴通行费的

e.zh: 重型卡车通过这座桥需要缴费。

e.en: The agency listed which routes were {tollable}.
e.zh: 该机构列出了哪些路线可征收通行费。

e.en: The carriage stopped at the {tollbar}.
e.zh: 马车在收费路障前停了下来。

e.en: An old {tollbar} once marked the city boundary.
e.zh: 一处旧收费栏杆曾标示城市边界。

e.en: Traffic slowed near the {tollgate}.
e.zh: 车辆在收费站附近慢了下来。

e.en: The old {tollgate} closed after the road became free.
e.zh: 那条路免费后，旧收费闸门关闭了。

e.en: The {tollgatherer} counted the coins carefully.
e.zh: 收通行费的人仔细数着硬币。

e.en: A {tollgatherer} lived beside the bridge.
e.zh: 一名收费员住在桥边。

e.en: The keeper slept inside the {tollhouse}.
e.zh: 看守人睡在收费站小屋里。

e.en: The restored {tollhouse} is now a small museum.
e.zh: 修复后的收费房现在是一座小博物馆。

e.en: Several old {tollhouses} still stand along the road.
e.zh: 路边仍保留着几座旧收费房。

e.en: The map shows former {tollhouses} near each bridge.
e.zh: 地图标出了每座桥附近从前的收费站小屋。

e.en: The {tollkeeper} raised the barrier.
e.zh: 收费员升起了栏杆。

e.en: In the diary, a lonely {tollkeeper} records every traveler.
e.zh: 日记里，一名孤独的收费站看守记录每个旅人。

e.en: The {tollman} waved us through after payment.
e.zh: 付款后，收费员挥手让我们通过。

e.en: A village {tollman} collected fees from passing carts.
e.zh: 村里的收通行费者向过路马车收费。

e.en: The {tollmen} worked late during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，收费员工作到很晚。

e.en: Old records name the {tollmen} who served the bridge.
e.zh: 旧记录列出了曾在这座桥收费的人。

e.en: The chemist handled {tollol} under a hood.
e.zh: 化学师在通风橱中处理甲酚。

e.en: Old dye manuals sometimes mention {tollol}.
e.zh: 旧染料手册有时会提到甲苯酚。

e.en: The hikers found a {tolmen} on the moor.
e.zh: 徒步者在荒原上发现了一座支石墓。

e.en: Local legends surround the ancient {tolmen}.
e.zh: 当地传说围绕着那座古老的史前石桌墓。

e.en: The festival included a rough game of {tolo}.
e.zh: 节日活动中有一场粗犷的托洛球戏。

e.en: He compared {tolo} with polo in his travel notes.
e.zh: 他在游记中把托洛球戏和马球作比较。

e.en: The old cough syrup contained {tolu}.
e.zh: 这种旧止咳糖浆含有妥鲁香脂。

e.en: Perfumers valued {tolu} for its warm scent.
e.zh: 调香师看重吐鲁香脂温暖的香气。

e.en: The lab synthesized {toluanilide} for comparison.
e.zh: 实验室合成了甲苯酰苯胺用于比较。

e.en: A trace of {toluanilide} appeared in the sample.
e.zh: 样品中出现了微量甲苯酰苯胺。

e.en: The reaction produced a methyl {toluate}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种甲苯酸甲酯。

e.en: Analysts measured each {toluate} in the mixture.
e.zh: 分析人员测定了混合物中的每种甲苯酸盐或酯。

toluic.t: 甲苯酸的；甲基苯甲酸的

e.en: The paper describes {toluic} acid derivatives.
e.zh: 论文描述了甲苯酸衍生物。

e.en: They compared three {toluic} isomers.
e.zh: 他们比较了三种甲基苯甲酸异构体。

e.en: The compound was identified as a {toluide}.
e.zh: 该化合物被鉴定为一种甲苯胺化物。

e.en: Heating the sample formed a new {toluide}.
e.zh: 加热样品生成了一种新的甲苯酰胺。

toluidide.t: 甲苯胺酰胺；甲苯胺化物

e.en: The report lists {toluidide} among the by-products.
e.zh: 报告把甲苯胺酰胺列为副产物之一。

e.en: A pure {toluidide} crystallized overnight.
e.zh: 一种纯净的甲苯胺化物在夜间结晶。

e.en: The dye process uses {toluidine} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 这种染料工艺使用甲苯胺作为中间体。

e.en: Workers tested the air for {toluidine} exposure.
e.zh: 工人检测空气中的甲苯胺暴露水平。

e.en: The chemist handled {toluol} under a fume hood.
e.zh: 化学师在通风橱里处理甲苯。

e.en: Older manuals may call the solvent {toluol}.
e.zh: 较旧的手册可能把这种溶剂称为甲苯旧名。

e.en: The reaction introduced a {toluoyl} group into the compound.
e.zh: 该反应把一个甲苯酰基引入了化合物。

e.en: A {toluoyl} chloride sample was stored in the cabinet.
e.zh: 一份甲苯酰氯样品被存放在柜中。

e.en: The paper described a new {toluquinoline} derivative.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种新的甲基喹啉衍生物。

e.en: They tested {toluquinoline} in a small laboratory assay.
e.zh: 他们在一次小型实验室测定中测试了甲基喹啉。

e.en: The oxidized product was identified as {toluquinone}.
e.zh: 氧化后的产物被鉴定为甲苯醌。

e.en: Pure {toluquinone} formed yellow crystals.
e.zh: 纯甲苯醌形成了黄色晶体。

e.en: The archive listed {tolurin} among related laboratory reagents.
e.zh: 档案把甲苯脲列在相关实验试剂中。

e.en: A small amount of {tolurin} remained in the sample vial.
e.zh: 样品瓶中还残留着少量甲苯脲。

e.en: The formula showed a {toluyl} residue attached to nitrogen.
e.zh: 该化学式显示有一个甲苯酰残基连在氮上。

e.en: Several {toluyl} compounds appeared in the old catalogue.
e.zh: 旧目录中出现了几种甲苯基化合物。

e.en: The old pharmacology text mentioned {tolyantipyrine} briefly.
e.zh: 那本旧药理学教材简要提到了甲苯基安替比林。

e.en: Researchers compared {tolyantipyrine} with related antipyrine compounds.
e.zh: 研究人员把甲苯基安替比林与相关的安替比林化合物作了比较。

e.en: The molecule contains a {tolyl} group on one side.
e.zh: 这个分子的一侧含有一个甲苯基。

e.en: Chemists often distinguish phenyl and {tolyl} substituents.
e.zh: 化学家常区分苯基和甲苯基取代基。

e.en: The polymer used a {tolylene} unit in its backbone.
e.zh: 这种聚合物的主链中使用了一个甲苯撑单元。

e.en: A {tolylene} bridge connected the two reactive groups.
e.zh: 一个甲苯撑桥连接了两个反应基团。

e.en: Workers monitored exposure to {tolylenediamine} in the plant.
e.zh: 工人监测了厂内甲苯二胺的接触水平。

e.en: {Tolylenediamine} is used in making certain dyes and polymers.
e.zh: 甲苯二胺用于制造某些染料和聚合物。

e.en: A noisy {tom-cat} prowled through the alley.
e.zh: 一只吵闹的公猫在小巷里游荡。

e.en: Their {tom-cat} came home with a torn ear.
e.zh: 他们家的雄猫回家时耳朵被撕破了。

e.en: The drummer struck the {tom-tom} during the chorus.
e.zh: 鼓手在副歌部分敲响了通通鼓。

e.en: A distant {tom-tom} echoed across the village.
e.zh: 远处的手鼓声在村子里回荡。

e.en: The band added {tom-toms} to the final verse.
e.zh: 乐队在最后一段加入了通通鼓。

e.en: Ceremonial {tom-toms} sounded after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后，仪式用手鼓响了起来。

e.en: The buckle was made of {tomac}, not real gold.
e.zh: 这个带扣是铜锌合金做的，不是真金。

e.en: Old buttons of {tomac} darkened with age.
e.zh: 旧的铜锌合金纽扣随着年代久远而变暗。

e.en: Some diners spread {tomalley} on toast.
e.zh: 有些食客把龙虾蟹黄抹在吐司上。

e.en: The chef removed the green {tomalley} before serving the lobster.
e.zh: 厨师上龙虾前去掉了绿色的肝胰腺。

e.en: Green tomatoes contain small amounts of {tomatine}.
e.zh: 青番茄中含有少量番茄碱。

e.en: The study measured {tomatine} levels in tomato leaves.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了番茄叶中的番茄碱含量。

e.en: The sauce tasted bright and {tomatoey}.
e.zh: 这款酱尝起来清爽，而且番茄味很足。

e.en: She wanted a more {tomatoey} soup for dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐想要一碗番茄味更浓的汤。

e.en: The medal was cast in {tombac}.
e.zh: 这枚奖章是用铜锌合金铸成的。

e.en: {Tombac} jewelry can resemble low-grade gold.
e.zh: 铜锌合金首饰可能看起来像成色较低的黄金。

e.en: The antique clasp was made from {tomback}.
e.zh: 这个古董扣件是用铜锌合金制成的。

e.en: Polished {tomback} has a warm golden color.
e.zh: 抛光后的铜锌合金呈现温暖的金色。

e.en: The craftsman chose {tombak} for the decorative plate.
e.zh: 工匠选择铜锌合金来制作装饰盘。

e.en: Old coins of {tombak} were often mistaken for gold.
e.zh: 旧的铜锌合金币常被误认为金币。

tonstein.t: 泥炭灰岩；泥灰岩煤层夹石

e.en: The geologist identified a thin layer of {tonstein} in the coal seam.
e.zh: 地质学家在煤层中发现了一层薄薄的泥炭灰岩。

e.en: Miners used the pale {tonstein} band to match coal beds across the basin.
e.zh: 矿工利用浅色的泥灰岩夹层来对比盆地内的煤层。

tontine.t: 联合养老金；通天寿保险

e.en: The old investors joined a {tontine} that paid more as members died.
e.zh: 那些老投资者加入了一种成员去世后收益增加的联合养老金计划。

e.en: Her novel turns a family {tontine} into a motive for murder.
e.zh: 她的小说把一份家族通天寿保险写成了谋杀动机。

e.en: The company tried to {tontise} its pension scheme in the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 这家公司在十八世纪试图按联合年金方式筹措养老金。

e.en: Lawyers warned that to {tontise} the fund would create strange incentives.
e.zh: 律师警告说，把基金改成联合年金制会造成奇怪的激励。

too-too.t: 过分讲究的；矫揉造作的

e.en: The drawing room looked {too-too} for such a modest house.
e.zh: 对这样一所朴素的房子来说，客厅显得过分讲究。

e.en: He mocked her {too-too} accent at the dinner table.
e.zh: 他在餐桌上取笑她那种矫揉造作的口音。

e.en: The farmer found {toodflax} tangled around the young flax plants.
e.zh: 农民发现亚麻菟丝子缠在幼小的亚麻植株上。

e.en: Old herbals describe {toodflax} as a troublesome parasitic weed.
e.zh: 古老草药书记载亚麻菟丝子是一种麻烦的寄生杂草。

e.en: She waved from the taxi and called, "{toodle-oo}!"
e.zh: 她从出租车里挥手喊道：“回头见！”

e.en: With a cheerful {toodle-oo}, he disappeared down the lane.
e.zh: 他愉快地说了声再见，便消失在小巷尽头。

e.en: "{Toodles}, everyone," she said as she left the party.
e.zh: 她离开聚会时说：“大家拜拜。”

e.en: He ended the call with a breezy {toodles}.
e.zh: 他用一声轻快的拜拜结束了通话。

e.en: The apprentice kept a stained {toolbook} beside the workbench.
e.zh: 学徒把一本沾了污渍的工具手册放在工作台旁。

e.en: This digital {toolbook} explains every command with examples.
e.zh: 这本数字工具书用例子解释每一条命令。

e.en: The machinist tightened the cutter inside the {toolframe}.
e.zh: 机械师把刀具固定在刀具框架里。

e.en: A broken {toolframe} can make the whole press unsafe.
e.zh: 工具架损坏会让整台压力机变得不安全。

e.en: Replace the {toolhead} before the drill starts to vibrate.
e.zh: 在钻头开始震动前先更换工具头。

e.en: The robot changes its {toolhead} automatically for each task.
e.zh: 机器人会根据每项任务自动更换工具头。

e.en: The lathe needs a rigid {toolholder} for precise cuts.
e.zh: 车床需要坚固的刀柄才能进行精密切削。

e.en: She placed the screwdriver back in its magnetic {toolholder}.
e.zh: 她把螺丝刀放回磁性工具夹持器里。

e.en: The spades are stored in the old {toolhouse} behind the barn.
e.zh: 铁锹存放在谷仓后面的旧工具房里。

e.en: After the storm, the small {toolhouse} needed a new roof.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，那间小工具棚需要换新屋顶。

e.en: He learned {toolmaking} at a technical college.
e.zh: 他在一所技术学院学习工具制造。

e.en: Precision {toolmaking} is essential for modern manufacturing.
e.zh: 精密工具制造对现代制造业至关重要。

e.en: Only trained staff may enter the {toolroom}.
e.zh: 只有受过培训的员工可以进入工具室。

e.en: The factory's {toolroom} produced custom dies overnight.
e.zh: 工厂的模具车间连夜制作了定制模具。

e.en: The mechanic bought a new {toolset} for the garage.
e.zh: 修理工给车库买了一套新工具。

e.en: This software {toolset} helps designers test layouts quickly.
e.zh: 这套软件工具能帮助设计师快速测试布局。

e.en: Different teams use different {toolsets} for testing.
e.zh: 不同团队使用不同的工具集进行测试。

e.en: The workshop sells compact {toolsets} for home repairs.
e.zh: 这家工坊出售用于家庭维修的紧凑型工具套装。

e.en: Accurate {toolsetting} reduces waste on the milling machine.
e.zh: 准确的刀具设定能减少铣床加工中的浪费。

e.en: The technician completed {toolsetting} before the production run.
e.zh: 技术员在投产前完成了工具调校。

e.en: Hover over the icon to read the {tooltip}.
e.zh: 把鼠标悬停在图标上即可阅读工具提示。

e.en: A clear {tooltip} can prevent users from making mistakes.
e.zh: 清晰的悬浮说明可以避免用户出错。

e.en: The old Scottish song speaks of a {toom} purse and a cold hearth.
e.zh: 那首古老的苏格兰歌唱到空空的钱袋和冰冷的炉边。

e.en: They had to {toom} the sacks before filling them with grain.
e.zh: 他们得先把袋子腾空，再装上谷物。

e.en: She dropped a {toonie} into the parking meter.
e.zh: 她把一枚加拿大两元硬币投进停车计时器。

e.en: The child saved every {toonie} he received from his grandparents.
e.zh: 那个孩子把祖父母给他的每一枚两元硬币都存起来。

toothbilled.t: 齿嘴的；喙有齿状突起的

e.en: The guide pointed out a rare {toothbilled} bird in the canopy.
e.zh: 向导指出树冠中有一只罕见的齿嘴鸟。

e.en: A {toothbilled} jaw suggests the animal fed differently from its relatives.
e.zh: 带齿状突起的颌部表明这种动物的取食方式不同于其近亲。

tombless.t: 没有坟墓的；无墓可葬的

e.en: The forgotten soldier lay {tombless} on the hill.
e.zh: 那名被遗忘的士兵无墓可葬地躺在山上。

e.en: Many victims remained {tombless} after the disaster.
e.zh: 灾难过后，许多遇难者仍没有坟墓。

tomblike.t: 像坟墓般的；死寂阴森的

e.en: A {tomblike} silence filled the empty house.
e.zh: 空屋里充满了坟墓般的死寂。

e.en: The cellar felt cold and {tomblike} at night.
e.zh: 夜里地窖显得寒冷而阴森，像座坟墓。

e.en: A narrow {tombolo} linked the island to the shore.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的连岛沙洲把小岛和海岸连在一起。

e.en: The storm reshaped the sandy {tombolo} overnight.
e.zh: 暴风雨一夜之间改变了那片沙质连岛沙坝的形状。

e.en: The fisherman caught a small {tomcod} near the pier.
e.zh: 渔民在码头附近钓到一条小鳕鱼。

e.en: In winter, {tomcod} gather in the cold estuary.
e.zh: 冬天，小鳕鱼会聚集在寒冷的河口。

e.en: The leaf's pale {tomenta} protected it from drying out.
e.zh: 叶片浅色的绒毛层保护它不易干枯。

e.en: Botanists compared the {tomenta} on several young stems.
e.zh: 植物学家比较了几根幼茎上的密生柔毛。

tomentose.t: 被绒毛覆盖的；密生柔毛的

e.en: The plant has broad, {tomentose} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有宽大的、密生柔毛的叶子。

e.en: A {tomentose} stem can feel almost velvety.
e.zh: 被绒毛覆盖的茎摸起来几乎像天鹅绒。

tomentum.t: 植物或动物表面的绒毛层

e.en: A soft {tomentum} covered the underside of each leaf.
e.zh: 每片叶子的背面都覆盖着一层柔软的绒毛。

e.en: The insect's body bore a fine gray {tomentum}.
e.zh: 这只昆虫的身体上有一层细细的灰色绒毛。

e.en: Only a {tomfool} would ignore that warning.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会无视那个警告。

e.en: Stop acting like a {tomfool} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时别再像个胡闹的人一样。

e.en: The bird uses its sharp {tomia} to slice fruit.
e.zh: 这只鸟用锋利的喙缘切开水果。

e.en: Researchers measured the {tomia} of several finches.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了几只雀鸟的喙部切缘。

e.en: The hawk's {tomium} helped it tear the meat.
e.zh: 鹰喙的锋利切缘帮助它撕开肉。

e.en: A parrot's {tomium} may be curved and strong.
e.zh: 鹦鹉的喙缘可能弯曲而有力。

e.en: The gangster carried a {tommy-gun} in the film.
e.zh: 电影里的歹徒拿着一把汤姆森冲锋枪。

e.en: A vintage {tommy-gun} was displayed behind glass.
e.zh: 一把老式汤姆森冲锋枪陈列在玻璃后面。

e.en: Workers had to spend wages at the company {tommy-shop}.
e.zh: 工人不得不在公司的以货代薪商店里花工资。

e.en: The law eventually restricted the abusive {tommy-shop} system.
e.zh: 法律最终限制了这种剥削性的以货代薪商店制度。

e.en: That rumor is pure {tommyrot}.
e.zh: 那个传闻完全是胡说八道。

e.en: He dismissed the speech as sentimental {tommyrot}.
e.zh: 他把那篇演讲斥为多愁善感的废话。

e.en: Do not stand there like a {tomnoddy}.
e.zh: 别像个呆子一样站在那里。

e.en: The old comedy made the clerk a harmless {tomnoddy}.
e.zh: 那部老喜剧把店员塑造成一个无害的笨人。

e.en: The doctor examined the lung {tomogram} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细查看了那张肺部断层扫描图像。

e.en: A new {tomogram} showed less swelling than before.
e.zh: 新的断层扫描图像显示肿胀比以前减轻了。

tomograph.t: 断层扫描仪；断层摄影机

e.en: The hospital installed a modern {tomograph} last month.
e.zh: 医院上个月安装了一台现代断层扫描仪。

e.en: Engineers calibrated the {tomograph} before the first scan.
e.zh: 工程师在首次扫描前校准了那台断层扫描仪。

e.en: He took a {toothful} of the sticky candy.
e.zh: 他咬了一小口黏黏的糖。

e.en: A {toothful} was enough to taste the spice.
e.zh: 尝一小口就足以尝出香料味。

e.en: The dentist adjusted the {toothholder} carefully.
e.zh: 牙医小心地调整了牙托。

e.en: A loose {toothholder} can make chewing painful.
e.zh: 松动的牙托会让咀嚼变得疼痛。

e.en: This saw is {toothier} than the old one.
e.zh: 这把锯子比旧的齿更多。

e.en: She gave him a {toothier} grin this time.
e.zh: 这次她对他露出了更明显的齿笑。

e.en: The child smiled {toothily} at the camera.
e.zh: 孩子对着相机露齿一笑。

e.en: The broken edge stuck out {toothily}.
e.zh: 破裂的边缘像牙齿一样突出来。

e.en: Each leaf had a tiny {toothlet} along its edge.
e.zh: 每片叶子的边缘都有一个细小齿突。

e.en: The fossil showed a sharp {toothlet} near the jaw.
e.zh: 化石在颌部附近显出一枚尖小齿。

e.en: The {toothleted} leaf edge helped identify the plant.
e.zh: 带细齿的叶缘帮助辨认了这种植物。

e.en: A {toothleted} wheel gripped the soft clay.
e.zh: 带小齿的轮子咬住了软黏土。

e.en: The shell had a {toothlike} point inside.
e.zh: 贝壳内侧有个像牙齿的尖突。

e.en: Rows of {toothlike} rocks lined the ridge.
e.zh: 一排排齿状岩石排列在山脊上。

e.en: Old shops sold scented {toothpowders} in small tins.
e.zh: 老店用小铁罐出售有香味的洁牙粉。

e.en: Some {toothpowders} contained chalk and herbs.
e.zh: 有些牙粉含有白垩和草药。

e.en: We found {toothwort} growing under the trees.
e.zh: 我们发现齿根草长在树下。

e.en: The guide said {toothwort} was once used medicinally.
e.zh: 向导说齿根草过去曾被用作药草。

e.en: The baby wiggled one tiny {tootsy}.
e.zh: 宝宝晃动着一只小脚丫。

e.en: My left {tootsy} got cold in the wet shoe.
e.zh: 我的左脚丫在湿鞋里冻着了。

e.en: Grandma kissed the baby's {tootsy-wootsy}.
e.zh: 奶奶亲了亲宝宝的小脚丫。

e.en: Put that {tootsy-wootsy} back under the blanket.
e.zh: 把那只小脚丫放回毯子下面。

e.en: They hired a {top-class} designer for the project.
e.zh: 他们为这个项目聘请了一流设计师。

e.en: The hotel offers {top-class} service throughout.
e.zh: 这家酒店全程提供顶级服务。

e.en: After the merger, she became the {top-dog}.
e.zh: 合并后，她成了头号人物。

e.en: Every team wants to beat the {top-dog}.
e.zh: 每支队伍都想击败那个老大。

e.en: The company uses a {top-down} management style.
e.zh: 这家公司采用自上而下的管理方式。

e.en: A {top-down} view shows the whole map clearly.
e.zh: 俯视图能清楚显示整张地图。

e.en: The restaurant is known for {top-drawer} cooking.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以最高档的烹饪闻名。

e.en: He moved in {top-drawer} social circles.
e.zh: 他混迹于上流社交圈。

e.en: Gardeners {top-dress} the lawn each spring.
e.zh: 园丁每年春天给草坪表层施肥。

e.en: You can {top-dress} the pot with fresh compost.
e.zh: 你可以在花盆表面铺一层新堆肥。

e.en: A thin {top-dressing} improved the tired lawn.
e.zh: 薄薄一层表层肥改善了疲弱的草坪。

e.en: Use gravel as a {top-dressing} for the pot.
e.zh: 用砾石作花盆表面的覆盖料。

e.en: She now works with {top-echelon} executives.
e.zh: 她现在与最高层的高管共事。

e.en: Only {top-echelon} players qualify for this event.
e.zh: 只有顶级选手才有资格参加这项赛事。

e.en: They signed a {top-flight} goalkeeper yesterday.
e.zh: 他们昨天签下了一名顶级门将。

e.en: The orchestra gave a {top-flight} performance.
e.zh: 这支管弦乐队奉献了一场一流演出。

e.en: The chef buys only {top-grade} olive oil.
e.zh: 厨师只购买最高级的橄榄油。

e.en: This factory produces {top-grade} steel.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产优质钢材。

top-grossing.t: 票房最高的；收入最高的

e.en: It became the year's {top-grossing} film.
e.zh: 它成了当年票房最高的电影。

e.en: The app is still {top-grossing} in several countries.
e.zh: 这款应用在几个国家仍是收入最高的应用。

e.en: The crew removed extra {top-hamper} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨前，船员移除了多余的上部重物。
