e.en: Too much {top-hamper} made the vessel roll badly.
e.zh: 过多的船上部重物使船摇晃得很厉害。

e.en: He wore a black {top-hat} to the wedding.
e.zh: 他戴着黑色高顶礼帽参加婚礼。

e.en: The magician pulled flowers from his {top-hat}.
e.zh: 魔术师从他的高顶礼帽里变出了花。

e.en: A {top-hatted} gentleman opened the carriage door.
e.zh: 一位戴高礼帽的绅士打开了马车门。

e.en: The magician's {top-hatted} silhouette appeared onstage.
e.zh: 魔术师戴高礼帽的身影出现在舞台上。

top-heavy.t: 头重脚轻的；高层过多的

e.en: The vase looked {top-heavy} and likely to fall.
e.zh: 那个花瓶看起来头重脚轻，像是要倒。

e.en: The company became {top-heavy} with too many managers.
e.zh: 这家公司管理层太多，结构变得头重脚轻。

e.en: That was a {top-hole} idea, old chap.
e.zh: 老兄，那真是个绝妙的主意。

e.en: We had a {top-hole} dinner at the club.
e.zh: 我们在俱乐部吃了一顿极好的晚餐。

e.en: She tied her hair into a neat {top-knot}.
e.zh: 她把头发扎成一个整齐的头顶发髻。

e.en: The bird's small {top-knot} shook in the wind.
e.zh: 那只鸟的小羽冠在风中抖动。

e.en: Only {top-level} officials attended the meeting.
e.zh: 只有最高级别的官员参加了会议。

e.en: Save the file in the {top-level} folder.
e.zh: 把文件保存在最顶层的文件夹里。

e.en: The report gives the {top-line} figures first.
e.zh: 报告先列出了最重要的数字。

e.en: Strong sales improved the company's {top-line} growth.
e.zh: 强劲销售提升了公司的营收增长。

e.en: The hotel provided {top-notch} service all week.
e.zh: 这家酒店整周都提供一流的服务。

e.en: She is a {top-notch} software engineer.
e.zh: 她是一位非常出色的软件工程师。

e.en: He bought a {top-of-the-line} laptop for work.
e.zh: 他买了一台最高档的笔记本电脑用于工作。

e.en: The clinic uses {top-of-the-line} imaging equipment.
e.zh: 这家诊所使用顶级的影像设备。

e.en: After the promotion, she felt {top-of-the-world}.
e.zh: 升职之后，她觉得自己开心到了极点。

e.en: The victory left the team {top-of-the-world}.
e.zh: 这场胜利让全队感觉站上了巅峰。

e.en: Safety is our {top-priority} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，安全是我们的首要任务。

e.en: Fixing the payment bug became {top-priority}.
e.zh: 修复支付漏洞成了最优先处理的事。

e.en: The bakery uses {top-quality} butter in its cakes.
e.zh: 这家面包店做蛋糕用的是优质黄油。

e.en: They sell {top-quality} tools for professional builders.
e.zh: 他们出售供专业建筑工使用的上乘工具。

e.en: Her work belongs in the {top-rank} of modern fiction.
e.zh: 她的作品属于现代小说中的一流水平。

e.en: Only officers of {top-rank} saw the document.
e.zh: 只有最高级别的军官看过那份文件。

e.en: They defeated the {top-ranked} team in the league.
e.zh: 他们击败了联赛中排名最高的队伍。

e.en: She applied to several {top-ranked} universities abroad.
e.zh: 她申请了几所国外顶尖大学。

e.en: A {top-ranking} diplomat led the negotiations.
e.zh: 一位高级别外交官主持了谈判。

e.en: The school remains {top-ranking} in national surveys.
e.zh: 这所学校在全国调查中仍排名靠前。

top-rated.t: 评分最高的；最受好评的

e.en: We booked a {top-rated} restaurant near the station.
e.zh: 我们订了车站附近一家评分很高的餐厅。

e.en: This is one of the {top-rated} apps for budgeting.
e.zh: 这是最受好评的预算管理应用之一。

e.en: Click the icon in the {top-right} corner.
e.zh: 点击右上角的图标。

e.en: The date appears at the {top-right} of the page.
e.zh: 日期显示在页面的右上方。

e.en: The spy carried a {top-secret} file.
e.zh: 那名间谍带着一份绝密文件。

e.en: Details of the mission remain {top-secret}.
e.zh: 这次任务的细节仍属最高机密。

e.en: The {top-seeded} player won in straight sets.
e.zh: 头号种子选手直落两盘获胜。

e.en: Fans expected the {top-seeded} team to dominate.
e.zh: 球迷期待头号种子队占据优势。

e.en: It became the company's {top-selling} phone this year.
e.zh: 它成了公司今年销量最高的手机。

e.en: Her {top-selling} novel was translated into ten languages.
e.zh: 她那本畅销小说被译成了十种语言。

e.en: The bar keeps its {top-shelf} whisky behind glass.
e.zh: 酒吧把高级威士忌放在玻璃柜后面。

e.en: They hired a {top-shelf} lawyer for the trial.
e.zh: 他们为这场审判聘请了一位顶级律师。

e.en: I need a phone {top-up} before the trip.
e.zh: 出发前我需要给手机充值。

e.en: The grant provided a small {top-up} to her salary.
e.zh: 这笔补助给她的工资做了一点补足。

e.en: Online {top-ups} are cheaper than shop vouchers.
e.zh: 网上充值比商店代金券更便宜。

e.en: The pension plan allows occasional {top-ups}.
e.zh: 这个养老金计划允许偶尔追加缴款。

e.en: The neurologist diagnosed {topagnosis} after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后，神经科医生诊断出空间定位失认症。

e.en: Patients with {topagnosis} may lose their way indoors.
e.zh: 患有空间定位失认症的病人可能在室内迷路。

toparch.t: 小地区统治者；地方长官

e.en: The ancient {toparch} governed a small district.
e.zh: 那位古代地方长官治理着一个小地区。

e.en: A {toparch} could owe loyalty to a larger king.
e.zh: 小地区统治者可能效忠于更大的国王。

e.en: Several {toparchies} paid taxes to the empire.
e.zh: 几个地方辖区向帝国纳税。

e.en: The historian compared the region's ancient {toparchies}.
e.zh: 历史学家比较了该地区古代的小型地方政权。

e.en: Early doctors used {tomophotography} to study hidden tissue layers.
e.zh: 早期医生用断层摄影术研究隐藏的组织层。

e.en: The lecture compared {tomophotography} with modern CT imaging.
e.zh: 讲座把断层摄影术与现代CT成像作了比较。

e.en: Come back {tomorrer} when the shop is open.
e.zh: 明天店开门时再回来。

e.en: The old letter promised payment {tomorrer}.
e.zh: 那封旧信承诺翌日付款。

e.en: Breast {tomosynthesis} can reveal small tumors more clearly.
e.zh: 乳腺断层合成成像能更清楚地显示小肿瘤。

e.en: The hospital upgraded its mammography unit with {tomosynthesis}.
e.zh: 医院为乳腺摄影设备升级了断层合成成像功能。

e.en: The sailor fitted a {tompion} into the cannon's muzzle.
e.zh: 水手把炮口塞装进大炮的炮口。

e.en: A carved wooden {tompion} protected the old gun from rain.
e.zh: 一个雕花木塞保护那门旧炮不受雨淋。

e.en: A {tomtit} hopped along the garden fence.
e.zh: 一只山雀类小鸟沿着花园篱笆跳来跳去。

e.en: Children watched the tiny {tomtit} peck at seeds.
e.zh: 孩子们看着那只小山雀啄食种子。

e.en: Freight companies measure work in {ton-miles}.
e.zh: 货运公司用吨英里来衡量运输工作量。

e.en: The route produced fewer {ton-miles} after demand fell.
e.zh: 需求下降后，这条线路产生的吨英里运输量减少了。

e.en: The harbor recorded the ship's {tonage} incorrectly.
e.zh: 港口把那艘船的吨位记录错了。

e.en: Older laws taxed vessels by {tonage}.
e.zh: 旧法规按船舶吨位征税。

e.en: The {tonalist} painted the river in soft gray light.
e.zh: 那位调性画派艺术家用柔和灰光描绘河流。

e.en: Critics called him a late American {tonalist}.
e.zh: 评论家称他为美国后期调性画派艺术家。

e.en: They decided {toname} the cottage after her mother.
e.zh: 他们决定用她母亲的名字给小屋命名。

e.en: The poet used old spellings {toname} each star.
e.zh: 诗人用古旧拼法给每颗星命名。

e.en: The neurologist diagnosed {tonaphasia} after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后，神经科医生诊断出音调性失语症。

e.en: Patients with {tonaphasia} may miss emotional pitch.
e.zh: 音调性失语症患者可能听不出情绪性的音高变化。

e.en: The museum displayed a Renaissance {tondino} above the case.
e.zh: 博物馆在展柜上方展示了一幅文艺复兴圆形小画。

e.en: A painted {tondino} decorated the ceiling corner.
e.zh: 一个彩绘圆饰装点着天花板角落。

e.en: He is {tone-deaf} but loves singing loudly.
e.zh: 他音盲，却很喜欢大声唱歌。

e.en: The minister sounded {tone-deaf} during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，那位部长显得很不体察民情。

e.en: She wore a {tone-on-tone} blue suit.
e.zh: 她穿了一套同色调搭配的蓝色西装。

e.en: The designer chose {tone-on-tone} wallpaper for the room.
e.zh: 设计师为房间选择了同色调墙纸。

e.en: The orchestra performed a stormy {tone-poem}.
e.zh: 管弦乐团演奏了一首气势汹涌的交响诗。

e.en: His {tone-poem} evokes a lonely mountain village.
e.zh: 他的音诗唤起一座孤寂山村的意象。

e.en: Lower the {tonearm} gently onto the record.
e.zh: 把唱臂轻轻放到唱片上。

e.en: A damaged {tonearm} can make records skip.
e.zh: 损坏的唱臂会让唱片跳针。

e.en: In Mandarin, each {toneme} can change word meaning.
e.zh: 在普通话中，每个调位都可能改变词义。

e.en: The linguist marked the final {toneme} carefully.
e.zh: 语言学家仔细标出了最后一个声调音位。

e.en: The paper analyzes {tonemic} contrasts in Thai.
e.zh: 这篇论文分析泰语中的调位对立。

e.en: She added {tonemic} marks to the transcription.
e.zh: 她在转写中加入了声调音位标记。

e.en: The researcher used {tonetic} symbols in the notes.
e.zh: 研究者在笔记中使用了声调学符号。

e.en: A {tonetic} analysis explained the speaker's pitch patterns.
e.zh: 一项声调学分析解释了说话者的音高模式。

e.en: The dialects were compared {tonetically} rather than historically.
e.zh: 这些方言是按声调学而非历史来源来比较的。

e.en: She transcribed the chant {tonetically} for her thesis.
e.zh: 她为论文按声调学方式转写了那段吟唱。

e.en: He specialized in {tonetics} at graduate school.
e.zh: 他在研究生阶段专攻声调学。

e.en: The course introduces {tonetics} through African languages.
e.zh: 这门课通过非洲语言介绍声调学。

e.en: The child learned melodies on a plastic {tonette}.
e.zh: 那个孩子用塑料托内特小笛学习旋律。

e.en: A school {tonette} is simpler than a recorder.
e.zh: 学校用的托内特小笛比竖笛更简单。

tonish.t: 有点像吨的；沉重的或大约一吨重的

e.en: The crate had a {tonish} weight when we tried to lift it.
e.zh: 我们试着抬那个箱子时，它重得像有一吨左右。

e.en: He gave a {tonish} estimate rather than an exact measurement.
e.zh: 他给的是大约一吨的估计，而不是精确测量。

tonite.t: 今晚的非正式拼法；火山灰凝灰岩

e.en: The poster says the band plays {tonite} at nine.
e.zh: 海报上写着乐队今晚九点演出。

e.en: The cliff contains layers of {tonite} formed from volcanic ash.
e.zh: 这处峭壁含有由火山灰形成的凝灰岩层。

e.en: He gave the old radio a sharp {tonk} with his knuckles.
e.zh: 他用指关节重重敲了一下那台旧收音机。

e.en: They played {tonk} at the kitchen table after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们在厨房桌旁玩起了tonk纸牌。

e.en: I ordered {tonkatsu} with rice and shredded cabbage.
e.zh: 我点了日式炸猪排，配米饭和卷心菜丝。

e.en: The chef sliced the {tonkatsu} before pouring sauce over it.
e.zh: 厨师先把炸猪排切开，再淋上酱汁。

tonnish.t: 略带吨位感的；约一吨重的

e.en: The sculpture looked {tonnish}, though it was hollow inside.
e.zh: 那座雕塑看起来有一吨左右重，虽然里面是空的。

e.en: She made a {tonnish} calculation for the shipment.
e.zh: 她对这批货做了约一吨的粗略估算。

tonofilament.t: 张力丝；细胞内支撑细丝

e.en: The microscope revealed a dense {tonofilament} network inside the cell.
e.zh: 显微镜显示细胞内有密集的张力丝网络。

e.en: Each {tonofilament} helps maintain the shape of epithelial tissue.
e.zh: 每条张力丝都有助于维持上皮组织的形状。

tonogram.t: 眼压记录图；压力记录图

e.en: The doctor reviewed the {tonogram} after the eye pressure test.
e.zh: 眼压测试后，医生查看了眼压记录图。

e.en: A clear {tonogram} can show how pressure changes over time.
e.zh: 清晰的压力记录图能显示压力随时间的变化。

e.en: The paper models muscle behavior using {tonomechanics}.
e.zh: 这篇论文用张力力学来模拟肌肉行为。

e.en: Students found {tonomechanics} difficult because it combines pressure and motion.
e.zh: 学生觉得压力力学很难，因为它结合了压力和运动。

e.en: The nurse used a {tonometer} to measure my eye pressure.
e.zh: 护士用眼压计测量了我的眼压。

e.en: A laboratory {tonometer} can measure tension in a delicate membrane.
e.zh: 实验室里的张力计可以测量薄膜中的张力。

e.en: Routine {tonometry} helps doctors detect glaucoma early.
e.zh: 常规眼压测量有助于医生早期发现青光眼。

e.en: The experiment required precise {tonometry} of the stretched material.
e.zh: 这个实验需要对拉伸材料进行精确的张力测定。

tonophily.t: 嗜张力性；对张力的亲和性

e.en: The researcher described the tissue's unusual {tonophily}.
e.zh: 研究人员描述了这种组织异常的嗜张力性。

e.en: In older physiology texts, {tonophily} referred to attraction toward tension.
e.zh: 在较早的生理学文献中，tonophily指对张力的亲和。

e.en: Water passes through the {tonoplast} into the plant cell's vacuole.
e.zh: 水通过液泡膜进入植物细胞的液泡。

e.en: Damage to the {tonoplast} can disrupt storage inside the cell.
e.zh: 液泡膜受损会扰乱细胞内部的储存功能。

tonoscillograph.t: 张力振动记录仪；压力振荡记录仪

e.en: The old clinic kept a {tonoscillograph} for vascular tests.
e.zh: 那家老诊所保留了一台用于血管测试的压力振荡记录仪。

e.en: A {tonoscillograph} records small changes in tension as waves.
e.zh: 张力振动记录仪会把张力的细微变化记录成波形。

tonoscope.t: 声音振动显示器；音调观察仪

e.en: The teacher used a {tonoscope} to show patterns made by sound.
e.zh: 老师用声音振动显示器展示声音形成的图案。

e.en: A {tonoscope} can make musical vibrations visible to students.
e.zh: 音调观察仪能让学生看见音乐振动。

tonotron.t: 电子音调仪；早期电子乐器

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {tonotron} from an early music laboratory.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台来自早期音乐实验室的稀有电子音调仪。

e.en: Composers experimented with the {tonotron} before modern synthesizers became common.
e.zh: 在现代合成器普及前，作曲家曾用这种早期电子乐器做实验。

e.en: The doctor noticed {tonsilar} swelling during the examination.
e.zh: 医生检查时注意到扁桃体肿胀。

e.en: Persistent {tonsilar} pain may require further tests.
e.zh: 持续的扁桃体疼痛可能需要进一步检查。

e.en: The surgeon selected a {tonsillectome} before the procedure began.
e.zh: 手术开始前，外科医生选用了扁桃体切除器。

e.en: An old {tonsillectome} was displayed with other medical instruments.
e.zh: 一把旧的扁桃体切除器和其他医疗器械一起展出。

e.en: She stayed home because of a {tonsillitic} infection.
e.zh: 她因扁桃体炎感染而待在家里。

e.en: The doctor treated the {tonsillitic} symptoms with antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生用抗生素治疗这些扁桃体炎症状。

e.en: The specialist used a {tonsilloscope} to inspect the inflamed tissue.
e.zh: 专科医生用扁桃体检查镜查看发炎组织。

e.en: A {tonsilloscope} gives a clearer view than a simple tongue depressor.
e.zh: 扁桃体检查镜比普通压舌板能看得更清楚。

tonsillotomy.t: 扁桃体切开术；部分切除术

e.en: The child recovered quickly after a minor {tonsillotomy}.
e.zh: 孩子做了小型扁桃体切开术后恢复很快。

e.en: Doctors once used {tonsillotomy} instead of full tonsil removal.
e.zh: 医生过去有时采用扁桃体部分切除术，而不是完全切除。

e.en: The manual described how to clean a {tonsilsector} after surgery.
e.zh: 手册说明了手术后如何清洁扁桃体切割器。

e.en: A {tonsilsector} was designed to remove diseased tonsil tissue.
e.zh: 扁桃体切割器是为切除病变扁桃体组织而设计的。

e.en: The old {tongkang} carried timber down the river.
e.zh: 那艘旧东南亚木货船沿河运送木材。

e.en: A restored {tongkang} now serves tourists in the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘修复后的东南亚木货船如今在港口接待游客。

e.en: They fitted {tongue-and-groove} boards along the wall.
e.zh: 他们沿墙安装了榫槽接合的木板。

e.en: The cabin floor used {tongue-and-groove} pine.
e.zh: 小屋地板用的是榫槽接合的松木。

e.en: Her apology was clearly {tongue-in-cheek}.
e.zh: 她的道歉显然是半开玩笑的。

e.en: He made a {tongue-in-cheek} comment about his fame.
e.zh: 他对自己的名气说了一句带讽刺意味的话。

e.en: The coach will {tongue-lash} anyone who misses practice.
e.zh: 教练会严厉斥责任何缺席训练的人。

e.en: She did not {tongue-lash} him in public.
e.zh: 她没有当众严厉斥责他。

e.en: He got a {tongue-lashing} for arriving late.
e.zh: 他因为迟到挨了一顿严厉训斥。

e.en: The editor gave the article a {tongue-lashing}.
e.zh: 编辑把那篇文章狠狠批了一通。

e.en: The child was {tongue-shy} around strangers.
e.zh: 那个孩子在陌生人面前羞于开口。

e.en: Even confident writers can feel {tongue-shy} on stage.
e.zh: 即使自信的作家上台时也可能不敢开口。

tongue-tie.t: 舌系带过短；使说不出话

e.en: The baby was treated for {tongue-tie}.
e.zh: 那个婴儿接受了舌系带过短的治疗。

e.en: Nerves seemed to {tongue-tie} him during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时紧张似乎让他说不出话。

e.en: I felt {tongue-tied} when she asked me to speak.
e.zh: 她让我发言时，我紧张得说不出话。

e.en: The usually witty host became {tongue-tied} on live television.
e.zh: 那位平时机智的主持人在直播中突然语塞。

e.en: She practiced a difficult {tongue-twister} before class.
e.zh: 上课前她练习了一段很难的绕口令。

e.en: This street name is a real {tongue-twister}.
e.zh: 这条街的名字真是拗口得像绕口令。

e.en: The students laughed while reading {tongue-twisters}.
e.zh: 学生们读绕口令时笑了起来。

e.en: Actors use {tongue-twisters} to warm up their voices.
e.zh: 演员会用绕口令来给嗓子热身。

e.en: The village has a {tongue-twisting} name.
e.zh: 这个村子的名字很拗口。

e.en: She turned the phrase into a {tongue-twisting} joke.
e.zh: 她把那句话改成了一个绕舌的笑话。

e.en: The market sold fresh {tonguefish} from the coast.
e.zh: 市场出售来自海岸的新鲜舌鳎鱼。

e.en: A {tonguefish} hides flat against the sandy seabed.
e.zh: 舌鳎鱼会平贴在沙质海底隐藏自己。

e.en: A tiny {tonguelet} of flame rose from the candle.
e.zh: 蜡烛上冒起一小条舌状火苗。

e.en: The botanist pointed to the petal's narrow {tonguelet}.
e.zh: 植物学家指着花瓣上狭窄的小舌状部分。

e.en: The old {tonguester} entertained everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 那位健谈的老人让晚餐上的每个人都很开心。

e.en: A sharp {tonguester} can win an argument quickly.
e.zh: 一个口齿锋利的饶舌者能很快赢得争论。

e.en: He stood {tonguetied} before the committee.
e.zh: 他站在委员会面前紧张得说不出话。

e.en: Love letters made the confident poet feel {tonguetied}.
e.zh: 情书让那位自信的诗人也感到语塞。

e.en: The composer avoided a clear {tonical} center.
e.zh: 作曲家避免使用明确的主音中心。

e.en: Some languages have {tonical} patterns that change meaning.
e.zh: 有些语言的声调模式会改变词义。

e.en: The melody resolves {tonically} at the end.
e.zh: 这段旋律在结尾以主音方式解决。

e.en: The muscle contracted {tonically} during the test.
e.zh: 测试中那块肌肉发生了强直性收缩。

e.en: Doctors measured the {tonicity} of the solution.
e.zh: 医生测量了该溶液的渗透压状态。

e.en: Exercise can improve the {tonicity} of muscles.
e.zh: 运动可以改善肌肉的张力。

e.en: The island was once a tiny {toparchy} under a local ruler.
e.zh: 这座岛曾是由地方统治者管辖的小政区。

e.en: Historians described the valley's {toparchy} as nearly independent.
e.zh: 历史学家把这个山谷的小地方政权描述为几乎独立。

e.en: The collector identified the yellow crystal as {topazolite}.
e.zh: 收藏者认出那块黄色晶体是黄榴石。

e.en: A small piece of {topazolite} glittered in the mineral case.
e.zh: 矿物柜里一小块黄榴石闪闪发亮。

e.en: Remove the {topcap} before cleaning the valve.
e.zh: 清洁阀门前先取下顶盖。

e.en: The bottle's {topcap} snapped firmly into place.
e.zh: 瓶子的上盖啪的一声牢牢扣住。

e.en: A small {topcross} stood above the church roof.
e.zh: 教堂屋顶上方立着一个小十字架。

e.en: The carpenter replaced the broken {topcross} on the frame.
e.zh: 木匠更换了框架上折断的上部横梁。

e.en: The company chose a {topdown} approach to reform.
e.zh: 公司选择了自上而下的改革方式。

e.en: The map gives a {topdown} view of the city.
e.zh: 这张地图呈现了城市的俯视视角。

e.en: Gardeners {topdress} the lawn with compost each spring.
e.zh: 园丁每年春天用堆肥给草坪表层施肥。

e.en: They will {topdress} the path with fine gravel.
e.zh: 他们会在小路表面铺上一层细砾石。

topdressed.t: 已表层施肥的；已铺面的

e.en: The {topdressed} lawn looked greener after rain.
e.zh: 表层施过肥的草坪雨后显得更绿。

e.en: A {topdressed} track can drain water more quickly.
e.zh: 铺过面层的跑道排水会更快。

e.en: She {topdresses} the rose beds with rich compost.
e.zh: 她用肥沃堆肥给玫瑰花坛表层施肥。

e.en: The crew {topdresses} the field before every tournament.
e.zh: 工作人员每次比赛前都会给球场铺面养护。

e.en: A thin {topdressing} of compost helps the seedlings.
e.zh: 薄薄一层堆肥表层肥料有助于幼苗生长。

e.en: The road received a fresh {topdressing} of gravel.
e.zh: 这条路新铺了一层砾石表面层。

e.en: The sailors liked to {tope} after a long voyage.
e.zh: 水手们长途航行后喜欢痛饮一番。

e.en: A young {tope} was caught near the rocky shore.
e.zh: 岩石海岸附近捕到了一条幼年小鲨鱼。

e.en: Doctors once tried to {topectomize} damaged brain tissue.
e.zh: 医生过去曾尝试切除受损的脑皮质组织。

e.en: The surgeon refused to {topectomize} without clearer evidence.
e.zh: 没有更明确证据时，外科医生拒绝进行脑皮质区切除。

e.en: The paper discussed {topectomy} as an obsolete treatment.
e.zh: 论文把脑皮质区切除术作为一种过时疗法来讨论。

e.en: After the {topectomy}, the patient needed careful monitoring.
e.zh: 脑皮质区切除术后，病人需要严密观察。

e.en: The officer wore a white {topee} in the heat.
e.zh: 那名军官在炎热天气里戴着白色遮阳盔。

e.en: An old {topee} hung beside the travel photographs.
e.zh: 一顶旧印度式硬帽挂在旅行照片旁边。

e.en: She stuffed a red {topepo} with rice and herbs.
e.zh: 她把米饭和香草塞进一个红色番茄椒里。

e.en: The market sold {topepo} peppers beside ordinary bell peppers.
e.zh: 市场在普通甜椒旁边售卖番茄椒。

e.en: He {topes} with friends whenever he visits the port.
e.zh: 他每次到港口都会和朋友们豪饮。

e.en: Several {topes} swam close to the fishing boat.
e.zh: 几条小鲨鱼游近了那艘渔船。

e.en: The exam tested her {topesthesia} after the injury.
e.zh: 检查测试了她受伤后的定位感觉。

e.en: Poor {topesthesia} can make a touch feel misplaced.
e.zh: 定位感觉差会让人觉得触碰位置不准确。

e.en: They hired a {topflight} lawyer for the case.
e.zh: 他们为这个案子聘请了一流律师。

e.en: The orchestra gave a {topflight} performance last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那支管弦乐团献上了最高水平的演出。

e.en: The young boxer soon became a {topflighter}.
e.zh: 那位年轻拳击手很快成了顶尖选手。

e.en: Every {topflighter} in the industry attended the summit.
e.zh: 业内每位一流人物都参加了这场峰会。

e.en: The bucket was {topful} of cold rainwater.
e.zh: 水桶里盛满了冰冷的雨水，几乎到顶。

e.en: Her schedule is {topful} this week.
e.zh: 她这周的日程排得满满当当。

e.en: The crew raised the {topgallant} in a steady wind.
e.zh: 船员们在稳定的风中升起了上桅帆。

e.en: A broken {topgallant} spar delayed the ship's departure.
e.zh: 一根折断的上桅帆桁耽误了船只启航。

e.en: The storm tore away much of the ship's {tophamper}.
e.zh: 暴风雨扯掉了船上大量上部索具。

e.en: Extra {tophamper} made the old vessel roll dangerously.
e.zh: 额外的上部重物让那艘旧船危险地摇晃。

e.en: The doctor found a small {tophus} near his elbow.
e.zh: 医生在他的肘部附近发现了一个小痛风石。

e.en: A painful {tophus} can limit joint movement.
e.zh: 疼痛的尿酸盐结节会限制关节活动。

e.en: He wore a white {topi} in the midday sun.
e.zh: 正午的阳光下，他戴着一顶白色遮阳帽。

e.en: A {topi} grazed quietly on the open plain.
e.zh: 一只印度羚在开阔的平原上安静地吃草。

e.en: The essay treats {topia} as more than physical location.
e.zh: 这篇文章把地方性视为不只是物理地点。

e.en: Her theory of {topia} links memory with landscape.
e.zh: 她关于地点的理论把记忆与景观联系起来。

e.en: The {topiarian} shaped the yew into a spiral.
e.zh: 那位园艺造型师把紫杉修剪成螺旋形。

e.en: A skilled {topiarian} can make hedges look alive.
e.zh: 熟练的树木造型师能让篱笆显得栩栩如生。

e.en: The estate was famous for elaborate {topiation}.
e.zh: 这座庄园以精细的树木造型修剪闻名。

e.en: Modern {topiation} often combines art with horticulture.
e.zh: 现代树木造型修剪常把艺术和园艺结合起来。

topicalize.t: 使成为话题；置于句首强调

e.en: The campaign tried to {topicalize} housing costs.
e.zh: 这场宣传试图把住房成本变成公众话题。

e.en: Some languages {topicalize} the object for emphasis.
e.zh: 有些语言会把宾语置于句首以示强调。

e.en: The {topkick} inspected the barracks before dawn.
e.zh: 那名军士长在黎明前检查了营房。

e.en: Every recruit listened when the {topkick} spoke.
e.zh: 军士长一开口，每个新兵都认真听。

e.en: The company reported strong {topline} growth this quarter.
e.zh: 公司公布本季度营收总额增长强劲。

e.en: She bought the {topline} model with every feature.
e.zh: 她买了功能最全的最高级型号。

toploftical.t: 高傲自大的；装腔作势的

e.en: His {toploftical} speech annoyed the whole room.
e.zh: 他那番高傲做作的讲话惹恼了全场。

e.en: The review mocked the novel's {toploftical} tone.
e.zh: 那篇评论嘲讽了小说装腔作势的语气。

e.en: She answered {toploftily} and walked away.
e.zh: 她高傲地回答了一句，然后走开了。

e.en: The critic wrote {toploftily} about popular music.
e.zh: 那位评论家以自命不凡的口吻谈论流行音乐。

e.en: His {toploftiness} made teamwork almost impossible.
e.zh: 他的高傲让团队合作几乎无法进行。

e.en: The essay's {toploftiness} weakened its argument.
e.zh: 文章的自命不凡削弱了它的论证。

e.en: He became {toplofty} after his first success.
e.zh: 第一次成功后，他变得自命不凡。

e.en: Her {toplofty} manner hid deep insecurity.
e.zh: 她高傲的态度掩盖了内心的不安。

topmaker.t: 陀螺制造者；上衣制作者

e.en: The village {topmaker} carved toys from maple wood.
e.zh: 村里的陀螺匠用枫木雕刻玩具。

e.en: A skilled {topmaker} finished the jacket by hand.
e.zh: 一位熟练的上衣制作者手工完成了那件夹克。

e.en: The {topman} climbed quickly into the rigging.
e.zh: 那名桅楼水手迅速爬上了索具。

e.en: The newspaper called him the firm's {topman}.
e.zh: 报纸称他为这家公司的最高负责人。

e.en: The storm snapped the ship's {topmast}.
e.zh: 暴风雨折断了船上的上桅。

e.en: A lookout climbed the {topmast} at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时，一名瞭望员爬上了中桅。

e.en: The carpenter lifted a heavy {topmaul}.
e.zh: 木匠举起一把沉重的大木槌。

e.en: They used a {topmaul} to drive the wedge deeper.
e.zh: 他们用重锤把楔子打得更深。

e.en: The hotel offers {topnotch} service all year.
e.zh: 这家酒店全年提供一流服务。

e.en: She gave a {topnotch} performance in the final.
e.zh: 她在决赛中表现得非常出色。

e.en: The school honored every {topnotcher} at graduation.
e.zh: 学校在毕业典礼上表彰了每位优等生。

e.en: He was a {topnotcher} among young trial lawyers.
e.zh: 他是年轻出庭律师中的顶尖人物。

e.en: The telescope used a {topocentric} coordinate system.
e.zh: 这台望远镜使用以观测地点为中心的坐标系统。

e.en: A {topocentric} view corrects for the observer's position.
e.zh: 以观测地点为中心的视角会校正观测者的位置。

topochemical.t: 拓扑化学的；定位化学的

e.en: The paper described a {topochemical} reaction in crystals.
e.zh: 论文描述了晶体中的一种拓扑化学反应。

e.en: Researchers studied the {topochemical} control of polymer growth.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了聚合物生长的拓扑化学控制。

e.en: Her thesis focused on {topochemistry} in solid materials.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于固体材料中的拓扑化学。

e.en: Modern {topochemistry} explains reactions shaped by structure.
e.zh: 现代拓扑化学解释了受结构影响的反应。

topocline.t: 地理渐变群；地域性渐变

e.en: The species shows a clear {topocline} across the valley.
e.zh: 这个物种在山谷两侧呈现明显的地域性渐变。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {topocline} in shell color.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了贝壳颜色的地理渐变。

e.en: The surveyor made a detailed {topograph} of the hill.
e.zh: 测量员绘制了那座山丘的详细地形图。

e.en: Engineers tried to {topograph} the river basin accurately.
e.zh: 工程师们试图准确描绘该流域的地形。

topoi.t: 主题；惯用论题；固定母题

e.en: The critic traced several classical {topoi} through the poem.
e.zh: 评论家在诗中追溯了几个古典主题。

e.en: Political speeches often recycle familiar {topoi} about freedom.
e.zh: 政治演讲常会重复关于自由的熟悉论题。

toponeurosis.t: 局部神经症；局部神经紊乱

e.en: The old textbook classified the pain as {toponeurosis}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把这种疼痛归为局部神经症。

e.en: Few modern doctors still use the term {toponeurosis}.
e.zh: 现在很少有医生还使用局部神经症这个术语。

e.en: Her dissertation examined rural naming patterns through {toponomasiology}.
e.zh: 她的论文从地名命名学角度研究乡村命名规律。

e.en: In {toponomasiology}, local legends can explain unusual place names.
e.zh: 在地名命名学中，地方传说能解释一些奇特地名。

e.en: The island's {toponomy} preserves traces of several languages.
e.zh: 这座岛的地名体系保留了多种语言的痕迹。

e.en: She studies {toponomy} to understand how communities name landscapes.
e.zh: 她研究地名学，以理解社区如何命名地貌。

topontozone.t: 特定地点生态带；地点生物带

e.en: The survey described each {topontozone} in careful detail.
e.zh: 这份调查细致描述了每个特定地点生态带。

e.en: A dry ridge may form a distinct {topontozone} within the valley.
e.zh: 干燥的山脊可能在山谷中形成独特的地点生物带。

e.en: The map includes notes on {toponymic} changes after independence.
e.zh: 这张地图注明了独立后地名方面的变化。

e.en: Her {toponymic} research focused on river names.
e.zh: 她的地名研究集中在河流名称上。

e.en: A {toponymist} explained why the village had two names.
e.zh: 一位地名学家解释了这个村庄为何有两个名字。

e.en: The council consulted a {toponymist} before renaming the street.
e.zh: 市政会在给街道改名之前咨询了地名研究者。

e.en: The region's {toponymy} reflects centuries of migration.
e.zh: 该地区的地名反映了数百年的迁徙历史。

e.en: He teaches {toponymy} as part of historical geography.
e.zh: 他把地名学作为历史地理的一部分来教授。

topophylaxis.t: 局部防御；部位保护反应

e.en: The article used {topophylaxis} to describe local tissue resistance.
e.zh: 文章用局部防御来描述组织的局部抵抗力。

e.en: Inflammation may contribute to {topophylaxis} around the wound.
e.zh: 炎症可能有助于伤口周围的部位保护反应。

e.en: The physician mentioned {toposcopy} in the clinical lecture.
e.zh: 医生在临床讲座中提到了部位检查。

e.en: Early diagnosticians relied on {toposcopy} to locate the disorder.
e.zh: 早期诊断者依靠局部观察法来定位病变。

e.en: The mineral shows clear {topotaxy} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这种矿物在显微镜下呈现清晰的定向排列。

e.en: Researchers studied the {topotaxy} of crystals during growth.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了晶体生长过程中的位置排列。

e.en: The technician saved the patient's {topothermogram} for comparison.
e.zh: 技术员保存了患者的体表温度图以便比较。

e.en: A {topothermogram} can reveal warmer areas of tissue.
e.zh: 局部热图可以显示组织中温度较高的区域。

e.en: The paper discussed {topotropism} in developing plant roots.
e.zh: 论文讨论了植物根系发育中的定向趋性。

e.en: Light can influence {topotropism} in some simple organisms.
e.zh: 光会影响某些简单生物的位置趋向性。

topotype.t: 模式产地标本；同产地标本

e.en: The museum keeps a {topotype} from the original collection site.
e.zh: 博物馆保存着一件来自原采集地的模式产地标本。

e.en: A {topotype} helps compare later specimens with the described species.
e.zh: 同产地标本有助于把后来的标本与已描述物种比较。

e.en: She spent the morning {topping-up} the water tanks.
e.zh: 她上午一直在给水箱加满水。

e.en: Online {topping-up} made the phone plan easier to manage.
e.zh: 线上充值让手机套餐更容易管理。

toppy.t: 头重脚轻的；价格偏高的

e.en: The sculpture looked {toppy} on its narrow base.
e.zh: 这座雕塑放在狭窄底座上显得头重脚轻。

e.en: Analysts warned that the market was getting {toppy}.
e.zh: 分析师警告说市场价格已显得偏高。

e.en: He rested his elbows on the fence {toprail}.
e.zh: 他把胳膊肘搁在栅栏的上横杆上。

e.en: The carpenter replaced the cracked {toprail} on the porch.
e.zh: 木匠更换了门廊上开裂的顶部栏杆。

e.en: The old manual called the upper layer the {topsin}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把上层称为顶部部分。

e.en: Workers removed the {topsin} before repairing the frame.
e.zh: 工人在修理框架前拆下了顶层。

topslicing.t: 削减高额部分；顶部切片

e.en: The policy used {topslicing} to reduce the largest payouts.
e.zh: 该政策通过削减高额部分来降低最大支出。

e.en: The lab tried {topslicing} the sample for microscopic study.
e.zh: 实验室尝试对样本做顶部切片以便显微观察。

e.en: The {topsman} climbed carefully along the rigging.
e.zh: 那名高处作业者小心地沿着索具攀爬。

e.en: A skilled {topsman} was essential on the old sailing ship.
e.zh: 在旧式帆船上，熟练的顶端工人非常重要。

topsmen.t: 高处作业者们；顶端工人们

e.en: The {topsmen} secured the mast before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，高处作业者们固定好了桅杆。

e.en: Experienced {topsmen} trained the new crew in the rigging.
e.zh: 经验丰富的顶端工人们训练新船员使用索具。

e.en: Use heavy thread to {topstitch} the jacket seam.
e.zh: 用粗线在夹克接缝处压明线。

e.en: A neat {topstitch} gives the pocket a finished look.
e.zh: 整齐的明线缝让口袋看起来更精致。

e.en: The jeans have orange {topstitching} along the pockets.
e.zh: 这条牛仔裤口袋边有橙色明线。

e.en: Careful {topstitching} keeps the lining flat.
e.zh: 细致的表面压线能让衬里保持平整。

e.en: The sudden strike threw the office into {topsy-turvydom}.
e.zh: 突如其来的罢工让办公室陷入混乱。

e.en: In that satire, politics becomes pure {topsy-turvydom}.
e.zh: 在那部讽刺作品中，政治成了彻底颠倒的世界。

e.en: The architect added a {topview} of the garden.
e.zh: 建筑师加了一张花园的俯视图。

e.en: Switch to {topview} before placing the furniture.
e.zh: 摆放家具前先切换到顶视图。

e.en: The tower's {topwork} was damaged by wind.
e.zh: 塔楼的上部结构被风损坏了。

e.en: Carved {topwork} gave the cabinet a formal look.
e.zh: 雕刻的顶上装饰让柜子显得更正式。

e.en: The hat was woven from {toquilla} straw.
e.zh: 这顶帽子是用托基亚棕榈纤维编成的。

e.en: Fine {toquilla} makes a lighter Panama hat.
e.zh: 优质托基亚纤维能做出更轻的巴拿马帽。

e.en: The mine once produced {torbanite} for oil.
e.zh: 这座矿曾开采托班油页岩来炼油。

e.en: Geologists identified the dark rock as {torbanite}.
e.zh: 地质学家认出这块黑色岩石是托班油页岩。

e.en: Bright green {torbernite} coated the fracture.
e.zh: 鲜绿色的铜铀云母矿覆盖着裂缝。

e.en: Collectors handle {torbernite} with care because it is radioactive.
e.zh: 收藏者会小心处理铜铀云母矿，因为它有放射性。

e.en: The warrior wore a bronze {torc}.
e.zh: 那名武士戴着一只青铜颈环。

e.en: A silver {torc} was found in the burial mound.
e.zh: 墓冢里发现了一只银制金属环。

e.en: A brass {torchere} stood beside the sofa.
e.zh: 沙发旁立着一盏黄铜高脚灯。

e.en: The museum restored the marble {torchere}.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了那座大理石高脚灯架。

e.en: The old curtain was edged with {torchon} lace.
e.zh: 旧窗帘边上镶着粗花边。

e.en: She wiped the counter with a clean {torchon}.
e.zh: 她用一块干净的厨房布擦台面。

e.en: The campers used dry {torchwood} to start the fire.
e.zh: 露营者用干燥的易燃木材来生火。

e.en: A grove of {torchwood} grew near the coast.
e.zh: 海岸附近长着一片火炬木林。

e.en: She sang a {torchy} ballad in the lounge.
e.zh: 她在酒廊里唱了一首感伤深情的情歌。

e.en: The film's {torchy} mood suited the rainy night.
e.zh: 电影感伤的氛围很适合那个雨夜。

e.en: The {torera} entered the ring calmly.
e.zh: 那位女斗牛士平静地走进斗牛场。

e.en: A famous {torera} challenged old traditions.
e.zh: 一位著名女斗牛士挑战了旧传统。

e.en: The museum displayed a Greek {toreuma}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件希腊金属浮雕作品。

e.en: Experts studied the silver {toreuma} under bright light.
e.zh: 专家在强光下研究那件银质金属浮雕。

e.en: The cup shows delicate {toreutic} workmanship.
e.zh: 这只杯子展现出精细的金属浮雕工艺。

e.en: She specialized in {toreutic} art from antiquity.
e.zh: 她专攻古代金属浮雕艺术。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on ancient {toreutics}.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于古代金属浮雕术的论文。

e.en: {Toreutics} requires patience and precise tools.
e.zh: 金属浮雕术需要耐心和精密工具。

e.en: The valley had dark, {torfaceous} soil.
e.zh: 山谷里有深色的泥炭质土壤。

e.en: Plants thrive in the damp {torfaceous} ground.
e.zh: 植物在潮湿的泥炭质地面上生长良好。

e.en: The patient needed a {toric} contact lens.
e.zh: 这名患者需要一片复曲面隐形眼镜。

e.en: The model uses a {toric} surface in its geometry.
e.zh: 这个模型在几何结构中使用了环面曲面。

e.en: A red {torii} marked the shrine entrance.
e.zh: 一座红色鸟居标示着神社入口。

e.en: Visitors walked beneath several stone {torii}.
e.zh: 游客从几座石制鸟居下走过。

e.en: The bull waited inside the {toril}.
e.zh: 公牛在斗牛栏里等待。

e.en: Workers repaired the wooden {toril} before the festival.
e.zh: 节日前工人修好了木制牛栏。

e.en: The herbalist dried {tormentil} for winter remedies.
e.zh: 草药师把委陵菜晒干，留作冬季药方。

e.en: A patch of {tormentil} grew beside the path.
e.zh: 小路旁长着一片委陵菜。

tormentress.t: 折磨人的女人；女施虐者

e.en: The novel casts her as a cruel {tormentress}.
e.zh: 小说把她塑造成一个残酷折磨他人的女人。

e.en: He called anxiety his private {tormentress}.
e.zh: 他把焦虑称作自己私下的折磨者。

e.en: The doctor noted severe {tormina} after the meal.
e.zh: 医生记录说他饭后出现严重腹绞痛。

e.en: Old medical texts describe {tormina} in vivid detail.
e.zh: 旧医学文献对腹绞痛有生动细致的描述。

e.en: The students identified several {tornariae} under the microscope.
e.zh: 学生们在显微镜下辨认出几只柱头虫幼体。

e.en: Marine biologists compared {tornariae} from two coastal sites.
e.zh: 海洋生物学家比较了两个海岸地点的柱头虫幼体。

e.en: A {tornillo} tree shaded the dry trail.
e.zh: 一棵螺旋豆树为干燥的小径投下阴影。

e.en: The rancher collected {tornillo} pods for fuel.
e.zh: 牧场主收集螺旋豆荚当燃料。

e.en: The specialist diagnosed chronic {tornwaldtitis} after the scan.
e.zh: 专科医生看片后诊断为慢性鼻咽囊炎。

e.en: Persistent throat discomfort can suggest {tornwaldtitis}.
e.zh: 持续的咽喉不适可能提示鼻咽囊炎。

e.en: The crowd cheered when the {toro} entered the ring.
e.zh: 公牛进入斗牛场时，人群欢呼起来。

e.en: The chef served fatty {toro} with warm rice.
e.zh: 厨师把肥美的金枪鱼腹肉配温米饭端上来。

e.en: A {Torontonian} showed us the quickest subway route.
e.zh: 一位多伦多人给我们指了最快的地铁路线。

e.en: Her {Torontonian} accent softened after years abroad.
e.zh: 她在国外多年后，多伦多口音变淡了。

torose.t: 圆柱状凸起的；节状肿胀的

e.en: The seed pod had a {torose} surface.
e.zh: 这个豆荚表面呈节状凸起。

e.en: Botanists described the stem as {torose} and rough.
e.zh: 植物学家把这根茎描述为圆凸而粗糙。

e.en: The drawing exaggerated the root's {torosity}.
e.zh: 这幅图夸大了根部的节状凸起。

e.en: Its unusual {torosity} helped identify the specimen.
e.zh: 它异常的凸起形态帮助人们鉴定了标本。

e.en: The sailor checked the {torp} before dawn.
e.zh: 水手在黎明前检查了那枚鱼雷。

e.en: They called the small attack boat a {torp}.
e.zh: 他们把那艘小型攻击艇简称为鱼雷艇。

e.en: The {torpedoman} inspected the tubes before launch.
e.zh: 鱼雷兵在发射前检查了发射管。

e.en: A retired {torpedoman} explained the old submarine controls.
e.zh: 一名退役鱼雷操作员讲解了旧潜艇的控制装置。

e.en: The cold seemed to {torpefy} his fingers.
e.zh: 寒冷似乎让他的手指变得麻木。

e.en: Long speeches can {torpefy} even patient listeners.
e.zh: 冗长的演讲连有耐心的听众也会听得迟钝。

e.en: A strange {torpescence} spread through his arm.
e.zh: 一种奇怪的麻木感传遍了他的手臂。

e.en: The afternoon heat brought a mood of {torpescence}.
e.zh: 午后的暑气带来一种昏沉迟钝的气氛。

e.en: The wartime torpedo carried a charge of {torpex}.
e.zh: 那枚战时鱼雷装有托佩克斯烈性炸药。

e.en: Engineers studied {torpex} for its underwater blast effect.
e.zh: 工程师研究托佩克斯炸药的水下爆炸效果。

e.en: Winter brought a heavy sense of {torpidity}.
e.zh: 冬天带来一种沉重的无精打采感。

e.en: The drug caused temporary {torpidity} in the patient.
e.zh: 这种药让病人暂时变得麻木迟钝。

e.en: His {torpified} hands could barely hold the cup.
e.zh: 他麻木的双手几乎握不住杯子。

e.en: The audience sat {torpified} by the endless lecture.
e.zh: 听众被没完没了的讲座弄得昏昏沉沉。

e.en: The bitter wind began to {torpify} her face.
e.zh: 刺骨的寒风开始让她的脸变得麻木。

e.en: Repetition can {torpify} a lively discussion.
e.zh: 反复空谈会让活跃的讨论变得沉闷迟钝。

torpifying.t: 使人麻木的；令人迟钝的

e.en: The medicine had a {torpifying} effect.
e.zh: 这种药有使人麻木的作用。

e.en: It was a {torpifying} afternoon of paperwork.
e.zh: 那是一个被文书工作拖得昏沉的下午。

e.en: The lecture had a strangely {torporific} rhythm.
e.zh: 这场讲座的节奏奇怪地令人昏昏欲睡。

e.en: Warm air made the room feel {torporific}.
e.zh: 温暖的空气让房间显得令人昏沉。

torquate.t: 有项圈状斑纹的；戴颈环的

e.en: The guide pointed out a {torquate} bird near the reeds.
e.zh: 向导指出芦苇旁有一只带项圈状斑纹的鸟。

e.en: A {torquate} pattern marked the snake's neck.
e.zh: 蛇颈部有一圈项圈状花纹。

torquated.t: 有颈环的；带项圈状斑的

e.en: The {torquated} pigeon stood out among the flock.
e.zh: 那只有颈环斑的鸽子在鸟群中很显眼。

e.en: Collectors prized the beetle's {torquated} markings.
e.zh: 收藏者看重这种甲虫的项圈状斑纹。

e.en: The mathematician described the solution set as a {torsor}.
e.zh: 那位数学家把解集描述为一个挠子。

e.en: A {torsor} has no preferred origin point.
e.zh: 挠子没有一个预先指定的原点。

e.en: The court ordered the {tort-feasor} to pay damages.
e.zh: 法院命令该侵权行为人支付赔偿金。

e.en: A careless driver may be treated as a {tort-feasor}.
e.zh: 粗心的司机可能会被视为侵权行为人。

e.en: She bought a spicy {torta} for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐买了一个辣味墨西哥夹馅面包。

e.en: The cafe serves a chicken {torta} with avocado.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应加鳄梨的鸡肉墨西哥夹馅面包。

e.en: The injured cyclist sued the {tortfeasor}.
e.zh: 受伤的骑车人起诉了侵权行为人。

e.en: Insurance may cover damages caused by a {tortfeasor}.
e.zh: 保险可能承保侵权行为人造成的损害。

e.en: The baby was diagnosed with {torticollis}.
e.zh: 这个婴儿被诊断出患有斜颈。

e.en: Physical therapy can help some cases of {torticollis}.
e.zh: 物理治疗能帮助部分斜颈病例。

e.en: The vine had a {tortile} stem.
e.zh: 那根藤有一条扭曲盘绕的茎。

e.en: A {tortile} column supported the old porch.
e.zh: 一根螺旋形柱子支撑着旧门廊。

e.en: The botanist noted the stem's unusual {tortility}.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这根茎异常的扭曲性。

e.en: The design emphasizes the {tortility} of the metal ribbons.
e.zh: 这个设计强调金属带的盘绕感。

e.en: The artist blended the charcoal with a {tortillon}.
e.zh: 画家用擦笔把木炭笔痕晕开。

e.en: A clean {tortillon} gives softer shading.
e.zh: 干净的纸卷擦笔能产生更柔和的阴影。

e.en: The specialist examined her for {tortipelvis}.
e.zh: 专科医生检查她是否有骨盆扭斜。

e.en: Severe {tortipelvis} can affect posture and walking.
e.zh: 严重的骨盆扭斜会影响姿势和行走。

e.en: The sculpture used {tortive} lines to suggest motion.
e.zh: 这座雕塑用扭曲的线条表现运动感。

e.en: A {tortive} path led through the garden.
e.zh: 一条弯弯绕绕的小路穿过花园。

e.en: A {tortoiseshell-cat} slept on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只玳瑁猫睡在窗台上。

e.en: The shelter advertised a shy {tortoiseshell-cat}.
e.zh: 收容所发布了一只胆小玳瑁猫的领养信息。

e.en: The restaurant served almond {tortoni} after dinner.
e.zh: 餐厅在晚餐后供应杏仁托托尼冰淇淋甜点。

e.en: She remembered {tortoni} from old Italian bakeries.
e.zh: 她记得老意大利面包店里的托托尼甜点。

e.en: The larvae of a {tortricid} damaged the apple trees.
e.zh: 一种卷蛾科昆虫的幼虫损害了苹果树。

e.en: Researchers trapped several {tortricid} moths overnight.
e.zh: 研究人员一夜间诱捕到几只卷蛾科蛾子。

e.en: The {tortrix} moth is a common orchard pest.
e.zh: 卷叶蛾是果园里常见的害虫。

e.en: Leaves curled tightly where the {tortrix} larvae fed.
e.zh: 卷叶蛾幼虫取食的地方叶片紧紧卷起。

e.en: The river followed a {tortuose} course through the valley.
e.zh: 那条河沿着弯曲的路线穿过山谷。

e.en: His argument was clever but {tortuose}.
e.zh: 他的论证很聪明，但过于迂回曲折。

e.en: Doctors measured the vessel's {tortuosity} on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描图上测量血管的弯曲度。

e.en: The road's {tortuosity} made the journey slow.
e.zh: 道路迂回曲折，使这段旅程变得缓慢。

e.en: The cruel regime treated prisoners as {torturable} bodies.
e.zh: 残酷政权把囚犯当作可以拷打的身体。

e.en: No person should be considered {torturable} under law.
e.zh: 法律上不应把任何人视为可以遭受酷刑。

e.en: The wait became {torturesome} as the hours passed.
e.zh: 随着时间流逝，等待变得十分折磨人。

e.en: He described the recovery as slow and {torturesome}.
e.zh: 他形容康复过程缓慢而痛苦。

e.en: The sample contained {torula} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下的样本含有圆酵母细胞。

e.en: Some food products use {torula} yeast for flavor.
e.zh: 一些食品会用圆酵母来增加风味。

torulae.t: 圆酵母复数；念珠状真菌

e.en: Several {torulae} appeared in the stained culture.
e.zh: 染色培养物中出现了几个圆酵母样细胞。

e.en: The report listed {torulae} among the observed yeasts.
e.zh: 报告把圆酵母列入观察到的酵母之中。

e.en: The old paper discussed {torulin} as a yeast product.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文把酵母核酸衍生物作为酵母产物讨论。

e.en: Chemists once studied {torulin} for its nutritional value.
e.zh: 化学家曾研究这种酵母衍生物的营养价值。

torulosis.t: 圆酵母病；隐球菌病旧称

e.en: The textbook used {torulosis} for a fungal infection.
e.zh: 这本教材用圆酵母病指一种真菌感染。

e.en: Older records described the case as {torulosis}.
e.zh: 较早的病历把这个病例描述为圆酵母病。

e.en: The anatomist pointed to a small {torulus}.
e.zh: 解剖学家指着一个小隆起。

e.en: A rounded {torulus} marked the edge of the structure.
e.zh: 一个圆形小凸起标示出该结构的边缘。

torque-to-inertia.t: 扭矩与惯量之比；转矩惯量比

e.en: The engineer compared the motor's {torque-to-inertia} ratio before choosing it.
e.zh: 工程师在选用电机前比较了它的扭矩与惯量之比。

e.en: A high {torque-to-inertia} value helps the actuator respond quickly.
e.zh: 较高的转矩惯量比有助于执行器快速响应。

e.en: The technician attached a {torquemeter} to the rotating shaft.
e.zh: 技术员把扭矩计接到旋转轴上。

e.en: A digital {torquemeter} recorded every change in load.
e.zh: 数字转矩测量仪记录了负载的每一次变化。

e.en: The beans changed color during {torrefaction}.
e.zh: 豆子在焙烧过程中变了颜色。

e.en: Wood pellets become drier and darker after {torrefaction}.
e.zh: 木质颗粒经过低温炭化处理后会更干、更深色。

e.en: The brewery tested {torrefied} barley in the new recipe.
e.zh: 啤酒厂在新配方中测试了经焙烧的大麦。

e.en: {Torrefied} biomass is easier to grind and store.
e.zh: 低温炭化的生物质更容易粉碎和储存。

e.en: They {torrefy} coffee beans to develop a deeper aroma.
e.zh: 他们焙烧咖啡豆，以形成更浓的香气。

e.en: The plant can {torrefy} wood waste before converting it to fuel.
e.zh: 这家工厂能先将木材废料低温炭化，再转化为燃料。

torrefying.t: 正在焙烧的；低温炭化过程

e.en: The lab is {torrefying} samples at different temperatures.
e.zh: 实验室正在用不同温度焙烧样品。

e.en: {Torrefying} wet biomass takes more energy than drying it first.
e.zh: 直接对潮湿生物质做低温炭化，比先干燥更耗能。

e.en: The collection includes a tiny specimen of {torreyite}.
e.zh: 这批藏品中有一小块托雷石标本。

e.en: Few geology students ever see {torreyite} outside a museum.
e.zh: 很少有地质学生能在博物馆之外见到托雷石。

e.en: The {torridity} of the desert surprised the visitors.
e.zh: 沙漠的酷热让游客们很意外。

e.en: Poets often used {torridity} to suggest passion as well as heat.
e.zh: 诗人常用炎热来暗示激情，也指真实的高温。

e.en: The old recipe says to {torrify} the grain before grinding it.
e.zh: 这份旧食谱说要先把谷物烤干再研磨。

e.en: Strong sun can {torrify} exposed soil in a few hours.
e.zh: 强烈阳光能在几小时内把裸露土壤晒得焦热。

torrone.t: 意式牛轧糖；杏仁蜂蜜糖

e.en: She bought a box of {torrone} for the holiday table.
e.zh: 她买了一盒意式牛轧糖放在节日餐桌上。

e.en: Traditional {torrone} is made with honey, nuts, and egg white.
e.zh: 传统意式牛轧糖用蜂蜜、坚果和蛋白制成。

e.en: The paper describes a {torsal} deformation of the beam.
e.zh: 论文描述了梁的一种扭转变形。

e.en: A {torsal} stress appeared near the joint.
e.zh: 接头附近出现了与扭转有关的应力。

torsalo.t: 人肤蝇幼虫；皮下寄生蛆

e.en: The doctor removed a {torsalo} from the traveler's skin.
e.zh: 医生从那名旅行者的皮肤里取出了一个人肤蝇幼虫。

e.en: In rural clinics, {torsalo} infections are treated with careful extraction.
e.zh: 在乡村诊所，人肤蝇幼虫感染通常通过仔细取出虫体来处理。

e.en: The knight's crest rested on a blue and silver {torse}.
e.zh: 骑士的饰章立在蓝银相间的纹章头饰扭带上。

e.en: A decorative {torse} framed the top of the old canopy.
e.zh: 一条装饰性扭索围住了旧华盖的顶部。

e.en: The manuscript shows a small {torsel} above the shield.
e.zh: 手稿中盾牌上方画着一条小纹章扭带。

e.en: A carved {torsel} runs along the edge of the frame.
e.zh: 一条雕刻的小扭索沿着画框边缘延伸。

torsi.t: 躯干复数；扭转相关量复数

e.en: The art class studied several marble {torsi} from Rome.
e.zh: 美术课研究了几件来自罗马的大理石躯干雕像。

e.en: The equation lists the {torsi} measured along each axis.
e.zh: 方程列出了沿各轴测得的扭转量。

torsibility.t: 可扭转性；抗扭变形能力

e.en: The alloy's {torsibility} made it useful in flexible couplings.
e.zh: 这种合金的可扭转性使它适合用于柔性联轴器。

e.en: Engineers tested the {torsibility} of the cable under repeated load.
e.zh: 工程师在反复载荷下测试了电缆的抗扭变形能力。

torsiograph.t: 扭转记录仪；转矩曲线仪

e.en: The {torsiograph} traced the shaft's twisting motion on paper.
e.zh: 扭转记录仪把轴的扭转运动描绘在纸上。

e.en: An old {torsiograph} still stands in the mechanics laboratory.
e.zh: 力学实验室里仍放着一台旧式转矩曲线仪。

e.en: The researcher used a {torsiometer} to measure angular strain.
e.zh: 研究人员用扭转计测量角应变。

e.en: A calibrated {torsiometer} is essential for this fatigue test.
e.zh: 这项疲劳测试需要一台校准过的转矩测量仪。

e.en: The model assumes a {torsionless} connection in space-time.
e.zh: 该模型假定时空中存在无扭转的联络。

e.en: A {torsionless} shaft would not twist under the applied load.
e.zh: 无扭转的轴在施加载荷下不会发生扭曲。

e.en: The menu listed baked {torsk} with potatoes.
e.zh: 菜单上列有配土豆的烤鳕鱼。

e.en: Local fishermen once caught {torsk} in the cold northern waters.
e.zh: 当地渔民曾在寒冷的北方水域捕捞这种鳕鱼。

e.en: The engineer checked the {torslograph} after the test run.
e.zh: 试运行后，工程师检查了扭转记录仪。

e.en: A {torslograph} can reveal sudden changes in twisting force.
e.zh: 扭力图仪能显示扭转力的突然变化。

totalizator.t: 赛马赌金计算器；彩票机

e.en: The old racetrack installed a {totalizator} to calculate betting odds.
e.zh: 那座老赛马场安装了一台赛马赌金计算器来计算赔率。

e.en: A mechanical {totalizator} once displayed the changing pool for each race.
e.zh: 一台机械式彩票机曾经显示每场比赛不断变化的奖池。

e.en: The clerk will {totall} the expenses before lunch.
e.zh: 职员会在午饭前把费用合计出来。

e.en: His notes {totall} the losses from the storm.
e.zh: 他的笔记总计了那场风暴造成的损失。

e.en: The report gave the {totany} of ships lost that winter.
e.zh: 报告列出了那个冬天沉没船只的总数。

e.en: She considered the {totany} of evidence before judging the case.
e.zh: 她在判断此案前考虑了全部证据。

e.en: A carved {totem-pole} stood near the village entrance.
e.zh: 一根雕刻的图腾柱立在村口附近。

e.en: New interns are usually low on the office {totem-pole}.
e.zh: 新实习生在办公室的等级体系里通常地位很低。

e.en: Her thesis examines {totemism} in several Indigenous communities.
e.zh: 她的论文研究几个原住民社群中的图腾崇拜。

e.en: Early anthropologists often treated {totemism} as a universal stage of religion.
e.zh: 早期人类学家常把图腾制度视为宗教发展的普遍阶段。

e.en: The elder was described as a {totemist} by the visiting scholar.
e.zh: 来访学者把那位长者称为图腾崇拜者。

e.en: A strict {totemist} might interpret the symbol as a clan ancestor.
e.zh: 严格的图腾论者可能会把这个符号解释为氏族祖先。

e.en: The mask has clear {totemistic} features in its animal form.
e.zh: 这副面具的动物造型带有明显的图腾式特征。

e.en: They studied {totemistic} beliefs without reducing them to superstition.
e.zh: 他们研究图腾崇拜的信仰，而没有简单贬为迷信。

e.en: Each {totemite} observed the food taboos of the clan.
e.zh: 每个同一图腾氏族成员都遵守氏族的食物禁忌。

e.en: The ceremony welcomed a young {totemite} into adult duties.
e.zh: 仪式欢迎一名年轻的图腾氏族成员承担成人职责。

e.en: He took one road, and she chose {tother}.
e.zh: 他走了一条路，而她选择了另一条。

e.en: In old ballads, {tother} knight often arrives too late.
e.zh: 在古老民谣里，那另一位骑士常常来得太晚。

totient.t: 欧拉函数值；互素数个数

e.en: The {totient} of nine is six.
e.zh: 九的欧拉函数值是六。

e.en: This algorithm computes the {totient} for every integer in the range.
e.zh: 这个算法会计算范围内每个整数的互素数个数。

e.en: Pelicans have {totipalmate} feet with all toes joined by webbing.
e.zh: 鹈鹕有全蹼足，所有脚趾都由蹼相连。

e.en: The guide pointed out the bird's {totipalmate} tracks in the mud.
e.zh: 向导指出泥地里那种鸟留下的全蹼足足迹。

e.en: The textbook illustrates {totipalmation} in cormorants and pelicans.
e.zh: 教材用鸬鹚和鹈鹕来说明全蹼足结构。

e.en: Strong {totipalmation} helps some seabirds push through water efficiently.
e.zh: 发达的全蹼足结构帮助一些海鸟高效划水。

e.en: Plant cells can sometimes regain {totipotency} in culture.
e.zh: 植物细胞有时能在培养中恢复全能性。

e.en: Embryologists study {totipotency} during the earliest stages of development.
e.zh: 胚胎学家研究发育最早阶段的发育全潜能。

e.en: A {totipotent} cell can give rise to an entire organism.
e.zh: 一个具全能性的细胞可以发育成完整个体。

e.en: The researchers identified a brief {totipotent} state after fertilization.
e.zh: 研究人员发现受精后会出现短暂的全能状态。

e.en: The children began to {totle} together in the corner.
e.zh: 孩子们开始在角落里轻声絮语。

e.en: He would {totle} old stories when the fire burned low.
e.zh: 炉火渐暗时，他会低声讲起旧故事。

e.en: The sleepy {tott} clung to his mother's coat.
e.zh: 那个困倦的小孩紧紧抓着母亲的外套。

e.en: He poured himself a small {tott} before bed.
e.zh: 睡前他给自己倒了一小杯酒。

e.en: The old table looked {tottery} but still held the vase.
e.zh: 那张旧桌子看起来摇摇欲坠，但仍撑住了花瓶。

e.en: After the fever, he felt weak and {tottery} on the stairs.
e.zh: 发烧之后，他上楼梯时觉得虚弱而步履蹒跚。

toryhillite.t: 托里希尔岩，一种稀有岩石或矿物名

e.en: The sample was tentatively identified as {toryhillite} by the curator.
e.zh: 馆长暂时把这个样本鉴定为托里希尔岩。

e.en: A thin vein of {toryhillite} crossed the darker stone.
e.zh: 一条细细的托里希尔岩脉穿过较深色的石头。

e.en: The chemist recorded the compound as a {tosate} in her notes.
e.zh: 化学家在笔记中把这种化合物记为托萨酸盐。

e.en: This {tosate} dissolves slowly in cold water.
e.zh: 这种托萨酸盐在冷水中溶解得很慢。

toscanite.t: 托斯卡纳岩，一种火山岩

e.en: The cliff contains layers of {toscanite} and ash.
e.zh: 这处峭壁含有托斯卡纳岩和火山灰的层次。

e.en: Geologists classified the pale rock as {toscanite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种浅色岩石归类为托斯卡纳岩。

e.en: He was dismissed as a hopeless {toss-pot} by the regulars.
e.zh: 常客们把他当成无可救药的酒鬼看待。

e.en: Don't be such a {toss-pot} about a simple mistake.
e.zh: 别为一个小错表现得像个没用的蠢货。

toss-up.t: 难分胜负；难以抉择的事

e.en: The final match is a real {toss-up}.
e.zh: 最后一场比赛真的很难分胜负。

e.en: It was a {toss-up} between staying home and going out.
e.zh: 是待在家里还是出门，当时很难抉择。

toss-ups.t: 难分胜负的局面；难以抉择的事

e.en: Several Senate races remain {toss-ups} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚还有几场参议院选举仍难分胜负。

e.en: The choices are all {toss-ups} at this point.
e.zh: 到这个阶段，这些选择都差不多难以取舍。

e.en: The wind began to {tossel} her loose hair.
e.zh: 风开始把她披散的头发吹得凌乱。

e.en: Please don't {tossel} the papers on my desk.
e.zh: 请别把我桌上的文件弄得乱七八糟。

e.en: The old novel calls him a lazy {tosspot}.
e.zh: 那本旧小说把他称作懒散的酒鬼。

e.en: Only a {tosspot} would shout at the waiter like that.
e.zh: 只有讨厌的蠢货才会那样冲服务员大喊。

tossup.t: 难分胜负；难以抉择的事

e.en: The election looks like a {tossup} in this district.
e.zh: 这个选区的选举看来难分胜负。

e.en: Dinner is a {tossup} between noodles and rice.
e.zh: 晚餐吃面还是吃饭有点难决定。

e.en: The bread was {tost} before the soup was served.
e.zh: 汤端上来之前，面包已经烤好了。

e.en: In the old recipe, the almonds are {tost} lightly.
e.zh: 在这份老食谱里，杏仁要稍微烘烤。

e.en: The report requires the {totalisation} of all regional sales.
e.zh: 这份报告需要汇总所有地区的销售额。

e.en: Critics warned against the {totalisation} of human experience into data.
e.zh: 批评者警告说，不应把人的经验完全总体化为数据。

e.en: The old racecourse still displays its mechanical {totalisator}.
e.zh: 那座旧赛马场仍展示着机械式赌注自动计算器。

e.en: Bettors watched the {totalisator} update the odds.
e.zh: 下注者看着赌注自动计算器更新赔率。

e.en: The clerk will {totalise} the receipts at closing time.
e.zh: 店员会在打烊时合计所有收据。

e.en: The theory tries to {totalise} every form of social life.
e.zh: 这套理论试图把各种社会生活形式都纳入整体解释。

totaliser.t: 合计器；赛马赌注计算器

e.en: The machine works as a simple {totaliser} for daily sales.
e.zh: 这台机器可作为每日销售额的简单合计器。

e.en: Crowds gathered near the {totaliser} before the race began.
e.zh: 比赛开始前，人群聚集在赌注计算器附近。

e.en: The software {totalises} the figures automatically each night.
e.zh: 这款软件每晚自动合计这些数字。

e.en: His argument {totalises} very different cultural practices.
e.zh: 他的论证把很不同的文化实践都作了总体化处理。

e.en: The essay criticizes political {totalism} in modern states.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评现代国家中的政治总体主义。

e.en: Religious {totalism} can leave little room for private doubt.
e.zh: 宗教上的绝对整体观可能几乎不给私人怀疑留下空间。

e.en: The movement developed a {totalistic} view of society.
e.zh: 这场运动形成了一种总体主义的社会观。

e.en: Her mentor rejected such {totalistic} explanations of art.
e.zh: 她的导师拒绝这种对艺术的绝对化解释。

totalitarianize.t: 使极权化；变成极权体制

e.en: The new laws could {totalitarianize} the political system.
e.zh: 这些新法律可能使政治制度走向极权化。

e.en: He argued that fear can {totalitarianize} ordinary institutions.
e.zh: 他认为恐惧会让普通机构变得极权化。

e.en: He embarrassed everyone by calling the waitress {totty}.
e.zh: 他把女服务员叫作漂亮妞儿，让大家都很尴尬。

e.en: The word {totty} sounds dated and offensive now.
e.zh: totty 这个词现在听起来过时又冒犯。

e.en: For a while, his recovery was {touch-and-go}.
e.zh: 有一段时间，他能否康复还很难说。

e.en: The landing was {touch-and-go} in the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中那次着陆十分惊险。

e.en: The child gently tapped the {touch-me-not} plant.
e.zh: 孩子轻轻碰了那株含羞草类植物。

e.en: A pink {touch-me-not} grew beside the garden wall.
e.zh: 花园墙边长着一株粉色凤仙花。

e.en: The kiosk has a bright {touch-screen} display.
e.zh: 那台自助终端有一块明亮的触摸屏。

e.en: She prefers {touch-screen} controls to small buttons.
e.zh: 比起小按钮，她更喜欢触屏控制。

e.en: The lamp has a {touch-sensitive} base.
e.zh: 这盏灯的底座是触摸感应的。

e.en: Some instruments use {touch-sensitive} keys.
e.zh: 有些乐器使用触敏按键。

e.en: Fairness became the {touch-stone} of the policy.
e.zh: 公平成了检验这项政策的标准。

e.en: The critic treated originality as his {touch-stone}.
e.zh: 那位评论家把原创性当作自己的试金石。

touch-tone.t: 按键式电话的；双音多频的

e.en: The bank menu asks for a {touch-tone} phone.
e.zh: 银行菜单要求使用按键式电话。

e.en: Older systems still recognize {touch-tone} signals.
e.zh: 一些老系统仍能识别双音多频信号。

e.en: I learned to {touch-type} at school.
e.zh: 我在学校学会了不看键盘打字。

e.en: People who {touch-type} often work faster.
e.zh: 会盲打的人通常工作更快。

touch-typed.t: 盲打了；不看键盘打出的

e.en: She {touch-typed} the report in an hour.
e.zh: 她一小时内盲打完了那份报告。

e.en: The notes were {touch-typed} without looking down.
e.zh: 这些笔记是不低头看键盘打出来的。

e.en: He {touch-types} quickly during meetings.
e.zh: 他开会时能很快地盲打。

e.en: Anyone who {touch-types} saves time on emails.
e.zh: 会盲打的人写邮件会省时间。

e.en: {Touch-typing} takes practice at first.
e.zh: 刚开始练盲打需要一些时间。

e.en: Her {touch-typing} improved after the course.
e.zh: 上完课程后，她的盲打水平提高了。

e.en: The photo needs a quick {touch-up}.
e.zh: 这张照片需要快速修一下。

e.en: She did a {touch-up} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前她补了一下妆。

e.en: The gunner cleaned the {touchhole} before firing.
e.zh: 炮手在开火前清理了点火孔。

e.en: Powder near the {touchhole} caught a spark.
e.zh: 点火孔附近的火药被火星引燃了。

e.en: Religion was the {touchiest} topic at dinner.
e.zh: 宗教是晚餐时最敏感的话题。

e.en: She is {touchiest} when people question her work.
e.zh: 别人质疑她的工作时，她最容易生气。

e.en: He replied {touchily} to a simple question.
e.zh: 面对一个简单问题，他很敏感地回了一句。

e.en: She reacted {touchily} when her plan was challenged.
e.zh: 她的计划受到质疑时，她反应得很易怒。

e.en: His {touchiness} made honest discussion difficult.
e.zh: 他的敏感让坦诚讨论变得困难。

e.en: The {touchiness} of the issue delayed the decision.
e.zh: 这个问题的棘手性拖延了决定。

e.en: The restroom has {touchless} soap dispensers.
e.zh: 洗手间装有免触摸的皂液器。

e.en: Many shops now accept {touchless} payments.
e.zh: 许多商店现在接受非接触式付款。

e.en: The old spoon bears a clear {touchmark}.
e.zh: 这把旧勺上有清晰的金银匠印记。

e.en: Experts used the {touchmark} to date the silver.
e.zh: 专家根据检验印来判断这件银器的年代。

e.en: The dry {touchwood} caught fire at once.
e.zh: 干燥的引火木一下子就着了。

e.en: We have had no delays, {touchwood}.
e.zh: 我们还没有遇到延误，碰木头求好运。

touchy-feely.t: 感情外露的；过分谈感受的

e.en: The workshop felt too {touchy-feely} for him.
e.zh: 他觉得这个工作坊太强调情感表达了。

e.en: She dislikes {touchy-feely} management advice.
e.zh: 她不喜欢那种过分谈感受的管理建议。

e.en: A {tough-looking} guard stood by the door.
e.zh: 门边站着一个看起来很凶悍的保安。

e.en: She bought a {tough-looking} pair of boots.
e.zh: 她买了一双看起来很结实的靴子。

tough-minded.t: 意志坚强的；务实强硬的

e.en: The company needs a {tough-minded} leader.
e.zh: 公司需要一位意志坚强的领导者。

e.en: Her {tough-minded} analysis ignored sentiment.
e.zh: 她务实强硬的分析没有顾及感情因素。

e.en: The interview was {toughish}, but she handled it well.
e.zh: 那场面试有点难，但她应对得很好。

e.en: He gave a {toughish} reply to the complaint.
e.zh: 他对投诉作出了略显强硬的回应。

e.en: This last question is a real {toughy}.
e.zh: 最后这个问题真是个难题。

e.en: The new coach is a {toughy} in training sessions.
e.zh: 新教练在训练课上是个难对付的人。

e.en: The school {tounament} starts on Friday.
e.zh: 学校的锦标赛周五开始。

e.en: Our team won the chess {tounament}.
e.zh: 我们队赢得了国际象棋比赛。

e.en: A loose {toup} of wool caught on the fence.
e.zh: 一绺松散的羊毛挂在了篱笆上。

e.en: The old dictionary defined {toup} as a small tuft.
e.zh: 那本旧词典把 toup 解释为一小撮毛。

e.en: The actor wore a small {toupet} on stage.
e.zh: 那位演员在舞台上戴了一顶小假发。

e.en: A gray {toupet} showed beneath his hat.
e.zh: 他的帽子下面露出一撮灰白头发。

e.en: The code calls {toupper} before comparing letters.
e.zh: 代码在比较字母前会调用转大写函数。

e.en: Use {toupper} to normalize the user's input.
e.zh: 用 toupper 把用户输入统一成大写。

e.en: The {tour-operator} arranged our hotels and buses.
e.zh: 旅行社经营者安排了我们的酒店和巴士。

e.en: A local {tour-operator} offers walking trips in the hills.
e.zh: 当地一家旅行社经营者提供山地徒步行程。

e.en: A green {touraco} flashed through the forest canopy.
e.zh: 一只绿色蕉鹃掠过森林树冠。

e.en: The guide pointed out a rare {touraco} near the river.
e.zh: 向导在河边指出了一只罕见的蕉鹃。

e.en: Dust rose in a sudden {tourbillion} across the road.
e.zh: 尘土突然在路面上卷成一股旋风。

e.en: The poem describes a {tourbillion} of confused emotions.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一团旋涡般混乱的情绪。

e.en: The watch has a visible {tourbillon} below the dial.
e.zh: 这块表的表盘下方能看到陀飞轮。

e.en: Leaves spun in a little {tourbillon} by the gate.
e.zh: 树叶在门口卷成一个小旋风。

e.en: They took a quick {tourie} around the old town.
e.zh: 他们在老城区短短游览了一圈。

e.en: The students planned a weekend {tourie} by bus.
e.zh: 学生们计划周末乘巴士来一次短途游。

touristically.t: 以旅游方式；从旅游角度

e.en: The island is {touristically} developed but still quiet.
e.zh: 这座岛在旅游方面已有开发，但仍然安静。

e.en: The report evaluates the valley {touristically}.
e.zh: 这份报告从旅游角度评估了这个山谷。

e.en: Seasonal {touristry} supports many families in the village.
e.zh: 季节性旅游业支撑着村里许多家庭。

e.en: The book criticizes cheap {touristry} in sacred places.
e.zh: 这本书批评圣地里的廉价观光活动。

e.en: The ring was set with a pink {tourmalin}.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶着一颗粉色碧玺。

e.en: Miners found {tourmalin} in the granite vein.
e.zh: 矿工们在花岗岩脉中发现了电气石。

e.en: The geologist studied {tourmalinization} around the ore body.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了矿体周围的电气石化作用。

e.en: Strong {tourmalinization} altered the original rock texture.
e.zh: 强烈的电气石化作用改变了原岩结构。

e.en: The museum displayed fine wooden {tournery} from the region.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了该地区精美的木质旋制品。

e.en: He learned {tournery} from an old craftsman.
e.zh: 他向一位老匠人学习车削工艺。

e.en: Her graceful {tournure} impressed the audience.
e.zh: 她优雅的风姿给观众留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The sentence has a distinctly French {tournure}.
e.zh: 这个句子有一种明显的法式措辞。

e.en: The wind began to {touzle} his hair.
e.zh: 风开始把他的头发吹得乱蓬蓬的。

e.en: She looked charmingly {touzled} after the nap.
e.zh: 她午睡后头发有些凌乱，却显得很可爱。

e.en: Welcome, {tovarich}, to our little meeting.
e.zh: 欢迎你，同志，来参加我们的小会。

e.en: The old novel used {tovarich} for every Soviet soldier.
e.zh: 那本老小说把每个苏联士兵都称作同志。

e.en: The guard nodded and said, {tovarisch}.
e.zh: 卫兵点点头，说了一声同志。

e.en: In the translation, {tovarisch} sounded deliberately foreign.
e.zh: 在译文里，tovarisch 这个称呼显得刻意带有异国味。

e.en: Come closer, {tovarish}, and hear the news.
e.zh: 靠近些，同志，听听这个消息。

e.en: He used {tovarish} with a theatrical Russian accent.
e.zh: 他说同志这个词时故意带着夸张的俄国口音。

e.en: The poem begins with a mysterious {tove}.
e.zh: 这首诗一开头就出现了一个神秘的虚构动物。

e.en: A child drew a {tove} with long ears.
e.zh: 一个孩子画了一只长耳朵的虚构小兽。

tow-headed.t: 淡金发的；亚麻色头发的

e.en: A {tow-headed} boy ran across the field.
e.zh: 一个淡金发的小男孩跑过田野。

e.en: She remembered him as a shy, {tow-headed} child.
e.zh: 她记得他小时候害羞，头发是亚麻色的。

e.en: The researchers lowered a {tow-net} behind the boat.
e.zh: 研究人员把一张拖网放到船后。

e.en: A torn {tow-net} delayed the survey at sea.
e.zh: 一张破损的拖网耽误了海上调查。

e.en: We attached a {tow-rope} to the bumper.
e.zh: 我们把拖车绳系在保险杠上。

e.en: The climbers used a {tow-rope} to haul the sled.
e.zh: 登山者用牵引绳拖着雪橇前进。

e.en: A {tow-truck} arrived after midnight.
e.zh: 一辆拖车在午夜后赶到了。

e.en: She called a {tow-truck} when the engine died.
e.zh: 发动机熄火后，她叫了一辆道路救援车。

e.en: The small trailer is {towable} by most cars.
e.zh: 这辆小拖车大多数汽车都能牵引。

e.en: They chose a {towable} generator for the construction site.
e.zh: 他们为工地选了一台可拖曳的发电机。

e.en: The company charges extra for {towage} in bad weather.
e.zh: 恶劣天气下，这家公司会额外收取拖船服务费。

e.en: Harbor rules require licensed crews for {towage}.
e.zh: 港口规定拖曳作业必须由持证船员执行。

e.en: Her {towardliness} made the difficult training easier.
e.zh: 她乐于配合的态度让艰难的训练轻松了些。

e.en: The teacher praised the child's unusual {towardliness}.
e.zh: 老师称赞这个孩子少见的顺从懂事。

e.en: The sign warned of immediate {towaway} after six.
e.zh: 牌子警告六点后会立即拖车。

e.en: He paid the {towaway} fee at the impound lot.
e.zh: 他在扣车场缴了拖车处罚费。

e.en: Hang the wet towel on the {towel-rail}.
e.zh: 把湿毛巾挂在毛巾架上。

e.en: The heated {towel-rail} warmed the small bathroom.
e.zh: 加热毛巾架让小浴室变暖了。

e.en: He was fired for calling a customer a {towelhead}.
e.zh: 他因把顾客叫作带有侮辱性的“包头巾者”而被解雇。

e.en: The novel exposes how words like {towelhead} spread hatred.
e.zh: 这部小说揭示了这类辱称如何传播仇恨。

e.en: They live on the tenth floor of a {tower-block}.
e.zh: 他们住在一栋高层住宅楼的十层。

e.en: The old {tower-block} was renovated last year.
e.zh: 那栋旧塔楼去年翻新了。

towerman.t: 塔楼看守；信号塔操作员

e.en: The {towerman} watched the railway signals all night.
e.zh: 那名信号塔操作员整夜盯着铁路信号。

e.en: An old {towerman} kept the fire lookout during summer.
e.zh: 一位老塔楼看守在夏天负责观察火情。

e.en: The old castle looked {towery} against the gray sky.
e.zh: 那座古堡在灰色天空下显得塔楼林立。

e.en: They admired the {towery} cliffs above the harbor.
e.zh: 他们欣赏港口上方高耸如塔的峭壁。

e.en: A {towhee} scratched under the leaves near the path.
e.zh: 一只唧鹀在小路旁的落叶下扒找食物。

e.en: We heard a {towhee} singing from the brush.
e.zh: 我们听见一只唧鹀在灌木丛里鸣叫。

towie.t: 拖车司机；拖车服务人员

e.en: The {towie} arrived before the rain started.
e.zh: 拖车司机在下雨前赶到了。

e.en: She thanked the {towie} for rescuing her car.
e.zh: 她感谢拖车服务人员救援了她的车。

e.en: The {towkay} greeted every customer by name.
e.zh: 那位老板能叫出每位顾客的名字。

e.en: His grandfather was a respected {towkay} in the town.
e.zh: 他的祖父曾是镇上受人尊敬的华商。

e.en: The {town-folk} gathered for the harvest fair.
e.zh: 镇民们聚在一起参加丰收集市。

e.en: Country customs surprised the visiting {town-folk}.
e.zh: 乡间习俗让来访的城里人感到意外。

townee.t: 城镇居民；大学城本地人

e.en: As a {townee}, he knew every back street.
e.zh: 作为本地镇民，他熟悉每一条后街。

e.en: The students rarely mixed with the {townee} families.
e.zh: 学生们很少和大学城的本地家庭来往。

e.en: They stopped at a quiet {townet} by the river.
e.zh: 他们在河边一个安静的小镇停了下来。

e.en: The map marked each village and {townet} along the road.
e.zh: 地图标出了路边的每个村庄和小城镇。

e.en: The mayor spoke at the {townhall} meeting.
e.zh: 市长在市民大会上发言。

e.en: They restored the old {townhall} after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾后他们修复了那座旧市政厅。

e.en: The village had become more {townish} over time.
e.zh: 这个村子随着时间变得更像城镇了。

e.en: He disliked her {townish} manners at the farm.
e.zh: 他不喜欢她在农场表现出的城里派头。

e.en: Each {townland} had its own old boundary stones.
e.zh: 每个乡镇地段都有自己的旧界石。

e.en: The family name was tied to a small {townland}.
e.zh: 这个家族姓氏与一小块爱尔兰乡镇地段有关。

e.en: They crossed a {townless} stretch of open country.
e.zh: 他们穿过一片没有城镇的开阔乡野。

e.en: The map showed a nearly {townless} coastal region.
e.zh: 地图显示那片海岸地区几乎没有城镇。

e.en: A quiet {townlet} lay beyond the hills.
e.zh: 山那边坐落着一个安静的小镇。

e.en: The train paused at every {townlet} on the line.
e.zh: 火车在沿线每个小城镇都停了一下。

e.en: A {townswoman} led the protest outside the hall.
e.zh: 一名女镇民在大厅外带头抗议。

e.en: The story follows a young {townswoman} seeking work.
e.zh: 这个故事讲述一位年轻城镇女子找工作的经历。

e.en: They walked {townward} as the sun went down.
e.zh: 太阳落山时，他们朝城里走去。

e.en: The {townward} road was crowded with carts.
e.zh: 通往城镇的路上挤满了马车。

e.en: The refugees moved {townwards} after dawn.
e.zh: 天亮后，难民们朝城镇方向移动。

e.en: He glanced {townwards} before crossing the field.
e.zh: 穿过田地前，他朝城里方向看了一眼。

e.en: She packed her {townwear} for the weekend visit.
e.zh: 她为周末出行收拾了城里穿的衣服。

e.en: His boots looked too rough for {townwear}.
e.zh: 他的靴子看起来太粗犷，不适合当外出服。

e.en: The sailor checked the {towrope} before the rescue.
e.zh: 救援前，水手检查了拖缆。

e.en: A frayed {towrope} snapped under the heavy strain.
e.zh: 磨损的牵引用绳在重压下断了。

e.en: The crew coiled the {towropes} on the deck.
e.zh: 船员把拖缆盘放在甲板上。

e.en: Old {towropes} hung from the barn wall.
e.zh: 旧牵引用绳索挂在谷仓墙上。

e.en: Their old {towser} barked at every stranger.
e.zh: 他们家的老大狗对每个陌生人都吠叫。

e.en: In debate, she was a real {towser}.
e.zh: 在辩论中，她真是个厉害角色。

e.en: The old report grouped the substance under {toxa}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这种物质归在毒素相关成分下。

e.en: Students rarely encounter {toxa} outside medical terminology.
e.zh: 学生很少在医学术语之外遇到toxa这个词。

e.en: The doctor suspected {toxaemia} after the infection spread.
e.zh: 感染扩散后，医生怀疑出现了毒血症。

e.en: Severe {toxaemia} can affect several organs.
e.zh: 严重毒血症可能影响多个器官。

e.en: The patient appeared {toxaemic} and very weak.
e.zh: 病人看起来有毒血症表现，而且十分虚弱。

e.en: A {toxaemic} condition requires urgent treatment.
e.zh: 毒血症状态需要紧急治疗。

e.en: Ricin is often described as a {toxalbumin}.
e.zh: 蓖麻毒素常被描述为一种毒白蛋白。

e.en: The seed contains a dangerous {toxalbumin}.
e.zh: 这种种子含有一种危险的毒白蛋白。

e.en: The nurse noted {toxemic} symptoms in the chart.
e.zh: 护士在病历中记录了毒血症症状。

e.en: A {toxemic} patient may deteriorate quickly.
e.zh: 毒血症患者可能会迅速恶化。

e.en: The chemist isolated {toxicarol} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出鱼藤毒醇。

e.en: Old pesticide studies sometimes mention {toxicarol}.
e.zh: 早期农药研究有时会提到鱼藤毒醇。

e.en: The paper used {toxication} to describe gradual poisoning.
e.zh: 论文用toxication来描述逐渐中毒的过程。

e.en: Repeated exposure caused {toxication} in the test animals.
e.zh: 反复接触使实验动物发生了中毒。

e.en: The laboratory tested a new {toxicide} on contaminated samples.
e.zh: 实验室在受污染样本上测试了一种新的杀毒剂。

e.en: A strong {toxicide} may also harm healthy cells.
e.zh: 强效杀毒剂也可能损害健康细胞。

e.en: The strain showed {toxicogenic} activity in culture.
e.zh: 该菌株在培养中表现出产毒活性。

e.en: Researchers examined the {toxicogenic} effect of the compound.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了这种化合物的致毒作用。

e.en: The reaction produced a {toxicoid} substance.
e.zh: 该反应产生了一种类毒素样物质。

e.en: Doctors used {toxicoid} to describe the unusual symptoms.
e.zh: 医生用toxicoid来描述这些异常症状。

e.en: The clinic treated cases of {toxicomania}.
e.zh: 这家诊所治疗药物成瘾病例。

e.en: Older psychiatry texts used {toxicomania} for drug dependence.
e.zh: 早期精神病学文献用toxicomania指药物依赖。

e.en: Vitamin D {toxicosis} can be serious.
e.zh: 维生素D中毒症可能很严重。

e.en: The veterinarian diagnosed {toxicosis} after the dog ate poison.
e.zh: 狗吃下毒物后，兽医诊断为中毒症。

e.en: The plant has {toxiferous} seeds.
e.zh: 这种植物的种子有毒。

e.en: Some {toxiferous} bacteria contaminate food.
e.zh: 一些产毒细菌会污染食物。

e.en: The assay detected a {toxigene} in the sample.
e.zh: 检测在样本中发现了毒素基因。

e.en: A missing {toxigene} made the strain less harmful.
e.zh: 缺少一个毒素基因使该菌株危害较低。

e.en: Temperature influenced {toxigenesis} in the culture.
e.zh: 温度影响了培养物中的毒素生成。

e.en: The study focused on bacterial {toxigenesis}.
e.zh: 这项研究聚焦于细菌的毒素生成。

e.en: A {toxigenic} strain caused the outbreak.
e.zh: 一种产毒菌株导致了这次暴发。

e.en: The lab screened for {toxigenic} bacteria in the food.
e.zh: 实验室筛查了食物中的产毒细菌。

e.en: Bacteria use a {toxinantitoxin} system to survive stress.
e.zh: 细菌利用毒素抗毒素系统来抵御压力。

e.en: The vaccine contained a {toxinantitoxin} mixture.
e.zh: 这种疫苗含有毒素抗毒素混合物。

e.en: The old experiment reported {toxipeptone} in the digest.
e.zh: 那项旧实验报告在消化产物中发现了毒性胨。

e.en: Few modern textbooks mention {toxipeptone}.
e.zh: 现代教材很少提到toxipeptone这种毒性胨。

e.en: Her {toxiphobia} made restaurant meals difficult.
e.zh: 她的中毒恐惧症让外出就餐变得困难。

e.en: The therapist treated {toxiphobia} with gradual exposure.
e.zh: 治疗师用逐步暴露法治疗中毒恐惧症。

e.en: The case notes described {toxiphrenia} after chemical exposure.
e.zh: 病例记录描述了化学暴露后的中毒性精神障碍。

e.en: Older doctors used {toxiphrenia} for toxin-related confusion.
e.zh: 早期医生用toxiphrenia指与毒素有关的意识混乱。

e.en: The pathogen produces {toxoflavin} during infection.
e.zh: 这种病原体在感染过程中产生毒黄素。

e.en: Researchers measured {toxoflavin} levels in the culture.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了培养物中的毒黄素水平。

e.en: The tumor was thought to release a {toxohormone}.
e.zh: 人们认为该肿瘤会释放一种毒激素。

e.en: Early cancer studies discussed {toxohormone} effects.
e.zh: 早期癌症研究讨论过毒激素效应。

e.en: Foodborne {toxoinfection} can spread through contaminated meat.
e.zh: 食源性毒素感染可通过受污染肉类传播。

e.en: The diagnosis was bacterial {toxoinfection}.
e.zh: 诊断结果是细菌性产毒感染。

e.en: The serum contained a measurable {toxolysin}.
e.zh: 血清中含有可测量的溶毒素。

e.en: Scientists studied how {toxolysin} broke down the toxin.
e.zh: 科学家研究了溶毒素如何分解毒素。

e.en: The lecture defined a {toxon} as a toxic unit.
e.zh: 讲座把toxon定义为一种毒素作用单位。

e.en: Older immunology papers sometimes mention {toxon}.
e.zh: 早期免疫学论文有时会提到toxon。

toxonosis.t: 毒素引起的疾病或中毒状态

e.en: The veterinarian suspected {toxonosis} after the animals ate spoiled feed.
e.zh: 动物吃了变质饲料后，兽医怀疑它们出现了毒素性疾病。

e.en: Early reports described the outbreak as a form of {toxonosis}.
e.zh: 早期报告把这次暴发描述为一种中毒状态。

e.en: The old {toxophilite} repaired his bow before dawn.
e.zh: 那位年长的射箭爱好者在黎明前修好了弓。

e.en: As a keen {toxophilite}, she practiced on the range every weekend.
e.zh: 作为热心的射箭爱好者，她每个周末都在靶场练习。

e.en: The club preserved several {toxophilitic} traditions from the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 这个俱乐部保留了几项十九世纪的射箭传统。

e.en: His {toxophilitic} enthusiasm filled the garage with bows and targets.
e.zh: 他对射箭的热情让车库里堆满了弓和靶子。

e.en: Her interest in {toxophily} began during a summer camp.
e.zh: 她对射箭的兴趣始于一次夏令营。

e.en: Medieval poems sometimes treat {toxophily} as a noble art.
e.zh: 中世纪诗歌有时把射箭术视为高雅技艺。

toxophore.t: 毒性基团；毒性载体部分

e.en: The chemist identified a {toxophore} in the new compound.
e.zh: 化学家在这种新化合物中发现了一个毒性基团。

e.en: Removing the {toxophore} made the molecule much safer.
e.zh: 去除毒性载体部分后，这个分子安全得多。

e.en: The paper proposed {toxophylaxin} as a protective factor in serum.
e.zh: 论文提出血清中的抗毒防护物质可能起保护作用。

e.en: Researchers tried to isolate {toxophylaxin} from the treated animals.
e.zh: 研究人员试图从处理过的动物体内分离出抗毒防护物质。

e.en: The stained slide revealed {toxoplasm} inside the host cell.
e.zh: 染色切片显示宿主细胞内有弓形虫体。

e.en: Older pathology texts used {toxoplasm} for certain parasitic material.
e.zh: 较早的病理学文本用toxoplasm指某些寄生性物质。

e.en: The patient showed signs of a {toxoplasmic} infection.
e.zh: 患者出现了弓形虫感染的迹象。

e.en: Doctors monitored the infant for {toxoplasmic} eye damage.
e.zh: 医生监测这名婴儿是否有弓形虫病导致的眼部损伤。

e.en: The obsolete term {toxosozin} appeared in an immunology footnote.
e.zh: 这个过时术语toxosozin出现在一条免疫学脚注中。

e.en: Scientists once hoped {toxosozin} could explain natural resistance to toxins.
e.zh: 科学家曾希望抗毒保护物质能解释机体对毒素的天然抵抗力。

e.en: The doctor considered {toxuria} after the abnormal urine test.
e.zh: 尿检异常后，医生考虑可能存在尿中含毒素的情况。

e.en: Severe poisoning may lead to {toxuria} in rare cases.
e.zh: 严重中毒在少数情况下可能导致尿中出现毒素。

e.en: The old herbal described the plant as {toxy} and dangerous.
e.zh: 那本旧草药书把这种植物描述为有毒且危险。

e.en: He used {toxy} as a playful shorthand for toxic behavior.
e.zh: 他把toxy当作toxic behavior的俏皮简写。

e.en: The manuscript used {toxynon} for an unnamed poisonous substance.
e.zh: 手稿用toxynon指一种未命名的有毒物质。

e.en: Modern readers may find {toxynon} only in historical medical glossaries.
e.zh: 现代读者可能只会在医学史词汇表中见到toxynon。

e.en: The tabloids called him her {toy-boy} after the photos appeared.
e.zh: 照片曝光后，小报称他是她的年轻男情人。

e.en: She disliked the phrase {toy-boy} because it sounded dismissive.
e.zh: 她不喜欢toy-boy这个说法，因为听起来很轻蔑。

e.en: A painted {toy-soldier} stood beside the model castle.
e.zh: 一个上了色的玩具士兵站在模型城堡旁。

e.en: He moved each {toy-soldier} across the carpet battlefield.
e.zh: 他把每个玩具士兵移过地毯上的战场。

e.en: The herald would {toyear} the news across the square.
e.zh: 传令员会在广场上高声宣布消息。

e.en: She tried to {toyear} a warning above the storm.
e.zh: 她试图在暴风雨声中高喊警告。

e.en: The nursery looked {toyful} after the birthday party.
e.zh: 生日派对后，儿童房里满是玩具。

e.en: His {toyful} mood made the dull meeting lighter.
e.zh: 他嬉戏般的情绪让沉闷的会议轻松了一些。

e.en: The crowd began to {toyi-toyi} outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 人群开始在法院外跳起南非抗议舞。

e.en: Reporters described the rhythmic {toyi-toyi} during the march.
e.zh: 记者描述了游行中有节奏的toyi-toyi抗议舞。

e.en: The tiny car had a {toyish} charm.
e.zh: 这辆小车有一种玩具般的可爱感。

e.en: Critics found the villain too {toyish} to be frightening.
e.zh: 评论家觉得这个反派太幼稚，不够吓人。

e.en: The shop window looked like {toyland} at Christmas.
e.zh: 圣诞节时，商店橱窗看起来像玩具世界。

e.en: The children imagined the attic as a secret {toyland}.
e.zh: 孩子们把阁楼想象成一个秘密的童话乐园。

e.en: The drone looked {toylike} but carried a real camera.
e.zh: 这架无人机看起来像玩具，却装着真正的摄像头。

e.en: From the hill, the houses seemed small and {toylike}.
e.zh: 从山上看，那些房子显得小小的，像玩具一样。

e.en: The village {toyman} carved wooden animals by hand.
e.zh: 村里的玩具制作人手工雕刻木制动物。

e.en: A cheerful {toyman} ran the small shop near the station.
e.zh: 一位快活的玩具商经营着车站附近的小店。

toyocamycin.t: 丰加霉素；核苷类抗生素

e.en: The lab tested {toyocamycin} against several cancer cell lines.
e.zh: 实验室测试了丰加霉素对几种癌细胞系的作用。

e.en: Researchers described {toyocamycin} as a nucleoside antibiotic.
e.zh: 研究人员把丰加霉素描述为一种核苷类抗生素。

toyon.t: 加州圣诞莓灌木及其红果；冬青叶石楠属植物

e.en: The hillside was dotted with red {toyon} berries in December.
e.zh: 十二月的山坡上点缀着红色的加州圣诞莓果。

e.en: Gardeners plant {toyon} because it tolerates dry summers.
e.zh: 园丁种植加州圣诞莓，因为它能耐受干燥的夏季。

e.en: She sang a cheerful {tra-la} while setting the table.
e.zh: 她一边摆餐具，一边哼着欢快的啦啦调。

e.en: His speech ended with vague {tra-la} about future harmony.
e.zh: 他的演讲最后说了些关于未来和谐的空泛漂亮话。

tra-la-la.t: 啦啦啦的哼唱声；轻浮空话

e.en: The children skipped down the path singing {tra-la-la}.
e.zh: 孩子们沿着小路蹦跳着，唱着啦啦啦。

e.en: The report avoided details and offered only {tra-la-la}.
e.zh: 那份报告避开细节，只说了些轻飘飘的空话。

e.en: The temple has a {trabeate} entrance supported by stone columns.
e.zh: 这座神庙有一处由石柱支撑的梁柱式入口。

e.en: Architects contrasted the {trabeate} frame with later arched forms.
e.zh: 建筑师把这种梁柱式框架同后来的拱形结构作了对比。

trabeated.t: 梁柱结构的；用横梁架成的

e.en: The museum preserves a {trabeated} hall from the old palace.
e.zh: 博物馆保存着旧宫殿里一座梁柱结构的大厅。

e.en: A {trabeated} doorway creates a heavy, formal impression.
e.zh: 梁柱式门口会造成厚重而庄严的印象。

trabeation.t: 梁柱式结构；横梁承重法

e.en: Classical Greek buildings often rely on {trabeation} rather than arches.
e.zh: 古典希腊建筑常依靠梁柱式结构，而不是拱券。

e.en: The lecture explained how {trabeation} limits the width of openings.
e.zh: 讲座解释了横梁承重法如何限制开口的宽度。

trabecula.t: 小梁；骨小梁或组织支架

e.en: Each {trabecula} helps support the spongy structure of bone.
e.zh: 每一根骨小梁都有助于支撑骨的海绵状结构。

e.en: The microscope showed a thin {trabecula} crossing the tissue sample.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见一条细小梁横穿组织样本。

trabecules.t: 小梁；组织或骨内细支架

e.en: The scan revealed delicate {trabecules} inside the vertebra.
e.zh: 扫描显示椎骨内部有精细的骨小梁。

e.en: Fibrous {trabecules} divided the soft tissue into small spaces.
e.zh: 纤维状小梁把软组织分隔成许多小空隙。

e.en: The company improved {traceability} for every batch of medicine.
e.zh: 公司提高了每批药品的可追溯性。

e.en: Good {traceability} lets engineers find where a defect began.
e.zh: 良好的追踪能力能让工程师找到缺陷最初出现的位置。

e.en: The thief made a nearly {traceless} escape through the crowd.
e.zh: 小偷几乎不留痕迹地穿过人群逃走了。

e.en: The software promises {traceless} browsing on shared computers.
e.zh: 这款软件承诺在共用电脑上实现无痕浏览。

e.en: The botanist studied {tracheary} elements in the stem.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了茎中的导管状细胞。

e.en: Some insects have complex {tracheary} systems for carrying air.
e.zh: 一些昆虫有复杂的气管系统来输送空气。

e.en: Insects are {tracheate} animals that breathe through tiny tubes.
e.zh: 昆虫是有气管的动物，通过细小管道呼吸。

e.en: The textbook grouped spiders with other {tracheate} arthropods.
e.zh: 教材把蜘蛛同其他有气管的节肢动物归为一类。

tracheated.t: 具气管的；带气管结构的

e.en: The specimen showed a clearly {tracheated} respiratory network.
e.zh: 标本显示出清晰的气管状呼吸网络。

e.en: A {tracheated} leaf vein can move water efficiently through the plant.
e.zh: 具导管结构的叶脉能在植物体内高效输送水分。

e.en: A {tracheid} carries water upward in many vascular plants.
e.zh: 管胞在许多维管植物中把水向上输送。

e.en: Under the microscope, each {tracheid} looked long and narrow.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，每个管胞都显得又长又窄。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed bacterial {tracheitis} after the child struggled to breathe.
e.zh: 孩子呼吸困难后，医生诊断为细菌性气管炎。

e.en: Hoarseness and coughing can occur with {tracheitis}.
e.zh: 气管炎可能伴随声音嘶哑和咳嗽。

e.en: The neurologist noted {trachelismus} during the physical examination.
e.zh: 神经科医生在体格检查中注意到颈肌痉挛。

e.en: Severe {trachelismus} made it painful for him to turn his head.
e.zh: 严重的颈部强直使他转头时感到疼痛。

e.en: Smoke irritated the {tracheobronchial} lining of the patient's airway.
e.zh: 烟雾刺激了患者气管支气管部位的气道内膜。

e.en: The study measured airflow in the {tracheobronchial} tree.
e.zh: 研究测量了气管支气管树中的气流。

e.en: The veterinarian treated the dog for infectious {tracheobronchitis}.
e.zh: 兽医为这只狗治疗传染性气管支气管炎。

e.en: Persistent coughing may be a sign of {tracheobronchitis}.
e.zh: 持续咳嗽可能是气管支气管炎的表现。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {tracheobronchomalacia} after noisy breathing episodes.
e.zh: 婴儿出现喘鸣样呼吸后，被诊断为气管支气管软化症。

e.en: Severe {tracheobronchomalacia} can cause airway collapse during exhalation.
e.zh: 严重的气管支气管软化症可导致呼气时气道塌陷。

e.en: CT imaging showed {tracheobronchomegaly} in the adult patient.
e.zh: CT影像显示这名成年患者有气管支气管巨大症。

e.en: People with {tracheobronchomegaly} may develop repeated chest infections.
e.zh: 气管支气管巨大症患者可能反复发生胸部感染。

tracheoesophageal.t: 气管食管的；连通气管与食管的

e.en: The newborn needed surgery for a {tracheoesophageal} fistula.
e.zh: 这名新生儿因气管食管瘘需要手术。

e.en: A {tracheoesophageal} voice prosthesis helped him speak after surgery.
e.zh: 气管食管发声假体帮助他在术后说话。

tracheole.t: 昆虫气管末梢微管；气管小管

e.en: Oxygen diffuses through each {tracheole} into the insect's tissues.
e.zh: 氧气通过每根气管小管扩散到昆虫组织中。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {tracheoles} formed a fine branching network.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，气管末梢微管形成了细密的分支网络。

tracheophyte.t: 维管植物；有输导组织的植物

e.en: A fern is a {tracheophyte} because it has vascular tissue.
e.zh: 蕨类是维管植物，因为它有输导组织。

e.en: The course compares mosses with {tracheophytes} in early plant evolution.
e.zh: 这门课比较苔藓和维管植物在早期植物演化中的差异。

tracheopyosis.t: 气管化脓；气管脓性感染

e.en: The old report described severe {tracheopyosis} after the injury.
e.zh: 那份旧报告描述了受伤后严重的气管化脓。

e.en: Doctors now rarely use the term {tracheopyosis} in everyday records.
e.zh: 医生现在很少在日常病历中使用气管化脓这个术语。

trachybasalt.t: 粗面玄武岩；碱性火山岩

e.en: The island's cliffs contain dark layers of {trachybasalt}.
e.zh: 这座岛的峭壁中含有深色的粗面玄武岩层。

e.en: Geologists classified the sample as {trachybasalt} after chemical analysis.
e.zh: 地质学家经过化学分析后把样品归为粗面玄武岩。

trachychromatic.t: 粗染色质的；染色质粗粒的

e.en: The pathologist noted a {trachychromatic} pattern in the cell nuclei.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到细胞核呈现粗染色质样模式。

e.en: A {trachychromatic} nucleus can suggest abnormal cell development.
e.zh: 粗染色质的细胞核可能提示细胞发育异常。

e.en: The botanist described the plant as {trachyspermous} in her notes.
e.zh: 那位植物学家在笔记中把这种植物描述为种子粗糙。

e.en: A {trachyspermous} surface helps distinguish this species from its relatives.
e.zh: 粗糙的种子表面有助于把这个物种同近缘种区分开。

e.en: The old fortress was built from blocks of {trachyte}.
e.zh: 这座老堡垒是用粗面岩石块建成的。

e.en: Fresh {trachyte} often shows a rough, feldspar-rich texture.
e.zh: 新鲜的粗面岩常呈现粗糙且富含长石的质地。

trachytic.t: 粗面岩的；具粗面结构的

e.en: The lava cooled into a pale {trachytic} rock.
e.zh: 熔岩冷却后形成了浅色的粗面岩质岩石。

e.en: Thin sections revealed a clear {trachytic} texture.
e.zh: 薄片显示出清楚的粗面结构。

e.en: She joined the {track-and-field} team at school.
e.zh: 她加入了学校的田径队。

e.en: The stadium hosts a major {track-and-field} meet every spring.
e.zh: 这座体育场每年春天都会举办大型田径比赛。

track-clearer.t: 清轨器；清除轨道障碍者

e.en: The railway crew sent a {track-clearer} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，铁路工人派出了清轨设备。

e.en: A good {track-clearer} removes snow before trains arrive.
e.zh: 好的清轨器会在列车到达前清除积雪。

e.en: Please wipe your boots so you do not {track-in} mud.
e.zh: 请擦擦靴子，免得把泥带进来。

e.en: The cleaner complained about constant {track-in} from the wet hallway.
e.zh: 清洁工抱怨潮湿走廊总有人把污物带进屋。

e.en: The company has a strong {track-record} of safety.
e.zh: 这家公司有良好的安全记录。

e.en: Voters questioned his {track-record} on education reform.
e.zh: 选民质疑他在教育改革方面的过往表现。

e.en: He wore a blue {track-suit} to the gym.
e.zh: 他穿着一套蓝色运动服去健身房。

e.en: The coach handed every runner a new {track-suit}.
e.zh: 教练给每位跑者发了一套新的训练服。

track-suited.t: 穿运动服的；适合赛道的

e.en: A {track-suited} man waited outside the locker room.
e.zh: 一个穿运动服的男人在更衣室外等着。

e.en: The bike was {track-suited} rather than built for city streets.
e.zh: 这辆自行车更适合赛道，而不是为城市街道设计的。

track-while-scan.t: 边扫描边跟踪；雷达跟踪模式

e.en: The radar used {track-while-scan} to monitor several aircraft.
e.zh: 雷达使用边扫描边跟踪模式监视多架飞机。

e.en: In {track-while-scan}, the system updates targets without stopping its sweep.
e.zh: 在边扫描边跟踪模式下，系统不停下扫描也能更新目标。

trackable.t: 可追踪的；可跟踪定位的

e.en: Every parcel is {trackable} through the delivery app.
e.zh: 每个包裹都可以通过配送应用追踪。

e.en: The tagged birds became {trackable} across their migration route.
e.zh: 装上标记后，这些鸟在迁徙路线中都可被跟踪。

trackage.t: 铁路轨道总长；轨道系统

e.en: The company owns miles of freight {trackage}.
e.zh: 这家公司拥有数英里的货运铁路轨道。

e.en: Flooding damaged the {trackage} near the river.
e.zh: 洪水损坏了河边的铁路轨道系统。

trackback.t: 反向链接；追溯引用通知

e.en: The blog sent a {trackback} to the original article.
e.zh: 这篇博客向原文发送了反向链接通知。

e.en: Old blogging software often displayed each {trackback} below the post.
e.zh: 旧式博客软件常把每条追溯引用显示在文章下方。

e.en: The {tracklayer} aligned the rails before the train arrived.
e.zh: 铺轨工在列车到达前校准了铁轨。

e.en: A heavy {tracklayer} moved slowly along the new line.
e.zh: 一台重型铺轨机械沿着新线路缓慢前进。

trackman.t: 铁路巡道工；赛道工作人员

e.en: The {trackman} inspected the rails before dawn.
e.zh: 铁路巡道工在黎明前检查了铁轨。

e.en: A {trackman} waved the runners back after the false start.
e.zh: 一次抢跑后，赛道工作人员挥手让选手回到起点。

e.en: Use the {trackpad} to scroll down the page.
e.zh: 用触控板向下滚动页面。

e.en: My laptop {trackpad} stopped responding after the update.
e.zh: 更新后，我的笔记本触控板没有反应了。

e.en: The driver reduced power to prevent {trackslip} on the wet rails.
e.zh: 司机降低动力，以防列车在湿轨上打滑。

e.en: Engineers investigated the {trackslip} reported during acceleration.
e.zh: 工程师调查了加速过程中报告的车轮打滑问题。

e.en: The young {trackster} won three races on Saturday.
e.zh: 那位年轻的径赛运动员周六赢了三场比赛。

e.en: She packed a warm {trackster} for the early-morning run.
e.zh: 她为清晨跑步带了一条保暖跑步裤。

trackwalker.t: 铁路巡道工；沿轨行走者

e.en: The {trackwalker} checked the rails after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，铁路巡道工检查了铁轨。

e.en: A lone {trackwalker} moved carefully beside the old line.
e.zh: 一个沿轨行走的人小心地走在旧铁路旁。

e.en: The problem can be solved {tractably} with this method.
e.zh: 用这种方法可以较容易地解决这个问题。

e.en: The horse moved {tractably} under the trainer's gentle hand.
e.zh: 在驯马师温和的控制下，那匹马顺从地移动。

e.en: The essay offers a careful {tractation} of moral duty.
e.zh: 这篇文章对道德责任作了细致论述。

e.en: The old medical text described {tractation} as part of treatment.
